papers.title: Does a model's stated reason for rejecting a candidate do any work?
papers.abstract_en: Asked to choose between candidates and explain the choice, a language model often rejects a rival by naming a fact its profile lacks: no director, no date of death. That sentence is a claim about the text in front of the model, and it can be tested without any judge. We insert a real corpus sentence stating the named fact into the rival's profile and ask again under greedy decoding. Two controls separate content from placement: a length-matched irrelevant sentence at the same profile, and the same two sentences at a third option the model never mentioned. In the largest of three runs, six open models on 2WikiMultihopQA, supplying the named fact at the profile the model named moves its choice more than the irrelevant control does, odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26], Holm p=0.0210, and this survives dropping any single model. The contrast the design was built to detect, the same fact at the option nobody named, does not clear correction, Holm p=0.2428. The strongest result in the family carries no content claim at all: the identical irrelevant sentence moves the choice more at the named rival than at the third option, Holm p=0.0008. Repair and control also differ in co-candidate mentions, relation template and fluency; post-hoc matching on the first two preserves the content effects' direction, matching fluency weakens one, so the content contrasts bound an effect rather than establish one. A forced single-token probability read disagrees in direction with the free-text choice on that same contrast, and three candidate explanations for the disagreement find no support. Every measurement is a string rule, so each was validated against the records it reads; validation caught eight defects. The largest, a choice-parsing rule that returned the option a model had just rejected in 17.1% of adjudicable responses, would have reported six surviving contrasts instead of four.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at LLM4XAI 2026: Workshop on Large Language Models for Explainable AI, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy, November 8, 2026. Code and per-item records: https://github.com/ArchitRastogi20/contrastive-rejection-test
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 检验语言模型给出的拒绝理由是否真的在起作用：把模型声称缺失的事实（如“无导演”“无死亡日期”）的真实语料句子插进被拒候选的档案，再用贪心解码重问。在 2WikiMultihopQA 上六个开源模型的最大一轮中，把事实插到模型点名的位置比无关对照更能改变选择，odds ratio 3.57 [1.54, 8.26]，Holm p=0.0210 且逐一剔除任一模型仍成立；但同一事实放到模型没提的第三选项不显著（Holm p=0.2428），而完全不含内容主张的对照——同一条无关句子在被点名候选处比在第三选项处更能改变选择——Holm p=0.0008。作者据此把内容效应定为上界而非确证，并指出字符串规则的验证抓出 8 处缺陷，其中选择解析规则在 17.1% 的可裁定回答里返回了模型刚拒绝的选项，会把存活对比从 4 个虚报成 6 个。
Motivation: 模型在解释选择时会以“档案缺少某事实”为由拒绝竞争者，但这句话是对面前文本的可检验主张，此前缺少不依赖评审的直接检验手段。
Method: 把真实语料中陈述该事实的句子插入被拒候选档案后在贪心解码下重问；两个对照分离内容与位置——同位置的长度匹配无关句子，以及同样两句放在模型从未提及的第三选项。全部测量用字符串规则实现并对照其读取的记录做验证；另做对共候选提及与关系模板的事后匹配、以及单 token 强制概率读数与自由文本选择的对照。
Result: 三个 run 中最大的一轮、六个开源模型在 2WikiMultihopQA：事实插在被点名位置 vs 无关对照 OR 3.57 [1.54, 8.26]，Holm p=0.0210，逐一剔除任一模型仍存活；同一事实放在第三选项 Holm p=0.2428 不过校正；无关句子在被点名候选处 vs 第三选项 Holm p=0.0008。事后匹配共候选提及与关系模板保持内容效应方向，匹配流畅度削弱其中一项；单 token 概率读数与自由文本选择在该对比上方向相反，三种解释均无支持。规则验证抓出 8 处缺陷，最大的一处在 17.1% 可裁定回答中返回刚被拒绝的选项，会把存活对比从 4 个报成 6 个。
Conclusion: 模型点名的缺失事实确能移动其选择，但位置本身（甚至无关句子）也能移动，因此内容对比只能界定效应上界而非确立因果；测量规则必须先对记录验证，否则会虚报存活对比。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graph-Based Inference and Topology-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Railway Network Management
papers.abstract_en: Modern infrastructure asset management constitutes a complex sequential decision-making problem, characterized by long planning horizons and system-level interactions, such as spatial deterioration correlations and economies of scale. While deep reinforcement learning has shown promise in optimizing maintenance policies, scaling to real-world networks remains challenging. Centralized approaches become computationally intractable in large-scale systems, whereas decentralized approaches often fail to capture essential coordination mechanisms. To address these challenges, we propose a graph-based framework that integrates accurate environment modeling with scalable decision support. First, we employ a hierarchical Bayesian model leveraging a Gaussian Process on Graph kernel to infer a realistic, spatially correlated networked environment of railway maintenance planning from real-world data provided by the Swiss Federal Railways. Second, we introduce a topology-aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework by integrating graph neural networks and graph Transformers to optimize network-level policies. A central contribution of this work is the demonstration of scalability through zero-shot transfer learning: graph-based agents, trained only on small network portions, are successfully deployed in a zero-shot manner on large-scale unseen networks without any retraining. Numerical results indicate that the proposed method significantly outperforms optimized heuristics and standard MARL baselines, reducing computational training time while maintaining superior performance on large-scale networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向瑞士联邦铁路网的基础设施维护决策，用图上高斯过程核的分层贝叶斯模型从真实数据推断空间相关的劣化环境，再用图神经网络与图 Transformer 的拓扑感知多智能体强化学习优化网络级维护策略。核心结论是只在小网络片段上训练的图智能体可零样本 (zero-shot) 部署到未见过的大规模网络，无需重训练，数值结果显著优于优化启发式与标准 MARL 基线，并缩短训练时间。
Motivation: 大规模基础设施维护是长规划周期、带空间劣化相关与规模经济的序贯决策问题：集中式方法在大系统上计算不可解，去中心化方法又丢掉必要的协调机制，深度 RL 难以扩展到真实网络规模。
Method: 两阶段图框架：先用基于 Gaussian Process on Graph 核的分层贝叶斯模型，从瑞士联邦铁路 (Swiss Federal Railways) 真实数据推断空间相关的网络化维护环境；再提出拓扑感知 MARL，把图神经网络与图 Transformer 结合以优化网络级策略，并通过零样本迁移实现跨规模部署。
Result: 数值结果表明该方法在大规模网络上显著优于优化启发式与标准 MARL 基线，同时降低计算训练时间并保持更优性能；图智能体仅在小网络片段上训练即可零样本部署到大规模未见网络且无需重训练。
Conclusion: 把环境推断与拓扑感知 MARL 用图结构统一起来，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下把维护策略学习扩展到真实铁路网络规模，零样本跨规模部署是其可扩展性的关键证据。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: GRASP: Generating, Revising, and Assessing for Strategic Planning with Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) typically exhibit a performance profile where reliability degrades as task complexity increases. We address the challenge of generating high-quality natural language executable plans for complex tasks by introducing $\textbf{GRASP}$, a strategy-aware, multi-stage planning framework. GRASP decouples the planning pipeline across specialized, context-isolated modules: it pre-compiles global macro-guidelines (GenPlan), explores alternative localized strategies within isolated context windows (RevPlan), and independently evaluates trajectories using a multi-criteria discriminator (VerPlan). Empirical evaluations show that GRASP consistently establishes a new state-of-the-art frontier across diverse datasets, yielding substantial accuracy gains over direct LLM planners on Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling ($\sim$12.4$\%$$\uparrow$), ZebraLogic ($\sim$30.8$\%$$\uparrow$), and SciBench Math. Crucially, under multi-task scaling-where standard planners suffer immediate performance collapse-GRASP completely flattens the multi-task degradation penalty. In interleaved dual-task environments, GRASP achieves an absolute accuracy gain of up to 16.7$\%$ over direct LLM planners. Furthermore, by isolating context and enforcing strict macro-regularization, GRASP outperforms frontier reasoning models (such as GPT-5-mini) by a margin of 14.5$\%$.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRASP 把复杂任务的自然语言可执行规划拆成三个上下文隔离的模块：GenPlan 预编译全局宏观准则，RevPlan 在隔离窗口内探索局部替代策略，VerPlan 用多准则判别器独立评估轨迹。在 Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling、ZebraLogic、SciBench Math 上相对直接 LLM 规划器分别提升约 12.4%、30.8%，多任务交错环境下绝对精度最多高出 16.7%，并完全抹平多任务性能衰减惩罚，超过 GPT-5-mini 等前沿推理模型 14.5%。
Motivation: LLM 的可靠性随任务复杂度上升而下降，直接让单一上下文的 LLM 规划器处理复杂任务时，多任务场景会立刻出现性能崩塌。
Method: GRASP 是策略感知的多阶段规划框架，把流水线解耦为上下文隔离的专用模块：GenPlan 预编译全局宏观准则 (macro-guidelines)，RevPlan 在隔离上下文窗口内探索局部替代策略，VerPlan 用多准则判别器 (multi-criteria discriminator) 独立评估轨迹，并施加严格的宏观正则化。
Result: 相对直接 LLM 规划器的准确率提升：Natural Plan Calendar Scheduling 约 12.4%，ZebraLogic 约 30.8%，另有 SciBench Math；多任务扩展下 GRASP 完全抹平多任务衰减惩罚；交错双任务环境绝对精度提升最多 16.7%；隔离上下文加宏观正则化后超过 GPT-5-mini 达 14.5%。
Conclusion: 把规划拆成生成、修订、评估三个隔离模块并强制宏观正则化，能在复杂与多任务规划上建立新的精度前沿，并消除标准规划器的多任务崩塌。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把规划拆成生成、修订、评估三个隔离模块并强制宏观正则化，能在复杂与多任务规划上建立新的精度前沿，并消除标准规划器的多任务崩塌。

papers.title: EnigmaForge: The Question Is Hidden in the Story
papers.abstract_en: Most benchmarks hand the model a question. EnigmaForge hands it a stack of old documents and no question at all. Buried in the letters, receipts, and logbook margins is a small logic puzzle whose solution is unique - proved by a SAT solver at generation time, with an ablation certificate showing every clue is load-bearing. Because instances are generated rather than collected, the corpus renews forever. The headline measure is intuition: task success when handed only the story, with world reconstruction as the secondary axis. Twenty-five frontier models ran over 600 instances (17,400 scored records) under three matched conditions. Intuition reshuffles the leaderboard: a 22x spread where fact recovery spans 1.6x, the second-best fact-recoverer ranks fourteenth, one model is indifferent to being told the question, and another is significantly better without it. Several models were blocked by their own content filters before reaching the puzzle - any benchmark scoring refusals as failure is quietly measuring filter behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EnigmaForge 把逻辑谜题藏进旧信件、收据和账本边注里，只给模型一堆文档而不给问题，谜题唯一解在生成时由 SAT solver 证明，并附每条线索都必要的 ablation certificate。25 个前沿模型在 600 个实例（17,400 条计分记录）三种匹配条件下跑出直觉轴重排榜单：任务成功率相差 22 倍，而事实检索轴只差 1.6 倍。
Motivation: 现有基准都把问题直接交给模型，无法区分只靠事实检索和真正读懂叙事就能定位并解题的能力，榜单排名被单一能力维度锁死。
Method: 生成式语料：把唯一可解的逻辑谜题埋入 letters、receipts、logbook margins，生成时用 SAT solver 证明解唯一，并给出 ablation certificate 说明每条线索都承重；评测以只给故事时的任务成功率为首要指标（intuition），世界重建为次要轴，三种 matched 条件对照（含给不给问题）。
Result: 25 个前沿模型、600 个实例、17,400 条计分记录：直觉轴出现 22 倍差距，事实检索轴仅 1.6 倍；事实检索第二名在直觉轴排第 14；一个模型对是否被告知问题无差别，另一个在不给问题时显著更好；若干模型在到达谜题前被自身内容过滤器拦截。
Conclusion: 只给故事的任务成功率与事实检索是两条不同的能力轴，会重排模型榜单；把拒答计为失败的基准实际在测过滤器行为，生成式语料可无限续新。

papers.title: Screen Before You Serve: Simulation for Production Customer Experience AI Agents at 140M Scale
papers.abstract_en: Customer experience (CX) agents use tools and large language models to address customer requests and guide conversational interactions with an organization's products. Improving these agents, especially in regulated industries, is difficult: they must detect intent, follow complex operational policies and use tools reliably. Manual end-to-end testing offers limited coverage, while live experiments expose customers to failures that can erode trust. We present a hypothesis-driven simulation workflow for screening candidate CX agents before deployment. Synthetic customers react to agent responses and simulated tool outputs enable multi-step agentic workflows without invoking production backends. We use the Snowglobe simulator on Nubank's Card Delivery agent and its expanded successor, Card Management - Nubank's highest-volume chat-support agent in Brazil. Across 4 deployed versions, simulated and production version-level binary evaluator scores show high correlation. Simulation-guided iteration increased transactional net promoter score (tNPS) by 36.69 points in a live A/B test. We also screened open-weight configurations in over 16,000 simulated conversations. In a subsequent live A/B test, the selected model increased self-service rate (SSR) by 8.82 percentage points to the highest level observed at Nubank, with no statistically significant change in tNPS. Simulation made broad exploration of models, reasoning settings, and prompts feasible without customer exposure, enabling production improvements that would have been impractical to pursue through live experimentation alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出假设驱动的仿真筛选流程：用 Snowglobe 模拟器让合成客户对 agent 回复做出反应、并模拟工具输出，从而在不上线的情况下跑通多步 agentic 工作流。在 Nubank Card Delivery 与 Card Management 上，4 个已部署版本的仿真与生产二元评估分高度相关；仿真引导迭代使线上 A/B 的 tNPS 提升 36.69 分，筛选 16,000+ 次仿真对话选出的模型在后续 A/B 中把自助率 (SSR) 提高 8.82 个百分点至 Nubank 历史最高，tNPS 无统计显著变化。
Motivation: 受监管行业中 CX agent 要同时做意图识别、遵循复杂运营策略并可靠调用工具，人工端到端测试覆盖有限，线上实验又会让客户直接暴露在故障下、侵蚀信任。
Method: 用 Snowglobe 仿真器构建假设驱动的筛选流程：合成客户根据 agent 回复动态反应，模拟工具输出使多步 agentic 工作流无需调用生产后端即可运行；在 Nubank 的 Card Delivery 及其扩展后继 Card Management（巴西最高流量的聊天支持 agent）上，对模型、推理设置与 prompt 做大规模配置搜索，再把选出的配置放到线上 A/B 检验。
Result: 跨 4 个已部署版本，仿真与生产的版本级二元评估分呈高相关；仿真引导迭代在一次线上 A/B 中使 tNPS 提升 36.69 分；在超过 16,000 次仿真对话中筛选 open-weight 配置后，后续线上 A/B 中选中模型把自助率 (SSR) 提高 8.82 个百分点至 Nubank 观测到的最高水平，同时 tNPS 无统计显著变化。
Conclusion: 仿真可以在不暴露客户的情况下支撑模型、推理设置与 prompt 的广泛探索，从而实现仅靠线上实验难以完成的生产改进。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Multimodal Thinking with Renderable Programs
papers.abstract_en: Current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at visual content understanding and text-based reasoning, yet their structure limits the advancement of incorporating images into the reasoning chain. Though Omnimodal models have made efforts in unifying text and image generation, they focus on visual tasks in the open-domain, lacking tractability due to rasterized or latent representations of images. We introduce SVGLM, a framework that uses scalable vector graphics (SVG) primitives to connect text and image in reasoning tasks. We exploit the duality of SVG as both image description and text instructions, yielding a more compact, interpretable solution to equip general VLMs with the capability of generating images within the reasoning process. We provide a large curated dataset of SVG-based image editing dataset, as well as the paradigm to tune open-source VLMs. Experiments on a mathematical reasoning benchmark demonstrate that SVGLM achieves strong SVG generation power as well as think-with-image intelligence. Our results highlight SVG as a suitable medium for building more robust digital domain agents, bridging the gap between text-based thinking and pixel-based images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SVGLM，用 SVG 图元作为文本与图像的统一中介，让通用 VLM 在推理链中直接生成图像；利用 SVG 既是图像描述又是文本指令的二重性，得到更紧凑、可解释的方案，并配套大规模 SVG 图像编辑数据集与开源 VLM 调优范式。在数学推理基准上展示了较强的 SVG 生成能力与 think-with-image 智能。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 擅长视觉理解与文本推理，但结构上难以把图像真正嵌入推理链；全模态模型虽能统一文图生成，却依赖栅格化或隐表示，缺乏可操作性 (tractability)。
Method: SVGLM 框架以 SVG 图元连接文本与图像推理，利用 SVG 的图像描述/文本指令二重性，在推理过程中生成图像；提供大规模精选的 SVG 图像编辑数据集，并给出调优开源 VLM 的范式。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，SVGLM 展现出较强的 SVG 生成能力与 think-with-image 智能；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: SVG 是构建更稳健数字领域智能体的合适媒介，可桥接基于文本的思考与基于像素的图像。

papers.title: HEXIS: Compiling Skills into Extended Finite State Machines
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills provide reusable knowledge and instructions, yet agents must repeatedly infer how to apply them and which operation should follow. This couples task reasoning with control decisions, allowing prescribed steps to be omitted or applied incorrectly. We introduce HEXIS, which compiles agent skills into extended finite state machines that separate knowledge from control flow. Skill knowledge is incorporated into local instructions that guide reasoning and generation within states. The machine records execution progress and intermediate results, while explicit transition conditions determine subsequent operations. Our incremental compiler first maps skill clauses and tool interfaces to state operations, local instructions, data bindings, and transitions. It then aligns development traces with existing states to identify missing operations and dependencies. These are incorporated by adding or reusing states and refining their connections. Updates are accepted only after static checks and replay of the current and all previously accepted traces. Across four benchmarks and four executors, HEXIS improves success over Skill + ReAct by 16.1 percentage points on average. Qwen3.8-27B reduces execution tokens by 38.4-88.9% across benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HEXIS 把 agent skill 编译成扩展有限状态机 (EFSM)，将知识放进状态内的局部指令、把控制流交给显式转移条件，从而把任务推理与控制决策解耦。增量编译器先映射 skill 子句与工具接口为状态操作，再对齐开发轨迹补齐缺失操作，且更新须通过静态检查与新旧轨迹重放才被接受。在四个 benchmark、四种 executor 上，成功率比 Skill + ReAct 平均高 16.1 个百分点，Qwen3.8-27B 执行 token 减少 38.4–88.9%。
Motivation: agent 每次都要重新推断 skill 何时用、下一步做什么，任务推理与控制决策耦合，导致规定步骤被遗漏或误用。
Method: 增量编译器把 skill 子句与工具接口映射为状态操作、局部指令、数据绑定与转移条件；再将开发轨迹与已有状态对齐，找出缺失操作与依赖，通过新增或复用状态并细化连接来补全，更新须经静态检查与当前及全部已接受轨迹的重放。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 和四种 executor 上，HEXIS 相对 Skill + ReAct 平均提升 16.1 个百分点成功率；Qwen3.8-27B 上执行 token 在各 benchmark 减少 38.4–88.9%。
Conclusion: 把 skill 编译为带显式转移条件的 EFSM，可将知识与控制流分离，在提升成功率的同时显著压缩执行 token。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: What, When, and How: Audio Description as Constrained Global Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Audio Description (AD) makes movies accessible to blind and visually impaired audiences by narrating visual information in gaps between dialogue. Existing automatic AD systems largely treat generation as a local video-to-text problem, assuming that the content to describe and its temporal location are already provided. Realistic AD instead requires coupled decisions about what visual information is narratively important, when it can be spoken without interfering with dialogue, and how it should be formulated to fit within the available time. We formalize AD generation as a constrained optimization problem over these three decisions. Our hybrid system uses large language models to propose and ground visual elements, estimate their salience to the narrative, and generate compressed realizations. A mixed-integer linear program then jointly selects and schedules descriptions across a scene subject to temporal constraints. When evaluated on REFRAMED, a benchmark for realistic AD of movies, our approach makes better decisions than prompted LLMs about what to describe and when to describe it, establishing a new SOTA on narrative QA and temporally grounded metrics. Ablations show that explicit temporal constraints drive gains in placement, while salience estimation controls how much narratively useful content is retained. Improvements are concentrated on temporal and narrative measures rather than n-gram overlap, although a significant gap to professional describers remains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把音频描述 (Audio Description) 生成形式化为联合决定「描述什么、何时说、怎么说」的约束优化问题：LLM 提出并落地视觉元素、估计叙事显著性、生成压缩表述，再由混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 在时间约束下跨场景统一选择与排程。在 REFRAMED 基准上，该方法在叙事 QA 与时间接地指标上超过 prompted LLM，取得新 SOTA；消融显示显式时间约束带来排程位置的收益，显著性估计控制保留多少有叙事价值的内容。
Motivation: 现有自动 AD 系统把生成当作局部 video-to-text 问题，默认要描述的内容与其时间位置已给定，无法处理真实场景中三个耦合的决策。
Method: 混合系统：LLM 提出并 grounding 视觉元素、估计其对叙事的显著性、生成压缩后的表述；随后用混合整数线性规划在时间约束下跨场景联合选择并排程描述。
Result: 在 REFRAMED（真实电影 AD 基准）上，叙事 QA 与时间接地指标优于 prompted LLM，建立新 SOTA；消融表明显式时间约束驱动排程位置 (placement) 的提升，显著性估计控制保留内容量；改进集中在时间与叙事指标而非 n-gram 重叠，与专业描述者仍有显著差距。
Conclusion: 把 AD 的内容选择与时间排程作为带约束的全局优化联合求解，比让 LLM 局部生成更能决定描述什么与何时描述；但 n-gram 重叠改善有限，且距专业描述者仍有明显差距。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动 AD 系统把生成当作局部 video-to-text 问题，默认要描述的内容与其时间位置已给定，无法处理真实场景中三个耦合的决策。
summary_sections.method: 混合系统：LLM 提出并 grounding 视觉元素、估计其对叙事的显著性、生成压缩后的表述；随后用混合整数线性规划在时间约束下跨场景联合选择并排程描述。
summary_sections.result: 在 REFRAMED（真实电影 AD 基准）上，叙事 QA 与时间接地指标优于 prompted LLM，建立新 SOTA；消融表明显式时间约束驱动排程位置 (placement) 的提升，显著性估计控制保留内容量；改进集中在时间与叙事指标而非 n-gram 重叠，与专业描述者仍有显著差距。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 AD 的内容选择与时间排程作为带约束的全局优化联合求解，比让 LLM 局部生成更能决定描述什么与何时描述；但 n-gram 重叠改善有限，且距专业描述者仍有明显差距。

papers.title: Orbital Error Dynamics: Self-Organized Criticality, Ephemeral Parameter Resonance, and Non-Linear Biological Ontologies in Zero-Storage Neural Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep neural networks treat parameters as static floating-point matrices stored in physical memory, incurring Von Neumann memory bottlenecks and representation collapse. We formulate Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), an analytical framework wherein synaptic weights are not stored masses (O(W)), but transient topological resonances (O(1)) derived procedurally from the complex quadratic polynomial map z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c. We introduce the Bent Sine Wave Hypothesis, demonstrating that non-equilibrium living systems emerge when harmonic waves curl inward through environmental drag toward the cardioid cusp (c = 1/4). We define the Observer Horizon Geometry in parameter space, identifying interior resonance shoulder loci X_upper = (0.25, +0.18) and X_lower = (0.25, -0.18) between the fixed-point basin and the true boundary at c = 0.25 +/- 0.50i. To escape non-convex stagnation without loss zeroing, we introduce a heavy-tailed Biomimetic Perturbed Jump Operator (Omega_tunneling) inspired by mammalian fertilization zinc sparks. We further couple an enteric-cranial Dual-Brain architecture shielded by adaptive CD4+ regulatory immune gating (M_CD4), and project the 4-nucleotide genetic basis (A, T, C, G) across quadrants in C. Multi-seed empirical validation on the Two-Moons manifold (5 seeds, 80/20 train/test split, 32x32 grid, zero test-time updates, zero label leakage) demonstrates that procedural parameterization from a 24-byte coordinate seed achieves 77.67% +/- 5.35% clean test accuracy (within an 8.00-point paired difference of an unconstrained gradient baseline at 85.67% +/- 5.35%, 95% CI: [-1.07%, 17.07%]) and 71.33% +/- 3.80% under distribution shift (N(1.2, 0.4)), alongside conceptual equivalence with an analog optical co-processor.

TL;DR: 提出 Orbital Error Dynamics (OED)：突触权重不存为内存矩阵，而由复二次映射 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 程序化生成的瞬时拓扑共振（O(W) 降为 O(1)），并配重尾 Biomimetic Perturbed Jump Operator 与 CD4+ 门控的肠脑-颅脑双脑架构。在 Two-Moons 流形 5 seed、80/20 划分上，24 字节坐标种子达 77.67%±5.35% 干净测试精度，分布偏移下 71.33%±3.80%。
Motivation: 现代 DNN 把参数当静态浮点矩阵存于物理内存，带来 Von Neumann 瓶颈与表示坍缩；非凸优化中的停滞又常靠丢权重的 zeroing 逃脱。
Method: 用 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 的程序化参数化替代存储权重；引入 Bent Sine Wave 假设与 Observer Horizon Geometry（肩部轨迹 X_upper=(0.25,+0.18)、X_lower=(0.25,-0.18)，真实边界 c=0.25±0.50i）；以受哺乳动物受精 zinc sparks 启发的重尾 Omega_tunneling 扰动跳出非凸停滞，叠加 CD4+ 自适应免疫门控的 enteric-cranial 双脑架构与 A/T/C/G 四象限投影。
Result: Two-Moons 流形上 5 seeds、80/20 train/test、32x32 网格、零测试时更新、零标签泄漏：24 字节坐标种子程序化参数化得 77.67%±5.35% 干净测试精度，与无约束梯度基线 85.67%±5.35% 的配对差 8.00 个百分点（95% CI [-1.07%, 17.07%]）；分布偏移 N(1.2,0.4) 下 71.33%±3.80%；并给出与模拟光协处理器的概念等价性。
Conclusion: 作者主张把权重从存储量改为过程生成的共振可同时绕开内存瓶颈与非凸停滞，代价是相对梯度基线约 8 个百分点的精度差，且该框架被定位为 Mandelbrot Fractal Neural Synthesis 的基础配套理论。

papers.title: Smartphone-Based Method for Automated Speed Enforcement
papers.abstract_en: Smartphone cameras and computer vision (CV) hold significant promise in assisting public agencies with enforcing traffic laws and enhancing road safety. This work designs and tests a smartphone-based method for automated speed estimation and vehicle identification (license plate, make/model, and color recognition) via an automated pipeline to assist enforcement agencies in reliably identifying speeders. The CV code accurately recognizes nearly half (46%) of the license plates' text on 1,800 images from a Brazil open-source dataset, called UFPR-ALPR. Code tests on daytime recordings from hand-held smartphone videos (n = 73) and roadside cameras (n = 42) in Austin, Texas yield 60.8% accuracy for color detection (among all possible RGB color categories), 48.6% on vehicle make/manufacturer identification, and 16.89% on vehicle make and model identification. Prediction accuracy for speed estimation (within a 20% range), vehicle make (within the top 3 predictions), and license plate recognition (within the top 10 predictions) are 16.3%, 16.9%, and 29.7%, respectively. This paper also illuminates the legal, technological, and practical aspects of using smartphones for enforcement, including the potential use of recordings for enforcement purposes, emphasizing the need to transform the potential of smartphone-based CV technologies into practical tools for vital information on traffic violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用智能手机摄像头加计算机视觉搭出自动测速与车辆识别流水线（车牌、品牌型号、颜色），在真实拍摄数据上测试后发现精度远不足以执法：UFPR-ALPR 上车牌文本识别率 46%，奥斯汀日间视频上颜色 60.8%、品牌 48.6%、品牌+型号 16.89%，测速（20% 误差内）仅 16.3%。结论是该技术目前只能作为辅助信息来源，需先解决精度与法律可用性问题。
Motivation: 交通执法机构需要可靠识别超速车辆，但人工执法成本高；智能手机与 CV 有望自动化测速与车辆身份识别，其实际可用精度尚不清楚。
Method: 设计自动化 CV 流水线，从智能手机与路边摄像头视频中估计车速并识别车牌文本、品牌/型号与颜色；在巴西开源数据集 UFPR-ALPR 的 1,800 张图片及奥斯汀日间手持手机视频 (n=73) 与路边摄像头视频 (n=42) 上测试，同时讨论录像用于执法的法律与技术可行性。
Result: UFPR-ALPR 1,800 张图片上车牌文本识别 46%；奥斯汀日间视频上颜色检测 60.8%、品牌识别 48.6%、品牌+型号 16.89%；测速（20% 误差范围内）16.3%、品牌（top-3 内）16.9%、车牌（top-10 内）29.7%。
Conclusion: 智能手机 CV 已能部分完成车牌与颜色识别，但测速与品牌型号精度过低，尚不能独立支撑执法，需转化为可靠工具并解决录像取证的法律问题。

papers.title: On the SoS Certifiability of Log-Concave Distributions
papers.abstract_en: For an arbitrary isotropic log-concave distribution $P$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, we prove that the polynomial $(Cm)^m\|v\|_2^m - \mathbb{E}_{X\sim P}\langle X,v\rangle^m$ is a sum of squares for every even $m\ge2$, where $C>0$ is a universal constant. This removes the dependence on the Poincaré constant in the theorem of Kothari and Steinhardt (arXiv:1711.07465), recovering the optimal moment bounds for log-concave distributions. As an immediate corollary, we obtain computationally efficient algorithms with dimension-free error guarantees for a wide range of high-dimensional statistical estimation problems. Our proof uses stochastic localization to decompose $P$ as an average of random strongly log-concave measures, whose centered moments admit the subgaussian certificates of Diakonikolas, Hopkins, Pensia, and Tiegel (STOC 2025; arXiv:2410.21194). With a covariance-adapted choice of localization, we show that a fourth-moment certificate derived from Letwin's variance inequality for quadratic forms (arXiv:2607.24164) suffices to control this averaging at every even degree.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明任意各向同性 log-concave 分布 P 上多项式 (Cm)^m‖v‖₂^m − E⟨X,v⟩^m 对每个偶数 m≥2 都是平方和 (sum of squares)，C 为普适常数，从而去掉 Kothari–Steinhardt 定理中对 Poincaré 常数的依赖并恢复 log-concave 分布的最优矩界。
Motivation: Kothari 与 Steinhardt (arXiv:1711.07465) 的矩界 SoS 证书依赖分布的 Poincaré 常数，对一般 log-concave 分布该常数未知或不理想，导致高维统计估计的误差保证带额外依赖。
Method: 用 stochastic localization 把 P 分解为随机强 log-concave 测度的平均，其中心矩套用 Diakonikolas、Hopkins、Pensia、Tiegel (STOC 2025, arXiv:2410.21194) 的 subgaussian 证书；再取协方差自适应的 localization，用 Letwin 针对二次型的方差不等式 (arXiv:2607.24164) 导出的四阶矩证书控制该平均过程在每个偶数次数上的求和。
Result: 对每个偶数 m≥2，(Cm)^m‖v‖₂^m − E_{X∼P}⟨X,v⟩^m 为 SoS，C>0 普适；由此得到一批高维统计估计问题上具维数无关 (dimension-free) 误差保证的多项式时间算法。
Conclusion: log-concave 分布的最优矩界可以不依赖 Poincaré 常数地做 SoS 认证，stochastic localization 加四阶矩证书足以在所有偶数次数上闭合。

papers.title: MQSS-Selector: RL-Guided Pass Selection for an MLIR Compilation Pipeline
authors: Martin Schulz (1 and 2) ((1) Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ)
papers.abstract_en: High Performance Computing (HPC) and Quantum Computing (QC) systems are increasingly converging towards unified High Performance Computing-Quantum Computing (HPCQC) infrastructures, driven by a growing need to bridge classical and quantum workflows, which affects all levels of the system stack, from the hardware to compilers and runtimes, all the way to applications. However, today's QC devices are still in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, are error-prone and resource-limited, and therefore require specialized optimizations and topology mappings to achieve sufficient fidelity. This places special emphasis on proper compilation and optimization within the overall quantum software stack. Many existing stacks remain fragmented, with separate components responsible for device selection, compiler-pass optimization, and job queue scheduling. This paper proposes a unified, learning-based selector that integrates these disparate stages into a cohesive framework. Our proposed selector scheme leverages reinforcement learning and deep learning models that can be extended to simultaneously optimize multiple objectives -- such as fidelity, compilation time, and scheduling latency -- while dynamically adapting to circuit characteristics and device conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MQSS-Selector：用强化学习与深度学习把量子计算栈中彼此割裂的设备选择、编译 pass 优化、作业队列调度三个阶段统一成一个选择器，可同时优化保真度、编译时间与调度延迟，并随电路特征和设备状态动态调整。
Motivation: HPC 与量子计算正走向统一的 HPCQC 基础设施，但 NISQ 设备易错、资源受限，需要专门的编译优化与拓扑映射；现有量子软件栈在设备选择、编译 pass 优化、队列调度上各自为政，缺少统一决策层。
Method: 提出统一的、基于学习的选择器 MQSS-Selector，用强化学习 (RL) 与深度学习模型联合决策设备选择与编译 pass 序列，并把调度纳入同一框架；目标函数可扩展到同时优化保真度、编译时间与调度延迟，输入为电路特征与设备状态。
Result: 论文提出该统一选择器方案，声称可扩展到同时优化保真度、编译时间、调度延迟等多个目标，并动态适应电路特征与设备条件；摘要给出的产出为 11 页、5 图、1 表的方案论文。
Conclusion: 设备选择、pass 优化与队列调度不应各自独立决策，用一个 RL 引导的选择器统一处理并按多目标联合优化，是应对 NISQ 编译栈碎片化的可行路径。

papers.title: R-DEIM Net: An Efficient Rationale-Augmented Dual-Expert Interaction Model for Paraphrase Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in paraphrase detection reveal a fundamental trade-off: large language models achieve high accuracy but require high computation, while efficient Siamese-BERT variants offer practical scalability with reduced transparency in rationale generation. We present R-DEIM Net, a 76M-parameter dual-expert architecture exploring whether moderate-scale models can achieve competitive accuracy on paraphrase detection while enabling human-readable rationale generation. The architecture combines two specialized components: an Interaction Expert that captures token-level similarity patterns through multi-scale 2D convolutions and attention head allowing variable input length, and a Reasoning Expert that uses a Flan-T5-small decoder to generate rationales as auxiliary supervision. Rather than re-encoding generated text, we extract and pool decoder hidden states as complementary features for classification. On the Quora Question Pairs dataset, R-DEIM Net achieves 90.07\% accuracy and 90.16\% F1-score via 10-fold cross-validation. This represents competitive performance with strong transformer-based baselines (e.g., MFAE BERT: 90.54\% accuracy) and recent large language model based approaches (LLaMA-70B) while using a substantially smaller parameter budget. The model generates rationales alongside predictions, providing potential for auxiliary human-readable descriptions.

papers.title: Accelerating Video Diffusion via Training-Free Trajectory Routing
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion is computationally expensive, as it requires executing a large model across many denoising steps. Even with step-distillation, inference remains expensive because every distilled step still requires a costly model evaluation. We present TRACK: TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection, a heterogeneous denoising strategy that switches between compatible large and small models at selected steps, reducing the average cost per denoising evaluation. The switching steps are determined using a calibration process. TRACK first rolls out a reference trajectory with the large model. Then at each step, the small model's prediction is also collected and compared against the large model's prediction to obtain a relative disagreement score. Both models receive the same latent, timestep, conditioning, and guidance inputs. Aggregating this signal over a calibration set produces a disagreement score map across diffusion steps, which determines a switching policy for an efficient inference process: quality-sensitive steps keep using the large model, while steps with low disagreement scores are routed to the small model. Inference executes only the selected model at each step, requiring no retraining, architecture or scheduler changes, or online dual-model evaluation. Across Wan 2.1, Cosmos 3, TurboDiffusion, and FastVideo, TRACK yields $1.95\times$, $2.04\times$-$2.73\times$, $2.69\times$, and $2.17\times$ speedups, respectively, with comparable aggregate quality and high diversity retention. TRACK thereby establishes automated, training-free model switching as a practical acceleration paradigm for video diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACK 用校准得到的逐步分歧分数图，在视频扩散去噪中按步切换大小模型：质量敏感步保留大模型，低分歧步路由给小模型，推理时每步只跑被选中的一个模型。在 Wan 2.1、Cosmos 3、TurboDiffusion、FastVideo 上分别取得 1.95×、2.04×–2.73×、2.69×、2.17× 加速，聚合质量相当且多样性保持度高，无需重训练。
Motivation: 视频扩散需要大模型跑完大量去噪步，即使 step-distillation 后每个蒸馏步仍要一次昂贵的模型评估，推理成本依然高。
Method: TRACK (TRajectory-Aware Capacity routing via top-K selection)：先用大模型 rollout 参考轨迹，同时在每步收集小模型预测，两者在相同 latent、timestep、conditioning、guidance 输入下比较得到相对分歧分数；在校准集上聚合成分歧分数图，据此生成切换策略，推理时每步只执行被选中的模型，不改架构、调度器，也不需在线双模型评估。
Result: 在 Wan 2.1 上 1.95× 加速，Cosmos 3 上 2.04×–2.73×，TurboDiffusion 上 2.69×，FastVideo 上 2.17×；聚合质量相当，多样性保持度高。

papers.title: PrivDrift: Auditing User-Secret Leakage Under Topic Drift in Active LLM Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce \textbf{PrivDrift}, a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1{,}000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7\% to 54.6\%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrivDrift 是一个审计活跃 LLM 对话中话题漂移后秘密是否仍可被提取的基准：1,000 条含植入秘密、内容密集漂移轮次与标准化提取探针的多轮对话，在三个长上下文 LLM 上测得对话级混合泄漏率 38.7%–54.6%，且在测试的漂移窗口内增加话题漂移并不能可靠降低泄漏。作者主张把活跃 LLM 的隐私风险当作持续性行为失效模式来评估，而非仅视为训练数据记忆或即时越狱。
Motivation: 用户在对话中披露的敏感信息在话题已转向无关内容后，仍可能被后续提示行为性地恢复；现有隐私评估多聚焦训练数据记忆或即时 jailbreak，缺少针对话题漂移与说服式探针的受控审计。
Method: 构建 PrivDrift 基准：1,000 条受控多轮对话，含植入秘密 (seeded secrets)、内容密集的话题漂移轮次 (content-dense drift turns) 与标准化提取探针 (extraction probes)，在三个带扩展上下文窗口的 LLM 上按模型、秘密类型与说服强度分层测量对话级混合泄漏 (dialogue-level hybrid leakage)。
Result: 三个长上下文 LLM 的对话级混合泄漏率介于 38.7% 到 54.6% 之间，且随模型、秘密类型与说服强度显著变化；在所测试的漂移窗口内，额外的话题漂移并不能可靠降低泄漏率。
Conclusion: 活跃 LLM 会话中的隐私风险应被建模为持续存在的行为失效模式，仅靠话题漂移不足以消解已披露秘密的可恢复性。

papers.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive capabilities in robotic manipulation, their memoryless nature renders them brittle to test-time environment shifts, particularly hardware shifts caused by wear or imperfect calibration. Enabling these models to self-adapt during deployment without requiring continuous on-site recalibration remains a critical bottleneck for real-world scalability. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive VLA, a novel post-training recipe that enables the policy to iteratively adapt to deployment-time hardware shifts leveraging its own rollouts as context. To do so, we first collect policy rollouts under deliberately injected hardware shifts. We then transform the base policy's training data into shift-conditioned expert demonstrations by pre-compensating the expert actions for these known shifts. Next, we introduce a lightweight, plug-in context encoder that compresses the context, including visual observation, proprioception, and actions in the shifted environment, into a latent context token. This token modulates the policy through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN). Furthermore, we find that context tokens can be ensembled, allowing the policy to iteratively self-correct and mitigate failures step by step. Extensive experiments across four precision-critical bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks show that Self-Adaptive VLA recovers over 80% of the base policy's performance under hardware shifts, such as actuation bias and joint encoder offsets. Moreover, Self-Adaptive VLA enables more robust deployment to new workstations compared to the base policy. Our approach provides a pathway for robust large-scale real-world robot deployments and easier maintenance. See videos at https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Self-Adaptive VLA 用自身 rollout 作上下文，让机器人策略在部署期硬件漂移（执行偏差、关节编码器偏置）下自我纠偏：把基础策略训练数据预补偿已知漂移，转成 shift-conditioned 专家示范，再用轻量上下文编码器压成 latent context token 经 AdaLN 调制策略。在四个精密双手/灵巧操作任务上恢复基础策略在硬件漂移下 80% 以上的性能，并更稳地部署到新工位。
Motivation: VLA 策略是 memoryless 的，测试期硬件漂移（磨损、标定不准）会使其性能骤降，而持续现场重标定是真实世界规模化部署的瓶颈。
Method: 先在人为注入的硬件漂移下采集策略 rollout；把基础策略训练数据对已知漂移做动作预补偿，转成 shift-conditioned 专家示范；再训练轻量即插即用上下文编码器，将视觉观测、本体感知与动作压缩为 latent context token，经 adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) 调制策略；context token 还可被 ensembled 以逐步自我纠正。
Result: 在四个精度关键的双手与灵巧操作任务上，Self-Adaptive VLA 在硬件漂移（actuation bias、joint encoder offsets）下恢复基础策略 80% 以上的性能；相比基础策略能更稳健地部署到新工位。
Conclusion: 以自身 rollout 为上下文的后训练配方可让 VLA 在部署期自适应硬件漂移，为大规模真实机器人部署与更易维护提供路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AT-SKM-Net: An Accelerated Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Framework for Linear Hard-Constraint Feasibility on Dynamic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph-structured optimization with linear constraints is fundamental to critical infrastructure but faces scalability limits due to massive strict hard constraints and high dimensionality. While recent projection-based methods such as Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin Net (T-SKM-Net) guarantee feasibility, they face high computational costs in dynamic environments by processing the entire constraint set and requiring expensive matrix factorizations. To bridge this gap, we propose the Accelerated Trainable-SKM (AT-SKM) Net framework. To concentrate computation on the active constraints and eliminate redundant calculations, we introduce a hybrid sampling strategy guided by a topology-aware heterogeneous GNN model. To efficiently handle topological shifts in graph-based constraints, we employ a Cholesky Update mechanism that theoretically reduces the equality projection complexity from O(N^3) to O(N^2) under low-rank perturbations. Experiments on random geometric graphs, N-1 Security-Constrained DC-OPF, and minimum-cost gas transport problem demonstrate that AT-SKM reduces iteration counts by up to 85% and achieves 2.95x-7.29x SKM layer speedups, while maintaining zero constraint violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AT-SKM-Net 把线性硬约束投影的 Trainable Sampling Kaczmarz-Motzkin (T-SKM-Net) 改成只在活跃约束上采样的加速框架：用拓扑感知异构 GNN 引导混合采样策略，并以 Cholesky Update 在低秩扰动下把等式投影复杂度从 O(N^3) 降到 O(N^2)。在随机几何图、N-1 安全约束 DC-OPF 与最小成本输气问题上，迭代次数最多减少 85%，SKM 层加速 2.95x–7.29x，且约束违反为零。
Motivation: 图结构线性约束优化要处理海量严格硬约束与高维变量，现有投影类方法（如 T-SKM-Net）虽保证可行，但在动态环境中每次都要处理整个约束集并做昂贵矩阵分解，计算代价高、难以扩展。
Method: 提出 AT-SKM 框架：以拓扑感知的异构 GNN 引导混合采样策略，把计算集中在活跃约束上以消除冗余；针对图约束的拓扑变化引入 Cholesky Update 机制，在低秩扰动下把等式投影复杂度由 O(N^3) 降至 O(N^2)。
Result: 在随机几何图、N-1 Security-Constrained DC-OPF 和最小成本输气问题三类实验上，AT-SKM 迭代次数最多减少 85%，SKM 层获得 2.95x–7.29x 加速，同时保持零约束违反。
Conclusion: 在活跃约束上做拓扑感知采样并用增量 Cholesky 更新替代重复分解，可以在保持严格可行（零违反）的前提下大幅降低动态图上线性硬约束求解的迭代与每层开销。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Return or Revise? Learning When Revision Helps Retrieval-Augmented QA
papers.abstract_en: We consider the decision of whether to return an existing draft answer or revise it using retrieved evidence, as in answer-revision systems. Draft confidence estimates whether the current answer is correct, but the decision requires estimating the effect of a specified revision. For offline training and evaluation, we grade both the returned draft and its candidate revision under the same correctness judge, which makes repair, harm, and the gap to an oracle observable. We call this paired effect its recoverability, and we train policies to predict it before revision. On 25,870 held-out open-domain questions across three revision setups, a scorer trained on the paired outcome has greater area under the accuracy--revision-rate curve than a matched draft-correctness scorer in all nine Llama setup--seed fits, and gains 0.23--0.68 accuracy points on average at development-selected thresholds, a difference significant across training runs only for dense retrieval. The resulting policy improves on always revising and on average closes more than a third of the oracle gap, although it still applies 38--46% of the harmful revisions. When a draft-free standard-RAG answer is also available, however, choosing between the draft and that answer is stronger by about two points for Llama and four for OLMo, and adding candidate revision as a third option yields no significant gain. Recoverability describes one revision; its value as an available action also depends on the alternatives.

papers.title: Residual Correlation as a Diagnostic for Joint-Uncertainty Gains from GP Coregionalisation
papers.abstract_en: In multi-target regression, correlated targets are often coupled through multi-output Gaussian processes with an intrinsic model of coregionalisation (GP-ICM), assuming that sharing statistical strength improves overall performance. In practice, the benefits are inconsistent. Across the settings studied, we find that the main benefit of coregionalisation is joint uncertainty quantification rather than point prediction. Raw target correlation does not predict when coupling helps; in the separable GP-ICM settings studied here, residual correlation, the cross-target dependence left unexplained by independent per-target predictors, is the strongest predictor of joint-uncertainty gains. We introduce a lightweight diagnostic, $D_{\rm logdet}=-\frac{1}{2}\log\det R_{\rm res}$, which represents the idealised joint negative log-likelihood (NLL) gain from modelling a full rather than diagonal residual covariance and is computable from independent GPs alone. Across a controlled synthetic study, 16 multi-target benchmarks, and frozen transformer and convolutional neural network representations for keypoint regression, point prediction remains largely unchanged ($ΔR^2\approx 0$). In contrast, $D_{\rm logdet}$ strongly predicts observed ICM NLL improvements ($ρ_s=-0.83$, $p<0.001$), outperforming heuristics such as the feature-to-sample ratio. We also propose Residual-ICM, which preserves independent marginal variances while adding residual-correlation structure to the joint covariance. Residual-ICM achieves the best average joint NLL among the compared methods, while the diagnostic indicates when covariance coupling is likely to be useful. The diagnostic is specific to global Gaussian residual dependence, the structure captured by separable coregionalisation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多目标回归中，GP-ICM 耦合带来的主要收益是联合不确定性量化而非点预测：跨 16 个多目标基准与合成研究，点预测几乎不变（ΔR²≈0），而残差相关性诊断 D_logdet 强预测 ICM 的 NLL 改善（ρ_s=-0.83, p<0.001），优于特征/样本比等启发式。作者据此提出保留独立边缘方差、只在联合协方差中加入残差相关结构的 Residual-ICM，取得所比较方法中最好的平均联合 NLL。
Motivation: 多输出 GP 常用 ICМ 耦合目标以共享统计强度，但收益不稳定；原始目标相关性无法预测耦合何时有帮助，缺少一个在只训练独立 GP 的前提下就能预判联合不确定性收益的判据。
Method: 提出轻量诊断 D_logdet = -½ log det R_res，表示用完整残差协方差替代对角残差协方差的理想化联合 NLL 收益，仅由独立 per-target GP 即可计算；并提出 Residual-ICM，在保留各目标独立边缘方差的同时把残差相关结构加入联合协方差。评估覆盖受控合成研究、16 个多目标基准，以及冻结的 transformer 与 CNN 表征上的关键点回归 (keypoint regression)。
Result: 点预测基本不变，ΔR²≈0；D_logdet 对观测到的 ICM NLL 改善的 Spearman 相关为 ρ_s=-0.83（p<0.001），强于特征/样本比等启发式；Residual-ICM 在所比较方法中取得最佳平均联合 NLL。
Conclusion: 核心收益在联合不确定性量化而非点预测，残差相关性（而非原始目标相关性）是耦合是否有用的最强预测量；该诊断仅针对全局高斯残差依赖，即可分 coregionalisation 所刻画的结构。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Can Frozen Hyperspherical Features Guide the Selection of Pseudo Masks?
papers.abstract_en: Foundation segmenters such as SAM return several plausible masks for an unlabeled image, and a student trained on the wrong one inherits its errors. Choosing among them means querying a second large model or fitting a quality head to annotated masks. We show that a candidate can be judged by what it does to a frozen self-supervised backbone's features. Normalized DINOv2 patch features lie on a hypersphere, and a candidate mask splits that sphere in two. Based on this reading, we introduce SphereTrust, which scores each candidate by three properties of the split, the angular contrast between the two sides, the coverage of the foreground's appearance modes, and contact with the image frame, one for each of three common ways a mask fails, and ranks a pool in 0.55 s per image from the frozen features alone. On eight SAM and SAM3 candidate pools spanning camouflaged, salient, and dichotomous segmentation and camouflage under low light, SphereTrust exceeds the strongest evaluated external baseline on six pools by 1.7 to 9.3 percentage points in mean selected Dice. These comparisons include published selection rules and explicitly labeled adaptations of DSS and UCOD-MKD. On the two prompted camouflage pools, its mean selected Dice is within 0.1 percentage points of the candidate-derived DSS adaptation, with a lower catastrophic-error rate. Which cue carries the signal depends on the candidate pool. The same sphere also supports training. The leading candidates enter as a candidate set with their scores as priors, prototypes reorder them, and a cross-fitted second round completes the labels, raising weighted F by 4.5, 2.3, and 5.5 points over fixed-label training on the three MLLM anchor pools, with students competitive with published unsupervised methods on nineteen test sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SphereTrust 用冻结 DINOv2 归一化 patch 特征所在超球面的三分割性质给 SAM/SAM3 候选掩码打分，无需第二个大模型或标注质量头。在八个候选池上，六个池的 mean selected Dice 比最强外部基线高 1.7 到 9.3 个百分点，单图排序耗时 0.55 秒；同一分数还作为先验驱动候选集训练，三个 MLLM anchor 池上 weighted F 提升 4.5、2.3、5.5 点。
Motivation: SAM 对无标注图像返回多个都合理的掩码，学生网络学错一个就继承其错误；现有做法要么再查询一个大模型、要么用标注掩码拟合质量头，成本高且依赖标注。
Method: 把归一化 DINOv2 patch 特征视为超球面上的点，候选掩码即对球面的一次二分；SphereTrust 按三个分割性质打分——两侧角度对比、前景外观模式覆盖、与图像边界接触，分别对应三类常见掩码失效。训练侧把领先候选连同分数作为先验候选集，用原型 (prototypes) 重排，再以 cross-fitted 第二轮补全标签。
Result: 在覆盖伪装、显著、二分分割及低光照伪装的八个 SAM/SAM3 候选池上，六个池的 mean selected Dice 超出最强外部基线 1.7 到 9.3 个百分点（对比含已发表选择规则及 DSS、UCOD-MKD 的显式标注适配版）；两个 prompted 伪装池上与 candidate-derived DSS 适配版差距在 0.1 个百分点内且 catastrophic-error rate 更低。仅凭冻结特征排序耗时 0.55 s/图。候选集训练在三个 MLLM anchor 池上把 weighted F 相对固定标签训练提高 4.5、2.3、5.5 点，学生在十九个测试集上与已发表无监督方法相当。
Conclusion: 候选掩码的取舍可由冻结自监督特征的几何分割性质判定，无需额外大模型或质量头；哪个线索携带信号取决于候选池，而同一分数既可排序也可作为训练先验。

papers.title: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty over both node and edge features. This extension enables the propagation of linear message-passing operations and the sound approximation of ReLU nonlinearities for GNN architectures, including graph convolutional network (GCN) and graph isomorphism network with edge features (GINE) layers. We evaluate GNNV across three power system tasks, PF, OPF, and CFA, on the IEEE-24, IEEE-39, and IEEE-118 test cases, as well as two standard graph classification benchmarks, ENZYMES and PROTEINS. Our results show that GNNV provides tighter robustness guarantees than CORA on graph classification models with ReLU-based activations and, for the first time, delivers edge-aware robustness guarantees for GINE-based PF and OPF models under joint node and edge perturbations.
papers.journal_ref: AI Verification: Third International Symposium, SAIV 2026, Lisbon, Portugal, July 24-25, 2026, Proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 NNV 形式化验证框架扩展到图结构输入，提出 GraphStar sets 同时刻画节点与边特征的不确定性，可对 GCN、GINE 等 GNN 的线性消息传递做传播并对 ReLU 非线性给出可靠逼近。在 IEEE-24/39/118 电力系统 PF、OPF、CFA 任务与 ENZYMES、PROTEINS 图分类基准上评测，GNNV 对 ReLU 激活的图分类模型给出比 CORA 更紧的鲁棒性保证，并首次为基于 GINE 的 PF/OPF 模型在节点与边联合扰动下给出边感知 (edge-aware) 鲁棒性保证。
Motivation: GNN 已成为电力系统中潮流 (PF)、最优潮流 (OPF) 与级联失效分析 (CFA) 的快速拓扑感知代理，但对 GNN 的形式化验证仍具挑战，已有方法适用范围有限，尤其缺少同时覆盖节点与边特征扰动的保证。
Method: 将 NNV 框架经 GraphStar sets 推广到图结构输入，该集合同时捕捉节点与边特征上的不确定性；支持对线性消息传递操作的传播以及对 ReLU 非线性的可靠逼近，覆盖 GCN 与带边特征的图同构网络 (GINE) 层，验证器命名为 GNNV。
Result: 在 IEEE-24、IEEE-39、IEEE-118 测试系统上的 PF、OPF、CFA 三个电力系统任务，以及 ENZYMES 和 PROTEINS 两个标准图分类基准上评测：对含 ReLU 激活的图分类模型，GNNV 给出比 CORA 更紧的鲁棒性保证；并首次为基于 GINE 的 PF 与 OPF 模型在节点与边联合扰动下给出边感知鲁棒性保证。
Conclusion: GraphStar sets 能把形式化验证从一般神经网络扩展到带节点与边特征的 GNN，使电力系统 GNN 代理获得覆盖联合扰动的可审计鲁棒性保证。

papers.title: Nuclear Norm-Regularized Bayesian Matrix Completion
papers.abstract_en: Matrix completion, the problem of estimating missing entries in a matrix from noisily observed ones, underlies a diverse array of problems such as recommender systems and counterfactual outcome estimation in panel data. Many algorithms address the problem using regularized least squares, often with the nuclear norm as a regularizer, but this method yields a point estimate with no built-in uncertainty quantification. A Bayesian formulation is a natural alternative, and if the noise variance is known, the nuclear norm-based prior yields a log-concave posterior. Unfortunately, in practice, the noise variance will not be known a priori, so for a fully Bayesian approach, a prior must be imposed on it. We give the first sampler for this model with an explicit non-asymptotic guarantee: polynomial in the matrix dimensions and in the reciprocal of the target accuracy. Our technique is to discretize the distribution of the noise precision onto a grid and build a categorical posterior via thermodynamic integration. This extension is not specific to matrix completion and may be useful in other non-log-concave sampling problems where the non-log-concavity is restricted to a single variable and the joint distribution of the remaining variables is nonsmooth. Our contribution is a feasibility result: we show that a polynomial-time Bayesian sampler for this model exists at all, and the resulting complexity, while polynomial, is not intended as a deployable algorithm at current problem scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在噪声方差未知的核范数贝叶斯矩阵补全中，给出首个带显式非渐近多项式时间保证的采样器：把噪声精度分布离散到网格上，经 thermodynamic integration 构造类别后验。复杂度对矩阵维数与目标精度倒数均为多项式级，作者明确这是可行性结果而非当前规模下可部署的算法。
Motivation: 核范数正则化最小二乘只给点估计、没有不确定性量化；贝叶斯化后一旦给噪声方差加先验，后验就失去 log-concave 性，此前缺少带非渐近保证的采样方法。
Method: 对噪声精度的分布做网格离散，用 thermodynamic integration 构造类别后验，从而把非 log-concave 性限制在单个变量上；给出复杂度对矩阵维数与目标精度倒数均为多项式的采样器，并论证该技术可迁移到非 log-concave 性只来自单变量、其余变量联合分布非光滑的采样问题。
Result: 给出该模型首个带显式非渐近保证的采样器，复杂度对矩阵维数和目标精度的倒数均为多项式级；作者说明该复杂度虽为多项式，但并非面向当前问题规模的可部署算法。
Conclusion: 未知噪声方差下的核范数贝叶斯矩阵补全存在多项式时间采样器，这是一个可行性结果；方法可推广到非 log-concave 性局限于单变量的其他采样问题。

papers.title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Previously submitted to TAE (Trust-AI-Eval), a NeurIPS 2026 workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 以 LLM 推断 prompt 结构为案例，对小样本 LLM 评测本身做自审计：8 个开源模型变体、5 个系列、8B–675B，293 份中间表示持久化。联合 cluster bootstrap 下只有排名底部稳固（最差两模型在 99% 与 86% 的重采样中保持名次，中间四个仅 27%–48%，最好的两个各 68%），即表格能可靠识别最差模型却不能可靠识别最好者；两种同样合理的重复 campaign 合并规则改写 8 行中的 4 行，使全研究头条指标移动 7 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 评测常在很小的 prompt 集上取平均并给出排名表，但这种表格到底有多少置信度没有被检验；且被测现象本身就不稳定，相同调用无法可靠复现相同结构。
Method: 以 LLM-based prompt-structure inference 为对象，覆盖 8 个开源模型变体、5 个模型家族、8B 到 675B 参数，关闭 caching 并持久化 293 份原始中间表示；对 prompt 做联合 cluster bootstrap 审计排名稳定性，比较两种重复 campaign 合并规则，并把推断结构与 ground-truth 标注对照。
Result: 相同调用的 node-set Jaccard 均值仅 0.39–0.96，72% 的 prompt-model 单元从未 node-set-perfect；bootstrap 中最不稳定的两个模型分别在 99% 与 86% 的重采样保持名次，中间四个为 27%–48%，最好的两个各 68%；两种合并规则改变 8 行中的 4 行并使头条指标移动 7 个百分点；8 个端点中有 4 个在测量后十周内被撤下。
Conclusion: 小样本 LLM 评测可以看起来远比其证据更确定，因此任何排名都应附带 rank stability、per-cell provenance、执行过的敏感性比较、逐次原始输出与测量日期；同时复现性不能当作准确性来读。

papers.title: Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data
papers.abstract_en: Advances in language modeling have been driven by scaling pretraining on ever more data. Yet, the training data is still largely curated on the model's behalf. A more general approach to pretraining would let the model learn to generate the data most useful for its own improvement. This would provide an effectively unbounded source of training data, limited by compute rather than human knowledge. We introduce Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data, an initial proof-of-concept towards realizing this vision. Our procedure casts synthetic data generation as a search over the space of all computable structure, taking inspiration from Solomonoff induction. Starting from random initialization, two models learn in tandem: a generator proposes programs interpreted by a universal Turing machine, generating byte sequences, while a learner autoregressively predicts these byte sequences. The learner is trained with standard cross-entropy, while the generator is trained with reinforcement learning to produce sequences at the frontier of the learner's capabilities, yielding an adaptive curriculum. A universal Turing machine gives us a search space over all computable data-generating processes, imposing little domain-specific structure, and self-play searches over this space for useful training data. We test whether zero-shot performance on natural data improves predictably with self-play compute; this is a clean test of transfer since neither generator nor learner is trained on natural data. Across several natural datasets, zero-shot loss exhibits predictable scaling in compute. The models also exhibit in-context learning, and discover recognizable mathematical sequences during training.
papers.comment: AC, KD, and MYL contributed equally; authors are listed alphabetically
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Play Pretraining with Zero Data：生成器用 RL 提出由 universal Turing machine 解释的程序并产出字节序列，学习者用标准交叉熵自回归预测，双方共同演化出自适应课程，训练数据由模型自己生成而非人工策展。在多个自然数据集上，零样本 loss 随 self-play compute 呈可预测的 scaling，模型还展现 in-context learning 并在训练中发现可识别的数学序列。
Motivation: 语言模型预训练依赖人工策展数据，数据量受限于人类知识而非算力；目标是让模型自己生成对自身改进最有用的数据，把数据来源变成只受算力约束的近乎无限供给。
Method: 把合成数据生成建模为对所有可计算结构的搜索（灵感来自 Solomonoff induction）：从随机初始化起，生成器提出由 universal Turing machine 解释的程序生成字节序列，学习者自回归预测这些序列；学习者用标准 cross-entropy 训练，生成器用 RL 训练以产出处于学习者能力前沿的序列，形成自适应课程。生成器与学习者都不接触自然数据，用零样本表现检验迁移。
Result: 在多个自然数据集上，零样本 loss 随 self-play compute 呈现可预测的 scaling；模型在训练过程中展现 in-context learning，并发现可识别的数学序列。
Conclusion: 自我博弈可以把预训练数据的来源从人工策展转为算力受限的自生成过程，且对自然数据的零样本迁移随算力可预测地提升；作者将其定位为面向该愿景的 initial proof-of-concept。

papers.title: KernelOPT: Dispatch-Aware Agentic Search for GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning inference and training performance depends critically on GPU kernel efficiency. Modern compilers such as PyTorch Inductor automatically generate GPU kernels from high-level model code, but frequently underperform expert-written implementations by wide margins. Recent LLM-assisted kernel optimizers can close this gap for standalone kernels, yet treat compiled models as black boxes, generally optimizing individual standalone kernels without respecting the compiler's structural decisions or verifying the model end-to-end. We present KernelOPT, a multi-agent system that treats compiled models as structured artifacts. It preserves vendor library calls (cuBLAS, cuDNN) and exclusively targets generated Triton sub-kernels using five profiling-guided LLM agents. A four-gate verification cascade of static validation, multi-seed correctness, model-level float64-fallback verification, and performance gating filters candidates during optimization and verifies the re-stitched model end-to-end. If no candidate passes all four gates, the system preserves the compiler baseline. The system accepts PyTorch nn.Modules, standalone Triton kernels, and Helion kernels. Evaluated on 250 KernelBench problems, KernelOPT achieves geometric mean speedups over \texttt{torch.compile} of 1.40$\times$ (Level 1: 51/100), 1.15$\times$ (Level 2: 31/100), and 1.07$\times$ (Level 3: 12/50) across all problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelOPT 把编译后的模型当作结构化产物而非黑盒：保留 cuBLAS/cuDNN 库调用，只对 Triton 子内核用五个 profiling 引导的 LLM agent 做改写，并用四道门级联（静态校验、多随机种子正确性、模型级 float64 回退验证、性能门）筛选候选并端到端复验，四道门全不过则保留编译器基线。在 250 道 KernelBench 上相对 torch.compile 的几何平均加速为 1.40×（Level 1，51/100）、1.15×（Level 2，31/100）、1.07×（Level 3，12/50）。
Motivation: PyTorch Inductor 自动生成的 GPU 内核常明显落后于手写实现，而现有 LLM 内核优化器只优化孤立内核，既不尊重编译器的结构决策，也不做模型级端到端验证。
Method: 多智能体系统 KernelOPT 接受 PyTorch nn.Module、独立 Triton 内核与 Helion 内核；保留厂商库调用，只针对生成的 Triton 子内核，由五个基于 profiling 的 LLM agent 提出候选；四道门级联依次做静态验证、多 seed 正确性、模型级 float64 回退验证与性能门，最后端到端复验重组后的模型，全部失败则回退到编译器基线。
Result: 在 250 道 KernelBench 上，相对 torch.compile 的几何平均加速为 Level 1 1.40×（51/100 题）、Level 2 1.15×（31/100 题）、Level 3 1.07×（12/50 题），覆盖全部题目。
Conclusion: 把编译产物当结构化对象、只改 Triton 子内核并用多级验证兜底，可以在不牺牲正确性的前提下稳定取得对 torch.compile 的加速；难度越高的 KernelBench 层级收益越小（Level 3 仅 1.07×）。

papers.title: Can Labor Markets Function in the Age of AI? The Evaluation Bottleneck in Hiring
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted job-search tools have become increasingly popular by making it easier to find and apply to jobs. But by making it easier for applicants to generate and tailor application materials, they can also reduce how informative those materials are about applicant fit. We study this tradeoff in a hiring market where applicants differ in experience and latent match quality and firms use noisy application materials to decide whom to screen. We ask how AI affects downstream screening and hiring, and which applicants are most adversely affected. As application materials become less informative, a Bayesian firm rationally relies more heavily on coarse observables such as prior experience. Among the four applicant types defined by experience and compatibility for the job, inexperienced-compatible applicants are the most exposed: they lack observable experience and lose the individualized information that could distinguish them from other inexperienced candidates. When screening is costly, these changes can also generate inefficient screening failures in which firms screen no applicants or screen only experienced applicants. We then show that multistage hiring can arise as an endogenous firm response: a relatively inexpensive intermediate assessment allows firms to acquire new evidence of fit before costly full screening. This can restore screening opportunities that disappear under one-stage hiring and give inexperienced-compatible applicants a path to screening. Our results show how AI can shift the central friction in hiring from submitting applications to obtaining credible evaluation, creating entry barriers for high-fit workers without prior experience. Multistage hiring can endogenously arise in response, restoring evaluation opportunities that would otherwise disappear and helping preserve market functioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在申请材料因 AI 而信息量下降的招聘市场中，贝叶斯企业会转而依赖经验这类粗观测，四类申请人里“无经验但匹配度高”者受损最大：既无可观测经验，又失去能区分自己的个体化信息。有筛选成本时还会出现低效筛选失败（企业一个都不筛，或只筛有经验者）；引入相对廉价的中间评估形成多阶段招聘，可恢复这些消失的筛选机会，给无经验高匹配者一条进筛路径。
Motivation: AI 求职工具让申请材料更易生成，却降低了材料对匹配度的信息量；招聘的核心摩擦可能从“提交申请”转移到“获得可信评估”，而无经验高匹配者会因此被挡在门外。
Method: 构建一个招聘市场模型：申请人在经验与潜在匹配质量 (latent match quality) 上存在差异，企业用含噪申请材料决定给谁进入成本高昂的筛选；分析材料信息量下降时贝叶斯企业的筛选决策，并比较单阶段与多阶段（含相对廉价中间评估）两种招聘结构。
Result: 在由经验与岗位匹配度定义的四类申请人中，无经验且匹配度高的申请人暴露度最高；当筛选有成本时，材料信息量下降会引发低效筛选失败，即企业完全不筛或只筛有经验者；多阶段招聘作为企业的内生反应出现，可恢复单阶段下消失的筛选机会。
Conclusion: AI 会把招聘的核心摩擦从提交申请推向获得可信评估，从而对无经验高匹配者形成进入壁垒；多阶段招聘能内生地恢复评估机会、维系市场运转。

papers.title: M3GD: Multi-Modal Multi-View Geometric Diffusion for Camera--LiDAR Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Robotic novel view synthesis (NVS) must recover both visual appearance and metric 3D structure, yet most generative NVS methods rely only on images, overlooking LiDAR, a complementary sensor common on robotic platforms. We present M3GD, a Camera--LiDAR multimodal representation for generative NVS that composes independently pretrained 2D image and 3D point-cloud foundation models without separately pretraining a cross-modal translator. We show that, after camera projection, frozen LiDAR and image features exhibit substantial shared spatial structure, providing a natural cross-modal representation. M3GD conditions generation on LiDAR through this structure: it combines explicit geometry statistics with learned point-cloud descriptors into view-aligned packets on the image-latent grid, injected through a lightweight residual adapter into a multi-view flow-matching generator whose latent space, decoders, and training objective remain intact. On the GrandTour dataset, M3GD improves target-view RGB and depth synthesis over an image-only version of the same backbone. Ablations show that the gains come from pixel-aligned LiDAR content and that target-view LiDAR acts as a geometric query linking the requested view to source observations. Deployment on a ground robot demonstrates practical real-world operation, with a configurable quality--cost trade-off controlled by the number of Euler integration steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M3GD 把独立预训练的 2D 图像与 3D 点云基础模型经相机投影直接组合成 Camera–LiDAR 多模态表示，不单独训练跨模态翻译器，用轻量残差适配器把 LiDAR 几何统计与学习到的点云描述子注入多视角 flow-matching 生成器。在 GrandTour 数据集上，其目标视角 RGB 与深度合成均优于同一骨干的纯图像版本，消融显示增益来自像素对齐的 LiDAR 内容，且目标视角 LiDAR 充当连接请求视角与源观测的几何查询。
Motivation: 机器人新视角合成 (NVS) 需要同时恢复外观与度量 3D 结构，但多数生成式 NVS 只用图像，忽略了机器人平台上常见的互补传感器 LiDAR；而跨模态翻译器通常需要单独预训练。
Method: 组合独立预训练的 2D 图像与 3D 点云基础模型，经相机投影后利用冻结的 LiDAR 与图像特征的共享空间结构；把显式几何统计与学习到的点云描述子在图像 latent 网格上打包成视角对齐的 packets，经轻量残差适配器注入多视角 flow-matching 生成器，其 latent 空间、解码器与训练目标保持不变。
Result: 在 GrandTour 数据集上，M3GD 相对同一骨干的纯图像版本提升了目标视角 RGB 与深度合成质量；消融表明增益来自像素对齐的 LiDAR 内容，目标视角 LiDAR 起到几何查询作用；地面机器人部署验证了实际运行，并可通过 Euler 积分步数配置质量–开销折中。
Conclusion: 无需单独预训练跨模态翻译器，仅靠相机投影后的共享空间结构即可把 LiDAR 有效注入生成式 NVS，且质量–开销可由 Euler 积分步数调节。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Era by Eon: Benchmarking Enterprise Agents on Hidden Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: In the Era by Eon benchmark, each question states the rules for its answer, and code computes the answer from a generated company's data. When agents can run code, the four strongest models each answer 22 to 25 of 27 such questions, so the benchmark barely separates them. We add eight question templates that depend on hidden facts. No question or document states a hidden fact, and the records that seem to hold it show something else. Other data implies it. For example, the sales system says a customer dropped a purchase because of timing. On a recorded call, the customer blames an outage. For each generated company, code fills each template and computes an exact answer without a language model. We evaluate 12 agents. Each pairs a model with an agent program, which connects it to the company's systems. The best agent answers 18 of its 24 attempts, three per question, correctly. Four of the six models answer at most 6 of 24 with any program. The hardest questions require picking one of several similar records, such as which of three renewal offers a customer signed. All agents together answered two such questions correctly in only 1 of 84 attempts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Era by Eon 是一个企业 agent 基准：问题自带答案规则，由代码从生成的公司数据中算出精确答案，可运行代码时四个最强模型各答对 27 题中的 22–25 题，几乎无法区分。作者加入 8 个依赖隐藏事实的模板（事实不写在任何问题或文档里，需从其他记录推断），评测 12 个 agent（模型×程序），最佳 agent 24 次尝试答对 18 次，六个模型中有四个换任何程序都最多答对 6/24；最难的同类记录甄别题全部 agent 合计 84 次尝试中仅 1 次答对两道。
Motivation: 现有企业 agent 基准里问题可由代码直接算出答案，四个最强模型成绩挤在 22–25/27，无法区分能力；需要一种必须跨系统推断、无法从字面读出答案的评测。
Method: 为每个生成的公司用代码填充 8 个隐藏事实模板并计算精确答案（不经语言模型）；隐藏事实不出现在任何问题或文档中，表面记录给出的是别的解释（如销售系统称因时间放弃购买，通话录音里客户归因于故障）。评测 12 个 agent，每个是模型与连接公司系统的 agent 程序的配对，每题尝试 3 次。
Result: 可运行代码时四个最强模型各答对 27 题中的 22–25 题；最佳 agent 在 24 次尝试中答对 18 次；六个模型中四个在任意程序下最多答对 6/24；最难的相似记录甄别题（如三份续约报价中客户签了哪一份），全部 agent 合计 84 次尝试中仅 1 次同时答对两道。
Conclusion: 企业 agent 的区分度取决于必须跨记录推断的隐藏事实题，而非可由代码直接计算的题；模型换 agent 程序收益有限，且在多条相似记录中做精确甄别仍是普遍短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SciWalker: Synthesizing Scientific Coding Problems with Operator Graphs and Execution Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Improving the scientific coding capabilities of large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality training data. However, such data remain scarce because manually authoring realistic problems is costly and time-consuming, while systematically covering diverse scientific domains and algorithmic combinations remains challenging. To address this, we introduce SciWalker, a framework for synthesizing scientific coding problems through operator-chain sampling and execution feedback. The framework combines scientific library interfaces with operation modes to instantiate operators, organizes them into operator graphs, and samples operator chains as computational workflow cues. Guided by these cues, we adopt LLMs to generate scientifically grounded problem statements, reference solutions, and tests, with failed generations iteratively repaired using execution feedback. By combining structured workflow composition with verification and quality review, SciWalker enables scalable task generation while promoting scientific grounding, computational diversity, and executability. Using this framework, we construct 8,178 high-quality problems spanning 5 scientific domains and 32 subdomains. To evaluate their training utility, we conduct reinforcement learning on Qwen3.5-9B using the GSPO algorithm. This training improves SciCode subproblem accuracy by 9.9 percentage points, from 29.3% to 39.2%, with gains across scientific code generation, code repair, and reasoning benchmarks. The code for SciWalker is available at https://github.com/lichenx1/SciWalker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciWalker 用算子链采样加执行反馈合成科学编程题目：把科学库接口与操作模式实例化为算子、组织成 operator graph 并采样算子链作为工作流线索，再让 LLM 据此生成题面、参考解与测试，失败生成用执行反馈迭代修复。共得到 8,178 道题、覆盖 5 个科学领域 32 个子领域；用 GSPO 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上做强化学习后，SciCode 子问题准确率从 29.3% 升到 39.2%，提升 9.9 个百分点。
Motivation: 科学编程训练数据稀缺：人工出题成本高，且难以系统覆盖多科学领域与算法组合，制约 LLM 科学代码能力提升。
Method: 将科学库接口与操作模式结合实例化算子，组织成 operator graph 并采样算子链作为计算工作流线索；以 LLM 依线索生成题面、参考解和测试，失败样本用执行反馈迭代修复，再叠加结构化工作流组合、验证与质量审查。训练侧用 GSPO 算法对 Qwen3.5-9B 做强化学习。
Result: 合成 8,178 道高质量问题，横跨 5 个科学领域、32 个子领域；GSPO 强化学习使 SciCode 子问题准确率从 29.3% 提升到 39.2%（+9.9 个百分点），并在科学代码生成、代码修复与推理基准上均有提升。
Conclusion: 算子图加执行反馈的合成管线能规模化产出可执行、科学上有依据的编程任务，且这类数据经强化学习可切实抬高 LLM 在 SciCode 等科学代码基准上的表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NNV3: Expanding Neural Network Verification to New Architectures and Domains
papers.abstract_en: We present NNV3, the latest version of the Neural Network Verification (NNV) tool, a MATLAB framework for formal verification of deep learning models and learning-enabled cyber-physical systems. Building on the set-based reachability foundation of NNV 1.0 (FFNNs, CNNs, NNCS) and NNV 2.0 (RNNs, SSNNs, neural ODEs), NNV3 introduces new members of the Star-set family: ModelStar for verifying networks under weight perturbation, VolumeStar for video and 3D volumetric inputs, and GraphStar for graph neural networks. A conformal-inference-based probabilistic reachability mode complements sound analysis for problems where deterministic verification is intractable, while FairNNV certifies counterfactual and individual fairness properties over continuous input regions. NNV3 introduces new benchmarks for malware detection, graph-based power-system models, medical imaging, variable-length time series data, and action recognition. NNV3 also incorporates tutorials and developer guides through a unified documentation site. This paper details these major updates, demonstrating NNV's maturation into a comprehensive, robust, and accessible verification tool for a diverse range of AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NNV3 把神经网络形式化验证工具 NNV 扩展到新架构与新领域：新增 Star 集合族成员 ModelStar（权重扰动下验证）、VolumeStar（视频与 3D 体数据输入）、GraphStar（图神经网络），并加入基于 conformal inference 的概率可达性模式与 FairNNV 连续输入区域上的反事实/个体公平性认证。同时发布恶意软件检测、图结构电力系统、医学影像、变长时间序列、动作识别等新基准与统一文档站。
Motivation: NNV 1.0/2.0 的集合可达性只覆盖 FFNN、CNN、NNCS、RNN、SSNN、neural ODE，无法处理权重扰动、体数据、图结构网络，也缺少确定性验证不可行时的概率性替代与公平性认证能力。
Method: 在 Star 集合可达性基础上新增 ModelStar、VolumeStar、GraphStar 三个 Star 家族成员；用 conformal inference 构造概率可达性模式，作为确定性验证不可行时的补充；FairNNV 在连续输入区域上认证反事实与个体公平性属性；配套新增五类基准与统一教程/开发者文档站。
Result: 新增基准覆盖恶意软件检测、图基于的电力系统模型、医学影像、变长时间序列数据与动作识别五类领域；论文陈述 NNV 已成长为覆盖多样 AI 系统的综合验证工具，摘要未给出具体数值指标。

papers.title: Style, Not Self: Surface Cues Explain Zero-Shot Code Attribution by Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: If a language model can recognize code it wrote, it may favor that code as a judge, and instances of one model monitoring each other could collude. We test this zero-shot on current commercial models. Five LLMs generate solutions to MBPP, HumanEval, and DS-1000, seven more to MBPP, and models act as evaluators in four tasks: picking their own solution from a pair, judging whether a single solution is their own, identifying which of two solutions a named model wrote, and judging quality blind. In the single-solution task, balanced accuracy is 49-58% for all 15 model-benchmark combinations, while raw accuracy (38-67%) mostly reflects how readily a model claims authorship. In the pairwise task, accuracy across 14 evaluator-opponent combinations correlates at r=0.93 with how often the evaluator's solution is longer. Attribution to a named model succeeds on some pairs and is consistently inverted on others. A rule-based normalization that strips docstrings, comments, type hints, and local names preserves Pass@1 and leaves ten of twelve re-tested results at chance; the other two follow a length difference it leaves, although a trained classifier still separates most normalized pairs. Claude Haiku's self-preference also disappears. We recommend reporting balanced accuracy, heuristic baselines, and label consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零样本代码归属测试显示，LLM 判断「这段代码是不是我写的」基本靠表面线索而非自我识别：单解任务上 15 个模型-基准组合的 balanced accuracy 仅 49–58%，raw accuracy 38–67% 主要反映模型多爱认领作者身份；成对任务准确率与「评估者解法更长」的相关达 r=0.93。剥掉 docstring、注释、类型标注与局部命名的规则归一化后，12 个复测结果中 10 个回到随机水平，Claude Haiku 的自偏好也随之消失。作者建议报告 balanced accuracy、启发式基线与标签一致性。
Motivation: 若模型能认出自己写的代码，就可能在当裁判时偏袒该代码，多个模型互相监督时甚至可能合谋；需要判断这种零样本自我归属到底来自真实识别还是表面特征。
Method: 在 MBPP、HumanEval、DS-1000 上让 5 个商用 LLM 生成解法、另 7 个只做 MBPP，并设置四类评估任务：成对选自己的解、单解判断是否自写、判断指定模型写了哪一个、盲评质量；再用规则归一化抹去 docstring、注释、类型提示与局部命名后复测，并与训练分类器对照。
Result: 单解任务 15 个模型-基准组合 balanced accuracy 49–58%，raw accuracy 38–67%；成对任务 14 个评估者-对手组合的准确率与「评估者解法更长」的频率相关 r=0.93；指定模型归属在部分配对成功、另一些配对一致反转；归一化保留 Pass@1，12 个复测结果中 10 个回到随机，另 2 个跟随归一化残留的长度差，但训练分类器仍能区分多数归一化后的配对；Claude Haiku 的自偏好消失。
Conclusion: 零样本代码归属主要由长度等表面线索驱动，而非模型对自身输出的真实识别，因此自我偏好与潜在合谋信号需用 balanced accuracy、启发式基线和标签一致性来甄别。

papers.title: From Processing to Functionality: Engineering Accessible Material States in Cu-Embedded SiO$_x$ Memristive Devices
papers.abstract_en: Resistive switching in oxide-based devices is widely governed by stochastic defect processes, yet a predictive link between fabrication conditions and functional behavior remains elusive. Here, we establish a multiscale framework connecting plasma-defined deposition conditions to macroscopic device functionality in sputtered SiO$_x$/Cu/SiO$_x$-based systems. By combining large-scale statistical analysis of more than 50,000 experimentally characterized devices with physics-based plasma and atomistic simulations, we show that device behavior does not emerge from deterministic process-to-performance mappings, but from a probabilistic cascade spanning defect formation, defect-state evolution, and functional-regime emergence. Data-driven clustering reveals a continuous functional state space composed of operational switching types, while inverse modeling identifies the reconstructed oxygen-vacancy density as an effective latent descriptor capturing the combined influence of structural disorder and defect topology. This latent descriptor is strongly coupled to both Cu redistribution and electrical response, linking otherwise hidden material properties to observable device characteristics. Furthermore, macroscopic switching behavior is argued to arise from ensemble integration across spatially heterogeneous subdomains, providing a physical explanation for the pronounced variability of large-area devices. These findings shift the perspective from deterministic defect engineering toward probabilistic defect-state design and establish a physically grounded framework for understanding and controlling functional variability in such oxide-based systems, such as memristive or resistive-switching devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把溅射 SiOx/Cu/SiOx 阻变器件的等离子体沉积条件到宏观功能行为的联系做成概率级联而非确定性映射：缺陷形成、缺陷态演化、功能区涌现逐级传递随机性。对逾 50,000 个实测器件的大规模统计加等离子体与原子尺度模拟显示，重构氧空位密度是同时耦合 Cu 再分布与电学响应的潜变量描述子，大面积器件的显著变异性来自空间异质子域的系综积分。
Motivation: 氧化物阻变器件的电阻开关由随机缺陷过程主导，沉积工艺条件与器件功能行为之间缺少可预测的定量联系，大面积器件的变异性也因此难以解释。
Method: 构建跨尺度框架：对逾 50,000 个实验表征器件做大规模统计分析，结合基于物理的等离子体模拟与原子尺度模拟；用数据驱动聚类得到由工作开关类型构成的连续功能状态空间，再用逆向建模 (inverse modeling) 识别重构氧空位密度作为潜变量描述子。
Result: 在逾 50,000 个实验器件上，器件行为被证明来自缺陷形成、缺陷态演化到功能区涌现的概率级联，而非确定性的工艺到性能映射；重构氧空位密度这一潜变量描述子与 Cu 再分布和电学响应都强耦合；宏观开关行为被论证为空间异质子域的系综积分结果。
Conclusion: 缺陷工程应从确定性思路转向概率性的缺陷态设计 (probabilistic defect-state design)，以理解并控制氧化物忆阻/阻变器件的功能变异性。

papers.title: ConPro: Contrast Projection Pretraining for Label-Efficient Vessel Segmentation in DSA Sequences
papers.abstract_en: Dense vessel annotation in digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is labor-intensive, yet every unlabeled sequence records how contrast passes through the vessels. Semi-supervised methods take their targets from the current model, and generic self-supervised pretexts reconstruct static appearance, so this signal goes unused. We propose ConPro, a self-supervised pretraining scheme whose target is a contrast projection, the normalized drop of every pixel below its temporal median over the sequence. On DIAS and DSCA, with 10%, 20% and 50% of the training cases labeled, ConPro improves on training from scratch at every label fraction and is the best of the compared methods on DSCA at 20% and 50% labels. Controlled comparisons show that the gain comes from the target. A temporal-median target with the same input, loss and budget stays at scratch level, and using the projection directly instead of learning it, as an input channel or a pseudo-label, helps little or hurts. ConPro provides pretrained weights without changing the segmentation architecture, so it combines with semi-supervised training, and UniMatch, the strongest baseline, gains 0.5 to 2.0 Dice and 0.9 to 2.3 clDice at every label fraction when started from ConPro weights, reaching 75.4 Dice on DIAS and 81.3 on DSCA.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ConPro 用「对比投影」(contrast projection) 作自监督预训练目标：每个像素相对序列时间中位数的归一化下降量，为 DSA 序列血管分割提供预训练权重。在 DIAS 与 DSCA 上用 10%/20%/50% 标注训练时均优于从零训练，最强基线 UniMatch 从 ConPro 权重起步在各标注比例上再涨 0.5–2.0 Dice 与 0.9–2.3 clDice，DIAS 达 75.4 Dice、DSCA 达 81.3。
Motivation: DSA 血管密集标注费工，而每段未标注序列都记录了造影剂通过血管的过程；半监督目标来自当前模型自身，通用自监督 pretext 只重建静态外观，这一时序信号被浪费。
Method: 自监督预训练目标为 contrast projection——序列中每个像素相对其时间中位数的归一化下降量；预训练产出的权重不改动分割架构，可与半监督训练（如 UniMatch）叠加。在 DIAS 与 DSCA 上按 10%、20%、50% 标注比例与从零训练及若干方法对比，并做受控消融：同输入/损失/预算的时间中位数目标、以及把投影直接当输入通道或伪标签。
Result: 在 10%、20%、50% 标注下 ConPro 均优于从零训练，并在 DSCA 的 20% 与 50% 标注上是所比方法中最好的；受控比较显示增益来自目标本身——时间中位数目标停留在从零训练水平，直接使用投影（输入通道或伪标签）帮助很小或反而变差。UniMatch 从 ConPro 权重起步在每个标注比例上多得 0.5–2.0 Dice 与 0.9–2.3 clDice，DIAS 达 75.4 Dice、DSCA 达 81.3。
Conclusion: DSA 里造影剂的时序变化本身是可用的监督信号，把它做成对比投影目标即可在不改分割架构的前提下提升标签效率，并与半监督训练兼容。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AERIAL: Adversarial Evaluation of Robustness in Accuracy-Preserving Low-Precision EEG Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Deployment-oriented compression is attractive for resource-constrained brain--computer interfaces (BCIs), but whether it changes adversarial vulnerability remains unclear. On BCI Competition IV-2a, we compare 32-bit floating-point (FP32) EEGNet and ShallowConvNet models with global magnitude pruning and simulated INT8 post training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) across nine subjects and three seeds. Simulation provides differentiable quantize--dequantize models for white-box attacks and gradient analysis, while native TensorRT deployment is used for validation. Accuracy-preserving compression does not improve direct robustness: at $ε=0.005$, EEGNet PGD accuracy remains 22--24\% across FP32, 50\% pruning (P50), PTQ, and QAT. However, P50 reduces bidirectional transfer efficiency to 0.963/0.928 (FP32$\rightarrow$P50/P50$\rightarrow$FP32), versus 0.994/0.997 for PTQ; the same trend holds for ShallowConvNet. Gradient alignment shows a corresponding separation, while native PTQ agrees with simulated clean/adversarial predictions in 95--98\% of cases. These results show that direct robustness, adversarial transfer, and deployment efficiency are distinct properties of compressed EEG decoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 BCI Competition IV-2a 上对比 FP32、全局幅值剪枝与 INT8 量化（PTQ/QAT）的 EEG 解码器，发现保持精度的压缩并不提升直接对抗鲁棒性：ε=0.005 时 EEGNet 的 PGD 准确率在 FP32、P50、PTQ、QAT 下都停留在 22–24%。但 P50 把双向迁移效率压到 0.963/0.928（FP32→P50/P50→FP32），而 PTQ 为 0.994/0.997，梯度对齐呈现同样的分离。结论是直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移与部署效率是压缩 EEG 解码器的三个独立属性。
Motivation: 面向资源受限 BCI 的部署导向压缩是否改变对抗脆弱性尚不清楚，需要区分直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移与部署效率这三者。
Method: 在 BCI Competition IV-2a 上比较 FP32 的 EEGNet 与 ShallowConvNet，施加全局幅值剪枝与模拟 INT8 的 PTQ/QAT，覆盖 9 名被试与 3 个种子；用可微 quantize–dequantize 模型做白盒攻击与梯度分析，并以原生 TensorRT 部署做验证。
Result: ε=0.005 时 EEGNet 的 PGD 准确率在 FP32、50% 剪枝 (P50)、PTQ、QAT 下均为 22–24%；P50 的双向迁移效率为 0.963/0.928（FP32→P50/P50→FP32），PTQ 为 0.994/0.997，ShallowConvNet 呈相同趋势；梯度对齐显示对应分离；原生 PTQ 与模拟的干净/对抗预测在 95–98% 的情形上一致。
Conclusion: 精度保持型压缩不会自动带来对抗鲁棒性，直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移与部署效率必须分别评估；模拟量化模型可代表原生 TensorRT 部署的预测行为。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 在 BCI Competition IV-2a 上对比 FP32、全局幅值剪枝与 INT8 量化（PTQ/QAT）的 EEG 解码器，发现保持精度的压缩并不提升直接对抗鲁棒性：ε=0.005 时 EEGNet 的 PGD 准确率在 FP32、P50、PTQ、QAT 下都停留在 22–24%。但 P50 把双向迁移效率压到 0.963/0.928（FP32→P50/P50→FP32），而 PTQ 为 0.994/0.997，梯度对齐呈现同样的分离。结论是直接鲁棒性、对抗迁移与部署效率是压缩 EEG 解码器的三个独立属性。
