papers.title: Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Planners built on visual world models commonly score each predicted outcome by its distance to the encoded goal image. We show that this target can limit control even with exact dynamics and globally optimal short-horizon search: reaching a goal may require actions that initially move away from it. With frozen LeWM models, intermediate targets substantially improve action synthesis and recorded-action ranking on Cube, PushT, Reacher, and TwoRoom. Learned targets and targets drawn from observed experience both produce these gains. We introduce Anchored Planning, which retrieves a recorded segment whose start and end resemble the current and goal observations, then aims at an observation shortly after its start. The frozen model scores actions toward this target from the current state. Without additional training, planning toward observed targets outperforms the released LeWM planner on every task in our long-range evaluation. Additional final-goal search falls short of the same gains. Lower successor-prediction error need not translate into better control. Success also depends on how far ahead the target is placed and on shrinking the retrieval span as execution advances. Changing only the target lets the same frozen model and planner reach goals that final-goal scoring misses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视觉世界模型规划器用目标图像距离给预测结果打分，即使动力学精确、短视界搜索全局最优也会卡住，因为到达目标常需先远离目标。Anchored Planning 从记录轨迹中检索起止分别接近当前观测与目标观测的片段，改瞄其起点稍后的一帧中间目标；在冻结 LeWM 上不加训练即在长程评测的每个任务上超过官方规划器，而继续做最终目标搜索拿不到同等增益。
Motivation: 以目标图像距离为唯一评分目标会限制控制：到达目标的动作序列可能先远离目标，短视界搜索因此被困；同时更低的后继预测误差并不等于更好的控制。
Method: 提出 Anchored Planning：检索起止观测分别接近当前观测与目标观测的记录片段，把中间目标设为该片段起点稍后的一帧观测，冻结的 LeWM 模型据此从当前状态给动作打分；中间目标可来自学习得到的目标或观测经验，全程无需额外训练。
Result: 在 Cube、PushT、Reacher、TwoRoom 上，中间目标显著改善动作合成与记录动作排序，学习目标与观测经验目标都带来增益；长程评测中朝观测目标规划在每个任务上都超过发布的 LeWM 规划器，而追加最终目标搜索达不到同等增益。
Conclusion: 控制质量取决于目标放得多远以及执行推进时缩短检索跨度，只改目标就能让同一冻结模型与规划器到达最终目标打分漏掉的目标；后继预测误差更低不必然带来更好的控制。

papers.title: How does Adversarial Influence Scale in Multi-Agent Systems?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent deliberation can improve performance, but what happens when some agents do not act in good faith? In practice, an agent may be deceptive and work to subvert the group, whether through its own objectives or external instruction. We study how susceptibility to deception scales as groups increase in size and deceivers become more prevalent. It is not the number of agents in the group that matters, but the proportion of deceivers. We observe that the defection rate, how often initially correct agents switch to an incorrect final answer, rises linearly with this proportion. Whereas humans in comparable conformity studies are reliably swayed only when misleading confederates form a majority, LLM agents defect regularly even when deceivers remain a minority. Susceptibility also depends on which models are interacting, especially on the honest agent side. Unexpectedly, allowing deceivers to coordinate privately can make them less effective. Altogether, our results show that adding more agents is therefore not a sufficient defense, because the adversary can simply scale with the group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体 LLM 审议中注入欺骗者时，群体被带偏的程度取决于欺骗者占比而非群体规模：初始正确的一方转向错误答案的脱离率 (defection rate) 随该占比线性上升。与人类从众实验中只有误导性同谋过半才起效不同，LLM 智能在欺骗者仍是少数时就会频繁脱离；且允许欺骗者私下串谋反而会削弱其效果。作者据此断言，单纯增加智能体数量不足以防御对抗方，因为对手可以随群体规模同步扩张。
Motivation: 多智能体审议被当作提升 LLM 表现的手段，但当部分成员不以善意行事（出于自身目标或外部指令而欺骗、颠覆群体）时，群体的脆弱性如何随规模与欺骗者比例变化，此前缺少刻画。
Method: 在多智能体审议设定中操纵群体规模与欺骗者比例，测量初始正确的智能体最终改判为错误答案的脱离率 (defection rate)，并对比不同模型组合（尤其诚实方模型）以及欺骗者能否私下协调两种条件；结果与人类从众 (conformity) 研究中误导性同谋 (confederates) 的行为对照。
Result: 脱离率随欺骗者占比线性上升，而群体规模本身不起决定作用；LLM 智能在欺骗者仍占少数时就频繁脱离，人类对照实验中则只有误导性同谋过半才被可靠带偏；易感性依赖参与交互的模型组合，尤其是诚实一方的模型；允许欺骗者私下协调反而使其效果变差。
Conclusion: 对抗影响按欺骗者比例而非绝对数量扩展，因此增加智能体数量不是充分防御，对手可随群体同步扩张；防御设计需针对欺骗者占比与诚实方模型选择，而非单纯扩大群体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthetic Hospital: An Open, Verifiable, Physician-Validated Longitudinal EHR Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models are rarely used in clinical workflows because the realistic, longitudinal benchmarks needed to develop them are scarce. Real electronic health record (EHR) data cannot be openly shared due to privacy, ethics or data use issues and it does not contain verifiable ground truth since the chart records only reflect what clinicians documented. We introduce Synthetic Hospital, an open, fully synthetic, fact-grounded longitudinal EHR benchmark that resolves the open sharing and verifiable ground truth barriers. Built entirely from public medical-education material with no protected health information, it comprises 1,268 longitudinal patients and 5,602 encounters, where every diagnosis, finding, and temporal relation is grounded in standard ontologies (ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC) and with a complete provenance chain back to its source medical education material. Synthetic Hospital is served through a simulated hospital record system that mirrors real EHR infrastructure (standard interoperability APIs, role-based access and function-calling interface). In a blinded review, physicians distinguished its records from real patient charts at near-chance rates (53\%). Across 10 frontier and open models, none approaches ceiling: the best model reconstructs a patient's longitudinal problem list with a severity-weighted F1 of 0.73, level with the mean of seven physicians on a matched subset but well below the best of them (0.89), and misses roughly half of clinically relevant findings when summarizing a chart. Overall, these results highlight that Synthetic Hospital is a difficult and realistic test of clinical AI performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Synthetic Hospital 是一个完全合成、可公开共享且可核验的纵向 EHR 基准，含 1,268 名纵向患者与 5,602 次就诊，每条诊断、发现与时间关系都锚定在 ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC 本体并回溯到公开医学教育材料。10 个前沿与开源模型无一接近上限：最佳模型重建纵向问题列表的 severity-weighted F1 为 0.73，与七名医师均值持平但远低于最强医师的 0.89，摘要病历时漏掉约一半临床相关发现。
Motivation: 真实 EHR 因隐私与数据使用条款无法公开共享，且病历只记录医生写下的内容、缺乏可核验 ground truth，导致开发临床工作流所需的纵向基准稀缺。
Method: 全部语料取自公开医学教育材料、不含 PHI，按标准本体（ICD-10-CM、SNOMED CT、LOINC）锚定并保留回到源材料的完整 provenance 链；通过模拟医院记录系统提供，具备标准互操作 API、基于角色的访问与 function-calling 接口；评测含盲法医师判别与跨模型问题列表重建。
Result: 医师盲评区分合成记录与真实病历的正确率接近随机，为 53%；在 10 个前沿与开源模型中无一接近上限，最佳模型的 severity-weighted F1 为 0.73，与匹配子集上七名医师的均值持平、但低于最强医师的 0.89；模型在摘要病历时漏掉约一半临床相关发现。
Conclusion: 合成 EHR 可以同时做到公开可共享、可核验且逼真到医师近乎无法分辨，而当前临床 AI 在其上仍远未达到天花板，因此它构成临床 AI 性能的困难而真实的检验。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
papers.abstract_en: Detecting which holds a climber uses, and when, underpins automated scoring, movement analysis, and assistive systems for sport climbing. Existing approaches train task-specific models or repurpose 2D pose estimators whose hand keypoint sits at the wrist and foot keypoint at the ankle i.e. offset from the fingertips and toes that actually contact the holds, and whose hands are occluded in roughly half of all frames. We show that a frozen, off-the-shelf pose foundation model is sufficient: using the fingertip and toe keypoints of Sapiens, a per-frame proximity test against the annotated holds, per-limb mutual exclusion, and a short temporal-persistence rule, we detect hold usage without any climbing-specific training. On the The Way Up dataset (22 videos, 10 athletes, two routes), our method reaches an event F_1 of 90.2% on a held-out split (89.8% under leave-one-participant-out cross-validation) and 79.9% over all 22 videos at any temporal overlap, and performs best on footholds (F_1,89.8% overall, 96.6% held-out). Under an identical protocol it exceeds our reproductions of the YOLOv8-pose and ViTPose pipelines at every temporal threshold, with the margin widening under strict timing. An ablation shows that two intuitively helpful additions---dense foundation-feature change gating and body-part segmentation---both hurt, arguing that a minimal, keypoint-only design is the right one for this task. Finally, standard coaching statistics computed from our automatic predictions track ground truth closely (Pearson r=1.00 for climb time, 0.94 for pace), turning ordinary single-camera video into reliable performance metrics with no instrumentation.
papers.comment: Accepted at AI2ML Conference 2026 (2nd International Conference on Advancement & Innovation in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结的 Sapiens 姿态基础模型做免训练攀岩支点使用检测：取指尖与脚尖关键点，对标注支点做逐帧邻近判定，再加肢体互斥与短时持续性规则。在 The Way Up 数据集（22 段视频、10 名运动员、2 条路线）上事件 F1 达 90.2%（留一被试交叉验证 89.8%），同协议下在所有时间阈值都超过 YOLOv8-pose 与 ViTPose 复现，且消融显示稠密特征门控与身体部位分割反而有害。
Motivation: 现有方法要么为攀岩支点检测专门训练模型，要么直接挪用 2D 姿态估计器，其手部关键点落在腕部、脚部落在踝部，与真正接触支点的指尖和脚尖存在偏移，且约一半帧中手部被遮挡。
Method: 冻结现成的姿态基础模型 Sapiens，取指尖与脚尖关键点；对标注支点做逐帧邻近测试，叠加肢体互斥 (per-limb mutual exclusion) 与短时持续性规则判定支点使用，全程无攀岩相关训练；对照为同协议下复现的 YOLOv8-pose 与 ViTPose 流程，并做稠密基础特征变化门控与身体部位分割两项消融。
Result: 在 The Way Up 数据集（22 段视频、10 名运动员、2 条路线）上，留出划分事件 F1 为 90.2%，留一被试交叉验证为 89.8%，全部 22 段视频在任意时间重叠下为 79.9%；脚点表现最好，整体 F1 89.8%、留出划分 96.6%。同协议下在每个时间阈值都超过 YOLOv8-pose 与 ViTPose 复现，时间判据越严格差距越大；消融显示稠密特征变化门控与身体部位分割两项改动均使性能下降。自动预测导出的攀爬用时与配速统计与真值高度一致，Pearson r 分别为 1.00 与 0.94。
Conclusion: 对支点使用检测这一任务，最小化的纯关键点设计（指尖/脚尖 + 邻近 + 互斥 + 持续性）优于加入稠密特征门控或身体分割的更复杂方案，且单机位普通视频即可产出可靠表现指标而无需任何可穿戴仪器。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法要么为攀岩支点检测专门训练模型，要么直接挪用 2D 姿态估计器，其手部关键点落在腕部、脚部落在踝部，与真正接触支点的指尖和脚尖存在偏移，且约一半帧中手部被遮挡。
summary_sections.method: 冻结现成的姿态基础模型 Sapiens，取指尖与脚尖关键点；对标注支点做逐帧邻近测试，叠加肢体互斥 (per-limb mutual exclusion) 与短时持续性规则判定支点使用，全程无攀岩相关训练；对照为同协议下复现的 YOLOv8-pose 与 ViTPose 流程，并做稠密基础特征变化门控与身体部位分割两项消融。
summary_sections.result: 在 The Way Up 数据集（22 段视频、10 名运动员、2 条路线）上，留出划分事件 F1 为 90.2%，留一被试交叉验证为 89.8%，全部 22 段视频在任意时间重叠下为 79.9%；脚点表现最好，整体 F1 89.8%、留出划分 96.6%。同协议下在每个时间阈值都超过 YOLOv8-pose 与 ViTPose 复现，时间判据越严格差距越大；消融显示稠密特征变化门控与身体部位分割两项改动均使性能下降。自动预测导出的攀爬用时与配速统计与真值高度一致，Pearson r 分别为 1.00 与 0.94。

papers.title: Canopy: Exploiting Piecewise Smooth Tree Priors for Multi-Fidelity Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Many LLM inference problems, including model routing, prefix-cache management, prompt trimming, and test-time search, can be viewed as optimization over a tree. This structure arises naturally from autoregressive generation: every prefix defines a node, and its continuations form a subtree below it. Internal nodes of the tree provide cheap but biased estimates of a region's value, while leaf evaluations are expensive but accurate. Hierarchical bandit methods can exploit this structure, but typically require a specific smoothness schedule to be specified in advance, even though real objectives are often only piecewise smooth and their optima may lie near sharp boundaries. We introduce CANOPY, a multi-fidelity tree bandit that learns where the smoothness prior is valid rather than assuming it globally. CANOPY uses cheap random-path probes to construct an online certificate of local aggregation bias, then directs expensive leaf evaluations toward cells where the certificate detects a smoothness violation. We prove fixed-budget and regret guarantees whose additional cost is additive in the number of discontinuities, recovering the smooth-tree rate when no violations are present and approaching structure-blind search as violations become dense. Across routing, top-$k$ identification, test-time search, caching, and prompt trimming, CANOPY consistently improves matched-budget performance, including $2.9\times$ higher top-10 recall on a 1000-model pool, $1.6\times$ more SWE-bench Verified issues resolved than best-of-$N$, and $3.6\times$ lower median time-to-first-token with prefix caching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CANOPY 是面向 LLM 推理树结构优化的多保真 bandit：用廉价随机路径探测在线构造局部聚合偏差证书，把昂贵的叶子评估定向到证书判定平滑性失效的区域，从而不再全局假设平滑树先验。在路由、top-k 识别、test-time search、缓存与 prompt trimming 上均提升同等预算表现，1000 模型池 top-10 recall 提高 2.9 倍，SWE-bench Verified 解决问题数比 best-of-N 多 1.6 倍，前缀缓存下中位首 token 时间降低 3.6 倍。
Motivation: 分层 bandit 利用树结构做多保真优化时通常要求预先指定平滑性调度，但真实目标往往只是分段平滑、最优点可能落在尖锐边界附近，全局平滑假设会失效。
Method: CANOPY 用廉价随机路径探测 (random-path probes) 在线构造局部聚合偏差的证书，据此把昂贵叶子评估导向证书检测到平滑性违例的单元格；并证明固定预算与 regret 保证，其额外代价按不连续点数量加性增长。
Result: 理论保证在无违例时恢复 smooth-tree 收敛率、违例密集时逼近 structure-blind search，额外代价对不连续点数为加性。在 routing、top-k identification、test-time search、caching、prompt trimming 五个任务上同预算表现一致提升：1000 模型池 top-10 recall 提高 2.9 倍，SWE-bench Verified 解决问题数比 best-of-N 多 1.6 倍，前缀缓存下中位 time-to-first-token 降低 3.6 倍。
Conclusion: 把平滑性先验当作可在线检验的局部假设而非全局前提，多保真树 bandit 能在分段平滑目标上同时保住平滑情形的收敛率并容忍不连续点。

papers.title: Low-Cost Assays for Measuring Model Behavior Across Vendors and Releases
papers.abstract_en: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing "right?" moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag's surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出低成本模型行为测量框架：每个研究是一份冻结的公开刺激，在跨厂商模型面板上以每个模型几美元的成本统一运行，按解释程度选三种读法之一（精确匹配、LLM judge 按 codebook 且逐条报告与人工编码者的一致性、记录 agent 实际行为的 instrumented environment）。跨四年、前沿与开源实验室的模型上发现四类现象：44 个模型中 27 个至少一次选 serendipity；句尾 trailing "right?" 使认可度最多移动 32 个百分点且随代际从谄媚翻转为抵抗；立场坚持度随代际变化、坚持方式随实验室变化；部分编码 agent 在仓库文档与指令矛盾时从不默从，且同一模型随 harness 改变。
Motivation: 模型行为需在多模型、多提示、多版本上反复采样，而大部分行为藏在非结构化文本里，必须先编码才能计数，且结果要足够可读可复现才能跨厂商比较。
Method: 每个研究 = 一份冻结的公开刺激，在跨厂商模型面板上统一运行，单模型成本几美元或更低；按行为所需解释程度三选一读取 transcript：对 clamp 后回复做 exact match、由 LLM judge 按 codebook 编码并逐条报告与人工编码者的一致性、或用 instrumented environment 独立记录 agent 实际做了什么。
Result: 跨四年、前沿与开源实验室的模型面板给出四项发现：选词任务中 44 个模型有 27 个至少一次答 serendipity（四次尝试内）；trailing "right?" 使认可度最多移动 32 个百分点，且符号随代际从 sycophantic 翻转为 resistant，并与标签表层形式相关；在压力下是否坚持立场随代际变化、如何坚持随构建实验室变化；当被要求执行与仓库文档矛盾的操作时，部分编码 agent 从不默从、另一些总是照做，同一模型还会随 harness 改变。
Conclusion: 这类几美元级、可冻结复现的行为 battery 每逢新版本重跑，即可跨厂商、跨时间追踪模型行为如何变化。

papers.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance Question Answering in Financial Services with Domain-Adapted Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Financial institutions operate under dense, frequently amended rulebooks, and answering a compliance question correctly requires not only fluency but verifiable grounding in the authoritative text. Large language models are attractive for this task, yet the models that firms can realistically deploy on-premise are compact ones, and compact models hallucinate obligations. We study whether a carefully domain-adapted retrieval-augmented generation pipeline closes that gap. Our retriever is built in three stages on top of LegalBERT: entailment tuning that recasts question--passage matching as premise--hypothesis reconstruction, contrastive tuning with in-batch negatives, and score-level fusion with BM25. Our generator is a compact model (2B--12B parameters) served under 4-bit quantization, either prompted or adapted with retrieval-aware fine-tuning (RAFT) through LoRA. On ObliQA, a question-answering benchmark built from the Abu Dhabi Global Market rulebooks, the staged retriever raises Recall@10 from 0.256 to 0.774 and outperforms BM25 (0.678) and E5-large-v2 (0.758), the strongest general-purpose dense encoder we tested. RAFT-LoRA then improves the composite RePASs answer-quality score for every model we could adapt, with the largest gain on the weakest one. However, the adapted models do not transfer to Australian case-law questions, and a closed-book model that receives no passages at all scores within 0.011 RePASs of the full pipeline while producing answers that cite nothing and misstate obligations. The retrieval gain is therefore measured directly, the generation gain is a gain in RePASs rather than demonstrated grounding, and grounding itself requires an evaluation protocol that RePASs does not provide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ObliQA（阿布扎比全球市场规则库构建的合规问答基准）上，三阶段领域适配检索器把 Recall@10 从 0.256 提到 0.774，超过 BM25 的 0.678 与 E5-large-v2 的 0.758；RAFT-LoRA 提升所有可适配模型的 RePASs 分数。但适配模型无法迁移到澳大利亚案例法问题，且不给任何段落的 closed-book 模型 RePASs 仅低 0.011 却引用为零、错述义务，说明检索增益是实测的，生成增益只是 RePASs 上的增益而非已证实的 grounding。
Motivation: 金融机构规则库密集且频繁修订，合规问答需要对权威文本的可验证依据；企业实际可本地部署的紧凑 LLM（2B–12B）会幻觉义务，而现有评测无法区分真正 grounding 与分数提升。
Method: 检索器在 LegalBERT 之上分三阶段：蕴含微调（把问题-段落匹配改写为 premise-hypothesis 重构）、带 in-batch negatives 的对比微调、与 BM25 的分数级融合；生成器为 4-bit 量化的 2B–12B 紧凑模型，或经 LoRA 做检索感知微调 (RAFT)。评测用 ObliQA 与 RePASs 复合答案质量分，并测试向澳大利亚案例法问题的迁移。
Result: 三阶段检索器 Recall@10 从 0.256 升至 0.774，高于 BM25 (0.678) 与 E5-large-v2 (0.758)；RAFT-LoRA 对每个可适配模型都提升 RePASs，最弱模型增益最大。适配模型不迁移到澳大利亚案例法问题；不接收任何段落的 closed-book 模型 RePASs 与完整管线仅差 0.011，但其答案不引用任何来源且错述义务。
Conclusion: 检索增益可直接测量，生成增益只是 RePASs 分数而非已证实的 grounding；grounding 本身需要 RePASs 之外的评测协议，且领域适配不跨法域迁移。

papers.title: Advancing Model Research in AgentX: Long-Horizon Autonomy for Industrial Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Sustaining industrial recommendation research requires using the results of one experiment to decide what to investigate next. We present AgentX-Model, the next generation of AgentX's model research framework, which connects proposal development and model experimentation within sandboxes defined by business inputs and prediction tasks. AgentX-Model adopts a dual-agent architecture comprising a Research Agent and a Model Agent. The Research Agent develops independently reviewed proposals from papers and experimental findings, while the Model Agent conducts multi-round investigations and returns code, measurements, and unresolved questions. Using the returned results, the Research Agent selects a starting implementation and formulates the next research question, allowing subsequent experiments to build on earlier findings. We organize this continuing research around four actions: Reproduce, Follow-up, Composition, and Diagnose. The first three actions drive routine research, while Diagnose acquires the evidence needed to choose a repair, including for issues raised by business feedback and online evaluation, such as prediction bias measured by PCOC. Across the production evaluation, 560 of 636 completed model-changing experiments recorded AUC above their business baselines. As research continued, some experiments recorded AUC above every comparable ancestor in their lineages. The five latest online A/B evaluations across different business settings reported gains including 10-15% in acquisition efficiency, 15-20% in target-segment advertising spend, and 0.3-0.8% in watch time; the watch-time model used approximately 10% fewer FLOPs and parameters. A dependency-aware historical-replay benchmark further evaluates research allocation, with initial results showing no consistent efficiency gain from more complex scheduling when agents already analyze and select concrete candidates.
papers.comment: Technical report. 37 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentX-Model 用 Research Agent 与 Model Agent 的双智能体闭环把工业推荐模型研究串成可持续迭代：前者从论文与实验结论生成可评审的 proposal，后者多轮实验返回代码、测量与未解问题，再据此选定起点并提出下一个研究问题。636 个改模型实验中 560 个 AUC 超过业务基线，五次线上 A/B 报告获客效率 10-15%、目标人群广告花费 15-20%、观看时长 0.3-0.8% 的增益。
Motivation: 工业推荐研究里单次实验的结论往往被丢弃，下一轮选题缺少可复用的依据，实验链条难以在业务输入与预测任务定义的 sandbox 中持续累积。
Method: 双智能体架构：Research Agent 从论文与实验发现生成独立评审的 proposal，Model Agent 执行多轮调查并返回代码、测量与未解问题；研究动作分为 Reproduce、Follow-up、Composition、Diagnose 四类，Diagnose 为业务反馈与线上评估（如 PCOC 度量的预测偏差）收集选修复方案所需的证据。另设依赖感知的历史回放 benchmark 来评估研究分配。
Result: 生产评估中 636 个完成的改模型实验有 560 个 AUC 高于业务基线，部分实验 AUC 超过其 lineage 中所有可比祖先；五次跨业务场景的线上 A/B 报告获客效率增益 10-15%、目标人群广告花费增益 15-20%、观看时长增益 0.3-0.8%，其中观看时长模型少用约 10% FLOPs 与参数。历史回放 benchmark 初步显示，当 agent 已在分析并筛选具体候选时，更复杂的调度没有一致的效率增益。
Conclusion: 让 agent 把上一轮实验结果直接用作下一轮选题依据，可以在工业推荐中持续产出超过业务基线的模型；而研究分配上更复杂的调度在已有候选筛选时并不带来稳定收益。

papers.title: GHOST-Q: Towards Studying Grounding Hallucinations Overlooked Under Same-score TradeOffs in Quantized VLMS
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization of vision--language models (VLMs) is typically assessed through aggregate task accuracy and memory savings, but preserving a headline score does not guarantee preservation of visual grounding behavior. We present GHOST-Q, a cross-precision controlled evaluation of three 8B VLM families under FP16, INT8, and NF4 across utility and hallucination-sensitive benchmarks. Rather than comparing only aggregate accuracy, we pair FP16 and quantized predictions item by-item to quantify how compression redistributes grounding successes and failures. Five of six quantized variants preserve MMStar accuracy within $\pm2$ percentage points, yet 10 of 36 paired effects remain significant after false-discovery-rate correction, nine on hallucination-sensitive conditions. Same-device A100 profiling further demonstrates that substantial memory reduction does not necessarily mean lower inference latency. Finally, an open-ended AMBER audit reveals strong generation budget censoring whose severity varies by architecture and precision. These results show that quantized VLMs should be evaluated jointly for aggregate utility, grounding reliability, generation behavior, and realized deployment efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GHOST-Q 对三个 8B VLM 家族在 FP16、INT8、NF4 三种精度下做逐条配对的受控评测，发现聚合准确率持平并不等于 grounding 行为被保留：六个量化变体中五个把 MMStar 精度保持在 ±2 个百分点内，但 36 项配对效应里仍有 10 项经 FDR 校正后显著，其中 9 项落在幻觉敏感条件上。
Motivation: 量化 VLM 的评测只看聚合任务精度与显存节省，而总分持平可能掩盖逐条预测中 grounding 成败的重新分布，导致幻觉行为退化被掩盖。
Method: 对三个 8B VLM 家族做跨精度 (FP16/INT8/NF4) 受控评测，覆盖 utility 与幻觉敏感基准；将 FP16 与量化预测逐条配对来量化压缩对 grounding 成败的再分配，并对配对效应做 false-discovery-rate 校正；另在同卡 A100 上做 profiling，并对开放式生成做 AMBER 审计。
Result: 六个量化变体中五个的 MMStar 精度保持在 ±2 个百分点内，但 36 项配对效应中 10 项经 FDR 校正后仍显著，其中 9 项位于幻觉敏感条件；A100 profiling 显示大幅显存下降不必然带来更低推理延迟；AMBER 审计发现强烈的 generation budget censoring，其严重程度随架构与精度变化。
Conclusion: 量化 VLM 必须联合评估聚合 utility、grounding 可靠性、生成行为与实际部署效率，单看总分与显存不足以判定压缩是否保留了视觉 grounding。

papers.title: Guardrails or Roadblocks? Effects of Pedagogical Style and Context Awareness in AI Teaching Assistants for Programming
papers.abstract_en: AI teaching assistants (AI TAs) backed by large language models (LLMs) and pedagogical guardrails are increasingly being integrated into programming courses, providing students with scalable access to hints, conceptual explanations, and code-level feedback. However, guardrails may also create friction. If students feel that the support provided is overly restrictive or poorly contextualized to their current progress, they may bypass approved tools for general-purpose LLMs. To investigate how AI TA design affects students' learning experiences, we conducted a randomized controlled trial with 132 students in an introductory programming course. Students completed three tasks related to code-writing and debugging and were randomly assigned to one of four AI TAs varied across two dimensions: pedagogical guidance style (Socratic vs. Direct instruction) and context awareness (no context vs. full context of the problem and student solution). We examined students' perceptions, interaction behaviors, and evidence of post-task comprehension. Students rated the Socratic AI TA with full context least favorably, reporting significantly lower perceived support for task completion. Descriptively, this condition also showed the highest observed interaction stress, the highest rate of external LLM use, and the lowest proportion of post-task explanations demonstrating full comprehension, though these differences were not statistically significant. These findings suggest that guardrailed AI TAs are not automatically better for learning. Instead, their effectiveness depends on how pedagogical guidance and contextual awareness are balanced in ways that students experience as useful, supportive, and worth continuing to use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在入门编程课的随机对照试验中，带教学护栏的 AI 助教并不天然更利于学习：苏格拉底式提问叠加完整上下文（问题与学生代码全给）被评为支持感最低，同时观察到最高交互压力、最高外部通用 LLM 绕用率和最低的课后完全理解比例。作者主张护栏效果取决于教学引导风格与上下文感知如何配平到学生觉得有用、愿意继续用。
Motivation: 编程课的 AI 助教普遍加教学护栏，但若学生感到限制过强或与自身进度不匹配，会绕开批准工具改用通用 LLM，护栏反而制造摩擦；这一设计权衡缺少受控实验证据。
Method: 对 132 名入门编程课学生做随机对照试验，完成三个代码编写与调试任务，随机进入四组 AI 助教之一，按两个维度交叉：教学引导风格（苏格拉底式 vs 直接讲授）与上下文感知（无上下文 vs 给出题目与学生解答的完整上下文）；考察学生感知、交互行为与课后理解证据。
Result: 苏格拉底式 + 完整上下文组的感知支持评分显著最低；该组在描述统计上交互压力最高、外部 LLM 使用率最高、课后解释体现完全理解的比例最低，但后三项差异不具统计显著性。
Conclusion: 护栏式 AI 助教不会自动改善学习，其效果取决于教学引导与上下文感知的平衡方式，需让学生体验为有用、有支持感且值得继续使用。

papers.title: Let Training Guide Selection: Online Synthetic Data Filtering via Real-Anchored Utility
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data can scale training supervision when real-world data are limited, but noise and distribution mismatch can reduce its value. Existing synthetic data selection methods often emphasize fidelity or diversity rather than the learner's evolving needs. We propose FROST, an online framework that estimates synthetic-data utility through gradient feedback anchored in real training data. It calibrates batch utility against recent history to determine when filtering is needed and filters samples only in out-of-band batches to determine what to retain, without an external verifier or held-out validation set. Experiments on two public benchmarks for image classification and LLM fine-tuning for text-to-SQL show that FROST filters out around 20--30% of the synthetic data while improving real-task performance compared with training on the full synthetic data pool. We further apply FROST during training in a large-scale industrial ads re-ranking system, achieving significant performance gains over a highly optimized production baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FROST 用真实训练数据锚定的梯度反馈在线估计合成数据效用，先对照近期历史校准批次效用决定是否过滤，再只在 out-of-band 批次中决定保留哪些样本，无需外部验证器或留出验证集。在图像分类与 text-to-SQL 微调两个公开基准上，它滤掉约 20–30% 合成数据的同时，真实任务性能高于用全量合成池训练；在工业广告重排系统上也超过高度优化的生产基线。
Motivation: 真实数据受限时合成数据能扩大监督规模，但噪声与分布错配会稀释其价值；现有合成数据选择方法偏重保真度或多样性，不跟随学习器自身不断变化的需求。
Method: FROST 是在线框架：用真实训练数据锚定的梯度反馈估计每个合成样本的效用，把批次效用对照近期历史做校准以判断是否需要过滤，且只在 out-of-band 批次中执行保留决策，不依赖外部验证器或留出验证集。
Result: 在图像分类与 LLM 微调 text-to-SQL 两个公开基准上，FROST 过滤掉约 20–30% 的合成数据，真实任务性能优于在全量合成数据池上训练；在大规模工业广告重排系统训练中，相对高度优化的生产基线取得显著性能提升。
Conclusion: 让训练过程本身（真实数据锚定的梯度反馈）来决定合成数据取舍，可以在不引入验证器的前提下同时减少合成数据用量并提升真实任务表现，且能从公开基准迁移到工业重排场景。

papers.title: OceanXL: Large-scale Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting via Block Partitioning and Adaptive Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Underwater 3D reconstruction is critical for marine exploration, ecological monitoring, and subsea infrastructure inspection, yet remains challenging at large scale due to light attenuation, scattering, and limited capture coverage. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time rendering, its application to large underwater scenes is constrained by high memory consumption and inefficient optimization over extensive areas. We propose OceanXL, a fast and scalable 3DGS-based framework for large-scale underwater reconstruction. OceanXL adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy, partitioning scenes into spatially coherent blocks to enable efficient optimization while preserving global geometric consistency. We further introduce an adaptive pruning scheme tailored to underwater conditions that removes redundant primitives, producing compact representations without sacrificing visual fidelity. Together, these components improve training efficiency and rendering performance for large scenes. We also introduce a large-scale underwater dataset covering diverse marine environments. Experiments on five large-scale scenes demonstrate favorable scalability, compactness, and efficiency--quality trade-offs over large-scene baselines. Controlled comparisons on the small-scale SeaThru-NeRF dataset further show competitive reconstruction quality with substantially smaller model sizes than underwater-specific methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OceanXL 用分块 (block partitioning) 加自适应剪枝把 3D Gaussian Splatting 扩展到大尺度水下场景：把场景切成空间连续的块分别优化以保住全局几何一致性，再按水下条件剔除冗余高斯原语。在五个大尺度场景上相对大场景基线取得更有利的可扩展性、紧凑度与效率-质量折中，在小尺度 SeaThru-NeRF 上重建质量有竞争力且模型体积显著更小。
Motivation: 水下场景受光衰减、散射和拍摄覆盖有限影响，3DGS 用于大范围区域时显存占用高、优化低效，制约其在海洋勘探与海底设施巡检中的可用尺度。
Method: 分而治之：把场景划分为空间连续的块以支持高效优化并保持全局几何一致性；再引入针对水下条件的自适应剪枝 (adaptive pruning) 去除冗余原语，得到紧凑表示；同时发布一个覆盖多样海洋环境的大尺度水下数据集。
Result: 在五个大尺度场景上，相对大场景基线在可扩展性、紧凑度与效率-质量折中上表现有利；在小尺度 SeaThru-NeRF 数据集的受控对比中，重建质量有竞争力，模型体积比水下专用方法小得多。
Conclusion: 分块优化加水下自适应剪枝能让 3DGS 在大尺度水下重建中同时改善训练效率与渲染表现，并以更小的模型体积保持重建质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 分块优化加水下自适应剪枝能让 3DGS 在大尺度水下重建中同时改善训练效率与渲染表现，并以更小的模型体积保持重建质量。

papers.title: From Interests to Semantic IDs: Retrieval-Grounded Credit Assignment for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic IDs (SIDs) encode each catalog item as a short token sequence, enabling generative recommenders to predict the next item autoregressively. Reasoning-enhanced variants, an increasingly common extension, first generate a textual trace and then decode a next-item SID by beam search. Such recommenders are commonly trained with group-relative policy optimization under an exact-match SID reward, which is sparse in large catalogs. Two failure modes follow. When all rollouts in a group miss the target, the group yields zero advantage and no learning signal. Rollouts sharing the same SID reward receive identical advantages, however much their traces differ. In both cases the reward reflects only the decoded SID, never the reasoning that produced it. This creates a credit-assignment gap. We address this gap with retrieval-grounded query attribution. Each trace is structured into a history summary, a set of interest hypotheses, and a final SID. A frozen retriever executes every hypothesis as a catalog query, so that each hypothesis becomes independently verifiable rather than judged only through the final SID. A rollout is rewarded when any of its queries retrieves the target within the \mbox{top-$K$}, and per-query hit indicators localize that reward to individual hypotheses. Credit is thus assigned at the span level: only hypotheses that individually hit receive positive retrieval advantage, while the retrieval channel never updates the final SID span. Rollouts that share a SID reward can therefore receive different updates. Across experiments on three Amazon Reviews datasets, this yields consistent improvements in SID recommendation. On Video Games, an oracle analysis further reveals the potential of interest-conditioned SID decoding: selecting the target-relevant query among generated interests improves both recall and ranking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生成式推荐中 SID 精确匹配奖励在大目录下过于稀疏、组内全错或同奖励导致信用分配失效的问题，提出检索接地的查询归因：把推理轨迹拆成历史摘要、兴趣假设与最终 SID，用冻结 retriever 逐条执行假设，任一查询 top-K 命中即给奖励，并把奖励按命中查询定位到 span 级。在三个 Amazon Reviews 数据集上 SID 推荐一致提升，Video Games 的 oracle 分析显示按目标相关兴趣查询解码可同时改善 recall 与排序。
Motivation: 推理增强的生成式推荐用 GRPO 加精确匹配 SID 奖励训练，但大目录下奖励稀疏：组内全部落空时优势为零、无学习信号；共享同一 SID 奖励的 rollout 优势完全相同，无论其推理轨迹差异多大，奖励只反映解码出的 SID 而不反映产生它的推理。

Result: 在三个 Amazon Reviews 数据集上带来 SID 推荐的一致提升；Video Games 上的 oracle 分析显示，在生成的兴趣中选择与目标相关的查询进行 SID 解码，可同时改善 recall 与排序。

papers.title: Diverse Geometries, Frozen Weights: Robust Heterogeneous Treatment-Effect Estimation via Causal Expert Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects from observational data is difficult because the most appropriate inductive bias varies with overlap, treatment imbalance, prognostic structure, and sample size. We introduce the Geometry-Diverse Anchor-Correction Expert Ensemble (GeoACE), a five-expert framework that combines a common anchor-correction estimator with complementary overlap-aware and outcome-guided geometries. Its task-level ensemble weights are learned only from internal validation predictions, frozen before test evaluation, and then applied to experts refitted on the complete development sample. The fifth expert, O-Phi-ACE, constructs an outcome-free, overlap-aware statistical projection from covariates and treatment assignment and replaces the anchor input with this lower-dimensional geometry. We evaluate GeoACE against 11 comparators on eight benchmark protocols. Adding O-Phi-ACE reduced mean sqrt(PEHE) relative to the four-expert ensemble on all seven benchmarks with individual-effect truth, winning 998 of 1,225 paired tasks; the change on JOBS policy risk was negligible. The five-expert ensemble ranked first on IHDP100, IHDPA, and IHDPB and second on NEWS, differing from the NEWS leader by 0.13%. Across the seven sqrt(PEHE) benchmarks it obtained the lowest observed average rank (3.714), although the omnibus Friedman and Iman-Davenport tests were not significant (p=0.328 and p=0.330). Using the same five frozen experts, inverse-DR weighting was consistently better than winner-take-all selection, convex DR fitting, R-stacking, and causal Q-aggregation in benchmark-balanced analyses, but was statistically indistinguishable from equal weighting and DR ridge shrinkage. The evidence therefore supports geometry-diverse expert libraries and leakage-free aggregation as a robustness strategy, not universal superiority of either GeoACE or one weighting rule.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, 8 benchmark protocols. Supplementary material is included as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoACE 用五个几何各异的因果专家（共同 anchor-correction 估计器 + overlap-aware 与 outcome-guided 几何，第五个专家 O-Phi-ACE 从协变量与处理分配构造无结果的 overlap-aware 投影）做异质处理效应估计，集成权重只在内部验证预测上学出、测试前冻结。加入 O-Phi-ACE 后在全部七个有个体效应真值的基准上降低平均 sqrt(PEHE)，1,225 个配对任务中赢 998 个；但作者明确结论是支持几何多样专家库与无泄漏聚合这一稳健性策略，而非 GeoACE 或任一加权规则的普遍优越。
Motivation: 观测数据的异质处理效应估计中，最优归纳偏置随 overlap、处理不平衡、预后结构与样本量变化，单一估计器几何在不同基准协议上不稳定。

Result: 加入 O-Phi-ACE 在全部七个有个体效应真值的基准上降低平均 sqrt(PEHE)，1,225 个配对任务中赢 998 个；JOBS policy risk 上变化可忽略。五专家集成在 IHDP100、IHDPA、IHDPB 排第一、NEWS 排第二，与 NEWS 第一名差 0.13%。七个 sqrt(PEHE) 基准上平均秩最低（3.714），但 Friedman 与 Iman-Davenport 检验不显著（p=0.328、p=0.330）。同一批冻结专家下 inverse-DR 加权在 benchmark-balanced 分析中一致优于 winner-take-all、convex DR fitting、R-stacking 与 causal Q-aggregation，但与 equal weighting 和 DR ridge shrinkage 无统计差异。

papers.title: Learning Better Reasoning for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation reformulates item retrieval as sequence generation, allowing a unified model to directly generate the next item from a user's interaction history. Semantic IDs further make this paradigm effective and scalable by representing each item as discrete codes, enabling knowledge sharing among semantically related items. Recent studies introduce explicit reasoning before Semantic-ID generation, helping models summarize user interests and infer possible preference transitions. However, reasoning is not inherently beneficial: Inaccurate or uninformative reasoning may mislead subsequent item generation and ultimately degrade recommendation performance. This raises a central challenge: how can a recommender select and learn effective reasoning traces and progressively evolve toward better reasoning from its own generations? In this work, we propose Evo-Rec, a three-stage framework for learning better reasoning and further enhancing it through reinforcement learning. First, we align Semantic IDs with their textual and behavioral contexts, enabling the model to understand and generate item identifiers. Second, we sample multiple candidate reasoning traces and retain those that improve the prediction of the ground-truth item, providing a stronger reasoning initialization through supervised fine-tuning. Third, we further optimize the reasoning policy through reinforcement learning with catalog-constrained item generation and ranking-aware recommendation feedback. Experiments on three Amazon Review benchmarks show that Evo-Rec consistently outperforms discriminative, generative, and reasoning-enhanced recommenders across all evaluation metrics. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework in learning better reasoning for SID-based generative recommendation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Evo-Rec 是面向 Semantic ID 生成式推荐的三阶段推理学习框架：先对齐 Semantic ID 与文本/行为上下文，再采样多条候选推理轨迹并保留能提升真实物品预测的那些做监督微调，最后用带目录约束生成与排序感知反馈的强化学习优化推理策略。在三个 Amazon Review 基准上，它在全部评估指标上一致优于判别式、生成式与推理增强的推荐器。
Motivation: 生成式推荐中显式推理并不天然有益：不准确或无信息的推理会误导后续物品生成、反而降低推荐效果，因此需要让推荐器从自身生成中筛选并逐步学出有效推理轨迹。
Method: 三阶段框架 Evo-Rec：第一阶段将 Semantic ID 与其文本和行为上下文对齐，使模型能理解并生成物品标识；第二阶段采样多条候选推理轨迹，保留能改进真实物品预测的轨迹做监督微调 (SFT) 以获得更强的推理初始化；第三阶段用强化学习优化推理策略，采用目录约束的物品生成 (catalog-constrained item generation) 与排序感知的推荐反馈 (ranking-aware feedback)。
Result: 在三个 Amazon Review 基准上，Evo-Rec 在所有评估指标上一致优于判别式推荐器、生成式推荐器与推理增强推荐器。
Conclusion: 筛选出能提升真实物品预测的推理轨迹再用强化学习继续优化，是让 SID 生成式推荐获得更好推理并提升推荐效果的有效路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) bring broad knowledge and spatial reasoning to robot manipulation, yet existing systems either use them indirectly, to predict constraints or write programs, or give them a view of the scene rather than a world in which to act. We present World Action Agent (WAA), a multi-agent harness through which VLMs pilot robots with basic tools, making every decision within a visual action workspace. The workspace has three properties. Contact views, selected automatically from the scene geometry, present the scene around the current interaction. Action rehearsal turns each action into an editable proposal that the agent, alone or through an Imagination Agent, previews and revises against planning feedback before execution. In-view correction closes the loop between observation, rehearsal, and low-level execution, letting the agent remove residual offsets in the view where it observes them. Through the same workspace, WAA acquires embodied procedural knowledge in two ways: it evolves multimodal skills from expert videos and human teaching under evidence-based review and consults them through a Skill Agent, and its interaction traces train smaller VLMs to pilot the same harness. On LIBERO-Pro, WAA with skills evolved only from LIBERO-90 reaches a state-of-the-art 75.6% average success, outperforming end-to-end VLAs, code-as-policy agents, and a visual-harness baseline with the same backbone; the same skills remain effective on robosuite without further learning. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on harness traces raises its out-of-domain success from 1.7% to 43.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: World Action Agent (WAA) 用多智能体 harness 让 VLM 在可视化动作工作区里直接操作机器人：接触视角 (contact views) 由场景几何自动选取，动作预演 (action rehearsal) 把每个动作变成可编辑提案，经 Imagination Agent 与规划反馈修订后再执行，in-view correction 在观察处消除残余偏移。仅用 LIBERO-90 进化技能时，WAA 在 LIBERO-Pro 上平均成功率 75.6% 达 SOTA，超过端到端 VLA、code-as-policy 与同 backbone 的视觉 harness 基线；用 harness 轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-9B 使其域外成功率从 1.7% 升到 43.3%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 机器人系统要么间接用模型预测约束或写程序，要么只给模型场景的一张视图而非可作用的 world，导致操作决策缺少可修订的执行闭环。
Method: WAA 是多智能体 harness：VLM 带基础工具在可视化动作工作区内决策，含自动选取的 contact views、可编辑的 action rehearsal 提案（可经 Imagination Agent 预览修订）、in-view correction 闭环；技能从专家视频与人类示教在证据审查下进化并由 Skill Agent 调用，交互轨迹用于训练更小的 VLM 驾驶同一 harness。
Result: LIBERO-Pro 上，仅用 LIBERO-90 进化技能的 WAA 平均成功率 75.6%（SOTA），优于端到端 VLA、code-as-policy 与同 backbone 视觉 harness 基线；同批技能不需再学习即可迁到 robosuite。用 harness 轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-9B，域外成功率 1.7% → 43.3%。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的每个决策放进可预演、可修订、可纠错的动作工作区，配合进化技能与轨迹蒸馏，能在机器人操作上同时拿到 SOTA 成功率和小模型的域外迁移能力。

summary_sections.result: LIBERO-Pro 上，仅用 LIBERO-90 进化技能的 WAA 平均成功率 75.6%（SOTA），优于端到端 VLA、code-as-policy 与同 backbone 视觉 harness 基线；同批技能不需再学习即可迁到 robosuite。用 harness 轨迹微调 Qwen3.5-9B，域外成功率 1.7% → 43.3%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 VLM 的每个决策放进可预演、可修订、可纠错的动作工作区，配合进化技能与轨迹蒸馏，能在机器人操作上同时拿到 SOTA 成功率和小模型的域外迁移能力。

papers.title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
papers.abstract_en: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaTex4D 为基于形变的 4D Gaussian Splatting 引入自适应纹理容量分配：每个 Gaussian 携带打包的 RGBA triplane，两条轴依据可见性归一化的屏幕空间梯度与形变局部尺度独立增长。在 N3DV 与 PanopticSports 上纹理存储减半以上且重建质量保持，固定内存预算下优于均匀纹理分配。
Motivation: 对所有 primitive 给同一纹理分辨率会在低细节或弱可见区域浪费存储，使 4D Gaussian 表示的局部外观容量分配低效。
Method: AdaTex4D 是面向形变式 4D Gaussian Splatting 的自适应纹理容量模块：每个 Gaussian 携带 packed RGBA triplanes，其两条轴按可见性归一化的屏幕空间梯度 (visibility normalized screen-space gradients) 与形变局部尺度 (deformed local scales) 独立扩展，从而按需分配纹理容量。
Result: 在 N3DV 与 PanopticSports 上，AdaTex4D 使纹理存储减少一半以上 (more than half) 同时保持重建质量；在固定内存预算下，自适应分配相比均匀纹理分配提升质量，并降低整体模型与峰值内存。
Conclusion: 动态、各向异性的纹理分配是 4D Gaussian 表示中更高效的局部外观容量分配方式，可在同等内存下换取更高质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Contraction Framework for Stochastic Operators with Bootstrapping: Application to TD Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many iterative algorithms rely on bootstrapping. A variable is updated using a second, frozen copy as a target, which is periodically replaced with the updated variable. Majorize-minimize and inexact proximal-point methods share this structure, as does temporal-difference (TD) learning. However, existing convergence guarantees for scenarios that combine sampled updates with targets refreshed only every $K$ steps rely on the specific structure of the update, such as linear approximation or gradient-based inner steps, and on uniformly bounded sampling error. We instead model the sampled update as a stochastic operator on the parameter space, which reduces the analysis to a contraction argument that needs no gradient structure and allows the sampling error to grow with the iterates. Within this framework, we derive a finite-time bound for i.i.d. samples and any target-update period $K$. We show that the iterates converge geometrically in root mean square to a ball around the fixed point, provided the sensitivity to the frozen target is smaller than the contraction slack of the inner map. Existing deterministic frozen-target contraction and stochastic-gradient-type bounds follow as special cases of our framework, and simulations of TD learning reproduce the predicted contraction rate and scaling of the error floor with the step size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带 bootstrapping 的采样更新统一建模为参数空间上的随机算子，收敛性化归为收缩论证：只要对冻结目标的敏感度小于内层映射的收缩裕度，迭代量就以几何速率在均方意义下收敛到不动点邻域的球。对任意目标刷新周期 K 和 i.i.d. 样本给出有限时间界，TD 学习仿真复现了预测的收缩率与误差地板随步长的标度。
Motivation: 现有对“采样更新 + 每 K 步才刷新目标”这类组合的收敛保证依赖更新的具体结构（线性逼近、基于梯度的内层步）以及采样误差一致有界，适用面窄。
Method: 将采样更新直接建模为参数空间上的随机算子 (stochastic operator)，用收缩 (contraction) 论证替代梯度结构分析；对 i.i.d. 样本与任意目标刷新周期 K 推导有限时间界，并允许采样误差随迭代量增长。框架涵盖 majorize-minimize、非精确近端点法与 TD learning。
Result: 在“对冻结目标的敏感度小于内层映射收缩裕度”的条件下，迭代量以几何速率在均方 (root mean square) 意义下收敛到不动点周围的球；已有的确定性冻结目标收缩界与随机梯度型界作为特例被覆盖；TD learning 仿真复现了预测的收缩率以及误差地板随步长的标度。
Conclusion: 带 bootstrapping 的采样迭代算法的收敛性可以只靠随机算子的收缩性质刻画，无需梯度结构，也不必假设采样误差一致有界。

papers.title: Beyond Average Safety: Chance-Constrained LLM Fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models on new objectives can improve helpfulness, instruction following, or domain-specific performance, but it can also induce regressions on safety-critical prompts. Existing safety-preserving fine-tuning methods typically control average safety loss or use weighted auxiliary penalties, which can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose a chance-constrained formulation for safety-preserving fine-tuning that limits the fraction of safety examples whose degradation relative to a reference model exceeds a prescribed threshold. Because the resulting empirical chance constraint contains a discontinuous indicator, we introduce a differentiable majorization of the violation rate, yielding a tractable conservative constraint. We then develop a constraint-aware gradient descent method that treats the majorized constraint as a safe set in parameter space and minimally modifies the fine-tuning direction to preserve feasibility. The resulting update admits a closed form and produces a tail-aware safety correction that emphasizes examples near or above the degradation threshold. We conduct an extensive set of experiments on harmful fine-tuning across three different tasks and three models and show that our approach consistently outperforms the baselines that exist in the literature. These results suggest that safety preservation in LLM fine-tuning is better viewed as a reliability-constrained optimization problem than as average-risk regularization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 安全微调写成 chance-constrained 优化：限制相对参考模型退化超过阈值的安全样本比例，用可微 majorization 替代不连续指示函数，再把该约束当作参数空间的安全集，对梯度方向做最小修正以保持可行。在三个任务、三个模型的 harmful fine-tuning 实验中一致优于文献现有基线，更新对阈值附近或以上的样本给出尾部安全修正。
Motivation: 现有安全保持微调只控制平均安全损失或用加权辅助惩罚，会掩盖罕见但严重的失败；平均风险正则不足以约束尾部退化。
Method: 提出 chance-constrained 公式，约束退化超过给定阈值的样本比例；对含不连续 indicator 的经验约束做可微 majorization，得到保守但可解的约束；再开发 constraint-aware gradient descent，把 majorized 约束视为参数空间安全集，最小修改微分方向以保持可行性，更新有闭式解。
Result: 在 harmful fine-tuning 上做实验，覆盖三个不同任务与三个模型，方法一致优于文献中已有基线；更新产生 tail-aware 安全修正，强调接近或超过退化阈值的样本。
Conclusion: 安全保持应视为 reliability-constrained optimization 问题，而不是平均风险正则化问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Confusion Is Equal: A Source-Aware Uncertainty Diagnosis for Fine-Grained Aircraft Detection
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained object detectors are commonly evaluated with confusion matrices, which show where the model is confused but not why, nor whether the confusion can be reduced. We argue that confusion can be attributed to distinct, separable sources, each quantitatively measurable, turning a passive measurement into actionable guidance. We present $A^2E^2$, a diagnostic tool that decomposes the sources of confusion along two axes, $\{$aleatoric, epistemic$\} \times \{$within-class, between-class$\}$, giving a $2\times2$ taxonomy that enumerates the source types. Each quadrant is measured by its own quantity, computed in one of three places (input geometry, output-space disagreement, and the bias-parameter posterior), so the two epistemic sources are separated by construction rather than by an empirical correlation. On fine-grained aircraft detection, the four quadrants become four named sources with their own remedy verdict: affinity (geometric similarity, irreducible from size alone), heterogeneity (geometrically heterogeneous sub-variants, pointing to re-labeling rather than more data), contested (an insufficiently trained but learnable boundary, improvable), and collapsed (a class starved of data, reducible). After attributing the confusion to a specific reducible source, we apply a targeted intervention and verify experimentally that it reduces the diagnosed source specifically while leaving the irreducible sources unchanged. $A^2E^2$ thus turns confusion measurement into a concrete, validatable and actionable "diagnosis" in which the same off-diagonal mass can carry opposite causes and opposite remedies. We also state this framework's limits, including which sources are only partially identifiable on this specific dataset and why.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 A²E² 诊断工具，把细粒度目标检测混淆矩阵的非对角质量按 {偶然/认知} × {类内/类间} 拆成 2×2 四象限，每象限用独立量度在输入几何、输出分歧或偏置参数后验三处之一计算，两个认知来源由构造而非经验相关分离。在细粒度飞机检测上四象限对应四个命名来源与各自的处置判定：affinity 不可约、heterogeneity 应重标注、contested 可改进、collapsed 可通过补数据减少；定向干预后被诊断来源特异性下降，不可约来源保持不变。
Motivation: 混淆矩阵只显示模型在哪里混淆，不说明为什么混淆、能否消除，因而无法把被动测量转成可执行的修复指引。
Method: A²E² 沿 {aleatoric, epistemic} × {within-class, between-class} 建立 2×2 分类，每个象限用自身量度在输入几何、输出空间分歧、偏置参数后验三处之一计算，使两个 epistemic 来源由构造分离；随后对可归因的可约来源施加定向干预并验证。
Result: 在细粒度飞机检测上四象限落地为四个来源：affinity（几何相似，仅凭尺寸不可约）、heterogeneity（几何异质子型，指向重标注而非加数据）、contested（训练不足但可学的边界，可改进）、collapsed（数据饥饿类别，可减少）；定向干预实验验证被诊断来源特异性下降而不可约来源不变。
Conclusion: 同一块非对角混淆质量可能携带相反成因与相反处置，混淆测量可转成可验证、可执行的诊断；作者同时说明该框架的边界，包括此数据集上哪些来源仅部分可辨识及其原因。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Dimensional Matching
papers.abstract_en: We study a matching mechanism where agents and objects are described by features rather than complete rankings. A single spectral projection reduces the problem to a one-dimensional sort, computable in O(N log N) time. We prove that on descaled features and preferences, our algorithm obtains the exact Nash Social Welfare (NSW) optimum within the projected space, with an unconditional utilitarian-welfare guarantee and a conditional NSW guarantee. The proposed mechanism is stable against exogenous noise but not strategy-proof; we provide an explicit profitable misreport. On an agentic AI shopping application, the diagnostics correctly anticipate both a success and a failure case. A 100-instance robustness study confirms the findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于特征而非完整排序的多维匹配机制：一次谱投影把匹配问题化为一维排序，O(N log N) 可解，并在投影空间内精确达到 Nash Social Welfare (NSW) 最优。该机制对外生噪声稳定但不防策略操纵（给出显式获利谎报），在 agentic AI 购物应用中诊断正确预示一个成功与一个失败案例，100 实例稳健性研究确认结论。
Motivation: 当 agent 与对象只有特征描述而无完整偏好排序时，传统匹配机制无法直接使用；需要在降维后仍能给出福利最优性保证的可计算机制。
Method: 用单次谱投影 (spectral projection) 将多维特征与偏好去标度后压到一维并排序，时间复杂度 O(N log N)；证明在投影空间内取得精确 NSW 最优，并给出无条件的 utilitarian-welfare 保证与有条件的 NSW 保证；构造显式获利谎报以刻画非策略防操纵性。
Result: 投影空间内精确 NSW 最优；无条件 utilitarian-welfare 保证与条件 NSW 保证；机制对外生噪声稳定但不 strategy-proof（给出显式获利谎报）；agentic AI 购物应用中诊断正确预示一个成功与一个失败案例；100 实例稳健性研究确认上述发现。
Conclusion: 特征匹配可经一次谱投影降到一维排序并保留 NSW 最优性，但需接受非策略防操纵这一代价，其诊断能在应用中预测成败。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 投影空间内精确 NSW 最优；无条件 utilitarian-welfare 保证与条件 NSW 保证；机制对外生噪声稳定但不 strategy-proof（给出显式获利谎报）；agentic AI 购物应用中诊断正确预示一个成功与一个失败案例；100 实例稳健性研究确认上述发现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征匹配可经一次谱投影降到一维排序并保留 NSW 最优性，但需接受非策略防操纵这一代价，其诊断能在应用中预测成败。

papers.title: Augur: A Synthetic Decision Lab for Rehearsing Reactions to Product and Policy Changes
papers.abstract_en: Before a product or policy change ships, the question that matters is how people will react to it. Augur rehearses that reaction offline: it builds a typed knowledge graph from the change documents, populates a grounded persona market, simulates the interaction, and returns an auditable decision memo recommending one of five actions. We assemble Gold-50, fifty real product and policy episodes whose real-world outcome is known, adjudicated against the public record, and score the five-way release verdict against it. Our central finding is methodological and negative: most of the measured gap between frontier cloud models and open-weight models we fine-tune and serve offline is attributable to an under-specified evaluation, not a difference in capability. We show this three ways. First, the prompt envelope alone can dominate the score: holding weights, cases and scorer fixed, one system -- a LoRA-SFT adapter on Qwen3-32B -- swings from 0% to 73%. Second, in a matched 2x2 ablation, defining the decision taxonomy in the prompt -- with no model change -- lifts every frontier model by +24 to +34pp; under the under-specified prompt, Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT served offline beats all three frontier models (paired McNemar, Holm-corrected), and once the prompt is fair no significant difference from any of them is detected. Third, agreement with the distillation teacher rises without accuracy following, and the full pipeline amplifies a systematic "over-doom" bias rather than improving the verdict. Separately, we validate the reaction layer on its own terms: blind judges across four model families find the synthetic reaction recovers 67-90% of the concerns the public actually raised, and a pre-registered ablation locates its value -- largest where the decision is hardest, redundant near ceiling. The pipeline that regenerates every number and figure here is available from the authors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Augur 是一个离线彩排产品/政策变更反应的决策实验室：从变更文档构建 typed knowledge graph，生成 grounded persona market 并模拟交互，输出五选一的可审计决策备忘录。核心发现是方法论性的负面结论：前沿云模型与自托管开源权重模型之间的大部分测得差距来自欠规范的评估而非能力差异——同一 LoRA-SFT Qwen3-32B 在固定权重与评分器下仅凭 prompt envelope 就从 0% 摆到 73%。
Motivation: 产品/政策变更上线前需要预判公众反应，但用 LLM 模拟打分时，模型间的能力对比极易被评估设定本身污染，导致开源与前沿模型的差距被误读。
Method: 流水线为：变更文档 → typed knowledge graph → grounded persona market → 交互模拟 → 五选一 release verdict 决策备忘录；评测集 Gold-50，含 50 个真实结局已知、经公开记录裁定的产品与政策 episode。用 2x2 匹配消融在 prompt 中定义决策分类体系，配合 LoRA-SFT 微调 Qwen3-32B 离线服务，并以 paired McNemar 加 Holm 校正做显著性检验。
Result: 固定权重、案例与评分器时，单个 LoRA-SFT Qwen3-32B 系统分数在 0% 到 73% 之间摆动；在 prompt 中定义决策分类体系（不改模型）使每个前沿模型提升 +24 到 +34pp；欠规范 prompt 下 Qwen3-32B LoRA-SFT 离线服务胜过全部三个前沿模型，prompt 公平后与任一前沿模型无显著差异。蒸馏教师一致率上升但准确率未随之上升，完整流水线放大了系统性 over-doom 偏差。四个模型家族的盲评显示合成反应覆盖公众实际提出关切的 67-90%，预注册消融定位其价值在决策最难处最大、接近上限处冗余。
Conclusion: 模型能力对比必须先规范评估（prompt 中明确决策分类体系），否则测得的开源-前沿差距主要是评估伪影；反应层在困难决策上有独立价值，但流水线会放大 over-doom 偏差而非改善裁决。

papers.title: Tracking States or Tracking Cosets? An Algebraic Account of Learned State Tracking
papers.abstract_en: State tracking requires composing a sequence of updates, but accuracy alone does not reveal what a model has learned. We study neural networks trained to predict the running product of group elements. We identify quotient solutions in Transformers, where models recover the quotient class while predicting nearly uniformly among its members. The reciprocal of class size predicts partial accuracy without a fitted parameter, extending parity-based accounts to non-parity quotients. Our baseline Transformers' predictions change little under prefix reordering beyond the exact-tracking frontier. We prove that, for finite groups under uniform i.i.d. full-group inputs, optimal order-blind exact accuracy converges to the reciprocal of abelianization class size as prefix length grows, consistent with the observed abelianization plateaus. Sequential updates permit more: any partition into right cosets of a subgroup, normal or not, survives sequential updates. In our census of standard Transformers, every recovered coset partition comes from a normal subgroup, whereas parameter-matched recurrent networks pass through both normal and non-normal right-coset stages during training. On $A_5$, we identify low-dimensional subspaces of the recurrent state that encode non-normal cosets. In the three-dimensional cases, coset mean vectors form approximate dodecahedra, and swapping the state components in these subspaces transfers the donor's coset state through a shared input suffix. Our results connect partial accuracy, learning stages, and internal computation through the subgroup cosets that models learn to track.
papers.comment: 69 pages including appendices; 9 pages of main text
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把神经网络的群元素累积状态跟踪 (state tracking) 重新表述为对子群陪集 (coset) 的跟踪：Transformer 在精确跟踪前沿之外退化为只恢复商类并在其成员间近乎均匀猜测，而循环网络在训练中会经过非正规右陪集阶段。类大小的倒数无需拟合参数即可预测部分准确率，且在 A5 上可交换循环状态子空间分量来转移供体的陪集状态。
Motivation: 仅看准确率无法判断状态跟踪模型究竟学到了什么：模型可能只恢复了商类而非精确状态，需要一个代数层面的解释把部分准确率、学习阶段与内部计算联系起来。
Method: 在有限群上训练预测群元素运行积的神经网络，比较标准 Transformer 与参数匹配的循环网络；对均匀 i.i.d. 全群输入证明顺序盲最优精确准确率随前缀长度收敛到交换化 (abelianization) 类大小的倒数，并分析顺序更新下右陪集划分的存活条件；在 A5 上定位编码非正规陪集的低维状态子空间并做分量交换干预。
Result: Transformer 恢复商类并在其成员间近乎均匀预测，类大小倒数无拟合参数地预测部分准确率，把基于 parity 的解释推广到非 parity 商；前缀重排在精确跟踪前沿之外几乎不改变预测。标准 Transformer 的普查中所有恢复的陪集划分都来自正规子群，而参数匹配的循环网络训练中同时经过正规与非正规右陪集阶段。A5 上三维情形的陪集均值向量近似构成正十二面体，交换这些子空间的状态分量可把供体的陪集状态经共享输入后缀转移过去。
Conclusion: 状态跟踪模型学到的对象是子群陪集：顺序更新允许非正规右陪集存活，而标准 Transformer 的表达受限于正规子群，循环网络则能进入非正规陪集阶段；部分准确率、学习阶段与内部计算可由所学陪集统一解释。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ENDOPROMPT: Victim-Side Pseudo-References for Utility Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt injection can degrade benign task performance without eliciting harmful content. Yet many attack objectives depend on task labels or predefined target responses. We present ENDOPROMPT, a white-box method that learns utility-degrading prefixes from unlabeled instructions. Its generator takes the request text as input. Clean victim continuations serve as pseudo-references: local search identifies prefixes that reduce continuation likelihood, and preference fitting on comparisons within the same instruction, followed by reward refinement, distills this signal into a generator. At deployment, the generator produces one prefix per request without further victim-side search. Across four instruction-tuned models and the complete splits of seven benign benchmarks, ENDOPROMPT yields a mean utility change of -26.8 percentage points; 27 of 28 cells are negative. Failure analysis reveals output expansion and prefix reuse; the controls do not establish a degradation advantage from request matching. Victim-derived supervision can reveal utility weaknesses without benchmark feedback or prescribed failure responses. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ENDOPROMPT 是白盒 prompt injection 方法，从无标注指令中学习会降低良性任务效用的前缀：以受害者模型自身的干净续写作伪参考，局部搜索找出降低续写似然的前缀，再经同指令内比较的偏好拟合与奖励精炼蒸馏进生成器，部署时每条请求直接生成一个前缀。在四个指令微调模型和七个良性基准的完整划分上，平均效用下降 26.8 个百分点，28 个单元中 27 个为负。
Motivation: 许多 prompt injection 攻击目标依赖任务标签或预设的目标响应，而仅降低良性任务性能、不诱发有害内容的攻击缺少不依赖标签与基准反馈的构造方式。
Method: 白盒方法：生成器以请求文本为输入，用受害者模型的干净续写作伪参考，局部搜索定位降低续写似然的前缀；在同一条指令内部构造比较做偏好拟合，再经奖励精炼把该信号蒸馏进生成器；部署时对每条请求直接生成一个前缀，不再做受害者侧搜索。
Result: 在四个指令微调模型、七个良性基准的完整划分上，ENDOPROMPT 平均效用变化为 -26.8 个百分点，28 个（模型×基准）单元中 27 个为负。失败分析发现输出扩张 (output expansion) 与前缀复用 (prefix reuse)；对照实验未确立请求匹配 (request matching) 带来的退化优势。
Conclusion: 受害者侧派生的监督可以在不使用基准反馈、也不规定失败响应的情况下暴露效用弱点；代码将在论文接收后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuro-symbolic AI for Industrial Configuration
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performance on a wide range of generative tasks. Yet their probabilistic nature makes them, in isolation, fundamentally unsuited for industrial product configuration, where outputs must be syntactically valid, semantically consistent with a knowledge base of hundreds of features and rules, and producible by an existing manufacturing chain. We argue that Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI methods lay out a promising path towards industrial-grade configurators that are reliable by design, explainable, and trustworthy. This paper describes a taxonomy of three NeSy integration strategies, namely hybrid inference, hybrid fine-tuning, and hybrid training, exploring their usage in the configuration domain. We report our effort to operationalize NeSy concepts in an industrial configuration copilot and derive a set of practical design choices for deploying trustworthy AI in engineering environments. We close with a discussion of open research challenges we consider most pressing, in particular how to scale NeSy methods from small academic demonstrators to the size of industrial configurators.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Industrial Track at the NeSy Conference 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出工业产品配置场景下的 Neuro-symbolic AI 三类集成策略分类法（hybrid inference、hybrid fine-tuning、hybrid training），论证纯 LLM 因概率性输出无法满足语法合法、与数百特征和规则的知识库语义一致、且可被现有制造链生产的三重约束。作者据此落地一个工业配置 copilot，并给出工程环境部署可信 AI 的设计选择，核心主张是 NeSy 是实现 reliable by design 配置器的路径。
Motivation: 工业产品配置要求输出语法合法、与含数百特征和规则的知识库语义一致、并能由现有制造链生产，纯概率性 LLM 单独使用无法满足这些硬约束。
Method: 给出三类 NeSy 集成策略的 taxonomy：hybrid inference、hybrid fine-tuning、hybrid training，并在配置域探讨其用法；将 NeSy 概念落地到一个工业配置 copilot，从中提炼部署设计选择。
Result: 论文报告的是分类法、工业配置 copilot 的落地工作与由此导出的一组实践设计选择，以及从小型学术演示扩展到工业级配置器规模这一开放挑战；摘要未给出实验指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: NeSy 方法是构建 reliable by design、可解释、可信的工业级配置器的可行路径，但其能否从小型学术演示扩展到工业配置器规模仍是最紧迫的开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Error- and Prediction-Driven Motor Learning in the Cortico-Cerebellar Loop
papers.abstract_en: Robust control under delayed sensory feedback remains a key challenge in both robotics and neuroscience. Classical cerebellar models explain delay compensation through forward prediction but fail to account for fast online corrections and rapid adaptation observed in biological systems. We propose a cerebellum-inspired control framework that combines multiplexed predictive representations with internal feedback. By jointly encoding kinematic variables and task-relevant error signals, the model enables accurate online correction despite delayed feedback. Furthermore, incorporating feedback within the cerebellar loop significantly accelerates adaptation, reducing learning time by an order of magnitude. Our results show that single-signal predictions are insufficient under delay, while multiplexing and feedback together provide a unified mechanism for online control and rapid learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受小脑启发的控制框架，把运动学变量与任务误差信号复用编码 (multiplexed predictive representations) 并在小脑回路内引入内部反馈，使延迟反馈下仍能在线修正。加入回路内反馈使适应速度提升一个数量级；单信号预测在延迟条件下不足，复用与反馈结合才同时支撑在线控制与快速学习。
Motivation: 延迟感官反馈下的鲁棒控制是机器人与神经科学的共同难题；经典小脑模型只用前向预测补偿延迟，解释不了生物系统中的快速在线修正与快速适应。
Method: 小脑启发控制框架：复用预测表征同时编码运动学变量与任务相关误差信号，并在小脑回路中加入内部反馈 (internal feedback)，联合实现延迟下的在线修正与适应。
Result: 引入回路内反馈使学习时间缩短一个数量级 (an order of magnitude)；在延迟条件下单信号预测不足，复用编码与反馈结合才给出在线控制与快速学习的统一机制。
Conclusion: 延迟反馈下的快速修正与快速适应需要复用预测表征与回路内反馈共同作用，单靠前向预测不够。

papers.title: MF-SCBO : Multi-fidelity Scalable Constrained Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world optimization problems rely on expensive simulations or experiments, making the efficient use of available data essential. Multi-fidelity optimization of high-dimensional black-box functions subject to black-box constraints is increasingly relevant as the cost of objective evaluations continues to rise in applications such as machine learning, engineering, and control. To our knowledge, no existing method simultaneously addresses high-dimensionality, black-box constraints, an arbitrary number of fidelity levels, and non-nested sampling. In this work, we extend the Scalable Constrained Bayesian Optimization method to the multi-fidelity setting, resulting in the MF-SCBO method. The proposed approach is evaluated on standard benchmark functions as well as challenging problems. The experimental results demonstrate that MF-SCBO generally achieves better convergence than both the single-fidelity SCBO and the other multi-fidelity method considered in this high-dimensional and constrained settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MF-SCBO 把 Scalable Constrained Bayesian Optimization 扩展到多保真 (multi-fidelity) 设定，同时处理高维黑盒函数、黑盒约束、任意数量的保真度层级以及非嵌套 (non-nested) 采样。在标准基准函数与更具挑战性的问题上，MF-SCBO 的收敛总体优于单保真 SCBO 及所对比的其他多保真方法。
Motivation: 高维黑盒约束优化的评估成本不断上升，而现有方法无法同时覆盖高维、黑盒约束、任意保真层级数与非嵌套采样这四点。
Method: 将 Scalable Constrained Bayesian Optimization (SCBO) 扩展为 MF-SCBO：在多保真设定下保留其高维与黑盒约束处理能力，并支持任意数量的保真度层级与非嵌套采样；在标准基准函数与更具挑战性的问题上做实验评估。
Result: 在标准基准函数与挑战性问题的实验中，MF-SCBO 在高维、带约束设定下的收敛总体优于单保真 SCBO 以及所考虑的其他多保真方法。
Conclusion: 同时满足高维、黑盒约束、任意保真层级与非嵌套采样的多保真约束贝叶斯优化是可行的，且收敛优于单保真与既有对比多保真方案。

papers.title: Mind What Matters for Reasoning: Aligning Cross-Modal Attention via Selective Probability Mass Concentration
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning tasks, yet remain prone to hallucinations and over-reliance on language priors, often generating answers without adequately using task-relevant visual evidence. Existing approaches primarily improve reasoning through reasoning-oriented supervision or inference-time strategies. In this work, we study a complementary question: can multimodal reasoning be improved by strengthening implicit visual grounding without directly supervising the reasoning process? Motivated by the functional specialization of attention heads, we investigate whether reasoning can be improved by guiding only the heads most responsive to visual evidence grounding. We propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC), a training framework that identifies grounding-responsive heads and selectively regularizes their text-to-image attention. sPMC treats normalized attention over visual tokens as a spatial probability distribution and encourages the probability mass to be assigned to semantically relevant regions using segmentation-derived spatial priors. Adaptive Head Selection restricts this guidance to visually responsive heads while leaving the remaining heads unconstrained to preserve their complementary functions. Across 6 multimodal benchmark suites, sPMC achieves an average zero-shot improvement of 3% and gains of up to 11.3% across multiple MLLMs while regularizing only 3%-15% of their attention heads. These results demonstrate that targeted guidance of sparse and implicit visual evidence pathways can directly improve multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 sPMC (Selective Probability Mass Concentration)：只对最响应视觉证据的注意力头施加正则，把文本到图像的注意力当作视觉 token 上的空间概率分布，用分割得到的空间先验把概率质量推向语义相关区域。在 6 个多模态 benchmark 上零样本平均提升 3%，单个 MLLM 最高提升 11.3%，而只正则 3%–15% 的注意力头。
Motivation: 多模态大模型做视觉推理时容易幻觉、过度依赖语言先验，绕过任务相关的视觉证据；现有方法多从推理监督或推理时策略入手，缺少在不直接监督推理过程的前提下强化隐式视觉接地的手段。
Method: sPMC 训练框架分两步：先识别对视觉证据接地最响应的头 (Adaptive Head Selection)，再只对这些头的 text-to-image 注意力做正则，把归一化注意力视为空间概率分布，并用分割掩码导出的空间先验引导概率质量集中到语义相关区域，其余头保持无约束以保留其互补功能。
Result: 在 6 个多模态 benchmark 套件上，sPMC 在多个 MLLM 上取得平均 3% 的零样本 (zero-shot) 提升，单项最高 11.3%，同时只正则 3%–15% 的注意力头。
Conclusion: 稀疏且隐式的视觉证据通路经过定向引导即可直接改善多模态推理，无需直接监督推理过程；只约束少数接地响应头足以带来增益。

papers.title: Path-specific harm decomposition: A partial identification framework
papers.abstract_en: A central goal when designing treatment policies is often to "do no harm", that is, to avoid interventions that improve average outcomes while worsening outcomes for some individuals. A widely used notion for harm is the fraction of negatively affected (FNA), defined as the probability that an intervention decreases an individual's outcome. However, in many applications, treatments operate through mediators, and a single "total" FNA can obscure whether harm arises primarily through direct pathways or indirect (mediator-induced) pathways. In this work, we introduce a path-specific analogue of the FNA. For this, we disentangle total harm into direct and indirect harm in causal mediation settings. However, these quantities depend on joint distributions of potential outcomes that are not point-identified even in randomised controlled trials. As a remedy, we develop a novel partial identification framework for direct and indirect FNA. In our framework, we (i) derive sharp Makarov bounds for the FNA, and (ii) propose a semiparametrically efficient estimator with valid confidence intervals for these bounds under mild margin conditions. We demonstrate our framework across various numerical experiments. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to study path-specific decomposition of causal harm and to develop an orthogonal inference framework for its analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把伤害的负向受影响比例 (FNA) 拆成经由中介的直接与间接路径分量，并给出部分识别框架：推导 FNA 的 sharp Makarov 界，并在温和边际条件下构造半参数有效估计量与有效置信区间。数值实验演示了该框架，作者称这是首个针对因果伤害路径分解并配套正交推断的工作。
Motivation: 治疗政策设计要求避免平均收益掩盖个体受损，但单一总 FNA 无法区分伤害来自直接路径还是中介诱导路径，且这些量依赖的潜在结果联合分布在随机对照试验中也不是点可识别的。
Method: 在因果中介设定下把总伤害分解为直接与间接 FNA；对这两个量推导 sharp Makarov 界，并在温和边际条件下提出半参数有效 (semiparametrically efficient) 的正交估计量与对界有效的置信区间，最后用多组数值实验演示。
Result: 给出 FNA 的 sharp Makarov 界，以及带有效置信区间的半参数有效估计量；在多组数值实验中演示该框架。摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 路径特异的因果伤害分解在潜在结果联合分布下只能部分识别，但借助 Makarov 界与正交推断可以做出统计上有效的区间推断。

papers.title: When Temporal Perturbations Act Like Sensor Biases: Label-Free Auditing of Wearable Activity Recognizers
papers.abstract_en: Wearable human-activity recognition (HAR) models operate across sensors, subjects, and backbones, yet a smooth waveform may appear temporal while exploiting a persistent sensor offset primarily. We introduce SpectrumAudit, a label-sealed audit that fits a phase-randomized full-window stimulus on calibration windows from subjects held out from training and testing. After selection, it replays its exact DC projection and budget-constrained zero-mean residual on the same frozen victim without refitting. Across 27 victims from three datasets and three backbones, the selected waveforms cause 2.87-40.83-point three-phase robust accuracy losses. Under this replay budget, DC is more damaging than AC on 24/27 victims and recovers at least 90% of the full drop on 22/27; all 5 failures occur on WISDM. In a held-out UTD-MHAD check, the selected waveform causes 13.49-pp accuracy and 11.68-pp macro-F1 losses, versus -0.66 pp for matched random changes. The audit diagnoses offset versus zero-mean variation under a common peak-budget cap. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectrumAudit 是一种无标签审计：在留出被试的标定窗上拟合相位随机化的全窗扰动，再在冻结模型上原样重放其 DC 投影与预算受限的零均值残差，用来判定可穿戴活动识别模型是否主要依赖持久传感器偏置而非时序波形。27 个受害者模型上三阶段鲁棒准确率下降 2.87–40.83 点，DC 比 AC 更具破坏性的占 24/27。
Motivation: 可穿戴 HAR 模型跨传感器、被试和骨干网络部署，但光滑的时序波形可能主要利用持久的传感器偏置；需要一种不依赖标签、能在冻结模型上审计这种偏置依赖的手段。
Method: 在训练与测试之外留出的被试标定窗上，拟合相位随机化的全窗扰动 (phase-randomized full-window stimulus)；选中后不重拟合，直接在同一冻结受害者模型上重放其精确 DC 投影与峰值预算约束的零均值残差，在统一峰值预算上限下区分偏置 (DC) 与零均值变化 (AC)。
Result: 在三个数据集、三种骨干共 27 个受害者模型上，选中波形造成 2.87–40.83 点的三阶段鲁棒准确率下降；该重放预算下 DC 比 AC 更具破坏性的为 24/27，且在 22/27 上至少恢复完整降幅的 90%，5 例失败全部出现在 WISDM。在留出的 UTD-MHAD 检查中，选中波形造成 13.49 pp 准确率与 11.68 pp macro-F1 损失，而匹配的随机改动为 -0.66 pp。
Conclusion: 可穿戴活动识别模型的鲁棒性损失可主要由持久传感器偏置（DC 分量）而非零均值时序变化解释，且该诊断可在无标签、冻结模型的统一峰值预算下完成；代码将于录用后发布。

papers.title: Robust Detection of LLM-Generated Text under Contamination
papers.abstract_en: We study the detection of LLM-generated text under editing and contamination. Modeling human and machine text as finite-order Markov processes with Huber contamination, we characterize an exact boundary for reliable detection under our assumptions. Detection is impossible when contamination is sufficiently large relative to clean-source separation. Below this boundary, a collection of clipped likelihood-ratio tests achieves vanishing worst-case errors. This construction motivates clipping as a simple modification of existing statistical detectors. For a broad class of additive scores, we identify conditions under which the clipped test is consistent while the raw test's worst-case power tends to zero. We evaluate seven detectors across three datasets and three generation models, and on the RAID benchmark. Clipping improves robustness in both studies, with gains varying across detectors and contamination settings. For example, at a target false-positive rate of 5\%, clipping improves the log-likelihood--log-rank ratio (LRR) detector's true-positive rate by a median of 8.3 percentage points in the controlled study and 2.1 and 4.3 points in rate- and attack-specific RAID evaluations, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Beyond Spatial Benchmarks: From Spatial Reasoning to Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Does progress on spatial reasoning benchmarks translate into better navigation? Existing benchmarks test isolated inferences from images or videos, with little connection to downstream navigation. Our analysis reveals a gap between benchmark-oriented spatial specialization and navigation performance, and shows how aligning spatial supervision with navigation goals, phases, and decision learning improves navigation. Guided by these findings, we build \textsc{Spatial-Nav-100K} and fine-tune in two stages, \textit{i.e.} first learning a shared spatial-navigation foundation, and then specializing each phase with the abilities it relies on. We further introduce Spatial-NPD, where a teacher conditioned on spatial priors produces grounded action preferences and distills them into a student policy, so no explicit spatial reasoning is needed at inference. With 45 A100 GPU-hours of policy training, our 8B model reaches SR/SPL of 77.4/35.4 on HM3D-v0.2, 60.2/30.5 on HM3D-v0.1, and 47.9/20.6 on train-unseen MP3D. It outperforms several systems that rely on closed-source models or thousands of GPU-hours of training, at 148 ms per action step. All code and datasets will be publicly available at https://github.com/ylwhxht/Spatial-Nav.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 空间推理基准的分数并不自动转化为导航能力，作者把空间监督与导航目标、阶段和决策学习对齐，构建 Spatial-Nav-100K 并两阶段微调，再用 Spatial-NPD 把带空间先验的教师动作偏好蒸馏进学生策略，使推理时无需显式空间推理。8B 模型在 45 A100 GPU-hours 策略训练下达到 HM3D-v0.2 SR/SPL 77.4/35.4、HM3D-v0.1 60.2/30.5、MP3D train-unseen 47.9/20.6，每步动作 148 ms。
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准只测图像或视频中的孤立推理，与下游导航脱节；分析显示面向基准的空间专化与真实导航性能之间存在差距。
Method: 构建 Spatial-Nav-100K 数据集并两阶段微调：先学共享的空间-导航基础，再按导航各阶段所需能力分别专化；Spatial-NPD 中以空间先验为条件的教师产出 grounded action preferences，蒸馏进学生策略，推理时无需显式空间推理。
Result: 8B 模型用 45 A100 GPU-hours 策略训练，SR/SPL 为 HM3D-v0.2 77.4/35.4、HM3D-v0.1 60.2/30.5、MP3D train-unseen 47.9/20.6；每动作步 148 ms，超过若干依赖闭源模型或数千 GPU-hours 训练的系统。
Conclusion: 把空间监督与导航目标、阶段和决策学习对齐，能在极低训练开销下提升具身导航的 SR/SPL，且推理阶段可省去显式空间推理。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of VLM Pipelines for Long-Document QA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for long-document processing, where the inputs combine text with charts, tables, figures, and complex layouts. Deploying them means choosing how to feed the document to the model, which retriever to use when only a subset of pages is sent, and whether to run the model agentically or as a static pipeline. We study these choices on two long-document QA benchmarks with both frontier API and open-weight VLMs. First, on MMLongBench-Doc our six-tool agent with page, table, figure, and search calls pays off only once the answering VLM is large enough: with Qwen3.5-4B and 9B it trails static page input, with Qwen3.5-27B it draws level, and with Sonnet 4.5 it leads. On LongDocURL it is level with or ahead of static input at every reader. Its lead over the strongest static pipeline is clearest with the frontier reader on MMLongBench-Doc and narrows to within noise on LongDocURL. Second, retrieval modality matters more than the specific retriever: the strongest image retriever leads the strongest text pipeline, and on the text side a single off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank essentially matches a much heavier multi-stage LLM pipeline. Top-k image retrieval is also the most token-efficient input at every reader we paired it with, at roughly a seventh to a quarter of the tokens of sending every page. Third, cutting across all three choices, three of our strongest pipelines succeed on different questions, and an oracle that picks the best pipeline per question gains roughly thirteen points over the best single pipeline, though evidence-type routing recovers almost none of it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 LongDocURL 两个长文档 QA 基准上系统比较 VLM 输入与管线选择：六工具 agent 只在答题 VLM 足够大时才胜过静态整页输入（Qwen3.5-4B/9B 落后、27B 打平、Sonnet 4.5 领先），检索模态比具体检索器更重要，且逐题 oracle 选管线比最强单一管线高约 13 分。
Motivation: 长文档同时含文本、图表与复杂版式，部署时要决定如何喂页面、只送部分页时选哪个检索器、以及用静态管线还是 agent 式调用，这些选择对最终 QA 质量与 token 成本的影响缺乏系统对照。
Method: 在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 LongDocURL 上对比 frontier API 与 open-weight VLM，比较三类选择：静态整页输入 vs 六工具 agent（page、table、figure、search 调用）；图像检索 vs 文本检索（含 off-the-shelf cross-encoder rerank 与多阶段 LLM rerank 管线）；以及逐题 oracle 管线选择与 evidence-type routing。
Result: MMLongBench-Doc 上 agent 在 Qwen3.5-4B、9B 落后静态整页输入，27B 打平，Sonnet 4.5 领先；LongDocURL 上 agent 在所有 reader 上都持平或领先。Top-k 图像检索在所有配对 reader 上 token 最省，约为发送全部页面的七分之一到四分之一；文本侧单个 cross-encoder rerank 基本追平更重的多阶段 LLM 管线。三个最强管线答对的题目不同，逐题 oracle 比最强单一管线高约 13 分，而 evidence-type routing 几乎收不回这部分增益。
Conclusion: agent 式长文档 QA 的收益取决于答题模型规模，检索模态的选择比检索器本身更关键；管线多样性带来的 oracle 增益真实存在，但按证据类型路由无法将其兑现。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: It's the Geometry, Not the Model: Effective Rank and Subspace Alignment in Functional Connectivity Classification
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state functional connectivity (FC) is widely used to classify brain phenotypes and disorders. Most pipelines use the full connectome and seek gains through model design. We instead examine how FC geometry constrains classification and cross-site transfer. Across-subject FC variation concentrates in a small effective subspace, suggesting substantial redundancy in nominal dimensions. Across cohorts, these subspaces may differ in orientation even when their effective ranks are comparable, potentially limiting transfer. Across 2,330 subjects from HCP, ABIDE, and ADHD-200, effective-rank analysis reveals strong spectral concentration. Projection onto leading components at the effective-rank scale recovers most of the full-FC classification performance. In ABIDE, site-specific effective subspaces are weakly aligned, and their principal-angle overlap predicts pairwise transfer after covariate adjustment despite comparable per-site effective ranks. Controlled rotations that alter subspace orientation while preserving the mean and covariance spectrum drive transfer toward chance, whereas displacement-matched label-orthogonal rotations do not. These results identify subspace orientation as a key factor in transfer degradation under controlled perturbations. This study offers a geometric diagnostic of FC generalization and suggests evaluating cross-site harmonization by its ability to align effective subspaces alongside classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 静息态功能连接 (FC) 分类的跨站点迁移退化由子空间方向而非模型决定：把 FC 投影到有效秩尺度的主成分即可保住大部分全连接组分类性能，而 ABIDE 各站点有效子空间弱对齐、主角度重叠可在协变量校正后预测两两迁移。保持均值与协方差谱、只旋转子空间方向的受控扰动会把迁移打到随机水平，位移匹配但标签正交的旋转则不会。
Motivation: FC 分类管线普遍用全连接组并靠模型设计取收益，但跨站点迁移退化的几何来源不清：不同队列有效秩相当却子空间朝向不同，直接迁移受限。
Method: 对 2,330 名被试（HCP、ABIDE、ADHD-200）做有效秩 (effective rank) 谱集中分析，将 FC 投影到有效秩尺度的主成分并与全 FC 分类对比；在 ABIDE 上计算站点间主角度重叠并在协变量校正后回归两两迁移；构造保持均值与协方差谱的受控旋转（改变子空间方向）与位移匹配的标签正交旋转作对照。
Result: 跨被试 FC 变化集中在很小的有效子空间，谱高度集中；投影到有效秩尺度主成分可恢复全 FC 分类的大部分性能。ABIDE 站点间有效子空间弱对齐，主角度重叠在协变量校正后可预测两两迁移，尽管各站点有效秩相当。受控旋转把迁移推向随机水平，而位移匹配的标签正交旋转不会。
Conclusion: 子空间方向是受控扰动下迁移退化的关键因素；跨站点协调 (harmonization) 应按其对齐有效子空间的能力来评估，而不只看分类精度。
