papers.title: Right Choice of Classification Algorithms Based on Reinforcement Learning for Prediction of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver
papers.abstract_en: There are many complex issues in the world of artificial intelligence. Some of these problems are solved using other artificial intelligence methods, which are called artificial intelligence for artificial intelligence. Finding an appropriate classifier algorithm is a time-consuming task. For this reason, an algorithm that can automatically learn the choice of classification algorithms is very important. Classification algorithms are useful in predicting various diseases. Also, Primary Biliary Cirrhosis is one of the most well-known diseases that have been predicted by classification algorithms. This research's most significant achievement and novelty is the automatic increase in learning through a scoring method of reinforcement learning is called square learning (SL). In this research, an algorithm is presented that learns to automatically select the appropriate classification algorithm to predict Primary Biliary Cirrhosis. In this article, with inspiration from four evaluation metrics in classification algorithms, a new reinforcement learning method by the name of Fourth Degree Learning has been presented. In this research, we increased the performance of the classification algorithms used in this method from 63% of accuracy and achieved 98% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习自动选择分类算法的框架，用评分式 square learning (SL) 与受四个分类评价指标启发的 Fourth Degree Learning，在 Primary Biliary Cirrhosis 预测上把所用分类算法的准确率从 63% 提到 98%。
Motivation: 手工挑选分类算法耗时，而分类器选择直接影响疾病预测效果；目标是让算法自动学会选合适的分类器。
Method: 提出自动学习选择分类算法的强化学习方法：以 square learning (SL) 评分机制自动提升学习过程，并受分类算法四个评价指标启发设计 Fourth Degree Learning，用于 Primary Biliary Cirrhosis 预测任务。
Result: 所用分类算法的准确率从 63% 提升到 98%。
Conclusion: 用强化学习自动选择分类算法可在该疾病预测任务上显著抬高分类准确率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards Deployable Underwater Vessel Classification
papers.abstract_en: We propose a compact underwater acoustic classification framework combining multi-representation feature engineering, temporal statistical pooling, and compact convolutional architectures designed for acoustic time-frequency and cochlear representations. We investigate multiple conventional and auditory-inspired representations and first evaluate lightweight classifiers and Conventional Neural Networks (CNNs) on ShipsEar dataset. On the provided split, a two-layer CNN achieves a macro F1 of 0.9918, while a Radial Basis Function Support Vector Machine (RBF-SVM) reaches 0.9883. However, source-recording provenance cannot be reconstructed, preventing verification of recording-independent generalisation. We therefore evaluate on DeepShip dataset using recording-level partitioning before segmentation. Under this protocol, a 157K-parameter compact CNN achieves a test macro F1 of 0.7226, while an 11.17M-parameter ResNet18 provides no improvement in validation performance under the matched setting. These results demonstrate the importance of representation-aware feature and model design, together with rigorous recording-level evaluation, for classification performance and deployability in compact underwater acoustic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向可部署水下声学分类，提出融合多表示特征工程、时间统计池化与紧凑卷积结构的框架，覆盖时频与耳蜗 (cochlear) 表示。在 ShipsEar 给定划分上两层 CNN macro F1 达 0.9918、RBF-SVM 达 0.9883，但该划分无法重建录音来源、无法验证录音独立泛化；改用 DeepShip 分割前按录音级划分后，157K 参数紧凑 CNN 测试 macro F1 为 0.7226，而 11.17M 参数 ResNet18 在匹配设置下验证性能无提升。
Motivation: 水下船舶声学分类在常见划分上分数虚高，因为录音来源无法重建、无法验证录音独立泛化，紧凑系统的真实可部署性因此存疑。
Method: 组合多表示特征工程（时频与耳蜗表示）、时间统计池化与紧凑卷积结构；先在 ShipsEar 上评估轻量分类器与 CNN，再在 DeepShip 上采用分割前的录音级划分重新评估，并在匹配设置下对比 157K 参数紧凑 CNN 与 ResNet18。
Result: ShipsEar 给定划分：两层 CNN macro F1 0.9918，RBF-SVM 0.9883。DeepShip 录音级划分：157K 参数紧凑 CNN 测试 macro F1 0.7226；11.17M 参数 ResNet18 在匹配设置下验证性能无提升。
Conclusion: 分类性能与可部署性取决于表示感知的特征与模型设计以及严格的录音级评估协议，单看给定划分的高分会掩盖泛化问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation
papers.abstract_en: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RWM 把状态、转移和可执行规划一起学进表示空间：从端点表示构造潜在路径，沿路径做逆动力学监督，推理时直接在当前与目标表示间连一条潜在路径，再用逆动力学还原动作，不做递归 rollout 也不做动作空间搜索。连续控制基准实验验证了直接规划的有效性，机器人操作实验显示其可扩展到更复杂的具身控制任务。
Motivation: 现有世界模型把表示学习与显式动力学模型分开，规划依赖搜索、优化或基于策略的预测，规划与表示几何是解耦的。
Method: RWM 在表示空间中学习表示几何：由端点表示构造潜在路径，在路径上施加局部逆动力学监督，要求路径保留任务相关的状态与转移信息；推理时在当前与目标表示间直接构造潜在路径，用逆动力学恢复动作。
Result: 在连续控制基准上验证了 RWM 直接规划的有效性；在机器人操作任务上结果表明其有潜力扩展到更复杂的具身控制任务。
Conclusion: 直接在表示空间中规划可以作为传统世界模型规划的一种有前景的替代方案。

papers.title: Spot, Separate, and Enhance: Fully Generative Approach for Audio Mixing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Spot, Separate, and Enhance (SSE), the first multimodal, user-guided generative model for audio remixing and enhancement. SSE enhances video content by rebalancing the audio, removing unwanted audio sources, and reducing reverberation, guided by both video and textual descriptions. To support its training and evaluation, we propose DegradedMix, a new dataset built on the audio remixing benchmark MuddyMix. We also adopt evaluation metrics from generative modeling, which better capture the creative nature of remixing than standard reconstruction-based metrics. SSE outperforms existing baselines in both controllability and remixing quality, as shown by extensive experiments. Project page: https://sse-ai.notion.site
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Project page https://sse-ai.notion.site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SSE（Spot, Separate, and Enhance）：首个以视频与文本双重引导的多模态生成式音频重混与增强模型，可重平衡音轨、去除不需要的声源并抑制混响。基于 MuddyMix 构建新数据集 DegradedMix，并采用生成式建模的评价指标替代重建类指标；实验显示 SSE 在可控性与重混质量上均超过现有基线。
Motivation: 音频重混本质上是创作性任务，标准重建指标无法刻画其可控性与质量，且缺少支持用户引导生成式重混训练与评测的数据资源。
Method: SSE 以视频内容和文本描述为条件，用全生成式 (fully generative) 流程完成音量重平衡、声源去除与去混响；训练与评测依托基于 MuddyMix 构建的 DegradedMix 数据集，并采用生成式建模的评价指标。
Result: 在大量实验中，SSE 在可控性 (controllability) 与重混质量 (remixing quality) 两方面均超过现有基线；同时提出 DegradedMix 数据集并引入生成式评价指标。
Conclusion: 视频与文本联合引导的全生成式框架可用于用户可控的音频重混与增强，且生成式指标比重建类指标更适合衡量重混的创作质量。

papers.title: IndicBankBench: Evaluating Safety and Reliability of Language Model Assistants in Indian Retail Banking
papers.abstract_en: Banking assistants must use account-specific information to answer requests and, in many cases, take actions through tools. Evaluating only the final response misses important errors. An assistant may ask for information it already has, rely on stale context, select the wrong account, or write an invalid value after stating the correct one. We introduce IndicBankBench, a 799-case benchmark for Indian retail banking spanning five operational domains, a capability/refusal domain, and twenty primary axes. Cases are evaluated at four stages: safety, action and tool use, response adequacy, and advisory quality. Tool use and most safety checks are deterministic. A narrow resolver handles only ambiguous confirmation-before-write cases, while a separate LLM judge evaluates semantic response adequacy. We run every case three times and report strict pass^3, which requires success on all trials. Across the eleven evaluated models, strict reliability ranges from 43.7% to 58.2%, whereas at-least-once success ranges from 60% to 74%. This gap shows that at-least-once success can overstate dependable banking behavior. The case-level diagnostics also distinguish systems that ask unnecessary questions from those that act but fail to reconcile customer context or fully resolve the request. We release the cases, mock environment, and evaluation harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IndicBankBench 是一个 799 例印度零售银行助手评测基准，覆盖五个操作域、能力/拒答域与二十条主轴，按安全、动作与工具使用、响应充分性、咨询质量四阶段打分，工具使用与多数安全检查为确定性判定。11 个模型的严格 pass^3 为 43.7%–58.2%，而 at-least-once 成功率为 60%–74%，说明按至少一次成功会高估银行助手的可靠行为。
Motivation: 只评最终回答会漏掉助手已掌握信息仍重复提问、依赖过期上下文、选错账户、说对却写错值等过程性错误，银行场景对可依赖性要求高。
Method: 构建 799 例基准，分五个操作域、一个能力/拒答域、二十条主轴；四阶段评测中工具使用与多数安全检查用确定性检查，仅确认后写入类歧义用窄域 resolver，语义响应充分性交给单独 LLM judge；每例跑三次并报告要求全部成功的 strict pass^3。
Result: 11 个被评模型的 strict reliability 落在 43.7%–58.2%，at-least-once success 落在 60%–74%，两者差距表明至少一次成功会高估可依赖的银行行为；案例级诊断还能区分爱问多余问题的系统与肯动手但未对齐客户上下文或未完全解决请求的系统。

papers.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks. We introduce HarnessPAI, a model- and embodiment-agnostic Harness framework for Physical AI that treats code as the executable and evolvable interface that organizes the underlying action primitive. The framework separates two timescales: within a rollout, it executes open-loop at the program level, with a fixed program guiding and checking execution; across rollouts, it evolves closed-loop, using execution feedback to revise the program and distill failures into reusable skills. Across desktop robot arms, household robots, a robot vacuum, and a legged walking agent, HarnessPAI improves on both pure action models and code-as-policy baselines without retraining the underlying model: a 61.6-point gain over $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-PRO and a 27.2-point gain over WorldDreamer on RoboCasa atomic tasks. Once a program is selected, rollout execution requires no online high-level LLM deliberation. Beyond execution, the converged program is also a cheap and reliable expert-data collector, and fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ on collected expert data lifts success rate on LIBERO-PRO by 38.8 points. Our results suggest that the frontier of Physical AI depends not only on stronger action models, but also on executable harnesses that integrate perception, task understanding and reasoning, and action execution into a unified, verifiable, and feedback-driven system. Website: https://darwin-agent.github.io/HarnessPAI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HarnessPAI 把代码当作组织动作原语的可执行、可演化接口，用双时间尺度框架把感知、任务理解与动作执行统一起来：rollout 内按固定程序开环执行并自检，rollout 间用执行反馈改写程序、把失败蒸馏成可复用技能。在不重训底层模型的前提下，相对 π0.5 在 LIBERO-PRO 上提升 61.6 点，相对 WorldDreamer 在 RoboCasa atomic 任务上提升 27.2 点；用收敛程序采集的专家数据微调 π0.5，LIBERO-PRO 成功率再涨 38.8 点。
Motivation: Physical AI 长期只押注动作模型这一环，主流训练配方会侵蚀感知与推理能力，使强动作模型在场景扰动和长时程任务上仍然脆弱。
Method: 提出模型与具身无关的 Harness 框架，以代码为可执行且可演化的接口：rollout 内在程序层开环执行，由固定程序引导并检查执行；rollout 间闭环演化，用执行反馈修订程序并把失败蒸馏为可复用技能。选定程序后执行阶段无需在线高层 LLM 推理。
Result: 在桌面机械臂、家用机器人、扫地机器人与腿足行走体上，不重训底层模型即同时优于纯动作模型与 code-as-policy 基线：LIBERO-PRO 相对 π0.5 提升 61.6 点，RoboCasa atomic 任务相对 WorldDreamer 提升 27.2 点；用收敛程序采集的专家数据微调 π0.5，LIBERO-PRO 成功率再提升 38.8 点。
Conclusion: Physical AI 的前沿不只取决于更强的动作模型，还取决于把感知、任务理解与推理、动作执行整合为统一、可验证、反馈驱动系统的可执行 harness；收敛后的程序本身还是廉价可靠的专家数据采集器。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Edge AI on Constrained Devices for Binary Sleep-Wake Classification in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an Edge AI-based system for detecting sleep and wake states in non-stationary mobile environments using resource-constrained embedded hardware. Conventional approaches relying on accelerometer-based activity metrics are highly susceptible to motion and vibration artifacts and are limited by strict compute and energy budgets of wearable and IoT devices. To address these challenges, a multimodal pipeline is designed and implemented on an ESP32-S3 microcontroller. The system combines inertial sensing for head movement analysis and visual pose classification. A dual-core architecture with FreeRTOS enables parallel execution of real-time data acquisition and on-device inference. Sleep detection follows a two-stage strategy: low-movement detection over a temporal window, followed by visual validation of poses. Experimental results show accuracies of 96.5% for motion-based detection and 89% for pose classification, yielding robust binary sleep-wake classification. Field tests confirmed feasibility in representative mobile scenarios. The results demonstrate that privacy-preserving, local sleep detection is achievable on edge hardware through careful co-design, while highlighting limitations in sensing intrusiveness, dataset scale, and system integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ESP32-S3 上实现两阶段睡眠-清醒二分类：先用惯性传感在时间窗内检测低运动，再用视觉姿态分类做二次验证，双核 FreeRTOS 并行采集与推理。运动检测准确率 96.5%，姿态分类 89%，现场测试确认在代表性移动场景中可行。
Motivation: 可穿戴与 IoT 设备受算力和能耗预算限制，且基于加速度的活动指标在非平稳移动环境中易受运动与振动伪迹干扰，需要在边缘硬件上做隐私保护的本地睡眠检测。
Method: 在 ESP32-S3 微控制器上设计多模态流水线，融合头部运动的惯性传感与视觉姿态分类；双核架构配合 FreeRTOS 并行执行实时数据采集与设备端推理；睡眠检测采用两阶段策略，先做时间窗内的低运动检测，再用姿态做视觉验证。
Result: 运动检测准确率 96.5%，姿态分类准确率 89%，二者结合得到稳健的二分类睡眠-清醒判定；现场测试在代表性移动场景中确认可行性。
Conclusion: 通过软硬件协同设计，隐私保护的本地睡眠检测可在边缘硬件上实现；作者同时指出传感侵入性、数据集规模与系统集成方面的局限。

papers.title: Functional dynamic mode decomposition: Learning infinite-dimensional systems from data
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) is a data-driven method that computes the best linear approximation of the underlying dynamical system and decomposes the dynamics into a superposition of characteristic spatiotemporal patterns. Originally introduced by the fluid dynamics community, DMD and its extensions have found widespread use in many other research areas such as molecular dynamics, climate science, engineering, finance, and neuroscience. Applications include dimensionality reduction, forecasting, system identification, control, and spectral clustering. In order to apply DMD to partial differential equations, the spatial domain is typically first discretized using finite difference or finite element techniques, thus implicitly rendering the problem finite-dimensional. We extend projected and exact DMD to infinite-dimensional systems. Rather than estimating matrices from vector-valued observations, our DMD variants learn finite-rank operators from functional data such as observables, densities, or wavefunctions. We show that conventional DMD algorithms can be regarded as special cases of their functional DMD counterparts. All results will be illustrated with the aid of guiding examples. We focus in particular on Koopman, Perron-Frobenius, and Koopman-von Neumann operators associated with graphons, ordinary differential equations, and stochastic differential equations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 projected DMD 与 exact DMD 推广到无穷维系统：不再从向量值观测估计矩阵，而是直接从函数型数据（observables、densities、wavefunctions）学习有限秩算子，并证明常规 DMD 算法是其特例。结果以 Koopman、Perron-Frobenius 与 Koopman-von Neumann 算子的引导性例子说明，涉及 graphon、常微分方程与随机微分方程。
Motivation: DMD 处理 PDE 时通常先用有限差分或有限元离散空间域，把问题隐式降为有限维，丢失了无穷维算子结构；缺少直接在函数空间上学习线性算子的框架。
Method: 将 projected DMD 与 exact DMD 扩展为 functional DMD 变体，从函数型数据（observables、densities、wavefunctions）学习有限秩算子，而非从向量观测拟合矩阵；并给出常规 DMD 作为其特例的对应关系，围绕 Koopman、Perron-Frobenius、Koopman-von Neumann 算子在 graphon、ODE、SDE 上构造引导性例子。
Result: 证明常规 DMD 算法可视为 functional DMD 的特例；所有结果配以引导性示例，聚焦与 graphon、常微分方程、随机微分方程相关的 Koopman、Perron-Frobenius 和 Koopman-von Neumann 算子。
Conclusion: DMD 可以在不离散空间域的前提下直接推广到无穷维系统，把有限维矩阵估计统一为有限秩算子学习。

papers.title: Med-AR: Autoregressive Vision-Language Pretraining for Long-Tailed Chest X-Ray Classification and Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed chest X-ray classification requires visual representations that capture both common abnormalities and subtle, infrequent findings. We propose Med-AR-8B and Med-AR-2B, two radiology-native autoregressive vision-language models pretrained with structured reports, abnormality-focused text, and region annotations. We evaluate the transfer of their visual encoders to multi-label classification against contrastive, self-supervised, and supervised pretrained encoders, including Med-CLIP, CheXFound, EVA-Base, ARK, and BioViL-T, using a common ML-Decoder classification head. To assess fine-grained recognition, we also construct LLM-expanded, report-derived label sets for MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert. Across PadChest, MIMIC-CXR, and CheXpert, Med-AR-8B outperforms Med-CLIP in mean AUROC and AUPRC for head, medium, and tail findings. On MIMIC-CXR, it increases tail-label mean AUPRC from 0.1033 to 0.1441. Med-AR-2B achieves the strongest discrimination results on PadChest. Across the broader encoder comparison, a Med-AR variant achieves the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC in every reported prevalence group on each public dataset. Both Med-AR variants also achieve lower excess area under the risk-coverage curve than Med-CLIP on all three public datasets, indicating improved selective-prediction performance under the evaluated protocol. Internal results are metric-dependent, with Med-CLIP retaining advantages in overall and tail AUPRC and in selective prediction. These findings establish Med-AR as a strong pretraining recipe for long-tailed chest X-ray classification on the evaluated public benchmarks and demonstrate the value of assessing discrimination and selective prediction together.
papers.comment: 80 pages including supplementary material, 28 figures, and 22 tables. Supplementary material is included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Med-AR-8B 与 Med-AR-2B 是用结构化报告、异常聚焦文本和区域标注做自回归视觉-语言预训练的放射科原生模型，其视觉编码器迁移到长尾胸片多标签分类。在 PadChest、MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert 上用统一 ML-Decoder 头对比 Med-CLIP、CheXFound、EVA-Base、ARK、BioViL-T，Med-AR-8B 在头/中/尾各患病率组的 mean AUROC 与 AUPRC 全面超过 Med-CLIP，MIMIC-CXR 尾部标签 mean AUPRC 从 0.1033 升到 0.1441，且三个数据集上 excess AURC 更低。
Motivation: 胸片中罕见异常样本极少，通用或对比学习编码器在尾部标签上判别力弱；同时只看判别指标无法说明模型何时该拒绝预测。
Method: 以结构化报告、异常聚焦文本和区域标注预训练 Med-AR-8B/2B 自回归视觉-语言模型，取其视觉编码器接统一的 ML-Decoder 头做多标签分类，与 Med-CLIP、CheXFound、EVA-Base、ARK、BioViL-T 等对比学习、自监督和有监督编码器比较；另构建 LLM 扩展的报告派生标签集用于 MIMIC-CXR 与 CheXpert 的细粒度识别，并同时评判别与 selective prediction。
Result: 在 PadChest、MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert 上 Med-AR-8B 的 mean AUROC 与 AUPRC 在头、中、尾各组均高于 Med-CLIP；MIMIC-CXR 尾部标签 mean AUPRC 由 0.1033 提升至 0.1441；Med-AR-2B 在 PadChest 上判别结果最强；整体比较中每个公开数据集的每个患病率组均由某个 Med-AR 变体取得最高 mean AUROC 与 AUPRC；两个变体在三个数据集上的 excess AURC 均低于 Med-CLIP。内部结果按指标而异，Med-CLIP 在 overall 与 tail AUPRC 及 selective prediction 上仍占优。
Conclusion: Med-AR 是长尾胸片分类上强的预训练配方，但结论限于所评测的公开基准，且判别与 selective prediction 必须一起评估——单一指标会给出不同赢家。

summary_sections.result: 在 PadChest、MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert 上 Med-AR-8B 的 mean AUROC 与 AUPRC 在头、中、尾各组均高于 Med-CLIP；MIMIC-CXR 尾部标签 mean AUPRC 由 0.1033 提升至 0.1441；Med-AR-2B 在 PadChest 上判别结果最强；整体比较中每个公开数据集的每个患病率组均由某个 Med-AR 变体取得最高 mean AUROC 与 AUPRC；两个变体在三个数据集上的 excess AURC 均低于 Med-CLIP。内部结果按指标而异，Med-CLIP 在 overall 与 tail AUPRC 及 selective prediction 上仍占优。
summary_sections.conclusion: Med-AR 是长尾胸片分类上强的预训练配方，但结论限于所评测的公开基准，且判别与 selective prediction 必须一起评估——单一指标会给出不同赢家。

papers.title: A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on natural-language skills to solve complex tool-use tasks. However, such tasks often admit multiple valid solution paths, making it inappropriate to improve skills by forcing failed trajectories to match a fixed successful trajectory. Moreover, failed trajectories are rarely entirely wrong: an agent may first collect useful evidence and make meaningful progress, but later deviate into an erroneous suffix. We therefore argue that skill self-evolution should identify where productive problem solving begins to break down, rather than reflect coarsely over the entire failure. Based on this insight, we propose SkillPivot, a deviation-point-guided framework for skill self-evolution. SkillPivot detects the transition from a useful prefix to an erroneous suffix using execution validity, goal progress, and action diversity. A stronger teacher then continues from the same prefix and produces a successful alternative under the same interaction history. By contrasting the student's failed suffix with the teacher's successful suffix, SkillPivot generates localized skill updates while preserving already effective guidance. Experiments on ToolQA, LogicBench, and WildClawBench show that SkillPivot consistently outperforms competing skill-evolution methods, improves multiple agent models, and produces compact, transferable skill updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillPivot 用执行有效性、目标进度与动作多样性定位失败轨迹中「有用前缀转为错误后缀」的偏离点，再让更强的 teacher 从同一前缀续跑生成成功替代路径，通过对比两个后缀产生局部技能更新。在 ToolQA、LogicBench、WildClawBench 上 consistently 优于对比的技能进化方法，且技能更新紧凑、可迁移。
Motivation: 工具使用任务常有多条合法解路径，把失败轨迹整体对齐到固定成功轨迹并不合理；而失败轨迹往往前半段已收集有用证据，粗粒度反思会把这部分有效指导一并抹掉。
Method: SkillPivot 框架分三步：用 execution validity、goal progress、action diversity 检测有用前缀到错误后缀的转折点；更强的 teacher 在相同交互历史下从前缀续跑产出成功替代；对比 student 失败后缀与 teacher 成功后缀，生成局部技能更新并保留原本有效的指导。
Result: 在 ToolQA、LogicBench、WildClawBench 三个基准上，SkillPivot consistently outperforms competing skill-evolution methods，改善多个 agent 模型，并产出 compact、transferable 的技能更新。
Conclusion: 技能自进化应定位偏离点而非整体反思失败轨迹：只替换出错的后缀，就能在保留有效前缀指导的同时得到更紧凑、可迁移的技能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Recoverable Geographic Location Information in Earth-Observation Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Earth-observation (EO) foundation models provide reusable embeddings, yet downstream task accuracy does not reveal whether these representations encode geographic information, which may be beneficial for location-aware applications but potentially detrimental when representations invariant to geographic location are desired. We therefore evaluate the geographic coordinate robustness of Tessera v1, Tessera v1.1, and AlphaEarth by testing whether coordinates can be predicted from the embedding representations using 284 quality-verified European solar farms from 2024. We assessed geographic information content information through the association between cosine and geodesic distances and through prediction of projected coordinates in EPSG:3035. Embeddings from all three EO foundation models contain recoverable geographic information. All prediction models significantly outperform training-range uniform random sampling baselines, with AlphaEarth exhibiting the strongest distance association and lowest mean geodesic error. Both Tessera variants also yielded higher geographic distance correlations than the Sentinel-2 controls. These findings motivate geographic information content as an additional criterion for auditing EO foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 2024 年 284 个经质量核验的欧洲太阳能农场，检验 Tessera v1、Tessera v1.1 与 AlphaEarth 的 EO 基础模型嵌入能否反推地理坐标：三者的嵌入都含可恢复的地理信息，坐标预测显著优于训练范围内均匀随机采样基线，AlphaEarth 的距离关联最强、平均测地误差最低，两个 Tessera 变体的地理距离相关性也高于 Sentinel-2 对照。作者据此提出把地理信息含量作为审计 EO 基础模型的附加准则。
Motivation: EO 基础模型的下游任务精度无法揭示嵌入是否编码了地理位置：这既可能利于位置感知应用，也可能在需要地理不变表示时成为隐患，缺少相应的审计维度。
Method: 在 284 个质量核验的欧洲太阳能农场（2024 年）上，对 Tessera v1、Tessera v1.1、AlphaEarth 三类嵌入做两类度量：一是余弦距离与测地距离的关联，二是预测 EPSG:3035 投影坐标；以训练范围内均匀随机采样为基线，并加入 Sentinel-2 对照。
Result: 三个 EO 基础模型的嵌入均含可恢复的地理信息，所有坐标预测模型都显著优于训练范围均匀随机采样基线；AlphaEarth 距离关联最强、平均测地误差最低；两个 Tessera 变体的地理距离相关性均高于 Sentinel-2 对照。
Conclusion: EO 基础模型嵌入普遍泄露可恢复的地理坐标信息，因此地理信息含量应作为与下游精度并列的模型审计准则。

papers.title: A Particle-Swarm-Assisted Gradient Meta-Learning Algorithm for Joint Transmit Precoding and STAR-RIS Coefficient Optimization
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the joint optimization of the transmit precoder and the transmission/reflection coefficients of a simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface (STAR-RIS) to maximize the weighted sum rate (WSR) in a multi-user downlink. We propose a particle-swarm-assisted gradient meta-learning (PSA-GML) algorithm for this non-convex problem. The original problem is first equivalently transformed via an amplitude-split parameterization and a collapsed precoder representation, which automatically satisfy the energy-conservation constraint and reduce the search dimension. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) then performs a global search over the STAR-RIS coefficients to yield a high-quality, initialization-robust warm start, with the transmit precoder obtained in closed form. Departing from conventional alternating optimization (AO), a coordinate-wise long short-term memory (LSTM) meta-optimizer trained by first-order gradient meta-learning further refines the coefficients and precoder jointly, learning per-coordinate adaptive update rules from data. The meta-optimizer is trained offline and applied to unseen channels without further adaptation. Numerical results show that PSA-GML attains an 11.06 bits/s/Hz WSR at 10 dB with N=32 elements and K=4 users, exceeding AO by 13.1% (and by 6.2% even with multiple random restarts) and the random-phase scheme by 35.1%. In the interference-limited regime it reaches 83.9% of the hand-designed Adam refinement without manual hyper-parameter tuning, and it transfers zero-shot across regimes, indicating that the learned update rule captures the intrinsic WSR landscape structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 STAR-RIS 多用户下行联合预编码与透射/反射系数的非凸 WSR 优化，提出 PSA-GML：先用幅度分裂参数化与坍缩预编码表示降维并自动满足能量守恒，再用 PSO 全局搜索系数给出稳健初值（预编码闭式解），最后由一阶梯度元学习训练的逐坐标 LSTM 元优化器联合精调。10 dB、N=32、K=4 时 WSR 达 11.06 bits/s/Hz，比 AO 高 13.1%（多次随机重启仍高 6.2%），比随机相位高 35.1%。
Motivation: STAR-RIS 系数与预编码的联合优化非凸，交替优化 (AO) 依赖初值且需手动调超参，跨信道场景要重新求解。
Method: 幅度分裂参数化 + 坍缩预编码表示等价改写原问题，自动满足能量守恒并降维；PSO 在 STAR-RIS 系数上全局搜索给出初值稳健的 warm start，预编码取闭式解；随后由一阶梯度元学习 (first-order gradient meta-learning) 训练的逐坐标 LSTM 元优化器联合精调系数与预编码，离线训练后直接用于未见信道。
Result: 数值结果：10 dB、N=32、K=4 时 WSR 11.06 bits/s/Hz，超 AO 13.1%（AO 多次随机重启仍超 6.2%），超随机相位方案 35.1%；在干扰受限体制下达到手工设计 Adam 精调的 83.9%，且无需手动调超参，可跨体制零样本迁移。
Conclusion: PSO 全局初值加元学习的逐坐标自适应更新规则能捕捉 WSR 目标的内在结构，从而在免调参条件下跨信道零样本工作并优于交替优化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Claim-Gated Source-Risk Auditing for Generative Search
papers.abstract_en: A generative search answer can cite a supported passage yet omit a source relationship that changes its interpretation. We specify a claim-gated audit of the query-source-answer tuple. An omission is resolved only when relationship evidence, answer adoption, materiality, and disclosure are all observed; incomplete evidence remains unresolved rather than being treated as independence. The specification separates this endpoint from citation support and review priority, and binds decisions to versioned evidence spans. A reference checker makes the record contract executable. On an exhaustive synthetic suite, it reproduces all 81 three-state predicate combinations and rejects 192 deliberately malformed records. Common-guard baselines and predicate ablations isolate endpoint logic from missing-evidence handling, while controlled transitions check support separation and evidence removal. These are finite contract-conformance results, not detector accuracy or evidence of improved user outcomes. We define the independent annotation, held-out evaluation, and paired utility tests still required to establish semantic validity and deployment benefit.
papers.comment: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Automation and Algorithms (AI2A 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为生成式搜索的引用审计提出 claim-gated 源风险审计规范：只有当关系证据、答案采纳、实质性与披露四项同时观测到，query-source-answer 三元组中的遗漏才判为已解决，证据不全则保持未解决而非默认独立。在穷举合成套件上复现全部 81 个三态谓词组合并拒绝 192 条故意构造的畸形记录。
Motivation: 生成式搜索的回答可以引用到支持性段落，却遗漏会改变其含义的源关系；现有引用支持检查与审阅优先级无法区分这种遗漏，且证据缺失常被误当作独立。
Method: 规范把审计终点与 citation support、review priority 分离，并将判定绑定到带版本的证据片段 (versioned evidence spans)；用 reference checker 使记录契约可执行，另以 common-guard 基线与谓词消融隔离终点逻辑与缺失证据处理，并用受控转移检验支持分离与证据移除。
Result: 在穷举合成套件上复现全部 81 个三态谓词组合，拒绝 192 条故意畸形记录；common-guard 基线与谓词消融用于隔离终点逻辑，受控转移用于检验 support separation 与证据移除。作者明确这些是有限的契约一致性结果，不是检测器准确率或用户收益证据。
Conclusion: 该审计终点可作为可执行的记录契约通过有限的一致性检验，但语义有效性与部署收益仍需独立标注、留出集评估与配对效用检验来确立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Scope Before You Persist: Preventing Cross-Family Interference in Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory lets language-model agents improve prompts and skills without updating model weights. We show that matching retrieval scope to certification scope enables these edits to support reliable repeated adaptation across recurring task families. We study frozen-model agents on ProcStream-RSI, a 12-round code-repair stream, using Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC), an execution-grounded gate for persistent skill edits. In an intervention that holds proposals and gate decisions fixed, retrieving each accepted skill only for its originating family raises mean hidden trajectory utility from 0.713 under global memory to 0.816 and changes harmful deployments from six of eight to none. In 27 paired randomized-order streams, Scoped-ORC improves mean trajectory utility by 0.063 [0.037, 0.094] over Global-ORC, accepts 63 rather than 12 updates, and produces multiple accepted updates in 19/27 streams, with 0/63 harmful acceptances. The global control reaches 0.713, below the static agent's 0.775, because locally valid edits can interfere with unrelated families. These results establish scope matching as a complementary control for persistent agent memory: certification determines whether an edit is supported, while retrieval scope determines where that evidence authorizes its use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在持久记忆的 LLM agent 中，把技能编辑的检索范围限制到其来源任务族（scope matching），可避免跨族干扰：ProcStream-RSI 12 轮代码修复流上，均值轨迹效用从全局记忆的 0.713 升到 0.816，有害部署从 8 次中 6 次降为 0 次。认证决定编辑是否被证据支持，检索范围决定该证据授权其在何处使用。
Motivation: 持久记忆让 agent 不更新权重即可积累提示与技能，但全局检索会把局部有效的编辑部署到无关任务族，产生跨族干扰，甚至使全局记忆低于静态 agent。
Method: 在冻结模型 agent 上研究 ProcStream-RSI（12 轮代码修复流），用执行驱动的门控 Orthogonal Regression Control (ORC) 决定持久技能编辑是否被接受；干预实验固定提案与门控决策，只改变检索范围（按来源族限定 vs 全局），并在 27 条随机顺序配对流上比较 Scoped-ORC 与 Global-ORC。
Result: 按来源族检索使均值隐藏轨迹效用从 0.713 升至 0.816，有害部署从 8 次中 6 次变为 0 次；27 条配对随机顺序流上 Scoped-ORC 比 Global-ORC 均值轨迹效用高 0.063 [0.037, 0.094]，接受 63 而非 12 个更新，19/27 条流产生多个被接受更新，63 个接受中 0 个有害；Global-ORC 达到 0.713，低于静态 agent 的 0.775。
Conclusion: 范围匹配是持久 agent 记忆的补充控制手段：认证判定编辑是否有证据支持，检索范围判定该证据授权其生效的位置，二者需分开处理。

papers.title: AI-Moderated Interviews for Market Research and Digital Twins Calibration
papers.abstract_en: AI-moderated interviews are emerging as a scalable market-research method for generating consumer insights and building consumer "digital twins." Yet it remains unclear whether they match human-moderated interviews or improve on simpler, static data collection methods. In a pre-registered, between-subjects study (N = 317) with three industry partners, we compare AI-moderated (N = 139), human-moderated (N = 24), and static interviews (N = 154). AI moderation matches human moderation in depth, covers more themes, and, holding budget constant, recovers significantly more customer needs than human moderation or static interviews. However, participants sound more emotionally engaged when speaking to a live human. We then create digital twins using interview data and evaluate each twin against the participant's own held-out responses to six real-world marketing stimuli. We find that digital twins created from AI-moderated interviews predict consumer responses better than demographics-only personas. However, the additional richness from AI moderation does not translate into better quantitative predictions compared to static interviews. By analyzing open-ended thoughts generated from humans versus their twins, we find that prediction errors are connected both to differences in (self-reported) thinking styles between twins and humans, and to gaps between training and validation data (i.e., asking questions that are too far out of distribution).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI 主持的访谈在深度上与人类主持持平、覆盖主题更多，且在预算固定时回收的客户需求显著多于人类主持和静态问卷；但由此构建的消费者数字孪生在定量预测上并不优于静态访谈，错误来自孪生与人的自报思维风格差异以及训练/验证数据的分布外差距。
Motivation: AI 主持访谈作为可扩展的市场研究与数字孪生构建手段正在兴起，但它是否匹配人类主持、或优于更简单的静态数据采集方法尚不清楚。
Method: 预注册的组间实验 (N=317)，联合三家行业伙伴，比较 AI 主持 (N=139)、人类主持 (N=24)、静态访谈 (N=154)；再用访谈数据构建数字孪生，以参与者本人对六个真实营销刺激的留出回答做评估，并对比仅人口统计画像，同时分析人与孪生的开放式想法差异。
Result: AI 主持在深度上匹配人类主持、覆盖更多主题，预算固定时回收的客户需求显著多于人类主持与静态访谈；参与者对真人主持的情感投入更高。AI 访谈构建的孪生预测消费者反应优于仅人口统计画像，但相对静态访谈的额外丰富度未带来更好的定量预测。
Conclusion: AI 主持访谈在定性洞察产出上可替代人类主持，但访谈丰富度不自动转化为数字孪生的定量预测精度，预测误差与思维风格差异及训练-验证分布差距相关。

papers.title: Not Every Token Is Worth Distilling: Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD
papers.abstract_en: Direct On-Policy Distillation (Direct-OPD) transfers reinforcement-learning-induced policy improvements from a small model to a larger student by using the token-level log-ratio between post-RL and pre-RL checkpoints as dense supervision on the student's own rollouts. This transfer rewards the policy shift at every state, yet the log-ratio measures only relative change: it can stay fixed even as the probability mass that both checkpoints assign to the student's candidate tokens vanishes. Through an exact construction, we show that the Direct-OPD reward and its update can remain unchanged while the Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) and both KL directions between the checkpoints vanish with this mass, and we note that a small JSD bounds how much the teacher's behavior changed. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD (S$^2$D-OPD), which ranks student-sampled states by their teacher-reference JSD and masks Direct-OPD supervision at low-divergence states, retaining only the top 10% of states per response. Across two teacher pairs and four student models ranging from 1.7B to 8B parameters, S$^2$D-OPD improves held-out accuracy over dense Direct-OPD on AIME and HMMT benchmarks in seven of eight settings and matches it in the eighth, without extra forward passes. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/S2D-OPD-8868.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Yibo Zhao and Zixuan Yang are equal contributors and may list their names in either order on their CVs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Direct-OPD 用 post-RL 与 pre-RL 检查点的 token 级 log-ratio 作为稠密监督，但该比值只度量相对变化，即使两个检查点赋予候选 token 的概率质量同时趋零也可保持不变。作者据此提出 S²D-OPD：按 teacher-reference JSD 给学生采样状态排序，只保留每条回复中 JSD 最高的 10% 状态施加监督。在 1.7B–8B 的四个学生模型、两组 teacher 配对上，AIME 与 HMMT 共八个设置中七个提升留出精度、第八个持平，且不增加前向传播。
Motivation: Direct-OPD 在每个状态都奖励策略偏移，但 log-ratio 只反映相对变化，可能在两个检查点对候选 token 的概率质量都已消失时仍给出非零监督，导致无效更新。
Method: 先给出精确构造，证明 Direct-OPD 的奖励与更新可在 JSD 与双向 KL 同时趋零时保持不变；再提出 Selective Supervision for Direct-OPD (S²D-OPD)，按学生采样状态的 teacher-reference JSD 排序，屏蔽低散度状态的监督，每条回复仅保留前 10% 状态，无需额外前向传播。
Result: 在两组 teacher 配对与四个 1.7B–8B 学生模型上，S²D-OPD 在 AIME 与 HMMT 的八个设置中七个优于稠密 Direct-OPD 的留出精度，第八个持平；构造表明 Direct-OPD 奖励与更新可保持不变而 JSD 与双向 KL 同时趋零。
Conclusion: token 级 log-ratio 稠密监督会奖励无信息的状态，按 teacher-reference JSD 选择性施加监督即可在不增加前向传播的前提下提升直接在策略蒸馏效果。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sharp Limits for Honest Uncertainty in Hard-Budget Repeated Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Repeated evaluation can estimate a benchmark score accurately while still requiring replication to certify narrow uncertainty. We characterize that requirement on a fixed grid of $M$ tasks with $L$ binary paths per task under the hard budget $(M+t)K$, where each path costs at most $K$ responses or episodes. For fixed $L \ge 3$ and $0 < α\le 1/12$, the optimal expected width on the worst pure cohort is $Θ_{α,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})$ when every task is observed and $Θ_{α,L}([M(t+\sqrt{M})]^{-1/2})$ when omission is allowed. The lower bounds cover adaptive hard-budget policies, and fixed random-subset designs attain both rates through disagreement certificates. A joint mean/disagreement interval turns the task-covering law into practical finite-budget inference. In an equal-budget LiveCodeBench replay with 16 models, 880 tasks, and five outputs per task, the task-covering design reduces median point-estimation MSE by 87.0\% relative to pooled uniform sampling, while the Joint certificate produces narrower confidence intervals in 15/16 panels and reduces median interval width by 30.6\%. Finite-regime analyses identify task coverage as the effective choice at the evaluated scale and characterize how cohort size and within-task agreement determine the useful operating region. Together, the sharp laws and fixed-budget evidence make replication and task coverage explicit design variables for information-efficient repeated evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在硬预算 (M+t)K 下的重复评测中，任务覆盖而非重复次数决定不确定度：固定 L≥3、0<α≤1/12 时，全观测的最坏纯组最优期望区间宽度为 Θ_{α,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})，允许遗漏时为 Θ_{α,L}([M(t+√M)]^{-1/2})，且下界覆盖自适应策略。LiveCodeBench 等预算回放中任务覆盖设计使点估计 MSE 中位数降 87.0%，Joint 证书在 16 个面板中 15 个给出更窄区间、区间宽度中位数降 30.6%。
Motivation: 重复评测能准确估计基准分数，但要给出窄的置信区间仍需重复；这一重复需求在硬预算下此前没有刻画，评测设计缺少可判定的取舍依据。
Method: 在固定 M 个任务、每任务 L 条二元路径、每条路径至多 K 次响应的硬预算 (M+t)K 下推导最坏纯组的最优期望区间宽度上下界，下界覆盖自适应硬预算策略；固定随机子集设计通过 disagreement certificate 达到该速率，再用联合均值/分歧区间把任务覆盖律转成有限预算推断。
Result: 固定 L≥3、0<α≤1/12 时全观测宽度为 Θ_{α,L}([M(t+1)]^{-1/2})，允许遗漏为 Θ_{α,L}([M(t+√M)]^{-1/2})；等预算 LiveCodeBench 回放含 16 个模型、880 个任务、每任务 5 个输出，任务覆盖设计相对 pooled uniform sampling 使点估计 MSE 中位数降低 87.0%，Joint 证书在 15/16 个面板给出更窄置信区间、区间宽度中位数降低 30.6%。
Conclusion: 在所评测的规模上任务覆盖是有效设计变量，重复与覆盖应作为显式选择；cohort 大小与任务内一致性共同决定可用操作区间。

papers.title: Tag-Aware Structured Text Translation: Towards a Systematic Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Internet texts are replete with format tags that carry structural, semantic, and functional meaning. Current large language model (LLM)-based translation systems struggle to balance translation fluency with tag fidelity when processing tagged text. We argue that resolving this tension requires a systematic approach at three interconnected levels: data synthesis, capability building, and multi-objective alignment. At the data level, we identify and formalize a fundamental trade-off between structural tag diversity and translation naturalness in synthetic data generation; existing methods optimize for one at the expense of the other. We propose a hybrid synthesis strategy (Hy-LST) combining LLM-based synthesis tag method and Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method to produce both diverse and natural tagged data. At the capability level, we decompose tag-aware translation into four sub-tasks of increasing difficulty in a multi-task supervised fine-tuning framework, enabling targeted capability acquisition and knowledge transfer. At the alignment level, we design three complementary reward functions under a group relative policy optimization framework, each targeting a distinct objective (fluency, tag fidelity, and tag-scoped translation quality), and show that joint optimization consistently outperforms single-reward alternatives. Experiments on six language directions (en2zh, en2ja, en2de, en2fr, en2ru, de2fr) demonstrate that each level contributes measurable improvements, and the complete system significantly outperforms existing methods. Qualitative analysis reveals specific error patterns and their mitigation after training with our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对带格式标签文本的 LLM 翻译中流畅度与标签保真 (tag fidelity) 的冲突，提出三层方案：Hy-LST 混合数据合成、四子任务多任务微调、GRPO 下三条奖励（流畅度、标签保真、标签作用域翻译质量）联合优化。在六个语言方向上每层都带来可测提升，联合优化稳定优于单奖励设置，完整系统显著超过现有方法。
Motivation: 带标签文本里标签承载结构与语义，LLM 翻译系统难以同时保证译文流畅与标签不被破坏；合成数据中标签多样性与译文自然度存在此消彼长，现有方法只能二选一。
Method: 数据层用 Hy-LST 混合 LLM-based synthesis tag method 与 Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method；能力层把标签感知翻译拆成四个递增难度子任务做多任务监督微调；对齐层在 GRPO 框架下设计三条互补奖励，分别针对流畅度、标签保真与标签作用域翻译质量并联合优化。
Result: 在 en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr 六个语言方向上，三个层级各自带来可测提升；联合优化三条奖励一致优于单奖励设置，完整系统显著超过现有方法，定性分析显示训练后特定错误模式得到缓解。
Conclusion: 标签感知翻译需要在数据、能力、对齐三个层级同时处理，多目标联合优化比单奖励更能兼顾流畅度与标签保真。

summary_sections.method: 数据层用 Hy-LST 混合 LLM-based synthesis tag method 与 Two-Stage LLM-based synthesis tag method；能力层把标签感知翻译拆成四个递增难度子任务做多任务监督微调；对齐层在 GRPO 框架下设计三条互补奖励，分别针对流畅度、标签保真与标签作用域翻译质量并联合优化。
summary_sections.result: 在 en2zh、en2ja、en2de、en2fr、en2ru、de2fr 六个语言方向上，三个层级各自带来可测提升；联合优化三条奖励一致优于单奖励设置，完整系统显著超过现有方法，定性分析显示训练后特定错误模式得到缓解。
summary_sections.conclusion: 标签感知翻译需要在数据、能力、对齐三个层级同时处理，多目标联合优化比单奖励更能兼顾流畅度与标签保真。

papers.title: FoCal: Frequency-Oriented Cross-Modal Interaction and Spectral Calibration for Aerial Visible-Infrared Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: In aerial RGB--IR object detection, effectively exploiting complementary information across modalities is critical for robust perception under complex illumination and environmental conditions. Existing multimodal detectors mainly focus on spatial-domain interaction or frequency-specific feature enhancement, while the cross-modal interaction patterns of different frequency components remain insufficiently explored. Moreover, spectral discrepancy itself may contain both useful complementary cues and unreliable modality-specific responses, making indiscriminate frequency fusion suboptimal. To address these issues, we propose FoCal, a frequency-oriented framework for aerial RGB--IR object detection. First, a Frequency-Aware Dual-Domain Calibration (FADC) module is developed to explicitly model frequency-dependent cross-modal interaction. Low-frequency components are collaboratively consolidated into a shared structural consensus, whereas high-frequency components preserve modality-specific information through selective cross-modal exchange. The resulting frequency-aware cues are further transferred to the original feature domain to regulate cross-modal calibration. Second, we introduce a Discrepancy-Guided Spectral Modulation (DGSM) module, which characterizes cross-modal spectral imbalance using confidence-weighted relative amplitude discrepancy and transforms it into a bounded signed gate for adaptive enhancement, preservation, or attenuation of the joint multimodal spectrum. Extensive experiments on DroneVehicle, ESCVehicle, and ATR-UMOD demonstrate the effectiveness of FoCal, yielding $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ values of 83.5\%, 54.8\%, and 64.6\%, respectively. Meanwhile, with only 3.0M parameters, FoCal achieves 113.6 FPS while preserving leading detection accuracy, highlighting a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. Code is available at {https://github.com/universeliang/FoCal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FoCal 面向航拍 RGB-IR 目标检测，用频率感知双域校准 (FADC) 让低频成分收敛为共享结构共识、高频成分经选择性跨模态交换保留模态特有信息，再用差异引导的谱调制 (DGSM) 把置信度加权的相对幅度失衡转成有界符号门控，自适应增强/保留/衰减联合谱。在 DroneVehicle、ESCVehicle、ATR-UMOD 上 mAP50 分别达 83.5%、54.8%、64.6%，仅 3.0M 参数下 113.6 FPS。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-IR 检测器多停留在空间域交互或单一频率增强，跨模态在不同频率分量上的交互模式未被充分刻画；而谱差异同时含互补线索与不可靠的模态特有响应，无差别频率融合并非最优。
Method: FADC 显式建模频率依赖的跨模态交互：低频协同聚合为共享结构共识，高频经选择性跨模态交换保留模态特有信息，再把频率感知线索传回原始特征域调节跨模态校准。DGSM 用置信度加权的相对幅度差异刻画跨模态谱失衡，将其变换为有界符号门控，对联合多模态谱做自适应增强、保留或衰减。
Result: 在 DroneVehicle、ESCVehicle、ATR-UMOD 三个航拍 RGB-IR 检测基准上 mAP50 分别为 83.5%、54.8%、64.6%；参数量仅 3.0M，速度 113.6 FPS，同时保持领先检测精度。
Conclusion: 按频率分量区别对待跨模态融合、并用谱失衡信号门控联合谱，可在航拍 RGB-IR 检测上取得精度与效率的有利权衡。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Less is More: Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (AVSS) aims to identify, segment, and classify sound-emitting objects in video frames. Previous Transformer-based AVSS approaches largely inherit design principles from image segmentation models. Recent studies show that these image segmentation models contain redundant components that contribute little to the segmentation performance. Following this insight, we propose Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation (EASE). EASE runs at up to 365 FPS, 3x faster than prior State-of-the-Art (SotA) AVS models at comparable accuracy, and trains in under 11 GPU-hours. Furthermore, we achieve SotA AVSS performance across different backbones and input resolutions. Our results demonstrate that AVSS can be both simpler and faster, providing a scalable foundation for future research and real-time applications. Code, model weights, and samples are available at https://ease-avs.notion.site
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Project page https://ease-avs.notion.site
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EASE 把音频-视觉语义分割 (AVSS) 精简为纯编码器结构，去掉图像分割模型里冗余的解码组件，在精度相当的前提下跑到 365 FPS、比此前 SotA AVS 模型快 3 倍，训练只需不到 11 GPU 小时，并在不同 backbone 与输入分辨率上均达到 SotA AVSS 性能。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer AVSS 方法照搬图像分割的设计，含大量对分割性能贡献很小的冗余组件，导致推理慢、训练成本高，难以支撑实时应用。
Method: 提出 Encoder-only Audio-Visual Segmentation (EASE)，沿用图像分割冗余性这一观察，只保留编码器路径完成音频-视觉语义分割，跨多种 backbone 与输入分辨率验证。
Result: 推理速度最高 365 FPS，比先前 SotA AVS 模型快 3 倍且精度相当；训练耗时不到 11 GPU 小时；在不同 backbone 与输入分辨率上取得 SotA AVSS 性能。
Conclusion: AVSS 可以同时做得更简单、更快，纯编码器设计可作为实时应用与后续研究的可扩展基础。

papers.title: UpDown-SC: Gravity-Canonicalized Dual-Envelope Scan Context for Indoor LiDAR Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR place recognition is a key front end for loop closure and global relocalization, yet indoor retrieval remains difficult when attitude or sensor mounting height changes between mapping and query sessions. Scan Context stores the maximum height in each polar cell; indoors, broad ceilings can suppress the lower and mid-level geometry that distinguishes adjacent rooms and corridors. We present UpDown-SC, a training-free polar descriptor that first canonicalizes gravity and then represents two complementary surfaces: the upper envelope of lower/middle structures and the lower envelope of overhead structures. Their physical split is estimated once from a cell-balanced map height distribution and reused by every query. A mask-aware, non-uniform two-channel distance retains discriminative lower-level evidence while limiting sensitivity to its cross-session variation, without treating unobserved cells as zero-height measurements. Conventional Scan Context shortlisting and circular yaw alignment are retained, so retrieved hypotheses directly initialize geometric verification. Experiments across repeated indoor sessions, mounting-height changes, mixed outdoor-to-indoor trajectories, and an outdoor transfer sequence show more reliable first-choice retrieval on the indoor and mounting-height-varied sessions. A paired test finds a significant gain over Scan Context on the in-house sessions. UpDown-SC also gives the best or second-best F1max and AUPR under threshold-based acceptance while retaining a lightweight CPU front end. Continuous replay confirms that the retrieved hypotheses support metric prior-map localization. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UpDown-SC 是一个免训练的室内 LiDAR 地点识别描述子：先做重力方向规范化，再用一次估计的物理分界面把点云拆成下/中层结构的上包络与顶部结构的下包络两个通道，配合掩码感知的非均匀双通道距离。在重复室内会话与安装高度变化的会话上首选检索更可靠，配对检验显示相对 Scan Context 显著提升，且保持轻量 CPU 前端。
Motivation: Scan Context 每个极坐标格存最大高度，室内宽天花板会压掉区分相邻房间与走廊的中低层几何；同时建图与查询会话间姿态或传感器安装高度变化使室内检索变难。
Method: 先对点云做重力方向规范化；由 cell-balanced 的地图高度分布一次性估计物理分界面，把点云表示为下/中层结构上包络与顶部结构下包络两个互补面；用掩码感知的非均匀双通道距离，保留低层判别证据、不把未观测格当作零高度；保留常规 Scan Context 短名单与圆周 yaw 对齐，使检索假设可直接初始化几何验证。
Result: 在重复室内会话、安装高度变化、室外到室内混合轨迹与室外迁移序列上，室内与安装高度变化会话的首选检索更可靠；配对检验显示在自有会话上相对 Scan Context 有显著增益；在阈值接受下取得最好或次好的 F1max 与 AUPR，前端保持轻量 CPU；连续回放确认检索假设支持度量先验地图定位。
Conclusion: 免训练的重力规范化加双包络表示可在安装高度与姿态变化下提升室内 LiDAR 地点识别的检索可靠性，并能直接对接几何验证与先验地图定位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Concentration Bound for Two-Timescale Actor-Critic Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Significant research effort has been directed in recent years towards establishing both asymptotic and non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for two-timescale actor--critic algorithms, where the actor recursion is run on a slower timescale than the critic recursion. This work derives a uniform all-time concentration bound for the actor--critic algorithm with function approximation in the long-run average-reward setting. This bound helps us analyze the behavior of the actor parameter with high probability. We show that, after some finite time, the actor parameter enters a safe region and remains within it thereafter with high probability. Specifically, with probability at least $1-ε_1-ε_2$, the actor error $\Vert θ_k-θ^{*}\Vert$ is $O\left(\frac{n_0^{3/4}}{k}\frac{1}{\sqrt{ε_2}}+\left(\frac{1}{n_0}\right)^{1/4}\log^{1/4}\left(\frac{1}{ε_1}\right)+\left(\frac{1}{n_0}\right)^{1/4}\right)$ for all $k\geq n_0$ and sufficiently large $n_0$. We also present experimental results demonstrating that the aforementioned actor error diminishes with the number of actor-parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为函数逼近、长期平均奖励设定下的双时间尺度 actor-critic 算法给出一个全时段一致的集中界 (all-time concentration bound)：以概率至少 1−ε₁−ε₂，从时刻 n₀ 起 actor 参数进入安全区域并此后保持在内，误差 ‖θ_k−θ*‖ 为 O(n₀^{3/4}/(k√ε₂) + (1/n₀)^{1/4}log^{1/4}(1/ε₁) + (1/n₀)^{1/4})。实验显示该 actor 误差随 actor 参数更新次数下降。
Motivation: 双时间尺度 actor-critic 的既有收敛保证多为渐近或非渐近的单点界，缺少一个对所有时刻一致、能以高概率刻画 actor 参数长期轨迹的集中界。
Method: 在 actor 慢于 critic 的双时间尺度递推、函数逼近与长期平均奖励设定下推导全时段集中界，用安全区域论证给出高概率的参数误差界，并辅以实验验证误差随更新次数下降。
Result: 以概率至少 1−ε₁−ε₂，对所有 k≥n₀ 且 n₀ 足够大，actor 误差 ‖θ_k−θ*‖ = O(n₀^{3/4}/(k√ε₂) + (1/n₀)^{1/4}log^{1/4}(1/ε₁) + (1/n₀)^{1/4})；实验中该误差随 actor 参数更新次数减小。
Conclusion: 双时间尺度 actor-critic 的 actor 参数在有限时间后以高概率停留在安全区域内，且误差随更新次数衰减，全时段集中界可用于高概率分析其行为。

papers.title: Spectral Amplitude Purification in Distribution Matching for Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables high-quality diffusion sampling in only a few steps, but its optimization dynamics remain dominated by coarse, low-frequency signals, delaying the recovery of fine-grained details. We identify a pronounced concentration of spectral amplitudes at low frequencies in the DMD directional error, where dominant low-frequency components overwhelm weaker mid- and high-frequency signals. To address this issue, we propose Spectral Amplitude Purification for Distribution Matching Distillation (SAP-DMD), a plug-and-play approach that adaptively modulates the amplitude spectrum of the DMD directional field. By suppressing the dominant tail of the amplitude spectrum, SAP-DMD reduces low-frequency dominance and promotes more effective recovery of fine structures and textures. Experiments on PixArt-$α$, SD3, and SD3.5 demonstrate that SAP-DMD accelerates training convergence and improves generation quality under both 2-step and 4-step sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAP-DMD 针对分布匹配蒸馏 (DMD) 方向误差中谱幅在低频的显著集中，自适应压制幅度谱的主导尾部，降低低频主导程度以更快恢复细节纹理。在 PixArt-α、SD3、SD3.5 上，2 步与 4 步采样下均加速训练收敛并提升生成质量。
Motivation: DMD 的优化动态被粗粒度低频信号主导，中高频弱信号被压制，导致细粒度细节恢复缓慢。
Method: 提出 Spectral Amplitude Purification (SAP-DMD)，一种即插即用方法，自适应调制 DMD 方向场的幅度谱，压制幅度谱的主导尾部，从而减弱低频主导。
Result: 在 PixArt-α、SD3、SD3.5 上实验，2 步与 4 步采样设置下均加速训练收敛并提升生成质量。
Conclusion: DMD 方向误差的低频谱幅集中是细节恢复的瓶颈，压制幅度谱主导尾部可即插即用地改善少步扩散蒸馏的收敛与画质。

papers.title: CounterRoute: Self-Routed Reasoning via Hierarchical Counterfactual Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-capable language models often produce long chains of thought when direct answers suffice, wasting inference compute. Many dual-mode models leave this choice to users. Automating it is challenging because routing targets evolve with the policy, initial mode preferences destabilize exploration, and sequence-level objectives entangle routing with response learning. We introduce CounterRoute, an online reinforcement-learning framework that jointly learns routing and modeconditioned responses in one shared policy directly from a native dual-mode checkpoint, without method-specific SFT warm-up. Paired current-policy counterfactual rollouts assign cross-mode credit only to the routing token, while within-mode GRPO trains response tokens. A paired-to-self-routed curriculum stabilizes early training with forced rollouts from both modes, then increases self-routed updates to improve autonomous routing. Across nine benchmarks, CounterRoute better balances accuracy and efficiency than heuristic and learned adaptive-routing methods. Relative to always-thinking checkpoints, it improves macro-average accuracy while reducing mean generated tokens by 51% for Qwen3-8B and 41% for Qwen3-14B. On instruction-following and commonsense benchmarks where direct answering is strong, think rates fall as low as 1% while response quality improves. Despite training only on math and instruction following, its routing behavior and response quality generalize to held-out coding, science, knowledge, and commonsense benchmarks.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CounterRoute 用在线强化学习在单一共享策略里同时学路由与模式条件响应，直接从原生双模式 checkpoint 起训、无需方法特定 SFT 预热：配对的当前策略反事实 rollout 只把跨模式 credit 记到 routing token 上，模式内用 GRPO 训响应 token。相对 always-thinking checkpoint，Qwen3-8B 宏平均准确率提升且平均生成 token 减少 51%，Qwen3-14B 减少 41%；在直接作答本就强的指令遵循与常识基准上 think rate 最低降到 1% 而响应质量仍提升。
Motivation: 推理型语言模型常在直接答案足够时仍输出长思维链，浪费推理算力；而自动在思考与直接作答之间路由很难，因为路由目标随策略演化、初始模式偏好会破坏探索、序列级目标把路由与响应学习纠缠在一起。
Method: 在线 RL 框架 CounterRoute：从原生双模式 checkpoint 直接联合训练路由与模式条件响应，不做方法特定 SFT 预热；配对的当前策略反事实 rollout 只对 routing token 做跨模式 credit assignment，模式内用 GRPO 训练响应 token；训练采用 paired-to-self-routed 课程，先强制双模式 rollout 稳住早期训练，再逐步增加 self-routed 更新。
Result: 在九个基准上，相比启发式与学习型自适应路由方法更好地平衡准确率与效率；相对 always-thinking checkpoint，Qwen3-8B 宏平均准确率提升且平均生成 token 减少 51%，Qwen3-14B 减少 41%；在直接作答较强的指令遵循与常识基准上 think rate 低至 1% 且响应质量提升；仅在数学与指令遵循上训练，路由行为与响应质量泛化到留出的 coding、science、knowledge、commonsense 基准。
Conclusion: 把跨模式 credit 只归给 routing token、模式内用 GRPO 训响应，可以在单一策略里同时拿到更高准确率与更少生成 token，且路由行为能跨任务泛化。

papers.title: Functional Architecture of European Electricity Trading Markets: Requirements for AI Supported Trading Systems under Regulatory Constraints
papers.abstract_en: European electricity trading in the EU operates as a constrained multi-layer system in which legal design, exchange microstructure, and network physics are executed jointly across forward, day-ahead, intraday, and balancing horizons. This paper develops a functional architecture for AI-supported trading that is aligned with market-coupling mechanics, cross-zonal transfer constraints, and compliance obligations under REMIT, MiFID II, MiFIR, and EMIR. The contribution is a formal system specification composed of a decision-state vector, residual-exposure accounting, constrained optimization objective, executable-action permission gate, and fail-closed AI control logic with auditable records. The analysis maps major Nominated Electricity Market Operator (NEMO) venues and related exchange operators into an operational venue topology and identifies where cross-border coordination fails in practice: interface-level timing, permission heterogeneity, and balancing-layer coupling. The resulting framework proposes how AI can be deployed as a bounded decision component inside regulated market operation with explicit governance, rather than as an unconstrained prediction layer.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出欧洲电力交易市场的功能架构规范：把决策状态向量、残余敞口核算、约束优化目标、可执行动作许可门与 fail-closed AI 控制逻辑组合成形式化系统规格，使 AI 只能作为受监管市场内的有界决策组件运行。它把 NEMO 场所映射为运行拓扑，并指出跨境协调在接口时序、许可异质性和平衡层耦合三处实际失效。
Motivation: 欧洲电力交易横跨远期、日前、日内与平衡多个时域，法律设计、交易所微观结构与电网物理同时生效；AI 若作为无约束预测层接入，会与 REMIT、MiFID II、MiFIR、EMIR 的合规义务和跨境耦合机制冲突。
Method: 构建形式化系统规格：决策状态向量 + 残余敞口核算 + 约束优化目标 + 可执行动作许可门 + 带可审计记录的 fail-closed AI 控制逻辑；并把主要 NEMO 场所及关联交易所运营方映射为运行场所拓扑，对齐 market-coupling 机制与跨区输电约束。
Result: 识别出跨境协调在三处实际失效：接口层时序、许可异质性、平衡层耦合；产出为受监管市场内带显式治理的 AI 部署框架与场所拓扑映射，全文 12 页含 1 张表。
Conclusion: AI 在受监管电力市场中应作为受边界约束、可审计的决策组件嵌入，而不是无约束的预测层。

papers.title: WildHSR: Metric Feed-Forward 4D People-Scene Reconstruction from a 3D Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: 3D foundation models recover video cameras and geometry in one forward pass, but some of the strongest are up to scale. Joint people-scene reconstruction then requires two missing outputs: metric scale and persistent person identity. We ask whether one up-to-scale foundation representation can support both through lightweight adaptation. Exact metric labels are scarce, but unlabeled in-the-wild video is abundant. We use people in curated web video to initialise the solution: a posed metric body and 2D keypoints give an approximate, closed-form scale pseudo-label. These pseudo-labels pretrain a Scale Readout, which is then fine-tuned together with a lightweight adapter using exact metric supervision from standard real-video training splits. At inference the head predicts metric scale from foundation-model tokens, without the ruler or its teachers. For person identity, we probe the pretrained foundation model alone and find evidence that its intermediate query-key features encode person correspondence across frames. In most evaluated moving-person clips, a mid-layer token prefers that person over the vacated location and other people. A tiny projection reads this correspondence; together with metric pelvis motion and proposal confidence, it drives dustbin-aware Sinkhorn association of per-frame bodies. WildHSR combines both readouts to reconstruct metric cameras, scene and people from monocular video. Each window is predicted feed-forward; analytic association and Sim(3) composition connect windows. On EMDB-2, WildHSR is the first feed-forward method in the published comparison to beat the best optimization-based WA-MPJPE and RTE while leading feed-forward methods on all three world-frame metrics. On RICH, it leads feed-forward people-and-scene methods on WA-MPJPE and W-MPJPE. The complete pipeline runs at 10.1 fps on one GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildHSR 用 3D foundation model 的 token 一次性从单目视频前馈重建带真实尺度的相机、场景与人物：Scale Readout 从 foundation token 预测 metric scale，中层 query-key 特征经小投影读出跨帧人物对应，再用带 dustbin 的 Sinkhorn 关联逐帧人体。EMDB-2 上它成为已发表对比中首个在 WA-MPJPE 与 RTE 上超过最优优化式方法的前馈方法，单 GPU 跑 10.1 fps。
Motivation: 3D foundation model 一次前馈即可恢复相机与几何，但输出是 up-to-scale 且缺持久人物身份；精确 metric 标注稀缺，而野外视频充足，联合 people-scene 重建缺 metric scale 与 identity 两个输出。
Method: 用精选网络视频中的人物构造闭式近似尺度伪标签（posed metric body + 2D keypoints）预训练 Scale Readout，再与轻量 adapter 一起用标准真实视频训练划分的精确 metric 监督微调；身份侧只探测预训练 foundation model，用中层 query-key 特征的小投影读出跨帧对应，配合 metric 骨盆运动与 proposal 置信度驱动 dustbin-aware Sinkhorn 关联，两个 readout 合成 WildHSR，窗口间用解析关联与 Sim(3) 组合。
Result: EMDB-2 上 WildHSR 是已发表对比中首个在 WA-MPJPE 与 RTE 上超过最优优化式方法的前馈方法，并在三项 world-frame 指标上领先前馈方法；RICH 上在 WA-MPJPE 与 W-MPJPE 领先前馈 people-and-scene 方法；完整管线单 GPU 10.1 fps。多数被评估的移动人物片段中，中层 token 更偏好该人物而非原位置或其他人。
Conclusion: 一个 up-to-scale foundation 表示经轻量适配即可同时提供 metric scale 与持久人物身份，使单目 people-scene 重建可以全程前馈并达到优化式方法的精度。

papers.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续扩散语言模型 (continuous diffusion LM) 扩到数学与代码推理：ELF-REG 用冻结 AR 教师做表示对齐与纠缠 (REPA+REG)，让全局表示与响应一起去噪。ELF-REG-L 在 GSM8K 上 64 NFE 达 55.96% pass@1，MATH-500 128 NFE 达 13.39%（ELF-L 基线 10.55%），HumanEval 128 NFE 达 22.56%；配合 early-stop 在 16 NFE 下 HumanEval pass@10 达 41.21%。
Motivation: 全连续 dLM 不经离散化、最后一步并行解码全部 token，但在 GSM8K、MATH-500 这类难推理任务上的表现仍不如自回归 (AR) LLM 与 masked dLM。
Method: 把 Embedded Language Flows (ELF) 扩到数学推理与代码生成；新增 ELF-REG，用 REPA+REG 让冻结的 AR 教师监督去噪器中间层特征，并提供一个与响应联合去噪的全局表示；另用 early-stop 直接解码中间干净预测，实现低 NFE 推理而无需 few-step 训练。
Result: ELF-REG-L：GSM8K 64 NFE pass@1 55.96%，MATH-500 128 NFE 13.39%（ELF-L 基线 10.55%），HumanEval 128 NFE 22.56%；在 GSM8K 与代码任务上 pass@1 超过所评估的同规模 dLM。16 NFE 时 HumanEval pass@10 41.21%，超过近期同规模连续 dLM。
Conclusion: 教师监督的表示对齐与纠缠能把连续扩散语言模型推到可用的推理水平，且同一任务检查点靠 early-stop 即可支持低 NFE 强性能，无需额外 few-step 训练。

papers.title: Language Specificity vs. Domain Diversity: Benchmarking Transformers for Bangla Medical NER
papers.abstract_en: Medical Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource languages remains a challenging task due to high linguistic variability and a scarcity of domain-specific annotated corpora. This work presents a comprehensive empirical benchmark evaluating three fine-tuned transformer encoders-BanglaBERT, multilingual BERT (mBERT), and XLM-RoBERTa-against GPT-4o mini under zero-shot and few-shot prompting configurations for Bangla medical NER. In contrast to prior studies that evaluated large language models on limited subsets of only 50 samples, we conduct a large-scale evaluation across the full test set of 3,179 samples, providing statistically robust and reproducible baselines. Our fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa model achieves an F1- score of 0.5959, establishing a new state-of-the-art and surpassing the previously reported best result of 0.5848. Crucially, we demonstrate that the language-specific BanglaBERT model consistently underperforms its multilingual counterparts with an F1-score of 0.4937, indicating that pretraining domain diversity can outweigh language specificity in highly specialized clinical settings. Finally, fine-tuned transformer models outperform the optimal prompting configuration by a factor of 3.76, confirming that prompt-only pipelines remain inadequate for structured clinical entity extraction in low-resource language environments.

papers.title: TraceGuard: Adaptive Multimodal Poison Filtering through Cross-Feature Rank Agreement
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal training relies on image-text corpora collected from external sources, creating opportunities for attackers to poison the data. Stealthy attacks can preserve plausible image-text pairs while concealing the differences used by detectors, so apparently clean data can still redirect the trained model. We therefore ask which properties a poison set must preserve for the attack to remain effective. A small poison set must still exert enough collective influence during training to induce the attacker's target behavior. We analyze this influence in terms of how often an attack pattern occurs and how strongly the examples carrying it jointly affect the model. This analysis motivates six corpus-level features that examine cross-modal neighborhoods, recurring text, and changes after text-span erasure without training the victim model. We introduce TraceGuard, an adaptive rank-based filtering method that uses agreement among complementary feature rankings to identify suspicious examples. It refines the selected set through shared patterns and adapts the removal threshold to each corpus without knowing the attack or poison rate. Across 19 attack configurations spanning image-text learning, generative vision-language model fine-tuning, and encoder-transfer tests, TraceGuard removes an average of 98.4% of poisoned examples and 5.4% of clean examples. After training on the filtered corpora, the residual attack metric is at most 1% in 13 configurations. Matched-removal controls and ablations support the contributions of sample selection and adaptive removal. Stress tests also identify detection failures under adaptive attacks and unnecessary removal on poison-free corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceGuard 针对多模态图文语料的隐蔽投毒，提出基于互补特征排名一致性 (rank agreement) 的自适应过滤：先用六个无需训练受害者模型的语料级特征刻画投毒集的集体影响，再按共享模式精化选集并按语料自适应调整删除阈值。在覆盖图文学习、生成式 VLM 微调与编码器迁移的 19 种攻击配置上，平均清除 98.4% 投毒样本、误删 5.4% 干净样本，13 种配置残余攻击指标不超过 1%。
Motivation: 隐蔽投毒保留看似合理的图文对，抹掉了检测器依赖的差异，使表面干净的数据仍能改写训练模型；小投毒集要起效必须在训练中保持足够的集体影响，而现有检测难以在不知道攻击方式与投毒率的情况下识别它。
Method: 从攻击模式出现频率与其携带样本对模型的联合影响出发，构造六个语料级特征，覆盖跨模态邻域、重复文本与文本片段擦除后的变化，全程不训练受害者模型；TraceGuard 用互补特征排名之间的一致性筛出可疑样本，再依据共享模式精化选中集合，并针对每个语料自适应设定删除阈值。
Result: 在 19 种攻击配置（涵盖 image-text learning、generative vision-language model fine-tuning、encoder-transfer tests）上，平均移除 98.4% 投毒样本与 5.4% 干净样本；在过滤后语料上训练，13 种配置的残余攻击指标至多 1%。matched-removal 对照与消融支持样本选择和自适应删除的贡献；压力测试在 adaptive attacks 下发现检测失效，并在无毒语料上出现不必要删除。
Conclusion: 投毒集的可检测性可以由语料级跨特征排名一致性在不训练受害者模型、也不知道攻击与投毒率的前提下判定，但 adaptive attacks 与无毒语料仍是其失效与误删的边界。

papers.title: Downside-Controlled Online Forecast Combination under Delayed and Revised Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc correction adjusts a forecaster that cannot be retrained, such as a foundation model, but a correction fitted where errors are stable can hurt where they shift. We aim for downside control: not much worse than the starting forecast. We combine the frozen forecaster, a static corrector and an online corrector on the simplex, using only losses that mature after the horizon. Across seven benchmarks and four base models, two of them foundation models, the worst deterioration over 28 pairs at the main horizon is 0.15% and gains reach 11.5%. On day-ahead load for seven European bidding zones it lowers mean MSE in all seven zones, while single correctors raise mean MSE by up to 102% where the published forecast is most accurate. Three empirical conditions on expert speed, stream length and outcome alignment, each fixed by a documented failure, delimit its scope. Learning from the provisional outcome improves four zones on the settled one; learning on the settled outcome restores all seven.
papers.comment: 8 figures, 8 tables; supplementary material (1 figure, 23 tables) appended
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在单纯形 (simplex) 上把冻结预测器、静态校正器与在线校正器做在线组合的后处理方法，只使用在预报时效之后才成熟的损失，目标是下行风险受控：不比原始预报差太多。七个基准、四个基线模型（含两个 foundation model）上，主时效 28 组配对中最差恶化仅 0.15%，最大增益达 11.5%；日前负荷任务在七个欧洲交易分区全部降低平均 MSE。
Motivation: 对无法重训的预测器（如 foundation model）做事后校正时，在误差稳定处拟合的校正器在误差漂移处反而会变差，需要一种能限制下行风险的组合方式。
Method: 在单纯形上组合冻结预测器、静态校正器与在线校正器，只用在预报时效后才成熟的损失进行在线更新；用三个经验条件（专家速度、流长度、结果对齐）界定适用范围，每个条件对应一个有记录的失败案例。
Result: 七个基准、四个基线模型（两个为 foundation model）下，主时效 28 组配对中最差恶化 0.15%，最大增益 11.5%。日前负荷任务在七个欧洲交易分区全部降低平均 MSE，而单一校正器在已发布预报最准的分区把平均 MSE 最高推高 102%。用临时 (provisional) 结果学习改善四个分区，改用结算 (settled) 结果学习恢复全部七个分区。
Conclusion: 单纯形上的下行受控在线组合能把校正的最坏劣化压到 0.15% 以内并保留最高 11.5% 的增益，但适用范围由专家速度、流长度与结果对齐三个经验条件限定，且学习信号应使用结算结果而非临时结果。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Where Does Exactly-Once Live? Model, Harness, and Tool-Contract Effects on Duplicate Side Effects in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: When a tool-using agent's write times out or returns a server error, the action may already have taken effect. Retrying blindly duplicates it -- a second charge, a second announcement, a second deployment -- while giving up skips required work. We ask where exactly-once behaviour should be enforced: in the model, in the agent harness, or in the tool contract. We introduce LIMBO, a deterministic sandbox of six services with realistic contracts (optional idempotency keys, eventually consistent and missing read paths) and twelve fault modes injected at the service boundary, including late commits, redelivery and partial batches; every episode is graded against a ledger of committed effects. Across 25,930 episodes spanning nine recent models, three production agent harnesses, two contract variants and fifteen recovery conditions, the answer depends on the fault. When an immediate read-back can reveal what happened, the model decides: frontier models instructed to act exactly once almost never duplicate a write whose acknowledgement was lost (0.5%), weaker models often do, and the model explains 53% of the explained variance. When it cannot -- the request is still in flight, or the transport delivered it twice -- the same frontier models duplicate in 56% and 74% of episodes, and the contract explains 81%. We prove that no verification-only policy is exactly-once under late commits without a bound on in-flight time. Waiting works when such a bound is short and known, but with heavy-tailed in-flight delays even an hour of waiting per episode falls short of offering an idempotency key on every write, which lowers the duplicate rate from 28% to 4% because agents use keys when they exist. The harness barely matters, a guard that attaches keys transfers across harnesses unchanged, and agents reported success in 90% of the episodes in which they had duplicated an effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 LIMBO：六个带真实契约（可选幂等键、最终一致与缺失读路径）的确定性沙盒服务，在服务边界注入 12 种故障，用账本判定副作用是否重复。跨 25,930 个 episode、9 个模型、3 个生产 harness、2 种契约变体与 15 种恢复条件，结论是 exactly-once 的位置取决于故障：读回可见时由模型决定（前沿模型丢确认后重复率 0.5%，模型解释 53% 方差），请求在途或传输重复投递时由契约决定（重复率 56% 与 74%，契约解释 81% 方差）。
Motivation: 工具写操作超时或服务端报错时动作可能已生效：盲目重试会重复扣款、重复公告、重复部署，放弃则漏做必要工作。exactly-once 该在模型、harness 还是工具契约里强制执行，此前没有可判定的答案。
Method: 构建确定性沙盒 LIMBO：六个服务带可选幂等键、最终一致与缺失读路径等真实契约，在服务边界注入 late commit、redelivery、partial batch 等 12 种故障，每个 episode 对照已提交副作用账本评分。实验横跨 9 个近期模型、3 个生产 agent harness、2 种契约变体、15 种恢复条件，共 25,930 个 episode；并给出证明：在无在途时间上界时，任何仅靠验证的策略在 late commit 下都不是 exactly-once。
Result: 读回可见时，被指示 exactly-once 的前沿模型丢确认后重复写仅 0.5%，弱模型常重复，模型解释 53% 的已解释方差；请求在途或传输重复投递时，同批前沿模型重复率分别为 56% 与 74%，契约解释 81% 方差。重尾在途延迟下每 episode 等待一小时仍不足以替代每次写都带幂等键；强制幂等键把重复率从 28% 降到 4%。harness 影响很小，附加键的 guard 跨 harness 原样迁移；agent 在已重复副作用的 episode 中有 90% 报告成功。
Conclusion: exactly-once 的归属按故障类型划分：读回能判定时交给模型，请求在途或重复投递时必须由工具契约（幂等键）承担；harness 不是关键变量。无在途时间上界时仅靠验证无法保证 exactly-once，等待不如在每次写上强制幂等键。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DAWN: Noise-Robust Quadruped Parkour via Depth-Denoising World Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based legged locomotion methods assume clean depth at training time and rely on hand-tuned post-processing filters at deployment. However, filter parameters are rarely disclosed, hindering reproducibility, and performance degrades substantially when depth noise is left unaddressed. Building noise robustness directly into the learning pipeline would eliminate this dependency. While such robustness has been explored for proprioceptive inputs, analogous approaches for depth perception remain largely absent in legged locomotion. We propose DAWN (Denoising and Alignment in World models for Noise-robustness), a noise-robust perception framework for legged locomotion, which builds noise robustness directly into a world model via two modifications: (1) feeding noisy depth to the encoder while keeping clean depth as the reconstruction target, forcing the model to implicitly denoise its input; and (2) applying contrastive learning to align the latent states of noisy and clean depth. Importantly, DAWN is not tied to a specific noise model, requiring no manual tuning to the noise distribution at deployment. Furthermore, it incurs no additional inference cost over existing world model-based methods. Without any manual filter calibration -- relying solely on the learned noise-robust representation -- DAWN achieves zero-shot quadruped parkour on a Unitree Go1: traversing stairs up to 18 cm, clearing gaps up to 70 cm, and mounting steps up to 45 cm from raw depth observations. Ablation studies show that denoising and contrastive alignment contribute at complementary levels -- reconstruction and representation, respectively -- and yield additive gains when combined. Videos and code are available at: https://dawn-parkour.github.io/

papers.title: Can Classical Semantic-Extractive Summarization Be Evaluated in Hindi? A Replication Study
papers.abstract_en: We replicate the distributional-semantics extractive summarisation method of Mohd, Jan and Shah (2020) and adapt it to Hindi, substituting a Devanagari-appropriate component at every language-specific step. The system is evaluated on two independent corpora --- the Hindi portion of XL-Sum and FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi --- under a Devanagari-aware ROUGE implementation validated against the XL-Sum authors' own multilingual scorer, with all comparisons drawn as 1000-resample paired bootstraps. In its published equal-weight configuration the replicated system is significantly worse than a three-sentence lead baseline on both corpora, trailing Lead-3 by 0.042 ROUGE-1 Fon XL-Sum and by 0.265 on ILSUM. A feature ablation shows that sentenceposition is the only feature that contributes: position alone reproduces the lead baseline exactly, removing position gives the weakest configuration,and a validation-tuned weighting can at best equal Lead-3 and never exceed it. TextRank fails identically, making this a class-level rather than an implementation-level result. A selection analysis shows the remaining features steer extraction towards long, entity-dense body sentences while the references reuse the article lead.Current Hindi benchmarks therefore cannot reward non-lead content selection, motivating purpose-built evaluation resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Mohd, Jan 和 Shah (2020) 的分布式语义抽取式摘要方法逐语言步骤替换为 Devanagari 适配组件后复现到 Hindi，在 XL-Sum Hindi 与 FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi 上均显著输给三句 lead 基线（ROUGE-1 F 分别落后 0.042 与 0.265）。消融显示句子位置是唯一有效特征，位置单独即可精确复现 Lead-3，调权至多打平、从未超过；TextRank 同样失败，说明这是方法类别的失败而非实现问题。
Motivation: 抽取式摘要中的特征权重是否真正带来超越 lead 基线的选择能力，需要在 Hindi 这类非英语、Devanagari 书写的语言上检验；现有 Hindi 摘要基准可能无法奖励非 lead 内容选择。
Method: 复现分布语义抽取式摘要管线，在每个语言相关步骤替换 Devanagari 适配组件；用 Devanagari-aware ROUGE 实现评测，并与 XL-Sum 作者的多语评分器校验一致；所有对比用 1000 次重采样的配对 bootstrap，另做特征消融、验证集调权与选择分析。
Result: 等权配置在 XL-Sum Hindi 上比 Lead-3 低 0.042 ROUGE-1 F，在 FIRE ILSUM 2.0 Hindi 上低 0.265，均显著更差；消融中句子位置是唯一有贡献的特征，去掉位置为最弱配置，位置单独精确复现 lead 基线，验证调权至多等于 Lead-3；TextRank 表现同样失败。
Conclusion: 在当前 Hindi 基准上，这类分布式语义抽取特征无法超越 lead 选择，属于方法类别的普遍失败，需要专门构建能奖励非 lead 内容选择的评测资源。

papers.title: Physics and Data Driven Transformer-Mamba Framework for Flow Field
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning accelerates expensive partial differential equation solving in computational fluid dynamics (CFD), existing methods like PINNs and FNOs often struggle with generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency. We introduce the Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field (TM4FF) framework, a physics-constrained operator learning model with three key innovations: a Residual Wavelet Mamba (RWM) layer for feature denoising, a Transformer-based attention mechanism for enhanced feature fusion, and a physics-informed loss using Fourier derivatives to enforce the Navier-Stokes equations. Experiments on four CFD datasets show TM4FF achieves high accuracy and robust generalization across varying flow conditions.
papers.comment: Corrected version of our ICASSP'26 paper: Corrected seven Dam/MISSFormer metrics in Table 1 that were mistakenly estimated using the MSE(u) ratio. The conclusions remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TM4FF（Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field）：物理约束的算子学习框架，用 Residual Wavelet Mamba 层去噪、Transformer 注意力做特征融合、基于 Fourier 导数的 physics-informed loss 强制满足 Navier-Stokes 方程。在四个 CFD 数据集上，模型在不同流动条件下保持高精度与稳健泛化，直接针对 PINNs 与 FNOs 的泛化、噪声鲁棒性和物理一致性短板。
Motivation: 深度学习加速 CFD 中昂贵的 PDE 求解，但现有方法（PINNs、FNOs）在泛化、噪声鲁棒性和物理一致性上常常失效，跨流动条件外推时尤其明显。
Method: TM4FF 框架含三个组件：Residual Wavelet Mamba (RWM) 层做特征去噪；基于 Transformer 的注意力机制增强特征融合；physics-informed loss 用 Fourier 导数计算 Navier-Stokes 残差作为约束。属于 physics-constrained operator learning，在四个 CFD 数据集上实验。
Result: 在四个 CFD 数据集上，TM4FF 在不同流动条件下达到高精度与稳健泛化（abstract 未给出具体数值）。ICASSP'26 版本更正了 Table 1 中 Dam/MISSFormer 的七项指标——原以 MSE(u) 比值误估，结论不变。
Conclusion: 把小波去噪、Transformer 融合与 Fourier 导数物理损失结合进 Mamba 架构，可在跨流动条件的 CFD 算子学习中同时拿到精度、泛化与物理一致性。

papers.title: A Rapid Pipeline for Training and Deploying ML Models on WeBe Band
papers.abstract_en: Developing optimized machine-learning algorithms for edge devices with limited computational and memory resources is challenging, time-consuming, and highly dependent on device-specific constraints. In this work, we streamline an edge ML workflow to enable rapid development, optimization, and deployment of machine-learning (ML) models directly on the WeBe Band, a wrist-worn wearable device designed for multimodal physiological data monitoring. The proposed system automatically generates hardware-efficient ML models that can be easily integrated into the WeBe core firmware, supporting AutoML, hardware-aware quantization, and performance profiling to build models that meet desired latency targets while remaining compatible with device memory and power limitations. The proposed framework tightly integrates the open-source Piccolo AI ecosystem with an automated pipeline that generates deployable firmware artifacts, performs hardware-aware model compilation, and supports over-the-air (OTA) deployment. The system supports multiple lightweight model classes, including classical machine-learning algorithms and neural networks, and provides built-in on-device profiling tools to evaluate inference latency and memory footprint under realistic execution conditions. Experimental results demonstrate clear trade-offs between model complexity and deployability on a microcontroller, showing that classical models offer strong real-time performance while lightweight neural networks require careful resource management. Rather than proposing new learning architectures, the current work mainly focuses on system-level automation, deployability, and enabling researchers and developers to rapidly iterate on models and evaluate them directly on target hardware. Although demonstrated on the WeBe Band platform, the workflow is designed to be extensible to other ML-powered edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把边缘 ML 开发流程做成一条自动化流水线，直接在腕戴设备 WeBe Band 上生成、编译并部署模型：集成 Piccolo AI 生态，支持 AutoML、硬件感知量化、性能剖析与 OTA 固件下发，并内置设备端延迟与内存剖析工具。实验显示模型复杂度与微控制器可部署性存在明确取舍——经典模型实时性能好，轻量神经网络则需仔细管控资源。
Motivation: 面向算力与内存受限的边缘设备做 ML 开发耗时且高度依赖具体硬件约束，模型难以快速迭代并在真实硬件上验证。
Method: 流水线集成开源 Piccolo AI 生态，自动生成硬件高效模型并产出可部署固件工件，做硬件感知模型编译与 OTA 部署；支持 AutoML、硬件感知量化与性能剖析，覆盖经典机器学习算法与神经网络两类轻量模型，配合设备端剖析工具在真实执行条件下测延迟与内存占用。
Result: 实验结果给出模型复杂度与微控制器可部署性之间的明确取舍：经典模型提供强实时性能，轻量神经网络需要细致的资源管理；系统在满足延迟目标的同时保持与设备内存和功耗限制的兼容。
Conclusion: 该工作的贡献在系统级自动化与可部署性而非新学习架构，工作流虽在 WeBe Band 上演示，但设计为可扩展到其他 ML 边缘设备。
