papers.title: Too Sure to Be Safe: Model Calibration for Reliable Log Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Online log anomaly detection is critical for maintaining the reliability of large-scale computing systems. Although recent language model-based log anomaly detectors achieve strong detection performance, their confidence estimates remain poorly calibrated. We show that these detectors frequently assign excessive confidence to incorrect predictions, particularly for anomalous logs under severe class imbalance. Moreover, confidence on erroneous predictions remains persistently high even when conventional calibration metrics indicate good calibration, creating a critical reliability gap for operational monitoring systems. To address this issue, we propose Log Reconstruction and Distance (LoRD), a lightweight post-hoc calibration framework for reliable log anomaly detection. LoRD learns prediction-route-specific reliability models from latent representations of correctly classified validation samples and estimates prediction reliability through route-wise reconstruction distances. Based on the estimated reliability, LoRD selectively recalibrates high-risk predictions to suppress overconfident errors while preserving reliable predictions. Extensive experiments on four large-scale log benchmark datasets and multiple language model-based detectors demonstrate that LoRD consistently improves confidence reliability and substantially reduces overconfident anomaly-related errors without sacrificing anomaly detection performance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 日志异常检测器对错误预测给出过高置信度，且在类别严重不平衡时对异常日志尤其严重，即使常规校准指标看起来良好，错误预测的置信度仍持续偏高。LoRD 作为事后校准框架，按预测路径从正确分类验证样本的隐表示学习可靠性模型，用路径级重构距离估计可靠性，只对高风险预测做选择性重校准以抑制过自信错误。在四个大规模日志基准和多个基于语言模型的检测器上，LoRD 一致提升置信可靠性并大幅减少与异常相关的过自信错误，同时不牺牲检测性能。
Motivation: 基于语言模型的日志异常检测器检测性能强但置信度校准差，在严重类别不平衡下对错误预测（尤其异常日志）过度自信，常规校准指标良好时错误预测的置信度仍持续偏高，给运维监控系统带来可靠性缺口。
Method: 提出 Log Reconstruction and Distance (LoRD)，一个轻量的事后校准 (post-hoc calibration) 框架：从正确分类的验证样本的隐表示按预测路径 (prediction route) 学习各自的可靠性模型，用路径级重构距离 (route-wise reconstruction distances) 估计预测可靠性，再基于该可靠性选择性地重校准高风险预测，抑制过自信错误同时保留可靠预测。
Result: 在四个大规模日志基准数据集和多个基于语言模型的检测器上的实验中，LoRD 一致提升置信可靠性，并大幅减少与异常相关的过自信错误，同时不牺牲异常检测性能。
Conclusion: 按预测路径建模重构距离可以在不损失检测性能的前提下抑制日志异常检测中的过自信错误，缓解常规校准指标掩盖错误预测高置信度的可靠性缺口。

papers.title: Reflex-Guard: A Low-Latency Guardrail for LLM Prompt Safety Using Dense Semantic Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications often face the risks of specially crafted prompts designed to bypass the safety controls. Existing guardrail methods, such as LLM-as-a-judge and cloud-based safety APIs are able to detect unsafe content. However, they often add a delay of about 250-900 ms to each request. This delay is too high for real-time applications, when the system usually needs to respond in less than 100 ms. Furthermore, routing user prompts through external moderation endpoints raises significant data privacy concerns. This paper introduces Reflex-Guard, a lightweight guardrail that runs locally. It uses jailbreak-aware preprocessing, compact sentence-transformer embeddings, and seven fast binary classifiers. Together, these components enable high-accuracy prompt safety filtering with much lower latency than existing solutions. Through systematic evaluation on a strategically balanced dataset of 30,568 samples drawn from five complementary sources, we demonstrate that Reflex-Guard achieves 95.9% recall on harmful prompts at 37.6 ms end-to-end latency. It is faster than existing baselines, including Llama Guard 2 at 255 ms and SafeDecoding at 723 ms. It can detect 100% of GCG suffix attacks and Base64-encoded prompts using the default threshold. However, DrAttack structured prompts required lowering the threshold to 0.03 for optimal detection, as they produced a distinct probability distribution. Reflex-Guard achieves Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) scores up to 16.79, significantly outperforming Llama Guard 2 (11.90) and SafeDecoding (9.80). This analysis offers practical deployment advice and shows that different attack types occupy distinct regions in the embedding probability space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Reflex-Guard 是本地运行的轻量 LLM 提示安全护栏，用 jailbreak 感知预处理、紧凑 sentence-transformer 嵌入和七个快速二分类器替代 LLM-as-a-judge 与云端安全 API。在 30,568 条、五个来源的平衡数据集上，有害提示召回 95.9%、端到端延迟 37.6 ms，而 Llama Guard 2 为 255 ms、SafeDecoding 为 723 ms。
Motivation: 现有护栏（LLM-as-a-judge、云端安全 API）每次请求增加约 250–900 ms 延迟，而实时系统通常要求 100 ms 内响应；把提示外发到审核端点还带来数据隐私风险。
Method: 本地部署的三段流水线：jailbreak-aware 预处理、紧凑 sentence-transformer 嵌入、七个快速二分类器；在五个互补来源构成的 30,568 条平衡数据集上系统评估，并按攻击类型调整判定阈值。
Result: 有害提示召回 95.9%，端到端延迟 37.6 ms；基线 Llama Guard 2 为 255 ms、SafeDecoding 为 723 ms。默认阈值下检出 100% 的 GCG suffix 攻击与 Base64 编码提示；DrAttack 结构化提示需把阈值降到 0.03 才达到最优检测。Reflex Efficiency Score (RES) 最高 16.79，对比 Llama Guard 2 的 11.90 与 SafeDecoding 的 9.80。
Conclusion: 本地嵌入加轻量分类器可在 100 ms 内完成提示安全过滤并超过现有护栏的效率分数；不同攻击类型在嵌入概率空间中占据可分区域，DrAttack 这类结构化提示需要单独调阈值。

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model identifies manipulation cues from the trajectory, evaluates both the benign and adversarial interpretations of user intent, assigns a jailbreak score, and commits to an action: Allow, Caution, or Decline. We curate 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations from five attack frameworks, pair them with 2.4k benign dialogs, and 600 sensitive-but-benign conversations. We train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO under a multi-component reward that jointly optimizes helpfulness on benign prompts and robustness against jailbreak attempts. Across seven multi-turn attack benchmarks, Trace attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 14.5% against 31.4% for the strongest baseline and 74.9% for the undefended target, while significantly raising the attacker effort required per successful jailbreak. Trace also balances usability and safety, achieving a 93.3% average compliance on over-refusal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是面向多轮越狱攻击的 LLM 防御方法：每轮回复前先沿对话轨迹提取操纵线索，同时评估良性与对抗两种意图解释，给出 jailbreak 分数并输出 Allow/Caution/Decline 三档动作。在七个多轮攻击基准上平均攻击成功率 (ASR) 降至 14.5%，对比最强基线 31.4% 与无防御目标模型 74.9%，同时过拒基准平均合规率 93.3%。
Motivation: 多轮越狱把有害目标拆解到一系列看似无害的轮次中绕过护栏，现有防御缺乏识别渐进式操纵的推理能力，且常以牺牲敏感话题良性请求的可用性换取安全。
Method: 训练 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，用 SFT 与 GRPO 加多组件奖励（同时优化良性提示的 helpfulness 与对越狱的 robustness）；数据为 4k 条来自五个攻击框架的多轮对抗对话、2.4k 条良性对话与 600 条敏感但良性的对话。
Result: 七个多轮攻击基准上平均 ASR 14.5%，最强基线 31.4%，无防御目标 74.9%；每次成功越狱所需的攻击轮次显著上升；过拒基准平均合规率 93.3%。
Conclusion: 带轨迹感知结构化推理的三档动作决策能在压低多轮 ASR 的同时保住良性请求的合规率，把安全与可用性从取舍关系中同时拿到。

papers.title: Refusing Everything Looks Safe: Restoring the Benign Arm to Encoded-Prompt Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Encoded-prompt attacks are evaluated almost entirely on their harmful arm: a benchmark sends obfuscated harmful requests and reports how often the model complied. A high refusal rate there is reported as safety, and it is equally consistent with a model that has stopped telling the request apart from anything else in the same format. We run the benign arm through the same transformation, and the two cases are far apart. Across four 7-8B models spanning three base families and four post-training recipes, refusal of harmful homoglyph-encoded prompts spans 0.08 while the same four span 0.57 on the identical requests in plaintext. What the encoding destroys is not refusal but the harm gap: on one model the gap between harmful and benign refusal falls from +0.82 in plaintext to exactly 0.00 under the encoding, and a benchmark reading only the harmful arm scores that model and one retaining a +0.61 gap identically. Running the cell such benchmarks leave out (plaintext content wearing the attack template, with nothing obfuscated) shows that on two of the four models the loss is caused by the protocol rather than by the character transformation, and on a third by the characters. Across a full SFT -> DPO -> RLVR pipeline the harm gap rises by +0.26 with a paired interval excluding zero while the standard harmful-arm metric registers no resolved change at all. We report twelve instrument defects, each with the control that caught it, including a binary jailbreak judge that fires on 0.61-0.70 of responses to plaintext benign prompts; six of the twelve inflate apparent safety, which is the direction a broken safety evaluation fails in by default.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables; supplementary material included as an appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 编码提示 (encoded-prompt) 越狱评测只跑有害臂，把高拒绝率当安全；本文补跑良性臂后发现真正的指标是 harm gap。四个 7-8B 模型上，homoglyph 编码的有害提示拒绝率跨度仅 0.08，而同样请求的明文跨度 0.57；某模型 harm gap 从明文 +0.82 跌到恰好 0.00，只读有害臂的基准会把它与仍保有 +0.61 gap 的模型判为同分。
Motivation: 编码提示攻击基准只报告模型对混淆有害请求的顺从率，高拒绝率既可能来自真正识别危害，也可能来自模型不再区分请求内容，安全结论无法归因。
Method: 把良性请求经同一编码变换后与有害臂配对，测 harm gap（有害与良性拒绝率之差）；跨三个基座家族、四种后训练配方的四个 7-8B 模型，补跑基准遗漏的对照格（明文内容套攻击模板、无混淆），并在完整 SFT→DPO→RLVR 流水线上跟踪指标。
Result: homoglyph 编码有害提示的拒绝率在四模型间跨度 0.08，同请求明文跨度 0.57；某模型 harm gap 由明文 +0.82 降至编码下恰好 0.00，而只读有害臂的基准对它与保有 +0.61 gap 的模型打分相同。补跑的对照格显示四模型中两个的损失源于评测协议而非字符变换，第三个源于字符本身。SFT→DPO→RLVR 全流程中 harm gap 上升 +0.26（配对区间不含零），标准有害臂指标却显示无变化。报告 12 项仪器缺陷及各自检出对照，其中二元 jailbreak 判官对明文良性提示响应有 0.61–0.70 触发，6/12 项会抬高表面安全性。
Conclusion: 编码提示评测必须同时报告良性臂与 harm gap，只读有害臂的高拒绝率可能度量的是协议失效而非安全；6/12 项缺陷的偏差方向正是安全评测默认失效的方向。

papers.title: Aftab: A Progressive Design Study of Visual Encoders and Value Estimation for Replay-Free Parallelized Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Replay-free parallelized Q-learning removes the large experience replay buffers and target networks used by conventional deep Q-learning, but the role of network architecture in this training regime remains comparatively underexplored. We investigate this question through a progressive three-phase study within the Parallelized Q-Network (PQN) framework. First, we compare eight convolutional encoder topologies on Atari-57 under a common training protocol while jointly considering performance and computational complexity. Second, we integrate Hadamax-style multiplicative feature interactions and explicit pooling into the selected encoder hierarchy. Third, with the visual representation fixed, we compare complete categorical-dueling, ensemble-dueling, and categorical ensemble-dueling value-estimation configurations. The resulting architecture, Aftab, achieves an interquartile mean human-normalized score of $6.592$ on Atari-57, compared with $2.715$ for our independently rerun PQN reference, with a game-level Probability of Improvement of $0.86$. After completing all architecture selection on Atari-57, we evaluate Aftab on Procgen Hard. Aftab achieves a terminal IQM normalized score of $0.418$ compared with $0.382$ for PQN and increases the normalized area under the learning curve from $0.216$ to $0.541$, although terminal performance remains heterogeneous across environments. These results show that visual topology, multiplicative representation, and downstream value-estimation design can substantially affect replay-free Q-learning, and that their benefits should be evaluated jointly with computational complexity. The complete Aftab framework, including model definitions, training configurations, reproducibility settings, and raw experimental logs, is open-sourced at https://github.com/tahashieenavaz/aftab
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无经验回放的并行 Q 学习 (PQN) 框架内做三阶段渐进式架构设计研究，最终得到 Aftab：Atari-57 上人类归一化 IQM 达 6.592（自复现 PQN 参照 2.715），游戏级 Probability of Improvement 0.86；迁移到 Procgen Hard 后终端 IQM 归一化分 0.418（PQN 0.382），学习曲线归一化 AUC 从 0.216 提到 0.541。结论是视觉编码器拓扑、乘性特征交互与下游价值估计设计需连同计算复杂度一起联合评估。
Motivation: 无回放、无目标网络的并行 Q 学习已去掉大容量经验池，但网络架构在这一训练机制中的作用研究不足，架构选择与计算复杂度的权衡缺少系统对照。
Method: 在 PQN 框架内做三阶段渐进设计研究：先在统一训练协议下比较 Atari-57 上八种卷积编码器拓扑并同时权衡性能与计算复杂度；再在选定层级中加入 Hadamax 式乘性特征交互与显式池化；最后固定视觉表示，比较 categorical-dueling、ensemble-dueling 与 categorical ensemble-dueling 三种完整价值估计配置。

Conclusion: 视觉拓扑、乘性表示与价值估计设计会显著左右无回放 Q 学习的效果，且收益必须与计算复杂度一起评估；完整框架（模型定义、训练配置、复现设置与原始日志）已在 GitHub 开源。

papers.title: Multiscale Reward Hedging from Correct Demonstrations
papers.abstract_en: Learning from correct demonstrations is harder than supervised learning when many answers are correct: after predicting, the learner sees one valid answer but not whether its own answer was valid, nor any reward. Existing reward-hedging guarantees consequently assume a finite reward class. We give the first horizon-free guarantee for continuous classes. The key is to hedge in one shared vote over tolerant optimality tests at every accuracy scale. A target reward has one surviving proxy per scale, and a prediction with gap above that scale doubles the proxy. This yields the simultaneous tail bound $|\{t:\ell_t>2^{-j}\}|\leq \log_2\mathcal N(\mathcal G,2^{-j-1})+j$, where $\mathcal G$ is the class of optimality-gap functions. Integrating the tails gives cumulative hidden gap bounded by a metric-entropy integral, independently of the number of rounds. Polynomial entropy $(A/ε)^d$ gives $O(d\log A)$ total gap and a fast $O(d/m)$ statistical rate. For bounded linear contextual recommendation, the result is $O(d)$ regret for arbitrary compact menus. This is the first polynomial finite bound without structural restrictions on the menus, at the price of improper prediction. Although the general vote can be expensive, it is exactly polynomial-time for one-dimensional Lipschitz parameter curves. Fixed-radius rank-two recommendation takes $O(KT^2)$ time for menus of size $K$. We also prove an $Ω(d)$ lower bound, low-rank and bounded ReLU-network corollaries, and a robust theorem that adds only the demonstrator's cumulative suboptimality. A reproducible adaptive stress test illustrates the predicted scale adaptation. After factorization, an exact MovieLens audit runs in 1.7 CPU seconds across ten users and improves mean latent gap over both a demonstrated-rating policy and a proper online baseline. The learner uses only action demonstrations and never observes a reward or a loss.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能看到示范者正确答案、看不到自身答案是否正确也无奖励的设定下，本文给出连续 reward class 的首个 horizon-free 保证：在每个精度尺度上共享一次对容忍性最优检验的投票，尺度上留下的代理被 gap 超过该尺度的预测翻倍，得到尾界 |{t: ℓ_t>2^{-j}}| ≤ log_2 N(G,2^{-j-1})+j，积分后累计隐藏 gap 只由 metric-entropy 积分界定、与轮数无关。多项式熵 (A/ε)^d 给出 O(d log A) 总 gap 与 O(d/m) 速率，线性上下文推荐在任意紧菜单上 O(d) regret（以 improper prediction 为代价），并配 Ω(d) 下界。
Motivation: 从正确示范学习时，学习者预测后只见到一个合法答案，既不知道自己是否答对也拿不到奖励；已有 reward-hedging 保证都要求 reward class 有限，连续情形缺少与轮数无关的界。
Method: 在每个精度尺度上对容忍性最优检验 (tolerant optimality tests) 做一次共享投票，目标 reward 每尺度留一个存活代理，gap 超过该尺度的预测使代理翻倍；对最优性 gap 函数类 G 的尾界逐尺度积分得到 metric-entropy 积分界。另给出一维 Lipschitz 参数曲线上投票可多项式时间求解、固定半径 rank-two 推荐 O(KT^2) 时间（菜单大小 K），以及低秩、有界 ReLU 网络推论与只加示范者累计次优性的鲁棒版本。
Result: 尾界 |{t: ℓ_t>2^{-j}}| ≤ log_2 N(G,2^{-j-1})+j，累计隐藏 gap 与轮数无关；多项式熵 (A/ε)^d 给出 O(d log A) 总 gap 与 O(d/m) 统计速率；有界线性上下文推荐在任意紧菜单上 O(d) regret，为首个无菜单结构限制的多项式有限界；Ω(d) 下界；MovieLens 精确审计在 10 个用户上 1.7 CPU 秒完成，平均 latent gap 同时优于示范者打分策略与 proper online 基线；另有一个可复现自适应压力测试展示尺度自适应。
Conclusion: 把 hedging 收敛到跨尺度共享的一次投票，就能在连续 reward class 上得到与轮数无关的保证，并让线性上下文推荐在任意紧菜单上达到 O(d) regret，代价是预测为 improper；投票在一般情形可能昂贵，但在一维 Lipschitz 曲线上恰好多项式可解。

papers.title: Q-CueGraph: Query-Conditioned Visual Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can miss fine details in a full image that they recognize in a closer view. Recovering this evidence requires deciding where to look and how much surrounding context to retain. We present Q-CueGraph, a query-conditioned evidence acquisition method for frozen MLLMs. For text-rich images, it builds a reusable graph of OCR lines and layout relations. Each question activates anchors, expands them into contextual regions, and selects candidates for a single observation window. Query-conditioned object detections support natural-image search through the same region-selection and composition interface. A lightweight candidate scorer further learns which observations support correct answers from frozen-reader feedback and training answers, without evidence-box supervision. Across six benchmarks, we examine the roles of query conditioning, evidence composition, and learned answerability. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Q-CueGraph raises V*Bench accuracy from 0.696 to 0.832 using 19.1% of source-image area, and retains 92% of full-image ANLS on InfographicVQA using about half the image area. The analyses show that useful evidence depends on both its relevance to the question and the context available to the reader. Q-CueGraph makes these choices explicit before answer generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Q-CueGraph 为冻结的 MLLM 提出查询条件化的证据获取方法：对文字图像预建 OCR 行与版面关系图，按问题激活锚点、扩展上下文区域并选出单一观察窗口，再用轻量候选打分器依据冻结阅读器反馈学习可答性。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，V*Bench 准确率从 0.696 提到 0.832，仅用源图 19.1% 面积；InfographicVQA 上以约一半图像面积保留全图 ANLS 的 92%。
Motivation: MLLM 在全图视图下会漏掉近看才能识别的细节，而决定看哪里、保留多少上下文本身缺乏显式机制。
Method: 对文字图像构建可复用的 OCR 行与版面关系图，问题激活锚点后扩展为上下文区域并选出单一观察窗口；自然图像用查询条件化目标检测走同一区域选择与组合接口；轻量候选打分器从冻结阅读器反馈与训练答案学习哪些观察支撑正确答案，无需 evidence-box 监督。
Result: 在六个基准上检验查询条件化、证据组合与学习到的可答性的作用。Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上 V*Bench 准确率 0.696 → 0.832，仅用源图 19.1% 面积；InfographicVQA 上用约一半图像面积保留全图 ANLS 的 92%。
Conclusion: 有用证据同时取决于与问题的相关性和阅读器可用的上下文，Q-CueGraph 把这两项选择在答案生成前显式化。

papers.title: TARL: Transaction-Aware Reliable Ledgers for Executable Memory Management in Long-Term Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory helps long-term agents retain knowledge, yet a single update error can repeatedly distort future retrieval and reasoning. Most existing systems reduce memory updating to a binary Write/Hold decision, which cannot distinguish whether new information should be added, ignored, used to revise an outdated belief, rejected as unreliable, or deferred for verification. These choices may share the same binary label while producing fundamentally different memory states. We introduce TARL, a memory state update framework that maps each statement to one of five executable actions. TARL identifies the affected memory, resolves its temporal scope, compares source reliability, and updates accepted, pending, and rejected ledgers. It is further trained by comparing the memory states produced by alternative update operations, encouraging the model to select the operation that leads to the correct result. We also introduce TARL-Mem, a benchmark with fine-grained action labels and next-state targets. Across in-domain, cross-source, temporal, counterfactual, and sequential evaluations, TARL improves action prediction and state recovery, reduces memory pollution, preserves conflicting evidence, and limits cumulative corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TARL 把长期智能体的记忆更新从二元 Write/Hold 判定改为五类可执行动作（加入、忽略、修订过时信念、判为不可靠、延后待验证），并维护 accepted、pending、rejected 三本 ledger。训练时比较不同更新操作产生的记忆状态，促使模型选中能导向正确状态的操作；在 in-domain、cross-source、temporal、counterfactual、sequential 五类评测上提升动作预测与状态恢复，减少记忆污染并限制累积损坏。
Motivation: 长期智能体的持久记忆中一次更新错误会反复扭曲后续检索与推理；现有系统把更新压成二元 Write/Hold，无法区分语义上截然不同却共享同一标签的更新，导致记忆状态出错。
Method: TARL 对每条陈述定位受影响的记忆、解析其时间作用域、比较来源可靠性，再写入 accepted/pending/rejected 三本 ledger，输出五类可执行动作之一；训练阶段比较备选更新操作产生的记忆状态，鼓励模型选择导向正确结果的操作。配套发布细粒度动作标签与 next-state 目标的基准 TARL-Mem。
Result: 在 TARL-Mem 的 in-domain、cross-source、temporal、counterfactual、sequential 五类评测上，TARL 改善动作预测与状态恢复，减少记忆污染 (memory pollution)，保留冲突证据，并限制累积损坏 (cumulative corruption)。
Conclusion: 把记忆更新建模为带状态校验的多类可执行操作而非二元判定，能抑制长期智能体中错误更新的反复传播与累积污染。

papers.title: Wiring Beats Blending: Structure-Aware Compensation for Transformer Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Model families are trained size by size. Can a pretrained large model instead be converted into a smaller sibling? We study the 1.4B->410M conversion in Pythia end to end. Representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84); parameters align weakly. Dense weight projection is destructive; a bit-exact control places the fault in basis mixing, which breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure. Residuals after the best-fit linear operator carry no learnable or transferable signal under shuffle controls, so conversion value lives in initialization. Matched-budget continued pre-training separates two independent levers: least-squares compensation (function lever, best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics lever, best endpoints). Placement follows the architecture: compensation is well-posed exactly where no normalization sits between cut and read; norm-fronted paths take rescale. Compensation is a low-budget, token-efficiency win, not a universal one. At 30M tokens it beats the best subcloning variant on a width-reduced pair (84.0+-1.8 vs. 89.7+-3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds). Selection given the same activation statistics recovers under half of that gap (3/3 seeds): the gain is the re-fit, not the information. At 33x the budget the two reach parity (40.3+-0.3 vs. 40.3+-0.5, 3 seeds), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer always beats (up to 18x at low budget, narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale). At ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, consistent with an ill-conditioned compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as a fix. The init also beats structured pruning plus distillation, the standard pipeline, at matched budget, and improves further combined with it. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen eval corpus are released.

TL;DR: 把 Pythia 1.4B 直接转成 410M 小模型时，稠密权重投影会破坏 rotary、per-head、GELU 与 LayerNorm 结构而失效；改用结构感知的最小二乘补偿 (least-squares compensation) 加保方差重缩放 (variance-preserving rescale) 两个独立杠杆做初始化，在 30M token 低预算下 84.0±1.8 对 89.7±3.7、深度缩减对 109.3 对 117.9 胜过最佳 subcloning 变体，33 倍预算后两者打平 (40.3±0.3 对 40.3±0.5)。
Motivation: 模型家族逐个尺寸训练，能否把已预训练大模型直接转成小一号的兄弟模型尚不清楚；稠密权重投影被证明是破坏性的，需要定位失败原因并找到低预算下有效的转换路径。
Method: 在 Pythia 上端到端研究 1.4B→410M 转换：用 bit-exact control 把投影失败定位到 basis mixing，用 shuffle control 检验线性算子残差是否含可迁移信号；以 matched-budget 继续预训练分离最小二乘补偿（function lever）与保方差重缩放（dynamics lever），并做 information-matched selection control、LayerNorm/结构分解与 3-seed 蒸馏对比。
Result: 跨尺寸表征对齐强 (ridge R²=0.84) 而参数对齐弱；30M token 下补偿胜过最佳 subcloning 变体：宽度缩减对 84.0±1.8 vs 89.7±3.7、留出深度缩减对 109.3 vs 117.9，均 3/3 seeds；同激活统计的选择控制只追回不到一半差距 (3/3 seeds)；33x 预算下两者持平 (40.3±0.3 vs 40.3±0.5, 3 seeds)，且都远胜 from-scratch，transfer 最多快 18x；约 5x 捐献者规模 (6.9B→1.4B) 时两杠杆叠加过度校正；同预算下初始化胜过 structured pruning + distillation，与之叠加还能再提升。
Conclusion: 转换价值存在于初始化而非残差中的新信息，补偿是低预算、token 效率型收益而非普适收益；补偿只在切点与读取点之间无归一化时适定，norm-fronted 路径改用重缩放，大宽度下需按维度做正则化以避免过度校正。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Chart-Supported or Model-Supplied? Examining MLLM-Generated Claims for Accessible Visualization
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can connect visualization patterns to external causes, consequences, and domain knowledge, but the evidential basis of these interpretations is often unclear. We present an exploratory study of 102 visualizations from four sources, three MLLMs, and four input conditions that vary access to the image, accessible chart context (non-image artifacts such as data tables, captions, alt text, and screen-reader structures), and withheld-context framing. Across 1,224 descriptions, we analyze model-attributed DIRECT, DERIVED, and SPECULATIVE labels and conduct an automated audit of numeric agreement. Accessible chart context shifted Gemini and GPT toward DIRECT claims and improved numeric agreement for some models. Adding the image to the full context did not yield a consistent numeric benefit, and the withheld-context prompt did not reliably increase cautious language. The prompt-defined Real-World Significance section remained predominantly SPECULATIVE. These results motivate accessible description systems that distinguish claims supported by supplied evidence from model-supplied interpretation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 102 个可视化、3 个 MLLM、4 种输入条件共 1,224 条描述做探索性研究，检验 MLLM 生成的断言究竟由图表证据支撑还是模型自行补全。提供可访问图表上下文（数据表、caption、alt text、屏幕阅读器结构）使 Gemini 与 GPT 更多给出 DIRECT 断言并改善部分模型的数值一致性，而加入图像未带来一致的数值收益，Real-World Significance 段落仍以 SPECULATIVE 为主。
Motivation: MLLM 能把可视化模式连到外部成因与领域知识，但这些解读的证据基础不清晰，可访问描述系统难以区分有据断言与模型自行补全的解释。
Method: 探索性研究覆盖 102 个可视化（来自四个来源）、3 个 MLLM、4 种输入条件（改变图像、可访问图表上下文、扣留上下文 framing 的可得性），共 1,224 条描述；对模型自标的 DIRECT、DERIVED、SPECULATIVE 标签做分析，并做数值一致性的自动化审计。
Result: 可访问图表上下文使 Gemini 与 GPT 更倾向 DIRECT 断言，并在部分模型上改善数值一致性；在完整上下文上再加图像未带来一致的数值收益；扣留上下文的 prompt 未可靠增加谨慎措辞；prompt 定义的 Real-World Significance 段落仍以 SPECULATIVE 为主。
Conclusion: 可访问描述系统应区分由所提供证据支撑的断言与模型自行补全的解释，仅靠图像或扣留上下文的 prompt 不足以让数值更准或措辞更谨慎。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
papers.abstract_en: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific machine learning. In these methods, a neural network is trained to approximate the PDE solution by using (stochastic) gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual of the neural network. Due to the non-convexity of the PDE residual objective function, the trained neural network may, in principle, only converge to a local minimizer of the objective function (which would not be a solution of the PDE). Therefore, there is a longstanding question regarding the mathematical foundations of these algorithms, and it is highly valuable to establish that the trained neural network will converge to the PDE solution. In this paper, we consider a class of semilinear PDEs with nonlinearities in the solution and its first derivative. For this class of PDEs, we prove that neural networks trained with gradient descent to minimize the PDE residual objective function will converge to the PDE solution as the network width and training time $\rightarrow \infty$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对含解及其一阶导数非线性的半线性 PDE，证明用梯度下降最小化 PDE 残差目标训练的 DGM 与 PINN 神经网络，当网络宽度与训练时间趋于无穷时收敛到 PDE 真解，而非停留在非凸目标的局部极小点。
Motivation: PDE 残差目标非凸，梯度下降原则上只收敛到局部极小（那不是 PDE 解），DGM/PINN 广泛使用却缺少数学基础，需要给出收敛到真解的保证。
Method: 研究对象为 Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) 与 Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINN)：神经网络用（随机）梯度下降最小化 PDE 残差目标；在解及其一阶导数含非线性的半线性 PDE 类上做收敛性证明，取网络宽度与训练时间趋于无穷的极限。
Result: 证明了对该类半线性 PDE，梯度下降训练的网络收敛到 PDE 解（宽度与训练时间 → ∞）；摘要给出的是理论收敛结论，无实验数值。
Conclusion: 在该半线性 PDE 类与宽度/时间无穷极限下，非凸残差目标不会把 DGM/PINN 卡在局部极小，训练结果就是 PDE 解。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: No Free Lunch in Flow Surrogates under Time-Varying Boundary Conditions: A Two-Regime Study
papers.abstract_en: We test whether an architecture that succeeds on a simple flow regime also succeeds on a richer one, with each trained separately on each regime. We explore two transient flows under time-varying boundary conditions: the three-dimensional slurry film in chemical-mechanical planarisation (CMP), central to semiconductor manufacturing, and the two-dimensional Kármán vortex street (KVS). Eight surrogate models on one shared pipeline differ in whether they learn the full field or a latent representation, and in whether they predict in one shot or step by step. No single architecture wins both regimes. On the film, a one-shot full-field model reconstructs the cumulative wall shear stress to 2.7% relative error. On the wake, a latent autoregressive DeepONet retains 90% of the shedding power that direct and one-shot models damp to almost zero. The treatment of time decides the outcome. The self-sustained wake calls for autoregressive feedback and the boundary-driven film for a direct map. Pointwise RMSE hides the damped oscillation on the wake, compresses the sixfold lead on the film's process target, and picks the damped model under wake extrapolation. The evaluation scores five physical questions. Trained surrogates answer queries 10^3 to 10^4 times faster than the finite-element solver and pay off from the first query beyond the training set on the film and from the third on the wake. Neither the winning architecture nor its validation holds across regimes. The choice of surrogate should follow the dynamical character of the target flow, and its validation should resolve the failure modes.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 12 figures. v2: revised version, under review at Journal of Computational Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在时变边界条件下对比八个流体代理模型，发现没有单一架构同时赢下两个流态：CMP 三次流薄膜用一次性全场模型把累积壁面切应力重建到 2.7% 相对误差，而 Kármán 涡街用潜空间自回归 DeepONet 保留 90% 的脱落功率，直接与一次性模型把它衰减到几乎为零。决定成败的是时间处理方式——自维持尾迹要自回归反馈，边界驱动薄膜要直接映射；逐点 RMSE 会掩盖尾迹的衰减振荡、压缩薄膜工艺目标上六倍的领先，并在外推时选中已衰减的模型。
Motivation: 在简单流态上训练成功的代理架构，能否迁移到更丰富的流态，此前缺少系统检验；而常用的逐点 RMSE 会掩盖自激振荡被衰减这类失效模式，导致模型选择出错。
Method: 在同一条流水线上比较八个代理模型，按两个维度区分：学习全场还是潜表示，以及一次性预测还是逐步（自回归）预测；每个模型在两个流态上分别独立训练——三维化学机械抛光 (CMP) 浆料薄膜与二维 Kármán 涡街 (KVS)，均含时变边界条件。评估用五个物理问题打分，除逐点 RMSE 外还考察累积壁面切应力与脱落功率谱等过程量。
Result: 薄膜上一次性全场模型把累积壁面切应力重建到 2.7% 相对误差；尾迹上潜空间自回归 DeepONet 保留 90% 的脱落功率，而直接与一次性模型把它衰减到几乎为零。代理比有限元求解器快 10^3 至 10^4 倍，薄膜上从训练集之外的第一次查询、尾迹上从第三次查询即回本。逐点 RMSE 在尾迹外推时选中已衰减的模型，并把薄膜工艺目标上六倍的领先压缩掉。
Conclusion: 代理架构的选择应跟随目标流的动态特性（自维持尾迹用自回归、边界驱动薄膜用直接映射），且验证必须能分辨具体失效模式；胜出架构及其验证结论都不跨流态成立。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Multi-level Information Integration Framework for Physically Verifiable Fault Diagnosis of Rotating Machinery
papers.abstract_en: Integrating multi-level information, from physical models through data-driven diagnostics to natural language reasoning, into verifiable decision chains is a growing need in intelligent manufacturing. In bearing fault diagnosis, taken here as a representative testbed, the standard output is a class label and a confidence score derived from the classifier's own distribution, offering limited means of comparison against independent physical knowledge. Meanwhile, language models increasingly used for maintenance communication may introduce unsupported content. This work addresses both limitations from the output side. The proposed Diagnostic Evidence Network (DENet) is an encoder-agnostic multi-task framework that extends the output to a structured evidence record: the classification, a predicted characteristic frequency comparable against the theoretical value determined by bearing geometry and shaft speed, and a temporal localization of transient impulses inspectable on the raw waveform. Across four encoders and three public datasets, this evidence incurs no statistically significant accuracy cost, with a frequency error of about 6 Hz on 1,024-point segments. The deviation between predicted and theoretical frequency constitutes a label-free, inference-time validation signal. It detects misclassifications with AUROC of 0.970 and 0.871, and retains separation within the high-confidence subset. Finally, a QLoRA-adapted language model renders DENet's evidence into traceable maintenance reports without contributing diagnostic decisions, reducing unsupported-claim rates from 10-12% to 2% with no fabricated quantities observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Diagnostic Evidence Network (DENet)，把轴承故障诊断的输出从单一类别标签扩展为结构化证据记录：分类结果、可与轴承几何和转速推出的理论特征频率对比的预测频率、以及可在原始波形上核验的瞬态冲击时间定位。在 4 个编码器与 3 个公开数据集上，该证据不带来统计显著的精度损失，1024 点片段的频率误差约 6 Hz；预测与理论频率之差作为免标签的推理时校验信号，检测误分类的 AUROC 达 0.970 与 0.871，且在高置信子集内仍保持区分度。QLoRA 适配的语言模型只负责把证据渲染成可追溯维护报告，把无支撑断言率从 10-12% 降到 2%，未观察到编造数值。
Motivation: 轴承故障诊断的标准输出只有分类器自身分布给出的类别与置信度，难以与独立物理知识对照；同时用于维护沟通的语言模型可能产生无支撑内容。
Method: DENet 是编码器无关的多任务框架，在分类之外并行输出预测特征频率与瞬态冲击的时间定位，形成可核验的证据记录；预测频率与由轴承几何、转速决定的理论值比较，构成免标签的推理时验证信号。再用 QLoRA 适配语言模型，把证据渲染成可追溯维护报告，且不让语言模型参与诊断决策。
Result: 在 4 个编码器与 3 个公开数据集上，证据记录不带来统计显著的精度代价；1024 点片段的频率误差约 6 Hz。预测与理论频率偏差检测误分类的 AUROC 为 0.970 与 0.871，并在高置信子集内保持分离。QLoRA 报告生成把无支撑断言率从 10-12% 降到 2%，未观察到编造数值。
Conclusion: 把物理可核验的频率与时间定位证据放进诊断输出，可以在不损失精度的前提下提供免标签的推理时校验，并让语言模型只做报告渲染而不引入无支撑内容。

papers.title: Cryptographically verifiable authorization for autonomous AI agents: a falsifiable hypothesis and proof of concept
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents increasingly execute actions, invoke tools, and operate on protected resources with limited human oversight. Existing authentication and authorization mechanisms establish identity and delegate authority but do not inherently provide cryptographic evidence that a concrete request issued by a specific agent satisfies the applicable policy in a specific execution context. This study hypothesizes that agent authorization can be formalized as a cryptographically verifiable relation, denoted $R_{CVA}$, that jointly binds an agent principal, a concrete authorization request, an execution context, and the satisfaction of an applicable policy, while selectively preserving the confidentiality of private authorization attributes. We introduce a preliminary formal abstraction for Cryptographically Verifiable Agent Authorization (CVA), define a compact set of candidate security properties including authorization soundness, principal binding, request binding, policy binding, and replay resistance, and provide an executable zero-knowledge proof of concept that instantiates selected elements of the model over a Groth16 zk-SNARK construction. We further identify and formalize the structural separation among identity binding, authorization-request binding, and runtime execution binding as a central open problem in the design of secure agentic systems, a distinction to our knowledge, has not been formalized within a cryptographically verifiable authorization relation by current agentic security frameworks, and present a falsifiable research agenda for its resolution.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Author version (v3) of the article published in Frontiers in Computer Science 8:1966725 (2026). Keywords: access control, agentic security, autonomous AI agents, cryptographic authorization, cryptographic protocols, verifiable authorization, zero-knowledge proofs, zk-SNARKs

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可密码学验证的智能体授权关系 R_CVA，把 agent 主体、具体授权请求、执行上下文与策略满足情况绑定在一个关系里，同时选择性隐藏私有授权属性。给出 CVA 形式抽象、五条候选安全性质（authorization soundness、principal binding、request binding、policy binding、replay resistance），并用 Groth16 zk-SNARK 做可执行零知识证明概念验证。
Motivation: 现有认证授权机制只建立身份并委派权限，不提供密码学证据证明某 agent 在特定执行上下文中发出的具体请求确实满足适用策略；身份绑定、请求绑定与运行时执行绑定的结构性分离在现有 agentic 安全框架中尚未被形式化。
Method: 定义 CVA 形式抽象与关系 R_CVA，配套一组候选安全性质；在 Groth16 zk-SNARK 构造上实现可执行零知识证明概念验证，实例化模型选定要素；并给出关于三重绑定分离的可证伪研究议程。
Result: 提出并形式化 R_CVA 关系与五条候选安全性质，交付一个基于 Groth16 的可执行 zk-SNARK 概念验证，覆盖模型选定要素；作者主张三重绑定分离在其知识范围内未被当前 agentic 安全框架形式化。
Conclusion: agent 授权可被形式化为可密码学验证、可选择性保密的关系，而身份、请求与运行时执行三者的结构性分离是安全 agentic 系统设计的核心开放问题，需按可证伪议程推进。

papers.title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Joint Rank-bit Allocation
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference. Existing compression methods apply low-rank factorization or quantization independently, without jointly allocating rank and precision under a shared storage budget. We introduce JoLT, a training-free compressor that treats grouped prefill caches as fourth-order tensors and applies partial Tucker decomposition along the token and feature modes, the two axes that carry low-rank structure, while leaving the head and layer modes intact. A rotated low-bit quantizer captures the truncation residual, and a single Lagrangian dual allocates per-group Tucker ranks and residual bit-widths under a global byte constraint. FlashJoLT replaces the exact token-mode SVD with a randomized approximation that matches JoLT within the free zone at a fraction of the compression cost, and a fused Triton decode kernel evaluates attention directly over the stored factors without materializing dense KV tensors. Across five models from four architecture families, covering multi-head attention, grouped-query attention, and mixture-of-experts architecture, JoLT achieves 2 - 3x compression with less than 0.2% perplexity degradation, without retraining. On RULER at 64K context with LLaMA-3.1-8B, retrieval accuracy remains near-lossless through 3x and declines by only 0.90 and 2.40pp at 4x and 5x, respectively. JoLT demonstrates that tensor-aware low-rank decomposition and quantized residuals, unified under a single storage budget, achieve near-lossless KV-cache compression across diverse model architectures without retraining.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JoLT 把 KV cache 压缩从「先低秩、后量化」的独立决策改成共享字节预算下的联合分配：把 grouped prefill cache 视作四阶张量，只在 token 与 feature 两个模态做 partial Tucker 分解，head 与 layer 模态保持不动，残差交给旋转低比特量化器，再用单一 Lagrangian 对偶在全局字节约束下逐组分配 Tucker 秩与残差位宽。免重训下在四个架构族五个模型上达到 2–3 倍压缩且困惑度下降不到 0.2%；LLaMA-3.1-8B 在 RULER 64K 上检索精度到 3 倍压缩仍近无损，4 倍与 5 倍时仅分别下降 0.90 和 2.40 个百分点。
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV cache 是主要内存瓶颈，现有方法把低秩分解与量化分开做，没有在统一存储预算下联合决定秩与精度，导致预算分配次优。
Method: JoLT 是免训练压缩器：对 grouped prefill cache 建四阶张量，沿携带低秩结构的 token 与 feature 模态做 partial Tucker 分解，head/layer 模态不动；旋转低比特量化器编码截断残差；单一 Lagrangian 对偶在全局字节约束下联合求解每组 Tucker 秩与残差位宽。FlashJoLT 用随机化近似替代精确 token 模式 SVD，fused Triton decode kernel 直接在存储的因子上算 attention，不物化稠密 KV 张量。
Result: 在四个架构族五个模型（覆盖 MHA、GQA、MoE）上，2–3 倍压缩时困惑度退化小于 0.2%，无需重训。RULER 64K 上 LLaMA-3.1-8B 检索精度在 3 倍压缩下保持近无损，4 倍与 5 倍时分别仅下降 0.90pp 与 2.40pp。FlashJoLT 的随机化 SVD 在 free zone 内与 JoLT 精确 SVD 结果一致，压缩开销仅为一小部分。
Conclusion: 把张量感知的低秩分解与量化残差统一到单一存储预算下，可以在多种模型架构上免重训地实现近无损 KV cache 压缩；随机化近似与融合 decode kernel 让该方案在压缩成本和推理路径上都可落地。

papers.title: A hybrid analytical-PINN model for subsurface simulation of geothermal heat exchangers in heterogeneous underground
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient prediction of subsurface temperature fields is essential for the design and operation of borehole heat exchanger (BHE) systems. Here we develop a parametric hybrid analytical and physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework for long-term multi-BHE simulations in heterogeneous underground. The method analytically extracts the singular line source response and enables the effective training of neural correction associated with subsurface heterogeneity. An explicit parametrization of the thermal conductivity allows physics-informed learning of a single feedforward neural network to generalize across different subsurface conditions. By formulating the correction in borehole-centered relative coordinates, the learned correction can be reused as a universal corrector through spatial and temporal superposition principles. Numerical experiments based on the infinite line source (ILS), finite line source (FLS) and moving finite line source (MFLS) models show that the hybrid method outperforms analytical approximations with stable accuracy over long simulation horizons and achieves orders-of-magnitude speedups over traditional solvers. The proposed framework therefore combines the efficiency of analytical models with the ability of numerical methods to capture heterogeneous subsurface physics, providing a fast and accurate approach for repeated long-term simulation of multi-BHE systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出解析-PINN 混合框架用于非均匀地层中多钻孔地热换热器 (BHE) 的长期温度场模拟：解析提取奇异线源响应，单个前馈网络只学地层非均匀性的神经修正，并以热导率显式参数化实现跨工况泛化。修正定义在钻孔中心相对坐标下，可经时空叠加复用为通用修正子；数值实验显示其在长模拟时域上精度稳定、相对传统求解器有数量级加速。
Motivation: 地埋管换热器设计需要反复做长期多钻孔模拟，纯解析近似难以刻画非均匀地层，传统数值求解器又太慢，难以支撑重复调用。
Method: 混合参数化框架：解析部分提取奇异线源响应（基于 infinite line source、finite line source、moving finite line source 模型），神经部分用单个前馈网络学习地层非均匀性的修正，热导率作为显式参数输入以实现跨不同地下条件的物理信息学习；修正写在钻孔中心相对坐标中，借助时空叠加原理复用为通用修正子。
Result: 基于 ILS、FLS、MFLS 模型的数值实验表明，该混合方法优于解析近似，在长模拟时域上保持稳定精度，并相对传统求解器取得数量级 (orders-of-magnitude) 加速。
Conclusion: 把解析模型的效率与数值方法刻画非均匀地下物理的能力结合，可作为多 BHE 系统反复长期快速仿真的方案。

papers.title: Learning to Navigate with Minimal Parameters: Decomposing Visual Navigation Through Closed-Form Geometric Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Visual navigation policies have grown to hundreds of millions of parameters trained on billions of frames, with geometry, mapping, and control learned implicitly. We propose a decomposed point-goal navigation system in which operations with known closed-form structure, such as projective geometry, occupancy, and coordinate transforms, are computed analytically and serve as interfaces between three small learned modules: an egress predictor that grounds the episode goal as a local subgoal in the current view, a navigation predictor that estimates a goal-conditioned posterior over where trajectories travel, and an endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator that samples trajectory shapes from this posterior. Only 0.58M out of 23M parameters are trained, on 44k frames, in under one GPU-hour. Across 6060 point-goal episodes in 60 environments, the system attains competitive success rates with the lowest collision rate among evaluated methods. We further show that under this decomposition, the frozen image encoder can be replaced by a 0.54M MobileNetV2 at a -2.0 SR cost, bringing the full system under 1.2M parameters. It also transfers to no-goal exploration by retraining only the 123k-parameter egress head, and its failure modes under sensor corruption are transparent and analytically correctable. We deploy and evaluate the system zero-shot on a low-cost UGV, running navigation and localization on a Jetson Orin Nano in real-time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉导航中已知闭式结构的运算（投影几何、占据栅格、坐标变换）解析化，作为三个小学习模块之间的接口，只训练 23M 参数中的 0.58M。在 60 个环境的 6060 个 point-goal episode 上取得有竞争力的成功率且碰撞率最低，整机可压到 1.2M 参数以下并在 Jetson Orin Nano 上零样本实时部署。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航策略参数达数亿、训练用数十亿帧，几何、建图与控制全靠隐式学习，成本高且机制不透明。
Method: 分解式 point-goal 导航：闭式几何接口解析计算；三个小模块分别是 egress predictor（把目标落到当前视图的局部子目标）、navigation predictor（估计轨迹去向的目标条件后验）、endpoint-pinned residual diffusion generator（从该后验采样轨迹形状）。仅 0.58M 参数参与训练，用 44k 帧、不到 1 GPU 小时。
Result: 6060 个 point-goal episode、60 个环境下成功率有竞争力且碰撞率为所评方法中最低；冻结图像编码器可换成 0.54M 的 MobileNetV2，成功率代价 -2.0 SR，整机降到 1.2M 参数以下；no-goal 探索只需重训 123k 参数的 egress head；零样本部署到低成本 UGV，Jetson Orin Nano 上实时运行导航与定位。
Conclusion: 把闭式几何从学习中剥离后，导航系统可以用极小的训练参数量达到竞争性表现，且传感器损坏下的失效模式透明、可解析纠正。

papers.title: SOV-CAD: Stepwise Orthographic Views Guided CAD Modeling Sequence Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing Computer-Aided Design (CAD) modeling sequences from images is crucial for preserving design intent and supporting parametric editing. However, existing methods typically generate full CAD sequences holistically, overlooking the iterative, feedback-driven nature of human design workflows. We address this limitation by introducing the rich stepwise visual supervision: at each modeling step, the system observes the target's orthographic projections, the projections of the incrementally constructed model, and the active sketch, enabling informed action selection. To effectively leverage this on-the-fly feedback, we propose SOV-CAD, a framework that formulates CAD reconstruction as a sequential decision-making task and employs offline reinforcement learning with a Decision Transformer architecture. This design incorporates continuous visual feedback guided by geometric alignment rewards, resulting in a more accurate and human-like modeling process. Extensive experiments show that SOV-CAD surpasses state-of-the-art methods in CAD sequence reconstruction while exhibiting strong data efficiency. Code of SOV-CAD is available at: https://github.com/LukePhong/SOV-CAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOV-CAD 把图像到 CAD 建模序列的重建改写成序列决策问题：每一步同时看目标的正交视图、已建模型的增量投影和当前激活草图，用离线强化学习加 Decision Transformer 选动作，并以几何对齐奖励引入连续视觉反馈。作者称其在 CAD 序列重建上超过 SOTA 方法且数据效率强。
Motivation: 现有方法整体式地一次性生成完整 CAD 序列，忽略了人做设计时逐步试错、依赖反馈的迭代流程，导致重建过程不准确也不像人。
Method: 提出 SOV-CAD：以逐步正交视图 (stepwise orthographic views) 作监督，每步输入目标正交投影、当前已建模型投影与激活草图；把 CAD 重建形式化为序列决策任务，用离线强化学习配合 Decision Transformer 架构，奖励为几何对齐 (geometric alignment) 的连续视觉反馈。
Result: 在 CAD 序列重建上超过 state-of-the-art 方法，并表现出强数据效率；代码已开源（github.com/LukePhong/SOV-CAD）。
Conclusion: 逐步视觉反馈加离线 RL 的序列决策建模，能产生更准确、更接近人类的 CAD 建模过程，且在数据稀缺时仍有效。

papers.title: SechKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Hyperbolic Secant Functions
papers.abstract_en: In recent years KolmogorovArnold Networks KANs have attracted increasing attention due to their effectiveness in machine learning and scientific computing offering a new paradigm for neural network design In this paper we present SechKAN a novel KAN based on hyperbolic secant sech functions The hyperbolic secant basis is adopted for its smooth bellshaped form localized responses and wellbehaved gradients We employ a 1D linear projection to reduce the number of parameters allowing SechKAN to maintain a model size comparable to that of multilayer perceptrons MLPs Experimental results show the effectiveness of SechKAN on function fitting PDE surrogate modeling and image classification benchmarks including MNIST FashionMNIST CIFAR10 and CIFAR100 On function fitting SechKAN achieves performance comparable to both MLPs and representative KAN variants On PDE surrogate modeling it outperforms MLPs and achieves competitive or better performance than representative KAN variants On image classification benchmarks SechKAN achieves the best performance among the evaluated KAN variants while remaining competitive with MLPs using a comparable number of parameters However SechKAN still incurs higher computational cost than MLPs and some KAN variants Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/hoangthangta/All-KAN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SechKAN：以双曲正割 (sech) 函数为基的 Kolmogorov-Arnold Network，用 1D 线性投影压参数量使模型规模与 MLP 相当。在函数拟合、PDE 代理建模与 MNIST/FashionMNIST/CIFAR10/CIFAR100 图像分类上，PDE 代理优于 MLP，图像分类在所评估 KAN 变体中最好，但计算开销仍高于 MLP 和部分 KAN 变体。
Motivation: KAN 虽在科学计算中有效，但基函数与结构常带来参数量和计算开销偏高，需要在保持 KAN 表达力的同时把模型压到与 MLP 可比的规模。
Method: 以光滑钟形、响应局部化且梯度良好的 sech 基函数构建 KAN；用 1D 线性投影减少参数量，使 SechKAN 模型大小与 MLP 相当；在函数拟合、PDE 代理建模和图像分类三类基准上与 MLP 及代表性 KAN 变体对比，源码发布于 GitHub 仓库 All-KAN。
Result: 函数拟合上与 MLP 及代表性 KAN 变体相当；PDE 代理建模上优于 MLP，并达到或超过代表性 KAN 变体；在 MNIST、FashionMNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 上取得所评估 KAN 变体中最好的性能，同时以可比参数量与 MLP 竞争；计算成本仍高于 MLP 和部分 KAN 变体。
Conclusion: sech 基加 1D 线性投影能在参数量与 MLP 相当的前提下让 KAN 在 PDE 代理和图像分类上取得竞争力乃至领先，代价是计算开销仍高于 MLP。

papers.title: Breaking Failure Cascades: Step-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Medical Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models have shown great promise in clinical image reasoning, but existing post-training pipelines remain predominantly outcome-centric, relying on final answer correctness or sequence-level preferences. This suffers from sparse credit assignment, making it difficult to optimize the reasoning process essential for clinical applications. Our analysis reveals that cascading errors from early-stage reasoning failures are a leading cause of incorrect predictions in medical visual question answering (VQA) benchmarks. Motivated by this, we propose Medical Reasoning-aware Policy Optimization (MRPO), an RL algorithm that incorporates step-wise process rewards. When the final answer is incorrect, MRPO assigns exponentially larger penalties to tokens in earlier invalid reasoning steps, breaking failure cascades without compromising successful paths. Across four multimodal LLM backbones, MRPO consistently outperforms standard GRPO and a recent RL baseline, and on Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking even surpasses substantially larger medical MLLMs such as HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B by 4.59 points. Moreover, MRPO reduces early-stage reasoning failures from 58.6% to 13.4%, showing that targeted mitigation of cascading failures improves both reasoning quality and final answer accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/dmis-lab/MRPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 医疗多模态推理的后训练只看最终答案对错，信用分配稀疏，早期推理错误会级联成整题失败。MRPO 在答案错误时对更早的无效推理步 token 施加指数级更大的惩罚，答案正确则不动成功路径；在四个多模态 LLM 主干上一致超过 GRPO 与近期 RL 基线，Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 上比 HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 高 4.59 分，早期推理失败率从 58.6% 降到 13.4%。
Motivation: 现有后训练流程以结果为中心（最终答案正确性或序列级偏好），信用分配稀疏，难以优化临床应用所依赖的推理过程；作者分析发现早期推理失败的级联错误是医疗 VQA 基准预测出错的主因。
Method: 提出 Medical Reasoning-aware Policy Optimization (MRPO)：在 RL 中引入步级过程奖励 (step-wise process rewards)，当最终答案错误时对更早无效推理步的 token 施加指数级更大的惩罚，答案正确时不惩罚成功路径；在四个多模态 LLM 主干上与 GRPO 及近期 RL 基线对比。
Result: 在四个多模态 LLM 主干上 MRPO 一致优于标准 GRPO 与一个近期 RL 基线；在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 上超过规模大得多的医疗 MLLM HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 达 4.59 分；早期推理失败率由 58.6% 降至 13.4%。
Conclusion: 对级联失败做定向步级惩罚能同时提升推理质量与最终答案准确率，说明医疗多模态推理的后训练应从结果中心转向步级信用分配。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: All you need is log
papers.abstract_en: How different are several probability distributions from one another? For two distributions the standard answer is the family of Rényi divergences, singled out by two natural requirements: processing the data never makes distributions easier to tell apart, and independent repetitions add. Many problems in learning and statistics compare more than two distributions at once, such as testing among several hypotheses or bounding generalization against several priors. The same two requirements leave one kind of building block, built on a coincidence probability: how unlikely it is that independent samples, one from each distribution, all show the same empirical distribution. The logarithm is forced because repetitions add, which is already visible for a single experiment repeated. This characterization is known in greater generality, and this paper is about the meaning of its building blocks. On a finite alphabet, each building block indexed by a rational point of the simplex is the exponential rate of that coincidence as the samples grow in fixed proportions. Each is also the limiting free energy of Bayesian inference over distributions. At any amount of data, the free energy of the posterior is the coincidence measure plus two costs: the expected distance from a posterior draw to the most likely distribution, and the information gained per unit of data. Both costs vanish as data accumulate. When the comparison is conditioned on side information, every kind of building block has a conditional counterpart, and the coincidence ones alone do not suffice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Rényi 散度的两条公理（数据处理、独立重复可加）推广到多分布比较时，只剩一类以巧合概率为基础的 building block：独立同分布抽样恰好出现同一经验分布的概率。论文证明在有限字母表上，每个由单纯形有理点索引的 building block 就是该巧合概率随样本按固定比例增长时的指数速率，同时也是对分布做贝叶斯推断的极限自由能；在任意数据量下后验自由能等于巧合度量加两项代价（后验抽样到最可能分布的期望距离、单位数据获得的信息），两项都随数据积累而消失。
Motivation: 多分布比较（多假设检验、对多个先验界定泛化）无法直接套用两两 Rényi 散度，需要知道在同样两条公理下还剩下什么可加的度量构件及其含义。
Method: 沿用已知的更一般刻画，聚焦其 building block 的含义：在有限字母表上把每个构件表示为巧合概率的指数速率，并把它对应为贝叶斯推断的极限自由能，再对含边信息的条件化情形给出条件版本。
Result: 每个由单纯形有理点索引的 building block 是巧合概率在样本按固定比例增长时的指数速率，也是贝叶斯推断的极限自由能；任意数据量下后验自由能分解为巧合度量加两项代价，两项都随数据积累而趋于零；在含边信息的条件化下每类 building block 都有对应条件版本，而仅巧合类不足以支撑。
Conclusion: 对数形式由重复可加性唯一决定，多分布比较的可加构件由巧合概率统一给出其大样本速率与贝叶斯自由能含义；但一旦引入边信息，仅靠巧合类构件不够，需要全部构件的条件版本。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Answering Path Queries under Linear and Guarded Existential Rules
papers.abstract_en: Ontology-mediated query answering is concerned with the problem of answering queries over knowledge bases consisting of a database instance and an ontology. While most work in the area focuses on conjunctive queries (CQs), navigational queries have gained increasing attention. In this paper, we investigate the complexity of answering two-way (conjunctive) regular path queries ((C)RPQs) over knowledge bases whose ontology is given by a set of guarded existential rules. We first consider the subclass of linear existential rules and show that (C)RPQ answering is NL-complete in data complexity, which matches the data complexity of answering RPQs over plain graph databases (i.e., without an ontology). In combined complexity, both tasks are ExpTime-complete in the general case, but RPQ and CRPQ answering drop to PTime-complete and PSpace-complete respectively if there is a bound on predicate arity. For guarded rules, we provide a non-trivial reduction to the linear case, which allows us to show that the complexity of (C)RPQ answering is the same as for CQs, namely 2ExpTime-complete in combined complexity (ExpTime-complete in the bounded-arity case) and PTime-complete in data complexity.

papers.title: Analyzing Defensive Misdirection Against Model-Guided Automated Attacks on Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on language-model components to interpret instructions, process external data, invoke tools, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make prompt-injection and jailbreak attacks more consequential, especially as attackers adopt model-guided automation to scale probing, prompt refinement, and response evaluation. This work analyzes the resulting attack-defense setting through a probabilistic model of a target system, its defense mechanism, and the attacker's automated judge. Our analysis shows that conventional detect-and-block defenses can allow attacker success rate (ASR) to approach one as the query budget grows, since predictable refusals provide useful feedback to automated search. We then examine detect-and-misdirect, where detected malicious interactions receive controlled, non-operational responses designed to induce false-positive errors in the attacker's judge. This strategy reduces the positive predictive value of attacker-selected candidates and yields a bounded asymptotic ASR. We evaluate a proof-of-concept realization of this strategy through Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement (CMPE), a lightweight conversational misdirection method designed to replace predictable refusal text with safe but strategically misleading responses in automated jailbreak settings. On jailbreak benchmarks, CMPE reduces estimated ASR upper bounds by up to two orders of magnitude and nearly eliminates verified attack success in end-to-end experiments with PAIR, GPTFuzz, and AutoDAN-Turbo.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 42nd IEEE Annual Computer Security Applications Conference (ACSAC 2026). Keywords: agentic AI security, large language models, jailbreak attacks, prompt injection, cyber deception
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对模型引导的自动化越狱攻击，证明 detect-and-block 类防御在查询预算增长时攻击成功率 (ASR) 趋近于 1，因为可预测的拒绝文本给自动搜索提供了有效反馈；改用 detect-and-misdirect，对检出的恶意交互返回受控、非操作性的误导回复以污染攻击者 judge，可得到有界的渐近 ASR。概念验证方法 CMPE 在越狱基准上把估计 ASR 上界最多降低两个数量级，在 PAIR、GPTFuzz、AutoDAN-Turbo 端到端实验中几乎消除经验证的攻击成功。
Motivation: 攻击者用 LLM 自动化探测、改写提示与评估回复，使 prompt injection 与 jailbreak 可规模化；而可预测的 detect-and-block 拒绝恰好为这种自动搜索提供梯度式反馈，查询预算越大越容易被攻破。
Method: 先为目标系统、防御机制与攻击者自动 judge 建立概率模型，比较 detect-and-block 与 detect-and-misdirect 两种策略；再实现 CMPE (Contextual Misdirection via Progressive Engagement)，用轻量对话式误导回复替换可预测的拒绝文本，在自动化越狱场景中诱导攻击者 judge 出现假阳性。
Result: 模型分析显示 detect-and-block 下 ASR 随查询预算增长趋近于 1，detect-and-misdirect 则给出有界的渐近 ASR 并降低攻击者所选候选的正预测值 (PPV)；CMPE 在越狱基准上使估计 ASR 上界最多下降两个数量级，在 PAIR、GPTFuzz、AutoDAN-Turbo 的端到端实验中几乎消除经验证的攻击成功。
Conclusion: 对检出的恶意交互返回安全但策略性误导的回复，比直接拒绝更能阻断模型引导的自动化越狱搜索，因为可预测拒绝本身是攻击搜索的反馈信号。

papers.title: JoyAI-VL-Interaction: Real-Time Vision-Language Interaction Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Many moments in the real world do not wait for a user to ask. A fire starts on a security monitor, an expression flickers across a video call, or a product a viewer wants flashes by in a livestream. Yet today's large models remain mostly turn-based by design: they answer only when addressed, and even video-call apps that appear interactive still operate as question-answer systems, reacting only when polled or prompted. We argue for a different paradigm: a model that is present in the world like a person. It continuously watches what is happening now, decides on its own whether to speak or stay silent, interacts in real time, and delegates to a background model when the problem is hard. To advance interaction models and their adoption across domains, we make two fully open-sourced contributions. First, we release JoyAI-VL-Interaction, an 8B-scale, vision-first VL-interaction model. The model makes the response decision internally, choosing each second to stay silent, respond, or delegate to a background model, and it excels at vision-triggered responsiveness and time awareness. We pair it with a transferable training recipe, from which capabilities we never trained for emerge, such as guiding a shopper through changing app screens or improvising a lecture from a slide deck. Second, we release a complete, deployable system built around that model. The system streams any ongoing video into the model, making it genuinely present in the world. All other components are pluggable, including ASR/TTS modules, memory, visualization UI, and a background brain that can connect to any API or agent. Across six real-world scenarios, human raters prefer JoyAI-VL-Interaction over the in-app video-call assistants of Doubao and Gemini by a wide margin. To our knowledge, this is the first open, vision-driven interaction model released together with its training recipe, data, and complete deployable system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JoyAI-VL-Interaction 是一个 8B 视觉优先的实时交互模型，每秒内部决定保持沉默、回应或委托给后台模型，并配套可插拔的流式部署系统（ASR/TTS、记忆、后台 brain）。在六个真实场景的人类评分中，它以较大差距胜过 Doubao 与 Gemini 的应用内视频通话助手。
Motivation: 现有大模型按轮次设计，只在被提问时回答，视频通话助手也仍是问答系统，无法在事件发生当下主动响应。
Method: 开源 8B 视觉优先 VL-interaction 模型，逐秒做沉默/回应/委托三选一的内部决策；配套可迁移训练配方与完整可部署系统，将任意持续视频流接入模型，ASR/TTS、记忆、可视化 UI 与可连接任意 API/agent 的后台 brain 均可插拔。
Result: 在六个真实场景中，人类评分者对 JoyAI-VL-Interaction 的偏好以较大差距超过 Doubao 与 Gemini 的应用内视频通话助手；训练配方还涌现出未专门训练的能力，如跟随变化的 App 界面引导购物者、根据幻灯片即兴讲课。
Conclusion: 首个同时开源训练配方、数据与完整可部署系统的视觉驱动交互模型，证明逐秒自主决策加后台委托的范式可跨场景迁移。

papers.title: 3D Oral Modelling with Improved Vertex Distribution Using Matching-Based Learning
papers.abstract_en: In our previous work, a deep learning-based framework for 3D intraoral reconstruction was proposed. The model directly predicts explicit 3D point cloud coordinates from ten fixed-angle intraoral images, employing MobileNetV2 and Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion, with a combined L1 Loss and Chamfer Distance as the loss function. Although the model achieved an accuracy of 77.49%, predicted vertices tended to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, leaving other regions largely uncovered. In this paper, an improved loss function is proposed to address this limitation. Hungarian matching with filtering and Repulsion Loss are introduced to enforce more uniform vertex distribution across the reconstructed model. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 68.02%, which is numerically lower than the previous model. However, the vertex clustering issue observed in the prior work is substantially alleviated, with predicted vertices distributed more evenly across the entire reconstructed surface.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. English version of a paper presented at the Korea Multimedia Society Conference, November 2025. v2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 3D 口内重建中预测顶点向真值高密度区聚集、其他区域覆盖不足的问题，在原有 MobileNetV2 + Multi-head Attention 多视图融合与 L1 + Chamfer Distance 损失基础上，加入带过滤的 Hungarian matching 与 Repulsion Loss，强制顶点在重建表面更均匀分布。准确率从上一版 77.49% 降到 68.02%，但顶点聚集问题显著缓解，分布更均匀。
Motivation: 上一版深度学习口内重建模型直接从十张固定角度口内图像预测显式 3D 点云坐标，准确率 77.49%，但预测顶点集中在真值高密度区域，其余区域基本未被覆盖，表面重建不完整。
Method: 在原有框架（MobileNetV2 + Multi-head Attention 融合多视图特征，L1 Loss + Chamfer Distance 联合损失，输入十张固定角度口内图像直接回归 3D 点云坐标）之上，提出改进损失函数：引入带过滤的 Hungarian matching 建立预测顶点与真值的均匀对应，再加 Repulsion Loss 推开相邻顶点，抑制聚集。
Result: 提出的模型准确率为 68.02%，数值上低于上一版的 77.49%；但上一版的顶点聚集问题在新模型中显著缓解，预测顶点在重建表面整体分布更均匀。
Conclusion: 作者主张以牺牲部分数值准确率为代价，用 Hungarian matching + Repulsion Loss 换取更均匀的顶点覆盖，解决高密度区聚集导致的表面覆盖不全问题。

papers.title: Deep Learning-based 3D Oral Cavity Reconstruction Using 2D Intraoral Images
papers.abstract_en: Oral 3D modelling is one of the most essential stages in dentistry, and many different approaches, such as impression taking and intraoral scanning, are commonly used for this phase, each with notable limitations. Impression taking, which involves placing alginate or silicone material in a tray and inserting it into the patient's oral cavity to form a negative mold, suffers from significant patient discomfort, material deformation errors, and difficulties in storage and transportation. Intraoral scanners, which directly scan oral structures in real time using structured light or laser technology, produce state-of-the-art results but are associated with substantially high equipment costs. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a software-based approach that reconstructs a 3D oral model using only ten 2D intraoral images captured from different angles, requiring no dedicated hardware devices. The proposed method reduces cost, eliminates the need for physical scanning equipment, minimises patient discomfort, and enables automated 3D reconstruction. The model is trained on the publicly available Teeth3DS dataset, comprising 950 upper jaw samples, and employs MobileNetV2 as the image encoder combined with Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 77.49%, measured by nearest-neighbor matching with a distance threshold of 0.035. However, predicted vertices tend to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, resulting in uneven point distribution across the reconstructed model.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. English version of a paper presented at the Korea Multimedia Society Conference, November 2025. v2: single-column format
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 10 张不同角度的 2D 口内照片即可重建 3D 口腔模型，无需专用硬件：MobileNetV2 编码器加 Multi-head Attention 做多视图特征融合，在 Teeth3DS（950 个上颌样本）上训练，最近邻匹配准确率 77.49%（距离阈值 0.035）。预测顶点会向真值高密度区聚集，导致重建模型点分布不均。
Motivation: 取模有患者不适、材料形变与存储运输困难，口内扫描仪设备昂贵；希望用纯软件方案替代硬件扫描。
Method: 仅用 10 张不同角度 2D 口内图像，MobileNetV2 作图像编码器，Multi-head Attention 融合多视图特征，输出 3D 口腔模型；在公开 Teeth3DS 数据集（950 个上颌样本）上训练。
Result: 最近邻匹配准确率 77.49%（距离阈值 0.035）；预测顶点集中于真值高密度区域，重建模型点分布不均。
Conclusion: 纯软件多视图重建可免去专用扫描硬件并降低成本与不适，但点分布均匀性是当前主要短板。

papers.title: Planning Takes More Than Token Prediction: Causal Plan for Benchmarking and Building Physically Grounded Embodied Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning inadvertently favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track true causal dependencies, reducing complex physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. Hence, achieving genuine physical autonomy requires a fundamental shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite spanning four causal dimensions, curated via multi-stage verification. To endow models with this capability, a four-stage annotation pipeline extracts structured interaction records from egocentric videos to construct Causal-Plan-1M, a dense million-scale corpus of explicit causal reasoning traces. Extensive evaluation reveals a striking gap: leading models struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency -- even GPT-6-astra scores only 43.04. In contrast, our tailored training recipe enables Causal Planner to internalize the complex physical logic required for accurate next-state estimation. Built upon Qwen3-VL-8B, Causal Planner raises its backbone's score from 33.23 to 45.28, a 36.3% relative gain, and improves on three external benchmarks without benchmark-specific adaptation. We further observe an empirical Causal-Supervision Scaling Trend. Paired no-vision controls also reveal substantial visual dependence, while cross-judge comparisons and human scoring assess the reliability of automated evaluation. More importantly, we initiate the first effort to turn agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners, bridging language modeling and world modeling.

papers.title: A Unified Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDPs with fixed decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. MedGym models longitudinal patient evolution in a continuous-time framework and constructs a configurable medical RL benchmark from clinical data by using Physics-Informed Neural Networks. The resulting benchmark enables direct comparison between discrete-time and continuous-time methods under irregular treatment timing and patient-specific dynamics. Furthermore, MedGym supports evaluation from clinically important perspectives, such as personalization and trajectory-level safety. By providing a standardized and configurable benchmark for continuous-time dynamic treatment, MedGym enables more realistic and informative evaluation of medical RL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedGym 把动态治疗推荐 RL 从固定决策间隔的离散 MDP 换成连续时间框架，用 Physics-Informed Neural Networks 从临床数据构建可配置的医疗 RL 基准，使离散时间与连续时间方法能在不规则治疗时机和个体化动力学下直接对比，并按个性化与轨迹级安全两个临床视角评测。
Motivation: 现有 RL 公式与仿真环境都建立在固定决策间隔的离散 MDP 上，无法评估方法能否处理依赖时间间隔的疾病进展、个体化治疗反应，以及两次测量点之间的安全性。
Method: 以连续时间框架建模患者纵向演化，用 Physics-Informed Neural Networks 从临床数据构造可配置的 MedGym 基准环境，支持离散时间与连续时间方法在不规则治疗时机、患者特异动力学下的直接对比，并提供个性化与轨迹级安全等评测视角。
Result: 提出 MedGym 这一连续时间动态治疗推荐基准环境，可从临床数据配置生成，支持离散与连续时间方法对比及个性化、轨迹级安全评测。
Conclusion: 连续时间、可配置的基准能让医疗 RL 方法的评估更贴近真实临床设定，尤其是不规则测量与个体差异下的表现。

papers.title: Persona Prompting in Multimodal Urban Perception: Descriptive Convergence and Interpretive Variation
papers.abstract_en: This study examines how persona prompting shapes language generated by two multimodal large language models in urban perception, a setting for examining subjective interpretations of shared visual evidence. We organize outputs into three functional layers: descriptive grounding (captions), intermediate semantic layer (perception tags), and interpretive framing (justifications). Using approximately 60,000 persona-conditioned annotations from each of two MLLMs, Qwen3-VL and Gemma4, we find that captions converge strongly across persona profiles and show only small attribute-associated differences. Justifications vary substantially more: economic status produces the largest difference in both models, with political orientation and personality also prominent. Paired image-level comparisons confirm larger justification than caption differences for these three attributes. For perception tags, personas sharing the same attribute level produce more similar tag sets than personas with different attribute levels, with the largest separation observed for economic status. Exploratory topic analysis further suggests persona-specific evaluative emphasis. Across models, profile-pair similarity patterns are strongly correlated for all three output types, although agreement is lowest for justifications. Overall, persona prompting affects interpretive framing more strongly than descriptive grounding.
papers.journal_ref: EMNLP 2026 - Pandora
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在城市多模态感知任务中，persona prompting 对 MLLM 输出的影响随层级递增：约 6 万条 persona 条件标注显示，描述性 caption 在不同 persona 间高度收敛，而解释性 justification 差异显著，经济地位属性造成的差异最大，政治倾向与人格次之。结论是 persona 主要重塑解释框架而非描述性接地。
Motivation: 共享同一视觉证据时，persona prompting 对 MLLM 输出不同语义层级的影响程度尚不清楚，尤其缺少对描述、标签、解释三层的分离比较。
Method: 将 Qwen3-VL 与 Gemma4 各自生成的约 60,000 条 persona 条件标注组织为三层：描述性 caption、中间语义层 perception tags、解释性 justification；用配对图像级比较衡量 persona 属性差异，并做探索性主题分析与跨模型相似度相关。
Result: 两个模型中 caption 跨 persona 高度收敛、仅有小幅属性相关差异；justification 差异大得多，经济地位差异最大，政治倾向与人格次之，配对图像级比较确认这三属性的 justification 差异大于 caption 差异；同属性层级 persona 的 tag 集合更相似，经济地位分离最大；三类输出的 profile-pair 相似度模式跨模型强相关，但 justification 一致性最低。
Conclusion: persona prompting 对解释性 framing 的影响强于描述性 grounding，且该层级模式在 Qwen3-VL 与 Gemma4 间一致。

papers.title: A Multimodal 3D Foundation Model for Light Sheet Fluorescence Microscopy Enables Few-Shot Segmentation, Classification, and Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: Light sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSM) enables high-resolution, three-dimensional (3D) imaging of biological specimens, providing rich volumetric data for studying cellular organization, pathology, and vascular networks. However, the size, dimensionality, and annotation burden of LSM data make supervised deep learning approaches costly and difficult to scale. Additionally, despite the abundance of unannotated LSM volumes, foundation models for this modality remain underexplored due to computational challenges and the complexity of volumetric representation learning. In this work, we introduce a 3D foundation model for LSM data, pretrained on a large curated collection of 3D images spanning multiple organisms, stains, and imaging protocols. We learn transferable volumetric representations by jointly optimizing for masked reconstruction and image-text alignment. The pretrained backbone drastically reduces the annotation burden, enabling efficient, few-shot adaptation for varied downstream tasks. We evaluate this approach on downstream segmentation, classification, and deblurring. Our results demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, (1) when measured using standard evaluation metrics and (2) when rigorously assessed by domain experts. This highlights the potential of foundation model pretraining to reduce annotation requirements while improving performance across diverse LSM analysis tasks. Pretrained model weights and code for pretraining and finetuning are publicly available: https://github.com/AdinaScheinfeld/lsm_fm_public_repo.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向光片荧光显微镜 (LSM) 的多模态 3D 基础模型，在跨物种、染色与成像方案的 3D 图像集合上以掩码重建与图文对齐联合预训练，得到可迁移的体积表征。预训练骨干把下游分割、分类与去模糊的标注需求压到 few-shot 水平，并在标准指标与领域专家评审两方面一致优于基线。
Motivation: LSM 体积数据体量大、维度高、标注昂贵，监督深度学习难以扩展；该模态虽有大量未标注体数据，但受计算开销与体积表征学习复杂性制约，基础模型仍属空白。
Method: 在人工整理的多物种、多染色、多成像方案 3D 图像集合上预训练 3D 骨干，联合优化掩码重建 (masked reconstruction) 与图文对齐 (image-text alignment) 两项任务；预训练权重与预训练/微调代码开源，下游以 few-shot 方式适配分割、分类与去模糊。
Result: 在下游分割、分类与去模糊三类任务上相对基线取得一致改进，且改进同时经标准评估指标与领域专家严格评审两种方式确认；预训练大幅降低标注负担。
Conclusion: 基础模型预训练可在降低 LSM 标注需求的同时提升多类分析任务性能，few-shot 适配是该模态可行的落地路径。

papers.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: In multi-stage recommender systems, reranking optimizes overall utility by capturing intra-list contextual dependencies, yet its central challenge lies in exploring optimal sequences within an exponentially large permutation space. Recent studies have shifted towards end-to-end generative frameworks, which typically leverage list-wise rewards or preference alignment to guide generator training. However, these methods still face two critical issues. First is the heuristic label bias. Existing methods often construct training targets based on simple rules, such as promoting clicked items to the top, while ignoring causal dependencies within the list context. Second is the credit assignment problem. Sparse list-level posterior rewards fail to directly guide intermediate steps in sequence generation, leading to ambiguous optimization directions. To address these issues, we propose DeGRe (Dense-supervised Generative Reranking), a generative reranking framework that bridges the gap between offline exploration and online efficiency through dense supervision. The core of DeGRe lies in its offline-online decoupled design. During the offline phase, we introduce a Lookahead Evaluator based on cumulative regression, which leverages beam search to actively mine high-value lookahead sequences in the unexposed space. During training, we transform the step-wise value estimations from the evaluator into dense supervision signals and distill them into a lightweight Online Generator. This mechanism enables the generator to internalize lookahead planning capabilities, requiring only a single efficient greedy decoding pass during online inference to approximate the global optimum. Experiments demonstrate that DeGRe outperforms baseline models on public benchmarks and industrial datasets. We have successfully deployed DeGRe on Taobao Flash Shopping, significantly improving online recommendations.
papers.comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 ADS Track (Oral). Best Paper Award Honorable Mention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeGRe 用离线-在线解耦的稠密监督把重排 (reranking) 的序列规划蒸馏进轻量生成器：离线用基于累积回归的 Lookahead Evaluator 通过 beam search 在未曝光空间挖掘高价值前瞻序列，训练时把逐步价值估计转成稠密监督信号蒸馏给 Online Generator，在线只需一次贪心解码即可逼近全局最优。在公开 benchmark 与工业数据集上超过基线，并已部署到淘宝闪购，线上推荐显著提升。
Motivation: 多阶段推荐的重排要在指数级排列空间里搜序列，现有端到端生成式方法受启发式标签偏置（把点击项简单提到首位）与信用分配问题（稀疏列表级后验奖励无法指导中间步骤）双重制约，优化方向模糊。
Method: 框架分离线与在线两段：离线阶段的 Lookahead Evaluator 基于累积回归，用 beam search 在未曝光空间主动挖掘高价值前瞻序列；训练时把该评估器的 step-wise 价值估计转为稠密监督信号，蒸馏进轻量 Online Generator；线上推理只做一次贪心解码。
Result: 在公开 benchmark 与工业数据集上超过基线模型；部署到 Taobao Flash Shopping 后线上推荐显著提升。
Conclusion: 用离线挖掘的前瞻价值做稠密监督，可让轻量生成器在单次贪心解码下逼近排列空间的全局最优，从而同时缓解标签偏置与信用分配问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking the Limits of In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Ad-Hoc Teamwork
papers.abstract_en: In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) has enabled foundation agents to adapt instantaneously to novel tasks, yet its efficacy in Ad-Hoc Teamwork (AHT)-where coordination with unknown partners is required-remains unexplored. To rigorously evaluate this, we introduce a large-scale benchmark ICRL4AHT, built upon a high-throughput JAX implementation of Overcooked-V2. Our benchmark includes a large, diverse teammate suite spanning both RL and heuristic policies, enabling controlled train-test shifts, and provides a reproducible end-to-end pipeline for teammate generation, learning-history collection, dataset construction, and online multi-episode evaluation. We evaluate representative history-conditioned ICRL algorithms, including Algorithm Distillation (AD) and Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT), across millions of transitions. Results reveal notable limitations: contrary to their success in single-agent domains, these baselines fail to exhibit robust test-time adaptation in multi-agent settings. Specifically, these methods frequently underperform random baselines across both unseen teammate and unseen layout tracks, with no clear in-context improvement over long horizons. These findings highlight the challenges of strategic inference under partial observability within the OvercookedV2 AHT protocol, establishing our benchmark as a critical testbed for next-generation coordination algorithms.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ICRL4AHT 基准，用 JAX 高吞吐实现的 Overcooked-V2 检验 In-Context RL 能否在 Ad-Hoc Teamwork 中对未知队友做测试时自适应。在数百万 transitions 上评测 Algorithm Distillation (AD) 与 Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT)，两者在未见队友与未见布局两条赛道上常低于随机基线，长时程内无清晰的 in-context 提升。
Motivation: ICRL 已让 foundation agent 在单智能体任务上即时适应新任务，但其在需要与未知队友协作的 Ad-Hoc Teamwork 中的表现尚未被检验，缺少可控的 train-test shift 评测环境。
Method: 构建基于高吞吐 JAX 版 Overcooked-V2 的大规模基准 ICRL4AHT，含覆盖 RL 与启发式策略的多样化队友套件，提供队友生成、学习历史采集、数据集构建与在线多回合评测的端到端可复现流水线；在数百万 transitions 上评测 history-conditioned 的 AD 与 DPT。
Result: 在未见队友 (unseen teammate) 与未见布局 (unseen layout) 两条赛道上，AD 与 DPT 常低于随机基线，且长时程内没有清晰的 in-context 改善；评测跨越数百万 transitions。
Conclusion: 在 Overcooked-V2 AHT 协议的部分可观测下做策略性推断对现有 ICRL 算法构成实质挑战，单智能体上的成功不能直接迁移到多智能体协作。

papers.title: Every Component Is a Lookup: One Linear Graph for Interaction, Composition and Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods for transformers are typically built around separate questions: which components interact, how information routes to the output, and which input tokens contribute. Because these methods rely on different assumptions, their answers are difficult to relate. We argue that two architecturally motivated assumptions suffice to address all three questions: attention and MLPs share a key-value form, $φ(S)\,U$, in which $φ(S)$ selects over values $U$, and components read from an additive residual stream, the sum of component outputs. Holding these selections at their forward-pass values turns the model into a computational graph, of which component interactions, composition paths, and token attribution are different readouts. We develop Unpack, a backward attribution procedure over this graph, and validate each readout against the corresponding established test: interaction scores predict ablation effects across models from 160M to 6.9B parameters, recovered routes reproduce established circuits down to the key, query, or value branch the circuit specifies, and token attribution passes the same faithfulness test as dedicated attribution methods. The results suggest that these two assumptions suffice for the interpretability questions above. On a task with a known circuit, we find that contribution and causal effect can differ, and that the difference has a recognisable signature: components that matter for the task change their contribution when the task is removed from the input, while components that act like a bias term do not. Code is available at https://github.com/Fun-Cry/unpacklm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的 Transformer 可解释性框架 Unpack：把 attention 与 MLP 都写成键值形式 φ(S)U，并假设各组件从加性 residual stream 读取，固定前向选择值后模型变成一张线性计算图，交互、组合路径与 token 归因只是这张图的不同读出。交互分数在 160M 到 6.9B 参数的模型上预测消融效应，恢复的路径复现既有 circuits 直到 key/query/value 分支，token 归因通过与专用归因方法相同的 faithfulness 检验。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 可解释性方法把组件交互、信息路由到输出、输入 token 贡献当作三个独立问题，各自依赖不同假设，答案难以互相对照。
Method: 基于两条架构假设：attention 与 MLP 共享键值形式 φ(S)U（φ(S) 在值 U 上做选择），组件从加性 residual stream（各组件输出之和）读取；把前向选择固定后得到计算图，再提出图上的反向归因过程 Unpack，从中读出交互分数、组合路径与 token 归因三类结果。
Result: 交互分数在 160M 至 6.9B 参数的多个模型上预测消融效应；恢复的路由复现既有 circuits，细到电路指定的 key、query 或 value 分支；token 归因通过与专用归因方法相同的 faithfulness 检验。在已知 circuit 的任务上发现 contribution 与 causal effect 可以不同，且差异有可识别特征：对任务重要的组件在输入中移除该任务后 contribution 改变，而像 bias 项那样起作用的组件不变。
Conclusion: 两条架构假设（键值选择形式与加性 residual stream）足以同时回答交互、组合与归因三个可解释性问题；在已知 circuit 的任务上 contribution 与 causal effect 是可区分的量。
Relevance: 1
