papers.title: Interpreting and Enhancing Emotional Circuits in Large Vision-Language Models via Cross-Modal Information Flow
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) represent a significant leap towards empathetic agents, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in emotion understanding. However, the internal mechanisms governing how LVLMs translate abstract visual stimuli into coherent emotional narratives remain largely unexplored, primarily due to the scarcity of visual counterfactuals and the diffuse nature of emotional expression. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing a steering-vector-based causal attribution framework tailored for descriptive emotional reasoning. To this end, we construct a specialized dataset to demystify the emotional circuits underlying the three-stage ``Adapt-Aggregate-Execute'' mechanism. Crucially, we discover a functional decoupling: visual emotional cues are aggregated in middle layers via sentiment-specific attention heads, but are subsequently translated into narrative generation in deep layers through emotion-general pathways. Guided by these insights, we regulate the emotional information routing to strengthen attention flow and amplify the semantic activation to consolidate expression. Extensive experiments on the comprehensive MER-UniBench demonstrate that our methods significantly improve performance via inference-time intervention, effectively mitigating emotional hallucinations and corroborating the causal fidelity of the discovered circuits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 steering vector 的因果归因框架，定位 LVLM 情绪回路的三阶段 Adapt-Aggregate-Execute 机制，发现中层用情绪特异注意力头聚合视觉情绪线索、深层经情绪通用通路转成叙事。据此在推理时干预情绪信息路由与语义激活，在 MER-UniBench 上显著提升表现并缓解情绪幻觉。
Motivation: LVLM 如何把抽象视觉刺激转成连贯情绪叙事的内部机制基本未被打开，原因是视觉反事实稀缺且情绪表达弥散。
Method: 构建专用数据集，围绕三阶段 Adapt-Aggregate-Execute 机制做 steering-vector 因果归因；再据此调节情绪信息路由以增强注意力流，并放大语义激活以巩固表达，属推理时干预。
Result: 在 MER-UniBench 上，推理时干预显著提升性能并有效缓解情绪幻觉，同时印证所发现回路的因果保真度（causal fidelity）。
Conclusion: 情绪理解依赖功能解耦：中层情绪特异聚合、深层情绪通用生成，因此在推理时干预路由与激活即可改善表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pointwise Generalization in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We address the fundamental question of why deep neural networks generalize by establishing a pointwise generalization theory for fully connected networks. This framework resolves long-standing barriers to characterizing the rich nonlinear feature-learning regime and builds a new statistical foundation for representation learning. For each trained model, we characterize the hypothesis via a pointwise Riemannian Dimension, derived from the eigenvalues of the learned feature representations across layers. This establishes a principled framework for deriving hypothesis-dependent, representation-aware generalization bounds. These bounds offer a systematic upgrade over approaches based on model size, products of norms, and infinite-width linearizations, yielding guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter in both theory and experiment. Analytically, we identify the structural properties and mathematical principles that explain the tractability of deep networks. Empirically, the pointwise Riemannian Dimension exhibits substantial feature compression, decreases with increased over-parameterization, and captures the implicit bias of optimizers. Taken together, our results indicate that deep networks are mathematically tractable in practical regimes and that their generalization is sharply explained by pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为全连接网络建立逐点泛化理论：用各层学习到的特征表示的特征值定义逐点 Riemannian Dimension，据此给出依赖假设、感知表示的泛化界。该界比基于模型大小、范数乘积与无限宽线性化的界紧若干个数量级；实证中逐点 Riemannian Dimension 显示显著特征压缩，随过参数化加深而下降，并能捕捉优化器的隐式偏置。
Motivation: 深度网络为何泛化是核心问题，而现有基于模型大小、范数乘积与无限宽线性化的工具难以刻画非线性特征学习 (feature-learning) 这一丰富体制。
Method: 对每个训练好的模型，从各层学习到的特征表示的特征值出发定义逐点 Riemannian Dimension，用它刻画假设类，进而推导依赖假设、感知表示的泛化界；分析部分给出深度网络可处理性的结构性质与数学原理，实证部分检验该维度与特征压缩、过参数化及优化器偏置的关系。
Result: 泛化界在理论与实验上都比基于模型大小、范数乘积和无限宽线性化的方法紧若干个数量级 (orders of magnitude tighter)；实证中逐点 Riemannian Dimension 呈现显著特征压缩，随过参数化程度增加而下降，并能捕捉优化器的隐式偏置。
Conclusion: 深度网络在实际体制下是数学上可处理的，其泛化可由逐点的、感知特征谱的复杂度 (pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity) 得到锐利解释。

papers.title: BARRIER: Bounded Activation Regions for Robust Information Erasure
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted concepts from a trained model while preserving the rest of its knowledge. Central challenge of this setting is that effective and robust erasure requires extensive parameter updates, which can unintentionally alter representations that should be retained. As a result, existing methods often trade erasure strength for preservation, due to the lack of formal guarantees on the protection of neutral concepts. To address this, we propose BARRIER (Bounded Activation Regions for Robust Information Erasure), a method that enables more intensive unlearning by driving updates within an identified activation space control region, where target erasure can be performed with limited collateral degradation. Using interval arithmetic, we obtain a closed-form bound on the worst-case representation change over protected regions and use it as a knowledge preservation objective. We provide a formal analysis of this protection and its effect on the functional drift. BARRIER is principled, architecture-agnostic, and compatible with existing erasure objectives. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that BARRIER achieves competitive performance across classification and generative settings, including notable gains in some cases, while maintaining strong robustness against adversarial recovery attacks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OneAndZero24/BARRIER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BARRIER 用区间算术 (interval arithmetic) 在激活空间中划定一个受控区域，把模型更新约束在该区域内做机器遗忘，从而在强删目标概念的同时限制对保留知识的连带损伤。它给出受保护区域上最坏情况表示变化的闭式界，并将其作为知识保持目标；在分类与生成设定的评估中取得有竞争力的表现，部分场景有明显增益，同时对对抗性恢复攻击保持强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 机器遗忘要有效删除目标概念往往需要大幅参数更新，会连带改变本应保留的表示；现有方法因缺少对中性概念受保护的形式化保证，只能在遗忘强度与知识保持之间取舍。
Method: BARRIER 通过把更新限制在一个已识别的激活空间控制区域 (activation space control region) 内实施更激进的遗忘；用区间算术导出受保护区域上最坏情况表示变化的闭式界，并把该界作为知识保持目标，同时对保护效果与功能漂移 (functional drift) 做形式化分析。方法与具体架构无关，可与既有遗忘目标组合。
Result: 在分类与生成两类设定的实证评估中取得有竞争力的表现，部分场景有明显增益，并在对抗性恢复攻击下保持强鲁棒性；代码发布于 github.com/OneAndZero24/BARRIER。
Conclusion: 把更新约束在可界定的激活区域内，可以在不牺牲遗忘强度的前提下为保留知识提供形式化保护，从而缓解遗忘与保持之间的取舍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GOMA: Toward Structure-Driven Multimodal Alignment from a Graph Signal Smoothing Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval uses images, text, and object relationships to answer different questions about the same collection. A query may seek an object's paired description, another object in the same category, or an object connected by an observed relationship. These goals rely on different notions of relevance. Paired matching requires object-specific distinctions, whereas cross-object retrieval benefits from relational agreement. Existing methods learn strong cross-modal correspondence or propagate information over a graph, but a shared output regularized toward neighbors can weaken identity distinctions. Moreover, gains from graph regularization can diminish after uniform graph propagation. We introduce Graph-Optimized Multimodal Alignment (GOMA), which assigns these roles to two connected embeddings. Each modality produces a content embedding directly supervised for paired identity and a semantic embedding jointly trained with cross-modal pairs and observed relationships. For complete records, both embeddings form an initial fused representation, semantic agreement sets positive weights on observed edges, and restart graph propagation reinjects this initial signal. This design lets a jointly trained model support single-modality and dual-attribute retrieval through a task-specific readout. Across six datasets and four tasks, GOMA achieves state-of-the-art performance on all 14 primary measures against 14 external methods. Controlled comparisons further show how separate supervision, graph regularization, and semantic-guided graph propagation shape the final representation and align the learned signal with each retrieval target.

papers.title: RotVLA: Rotational Latent Action for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have emerged as an effective paradigm for handling heterogeneous datasets during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model pretraining, offering a unified action space across embodiments. However, existing LAMs often rely on discrete quantization encode and decode pipelines, which can lead to trivial frame reconstruction behavior, limited representational capacity, and a lack of physically meaningful structure. We introduce RotVLA, a VLA framework built on a continuous rotational latent action representation. Latent actions are modeled as elements of SO(n), providing continuity, compositionality, and structured geometry aligned with real-world action dynamics. A triplet frame learning framework further enforces meaningful temporal dynamics while avoiding degeneration. RotVLA consists of a VLM backbone and a flow-matching action head, pretrained on large-scale cross-embodiment robotic datasets and human videos with latent-action supervision. For downstream robot control, the flow-matching head is extended into a unified action expert that jointly denoises latent and robot actions. Here, latent actions serve as a latent planner, providing high-level guidance that conditions action generation. With only 1.7B parameters and 1700+ hours of pretraining data, RotVLA achieves 98.2% on LIBERO and 89.6% / 88.5% on RoboTwin2.0 under clean and randomized settings, respectively. It also demonstrates strong real-world performance on manipulation tasks, consistently outperforming existing VLA models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RotVLA 把潜在动作从离散量化改为 SO(n) 上的连续旋转表示，并用三帧 (triplet frame) 学习约束时间动态，避免平凡帧重建。1.7B 参数、1700+ 小时跨具身预训练后，LIBERO 达 98.2%，RoboTwin2.0 干净/随机化设置分别 89.6%/88.5%，真实操作任务上持续超过现有 VLA 模型。
Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型 (LAM) 依赖离散量化编解码，容易退化为平凡帧重建，表示能力受限且缺少与真实动作动力学对应的物理结构。
Method: 潜在动作建模为 SO(n) 元素，获得连续性、可组合性与结构化几何；三帧学习框架强制有意义的时间动态并抑制退化。骨干为 VLM 加 flow-matching 动作头，在大规模跨具身机器人数据与人类视频上以潜在动作监督预训练；下游控制时 flow-matching 头扩展为统一动作专家，联合去噪潜在动作与机器人动作，潜在动作充当高层规划器条件化动作生成。
Result: 仅 1.7B 参数、1700+ 小时预训练数据，LIBERO 成功率 98.2%，RoboTwin2.0 干净设置 89.6%、随机化设置 88.5%；在真实操作任务上持续优于现有 VLA 模型。
Conclusion: 连续旋转潜在动作加三帧约束足以替代离散量化 LAM，在小参数量与有限预训练数据下支撑跨具身机器人操作的预训练与下游控制。

papers.title: A Neural Hierarchical-Matrix Preconditioner for Real-Time GPU Solves
papers.abstract_en: Interactive simulation solves Ax=b for a sparse SPD A that changes every frame, inside an 8-16 ms budget. At a few thousand unknowns, the setup of algebraic multigrid alone exceeds that budget, while Jacobi and other local preconditioners have no setup but cannot move error across the domain. We learn a preconditioner for this gap: a graph-and-attention network predicts an SPD approximate inverse in H^2-matrix format. On a spatially ordered 3D mesh, blocks of the true inverse lose rank as the clusters they couple move apart; the nested bases of the format follow that decay, so inference and apply are dominated by leaf-block work linear in N, where a dense inverse costs N^2. Our main finding concerns training. Probe losses reach M only through a product with A, so their gradient vanishes on the near-null modes that set the conjugate-gradient iteration count. A truncated Kaporin condition number has no such factor; changing only the objective cuts iterations on a held-out frame from 116 to 33. On a ladder of stiff tetrahedral diffusion problems ours alone fits an 8.3 ms (120 fps) frame from N=572 to 3,647.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters (SA Posters '26). 3 pages; 2-page supplement as ancillary file. Supersedes v1-v2 (Hierarchical Transformer Preconditioning for Interactive Physics Simulation): their cosine-Hutchinson objective carries a factor lambda in its gradient on near-null modes; this version trains a truncated Kaporin condition number and evaluates on 3D tet meshes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向交互式物理仿真每帧 8–16 ms 的 Ax=b 求解，用图与注意力网络预测 H² 矩阵格式的 SPD 近似逆作为预条件子，叶子块工作量随 N 线性。关键在训练目标：探针损失经 A 作用后在近零模态上梯度消失，改用截断 Kaporin 条件数后，held-out 帧的共轭梯度迭代从 116 降到 33，且在 N=572 到 3,647 的 stiff tetrahedral diffusion 阶梯上唯一满足 8.3 ms（120 fps）帧预算。
Motivation: 交互式仿真要求每帧 8–16 ms 内解稀疏 SPD 系统，而 A 每帧都变；几千未知数时仅 algebraic multigrid 的 setup 就超预算，Jacobi 等局部预条件子虽无 setup 却无法跨域传播误差。
Method: 图与注意力网络直接预测 H² 矩阵格式的 SPD 近似逆，利用空间有序 3D 网格上真逆块随耦合距离增大而降秩的结构，使推理与施加由叶子块主导、代价对 N 线性。训练用截断 Kaporin 条件数替代原 cosine-Hutchinson 探针损失（后者梯度含 A 因子，在近零模态上消失），在 3D tet 网格上评估。
Result: 仅更换目标函数即把 held-out 帧的 CG 迭代数从 116 降到 33；在 N=572 至 3,647 的 stiff tetrahedral diffusion 问题阶梯上，该方法是唯一能装进 8.3 ms（120 fps）帧预算的方案。
Conclusion: 预条件子学习的瓶颈在损失设计而非网络容量：去掉梯度中的 A 因子、直接优化决定迭代数的近零模态，才能让学习型预条件子在实时预算内可用。

papers.title: Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Frontier commercial generative models face a growing threat from distillation, whereby a distiller harvests generated responses and trains a competing model at drastically lower cost. Existing defenses either modify the generation to degrade distillation performance, sacrificing response quality, or rely on behavioral detection mechanisms that can be readily bypassed through multi-account querying. In this work, we propose Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling (LADS), which leaves the generation itself unchanged while substantially reducing the effectiveness of distillation. Concretely, LADS controls the latent randomness underlying inference through a coupling mechanism that preserves within-account generation independence while inducing cross-account dependence. By construction, each benign user, who typically holds only a single account, receives the same experience under LADS as they would without any defense, thereby enjoying a lossless experience. However, for a multi-account task-specific distiller, semantically similar queries submitted across different accounts are assigned coupled randomness, inducing dependence in the harvested data and thereby degrading the generalization performance of the distilled model. Using uniform convergence theory, we show that LADS provably degrades the distiller's generalization gap relative to standard i.i.d. sampling. Experiments on image generation, mathematical reasoning, and code generation confirm that LADS substantially degrades the performance of distilled students while preserving exact statistical fidelity for individual users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling (LADS)：不改动生成过程本身，而是通过耦合机制控制推理时的潜在随机性，保持单账号内部生成独立、同时在跨账号间引入依赖。单账号良性用户体验与无防御时完全一致（lossless），而多账号蒸馏者跨账号提交语义相似查询时被分配耦合随机性，采得数据产生依赖，蒸馏学生模型的泛化性能被显著削弱。
Motivation: 前沿商用生成模型面临低成本蒸馏威胁：现有防御要么改动生成、牺牲响应质量，要么依赖行为检测、易被多账号查询绕过。
Method: LADS 通过耦合机制控制推理潜在随机性：单账号内保持生成独立，跨账号对语义相似查询注入耦合随机性；用 uniform convergence theory 分析蒸馏者的泛化间隙，并在图像生成、数学推理、代码生成三类任务上做实验。
Result: uniform convergence 理论证明 LADS 相对标准 i.i.d. 采样可证明地恶化蒸馏者的泛化间隙；图像生成、数学推理与代码生成实验中，蒸馏学生性能被显著削弱，同时对单个用户保持精确的统计保真度 (exact statistical fidelity)。
Conclusion: 在不牺牲单用户体验的前提下，通过跨账号耦合随机性即可实质性削弱多账号蒸馏，防御无需改动生成或依赖可被绕过的行为检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frontier Lag: A Bibliometric Audit of Capability Misrepresentation in Academic AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluations in applied domains tend to reflect models that were already outclassed at time of publication. We observe a publication elicitation gap: the distance between the AI systems generating the results reported in an academic paper and the AI systems that a current reader of that paper would reasonably assume are being referenced. We systematically sweep OpenAlex from 2022-01-01 to 2026-04-01 (n = 112,303 LLM keyword matches). Then, we identify what models were evaluated (n = 18,574 admissible records). We then rank each evaluated LLM against a frontier LLM based on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), an aggregate LLM capability score. At time of evaluation, the median paper is evaluating models that are behind frontier LLMs in capability, with a median gap of +10.85 ECI (H1; n = 12,312). This gap is growing, increasing at a rate of +5.53 ECI per year (H2, nominal 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]). The sign holds even in the absence of any imputation for evaluation date. In papers (n = 728) where the date of evaluation is explicit and the model in question can be resolved to an ECI score, the median gap for H1 is +5.01 ECI. An explicitly stated evaluation date can be found in only 18.4% of full-text papers. After correction, in 52.5% (95% CI: [48.2, 56.9]) of abstracts in our audit, conclusions are stated at the class level ("AI") rather than the model level. For papers about reasoning models, only 3.2% of abstracts and 21.2% of full-text articles disclose the reasoning mode status of the models used (H4). We propose a solution to this problem that is distributed among authors, editors, and funders. First, reporting from authors. VERSIO-AI v1.2 is a proposed 13-item checklist to cover the configuration surface described herein. Second, enforcement from journal editors and peer reviewers. Third, conditioning grants on disclosure and providing API access.
papers.comment: 63 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. v3: corrects the validation-sample, primary-model and appendix-reference errors; revised text; updated declarations. Pre-registered on OSF: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/7XM3D. Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20060458. VERSIO-AI v1.2 reporting checklist: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20060459. frontierlag package + per-DOI audit tool: https://frontierlag.org
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 2022-01-01 至 2026-04-01 的 OpenAlex 记录做文献计量审计，量化论文所评估 LLM 与当时前沿模型的能力差距（frontier lag）：中位差距 +10.85 ECI，且以每年 +5.53 ECI 扩大；提出 VERSIO-AI v1.2 十三项报告清单，把披露责任分摊给作者、编辑与资助方。
Motivation: 应用领域的 LLM 评测论文发表时所用模型往往已被超越，读者会误以为论文指的是当前前沿模型；这种「发表-引出差距」(publication elicitation gap) 使已发表结论的时效性与可解释性受损，且缺少系统性度量。
Method: 系统扫描 OpenAlex（2022-01-01 至 2026-04-01，n=112,303 条 LLM 关键词命中），筛出可判定被评估模型的记录（n=18,574），再用 Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI) 这一聚合能力分把每篇论文评估的 LLM 与前沿 LLM 排名比较；对显式评估日期子集（n=728）单独检验，并提出 13 项 VERSIO-AI v1.2 报告清单与 per-DOI 审计工具。
Result: 评估时中位论文落后前沿 +10.85 ECI（H1, n=12,312）；差距以 +5.53 ECI/年扩大（H2，名义 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]），不做评估日期插补时符号仍成立；显式日期子集（n=728）H1 中位差距 +5.01 ECI；仅 18.4% 全文给出明确评估日期；更正后 52.5%（95% CI [48.2, 56.9]）摘要以类级别（"AI"）而非模型级别下结论；推理模型论文仅 3.2% 摘要、21.2% 全文披露 reasoning mode 状态（H4）。
Conclusion: 学术 AI 评测普遍存在且不断扩大的能力滞后与模型级披露缺失，需要作者按 VERSIO-AI v1.2 报告配置、编辑与审稿人强制执行、资助方以披露和 API 访问为条件来共同纠正。

summary_sections.motivation: 应用领域的 LLM 评测论文发表时所用模型往往已被超越，读者会误以为论文指的是当前前沿模型；这种「发表-引出差距」(publication elicitation gap) 使已发表结论的时效性与可解释性受损，且缺少系统性度量。
summary_sections.method: 系统扫描 OpenAlex（2022-01-01 至 2026-04-01，n=112,303 条 LLM 关键词命中），筛出可判定被评估模型的记录（n=18,574），再用 Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI) 这一聚合能力分把每篇论文评估的 LLM 与前沿 LLM 排名比较；对显式评估日期子集（n=728）单独检验，并提出 13 项 VERSIO-AI v1.2 报告清单与 per-DOI 审计工具。
summary_sections.result: 评估时中位论文落后前沿 +10.85 ECI（H1, n=12,312）；差距以 +5.53 ECI/年扩大（H2，名义 95% CI [+5.03, +5.83]），不做评估日期插补时符号仍成立；显式日期子集（n=728）H1 中位差距 +5.01 ECI；仅 18.4% 全文给出明确评估日期；更正后 52.5%（95% CI [48.2, 56.9]）摘要以类级别（"AI"）而非模型级别下结论；推理模型论文仅 3.2% 摘要、21.2% 全文披露 reasoning mode 状态（H4）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学术 AI 评测普遍存在且不断扩大的能力滞后与模型级披露缺失，需要作者按 VERSIO-AI v1.2 报告配置、编辑与审稿人强制执行、资助方以披露和 API 访问为条件来共同纠正。

papers.title: Open-access model for detecting openly dumped dispersed municipal solid waste from crowdsourced UAV imagery in Sub-Saharan Africa
papers.abstract_en: Managing municipal solid waste in rapidly urbanizing Sub-Saharan Africa remains challenging due to dispersed informal dumping and limited high-resolution datasets for spatial monitoring. We present an open-access deep learning model for automated detection of openly dumped dispersed solid waste via crowdsourced UAV imagery, trained and evaluated across 29 regions in 10 countries, encompassing diverse environmental contexts. A deep learning model trained on manually annotated image tiles achieved excellent performance in detecting openly dumped dispersed solid waste across all study regions. Predicted distributions reveal heterogeneous accumulation patterns, ranging from localized hotspots - often along waterways, where waste can exacerbate flood and public health risks - to more dispersed litter across urban areas. Waste accumulation is most strongly associated with population density and indicators of lack of local infrastructure access, whereas its relationship with broader measures of regional development is weaker, highlighting the importance of fine-scale data for understanding localized waste dynamics. By releasing the model, this study provides a ready-to-use tool for UAV imagery collected by municipalities and local mapping communities, enabling openly dumped dispersed solid waste monitoring without extensive technical expertise. This approach empowers local practitioners to convert UAV imagery into actionable insights, supporting targeted interventions and improved municipal solid waste management across Sub-Saharan Africa.

TL;DR: 开源一个基于众包 UAV 影像检测露天倾倒分散生活垃圾的深度学习模型，在撒哈拉以南非洲 10 国 29 个区域训练与检验，对所有研究区域都给出良好检测表现。预测分布显示垃圾沿水道形成局部热点、城区则更分散；积累与人口密度及本地基础设施缺失指标关联最强，与区域发展总体指标关联较弱。
Motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲城市化快、非正式倾倒分散，且缺少高分辨率空间监测数据集，人工巡查难以覆盖。
Method: 用人工标注的 UAV 影像图块 (image tiles) 训练开源深度学习检测模型，在 10 国 29 个区域上训练与评估，覆盖多样环境背景；再把模型预测的空间分布与人口密度、基础设施可及性及区域发展指标做关联分析。
Result: 模型在全部研究区域检测露天倾倒分散固体废物均达到良好表现；预测分布呈异质格局，热点常沿水道（加剧洪水与公共卫生风险），城区则为更分散的散落垃圾。垃圾积累与人口密度和本地基础设施缺失指标的关联最强，与更宏观的区域发展指标关联较弱。
Conclusion: 模型以开放获取形式发布，供市政部门与本地制图社群直接把 UAV 影像转成可用于定向干预的监测信息，无需大量技术专长；理解垃圾动态需要细尺度数据而非宏观发展指标。

papers.title: GeoBlur: Epipolar Geometry Estimation from a Single Motion-Blurred Image
papers.abstract_en: Relative camera pose geometry, formulated via fundamental matrix estimation, is a challenging problem in many robotics and VR/AR applications. These applications occasionally contain fast monocular camera motion, which severely blurs the image and prevents the use of traditional multi-view geometry methods for camera pose estimation. To handle these cases, we propose GeoBlur, a framework for estimating the fundamental matrix and recovering relative camera pose directly from a single motion-blurred image, using the motion cues from blur artifacts. GeoBlur first predicts the visual correspondences between two time instances within the camera exposure window; then, it infers the fundamental matrix by solving the single-frame epipolar geometry problem under time-direction ambiguity. The resulting fundamental matrix is unique up to transposition, reflecting the inherent ambiguity in the direction of time. GeoBlur improves performance on synthetic and hybrid benchmarks while remaining competitive with prior work on real motion-blur data. We further demonstrate the use of GeoBlur on the downstream task on single frame motion segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoBlur 从单张运动模糊图像直接估计基础矩阵并恢复相对相机位姿：先在曝光窗口内预测两个时刻之间的视觉对应，再在时间方向歧义下求解单帧对极几何问题，得到的基础矩阵唯一到转置。在合成与混合基准上性能提升，在真实运动模糊数据上保持竞争力，并可驱动单帧运动分割下游任务。
Motivation: 机器人与 VR/AR 中的快速单目相机会严重模糊图像，传统多视图几何方法无法用于相机位姿估计，需要从单帧模糊中恢复相对位姿。
Method: GeoBlur 框架分两步：先预测曝光窗口内两个时刻之间的视觉对应，再在时间方向歧义 (time-direction ambiguity) 下求解单帧对极几何问题推断基础矩阵；结果基础矩阵唯一到转置，反映时间方向的固有歧义。
Result: 在合成与混合基准 (synthetic and hybrid benchmarks) 上性能提升，在真实运动模糊数据上与已有工作相当；并成功用于单帧运动分割 (motion segmentation) 下游任务。
Conclusion: 模糊伪影中的运动线索足以从单张图像恢复对极几何，代价是解只在转置意义下唯一，即时间方向不可辨。

papers.title: The impact of two-dimensional filtering on SWOT observations with white noise
papers.abstract_en: The Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) mission provides two-dimensional observations of sea surface height (SSH) at unprecedented spatial resolution, enabling exploration of ocean variability down to scales of $O(10~\mathrm{ km})$. At these scales, however, interpreting SSH variability is challenging because ocean dynamical signals overlap with measurement noise, and their respective spectral signatures are not yet fully understood. Recent analyses of SWOT 2-km posting observations have shown that along-track spectra transition to flatter but still red spectra at scales around 30 km. These flatter portions of the spectra have a power-law-like behavior and spectral slopes of approximately $-1$ or steeper, and their magnitudes and slopes are correlated with SWOT measurement noise magnitude. Here, we investigate the hypothesis that these flatter but still red along-track small-scale spectra can arise from two-dimensional filtering and aliasing of spatially uncorrelated (white) noise. Using synthetic experiments, we show that the resulting one-dimensional along-track spectra exhibit a similar transition to red, power-law-like behavior at scales of 15--50 km, qualitatively similar to spectral behavior reported in SWOT observations. The transition scale and apparent spectral slopes depend on the noise level, its cross-track variability, and the background ocean signal. This finding highlights the importance of carefully accounting for measurement noise and processing effects when interpreting SWOT spectra, and suggests that a white noise model should serve as a baseline null hypothesis for small-scale spectral analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWOT 沿轨 SSH 小尺度谱在约 30 km 处转平但仍偏红、斜率约 -1 或更陡，作者用合成实验检验这是否只是二维滤波与混叠作用于空间不相关白噪声的结果。合成实验在 15–50 km 尺度上重现了向红、幂律样谱的转变，转变尺度与表观斜率随噪声水平、跨轨变化和背景海洋信号而变；因此白噪声模型应作为小尺度谱分析的基线零假设。
Motivation: SWOT 把海面高度 (SSH) 观测推进到 O(10 km) 分辨率，但该尺度上海洋动力信号与测量噪声谱特征重叠，谱形解释缺乏判据。
Method: 提出并检验假设：沿轨小尺度的平坦偏红谱可由二维滤波与混叠 (aliasing) 作用于空间不相关白噪声产生；用合成实验生成含噪 SSH 并计算一维沿轨谱，考察噪声水平、跨轨变化与背景海洋信号的影响。
Result: 合成实验得到的一维沿轨谱在 15–50 km 尺度出现向红、幂律样行为的转变，与 SWOT 观测中约 30 km 处、斜率约 -1 或更陡的转变定性一致；转变尺度与表观斜率依赖噪声水平、跨轨变化和背景海洋信号。
Conclusion: SWOT 小尺度平坦偏红谱可由白噪声经二维滤波与混叠解释，白噪声模型应作为小尺度谱分析的基线零假设，解读谱时须显式计入测量噪声与处理效应。

papers.title: IatroBench: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Clinical Omission in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A strongly safety-trained model will provide a doctor with a benzodiazepine taper schedule, but not a patient who asks for one. The model knows the information, but how much it shares depends on the framing. We introduce IatroBench, a benchmark that evaluates models on two axes of harm (commission and omission) across 60 pre-registered clinical scenarios and 6 models. We use Claude Opus 4.6 to score model responses against a rubric written by a physician, and find that its omission scores are as well-aligned to the physician's scores as another physician's scores are. We find that when the same case is presented as a patient query and a doctor consultation (the variants also differ in register, request and the supervision a treating physician implies), all five models we test share more information with the doctor than the patient. We term this phenomenon "framing-contingent withholding." We find a mean decoupling gap of +0.38 across models (p = 0.003), and of +0.22 under an independent LLM judge (95% CI 0.10-0.36, p = 0.0014). An evaluation that focuses solely on commission harms would consider all of these cases as equally cautious refusals, but closer investigation reveals three different patterns: Claude Opus withholds information from the patient that it demonstrates knowledge of in the doctor framing. Llama 4 does poorly in both framings, so the decoupling gap cannot distinguish information withholding from incompetence. We are forced to exclude GPT-5.2 from this analysis because it returns no text for 33.2% of doctor responses, but 0% of layperson responses. A standard LLM judge rates responses as having zero omission harm in 86.6% of cases where our structured evaluations score them as omission harms. (Because our scenarios are designed to induce tension between safety and helpfulness, these statistics should be taken as only applying to this distribution.)
papers.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables. Pre-registered on OSF (DOI: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/G6VMZ). Code and derived results: https://github.com/davidgringras/iatrobench. v5: corrected title; science corrections from re-analysis; revised text; updated declarations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IatroBench 用 60 个预注册临床场景、6 个模型，从「危害发生」与「危害遗漏」两个轴评测语言模型，发现同一病例以患者提问 vs. 医生会诊两种框架呈现时，五个模型都对医生透露更多信息（mean decoupling gap +0.38，p=0.003），作者称之为「框架依赖的隐瞒」(framing-contingent withholding)。
Motivation: 只看 commission 危害的评测会把所有拒答都当成同等谨慎，无法区分模型是明知不说还是根本不知道；而安全训练会让同一信息按提问者身份选择性披露，这在临床场景直接构成遗漏型伤害。
Method: 预注册 60 个临床场景，每个场景构造患者提问与医生会诊两种框架（同时改变语域、请求方式与隐含监督）；用 Claude Opus 4.6 按医师撰写的 rubric 打分，并与独立 LLM judge 及另一位医师的评分对照；另设 6 个被测模型。
Result: 五个模型对医生透露的信息均多于对患者，mean decoupling gap +0.38（p=0.003），独立 LLM judge 下为 +0.22（95% CI 0.10–0.36，p=0.0014）；Claude Opus 4.6 的遗漏评分与医师评分的一致性达到另一位医师之间的一致性水平；GPT-5.2 因 33.2% 的医生回答返回空文本（患者回答 0%）被排除；标准 LLM judge 在结构化评测判为遗漏危害的案例中有 86.6% 判为零遗漏危害。
Conclusion: 临床 LLM 的信息披露随提问框架系统性漂移，仅评 commission 的评测会把这种隐瞒误读为谨慎；该统计只适用于为制造安全-有用张力而设计的场景分布。

papers.title: COMPASS: Fusion-Matched Supervision for Missing-Modality Human Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal human activity recognition (HAR) and human pose estimation (HPE) must cope with modalities missing at inference. Completions generated for a fixed fusion model must preserve the fusion readout: what fusion uses from each modality. We propose COMPASS, a completion-and-fusion framework in which each modality occupies a fixed slot filled by an observed representation or a completion inferred from available inputs. Its core principle, fusion-matched supervision, supervises completions with same-sample real targets at readout granularity: token means for HAR, where fusion averages tokens, and per-joint representations for HPE, where fusion preserves joint structure. Trained with complete multimodal samples, COMPASS improves subset-averaged performance over the strongest baselines on XRF55 and MM-Fi for HAR and on MM-Fi for HPE. At fixed architecture, fusion-matched supervision outperforms full-token and centered-token matching in HAR, and joint-mean matching and no matching in HPE. The code is available at: https://github.com/haowangcoder/COMPASS.

Method: 提出 completion-and-fusion 框架 COMPASS：每个模态占固定槽位，由观测表示或从可用输入推断的补全填充；核心是 fusion-matched supervision，在读出粒度上用同一样本真实目标监督补全（HAR 为 token 均值，HPE 为逐关节表示），并用完整多模态样本训练。
Result: 在 XRF55 与 MM-Fi 的 HAR、以及 MM-Fi 的 HPE 上，子集平均性能超过最强基线；固定架构下，fusion-matched supervision 在 HAR 中优于 full-token 与 centered-token 匹配，在 HPE 中优于 joint-mean 匹配与无匹配。
Conclusion: 补全应在融合实际读出的粒度上被监督，这样补全与固定融合模型对齐才能在模态缺失时保住子集平均性能；代码已开源。

papers.title: LiveMathematicianBench: A Live Benchmark for Research-Level Mathematical Reasoning with Proof Sketches
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, and whether large language models (LLMs) can meaningfully perform it remains a central question in artificial intelligence and cognitive science. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, rigorous evaluation of their mathematical capabilities becomes a practical necessity. Existing benchmarks are limited by synthetic settings and data contamination. We present LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic multiple-choice benchmark for research-level mathematical reasoning built from recent arXiv papers published after model training cutoffs. By grounding evaluation in newly published theorems, it provides a realistic testbed beyond memorized patterns. The benchmark introduces a thirteen-category logical taxonomy of theorem types (e.g., implication, equivalence, existence, uniqueness), enabling fine-grained evaluation across reasoning forms. It employs a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline that uses high-level proof strategies to construct plausible but invalid answer choices reflecting misleading proof directions, increasing sensitivity to genuine understanding over surface-level matching. We also introduce a substitution-resistant mechanism to distinguish answer recognition from substantive reasoning. Evaluation shows the benchmark is far from saturated: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the best model, achieves only 43.5%. Under substitution-resistant evaluation, accuracy drops sharply: GPT-5.4 scores highest at 30.6%, while Gemini-3.1-pro-preview falls to 17.6%, below the 20% random baseline. A dual-mode protocol reveals that proof-sketch access yields consistent accuracy gains, suggesting models can leverage high-level proof strategies for reasoning. Overall, LiveMathematicianBench offers a scalable, contamination-resistant testbed for studying research-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiveMathematicianBench 是一个动态多选基准，从模型训练截止后发表的 arXiv 论文抽取新定理，用十三类定理逻辑分类与 proof-sketch 引导的干扰项管线构造题目，并加入抗替换机制区分答案识别与真实推理。最佳模型 Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 仅 43.5%；抗替换评测下 GPT-5.4 最高 30.6%，Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 跌到 17.6%，低于 20% 随机基线。
Motivation: 现有数学推理基准受合成设定与数据污染限制，模型可能靠记忆模式而非推理作答；随着 LLM 进入科研流程，需要能区分答案识别与实质推理的评测。
Method: 从训练截止后新发表的 arXiv 论文构建动态多选题，建立十三类定理逻辑分类（蕴含、等价、存在、唯一等）；用 proof-sketch 引导的干扰项管线，依据高层证明策略构造看似合理但错误、对应误导性证明方向的选项；另设抗替换机制，并以双模式协议比较有无 proof-sketch 访问。
Result: 基准远未饱和：Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 最佳，仅 43.5%。抗替换评测下准确率骤降，GPT-5.4 最高 30.6%，Gemini-3.1-pro-preview 降至 17.6%，低于 20% 随机基线。双模式协议显示可访问 proof-sketch 时准确率一致提升。
Conclusion: 研究级数学推理对当前 LLM 仍远未解决，尤其在抗替换评测下模型表现可跌破随机水平；提供高层证明策略能稳定提升推理准确率。

papers.title: Invertible Query-Key Coupling Composes with Attention Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Scaled dot-product attention forms its queries and keys as independent linear projections, so the two never interact before the dot product that scores them. We study coupled query-key dynamics, a pre-scoring transformation that evolves each token's query and key jointly through a shared invertible coupling before standard scoring. We realize it as an alternating affine map in the style of real non-volume-preserving flows: the coupling is the identity at initialization, adds a small fraction of parameters per head, and leaves the softmax and surrounding architecture unchanged. We place coupling on top of existing attention methods rather than replacing them, and ask whether that composition helps. On WikiText-103, adding coupling to Differential Attention improves on it at both 150M and 455M parameters. At 455M the gain is significant at sequence length 512 (p=0.003, six seeds), survives a Bonferroni correction and replicates on a held-out test split; it also holds across rotary-embedding training lengths 512, 1024, and 2048. The same additive direction appears when coupling is added to query-key normalization (significant at 150M) and Multi-Token Attention (directional). Matched controls attribute the gain to the joint pre-scoring coupling rather than to added capacity, and show that removing the invertibility guarantee preserves the 455M gain yet is far worse than the base method at 150M, so invertibility is what makes the coupling reliable across scales. On its own, coupling lowers perplexity at 60M and 150M (one-sided Welch tests, p<0.05) but the gain narrows with scale and is not significant at 455M. We relate the construction to the expressivity of coupling flows, use an associative-recall study to map where coupling helps and where it degrades sharp retrieval, and conclude that coupling is most useful in composition with a scoring-stage method rather than as a standalone change.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 17th Asian Conference on Machine Learning (ACML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在打分前让每个 token 的 query 与 key 经共享可逆耦合共同演化的注意力改造（coupled query-key dynamics），实现为 RealNVP 风格的交替仿射映射，耦合在初始化时为恒等、每头只增少量参数，softmax 与外围架构不变。在 WikiText-103 上把它叠加到 Differential Attention，150M 与 455M 参数量均改善，455M 序列长度 512 处 p=0.003（六个种子）且过 Bonferroni 校正；单独使用时困惑度在 60M/150M 显著下降（p<0.05）但 455M 不显著，因此耦合更适合与打分阶段方法组合而非单独使用。
Motivation: 标准 scaled dot-product attention 的 query 与 key 是两条独立线性投影，在打分点积之前互不作用，缺少打分前的联合演化通道；作者要检验这种耦合能否叠加到既有注意力方法上带来增益。
Method: 在打分前对每个 token 的 query 与 key 做共享可逆耦合变换，具体实现为 RealNVP 风格的交替仿射映射，初始化为恒等、每头仅增加少量参数，softmax 与外围架构保持不变；耦合叠加在 Differential Attention、query-key normalization、Multi-Token Attention 之上而非替换，并用 matched controls 归因增益来源，另做 associative-recall 研究定位耦合何时帮助、何时损害 sharp retrieval。
Result: WikiText-103 上，耦合叠加 Differential Attention 在 150M 与 455M 均改善；455M 序列长度 512 处增益显著（p=0.003，六个种子），通过 Bonferroni 校正并在留出测试集复现，且在 rotary-embedding 训练长度 512、1024、2048 上均成立。叠加 query-key normalization 在 150M 显著，叠加 Multi-Token Attention 为方向性一致。matched controls 显示增益来自打分前的联合耦合而非额外容量；去掉可逆性保证后 455M 增益仍在，但 150M 远差于基线方法。单独使用耦合在 60M 与 150M 降低困惑度（单侧 Welch 检验 p<0.05），455M 不显著。
Conclusion: 可逆耦合是让 query-key 联合演化在不同规模上可靠的前提，且它作为与打分阶段方法的组合改造最有用，单独替换注意力本身收益随规模收窄。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MemGuard-Alpha: Limits of Membership Inference for Detecting and Filtering Memorization-Contaminated Signals in LLM-Based Financial Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to generate financial alpha signals, but many have memorized the historical data in their training corpora, producing apparent accuracy that collapses out of sample. Membership inference attacks (MIA) have been proposed as a diagnostic. What has not been established is whether MIA scores are informative about memorization in this setting, or whether signal-level filtering built on them helps once realistic costs are applied.We introduce MemGuard-Alpha, comprising a composite contamination score combining five MIA methods with a temporal proximity feature, and Cross-Model Memorization Disagreement, which exploits variation in training cutoffs across models. We then audit both. Across seven LLMs (124M-7B), 50 S&P 100 constituents, 42,800 prompts and 299,600 prompt-model MIA scores spanning 2019-2024, three findings emerge.First, where in-sample status is defined by a training cutoff, a temporal proximity feature recovers that label perfectly (ROC-AUC 1.000) because it is a monotone transform of the defining variable; any composite score containing such a feature reports separation that is arithmetic rather than detection. Second, the discriminative power of the MIA scores is largely attributable to scale differences between models: asked at a fixed date which models had that date in training, raw scores appear highly informative (AUC up to 0.99), but under three independent within-model normalizations discrimination falls to 0.487-0.537. Third, with transaction costs applied symmetrically, no filtering variant improves risk-adjusted performance over the unfiltered ensemble, none attains significant Fama-French five-factor alpha, and excluding the single weakest model outperforms every contamination-based filter.We report these as negative results with the failure modes that produced them, and release all artifacts needed to reproduce them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemGuard-Alpha 把五种成员推断攻击 (MIA) 与时间邻近特征合成污染分数，用于筛除 LLM 金融 alpha 信号中的记忆污染，但审计给出否定结果：时间邻近特征对训练截止标签的 ROC-AUC 达 1.000 只是定义变量的单调变换，MIA 分数的判别力在模型内归一化后从 AUC 0.99 跌到 0.487–0.537，且计入对称交易成本后没有任何过滤变体改善风险调整绩效。
Motivation: LLM 生成的金融 alpha 信号可能只是记忆了训练语料中的历史数据，样本外精度会崩塌；MIA 被提议作为诊断，但其分数在该场景下是否真的反映记忆、以及基于它的信号级过滤在现实成本下是否有用，此前未被确立。
Method: 提出 MemGuard-Alpha：复合污染分数（五种 MIA 方法 + 时间邻近特征）与 Cross-Model Memorization Disagreement（利用各模型训练截止时间差异）。在 7 个 LLM（124M–7B）、S&P 100 中 50 只成分股、2019–2024 年上做审计，含三种模型内归一化与对称交易成本下的过滤变体比较。
Result: 共 42,800 条 prompt、299,600 个 prompt-model MIA 分数。时间邻近特征对按训练截止定义的 in-sample 标签 ROC-AUC 1.000（单调变换，属算术而非检测）；固定日期问哪些模型训练过该日期时原始分数 AUC 高达 0.99，经三种独立模型内归一化后降至 0.487–0.537；对称交易成本下无任何过滤变体改善未过滤集成的风险调整绩效，无一取得显著 Fama-French 五因子 alpha，剔除单个最弱模型胜过所有基于污染的过滤器。
Conclusion: 作者将结果报告为负结果并附上导致失败的模式，同时发布全部可复现工件：MIA 分数在此场景的判别力主要来自模型间规模差异而非记忆检测，基于 MIA 的信号过滤在现实成本下不优于简单剔除最弱模型。

papers.title: OptiSAR-Net++: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Transformer-Free Framework for Cross-Domain Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to localize specific targets in remote sensing images using natural language expressions. However, existing methods are restricted to single-sensor domains, i.e., either optical or synthetic aperture radar (SAR), limiting their real-world applicability. In this paper, we introduce the Cross-Domain RSVG (CD-RSVG) task and construct OptSAR-RSVG, the first large-scale benchmark dataset for this setting. To tackle the challenges of cross-domain feature modeling, computational inefficiency, and fine-grained semantic discrimination, we propose OptiSAR-Net++. Our framework features a patch-level Low-Rank Adaptation Mixture of Experts (PL-MoE) for efficient cross-domain feature decoupling. To mitigate the substantial computational overhead of Transformer decoding frameworks, we adopt a CLIP-based contrastive paradigm and further incorporate dynamic adversarial negative sampling, thereby transforming generative regression into an efficient cross-modal matching process. Additionally, a text-guided dual-gate fusion module (TGDF-SSA) and a region-aware auxiliary head are introduced to enhance semantic-visual alignment and spatial modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OptiSAR-Net++ achieves SOTA performance on both OptSAR-RSVG and DIOR-RSVG benchmarks, offering significant advantages in localization accuracy and efficiency. The model and dataset have been made publicly available at https://github.com/JunDong-dev/OptiSAR-Net-PlusPlus.

papers.title: One View Is Enough: In-the-Wild Monocular Pretraining for Novel View Generation
papers.abstract_en: Monocular novel-view synthesis has long required multi-view image pairs for supervision, limiting training to a narrow set of purpose-built datasets. We propose in-the-wild monocular pretraining: a frozen depth estimator lifts each source image into 3D and reprojects under sampled poses to yield pseudo-target views; masked losses restrict supervision to valid regions and an adversarial objective covers disoccluded areas. Scaled to 30 million uncurated images, this produces OVIE, requiring only a source image and target pose at inference. Prior work trains without multi-view data but needs a depth estimator at inference, or drops this dependency but requires multi-view training pairs; OVIE is the first to require neither. Without multi-view supervision, OVIE rivals in-domain baselines on RealEstate10K and surpasses all on DL3DV, producing the most multi-view-consistent trajectories of any geometry-free method; brief multi-view fine-tuning outperforms all geometry-free methods on their training domain. At 116 FPS, it is over 600x faster than the fastest baseline. Code and pretrained models are at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/ovie; video results are on the project page, https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-04-14-ovie/.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/ovie. Project page: https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-04-14-ovie/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OVIE 用冻结深度估计器把单张野外图像抬升到 3D 并按采样位姿重投影出伪目标视图，配合掩码损失与对抗目标在 3000 万张无筛选图像上做单目预训练，推理时只需源图与目标位姿。无需多视监督即在 DL3DV 上超过全部基线、在 RealEstate10K 上与域内基线持平，116 FPS 比最快基线快 600 倍以上。
Motivation: 单目新视角合成长期依赖多视图像对监督，训练被限制在少数专用数据集；已有免多视方法推理时仍需深度估计器，而摆脱该依赖的方法又需要多视训练对。
Method: 冻结深度估计器将每张源图抬升为 3D，在采样位姿下重投影生成伪目标视图；掩码损失只在有效区域计监督，对抗目标补上被遮挡 (disoccluded) 区域；在 3000 万张未筛选图像上预训练，推理仅需源图与目标位姿，另可做简短多视微调。
Result: 无多视监督时 OVIE 在 RealEstate10K 上与域内基线持平、在 DL3DV 上超过全部基线，并产出几何无关 (geometry-free) 方法中最一致的多视轨迹；简短多视微调后在其训练域上超过所有 geometry-free 方法；推理速度 116 FPS，比最快基线快 600 倍以上。
Conclusion: 单目重投影加掩码与对抗监督足以替代多视配对监督，使 OVIE 成为首个既不需要多视训练对、推理时也不需要深度估计器的新视角生成方法。

papers.title: Detecting Data Poisoning in Code Generation LLMs via Black-Box, Vulnerability-Oriented Scanning
papers.abstract_en: Code generation large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into modern software development workflows. Recent work has shown that these models are vulnerable to backdoor and poisoning attacks that induce the generation of insecure code, yet effective defenses remain limited. Existing scanning approaches rely on token-level generation consistency to invert attack targets, which is ineffective for source code where identical semantics can appear in diverse syntactic forms. We present CodeScan, the first black-box, vulnerability-specific scanning framework for auditing code generation LLMs, assuming that the defender specifies the target vulnerability classes and provides corresponding task-relevant prompts. CodeScan identifies attack targets by analyzing structural similarities across multiple generations conditioned on different clean prompts. It combines iterative divergence analysis with abstract syntax tree (AST)-based normalization to abstract away surface-level variation and unify semantically equivalent code, isolating structures that recur consistently across generations. CodeScan then applies LLM-based vulnerability analysis to determine whether the extracted structures contain security vulnerabilities and flags the model as compromised when such a structure is found. We evaluate CodeScan against four representative attacks under both backdoor and poisoning settings across three real-world vulnerability classes. Experiments on 117 models spanning three architectures and multiple model sizes demonstrate 97%+ detection accuracy with substantially lower false positives than prior methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CodeScan 用跨提示多次生成的结构相似性加 AST 归一化，替代 token 级一致性来反演投毒目标，在黑盒条件下判定代码生成 LLM 是否被植入漏洞后门。对 4 种攻击、3 类真实漏洞、117 个模型（3 种架构）检测准确率 97%+，误报显著低于既有扫描方法。
Motivation: 代码生成 LLM 的后门与投毒攻击会诱导生成不安全代码，但现有扫描依赖 token 级生成一致性反演攻击目标，而源代码同一语义可有多种句法形式，该假设失效。
Method: CodeScan 假设防守方指定目标漏洞类别并提供相应提示：先在多个干净提示条件下分析多次生成的结构相似性，用迭代发散分析 (iterative divergence analysis) 加 AST 归一化抹平表面差异、统一语义等价代码，提取跨生成稳定复现的结构；再用 LLM 做漏洞分析，判定这些结构是否含安全漏洞。
Result: 在后门与投毒两种设定下、针对 4 种代表性攻击和 3 类真实漏洞类别，于 117 个模型（3 种架构、多种规模）上达到 97%+ 检测准确率，误报率大幅低于既有方法。
Conclusion: 黑盒、面向漏洞类别的结构级扫描可以在不知道攻击细节的情况下有效审计代码生成 LLM，前提是防守方能给出目标漏洞类别与对应提示。

papers.title: Beyond Pairwise Attention: Higher-Order Modular Attention for Efficient Sequence Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sequence modeling tasks can involve intrinsic higher-order dependencies, while standard self-attention assigns scores to token pairs and does not explicitly parameterize such interactions. We introduce Higher-Order Modular Attention (HOMA), which fuses pairwise attention with an explicit triadic attention pathway made tractable through overlapping blocks, local windows, and a low-rank projection. We compare HOMA with matched pairwise and purely triadic baselines on controlled PARITY and MATCH3 tasks, as well as TAPE benchmarks. HOMA is competitive with or outperforms the baselines, with its clearest advantages when the underlying dependencies extend beyond the explicitly modeled triadic order. These advantages are accompanied in several settings by faster convergence and improved parameter efficiency, with the learned nonlinear fusion providing an effective mechanism for combining the pairwise and triadic representations. Overall, our results provide empirical evidence that HOMA is an effective attention design when task structure extends beyond pairwise interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出高阶模块化注意力 (HOMA)，在成对自注意力之外显式加入三元 (triadic) 注意力通路，用重叠块、局部窗口和低秩投影使其可计算，再以非线性融合组合两路表示。在受控 PARITY、MATCH3 任务与 TAPE 基准上，HOMA 与匹配的成对、纯三元基线相当或更优，且当真实依赖超出所显式建模的三元阶数时优势最明显，若干设置下收敛更快、参数效率更高。
Motivation: 标准自注意力只给 token 对打分，无法显式参数化序列中固有的高阶依赖，这类任务结构超出成对交互时表达能力受限。
Method: HOMA 将成对注意力与显式 triadic 注意力通路融合，三元通路通过重叠块 (overlapping blocks)、局部窗口 (local windows) 和低秩投影 (low-rank projection) 降低计算量；两路表示由学习到的非线性融合模块组合。与匹配的成对基线和纯三元基线在受控 PARITY、MATCH3 任务及 TAPE benchmarks 上对比。
Result: 在 PARITY、MATCH3 与 TAPE benchmarks 上，HOMA 相对匹配的成对与纯三元基线持平或更优；优势在底层依赖超出显式建模的三元阶数时最清晰，若干设置下还表现出更快收敛与更好的参数效率。
Conclusion: 当任务结构超出成对交互时，把成对注意力与可计算的高阶通路做非线性融合是一种有效的注意力设计。

papers.title: MultiwayPAM: Multiway Partitioning Around Medoids for LLM-as-a-Judge Score Analysis
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge is a flexible framework for text evaluation, which allows us to obtain scores for the quality of a given text from various perspectives by changing the prompt template. Two main challenges in using LLM-as-a-Judge are computational cost of inference using a large language model (LLM), especially when evaluating a large number of instances, and inherent bias of an LLM evaluator. To address these issues and reveal the structure of score bias caused by an LLM evaluator, we propose to apply a tensor clustering method to a given LLM-as-a-Judge score tensor, whose entries are the scores for different combinations of questions, answerers, and evaluators. Specifically, we develop a new tensor clustering method MultiwayPAM, with which we can simultaneously estimate the cluster membership and the medoids for each mode of a given data tensor. By observing the medoids obtained by MultiwayPAM, we can gain knowledge about the membership of each question/answerer/evaluator cluster. We experimentally show the effectiveness of MultiwayPAM by applying it to the score tensors for two practical datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MultiwayPAM：对 LLM-as-a-Judge 的三维评分张量（问题×回答者×评估者）做多路划分中心点 (multiway partitioning around medoids) 联合聚类，同时估计每个模态的簇归属与 medoid，用 medoid 反推各簇的评分偏差结构。在两个实际数据集的评分张量上验证其有效性。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge 推理成本高且评估者本身带偏差，评分张量中问题、回答者、评估者三个模态的偏差结构纠缠在一起，难以直接解读。
Method: 把评分张量作为输入，开发 MultiwayPAM 张量聚类方法，对问题、回答者、评估者三个模态同时估计簇归属与 medoid，再通过 medoid 解读各簇成员构成。
Result: 在两个实际数据集的评分张量上实验性地展示了 MultiwayPAM 的有效性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 多路 medoid 聚类能把 LLM 评分偏差按问题/回答者/评估者三个模态拆开，从而在降低评估成本的同时揭示评分偏差的结构。

papers.title: Safety Under Scaffolding: How Evaluation Conditions Shape Measured Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety benchmarks usually test "bare" models that receive prompts and output responses, but real-world deployments "wrap" those models in complex scaffolds. How much do these scaffolds affect model safety as measured by benchmarks? We test six leading models on four pre-registered safety benchmarks with a direct API and three scaffolds: ReAct, multi-agent, and map-reduce. We conducted 62,808 scored evaluations. How safety is measured matters more than scaffolding does: we find that using a multiple choice vs. open-ended format for otherwise-identical benchmark items changes measured safety by 5-20 percentage points (pp). The two formats are scored with different methods (answer extraction and an LLM judge), so the gap is due to measurement rather than differences in latent safety. Using a heuristic to classify model refusals would have led to different findings in five cases. Benchmark choice explains 19.3% of the variation in outcomes; scaffold architecture explains 0.4%, about 45x less. We find that map-reduce scaffolds, a form of structure-destroying delegation that strips answer options by decomposing prompts, reduce pooled measured safety by 7.3 pp (95% CI: 6.4 to 8.1). The pooled effects for ReAct and multi-agent scaffolds are within our pre-registered +/-2 pp margin of equivalence. However, there are large differences across models for specific benchmarks and scaffolds that are hidden by pooled estimates: for example, on the same sycophancy benchmark items, Opus 4.6 has 16.8 pp lower measured safety with a map-reduce scaffold, while Llama 4 has 18.8 pp higher measured safety. Composite reliability is G = 0.000 (95% CI: [0.000, 0.752]). This wide confidence interval, which spans "of little use" to "very good", does not support using a single composite measure of model safety as the basis for go/no-go decisions about model deployment.
papers.comment: 78 pages, 12 figures, 43 tables. Pre-registered: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/CJW92. Code and data: https://github.com/davidgringras/safety-under-scaffolding. v3: text revised throughout; sycophancy baselines stated relative to the other benchmarks; Figures 1 and 5 redrawn as changes from baseline; Figure 6 XSTest bars use LLM-judge labels; captions corrected; declarations updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对六个领先模型在四个预注册安全基准上做 62,808 次评分，比较直连 API 与 ReAct、multi-agent、map-reduce 三种 scaffold。结论是测量方式比 scaffold 更决定结果：同一题目改成选择题 vs 开放式使测得安全度差 5–20 个百分点，基准选择解释 19.3% 的方差而 scaffold 架构仅 0.4%（约 45 倍差距）；map-reduce 使汇总安全度降 7.3 pp（95% CI 6.4–8.1），且合成信度 G=0.000（CI [0.000, 0.752]），不足以支撑用单一合成指标做部署 go/no-go 决策。
Motivation: 安全基准通常测“裸模型”，真实部署却把模型包进 scaffold；现有评测既未量化 scaffold 对测得安全度的影响，也未区分该影响与测量方式本身带来的差异。
Method: 对六个领先模型在四个预注册安全基准上，用直连 API 与三种 scaffold（ReAct、multi-agent、map-reduce）交叉评测，共 62,808 次评分；同一题目分别以选择题（answer extraction 打分）与开放式（LLM judge 打分）呈现，并用方差分解与预注册的 ±2 pp 等价界限分析，另检验启发式拒绝分类与合成信度 G。
Result: 选择题 vs 开放式格式使测得安全度差 5–20 pp；启发式拒绝分类会在五种情形下得出不同结论；基准选择解释 19.3% 结果方差，scaffold 架构仅 0.4%（约 45 倍少）；map-reduce 使汇总安全度降 7.3 pp（95% CI 6.4–8.1），ReAct 与 multi-agent 落在 ±2 pp 等价界限内；同一 sycophancy 题目上 Opus 4.6 配 map-reduce 低 16.8 pp 而 Llama 4 高 18.8 pp；合成信度 G=0.000（95% CI [0.000, 0.752]）。
Conclusion: 测得的安全度主要由测量与基准选择塑造而非 scaffold 架构，且模型间差异被汇总估计掩盖；作者据此不支持把单一合成安全指标作为部署 go/no-go 决策依据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Match4Annotate: Cross-Video Annotation Transfer in Ultrasound via Implicit Feature Flow-Guided Matching
papers.abstract_en: Acquiring per-frame annotations for ultrasound videos is costly and requires clinical expertise, limiting learning-based analysis. We study cross-video annotation transfer: propagating user-specified annotations from a labeled ultrasound video to an independently acquired target video with no target-side labels or manual initialization. Video trackers and segmentation propagators rely on temporal continuity and require a prompt in every new sequence, whereas cross-image feature matching and one-shot segmentation estimate correspondences independently, without enforcing coherent deformations or supporting both point and mask annotations. We present Match4Annotate, a test-time framework with three stages. A spatiotemporal implicit feature representation lifts frozen vision foundation-model features into a continuous field over space and time, enabling queries beyond the backbone resolution. A continuous implicit feature flow then aligns the source and target fields under a smooth-deformation prior, estimating correspondence in feature space rather than relying on intensity consistency, which is often violated in ultrasound by speckle and acquisition-dependent appearance. Finally, flow-guided annotation transfer uses the estimated flow as a spatial prior over feature similarity. This formulation unifies sparse point and dense mask transfer and includes unconstrained feature matching and direct flow warping as limiting cases. On four clinical ultrasound datasets spanning echocardiography and musculoskeletal imaging, Match4Annotate achieves state-of-the-art annotation transfer, outperforming dense feature-matching baselines across PCK thresholds and one-shot segmentation methods in Dice score. It also demonstrates bidirectional transfer of left-ventricular annotations across datasets. It requires no task-specific training and adapts to each video in minutes on a single consumer GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Match4Annotate 是一个测试时 (test-time) 超声视频跨视频标注迁移框架：用时空隐式特征场把冻结的视觉基础模型特征提升到连续时空域，再在平滑形变先验下估计隐式特征流，最后以流作为空间先验引导特征相似度完成点与掩码标注迁移。在四个临床超声数据集（超声心动图与肌骨影像）上取得 SOTA，跨 PCK 阈值优于稠密特征匹配基线、Dice 优于 one-shot 分割方法，且无需任务特定训练、单张消费级 GPU 上数分钟内适配每个视频。
Motivation: 超声逐帧标注成本高且需临床专业知识；现有视频追踪与分割传播依赖时序连续性、每个新序列都要提示，跨图匹配与 one-shot 分割又不保证形变一致且不同时支持点和掩码标注。
Method: 三阶段测试时框架：时空隐式特征表示将冻结视觉基础模型特征提升为连续时空场，可查询超出骨干分辨率的位置；连续隐式特征流在平滑形变先验下于特征空间对齐源与目标场（不依赖被斑点与采集差异破坏的强度一致性）；流引导迁移把估计的流作为特征相似度上的空间先验，统一稀疏点与稠密掩码迁移，无约束特征匹配与直接流 warp 是其极限情形。
Result: 在覆盖超声心动图与肌骨影像的四个临床超声数据集上达到标注迁移 SOTA：跨各 PCK 阈值优于稠密特征匹配基线，Dice 优于 one-shot 分割方法；可跨数据集双向迁移左心室标注；无需任务特定训练，单张消费级 GPU 上数分钟内适配每个视频。
Conclusion: 在特征空间用平滑形变先验做流引导迁移，可以在无目标侧标签、无手动初始化的条件下统一超声点与掩码的跨视频标注迁移，并免去任务特定训练。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learning Causal Structure of Time Series using Best Order Score Search
papers.abstract_en: Causal structure learning from observational data is central to many scientific and policy domains, but the time series setting common to many disciplines poses several challenges due to temporal dependence. In this paper we focus on score-based causal discovery for multivariate time series and introduce TS-BOSS, a time series extension of the recently proposed Best Order Score Search (BOSS) (Andrews et al. 2023). TS-BOSS performs a permutation-based search over dynamic Bayesian network structures while leveraging grow-shrink trees to cache intermediate score computations, preserving the scalability and strong empirical performance of BOSS in the static setting. We provide theoretical guarantees establishing the soundness of TS-BOSS under suitable assumptions, and we present an intermediate result that extends classical subgraph minimality results for permutation-based methods to the dynamic (time series) setting. Our experiments on synthetic data show that TS-BOSS is especially effective in high auto-correlation regimes, where it consistently achieves higher adjacency recall at comparable precision than standard constraint-based methods. Overall, TS-BOSS offers a high-performing, scalable approach for time series causal discovery and our results provide a principled bridge for extending sparsity-based, permutation-driven causal learning theory to dynamic settings.
papers.comment: v2: added more experiments, modified notation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把静态因果发现方法 BOSS 扩展为多变量时间序列的 TS-BOSS：在动态贝叶斯网络 (DBN) 结构上做置换搜索 (permutation-based search)，用 grow-shrink 树缓存中间打分以保持可扩展性。合成数据上在高自相关 regime 中，它比标准 constraint-based 方法稳定取得更高 adjacency recall 且 precision 相当。
Motivation: 时间序列的 temporal dependence 破坏了静态因果发现的独立性假设，score-based 方法在动态结构上难以兼顾打分搜索的精度与可扩展性。
Method: TS-BOSS 对动态贝叶斯网络结构做置换搜索，借 grow-shrink 树缓存中间 score 计算以继承 BOSS 的可扩展性；给出适当假设下的 soundness 理论保证，并把置换式方法的经典 subgraph minimality 结果推广到时序设定。
Result: 合成数据实验显示 TS-BOSS 在高自相关 regime 中尤其有效，相对标准 constraint-based 方法始终取得更高 adjacency recall 且 precision 相当。
Conclusion: 置换驱动、稀疏导向的因果学习理论可以有原则地桥接到动态时序设定，TS-BOSS 是一条高表现且可扩展的时间序列因果发现路径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MPFlow: Multi-modal Posterior-Guided Flow Matching for Zero-Shot MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot MRI reconstruction relies on generative priors, but single-modality unconditional priors produce hallucinations under severe ill-posedness. In many clinical workflows, complementary MRI acquisitions (e.g. high-quality structural scans) are routinely available, yet existing reconstruction methods lack mechanisms to leverage this additional information. We propose MPFlow, a zero-shot multi-modal reconstruction framework built on rectified flow that incorporates auxiliary MRI modalities at inference time without retraining the generative prior to improve anatomical fidelity. Cross-modal guidance is enabled by our proposed self-supervised pretraining strategy, Patch-level Multi-modal MR Image Pretraining (PAMRI), which learns shared representations across modalities. Sampling is jointly guided by data consistency and cross-modal feature alignment using pre-trained PAMRI, systematically suppressing intrinsic and extrinsic hallucinations. Extensive experiments on HCP and BraTS show that MPFlow matches diffusion baselines on image quality using only 20% of sampling steps while reducing tumor hallucinations by more than 15% (segmentation dice score). This demonstrates that cross-modal guidance enables more reliable and efficient zero-shot MRI reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MPFlow 用 rectified flow 做零样本 MRI 重建，在推理期引入辅助模态（如高质量结构像）而不重训生成先验：采样同时受数据一致性与 PAMRI 跨模态特征对齐引导，抑制内在与外在幻觉。在 HCP 与 BraTS 上，仅用 20% 采样步数即达到扩散基线的图像质量，肿瘤幻觉降低超过 15%（segmentation dice score）。
Motivation: 严重不适定下单模态无条件生成先验会产生解剖幻觉，而临床上常有互补 MRI 扫描可用，现有重建方法缺少利用该信息的机制。
Method: 基于 rectified flow 构建零样本多模态重建框架 MPFlow；用自监督预训练策略 Patch-level Multi-modal MR Image Pretraining (PAMRI) 学习跨模态共享表示；采样阶段由数据一致性与 PAMRI 跨模态特征对齐联合引导，无需重训生成先验。
Result: 在 HCP 与 BraTS 上，MPFlow 仅用 20% 采样步数即匹配扩散基线的图像质量，并使肿瘤幻觉降低超过 15%（以 segmentation dice score 计）。
Conclusion: 跨模态引导可以在不重训先验的前提下同时提升零样本 MRI 重建的解剖保真度与采样效率。

papers.title: SHINE: Sequential Hierarchical Integration Network for EEG and MEG
papers.abstract_en: How natural speech is represented in the brain constitutes a major challenge for cognitive neuroscience. Reconstructing the speech envelope and Mel spectrogram from EEG and MEG provides a time-resolved way to study its temporal and spectral structure. Speech-related neural activity spans sensors and temporal scales; extracting these representations while adapting the use of context to each acoustic target is a central problem in speech reconstruction. We propose SHINE, a Sequential Hierarchical Integration Network for EEG and MEG. A residual sensor adapter unifies input dimensions, intermediate dilated-block states retain temporal depth, and a target- and time-dependent gate fuses local hierarchical and attention-enhanced context predictions. Across two EEG and two MEG datasets, SHINE has the highest mean envelope and mean-Mel Pearson correlations among nine local baseline implementations on all eight dataset-metric combinations. SHINE also placed second in the speech-detection Extended Track of the NeurIPS 2025 PNPL Competition. Code will be released at https://github.com/xuxiran/SHINE.
papers.comment: submit to ICASSP 2027; ranked second at LibriBrain Competition 2025 https://neural-processing-lab.github.io/2025-libribrain-competition/prizes/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHINE 用残差传感器适配器统一 EEG/MEG 输入维度，以膨胀卷积块保留时间深度，再用目标与时间相关的门控融合局部层级预测和注意力增强的上下文预测，从 EEG/MEG 重建语音包络与 Mel 频谱。在两个 EEG 与两个 MEG 数据集的八种数据集-指标组合上，其包络与 mean-Mel Pearson 相关在九个局部基线实现中均最高，并在 NeurIPS 2025 PNPL Competition 语音检测 Extended Track 获第二名。
Motivation: 语音相关神经活动跨越传感器与时间尺度，而现有重建方法对不同声学目标（包络 vs Mel 频谱）难以自适应地调整上下文使用，这是从 EEG/MEG 重建言语表征的核心难题。
Method: SHINE（Sequential Hierarchical Integration Network for EEG and MEG）包含三部分：残差传感器适配器统一不同传感器输入维度；中间膨胀卷积块 (dilated blocks) 保留时间深度；目标与时间相关的门控 (target- and time-dependent gate) 融合局部层级预测与注意力增强的上下文预测，用于重建语音包络和 Mel 频谱。
Result: 在两个 EEG 和两个 MEG 数据集共八种数据集-指标组合上，SHINE 的 mean envelope Pearson 相关与 mean-Mel Pearson 相关在九个局部基线实现中全部最高；在 NeurIPS 2025 PNPL Competition 语音检测 Extended Track 中排名第二（LibriBrain Competition 2025 中获第二名）。
Conclusion: 按目标与时间自适应融合局部层级特征和注意力上下文，能在 EEG 与 MEG 两种模态上一致提升语音包络与 Mel 频谱的重建相关性；代码将在 github.com/xuxiran/SHINE 发布。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 按目标与时间自适应融合局部层级特征和注意力上下文，能在 EEG 与 MEG 两种模态上一致提升语音包络与 Mel 频谱的重建相关性；代码将在 github.com/xuxiran/SHINE 发布。

papers.title: RQ-Reg: A Residual-Quantization-Based Framework for Continuous Value Prediction in Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Predicting continuous values such as watch-time and gross merchandise value (GMV) is a core problem in industrial recommendation systems. Its inherent difficulty stems from the highly complex and long-tailed distributions of the target signals, which are hard to model accurately. Existing regression methods typically rely on fixed parametric assumptions on the target distribution: overly simple assumptions underfit real-world data, whereas more intricate ones tend to sacrifice scalability and generalization. To address these limitations, we propose a sequence modeling framework based on residual quantization (RQ), in which the target continuous value is decomposed into a sequence of quantization codes that represent progressively finer approximations. The model autoregressively predicts these codes from coarse to fine granularity, with each step refining the residual error left by the previous one. To further improve the quality of the learned representations, we introduce an ordinal-aware representation learning objective that aligns the RQ code embedding space with the ordinal structure of target values, thereby yielding continuous representations of quantization codes and more accurate predictions. We conduct comprehensive experiments on public benchmarks for watch-time and lifetime value (LTV) prediction, together with a large-scale online A/B test for GMV prediction on an industrial short-video recommendation platform. Across all settings, the proposed method shows competitive performance among existing state-of-the-art approaches and generalizes well across diverse continuous value prediction scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RQ-Reg 把推荐系统里的连续值（观看时长、GMV、LTV）分解为逐级细化的残差量化 (residual quantization) 码序列，由序列模型从粗到细自回归预测，每步修正上一步的残差；再用序数感知表征学习目标把 RQ 码嵌入空间对齐目标值的序数结构。在公开的观看时长与 LTV 基准及工业短视频平台的大规模在线 A/B（GMV 预测）上，该方法在现有 SOTA 中表现有竞争力并能跨场景泛化。
Motivation: 工业推荐中连续值目标分布高度复杂且长尾，现有回归方法依赖固定参数分布假设：过简单会欠拟合，过复杂则牺牲可扩展性与泛化。
Method: 残差量化框架：把连续目标拆成表示逐级更细近似的量化码序列，模型自回归地从粗到细预测这些码，每步细化前一步的残差；另加一个序数感知表征学习目标，使 RQ 码嵌入空间与目标值的序数结构对齐，得到码的连续表征以提升预测精度。
Result: 在公开的观看时长与 LTV 预测基准，以及工业短视频推荐平台上的大规模在线 A/B（GMV 预测）中，所提方法在现有 SOTA 方法中表现有竞争力，并能跨多种连续值预测场景良好泛化。
Conclusion: 用残差量化加序数对齐的序列建模替代固定参数分布假设，可作为工业推荐连续值预测的通用且可扩展的方案。

papers.title: Decoding ML Decision: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Large-Scale Ranking System
papers.abstract_en: Modern large-scale ranking systems operate within a sophisticated landscape of competing objectives, operational constraints, and evolving product requirements. Progress in this domain is increasingly bottlenecked by the engineering context constraint: the arduous process of translating ambiguous product intent into reasonable, executable, verifiable hypotheses, rather than by modeling techniques alone. We present GEARS (Generative Engine for Agentic Ranking Systems), a framework that reframes ranking optimization as an autonomous discovery process within a programmable experimentation environment. Rather than treating optimization as static model selection, GEARS leverages Specialized Agent Skills to encapsulate ranking expert knowledge into reusable reasoning capabilities, enabling operators to steer systems via high-level intent vibe personalization. Furthermore, to ensure production reliability, the framework incorporates validation hooks to enforce statistical robustness and filter out brittle policies that overfit short-term signals. Experimental validation across diverse product surfaces demonstrates that GEARS consistently identifies superior, near-Pareto-efficient policies by synergizing algorithmic signals with deep ranking context while maintaining rigorous deployment stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEARS 把大规模排序系统的优化改写成在可编程实验环境中做自主策略发现：用 Specialized Agent Skills 把排序专家知识封装成可复用推理能力，让运营者以高层意图（vibe personalization）驱动系统，并用 validation hooks 强制统计稳健性、过滤过拟合短期信号的脆弱策略。跨多种产品面的实验显示 GEARS 能持续找到更优、接近 Pareto 高效的策略，同时保持严格的部署稳定性。
Motivation: 排序系统进展的瓶颈已从建模技术转向工程上下文约束：把模糊的产品意图翻译成合理、可执行、可验证的假设过程极其费力。
Method: GEARS（Generative Engine for Agentic Ranking Systems）将排序优化重构为可编程实验环境中的自主发现过程；Specialized Agent Skills 封装排序专家知识为可复用推理能力，支持高层意图的 vibe personalization 式操控；validation hooks 负责统计稳健性校验并剔除过拟合短期信号的策略。
Result: 在多种产品面上的实验验证中，GEARS 持续识别出更优且接近 Pareto 高效的策略，把算法信号与深度排序上下文协同利用，并保持严格的部署稳定性。
Conclusion: 排序优化的瓶颈在于把产品意图转成可验证假设，而把专家知识封装成 agent 能力并加统计校验，可以在不牺牲部署稳定性的前提下找到近 Pareto 最优策略。

papers.title: VLANeXt: Recipes for Building Strong VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Following the rise of large foundation models, Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) emerged, leveraging strong visual and language understanding from Vision-Language Models for general-purpose policy learning. Yet, the current VLA landscape remains fragmented and exploratory. Although many groups have proposed their own VLA models, inconsistencies in training protocols and evaluation settings make it difficult to identify which design choices truly matter. To bring structure to this evolving space, we reexamine the VLA design space under a unified framework and evaluation setup. Starting from a simple VLA baseline similar to RT-2, which is the origin of VLA, we systematically dissect design choices along three dimensions: foundational components, perception essentials, and action modelling perspectives. From this study, we distill 12 key findings that together form a practical recipe for building strong VLA models. The outcome of this exploration is a simple yet effective model, VLANeXt. It outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on the LIBERO and LIBERO-plus benchmarks and demonstrates strong performance in real-world experiments. We release a unified and easy-to-use codebase to reproduce our findings, explore the design space, and develop new VLA variants on top of a shared foundation. The codebase is available at https://github.com/DravenALG/VLANeXt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLANeXt 在统一训练协议与评测设置下系统拆解 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 设计空间，沿基础组件、感知要素、动作建模三个维度从类 RT-2 基线出发，提炼出 12 条关键发现并据此构建出简单而有效的 VLANeXt 模型。该模型在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus 基准上超过 state-of-the-art 方法，并在真实机器人实验中表现强劲，配套开源统一代码库。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型各自为战，训练协议与评测设置不一致，导致无法判断哪些设计选择真正起作用。
Method: 以接近 RT-2 的简单 VLA 基线为起点，在统一框架与统一评测设置下，沿三个维度（foundational components、perception essentials、action modelling perspectives）系统消融设计选择，从中蒸馏出 12 条关键发现形成构建强 VLA 的配方，并据此实现 VLANeXt，同时发布可复现、可扩展的统一代码库。
Result: VLANeXt 在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-plus 基准上超过 state-of-the-art 方法，并在真实世界实验中展示强劲性能；研究共提炼出 12 条关键发现。
Conclusion: 统一的训练协议与评测设置能定位真正决定 VLA 性能的设计选择，按该配方构建的简洁模型即可在 LIBERO 系列与真机上取得领先表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Context-aware Skin Cancer Epithelial Cell Classification with Scalable Graph Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Whole-slide images (WSIs) from cancer patients contain rich information that can be used for medical diagnosis or to follow treatment progress. To automate their analysis, numerous deep learning methods based on convolutional neural networks and Vision Transformers have been developed and have achieved strong performance in segmentation and classification tasks. However, due to the large size and complex cellular organization of WSIs, these models rely on patch-based representations, losing vital tissue-level context. We propose using scalable Graph Transformers on a full-WSI cell graph for classification. We evaluate this methodology on a challenging task: the classification of healthy versus tumor epithelial cells in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC), where both cell types exhibit very similar morphologies and are therefore difficult to differentiate for image-based approaches. We first compared image-based and graph-based methods on a single WSI. Graph Transformer models SGFormer and DIFFormer achieved balanced accuracies of $85.2 \pm 1.5$ ($\pm$ standard error) and $85.1 \pm 2.5$ in 3-fold cross-validation, respectively, whereas the best image-based method reached $81.2 \pm 3.0$. By evaluating several node feature configurations, we found that the most informative representation combined morphological and texture features as well as the cell classes of non-epithelial cells, highlighting the importance of the surrounding cellular context. We then extended our work to train on several WSIs from several patients. To address the computational constraints of image-based models, we extracted four $2560 \times 2560$ pixel patches from each image and converted them into graphs. In this setting, DIFFormer achieved a balanced accuracy of $83.6 \pm 1.9$ (3-fold cross-validation), while the state-of-the-art image-based model CellViT256 reached $78.1 \pm 0.5$.

papers.title: Gradient Networks for Universal Magnetic Modeling of Synchronous Machines
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a physics-constrained neural network framework for magnetic modeling of saturable synchronous machines, including spatial harmonics. By embedding gradient networks into the machine equations to model conservative electromagnetic behavior, the framework satisfies reciprocity and energy conservation by construction, while universally approximating any physically feasible magnetic characteristic. Unlike lookup tables and black-box neural networks, it guarantees monotonicity, invertibility, and smooth outputs, and remains highly data efficient. The method is validated using measured and finite-element method (FEM) data from a 5.6-kW permanent-magnet (PM) synchronous reluctance machine, and is demonstrated in real-time closed-loop control on an embedded platform. The results confirm accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 gradient networks 嵌入同步电机方程，构造满足互易性与能量守恒的饱和磁化建模框架，可单调、可逆、光滑地逼近任意物理可行的磁特性。在 5.6-kW 永磁同步磁阻电机的实测与 FEM 数据上验证，并在嵌入式平台完成实时闭环控制演示。
Motivation: 同步电机饱和磁化建模依赖查找表或黑盒神经网络，缺少互易性、能量守恒与单调可逆保证，且数据效率低。
Method: 物理约束神经网络框架：将 gradient networks 嵌入机器方程以表示保守电磁行为，按构造满足互易性与能量守恒，并纳入空间谐波；用实测与有限元 (FEM) 数据验证。
Result: 在 5.6-kW 永磁同步磁阻 (PM synchronous reluctance) 电机的实测与 FEM 数据上验证，结果为准确、物理一致且计算高效；在嵌入式平台上完成实时闭环控制演示。
Conclusion: 按构造满足物理约束的 gradient network 可替代查找表与黑盒网络做饱和磁化建模，并满足实时控制的算力要求。

papers.title: TabSieve: Explicit In-Table Evidence Selection for Tabular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Tabular prediction can benefit from in-table rows as few-shot evidence, yet existing tabular models typically perform instance-wise inference and LLM-based prompting is often brittle. Models do not consistently leverage relevant rows, and noisy context can degrade performance. To address this challenge, we propose TabSieve, a select-then-predict framework that makes evidence usage explicit and auditable. Given a table and a query row, TabSieve first selects a small set of informative rows as evidence and then predicts the missing target conditioned on the selected evidence. To enable this capability, we construct TabSieve-SFT-40K by synthesizing high-quality reasoning trajectories from 331 real tables using a strong teacher model with strict filtering. Furthermore, we introduce TAB-GRPO, a reinforcement learning recipe that jointly optimizes evidence selection and prediction correctness with separate rewards, and stabilizes mixed regression and classification training via dynamic task-advantage balancing. Experiments on a held-out benchmark of 75 classification and 52 regression tables show that TabSieve consistently improves performance across shot budgets, with average gains of 2.92% on classification and 4.45% on regression over the second-best baseline. Further analysis indicates that TabSieve concentrates more attention on the selected evidence, which improves robustness to noisy context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabSieve 把表格预测做成先选证据再预测的 select-then-predict 框架：先从表中挑出少量有信息的行作为证据，再以被选证据为条件预测缺失目标，使证据使用可显式审计。用 331 张真实表合成的 TabSieve-SFT-40K 做监督训练，再用 TAB-GRPO 以分离奖励联合优化证据选择与预测正确性。在 75 个分类表与 52 个回归表的 held-out 基准上，相对次优基线平均提升 2.92%（分类）与 4.45%（回归），且对含噪上下文更稳健。
Motivation: 表格模型多为 instance-wise 推理，LLM 提示又脆弱：模型不能稳定利用相关行，噪声上下文还会拉低性能，证据使用过程也不可审计。
Method: select-then-predict 两阶段框架：先为查询行选出少量信息行作为证据，再以证据为条件预测目标。训练数据为 TabSieve-SFT-40K，由强教师模型从 331 张真实表合成推理轨迹并严格过滤；再引入 TAB-GRPO 强化学习配方，用分离奖励同时优化证据选择与预测正确性，并以 dynamic task-advantage balancing 稳定混合回归与分类训练。
Result: 在 75 个分类表与 52 个回归表构成的 held-out 基准上，TabSieve 在各 shot 预算下均提升性能，相对次优基线平均增益为分类 2.92%、回归 4.45%；进一步分析显示模型把更多注意力集中在被选证据上，从而提升对噪声上下文的稳健性。
Conclusion: 把证据选择与预测显式分开并联合优化，能让表格预测稳定利用相关行、抵抗噪声上下文，且证据使用可审计。

papers.title: MDE-VIO: Enhancing Visual-Inertial Odometry Using Learned Depth Priors
papers.abstract_en: Traditional monocular Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) systems struggle in low-texture environments where sparse visual features are insufficient for accurate pose estimation. To address this, dense Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has been widely explored as a complementary information source. While recent Vision Transformer (ViT) based complex foundational models offer dense, geometrically consistent depth, their computational demands typically preclude them from real-time edge deployment. Our work bridges this gap by integrating learned depth priors directly into the VINS-Mono optimization backend. We propose a novel framework that enforces affine-invariant depth consistency and pairwise ordinal constraints, explicitly filtering unstable artifacts via variance-based gating. This approach strictly adheres to the computational limits of edge devices while robustly recovering metric scale. Extensive experiments on the TartanGround and M3ED datasets demonstrate that our method prevents divergence in challenging scenarios and delivers significant accuracy gains, reducing Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) by up to 28.3%. Code will be made available.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ICIP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MDE-VIO 把稠密单目深度估计 (MDE) 的学习深度先验直接接进 VINS-Mono 优化后端，用仿射不变深度一致性与成对序数约束约束深度项，并用基于方差的门控剔除不稳定伪影，从而在低纹理场景下稳健恢复度量尺度。在 TartanGround 与 M3ED 数据集上，该方法在困难场景中防止轨迹发散，绝对轨迹误差 (ATE) 最高降低 28.3%。
Motivation: 单目 VIO 在低纹理环境中稀疏视觉特征不足，位姿估计易发散；ViT 基础模型虽能给出稠密且几何一致的深度，但算力开销通常无法在边缘设备上实时运行。
Method: 在 VINS-Mono 优化后端中融合学习深度先验：加入仿射不变 (affine-invariant) 深度一致性项与成对序数 (pairwise ordinal) 约束，并用基于方差的门控 (variance-based gating) 过滤不稳定深度伪影，整体设计受边缘设备算力预算约束。
Result: 在 TartanGround 和 M3ED 数据集上的实验中，方法在困难场景下防止轨迹发散，绝对轨迹误差 (ATE) 最高降低 28.3%。
Conclusion: 把带序数约束与方差门控的轻量深度先验嵌入现有 VIO 后端，可在边缘算力限制内提升低纹理单目 VIO 的尺度恢复与轨迹精度；代码将开源。

papers.title: Quantum Attention by Overlap Interference: Predicting Classical and Many-Body Quantum Sequences
papers.abstract_en: We propose a variational quantum implementation of self-attention (QSA)-the core operation in transformers and large language models-which predicts future elements of a sequence by forming overlap-weighted combinations of past data. At variance with previous approaches, our QSA realizes the required nonlinearity through interference of state overlaps and a degree-$k$ polynomial kernel, and estimates a loss based on Rényi-$1/2$ entropic functionals via two observables' expectation values, avoiding the decoding of amplitude-encoded predictions into classical probabilities. QSA also accommodates a constrained, trainable data-embedding tying state overlaps to data-level similarities. Its dominant end-to-end training complexity scales as $O\left(μ^{-1}k^2Td\right)$, versus $O\left(T d^{k+1}\right)$ of the fairest classical comparison, with $μ$ a training signal; we show numerically that this allows a complexity advantage in the regime where sequence length $T$ dominates the embedding size $d$. In simulations, our QSA-based quantum transformer learns sequence prediction on classical data and on many-body transverse-field Ising trajectories-establishing trainable attention as a practical primitive for quantum dynamical modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出变分量子自注意力 (QSA)：用状态重叠的干涉实现非线性，配合 degree-k 多项式核，并以两个观测量的期望值估计基于 Rényi-1/2 熵泛函的损失，从而免去把振幅编码预测解码回经典概率。端到端训练复杂度为 O(μ⁻¹k²Td)，对比最公平经典方案的 O(Td^{k+1})，在序列长度 T 主导嵌入维度 d 的区间给出复杂度优势；仿真中该量子 transformer 学会了经典数据与多体横场 Ising 轨迹的序列预测。
Motivation: 此前的量子注意力方案要么非线性实现不对应注意力所需的核，要么必须把振幅编码的输出解码成经典概率，带来额外开销；同时缺少与经典 transformer 的训练复杂度对照。
Method: QSA 通过状态重叠干涉与 degree-k 多项式核实现非线性，用两个观测量的期望值估计 Rényi-1/2 熵损失以规避解码；另设受约束的可训练数据嵌入，把状态重叠与数据级相似度绑定。训练复杂度 O(μ⁻¹k²Td)，μ 为训练信号。
Result: 端到端训练复杂度 O(μ⁻¹k²Td) 对比最公平经典比较的 O(Td^{k+1})；数值上在 T 主导 d 的区间出现复杂度优势。仿真中 QSA 量子 transformer 在经典数据与多体横场 Ising (transverse-field Ising) 轨迹上学会序列预测。
Conclusion: 可训练的量子注意力可作为量子动力学建模的实用原语，其复杂度优势成立于序列长度 T 远大于嵌入维度 d 的区间。
