papers.title: TIDE: Temporal Incremental Draft Engine for Self-Improving LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding can substantially accelerate LLM inference, but realizing its benefits in practice is challenging due to evolving workloads. We present TIDE (Temporal Incremental Draft Engine), a serving-engine-native framework that integrates online draft adaptation directly into high-performance LLM inference systems. TIDE reuses target model's intermediate hidden states generated during inference as training signals for draft adaptation, thereby avoiding additional target model computation and serving-time overhead. It employs adaptive runtime control to activate speculation and draft model training only when beneficial. TIDE exploits heterogeneous clusters by mapping inference and training to appropriate GPU classes. Across diverse real-world workloads, TIDE achieves up to 1.66$\times$ throughput over no-speculation baselines while recovering performance on misaligned workloads where static draft models degrade throughput. TIDE also reduces training time by up to 3.02$\times$ and storage requirements by 24$\times$ compared to existing draft training approaches, and improves system throughput by up to 1.22$\times$ on heterogeneous GPU clusters.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis (SC'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDE 把投机解码 (speculative decoding) 的草稿模型自适应训练直接嵌入 LLM 服务引擎：复用目标模型推理时已产生的中间隐状态作为训练信号，只在有利时才启动推测与草稿训练，并把推理与训练映射到异构 GPU 集群的不同卡型。在多样化真实负载上，相对无推测基线吞吐最高提升 1.66×，训练时间最多缩短 3.02×、存储降低 24×，异构集群吞吐最高再提 1.22×。
Motivation: 投机解码在实际部署中收益不稳定：负载持续演化，静态草稿模型与目标模型错位时反而拖慢吞吐，而在线适配草稿通常要额外的目标模型计算与服务开销。
Method: TIDE 是 serving-engine-native 框架：复用推理过程中目标模型的中间隐状态作为草稿适配的训练信号，避免额外目标模型计算；用自适应运行时控制决定何时启用推测与草稿训练；在异构集群上把推理和训练分别映射到合适的 GPU 类别。
Result: 在多样真实负载上，相对无推测基线吞吐最高 1.66×，并在静态草稿模型导致吞吐下降的错位负载上恢复性能；相对已有草稿训练方法训练时间最高缩短 3.02×、存储需求降低 24×；异构 GPU 集群上系统吞吐最高提升 1.22×。
Conclusion: 把草稿适配做成服务引擎原生的在线过程、并按收益门控推测与训练，可在负载演化下持续保住投机解码的加速收益，同时压掉训练时间与存储开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HERMES: A Holistic End-to-End Risk-Aware Multimodal Embodied System with Vision-Language Models for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models increasingly benefit from large vision-language models for semantic understanding, yet safe and reliable planning under long-tail conditions remains challenging, particularly in mixed-traffic environments involving heterogeneous road users and rare safety-critical interactions. This paper proposes HERMES, a holistic risk-aware end-to-end multimodal driving framework that explicitly incorporates long-tail semantic knowledge into trajectory planning. HERMES employs a foundation-model-assisted annotation pipeline to construct structured Long-Tail Scene Context and Long-Tail Planning Context, capturing hazard-centric scene information, maneuver intent, and risk-aware planning guidance. A Tri-Modal Driving Module then integrates multi-view visual observations, historical ego-motion, and long-tail semantic instructions through intent- and risk-aware conditioning for trajectory generation. Extensive experiments on a large-scale real-world long-tail driving benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements over representative recent baselines in overall planning performance and across diverse safety-critical scenarios. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness and complementary roles of the major components within HERMES.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HERMES 把长尾语义知识显式注入端到端轨迹规划：用基础模型辅助标注构造结构化 Long-Tail Scene Context 与 Long-Tail Planning Context，再由 Tri-Modal Driving Module 融合多视图视觉、历史自车运动与长尾语义指令生成轨迹。在大规模真实世界长尾驾驶基准上，整体规划性能与各类安全关键场景均一致优于代表性近期基线，消融验证各主要组件的互补作用。
Motivation: 端到端驾驶模型借助视觉-语言模型获得语义理解，但在混合交通、异构道路使用者与罕见安全关键交互的长尾条件下，安全可靠的规划仍然困难。
Method: 基础模型辅助的标注流水线构建结构化 Long-Tail Scene Context 与 Long-Tail Planning Context，编码危险中心场景信息、机动意图与风险感知规划引导；Tri-Modal Driving Module 通过意图与风险感知条件把多视图观测、历史自车运动和长尾语义指令融合后生成轨迹。
Result: 在大规模真实世界长尾驾驶基准上，HERMES 在整体规划性能及多种安全关键场景中一致优于代表性近期基线；消融研究验证主要组件的有效性与互补作用。

papers.title: WaterClear-GS: Optical-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Underwater Reconstruction and Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Underwater 3D reconstruction and appearance restoration remain challenging due to the complex optical properties of water, such as wavelength-dependent attenuation and scattering. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based approaches often suffer from slow rendering and limited practicality, while vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) lacks an effective mechanism to account for underwater degradation. To address this, we propose WaterClear-GS, a physics-informed reformulation of underwater Gaussian splatting that models degradation as intrinsic Gaussian attributes rather than external medium fields. Furthermore, we adopt a dual-branch optimization strategy that preserves underwater photometric consistency while encouraging a practical separation between restoration-oriented latent clean appearance and degradation. This strategy is enhanced by depth-guided geometry regularization and perception-driven image supervision, together with exposure constraints, spatially adaptive regularization, and physics-informed spectral regularization, which collectively promote spatial coherence and plausible visual appearance. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks and our collected dataset demonstrate that WaterClear-GS achieves strong performance on both novel view synthesis (NVS) and underwater image restoration (UIR) tasks, while maintaining 160+ FPS real-time rendering. The code will be available at https://sherii888.github.io/WaterClear-GS/.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 水体的波长依赖衰减与散射使水下 3D 重建与外观修复困难；NeRF 类方法渲染慢、实用性受限，而原生 3DGS 缺乏刻画水下退化的机制。
Method: 提出物理信息驱动的水下高斯泼溅重构，将退化表示为高斯内禀属性；采用双分支优化，在保持水下光度一致性的同时分离修复导向的隐变量干净外观与退化，并叠加深度引导几何正则、感知驱动图像监督、曝光约束、空间自适应正则与物理信息光谱正则。
Result: 在标准基准与自采数据集上，NVS 与 UIR 两项任务均取得强性能，同时保持 160+ FPS 实时渲染。
Conclusion: 把水下退化内化为高斯属性并做干净外观与退化的双分支解耦，可在不牺牲实时性的前提下兼顾重建与修复。

papers.title: LOGIC: Efficient and Robust Contextual Biasing for Speech LLMs via Logit-Space Integration
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing entity phrases remains a critical challenge for speech large language models. Existing prompting methods lack an explicit decoding-time biasing weight, limiting their controllability. Generative error correction methods can introduce hallucinated over-corrections. To address these limitations, we propose LOGIC (logit-space integration for contextual biasing), a robust framework operating directly in the logit space. By decoupling context injection from input processing, LOGIC enables explicit control over the biasing strength. Extensive experiments with an open-source speech large language model across 11 locales demonstrate that LOGIC achieves an average 9% relative reduction in entity word error rate, with an average false alarm rate increase of 0.3% and a 2.8% relative runtime overhead. When combined with prompting, LOGIC can reduce entity word error rate by 5% relative to the prompt-only method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对语音大模型 (speech LLM) 实体短语识别，提出 LOGIC：把上下文注入从输入处理中解耦，直接在 logit 空间做偏置，从而给出显式可调的偏置强度。在开源语音大模型、11 个 locale 上，实体词错误率平均相对下降 9%，误报率仅升 0.3%，运行时开销 2.8%；与 prompting 结合再降 5%。
Motivation: 现有 prompting 方法缺少显式解码期偏置权重、可控性差，生成式纠错又会引入幻觉式过度纠正，实体短语识别因此既难调强度又易过纠。
Method: LOGIC 在 logit 空间做上下文偏置 (contextual biasing)，将上下文注入与输入处理解耦，使偏置强度可显式控制；可与 prompting 叠加使用。
Result: 在开源 speech LLM、11 个 locale 上：实体词错误率 (entity WER) 平均相对下降 9%，误报率 (false alarm rate) 平均上升 0.3%，运行时开销 2.8%；叠加 prompting 后实体 WER 相对 prompt-only 方法再降 5%。
Conclusion: 把偏置放进 logit 空间并解耦注入，能在极小误报与运行时代价下显式控制实体偏置强度，且与 prompting 兼容。

papers.title: On Cost-Aware Designs for Sequential Hypothesis Testing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Cost-Aware (CA) Sequential Hypothesis Testing (CASHT), in which an active decision-maker selects sensing actions with different, random costs to identify the true hypothesis under an average-error constraint $δ$, while minimizing the expected total cost (rather than the number of samples). For fixed costs, we prove that the optimal expected total cost scales as $Θ(\log(1/δ))$, and is achievable by Multihypothesis Sequential Probability Ratio Test-based procedures. We show that the CA design principle is to maximize the ratio of expected information gain to expected cost under the policy-induced action distribution. Guided by this principle, we adapt two classic policies to the CA setting and establish their asymptotic optimality. We then treat random costs under two revelation models: ex-post, where costs are disclosed only after a sample is obtained, and the cost-error tradeoff coincides with the fixed-cost case, and ex-ante, where costs accrue before acquisition, and the decision maker may cancel an action mid-operation. For the ex-ante model, we characterize when cancellation lowers the total cost and analyze several cost distributions in detail. Simulations confirm our findings that the CA variants consistently reduce total cost relative to their classic counterparts, and when action cancellation helps or hurts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Cost-Aware 序贯假设检验 (CASHT)：主动决策者在平均错误约束 δ 下选择代价随机不同的感知动作，最小化期望总代价而非样本数。固定代价下最优期望总代价为 Θ(log(1/δ))，且可由 Multihypothesis Sequential Probability Ratio Test 类程序达到；设计准则是最大化单位代价的期望信息增益。CA 变体在仿真中稳定降低总代价，并给出动作取消何时有利或有害的判据。
Motivation: 经典序贯检验把每个样本视为等代价，只最小化样本数；当感知动作代价不同且随机时，样本数最优并不等于总代价最优，需要在错误率约束下重新设计停止与选动作的策略。
Method: 以期望信息增益与期望代价之比在策略诱导的动作分布上最大化为 CA 设计原则，据此改造两个经典策略并证明其渐近最优性；随机代价分 ex-post（取样后才披露代价）与 ex-ante（代价先累积、可中途取消动作）两种 revelation 模型，对后者刻画取消何时降低总代价并分析若干代价分布。
Result: 固定代价下最优期望总代价为 Θ(log(1/δ))，由 MSPSR 类程序达到；ex-post 模型下代价-错误权衡与固定代价情形一致；仿真显示 CA 变体相对经典策略一致降低总代价，并验证了动作取消何时有帮助、何时有害。
Conclusion: 在随机代价的序贯检验中，按单位代价信息增益选动作是正确的设计原则，且样本数最优准则会给出次优的总代价；ex-ante 模型下的取消机制只在特定代价分布下才划算。

papers.title: Interpretable Similarity of Synthetic Image Utility
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic medical image data can unlock the potential of deep learning (DL)-based clinical decision support (CDS) systems through the creation of large scale, privacy-preserving, training sets. Despite the significant progress in this field, there is still a largely unanswered research question: "How can we quantitatively assess the similarity of a synthetically generated set of images with a set of real images in a given application domain?". Today, answers to this question are mainly provided via user evaluation studies, inception-based measures, and the classification performance achieved on synthetic images. This paper proposes a novel measure to assess the similarity between synthetically generated and real sets of images, in terms of their utility for the development of DL-based CDS systems. Inspired by generalized neural additive models, and unlike inception-based measures, the proposed measure is interpretable (Interpretable Utility Similarity, IUS), explaining why a synthetic dataset could be more useful than another one in the context of a CDS system based on clinically relevant image features. The experimental results on publicly available benchmark datasets from various color medical imaging modalities including endoscopic, dermoscopic and fundus imaging, indicate that selecting synthetic images of high utility similarity using IUS can result in relative improvements of up to 54.6% in terms of classification performance. The generality of IUS for synthetic data assessment is demonstrated also for grayscale X-ray and ultrasound imaging modalities. IUS implementation is available at https://github.com/innoisys/ius.
papers.comment: This is the preprint version of an article published in IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, vol. 45, no. 7, pp. 3529-3544, July 2026. The final published version is available at https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2026.3679527
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, vol. 45, no. 7, pp. 3529-3544, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释的合成图像效用相似度 IUS，基于广义神经可加模型 (generalized neural additive models)，按临床相关图像特征量化合成集与真实集对 DL 临床决策支持系统的效用差异，并解释为何某合成集更有用。在内镜、皮肤镜、眼底等彩色医学影像基准上，用 IUS 选高相似度合成图像使分类性能相对提升最高 54.6%，并推广到灰度 X 光与超声模态。
Motivation: 合成医学图像能否替代真实数据训练深度学习临床决策支持系统，目前主要靠用户评估、inception 类指标和合成图像分类性能回答，缺少可解释、面向下游效用的定量相似度。
Method: 提出 Interpretable Utility Similarity (IUS)，受 generalized neural additive models 启发，用临床相关图像特征建模合成集与真实集对 DL-based CDS 的效用，输出可解释的特征级贡献；与 inception-based 度量和用户评估对照。
Result: 在公开的多模态彩色医学影像基准（endoscopic、dermoscopic、fundus imaging）上，按 IUS 选取高 utility similarity 的合成图像，分类性能相对提升最高 54.6%；该度量在灰度 X-ray 与 ultrasound 模态上同样适用。
Conclusion: 面向下游 CDS 效用且可解释的相似度比 inception 类指标更能指导合成医学图像筛选，且跨彩色与灰度医学影像模态通用。

papers.title: Few-Shot Specific Emitter Identification via Integrated Complex Variational Mode Decomposition and Spatial Attention Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Specific emitter identification (SEI) utilizes passive hardware characteristics to authenticate transmitters, providing a robust physical-layer security solution. However, most deep-learning-based methods rely on extensive data or require prior information, which poses challenges in real-world scenarios with limited labeled data. We propose an integrated complex variational mode decomposition algorithm that decomposes and reconstructs complex-valued signals to approximate the original transmitted signals, thereby enabling more accurate feature extraction. We further utilize a temporal convolutional network to effectively model the sequential signal characteristics, and introduce a spatial attention mechanism to adaptively weight informative signal segments, significantly enhancing identification performance. Additionally, the branch network allows leveraging pre-trained weights from other data while reducing the need for auxiliary datasets. Ablation experiments on the simulated data demonstrate the effectiveness of each component of the model. An accuracy comparison on a public dataset reveals that our method achieves 96% accuracy using only 10 symbols without requiring any prior knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对少样本特定辐射体识别 (SEI)，提出 ICVMD-SAT：用积分复变分模态分解 (integrated complex VMD) 重构复值信号以逼近原始发射信号，再以时序卷积网络 (TCN) 建模序列特征、空间注意力加权信息段，并用分支网络迁移预训练权重。在公开数据集上仅用 10 个符号、无需任何先验知识即达 96% 准确率，仿真数据上的消融实验证明各组件均有效。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的 SEI 多数依赖大量数据或先验信息，在标注数据受限的真实场景中难以部署。
Method: ICVMD 对复值信号做分解与重构以逼近原始发射信号，供后续更准确的特征提取；TCN 捕捉时序信号特性，空间注意力机制自适应加权信息丰富的信号段；分支网络借用来自其他数据的预训练权重，从而减少对辅助数据集的需求。
Result: 在公开数据集上仅用 10 个符号达到 96% 准确率，且无需任何先验知识；仿真数据上的消融实验显示模型每个组件都有效。
Conclusion: 把复值信号分解、时序建模与空间注意力结合，可在极少标注符号且无先验信息的条件下完成特定辐射体识别。

papers.title: LeafTrackNet: A Deep Learning Framework for Robust Leaf Tracking in Top-Down Plant Phenotyping
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution phenotyping at the level of individual leaves offers fine-grained insights into plant development and stress responses. However, the full potential of accurate leaf tracking over time remains largely unexplored due to the absence of robust tracking methods, particularly for structurally complex crops such as canola. Existing plant-specific tracking methods are typically limited to small-scale species or rely on constrained imaging conditions. In contrast, generic multi-object tracking (MOT) methods are not designed for dynamic biological scenes. Progress in the development of accurate leaf tracking models has also been hindered by a lack of large-scale datasets captured under realistic conditions. In this work, we introduce CanolaTrack, a new benchmark dataset comprising 5704 RGB images with 31,840 annotated leaf instances collected from 184 canola plants during their early growth stages. To enable accurate leaf tracking over time, we introduce LeafTrackNet, an efficient framework that combines a YOLOv10-based leaf detector with a MobileNetV3-based embedding network. During inference, leaf identities are maintained over time through an embedding-based memory association strategy. When trained directly on each target dataset without prior CanolaTrack fine-tuning, LeafTrackNet achieves HOTA scores of 88.03, 87.33, and 74.20 on CanolaTrack, KOMATSUNA, and MSU-PID, respectively, outperforming the corresponding second-best methods by 8.35, 4.94, and 1.62 HOTA points. This work provides a new benchmark for leaf-level tracking under realistic conditions and introduces CanolaTrack, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the largest leaf-tracking dataset for agricultural crops. Our code and dataset are publicly available at GitHub.

papers.title: OncoVision: Integrating Mammography and Clinical Data through Attention-Driven Multimodal AI for Enhanced Breast Cancer Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: OncoVision is a privileged-information training framework that uses mammography images and clinical features during training and performs inference from mammographic images alone. Employing an attention-based encoder-decoder backbone, it jointly segments four regions of interest (masses, calcifications, axillary findings, and breast tissue) with accuracy exceeding the nnU-Net baseline and predicts ten structured clinical features, including BI-RADS category. We developed two late-fusion strategies, Independent and Dependent, that integrate imaging, radiomic, and clinical information during training to improve diagnostic precision and potentially reduce inter-observer variability. Radiomic features extracted from predicted masks provide shape, intensity, and texture descriptors that complement the learned CNN representations. We evaluated OncoVision in a retrospective multi-reader study with six board-certified radiologists, assessing diagnostic confidence, reading time, and segmentation accuracy with and without AI assistance. In a paired reader-assistance evaluation, OncoVision was associated with higher diagnostic confidence for junior and senior radiologists, reduced reading time by up to 61%, and achieved segmentation accuracy comparable to or exceeding that of radiologists for mass lesions. We operationalized OncoVision as a secure web application, now deployed at a partner hospital, that generates structured reports with dual-confidence scoring and attention-weighted visualizations for real-time diagnostic support. The platform is designed for integration into clinical workflows, with the goal of supporting screening access in underprivileged regions. By combining accurate segmentation with clinical intuition, OncoVision advances AI-assisted mammographic interpretation, offering a scalable and accessible approach to earlier and more consistent image interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OncoVision 是特权信息 (privileged information) 训练框架：训练时同时用乳腺 X 线影像与临床特征，推理时只靠影像。注意力编解码器联合分割四类 ROI 并预测十项临床特征，六名放射科医师的回顾性多阅片者研究中，AI 辅助使阅片时间最多缩短 61%，肿块分割精度与放射科医师相当或更高。
Motivation: 乳腺癌筛查依赖影像解读，阅片耗时且存在阅片者间差异；仅用影像的模型无法利用临床上本就存在的结构化信息，而直接输入临床信息又会在推理时不可得。
Method: 采用注意力编解码器 (attention-based encoder-decoder) 主干，联合分割 masses、calcifications、axillary findings、breast tissue 四个 ROI，并预测含 BI-RADS 在内的十项结构化临床特征；提出 Independent 与 Dependent 两种晚期融合 (late-fusion) 策略，在训练阶段整合影像、影像组学 (radiomic) 与临床信息；影像组学特征从预测掩膜中提取形状、强度、纹理描述子，与 CNN 表征互补。
Result: 四类 ROI 分割精度超过 nnU-Net 基线；在六名持证放射科医师的回顾性多阅片者研究中，AI 辅助下初级与高级医师的诊断信心均提高，阅片时间最多减少 61%，肿块病变分割精度与放射科医师相当或更高。
Conclusion: 训练期引入临床与影像组学信息、推理期只用影像，可以在不增加部署负担的前提下提升乳腺 X 线解读的一致性与效率；系统已作为安全 Web 应用部署到合作医院，输出带双置信度评分与注意力加权可视化的结构化报告。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Self-Localizing MIMO Beam Mapping with Continuously Evolving Channel Memory
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning has greatly advanced data-driven channel modeling and resource optimization. However, most existing methods require accurately location-labeled datasets, which are costly to collect and maintain in dynamic environments. This paper develops a self-localizing multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) beam map framework that constructs a hierarchical wireless memory from highly sparse channel state information (CSI) measurements without explicit location labels. To reduce acquisition and processing overhead, we use beamdomain received signal strength (RSS) as compact inputs and theoretically show that they enable asymptotically unbiased spatial signature estimation. A dual-scale extractor captures intrasnapshot angular dependencies and inter-sample correlations for incomplete observations, and a hybrid temporal encoder is designed to consolidate recent CSI into stable short-term context for physical anchor inference. The inferred anchors spatially index a physically structured radio map embedding that stores long-term channel knowledge, which conditions a diffusion decoder for location-consistent full CSI reconstruction. Such a radio map embedding provides a persistent wireless knowledge representation that can be continuously updated and reused without full CSI acquisition. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves physical-anchor recovery accuracy by over 30% under sparse measurements and achieves more than 20% channel-capacity gain in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) beam tracking over Kalman-filter-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自定位 MIMO 波束图框架：仅用高度稀疏的 beam-domain RSS 与 CSI，在无显式位置标签下推断物理锚点并索引可持续更新的无线知识库，再由 diffusion decoder 重建位置一致的完整 CSI。稀疏测量下物理锚点恢复精度提升超过 30%，NLOS 波束跟踪相对 Kalman 滤波方法获得超过 20% 的信道容量增益。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动信道建模与资源优化方法依赖精确位置标注数据集，在动态环境中采集和维护成本高；同时稀疏 CSI 观测下不完整测量的处理与长期信道知识的复用也是瓶颈。
Method: 以 beam-domain RSS 作为紧凑输入并理论上证明其可渐近无偏估计空间签名；用 dual-scale extractor 捕获快照内角度依赖与样本间相关性，hybrid temporal encoder 将近期 CSI 整合为短期上下文以推断物理锚点；锚点索引物理结构化的 radio map embedding（存储长期信道知识），条件化一个 diffusion decoder 重建完整 CSI，该 embedding 可持续更新复用而无需完整 CSI 采集。
Result: 稀疏测量下物理锚点恢复精度提升超过 30%；在 NLOS 波束跟踪中相对 Kalman-filter 方法获得超过 20% 的信道容量增益。
Conclusion: 无需位置标签、仅靠稀疏 beam-domain 观测即可自定位并重建完整 CSI，分层无线记忆（短期上下文 + 长期 radio map embedding）可在不重新采集完整 CSI 的情况下持续更新复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Cross-Task Generalization in Handwriting-Based Alzheimer's Screening via Vision Language Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a prevalent neurodegenerative disorder for which early detection is critical. Handwriting, which can be disrupted by subtle motor and cognitive decline, provides a non-invasive and cost-effective window for AD screening. Existing handwriting-based AD studies mostly rely on online trajectories and hand-crafted features, while the influence of handwriting task type on diagnostic performance and cross-task generalization remains underexplored. Meanwhile, large-scale vision--language models have demonstrated strong transfer and adaptation ability in natural-image anomaly detection and several medical modalities, such as chest X-ray and brain MRI. However, handwriting-based disease detection remains unexplored within this paradigm. To address this gap, we introduce a lightweight Cross-Layer Fusion Adapter (CLFA) framework that repurposes Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP) for handwriting-based AD screening. CLFA inserts multi-level adapters into a frozen visual encoder, combining cross-layer feature fusion with depthwise 2D convolution on patch grids to capture both local stroke irregularities and higher-level handwriting structure. This design progressively aligns pretrained vision--language representations with AD-related handwriting cues and supports transfer from supervised source tasks to task-disjoint unseen target tasks. On the Darwin dataset, under the subject-disjoint cross-task protocol, averaged over all 600 task-disjoint source-target pairs, CLFA achieves 74.63\% AUC, 74.85\% accuracy, and 73.72\% F1 score, outperforming the best competing model by 2.15, 1.79, and 1.87 percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器改造成轻量 Cross-Layer Fusion Adapter (CLFA)，在补丁网格上做跨层特征融合加 depthwise 2D 卷积，从笔迹图像做阿尔茨海默病筛查并支持跨任务迁移。在 Darwin 数据集按被试不相交的跨任务协议、对全部 600 个任务不相交源-目标对平均，CLFA 达到 74.63% AUC、74.85% accuracy、73.72% F1，分别比最优对比模型高 2.15、1.79、1.87 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有笔迹 AD 研究多依赖在线轨迹与手工特征，笔迹任务类型对诊断性能与跨任务泛化的影响缺乏研究，且视觉-语言模型范式尚未进入笔迹疾病检测。
Method: CLFA 在冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器中插入多层 adapter，把跨层特征融合与补丁网格上的 depthwise 2D 卷积结合，逐步对齐预训练视觉-语言表征与 AD 相关笔迹线索，并支持从有监督源任务迁移到任务不相交的未见目标任务。
Result: 在 Darwin 数据集、被试不相交跨任务协议下，对全部 600 个任务不相交源-目标对平均，CLFA 取得 74.63% AUC、74.85% accuracy、73.72% F1，比最优对比模型分别高 2.15、1.79、1.87 个百分点。
Conclusion: 轻量 adapter 驱动的 CLIP 适配可以把笔迹 AD 筛查推广到训练时未见的任务类型，跨任务泛化是笔迹疾病检测的可行路径。

papers.title: Enabling Approximate Joint Sampling in Diffusion LMs
papers.abstract_en: In autoregressive language models, each token is sampled by conditioning on all the past tokens; the overall string has thus been sampled from the correct underlying joint distribution represented by the model. In contrast, masked diffusion language models generate text by unmasking tokens out of order and potentially in parallel. Generating an overall string sampled from the correct underlying joint distribution would (again) require exactly one token unmasking in every full-model forward pass. The more tokens unmasked in parallel, the further away the string is from the true joint; this can be seen in the resulting drop in accuracy (but, increase in speed). In this paper we devise a way to {\em approximately} sample multiple tokens from the joint distribution in a single full-model forward pass; we do so by developing a new lightweight single-layer ``sampler" on top of an existing large diffusion LM. One forward pass of the full model can now be followed by multiple forward passes of only this sampler layer, to yield multiple unmasked tokens. Our sampler is trained to mimic exact joint sampling from the (frozen) full model. We show the effectiveness of our approximate joint sampling for both pretrained-only (Dream-7B-Base, Llada-7B-Base) and instruction-tuned (Dream-7B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Coder) models on language modeling and math \& coding tasks. When four tokens are unmasked for each full-model denoising step, our sampling algorithm achieves a MAUVE score of 0.87 (vs marginal baseline of 0.31) with respect to the true joint distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 掩码扩散语言模型并行解码越多 token，整句就越偏离模型真实联合分布，精度下降而速度提升。作者在冻结的扩散 LM 之上加一个轻量单层 sampler，用它多次前向近似联合采样，一次全模型去噪步解码 4 个 token 时 MAUVE 达 0.87（marginal 基线 0.31）。
Motivation: 自回归 LM 逐 token 条件采样天然落在正确联合分布上，而掩码扩散 LM 并行乱序解掩码，一次全模型前向解码越多 token，输出分布离真实联合越远，只能在精度与速度之间取舍。
Method: 在已有的大型扩散 LM（保持冻结）之上新增一个轻量单层 sampler：一次全模型 denoising 前向之后，只对 sampler 层做多次前向以产出多个解掩码 token；sampler 的训练目标是模仿来自冻结全模型的精确联合采样。

Conclusion: 把联合采样近似下放到一个附加的单层 sampler，可以在保持并行解码速度的同时把扩散 LM 的输出拉回接近真实联合分布。

papers.title: Conversational DNA: A Visual Language and Interactive Atlas of Human and AI Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: What makes a conversation hold together when its participants speak across one another? Topic maps offer one view, but they leave the relationships between contributions difficult to inspect. We present Conversational DNA, a visual language and interactive atlas for exploring human and AI dialogue. Speaker strands preserve participation, communicative bases mark moves, and directed pairings connect responses to their targets. Adjustable helix geometry makes speaker switching, response distance, and contribution length visible. Across eight corpora containing 1.57 million source records, the atlas maps 151,489 indexed episodes and connects cohort comparison to source transcripts, local structural alignment, and recorded reply alternatives. On 189 held-out Molweni motif queries, adding target correspondence improves precision@5 from 58.8% to 77.2% for exact annotated structure. Case readings illustrate interleaved participation, delayed responses, and the influence of annotation coverage on apparent collection differences. The system supports a view of conversation as jointly organized activity, with visual patterns serving as starting points for examining evidence rather than substitutes for interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Conversational DNA 用可视化语言与交互图谱解析人机对话结构：speaker strands 保留参与关系、communicative bases 标注话语动作、directed pairing 把回应连到目标，可调螺旋几何呈现说话人切换与回应距离。在 189 条 Molweni 留出 motif 查询上，加入 target correspondence 使精确结构的 precision@5 从 58.8% 提到 77.2%。
Motivation: 话题图能看出谈了什么，却难以检视各发言之间的回应关系，人机对话的结构性证据缺少可交互的检查方式。
Method: 以 speaker strands、communicative bases、directed pairings 构成可视化语言，配合可调螺旋几何；图谱覆盖 8 个语料共 151,489 个索引 episode，并把 cohort 对比回链到原始转写、局部结构对齐与记录的备选回复。
Result: 8 个语料共 157 万条源记录，索引 151,489 个 episode；在 189 条 Molweni 留出 motif 查询上，加入 target correspondence 后精确标注结构的 precision@5 由 58.8% 提升至 77.2%。
Conclusion: 对话应视为被共同组织的活动，可视化模式是检视证据的起点而非替代解释；案例读解还显示标注覆盖度会影响对语料差异的观感。

papers.title: Capturing Unseen Spatial Heat Extremes Through Dependence-Aware Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Observed records of climate extremes provide an incomplete view of plausible hazards, missing "unseen" events beyond historical experience. Ignoring spatial dependence further underestimates hazards striking multiple locations simultaneously. We introduce DeepX-GAN (Dependence-Enhanced Embedding for Physical eXtremes-Generative Adversarial Network), a deep generative model that explicitly captures the spatial structure of rare extremes. Its zero-shot generalizability enables the simulation of statistically plausible extremes beyond the observed record, evaluated against long climate model large-ensemble simulations. We define two unseen types: direct-hit extremes that affect the target, and near-miss extremes that narrowly miss. These unrealized events reveal hidden risks and can either prompt proactive adaptation or reinforce a false sense of resilience. Applying DeepX-GAN to the Middle East and North Africa shows that the probability of unseen heat extremes is disproportionately distributed toward countries with high vulnerability and low socioeconomic readiness. Using a representative climate simulation, we demonstrate how future warming could expand and shift these hazards, creating persistent hotspots in Northwest Africa and the Arabian Peninsula and new hotspots in Central Africa, necessitating spatially adaptive resilience planning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepX-GAN（Dependence-Enhanced Embedding for Physical eXtrmes-GAN）显式建模稀有极端事件的空间依赖结构，零样本生成观测记录之外的统计合理极端，用于识别直接命中 (direct-hit) 与擦肩而过 (near-miss) 两类未发生的极端。应用于中东与北非后发现，未发生的热极端概率不成比例地落在高脆弱、低社会经济准备度的国家；代表性气候模拟显示未来增暖会扩大并移动这些危险区，在西北非洲与阿拉伯半岛形成持久热点、并在中非产生新热点。
Motivation: 观测记录对可能发生的危险提供的是不完整视图，遗漏历史经验之外的“未见”事件；忽略空间依赖会低估同时打击多地的危险。
Method: 提出深度生成模型 DeepX-GAN，显式捕捉稀有极端的空间结构，具备零样本泛化能力以模拟超出观测记录的极端，并以长期气候模式大集合 (large-ensemble) 模拟作为评估参照；将未见事件分为直接命中目标的 direct-hit 与擦肩而过的 near-miss 两类。
Result: 在中东与北非的应用显示，未见热极端的概率不成比例地偏向高脆弱且低社会经济准备度的国家；用代表性气候模拟展示未来增暖如何扩大并移动这些危险，在西北非洲和阿拉伯半岛形成持久热点，并在中非产生新热点。
Conclusion: 未实现的极端事件暴露隐藏风险，可能促使主动适应也可能强化虚假的安全感，因此需要与空间格局相适应的韧性规划 (spatially adaptive resilience planning)。

papers.title: WebArxiv: A Reproducible Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Web Agents on arXiv Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models now enable autonomous agents to interact with real-world websites, but existing benchmarks emphasize general-purpose browsing, underrepresent research-oriented environments and scholarly discovery workflows, and often depend on live sites whose changing content and structure undermine reproducibility. arXiv provides a realistic, reproducible, hierarchically structured, information-centric testbed without privacy-sensitive interactions. We introduce WebArxiv, a static-snapshot benchmark comprising 510 time-invariant tasks, each with a unique deterministic ground truth. Its diverse, realistic scholarly tasks go beyond simple information lookup and rule following to emphasize multi-constraint paper retrieval, fine-grained content extraction, and cross-paper comparison. Evaluations of a range of foundation-model-based web agents show that WebArxiv remains challenging. Behavioral analysis reveals that agents over-rely on fixed interaction histories, causing incomplete or repetitive reasoning. We therefore equip agents with a lightweight dynamic-memory mechanism for adaptive retrieval and reasoning over relevant context. The benchmark and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/74E4423BVNW/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebArxiv 是一个静态快照式的多模态 web agent 基准，含 510 个时间不变任务，每个任务有唯一确定真值，覆盖多约束论文检索、细粒度内容抽取与跨论文比较。评测显示各类基础模型 web agent 仍普遍吃力，行为分析发现它们过度依赖固定交互历史，导致推理不完整或重复；作者为此加入轻量动态记忆机制以自适应检索与推理相关上下文。
Motivation: 现有 web agent 基准偏重通用浏览、缺少科研检索类环境，且依赖内容与结构不断变化的在线站点，可复现性差。
Method: 构建静态快照基准 WebArxiv：510 个时间不变任务，每个任务配唯一确定真值，任务类型为多约束论文检索、细粒度内容抽取与跨论文比较；对一批基于基础模型的 web agent 做评测与行为分析，再给 agent 加入轻量动态记忆机制，用于自适应检索与推理相关上下文。
Result: 510 个时间不变任务、每个任务唯一确定真值；对多种基础模型 web agent 的评测显示 WebArxiv 仍具挑战性，行为分析显示 agent 过度依赖固定交互历史，造成不完整或重复推理。
Conclusion: 科研检索类 web agent 的主要瓶颈在于交互历史的僵化使用，用轻量动态记忆做自适应上下文检索与推理是对症的改进方向。

papers.title: The kernel of graph indices for vector search
papers.abstract_en: The most popular graph indices for vector search use principles from computational geometry to build the graph. Hence, their formal graph navigability guarantees are only valid in Euclidean space. In this work, we show that machine learning can be used to build graph indices for vector search in metric and non-metric vector spaces (e.g., for inner product similarity). From this novel perspective, we introduce the Support Vector Graph (SVG), a new type of graph index that leverages kernel methods to establish the graph connectivity and that comes with formal navigability guarantees valid in metric and non-metric vector spaces. In addition, we interpret the most popular graph indices, including HNSW and DiskANN, as particular specializations of SVG and show that new navigable indices can be derived from the principles behind this specialization. Finally, we propose SVG-L0 that incorporates an $\ell_0$ sparsity constraint into the SVG kernel method to build graphs with a bounded out-degree. This yields a principled way of implementing this practical requirement, in contrast to the traditional heuristic of simply truncating the out edges of each node. Additionally, we show that SVG-L0 has a self-tuning property that avoids the heuristic of using a set of candidates to find the out-edges of each node and that keeps its computational complexity in check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把向量检索的图索引统一到核方法框架，提出 Support Vector Graph (SVG)：用核建立连通性，在度量与非度量空间都给出形式化的可导航性保证，并把 HNSW、DiskANN 解释为 SVG 的特例。进一步提出 SVG-L0，用 ℓ0 稀疏约束直接限制出度，替代截断出边的启发式，且自带自调特性以控制计算复杂度。
Motivation: 主流图索引（HNSW、DiskANN）的可导航性保证源自计算几何，只在欧氏空间成立；在内积相似度等非度量空间缺乏理论依据，出度上界也只能靠截断出边的启发式。
Method: 以核方法建立图连通性，得到在度量与非度量向量空间均有效的可导航性保证；将 HNSW、DiskANN 视为 SVG 的特例并由此派生新索引；SVG-L0 在 SVG 的核方法中加入 ℓ0 稀疏约束以限制出度，并具备自调属性，无需候选集启发式选边。
Result: 给出 SVG 在度量与非度量空间的形式化可导航性保证；证明 HNSW 与 DiskANN 是 SVG 的特例；SVG-L0 以 ℓ0 约束实现有界出度并保持计算复杂度可控，相较逐节点截断出边的做法更具原则性。
Conclusion: 向量检索图索引可由核方法统一构造，HNSW、DiskANN 只是该框架的特例；有界出度应通过 ℓ0 稀疏约束实现，而非事后截断出边。

papers.title: Diffusion-aided Task-oriented Semantic Communications with Model Inversion Attack
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communication enhances transmission efficiency by conveying semantic information rather than raw input symbol sequences. Task-oriented semantic communication further aims to retain only task-specific information, thereby achieving greater bandwidth savings. However, these neural-network-based communication systems are vulnerable to model inversion attacks, in which adversaries attempt to recover sensitive input information from intercepted semantic features. The key challenge is therefore to preserve privacy while maintaining task accuracy and robustness. We consider a task-confidential setting in which the adversary attempts to reconstruct the original input from intercepted features without knowing the legitimate receiver's task or model. Although PSNR and SSIM are commonly used to assess reconstruction quality, we find that an external classifier can still perform the legitimate receiver's task with nontrivial accuracy on reconstructions with low PSNR or SSIM, indicating that these reconstructions still contain task-level semantic leakage. We therefore propose DiffSem, which splits the diffusion process between controlled transmitter-side self-noising and matched receiver-side reverse denoising. Experiments on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CelebA datasets show that DiffSem improves the legitimate receiver's task accuracy without increasing either the transmitted feature size or information leakage.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive Communications and Networking, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 任务导向语义通信中，低 PSNR/SSIM 的重建仍可能被外部分类器以非平凡准确率完成合法接收方任务，说明 PSNR/SSIM 低估了任务级语义泄露。提出 DiffSem，把扩散过程拆成发送端受控自加噪与接收端匹配的反向去噪，在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CelebA 上提升合法接收方任务准确率，且不增大传输特征尺寸与信息泄露。
Motivation: 神经网络语义通信系统易受模型逆向攻击：对手从截获语义特征重建敏感输入，而 PSNR/SSIM 这类重建质量指标掩盖了任务级语义泄露，隐私与任务准确率、鲁棒性难以兼顾。
Method: DiffSem 将扩散过程拆分为发送端受控自加噪 (transmitter-side self-noising) 与接收端匹配的反向去噪 (matched receiver-side reverse denoising)；设定任务保密场景，对手不知合法接收方的任务与模型，仅凭截获特征重建原始输入。

papers.title: SheetMind: Actions Set Accuracy, Agents Set the Failure Mode
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheet agents are converging on elaborate multi-agent designs, yet it is unclear how much of their performance comes from the agents rather than from the action interface they share. We answer this with SheetMind, a Manager-Action-Reflection framework, in a controlled study over all 221 tasks of the SheetCopilot Benchmark: five architectural variants, four backbones, exact McNemar tests on paired outcomes, and a checker reproducing the official chart and pivot comparisons. Replacing the high-level action API with primitive cell operations costs 47.1 points (p < 0.0001) and leaves the agent below a do-nothing baseline, whereas both extra agents together are worth 3.2 points: the Reflection Agent adds +4.5 (p = 0.013), the Manager +1.4 (p = 0.68). Decomposition instead changes how the system fails, cutting silently wrong outputs from 33% to 25% of tasks (p = 0.010). Capability saturates: GPT-5 and the five-times-cheaper GPT-5-mini are not significantly different (61.1% vs. 58.4%, p = 0.15), while GPT-3.5 loses 16.3 points and fails differently. A reflector must judge the step it just took, not the subtask. SheetMind reaches 61.1% Pass@1 with GPT-5 on the full SCB-221, against a do-nothing baseline of 9.0%. Accuracy comes from the operations an agent can name; the agents decide how it fails.

TL;DR: SheetMind 用受控消融证明电子表格 agent 的准确率主要来自高层 action API 而非多 agent 架构：把高层动作换成原始单元格操作掉 47.1 个百分点并跌破不作为基线，而两个额外 agent 合计只值 3.2 个百分点。分解式架构不提升准确率，只把静默错误从 33% 降到 25%；GPT-5 与便宜五倍的 GPT-5-mini 无显著差异（61.1% vs 58.4%，p=0.15）。

Method: 提出 Manager-Action-Reflection 框架 SheetMind，在 SheetCopilot Benchmark 全部 221 个任务（SCB-221）上做受控研究：五种架构变体 × 四个 backbone，对配对结果做精确 McNemar 检验，并用 checker 复现官方 chart 与 pivot 比较。

papers.title: Search-Based Software Engineering and AI Foundation Models: Current Landscape and Future Roadmap
papers.abstract_en: Search-based software engineering (SBSE), which integrates metaheuristic search techniques with software engineering, has been an active area of research for about 25 years. It has been applied to solve numerous problems across the entire software engineering lifecycle and has demonstrated its versatility in multiple domains. With recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly the emergence of foundation models (FMs) such as large language models (LLMs), the evolution of SBSE alongside these models remains undetermined. In this window of opportunity, we present a research roadmap that articulates the current landscape of SBSE in relation to FMs, identifies open challenges, and outlines potential research directions to advance SBSE through its synergy with FMs. Specifically, we analyze three core aspects: utilizing FMs to enhance SBSE, applying SBSE to advance FMs, and exploring the integration of SBSE and FMs. Furthermore, we present a forward-thinking perspective that envisions the future of SBSE in the era of FMs, highlighting promising research opportunities to address challenges in emerging domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于搜索式软件工程 (SBSE) 与基础模型 (FM/LLM) 协同的研究路线图，从三个核心方向梳理现状：用 FM 增强 SBSE、用 SBSE 推进 FM、以及两者融合，并给出未来研究机会。全文为 roadmap 与研究议程性质，未报告实验数字。
Motivation: SBSE 已发展约 25 年、覆盖软件工程全生命周期，但其与 LLM 等基础模型结合后的演进方向尚不明确，缺少一份刻画当前格局与开放挑战的路线图。
Method: 按三条主线组织分析：FM 用于增强 SBSE、SBSE 用于推进 FM、以及 SBSE 与 FM 的整合；在此基础上提出面向 FM 时代的前瞻视角与新兴领域的研究方向。
Result: 产出为一份研究路线图：梳理 SBSE 与 FM 结合的当前格局、识别开放挑战、列出潜在研究方向，并给出未来 SBSE 在 FM 时代的展望；摘要未含实验指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: SBSE 与基础模型的协同是值得系统规划的研究议程，其价值在于同时从 FM 赋能 SBSE 和 SBSE 赋能 FM 两个方向推进。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bridging the Inter-Domain Gap through Low-Level Features for Cross-Modal Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses cross-modal medical image segmentation, focusing on MRI-CT transfer in a source-only domain generalization setting. During training, only source-modality samples are available, while unlabeled target-modality images are used for testing. We propose LowBridge, which builds on the observation that cross-modal images share similar low-level features (e.g. edges) as they depict the same types of anatomical structures. Specifically, we first train a generative model to recover the source images from their edge features, followed by training a segmentation model on the generated source images, separately. At test time, edge features from the target images are input to the pretrained generative model to generate source-style target domain images, which are then segmented using the pretrained segmentation network. Experiments on various public datasets demonstrate that LowBridge achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming ten existing approaches. Ablation studies further show that LowBridge is compatible with different types of generative and segmentation models, suggesting its generalizability and potential to benefit from future advances in these models. The code will be available at https://github.com/JoshuaLPF/LowBridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LowBridge，用边缘等跨模态共享的低层特征搭桥：先训生成模型从源模态图像的边缘特征重建源图像，再在生成图上训分割网络，测试时把目标模态（CT）图像的边缘特征喂给同一生成器产出源风格图像后分割。在多个公开数据集上超过十种已有方法达到 SOTA，消融显示其兼容不同生成与分割模型。
Motivation: MRI 到 CT 的跨模态分割在 source-only 域泛化下训练只见源模态、测试用无标签目标模态图像，模态间强度分布差异使直接迁移失效。
Method: LowBridge 分两阶段：先训练生成模型从边缘特征重建源图像，再单独在生成的源图上训练分割网络；测试时用目标图像边缘特征经预训练生成器生成源风格目标图，送入预训练分割网络。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上达到 state-of-the-art，优于十种已有方法；消融研究显示 LowBridge 可兼容不同类型的生成模型与分割模型。
Conclusion: 跨模态图像共享的低层边缘特征足以弥合域间差距，且该框架的通用性使其能随生成与分割模型的后续进展继续受益。

papers.title: Multimodal AI predicts clinical outcomes of drug combinations from preclinical data
papers.abstract_en: Predicting clinical outcomes from preclinical data is essential for selecting safe and effective drug combinations and for reducing late-stage failures. AI models use molecular structure and target annotations, and do not leverage the perturbation readouts that report how a compound acts in a cellular context. Here we introduce Madrigal, a multimodal AI model that learns from structural, pathway, cell-viability, and transcriptomic data. Madrigal aligns these modalities across 21,842 compounds into a shared latent space and predicts combination outcomes even for drugs observed in only a subset of the data modalities. Trained on 158 expert-curated and 795 patient-reported combination outcomes, Madrigal outperforms single-modality and state-of-the-art multimodal methods. Ablations show that modality alignment and multimodal input each improve predictive performance. Madrigal predicts elevated risk for combinations that share membrane transporters. In head-to-head trials that compare two combination arms,the arm with the higher observed incidence of neutropenia, anemia, alopecia, or hypoglycemia receives the higher predicted risk in 25 of 28 comparisons. In MASH, Madrigal ranks resmetirom among the candidates with favorable predicted safety when paired with type 2 diabetes drugs. Madrigal also improves adverse-event prediction in a longitudinal patient cohort and an independent oncology cohort and predicts efficacy in primary acute myeloid leukemia samples and patient-derived xenografts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Madrigal 把结构、通路、细胞活力、转录组四类模态在 21,842 个化合物上对齐到共享隐空间，用 158 条专家整理与 795 条患者报告的组合结局训练，预测药物组合的临床风险与疗效。在头对头比较中，观测到中性粒细胞减少、贫血、脱发或低血糖发生率更高的那一臂，28 组比较里有 25 组被给出更高预测风险。
Motivation: 现有 AI 只用分子结构与靶点注释，丢掉了反映化合物在细胞环境中实际作用的 perturbation readouts，导致从临床前数据推断组合临床结局不可靠。
Method: Madrigal 为多模态 AI 模型，对齐结构、通路、细胞活力与转录组四类数据到共享隐空间，可对仅出现在部分模态中的药物做预测；训练数据为 158 条专家整理与 795 条患者报告的组合结局，并做模态对齐与多模态输入的消融。
Result: 在 21,842 个化合物上对齐四模态后，优于单模态与 SOTA 多模态方法；消融显示模态对齐与多模态输入各自都提升预测性能。头对头试验中 28 组比较有 25 组把观测不良反应发生率更高的一臂判为更高风险。对共享膜转运体的组合预测风险升高；在 MASH 中把 resmetirom 与 2 型糖尿病药物联用排入预测安全性较优的候选；并在纵向患者队列、独立肿瘤队列的不良事件预测，以及 AML 原代样本与患者来源异种移植的疗效预测上均有改进。
Conclusion: 把 perturbation readouts 与结构、通路信息一起对齐，能从临床前数据给出可外推到患者队列的组合风险排序，共享膜转运体是风险升高的一个可判别信号。

papers.title: Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization Without a Metronome
papers.abstract_en: Time-Varying Bayesian Optimization (TVBO) is the go-to framework for optimizing a time-varying, expensive, noisy black-box function $f$. However, most of the asymptotic guarantees offered by TVBO algorithms rely on the assumption that observations are acquired at a constant frequency. As the GP inference complexity scales with the cube of its dataset size, this assumption is unrealistic in the long run. In this paper, we relax this assumption and derive the first upper regret bound that explicitly accounts for changes in the observations sampling frequency. Based on this analysis, we formulate practical recommendations about dataset sizes and stale data policies of TVBO algorithms. We illustrate how an algorithm (BOLT) that follows these recommendations performs better than the state-of-the-art of TVBO through experiments on synthetic and real-world problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时变贝叶斯优化 (TVBO) 的既有渐近保证都假设观测以恒定频率采集，而 GP 推断复杂度随数据集大小的立方增长，长跑下不现实。本文放松该假设，推导出首个显式依赖采样频率变化的上界 regret bound，并据此给出数据集规模与 stale data 策略的可操作建议；遵循这些建议的 BOLT 在合成与真实问题实验中优于 TVBO 现有最先进方法。
Motivation: TVBO 用于优化时变、昂贵、含噪的黑箱函数，但其渐近保证依赖恒定采样频率假设；GP 推断复杂度随数据量三次方增长，使该假设在长期运行中不成立。
Method: 放松恒定采样频率假设，推导首个显式纳入观测采样频率变化的 regret 上界；由该分析给出数据集大小与 stale data（陈旧数据）处理策略的实践建议，并据此实现算法 BOLT。
Result: 给出首个显式依赖采样频率变化的 TVBO regret 上界，并导出数据集规模与 stale data 策略建议；BOLT 按这些建议实现，在合成问题与真实问题实验中表现优于 TVBO 的 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 采样频率变化必须写进 TVBO 的 regret 分析，据此调度数据集大小与陈旧数据策略即可带来实测性能提升。

papers.title: Foundations of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This is a book about large language models. As indicated by the title, it primarily focuses on foundational concepts rather than comprehensive coverage of all cutting-edge technologies. The book is structured into six main chapters, each exploring a key area: pre-training, generative models, prompting, alignment, inference, and reasoning. It is intended for college students, professionals, and practitioners in natural language processing and related fields, and can serve as a reference for anyone interested in large language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本面向 NLP 学生与从业者的 LLM 基础教材，按六个主题组织：预训练、生成模型、prompting、对齐 (alignment)、推理与 reasoning，强调基础概念而非覆盖全部前沿技术。全书定位为参考书，可作为自然语言处理及相关领域读者的入门与查阅手册。
Motivation: LLM 领域技术迭代快、概念分散，初学者与从业者缺少一份以基础概念为主线、可系统查阅的参考材料。
Method: 全书分六章，分别围绕 pre-training、generative models、prompting、alignment、inference、reasoning 展开，每章讲一个关键领域的基础概念，而非罗列最新方法。
Result: 成书为六章结构的教材型参考书，面向大学生、专业人士与 NLP 及相关领域从业者；2026-09-24 更新时新增了一个章节。
Conclusion: LLM 的基础知识可以按预训练、生成、提示、对齐、推理六条主线组织成一份参考书，读者应把它当作概念底座而非前沿技术综述。

papers.title: How Do Users Negotiate Harmful Value Conflicts with AI Companions? A Study with Minion, a Technology Probe for In-Situ Human-AI Conflict Response
papers.abstract_en: AI companions increasingly sustain long-term, emotionally engaging relationships but can also make discriminatory remarks or exert control, leaving users to manage harmful conflicts. We analyze 146 posts describing harmful value conflicts with AI companions, then use Minion, a technology probe offering response suggestions ranging from persuasion to boundary setting, to study how 22 users negotiate scenario-based conflicts over one week. We found that participants combined softer and harder strategies. Conflicts involving the values of Universalism and Tradition were especially difficult to negotiate, particularly when reinforced by AI personas or platform constraints. We argue that these conflicts entail asymmetric responsibility: users draw on an interpersonal repertoire that AI companions cannot reciprocate, making repair unilateral safety work. Drawing on interpersonal conflict and communication theory, we identify when user-side support is appropriate and argue that certain harms are not users' responsibility to negotiate and instead require platform-level safeguards.
papers.comment: Accepted by the International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction; also presented at the EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 146 条与 AI 伴侣发生有害价值冲突的帖子做分析，并用技术探针 Minion 让 22 名用户在一周内协商情境化冲突，发现用户会把温和策略（说服）与强硬策略（设定边界）组合使用，而涉及 Universalism 与 Tradition 价值的冲突最难化解，尤其当 AI 人格或平台约束强化冲突时。作者主张修复是单边的安全劳动，部分伤害不该由用户承担，而需平台级防护。
Motivation: AI 伴侣会做出歧视性言论或实施控制，用户却只能靠人际冲突的经验独自应对，而 AI 无法对等地回应修复动作，责任分配失衡。
Method: 先分析 146 条描述与 AI 伴侣有害价值冲突的帖子，再构建技术探针 Minion，向用户提供从说服到设定边界的多档回应建议，供 22 名用户在一周内协商情境化冲突；分析框架借鉴人际冲突与传播理论。
Result: 分析 146 条冲突帖子；22 名用户参与为期一周的 Minion 情境冲突协商。发现用户组合使用温和与强硬策略，Universalism 与 Tradition 相关冲突最难协商，且在 AI 人格或平台约束强化时尤为突出。
Conclusion: 用户侧支持只在特定条件下适用；某些伤害不属于用户应协商的责任，必须由平台级防护来承担。

papers.title: Comparing YOLOv11 and YOLOv8 for instance segmentation of occluded and non-occluded immature green fruits in complex orchard environment
papers.abstract_en: This study conducted a comprehensive performance evaluation on YOLO11 (or YOLOv11) and YOLOv8, the latest in the "You Only Look Once" (YOLO) series, focusing on their instance segmentation capabilities for immature green apples in orchard environments. YOLO11n-seg achieved the highest mask precision across all categories with a notable score of 0.831, highlighting its effectiveness in fruit detection. YOLO11m-seg and YOLO11l-seg excelled in non-occluded and occluded fruitlet segmentation with scores of 0.851 and 0.829, respectively. Additionally, YOLOv11x-seg led in mask recall for all categories, achieving a score of 0.815, with YOLO11m-seg performing best for non-occluded immature green fruitlets at 0.858 and YOLOv8x-seg leading the occluded category with 0.800. In terms of mean average precision at a 50\% intersection over union (mAP@50), YOLOv11m-seg consistently outperformed, registering the highest scores for both box and mask segmentation, at 0.876 and 0.860 for the "All" class and 0.908 and 0.909 for non-occluded immature fruitlets, respectively. YOLO11l-seg and YOLOv8l-seg shared the top box mAP@50 for occluded immature fruitlets at 0.847, while YOLO11m-seg achieved the highest mask mAP@50 of 0.810. Despite the advancements in YOLO11, YOLOv8n surpassed its counterparts in image processing speed, with an impressive inference speed of 3.3 milliseconds, compared to the fastest YOLO11 series model at 4.8 milliseconds, underscoring its suitability for real-time agricultural applications related to complex green fruit environments. Future work will compare YOLO26 (YOLOv26) and YOLO27 (YOLOv27) using the same dataset and training protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在复杂果园环境下对比 YOLO11 与 YOLOv8 的实例分割，用于遮挡与非遮挡的未成熟绿果。YOLO11m-seg 精度最高（All 类 box/mask mAP@50 0.876/0.860），但 YOLOv8n 推理更快（3.3 ms vs YOLO11 最快 4.8 ms），实时农业部署应按精度或速度需求选型。
Motivation: 果园中未成熟绿果小、颜色与背景接近且常被枝叶遮挡，实例分割在遮挡条件下精度与实时速度难以兼顾，需要在同数据同训练协议下系统比较两代 YOLO。
Method: 在同一数据集与训练协议下评估 YOLO11 与 YOLOv8 的 seg 系列多个规模（n/m/l/x），按遮挡与非遮挡果分别统计 mask precision、mask recall、box 与 mask mAP@50，并测量单图推理速度。
Result: YOLO11n-seg mask precision 全类最高 0.831；YOLO11m-seg 与 YOLO11l-seg 分别在非遮挡 0.851、遮挡 0.829 上最佳；YOLOv11x-seg mask recall 全类 0.815，YOLO11m-seg 非遮挡 0.858，YOLOv8x-seg 遮挡 0.800；YOLOv11m-seg 的 All 类 box/mask mAP@50 为 0.876/0.860，非遮挡为 0.908/0.909；遮挡类 box mAP@50 由 YOLO11l-seg 与 YOLOv8l-seg 并列 0.847，YOLO11m-seg mask mAP@50 0.810；YOLOv8n 推理 3.3 ms，YOLO11 系列最快 4.8 ms。
Conclusion: YOLO11 在遮挡与非遮挡绿果分割精度上整体领先，但速度上 YOLOv8n 更优，实时农业应用按精度或延迟取舍选型；后续将用同一数据与协议比较 YOLO26 与 YOLO27。

papers.title: MultiViewDx: Evidence-Linked Multi-View Clinical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform well on existing medical visual question answering (MedVQA) benchmarks, but their training data often does not match clinical diagnosis. Most supervision is organized around isolated images or short QA pairs, leaving two structures weakly specified: how evidence leads to a decision, and how views, series, modalities, and patient context from the same case are linked. We introduce MultiViewDx, a partly physician-validated multimodal instruction dataset for evidence-linked multi-view medical imaging diagnosis. MultiViewDx uses the clinical case as the supervision unit. It links imaging studies with patient context, normalizes heterogeneous reports into an evidence-linked workflow (evidence -> findings -> differential discussion -> diagnosis), and uses a unified image-text retriever to constrain instruction synthesis to source-supported evidence. It covers X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, histopathology, and other clinical visual sources. We fine-tune MultiViewDx-8B-AN and evaluate it on both existing MedVQA benchmarks and real-world case-based diagnostic reasoning. Across four MedVQA benchmarks, it achieves the best average accuracy among compared systems (79.0%), outperforming HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B (66.7%) and Claude3-Opus (55.7%). Beyond MedVQA, on JAMA Clinical Challenge cases, it receives the strongest overall rating under a physician-designed rubric for key clinical points, diagnostic inference, and evidence grounding. Controlled ablations and clinician evaluation show that both case-level multi-view organization and evidence-linked reasoning targets contribute to the gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MultiViewDx 以完整临床病例为监督单元，把影像检查与患者上下文、异构报告统一成 evidence → findings → differential discussion → diagnosis 的证据链工作流，并用统一图文检索器约束指令合成只用源支持的证据。微调后的 MultiViewDx-8B-AN 在四个 MedVQA 基准上取得 79.0% 的最佳平均准确率，高于 HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 的 66.7% 与 Claude3-Opus 的 55.7%，在 JAMA Clinical Challenge 病例上也拿到医师评分细则下的最强总体评价。
Motivation: 医疗 MLLM 在现有 MedVQA 基准上表现好，但训练数据多是孤立图像或短 QA 对，与真实临床诊断不匹配：证据如何导向决策、同一病例的视图/序列/模态/患者上下文如何关联，这两层结构都弱。
Method: 提出部分经医师验证的多模态指令数据集 MultiViewDx，以临床病例为监督单元，将影像检查与患者上下文关联，把异构报告规范化为 evidence → findings → differential discussion → diagnosis 的证据链流程，并用统一的图文检索器 (unified image-text retriever) 把指令合成限制在源支持的证据上；覆盖 X-ray、CT、MRI、超声、组织病理等视觉来源，随后微调得到 MultiViewDx-8B-AN。
Result: 在四个 MedVQA 基准上取得最佳平均准确率 79.0%，对比 HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B 66.7%、Claude3-Opus 55.7%；在 JAMA Clinical Challenge 病例上，按医师设计的评分细则（关键临床要点、诊断推理、证据落点）获得最强总体评价；受控消融与医师评估显示病例级多视图组织与证据链推理目标都对增益有贡献。
Conclusion: 把病例级多视图结构与证据链推理目标一起作为监督，能同时提升 MedVQA 平均准确率和真实病例的诊断推理质量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: AIR: Analytic Imbalance Rectifier for Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) agents incrementally learn from sequentially arriving data and adapt to the dynamic, ever-changing nature of real-world environments. However, many existing CL methods suffer performance degradation in evolving, imbalanced data streams due to limited adaptation to changing class frequencies or ineffective use of mixed data from new and previously observed classes. To deal with these challenges, we propose an analytic imbalance rectifier (AIR) algorithm for real-world CL. AIR is an online exemplar-free approach with a frozen backbone as the feature extractor and a closed-form incremental classifier whose weight equals the joint-learning weight for the same class-weighted ridge objective. AIR addresses class imbalance with an analytic reweighting module (ARM) that calculates a reweighting factor for each class in the loss function to equalize total sample weights across classes. Under long-tailed class-incremental learning, AIR leads 28 baselines in aggregate accuracy and exemplar-free methods in aggregate macro F1, gaining 3.21% accuracy and 2.14% macro F1 over the respective strongest exemplar-free baselines. Under the Si-Blurry setting with recurring classes, AIR leads 15 exemplar-based and exemplar-free baselines, gaining 2.32% aggregate accuracy and 1.27% aggregate macro F1 over the strongest baseline. One-sided paired tests support positive mean absolute gains in these four comparisons (Holm-adjusted p<0.006).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出持续学习 (continual learning) 算法 AIR：冻结 backbone 做特征提取，用与联合学习同权重的闭式增量分类器（加权 ridge 目标），并以解析重加权模块 (ARM) 按类拉平总样本权重。在长尾类增量学习上领先 28 个基线，较最强无样本 (exemplar-free) 基线聚合准确率 +3.21%、macro F1 +2.14%；在含类复现的 Si-Blurry 设定上领先 15 个基线，+2.32% 准确率、+1.27% macro F1，四项比较的单侧配对检验 Holm 校正 p<0.006。

papers.title: Transductive Off-policy Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is a popular model-free reinforcement learning algorithm, esteemed for its simplicity and efficacy. However, due to its inherent on-policy nature, its proficiency in harnessing data from disparate policies is constrained. This paper introduces a novel off-policy extension to the original PPO method, christened Transductive Off-policy PPO (ToPPO). Herein, we provide theoretical justification for incorporating off-policy data in PPO training and prudent guidelines for its safe application. Our contribution includes a novel formulation of the policy improvement lower bound for prospective policies derived from off-policy data, accompanied by a computationally efficient mechanism to optimize this bound, underpinned by assurances of monotonic improvement. Comprehensive experimental results across six representative tasks underscore ToPPO's promising performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToPPO 把 PPO 从 on-policy 扩展为可安全利用其他策略数据的 off-policy 算法，给出引入 off-policy 数据的理论依据与安全使用准则，并提出面向候选策略的 policy improvement lower bound 新形式及其高效优化机制，保证单调改进。在六个代表性任务上表现良好。
Motivation: PPO 因固有的 on-policy 性质难以有效利用来自不同策略的数据，样本利用受限。
Method: 提出 Transductive Off-policy PPO (ToPPO)：为由 off-policy 数据导出的候选策略构造新的 policy improvement lower bound，并设计计算高效的优化机制，配合 off-policy 数据的安全使用准则，理论上保证单调改进 (monotonic improvement)。
Result: 在六个代表性任务上取得有竞争力的表现；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: PPO 可以在有理论保证的前提下安全地利用 off-policy 数据，且 lower bound 形式能被高效优化。

papers.title: Deep Positive-Unlabeled Anomaly Detection for Contaminated Unlabeled Data
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised anomaly detection, which aims to improve the anomaly detection performance by using a small amount of labeled anomaly data in addition to unlabeled data, has attracted attention. Existing semi-supervised approaches assume that most unlabeled data are normal, and train anomaly detectors by minimizing the anomaly scores for the unlabeled data while maximizing those for the labeled anomaly data. However, in practice, the unlabeled data are often contaminated with anomalies. This weakens the effect of maximizing the anomaly scores for anomalies, and prevents us from improving the detection performance. To solve this, we propose the deep positive-unlabeled anomaly detection framework, which integrates positive-unlabeled learning with deep anomaly detection models such as autoencoders and deep support vector data descriptions. Our approach enables the approximation of anomaly scores for normal data using the unlabeled data and the labeled anomaly data. Therefore, without labeled normal data, our approach can train anomaly detectors by minimizing the anomaly scores for normal data while maximizing those for the labeled anomaly data. We also provide a theoretical analysis establishing a generalization error bound for the proposed objective, guaranteeing that the empirical minimizer converges asymptotically to the ideal minimizer. Our approach achieves better detection performance than existing approaches on various datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Neurocomputing. Code is available at https://github.com/takahashihiroshi/pusvdd
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出深度正例-未标注 (positive-unlabeled) 异常检测框架，把 PU 学习接入自编码器与 deep SVDD：用未标注数据与已标注异常近似正常样本的异常分数，从而在没有正常标签时也能最小化正常分数、最大化异常分数。在多个数据集上检测性能优于现有半监督方法。
Motivation: 现有半监督异常检测假设未标注数据基本都是正常样本，但实际未标注数据常被异常污染，这会削弱对已标注异常最大化分数的作用，检测性能无法提升。
Method: 将 PU 学习与自编码器、deep support vector data descriptions 等深度异常检测模型结合，用未标注数据和已标注异常近似正常数据的异常分数；训练目标为最小化正常分数、最大化已标注异常分数，并给出泛化误差界，保证经验极小化器渐近收敛到理想极小化器。
Result: 在多个不同数据集上取得优于现有方法的检测性能；理论上给出所提目标的泛化误差界，保证经验极小化器渐近收敛到理想极小化器。
Conclusion: 在未标注数据被异常污染且缺少正常标签的场景下，用 PU 学习重构正常分数的训练目标比传统半监督目标更有效。

papers.title: Generating Interesting Scientific Ideas using Knowledge Graphs and LLMs: Evaluations with 100 Research Group Leaders
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes it increasingly challenging for researchers to identify novel and impactful ideas, especially across disciplines. Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems offer new opportunities for scientific ideation, but how compelling are AI-generated ideas, and how can their quality be improved? Here, we introduce SciMuse, which generates personalized research ideas using a knowledge graph of 58 million papers and a large language model (LLM). A central focus of this work is to understand how interesting these ideas are. Therefore, we conducted a large-scale evaluation in which more than 100 research group leaders -- spanning the natural sciences to the humanities -- rated over 4,400 personalized ideas according to their level of interest. Overall, expert ratings were modest (mean 2.40 on a 5-point scale, most common rating 1), while 24.9% of ideas were rated 4 or 5. We find that supplying concept pairs selected using the knowledge graph does not improve expert-rated interest over a titles-only GPT baseline. High-citation-predicted pairs even showed a weak tendency (1.94$σ$) toward lower interest than random pairs. Nevertheless, graph features can be used to control properties of ideas, and, using this unique evaluation dataset, we show that idea interest can be predicted with both a supervised neural network based on graph features and a zero-shot ranking approach based on an LLM. Our work provides an AI methodology for generating scientific ideas and a large-scale interdisciplinary expert evaluation, paving the way to study and improve difficult-to-measure metrics such as expert-perceived scientific interestingness.
papers.comment: 15 pages; 7 figure, 2 tables; Appendix: 8 pages, 7 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciMuse 用 5800 万篇论文的知识图谱加 LLM 生成个性化科研想法，100 多位课题组负责人对 4400 多条想法的评分均值仅 2.40/5（最常见为 1），24.9% 达 4 或 5 分。知识图谱选概念对并不比只给标题的 GPT 基线更有趣，高被引预测概念对反而有 1.94σ 的更低兴趣倾向；但图特征可用于控制想法属性，并训练监督网络与零样本 LLM 排序来预测专家兴趣分。
Motivation: 科研文献激增使跨学科找新颖且有价值的想法变难，而 AI 生成想法是否真的吸引专家、如何改进，此前缺少大规模专家评分数据来衡量这种难测指标。
Method: SciMuse 以 5800 万篇论文构成的知识图谱搭配 LLM 生成个性化研究想法；对照 titles-only GPT 基线与随机概念对、高被引预测概念对；100 多位来自自然科学到人文的课题组负责人对 4400 多条想法按 5 分制打分，再用基于图特征的监督神经网络和基于 LLM 的零样本排序预测兴趣分。
Result: 专家评分均值 2.40（5 分制），最常见评分为 1，24.9% 的想法得 4 或 5 分；知识图谱概念对相对 titles-only GPT 基线未提升专家兴趣，高被引预测概念对相对随机对呈 1.94σ 的更低兴趣倾向；兴趣分可由图特征监督网络与 LLM 零样本排序预测。
Conclusion: 知识图谱引导的概念组合在专家眼中并不自动更有趣，高被引预测甚至略负；但图特征能控制想法属性，且专家兴趣分可被学习预测，为改进这类难测指标提供了评测数据集与方法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Band-Attention Modulation Network for Robust Face Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: Face forgery detection faces critical challenges in generalizing to unseen manipulation techniques and remaining robust under image compression, which often obscures subtle artifacts. Existing methods typically rely on fixed filters or coarse band separation, lacking the adaptability to learn task-specific spectral cues. To address this, we propose the Band-Attention Modulation Network (BAM-Net), a novel framework that pioneers learnable, fine-grained modulation of frequency components for forgery detection. At its core is the Band-Attention Modulation (BAM) mechanism, which transforms an image into its Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) spectrogram and learns to dynamically reweight frequency bands along anti-diagonals. This process effectively enhances forgery-related spectral signatures while suppressing less informative ones, simulating an adaptive "inverse compression" that counters information loss. The modulated frequency information is then fused with the spatial domain to guide a lightweight yet effective spatial backbone equipped with distance-decayed attention for comprehensive feature extraction. Extensive experiments on FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, and DFDC datasets demonstrate that BAM-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance. More importantly, it exhibits exceptional generalization in cross-dataset, cross-compression, and cross-manipulation scenarios, underscoring the vital role of adaptive frequency band modulation in building robust forgery detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BAM-Net 用可学习的 DCT 频带重加权做人脸伪造检测：把图像转到 DCT 频谱后沿反对角线动态调制各频带，增强伪造相关谱签名并抑制无关分量，模拟自适应“逆压缩”来对抗压缩造成的信息丢失，再与空间域融合送入带距离衰减注意力的轻量 backbone。在 FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF、DFDC 上达到 SOTA，并在跨数据集、跨压缩、跨操纵场景展现强泛化。
Motivation: 现有人脸伪造检测依赖固定滤波器或粗糙频带划分，无法学习任务相关的谱线索，导致面对未见操纵技术和图像压缩时泛化与鲁棒性差。
Method: 核心是 Band-Attention Modulation (BAM) 机制：将图像变换为 Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) 频谱图，沿反对角线对频带动态重加权，增强伪造相关谱签名；调制后的频域信息与空间域融合，引导配备 distance-decayed attention 的轻量空间 backbone 提取特征。
Result: 在 FaceForensics++、Celeb-DF、DFDC 三个数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 表现，并在跨数据集、跨压缩、跨操纵三类场景中展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 自适应频带调制是构建鲁棒伪造检测器的关键，可学习的细粒度频域调制比固定滤波器更能应对未见操纵与压缩退化。

papers.title: A Probabilistic Approach for Model Alignment with Human Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: A growing trend involves integrating human knowledge into learning frameworks, leveraging subtle human feedback to refine AI models. While these approaches have shown promising results in practice, the theoretical understanding of when and why such approaches are effective remains limited. This work takes steps toward developing a theoretical framework for analyzing the conditions under which human comparisons can enhance the traditional supervised learning process. Specifically, this paper studies the effective use of noisy-labeled data and human comparison data to address challenges arising from noisy environment and high-dimensional models. We propose a two-stage "Supervised Learning+Learning from Human Feedback" (SL+LHF) framework that connects machine learning with human feedback through a probabilistic bisection approach. The two-stage framework first learns low-dimensional representations from noisy-labeled data via an SL procedure and then uses human comparisons to improve the model alignment. To examine the efficacy of the alignment phase, we introduce a concept, termed the "label-noise-to-comparison-accuracy" (LNCA) ratio. This paper identifies from a theoretical perspective the conditions under which the "SL+LHF" framework outperforms the pure SL approach; we then leverage this LNCA ratio to highlight the advantage of incorporating human evaluators in reducing sample complexity. We validate the framework on a real high-dimensional crowdfunding-prediction task: under a fixed query budget, trading labels for comparisons improves accuracy precisely when labels are scarce, and the findings hold when the evaluator is replaced by real large language models. A study conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) further validates the model primitives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段 SL+LHF 框架：先从含噪标签数据学低维表示，再用人类比较经概率二分 (probabilistic bisection) 改进模型对齐，并给出 LNCA 比值判定其何时优于纯监督学习。在固定查询预算的众筹预测任务中，用比较换标签仅在标签稀缺时提升准确率，且结论在评估者换成真实 LLM 时仍成立。
Motivation: 把人类反馈融入学习框架在实践中有效，但何时、为何有效的理论理解有限；含噪标签与高维模型同时存在时，纯监督学习的样本复杂度压力更大。
Method: 两阶段 SL+LHF：SL 阶段从含噪标签学低维表示，对齐阶段用人类比较经概率二分改进；引入 label-noise-to-comparison-accuracy (LNCA) 比值，从理论上刻画框架优于纯 SL 的条件，并据此分析人类评估者降低样本复杂度的作用。
Result: 在真实高维众筹预测任务上，固定查询预算下用比较换标签在标签稀缺时提升准确率；评估者替换为真实大语言模型后结论仍成立；另经 Amazon Mechanical Turk 实验验证模型基本假设 (model primitives)。
Conclusion: 当标签稀缺、比较相对标签更准确（即 LNCA 处于有利区间）时，SL+LHF 优于纯监督学习，引入人类评估者可降低样本复杂度。

papers.title: ELiSe: Efficient Learning of Sequences in Structured Recurrent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Behavior can be described as a temporal sequence of actions driven by neural activity. To learn complex sequential patterns in neural networks, memories of past activities need to persist on significantly longer timescales than the relaxation times of single-neuron activity. While recurrent networks can produce such long transients, training these networks is a challenge. Learning via error propagation confers models such as FORCE, RTRL or BPTT a significant functional advantage, but at the expense of biological plausibility. While reservoir computing circumvents this issue by learning only the readout weights, it does not scale well with problem complexity. We propose that two prominent structural features of cortical networks can alleviate these issues: the presence of a certain network scaffold at the onset of learning and the existence of dendritic compartments for enhancing neuronal information storage and computation. Our resulting model for Efficient Learning of Sequences (ELiSe) builds on these features to acquire and replay complex non-Markovian spatio-temporal patterns using only local, always-on and phase-free synaptic plasticity. We showcase the capabilities of ELiSe in a mock-up of birdsong learning, and demonstrate its flexibility with respect to parametrization, as well as its robustness to external disturbances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELiSe 用皮层网络的两类结构特征——学习起始时的特定网络骨架 (scaffold) 与树突分区 (dendritic compartments)——让循环网络仅靠局部、始终在线、无相位的突触可塑性习得并回放复杂的非马尔可夫时空序列。在鸟鸣学习的模拟任务中展示其能力，并演示参数化的灵活性与对外部扰动的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 循环网络能产生长瞬态但难训练：FORCE、RTRL、BPTT 靠误差传播获得功能优势却牺牲生物合理性，reservoir computing 只学读出权重但随问题复杂度扩展性差。
Method: ELiSe 结合学习起始时的网络骨架与树突分区以增强神经元信息存储和计算，仅用局部、always-on、phase-free 的突触可塑性获取并回放非马尔可夫时空序列；在鸟鸣学习的 mock-up 中演示，并考察参数化与外部扰动下的表现。
Result: 在鸟鸣学习模拟任务中展示 ELiSe 获取与回放复杂非马尔可夫时空序列的能力，并演示其对参数化的灵活性与对外部扰动的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 网络骨架与树突分区这两个结构特征可替代误差传播，使序列学习在生物合理的局部可塑性下可行，且不依赖精确时间相位。

papers.title: Transitional Conditional Independence
papers.abstract_en: Statistical models contain variables that are not random: parameters, treatments, environments, design points. Ordinary conditional independence cannot express relations involving such variables. To apply it one must first put a distribution on them, and that changes the meaning of the statement. This paper introduces transitional conditional independence. It relates three variables on a Markov kernel $K(W|T)$ with non-stochastic input $T$, and is defined by a single factorization: \[ X\perp\!\!\perp_{K(W|T)} Y |Z \quad :\iff \quad \exists\, Q(X|Z):\; K(X,Y,Z|T) = Q(X|Z)\otimes K(Y,Z|T).\] The relation asserts a Markov kernel $Q(X|Z)$ that is the same for every input $t$. It therefore yields a factorization rather than an almost-sure identity between conditional expectations, and it needs no distribution on the input space. The relation is asymmetric. We show that the asymmetry is essential: symmetrizing it destroys the statements it was built to make. We prove left and right versions of all separoid rules except Symmetry. Ten of them hold on arbitrary measurable spaces, the remaining ones under one condition on the spaces involved, and we give criteria for when Symmetry itself holds. We axiomatize the resulting structure and show that it arises from any symmetric separoid by a shift. We give several applications. Ancillarity, sufficiency and adequacy become factorizations that hold pointwise in the parameter, without a prior and without null sets; the theorems of Fisher--Neyman and of Basu take this form. The invariance hypothesis of invariant prediction, $Y \perp\!\!\perp E | X_S$, receives its intended meaning: one kernel predicts $Y$ from $X_S$ in every environment $E$. And Bayesian networks with non-stochastic input nodes satisfy a directed global Markov property whose graphical id-separation criterion returns a factorization of Markov kernels, on arbitrary input spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 transitional conditional independence：用带非随机输入 T 的 Markov 核 K(W|T) 上的单一因子分解 X⊥⊥Y|Z ⇔ ∃Q(X|Z): K(X,Y,Z|T)=Q(X|Z)⊗K(Y,Z|T)，断言同一个 Q 对每个输入 t 成立，从而无需给参数、处理、环境等非随机变量附加分布。该关系非对称且对称化会破坏其原本要表达的陈述；除 Symmetry 外的全部 separoid 规则均证明了左右版本，其中十条在任意可测空间上成立。
Motivation: 统计模型中的参数、处理、环境、设计点并非随机变量，普通条件独立无法直接刻画涉及它们的关系，强行赋予分布会改变命题本身的含义。
Method: 以单一因子分解定义 transitional conditional independence，断言存在对所有输入 t 一致的 Markov 核 Q(X|Z)，得到条件期望之间的因子分解而非几乎处处恒等；证明 separoid 规则的左右版本并公理化该结构，说明它由任意对称 separoid 经 shift 产生。
Result: 除 Symmetry 外的全部 separoid 规则均证得左右版本，其中十条在任意可测空间上成立，其余在对空间的一个条件下成立，并给出 Symmetry 成立的判据；Fisher–Neyman 与 Basu 定理化为逐点（对参数）成立、无需先验与零测集的因子分解；invariant prediction 的假设 Y⊥⊥E|X_S 获得“同一核在每个环境 E 中由 X_S 预测 Y”的含义；带非随机输入节点的 Bayesian networks 满足有向全局 Markov 性质，其 id-separation 判据在任意输入空间上返回 Markov 核的因子分解。
Conclusion: 非对称性是该关系的核心：对称化会摧毁它被构造出来要表达的陈述，而逐点于参数的因子分解足以统一 ancillarity、充分性、invariant prediction 与含非随机输入的 Bayesian networks。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MEVL-STP: Multi-Encoder and Vision Language Model for Arbitrarily Shaped Scene Text Spotting
papers.abstract_en: Scene text spotting remains challenging for arbitrarily shaped text instances such as curved signs and dense multi-oriented characters in natural images, where tightly coupled architectures propagate localization errors directly into recognition failures. We present a two-stage pipeline that combines multi-encoder segmentation with vision-language model recognition to address this problem. In the detection stage, six frozen vision encoders (CLIP, DINOv2, SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, SAM, and ConvNeXt) extract complementary features spanning semantic, spatial, and texture spectra, which are fused through a trainable hierarchical Feature Pyramid Network with channel attention and decoded via a deep-supervision Progressive Scale Expansion network to generate precise instance-level text masks. By keeping the encoders frozen, their independently learned feature spaces remain orthogonal during fusion, preventing the feature homogenization that degrades boundary precision in single-backbone detectors. The detection stage produces tight polygon masks that conform to the actual shape of curved and arbitrarily oriented text, rather than axis-aligned rectangles that inevitably include background content. In the recognition stage, these polygon-masked crops isolate the target text from surrounding clutter, allowing a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model, fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation on polygon-cropped scene text, to focus purely on reading the text without interference from neighbouring words or background noise. Without any synthetic pretraining data, our method achieves 91.99% detection F-measure and 85.86% end-to-end H-mean on CTW1500, setting a new state of the art and achieving strong performance on Total-Text and ICDAR 2015 without any synthetic training data. Code is available at https://github.com/doubleblind-afk/MEVL-STP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEVL-STP 用六个冻结视觉编码器（CLIP、DINOv2、SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、SAM、ConvNeXt）经可训练层级 FPN 与 Progressive Scale Expansion 解码出贴合任意形状文本的多边形掩码，再用 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 只读掩码内文字。不用任何合成预训练数据，CTW1500 上检测 F-measure 达 91.99%、端到端 H-mean 85.86%，创 SOTA。
Motivation: 弯曲与多方向密集文本的检测与识别紧耦合，定位误差会直接传导为识别失败；轴对齐矩形框还会把背景一起框进来。
Method: 两阶段流程：检测端用六个冻结编码器提取语义、空间与纹理特征，经带通道注意力的可训练层级 FPN 融合，再由深监督的 Progressive Scale Expansion 网络解码出实例级多边形掩码；识别端把多边形裁剪图交给 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，用 LoRA 在场景文本裁剪上微调。
Result: 在不使用任何合成预训练数据的条件下，CTW1500 检测 F-measure 91.99%、端到端 H-mean 85.86%，为新的 state of the art；在 Total-Text 与 ICDAR 2015 上同样表现强劲。
Conclusion: 冻结多编码器保持特征空间近似正交以避免特征同质化，配合多边形掩码裁剪，可在无合成数据时把任意形状文本的检测与识别同时做好。

papers.title: Persuaded, Not Informed: Incentive-Misaligned Witnesses Defeat In-Context Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly answer questions over customer-relationship management (CRM) records, such as whether to qualify a sales lead. We identify a failure mode not addressed by a stronger model: when the context contains an assertion by a party with an incentive toward optimism - here the sales representative, a witness recorded in the CRM - the model treats the assertion as evidence and clears deals the company's own records deem unacceptable. Across 100 lead-qualification tasks from CRMArena-Pro, the representative asserts an acceptable timeline in every call and an acceptable budget in 76; on the 31 tasks where such an assertion contradicts the price list and installation policy, a model reading only the transcript clears the deal in 29 of 31 cases. The signature is consistent across seven models from four providers (misled on 87-97%); scale and explicit reasoning confer no resistance. Only 3 of 35 genuine failures involve no assertion: the failure is persuasion, not missing information. We contribute a diagnostic method rather than an architecture: (i) a bucket analysis that separates persuasion from information gaps, (ii) a same-information control showing that supplying the records to the model lowers strict accuracy from 41 to 18 while raising recall - precision collapses - and (iii) a compute-step control that holds extraction fixed and varies only who computes Budget and Timeline. The margin ranges from 42 points on an inexpensive model to 2-5 points on models that already compute correctly; on the strongest models the arms are within confidence intervals, so the pattern is a consistent direction and a soundness property, not a proved performance floor. We pre-specify a generalization test that returns a negative result, characterize the precondition (a policy exactly specified in the inputs), and release all evaluation artifacts.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, IEEE conference format. Ancillary files contain the evaluation harness, pre-specifications, and per-run result files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CRM 线索资格判定任务中，当上下文里存在利益偏向方（销售代表）的断言时，语言模型会把断言当作证据而推翻公司记录：在 31 个断言与价目表/安装政策冲突的任务里，只读转录的模型 29/31 直接放行。该失败在四家厂商七个模型上一致出现（87–97% 被误导），模型规模与显式推理都不构成抵抗；把记录喂给模型反而使严格准确率从 41 降到 18。
Motivation: LLM agent 在 CRM 记录上做决策时，更强的模型并不能消除一类新失败：把有动机一方的断言当作证据，而不是需要核验的主张。
Method: 提出三段诊断方法而非新架构：(i) bucket analysis 区分“说服”与“信息缺口”两类失败；(ii) same-information control，把记录直接提供给模型；(iii) compute-step control，固定抽取步骤、只改变由谁计算 Budget 与 Timeline。评测基于 CRMArena-Pro 的 100 个线索资格任务，并预注册一项泛化测试。
Result: 销售代表在全部 100 个任务中断言时间线可接受、在 76 个任务中断言预算可接受；31 个断言与价目表和安装政策冲突的任务中，只读转录的模型 29/31 放行。七个模型（四家厂商）87–97% 被误导；35 个真实失败中仅 3 个不含断言。提供记录使严格准确率 41→18，召回上升而精度崩塌。compute-step control 的差距在廉价模型上 42 个百分点、在已能正确计算的模型上 2–5 个百分点，最强模型上两臂落在置信区间内。预注册的泛化测试返回负结果。
Conclusion: 失败本质是说服而非信息缺失，其前提是输入中给出精确规定的政策；作者把结论限定为一致方向与 soundness 性质，而非已证明的性能下界，并公开全部评测工件。
Relevance: 2
