papers.title: Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Structural Governance through Role-Scoped Capability Delivery
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle to scale safely when exposed to vast enterprise toolsets. Providing an agent with access to every internal tool leads to oversized context windows, degraded tool selection, and severe governance vulnerabilities - as system policies defined purely in prompts remain probabilistic advice rather than hard constraints. Existing mitigations, such as multi-agent domain delegation, decentralize audit logs and fail to guarantee policy compliance across sessions. We introduce skilder, a framework that packages capabilities into roles: bundles of skills, tools, and instructions, together with the limits that bound them. An agent begins with a minimal role catalog, learns the roles a task requires, and receives each role's skills, instructions, and tools through a single MCP server. Because tools reach the agent only inside learned skills, the same server enforces the scope of what was learned deterministically. We evaluate skilder against flat-context tool selection and multi-agent orchestration across 13 tasks using six models (10 runs each). Our results show that, when models completed discovery and issued a governed call, the skilder simulated authorization layer enforced governance boundaries: no unauthorized tool call or parameter violation (e.g., a spending-limit breach) executed. Aggregate task pass rates also reflect whether each model followed the discovery protocol and satisfied response-quality checks; those misses are not authorization failures. Furthermore, by allowing agents to dynamically acquire cross-role capabilities mid-task, skilder preserves problem-solving flexibility while providing hard system-level enforcement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: skilder 把企业工具集打包成 role（skills、tools、instructions 及其边界），agent 从最小 role 目录起步、按任务渐进学习所需 role，工具只能经已学 skill 进入，从而由单一 MCP server 确定性地强制作用域。在 13 个任务、6 个模型、每模型 10 次运行的评测中，凡完成 discovery 并发出受治理调用的情形，均无未授权工具调用或参数越界（如 spending-limit breach）被执行。
Motivation: 把全部内部工具直接暴露给 LLM agent 会造成上下文膨胀、工具选择退化和治理漏洞，prompt 层策略只是概率性建议而非硬约束；多 agent 领域委派又把审计日志分散，跨会话无法保证合规。
Method: skilder 将能力封装为 role（skills、tools、instructions 加边界限制），agent 从最小 role 目录开始按任务渐进发现所需 role，经单一 MCP server 注入该 role 的技能与指令；由于工具只能在已学 skill 内到达 agent，同一 server 确定性地强制已学范围，并支持任务中途动态获取跨 role 能力。评测对比 flat-context 工具选择与 multi-agent orchestration，覆盖 13 个任务、6 个模型、每模型 10 次运行。
Result: 在 13 个任务、6 个模型、每模型 10 次运行下，凡模型完成 discovery 并发出受治理调用，skilder 的模拟授权层均未执行任何未授权工具调用或参数违规（例如 spending-limit breach）；聚合任务通过率还反映模型是否遵循 discovery 协议与响应质量检查，这些失败不属于授权失败。
Conclusion: 把工具访问收敛为按 role 交付的已学 skill，可以在保持任务中途跨 role 灵活性的同时，把 prompt 层的软策略变成系统级硬约束。

papers.title: Driving Epidemic Models with AI Agents: the Epydemix Agent Framework
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence agents based on large language models provide convenient natural language interfaces to scientific software, but reliability is not automatic. Here we introduce the Epydemix Agent Framework, an additive layer over Epydemix, an open-source Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modeling. The framework extends the library with four capabilities to facilitate interaction with an AI agent: discovery of available models and parameters, preventive validation of a declarative scenario specification, execution through tested library code, and inspectability of results. These capabilities let an agent handle the entire modeling process, from the natural-language description of the scenario to quantitative results, figures, and interpretation of findings without writing custom code. Each step reads input files and saves results in a separate output bundle, making the process auditable and reproducible. First, we show the end-to-end workflow with a case study comparing vaccination strategies for a novel respiratory virus. Second, we assessed the framework across 50 agent sessions and five modeling tasks by comparing the agent use of the framework against the direct use of the Python interface. The framework reduced turns, output tokens, and cost on most tasks, unless it trades resources for per-point reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Epydemix Agent Framework 在开源随机房室流行病模型库 Epydemix 之上加一层 AI agent 能力，让 LLM agent 从自然语言场景描述一路走到定量结果、图表与解释而无需写自定义代码。在 50 个 agent 会话、5 个建模任务的对照中，相比直接调用 Python 接口，该框架在多数任务上减少了对话轮数、输出 token 与成本，代价是换取逐点可复现性。
Motivation: LLM agent 调用科学软件时可靠性不会自动成立：模型与参数不可见、场景规格易错、执行过程不可审计，导致自然语言到定量结果的链路难以复现。
Method: 在 Epydemix（开源 Python 随机房室流行病建模库）之上加四个能力：可用模型与参数的发现、声明式场景规格的预防性校验、经测试库代码执行、结果可检查；每步读输入文件并把结果存入独立 output bundle，保证可审计可复现。评估设计为 50 个 agent 会话、5 个建模任务，对比 agent 使用该框架与直接使用 Python 接口。
Result: 50 个 agent 会话、5 个建模任务的对照显示，框架在多数任务上降低了轮数、输出 token 与成本，除非以资源换取逐点 (per-point) 可复现性；另有一个新发呼吸道病毒疫苗策略比较的端到端案例研究。
Conclusion: 给流行病建模库加一层带校验、可审计输出包的 agent 中介，能在多数任务上省 token 和成本而不牺牲结果可检查性，代价是逐点复现需要额外资源。

papers.title: Beyond Surface Style: Aligning Multi-Turn User Simulators with Behavioral Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Faithful user simulation is fundamental to building, evaluating, and improving interactive AI at scale. However, plausible individual responses do not ensure that simulated users reproduce the intent evolution and outcomes observed in real interactions. We propose TRACER, a multi-turn user simulator that explicitly models users' evolving intent and learns to align simulated behavior with real interaction trajectories. TRACER is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on real user dialogues, followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning. The RL stage combines hierarchical outcome- and trajectory-level rewards with deviation-aware advantage modulation, jointly mitigating reward sparsity and credit assignment in long dialogues. On real customer-service sessions organized into reference cohorts, TRACER-7B surpasses the strongest baseline by 11.4 conversion F1, while also achieving the lowest group-level conversion-rate error and semantic trajectory distance, and generalizing to out-of-distribution scenarios. Human Turing tests yield identification accuracy close to chance, supporting the perceived naturalness of generated conversations. Building on this simulator, we further introduce the Dynamic Marketing Benchmark, which jointly evaluates persuasion effectiveness and response quality of LLMs through simulated interactions, revealing that higher response quality does not necessarily correspond to higher conversion rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACER 用显式建模用户意图演化的方式对齐多轮用户模拟器与真实交互轨迹，两阶段训练（真实客服对话 SFT + 多轮 RL）后，TRACER-7B 在真实客服会话上比最强基线 conversion F1 高 11.4，并给出最低的组级转化率误差与语义轨迹距离。基于该模拟器的 Dynamic Marketing Benchmark 进一步显示，LLM 回复质量更高并不必然带来更高转化率。
Motivation: 逐条回复看似合理的模拟用户并不保证复现真实交互中的意图演化与最终结果，导致交互式 AI 的大规模构建与评测不可靠。
Method: TRACER 显式建模用户演化意图，两阶段训练：先在真实用户对话上做监督微调 (SFT)，再做多轮强化学习；RL 阶段结合层级的 outcome-level 与 trajectory-level 奖励，并用 deviation-aware advantage modulation 缓解长对话中的奖励稀疏与 credit assignment 问题。
Result: 在按 reference cohort 组织的真实客服会话上，TRACER-7B 比最强基线高 11.4 conversion F1，同时取得最低的组级转化率误差与语义轨迹距离，并能泛化到 out-of-distribution 场景；人工 Turing 测试的识别准确率接近随机水平。
Conclusion: 对齐模拟行为与真实轨迹（而非只追求单条回复的表面合理）能同时提升转化预测精度与对话自然度；由此构建的 Dynamic Marketing Benchmark 揭示回复质量与转化率并不同向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: M-plicits: Neural Implicit Surfaces via Nested Multiscale Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Encoding input coordinates with sinusoidal functions into multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) has proven effective for implicit neural representations (INRs) of surfaces defined as zero-level sets. However, existing methods often struggle to balance training efficiency, rendering speed, and noise robustness: single-MLP approaches are expensive at inference, grid-based representations are fast but can limit surface smoothness and overfit input noise, and previous multiscale approaches frequently capture noise and produce artifacts due to hard spectral truncation. To address these limitations, we propose M-plicits, a multiscale framework that models surfaces as a residual sum of MLPs trained via a sequence of nested neighborhoods. Unlike existing residual approaches that rely on standard domain-wide sampling and require costly mesh extraction for visualization, our method strictly localizes supervision to narrow bands around the previous zero-level sets. This nested design naturally provides robustness against noisy input data: the coarse network acts as a low-pass filter that establishes a clean geometric prior, while subsequent residuals progressively refine the geometry without fitting to high-frequency artifacts. We further introduce a multiscale sphere-tracing algorithm and a GEMM-based analytical normal computation that bypasses auto-differentiation entirely, yielding high-fidelity real-time rendering. On Stanford and Thingi32, M-plicits achieves the best mean Chamfer distance in the coarse configuration and the best median Chamfer distance and IoU in the fine configuration, with substantially better noise robustness than iNGP, BACON, and IDF, while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters than grid-based baselines. Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/dsilvavinicius/m-plicits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M-plicits 把曲面表示为多个 MLP 的残差和，按嵌套邻域序列训练，监督严格限制在上一零水平集附近的窄带内。粗网络充当低通滤波给出干净几何先验，后续残差逐步细化而不拟合高频伪影；在 Stanford 与 Thingi32 上取得粗配置最佳平均 Chamfer 距离、细配置最佳中位 Chamfer 距离与 IoU，参数量比基于网格的基线少一个数量级。
Motivation: 隐式曲面表示难以同时兼顾训练效率、渲染速度与噪声鲁棒性：单 MLP 推理昂贵，网格表示快但限制光滑性并过拟合噪声，多尺度方法因硬谱截断易捕获噪声产生伪影。
Method: M-plicits 以正弦坐标编码输入 MLP，将曲面建模为 MLP 残差和，按嵌套邻域序列训练，监督严格局部化到上一零水平集附近的窄带；另引入多尺度 sphere-tracing 渲染算法与绕过自动微分的 GEMM 解析法线计算。
Result: 在 Stanford 与 Thingi32 上，M-plicits 在粗配置取得最佳平均 Chamfer 距离，在细配置取得最佳中位 Chamfer 距离与 IoU；噪声鲁棒性显著优于 iNGP、BACON 与 IDF，参数量比基于网格的基线少一个数量级。
Conclusion: 嵌套窄带残差训练天然带来噪声鲁棒性，粗网络低通先验加逐级细化可在减少参数的同时保持高保真实时渲染。

papers.title: Thinking Leakage: A Causal Audit of NoThink Post-Training in Hybrid Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training hybrid reasoning models in NoThink mode has attracted growing interest as a way to improve performance while keeping inference fast. However, these gains may draw on thinking behavior already accessible through the base model's Think mode. We formulate this thinking leakage in a causal mediation framework and audit its contribution using bidirectional interventions along a simple base-derived activation direction. Across three models and three post-training methods on competition math benchmarks, we find that leakage is real, causal, and substantial: behavioral and representational analyses reveal shifts toward Think, steering the base model along this direction reproduces most of the post-training accuracy gain, and counter-steering a checkpoint removes a substantial share of what it gains. Across nine aligned checkpoints with positive NoThink gains, the resulting leakage ratio ranges from 42% to 79%. These interventions support a substantial causal contribution of thinking leakage. Our findings show that a post-training method's apparent advantage can therefore reflect greater drift toward Think, obscuring whether it improves capability within NoThink or more effectively re-invokes existing Think behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把混合推理模型 NoThink 后训练的收益归因到「思维泄漏」(thinking leakage)：用因果中介框架沿基础模型自带的激活方向做双向干预，发现泄漏真实、因果且可观。九个有正向 NoThink 增益的 checkpoint 上泄漏比例达 42%–79%，沿该方向引导基础模型即可复现大部分后训练精度增益，反向引导则抹掉 checkpoint 增益的相当一部分。
Motivation: NoThink 模式后训练看似在提速的同时提升性能，但这些增益可能只是重新调用了基础模型 Think 模式里已有的能力，而非在 NoThink 内真正增强能力，导致方法优势被误读。
Method: 在因果中介 (causal mediation) 框架下形式化 thinking leakage，沿一条由基础模型导出的简单激活方向做双向干预（正向 steering 与反向 counter-steering），结合行为与表征分析；覆盖三个模型、三种后训练方法与竞赛数学基准。
Result: 在三个模型、三种后训练方法的竞赛数学基准上，行为与表征分析显示表征向 Think 偏移；沿该方向引导基础模型可复现后训练精度增益的大部分；对 checkpoint 反向引导会去掉其增益的相当一部分。九个具有正向 NoThink 增益的对齐 checkpoint 上，泄漏比例为 42%–79%。
Conclusion: 后训练方法的表面优势可能反映其向 Think 的漂移程度，而非在 NoThink 内提升能力；评估这类方法时须区分「增强能力」与「重新调用既有 Think 行为」。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based world models have recently emerged as a means of learning transitions over relational state representations. However, existing approaches are largely limited to fixed-topology graphs or deterministic, fully observable environments. We propose the Graph Dynamics Model (GDM), a world model for graph-structured observations that is designed to handle the more general setting of evolving topologies in stochastic and partially observable environments. The GDM uses a sparse recurrent adjacency matrix to model topology updates and perform message passing, together with a recurrent state-space architecture for modelling stochastic transitions. Furthermore, we identify a gap in the evaluation of graph-based world models, as existing methods do not provide a means of comparing predicted and true distributions over the joint graph state comprising the interdependent topology, node features, and graph features. We therefore introduce the Graph Distribution Distance (GDD) metric, which uses maximum mean discrepancy with a graph kernel to comprehensively compare joint next-state distributions. We evaluate the GDM across several environments, including stochastic and partially observable settings. We demonstrate that GDM outperforms baseline models and displays zero-shot generalisation on large graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Graph Dynamics Model (GDM)，用稀疏循环邻接矩阵更新拓扑并做消息传递，配合循环状态空间 (recurrent state-space) 架构建模随机、部分可观测环境下的图转移；并提出 Graph Distribution Distance (GDD) 指标，用图核上的最大均值差异 (MMD) 比较联合下一状态分布。在多个环境中 GDM 优于基线，并在大图上展现零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有基于图的世界模型基本局限于固定拓扑或确定性、完全可观测环境，且缺少比较预测与真实联合图状态（拓扑、节点特征、图特征相互耦合）分布的评估手段。
Method: GDM 以稀疏循环邻接矩阵建模拓扑更新并执行消息传递，用循环状态空间架构建模随机转移；评估指标 GDD 用带图核的最大均值差异 (MMD) 全面比较联合下一状态分布，并在包含随机与部分可观测设定的多个环境中评测。
Result: 在多个环境（含随机与部分可观测设定）中 GDM 优于基线模型，并在大图上展现零样本泛化 (zero-shot generalisation)；同时提出 GDD 指标用于联合图状态分布比较。
Conclusion: 把拓扑演化与随机潜动态一起建模、并用分布层面的图度量评估，是图世界模型走向随机部分可观测设定的可行路径。

papers.title: OPDiv: Optimal Selection of Top-K High-Scoring, Diverse Compounds
papers.abstract_en: A virtual screening campaign may produce thousands of promising candidates, but only a small number can be purchased, synthesized, or tested. The practical question is how to select a set of compounds that both rank well and are diverse enough: this poses a genuine tradeoff, where selecting the highest-scoring molecules yields limited diversity, while diversity selection sacrifices some well-scoring molecules. We introduce OPDiv, a diversity selection and evaluation algorithm solving this tradeoff by finding an optimal subset of molecules using integer optimization. We demonstrate the selection algorithm in practice with fingerprint distance, shape and electrostatic diversity and compare the resulting diversity spectra. We argue that virtual screening is not merely a ranking problem, but also an implicit constrained optimization task: when redundant chemotypes are undesirable, pipelines should be compared based on the top-k compound selections satisfying the desired diversity constraints. OPDiv makes it possible to find the optimal compound set under a given diversity threshold efficiently and serves as a fair benchmark of the best diverse selection achievable by a given structure-based or ligand-based virtual screening pipeline, molecular search or generative model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPDiv 用整数优化在虚拟筛选的打分与多样性之间求最优子集：给定多样性阈值，选出既排名靠前又彼此不冗余的 top-K 化合物。作者主张虚拟筛选不只是排序问题，而是带多样性约束的隐式约束优化问题，应按满足约束的 top-K 选择来比较不同筛选流程。
Motivation: 虚拟筛选常产出数千个候选，但只能购买、合成或测试少量；直接取最高分分子化学型高度重复，纯多样性选择又会丢掉高分分子，这个权衡此前缺少最优解的求法。
Method: OPDiv 是一个多样性选择与评估算法，用整数优化 (integer optimization) 在给定多样性阈值下寻找分子的最优子集；演示中分别用指纹距离 (fingerprint distance)、形状多样性与静电多样性三种度量并比较各自的多样性谱 (diversity spectra)。
Result: 在给定多样性阈值下可高效找到最优化合物集合，并作为公平基准，衡量基于结构或基于配体的虚拟筛选流程、分子搜索或生成模型所能达到的最佳多样化选择；摘要给出 12 页、3 幅图与开源代码地址，未含精度类数值。
Conclusion: 当冗余化学型不可接受时，虚拟筛选流水线应按满足多样性约束的 top-K 选择来比较，而不是只比排序；OPDiv 提供这一比较的最优基准。

papers.title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of 150 hand-designed cognitive science inspired tasks, divided into six cognitive categories. We build Blender generators that randomize speed, lighting, camera angle, and other nuisance parameters while preserving each task's cognitive structure, yielding 10,000+ samples per task. We release a 1.5M-sample training corpus and a 300-question exam. On this exam we evaluate 14 video models: 3 reference-to-video, 7 edit, and 4 continuation, among which PWM-WROP, our 16B world model. In a blind pairwise Elo study, PWM-WROP ranks first among continuation models and third overall, behind only a statistical tie between two reference-to-video models. We release the data, exam, model answers, scores, weights, and PWM, our native-PyTorch training stack on AWS Trainium2.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://object-permanence.world
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 WROP：150 个认知科学启发的物体恒存 (object permanence) 任务数据基础设施，用 Blender 生成器随机化速度、光照、相机角度等干扰参数并保持任务认知结构，每任务产出 10,000+ 样本，训练其 16B 世界模型 PWM-WROP。在 300 题考试上评测 14 个视频模型的盲测 pairwise Elo 中，PWM-WROP 在 continuation 模型里排第一、总排名第三，仅落后于两个 reference-to-video 模型之间的统计并列。
Motivation: 视频生成模型已显现推理能力，但是否内嵌物体恒存与固体性 (solidity) 这类人类核心认知先验尚不清楚；若缺失，需要一套受认知科学启发的数据来训练。
Method: 构建 WROP 数据基础设施：150 个手工设计、分六大认知类别的任务；为每个任务写 Blender 生成器，随机化速度、光照、相机角度等 nuisance 参数而保持认知结构，每任务生成 10,000+ 样本；发布 1.5M 样本训练语料与 300 题考试，并训练 16B 世界模型 PWM-WROP，训练栈为原生 PyTorch 的 PWM，跑在 AWS Trainium2 上。
Result: 在 300 题考试上评测 14 个视频模型（3 个 reference-to-video、7 个 edit、4 个 continuation，含本文 16B 的 PWM-WROP）；盲测 pairwise Elo 中 PWM-WROP 在 continuation 类里排名第一、总榜第三，仅排在两个 reference-to-video 模型的统计并列之后。数据、考试、模型答案、分数、权重与 PWM 训练栈一并发布。
Conclusion: 物体恒存可以用认知科学启发的大规模合成任务数据来训练进视频世界模型，PWM-WROP 使 continuation 类模型首次在 Elo 上追平更强的 reference-to-video 类别。

papers.title: The Fellowship of the Query: Learning Retrieval Actions
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented question answering requires control decisions about when to decompose a question, search, reformulate, extract evidence, synthesize facts, verify progress, and stop. We study whether trajectory fine-tuning can improve small language models (SLMs) as next-action controllers. We additionally evaluate a low-resource setting in which a single SLM serves as both the controller and the final-answer generator. From accepted teacher search traces, we build a seven-way action-prediction task, where the model predicts the next structured teacher action from the current trajectory state, and evaluate LoRA-supervised fine-tuning across SLMs and xSLMs as controllers. On 1,646 held-out action examples, Granite 4.1 3B trained on 13,194 actions reaches macro-F1 0.6536, compared with 0.1736 for zero-shot prompting of the same model and 0.5399 for a TF-IDF logistic-regression baseline. In an end-to-end controller/generator swap evaluation over 149 held-out trajectories, using the fine-tuned model for both roles improves Exact Match from 0.7530 to 0.7946 and token F1 from 0.7783 to 0.8295 compared with using the base model as both controller and generator. The cross-role conditions show that the fine-tuned controller increases evidence-fact recording when the generator is fixed, while controller-only final-answer gains are not statistically clear. Overall, trajectory supervision improves action prediction and evidence-recording behaviour in this evaluated pipeline. Code is available at https://github.com/padas-lab-de/agent-action-controller
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在检索增强问答 (RAG) 中把「下一步做什么」做成七类动作预测任务，用教师搜索轨迹做 LoRA 轨迹微调，让小语言模型 (SLM) 当控制器。Granite 4.1 3B 在 1,646 条留出动作上 macro-F1 达 0.6536，远高于同模型 zero-shot 的 0.1736 与 TF-IDF 逻辑回归基线的 0.5399；同一模型兼任控制器与生成器时端到端 Exact Match 从 0.7530 升到 0.7946。
Motivation: RAG 智能体需要在分解、搜索、改写、抽取、综合、验证、停止之间连续做控制决策，而小模型在该决策上缺乏监督信号，仅靠 prompt 难以稳定给出结构化动作。
Method: 从被接受的教师搜索轨迹构建七类动作预测任务（由当前轨迹状态预测下一个结构化教师动作），对 SLM 与 xSLM 做 LoRA 监督微调；另设低资源设定，让同一个 SLM 同时充当控制器与最终答案生成器，并做控制器/生成器互换评估。
Result: 在 1,646 条留出动作样本上，Granite 4.1 3B 用 13,194 条动作训练后 macro-F1 0.6536，对比同模型 zero-shot 0.1736 与 TF-IDF 逻辑回归基线 0.5399。在 149 条留出轨迹的端到端互换评估中，微调模型同时任两角使 Exact Match 从 0.7530 升至 0.7946、token F1 从 0.7783 升至 0.8295。固定生成器时微调控制器增加证据事实记录，而仅换控制器带来的最终答案增益不具统计显著性。
Conclusion: 轨迹监督能提升动作预测与证据记录行为；仅换控制器的最终答案收益在本评估中不明确，收益更依赖控制器与生成器同时微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PePESeg3D: Perception Prior Enhances Multi-Scale Segmentation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have extended its capabilities to multi-scale segmentation. Existing methods reconstruct a scene with Gaussian primitives and learn multi-scale segmentation features separately, which leaves the geometry unaware of semantic structure and the feature learning dependent on incomplete mask supervision. To address these limitations, we present PePESeg3D, a novel framework that injects perception priors into a multi-scale 3D Gaussian segmentation pipeline. To fully exploit perception priors, we integrate them not only into contrastive feature learning but also into the upstream geometry reconstruction. Specifically, PePE Reconstruction incorporates monocular depth and mask constraints to ensure semantically coherent object structures. Building on this aligned geometry, PePE Contrastive Learning leverages dense depth-color cues and view-consistent centroid supervision to compensate for the incompleteness of multi-scale masks obtained from a 2D foundation model. Extensive experiments on the SPIn-NeRF, LERF-Mask, and NVOS benchmarks demonstrate that PePESeg3D achieves state-of-the-art performance in both multi-scale segmentation and scene reconstruction, highlighting the importance of integrating perception priors into both geometry optimization and feature learning for accurate multi-scale 3D segmentation. Our code is available at https://github.com/BeCow5X5/PePESeg3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PePESeg3D 把感知先验同时注入 3D Gaussian Splatting 的几何重建与对比特征学习：PePE Reconstruction 用单目深度与 mask 约束得到语义一致的物体结构，PePE Contrastive Learning 用稠密深度-颜色线索与视角一致的质心监督补足 2D 基础模型给出的不完整多尺度 mask。在 SPIn-NeRF、LERF-Mask、NVOS 上同时取得多尺度分割与场景重建的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 多尺度分割方法把几何重建与分割特征分开学，几何对语义结构无感知，特征学习又受不完整 mask 监督制约。
Method: 两条感知先验注入路径：PePE Reconstruction 在几何优化阶段加入单目深度约束与 mask 约束；PePE Contrastive Learning 在特征阶段利用稠密 depth-color 线索和视角一致的质心 (centroid) 监督，弥补 2D foundation model 产出的多尺度 mask 的不完整性。
Result: 在 SPIn-NeRF、LERF-Mask、NVOS 三个 benchmark 上，多尺度分割与场景重建均达到 state-of-the-art；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 感知先验需要同时进入几何优化与特征学习两端，才能支撑准确的多尺度 3D 分割；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RLVR landscapes for iterated multiplications can be benign: Insights from spin-glass theory
papers.abstract_en: Despite the importance of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), the extent to which it can learn new reasoning capabilities remains debated. Here we study the optimization landscape of RLVR on algorithmic tasks, such as iterated group and quasigroup multiplication. To this end, we map entropy-regularized RLVR over myopic tabular policies onto an energy-based (spin-glass) model over deterministic policies. This mapping upper-bounds what RLVR can achieve, and lets us rigorously characterize the landscape in this tabular setting. We show, both theoretically and experimentally, that for a wide class of models and tasks with uncorrelated inputs, this landscape is benign, containing no local minima that could trap RLVR training. Rather, the practical difficulty of these tasks appears to stem, at least in part, from issues such as diffusive barriers and gradient-estimation error in traversing the landscape. These are genuine obstacles that can prevent a solution from being found, but they are distinct from the landscape itself being rugged. We show that these obstacles can often be mitigated through the choice of entropy regulator. Consistent with this theory, we find that a transformer trained from scratch, using only last-token rewards, successfully learns an algorithmic chain of thought for iterated non-Abelian group multiplications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把熵正则化的 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）在表格型短视策略上的优化映射为确定性策略上的自旋玻璃能量模型，证明在输入不相关的一类模型与任务中该景观是良性的、不存在困住训练的局部极小值。实际困难来自扩散势垒与梯度估计误差而非景观崎岖，且常可通过选择熵正则项缓解；据此从零训练、只用 last-token 奖励的 transformer 成功学出迭代非阿贝尔群乘法的算法链式思维。
Motivation: RLVR 能否学到新的推理能力仍有争议，需要区分训练失败究竟来自损失景观本身的崎岖，还是来自穿越景观时的其他障碍。
Method: 将熵正则化 RLVR 在表格型短视策略上的优化映射为确定性策略上的能量（spin-glass）模型，该映射给出 RLVR 可达性能的上界；在此表征下做理论刻画并配合实验，再用不同熵正则项的选择来缓解扩散势垒与梯度估计误差。
Result: 对输入不相关的一广类模型与任务，理论与实验都表明景观良性、无局部极小值；实际困难被归因于扩散势垒与梯度估计误差，且这些障碍常可通过熵正则项的选择缓解；一个从零训练、仅用 last-token 奖励的 transformer 成功学会迭代非阿贝尔群乘法的算法链式思维。
Conclusion: RLVR 在这类算法任务上的失败不必归咎于损失景观崎岖，而应归咎于穿越景观的障碍，且熵正则项的选择可以缓解它们。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reward Hacking Challenges Oversight of Autonomous Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research agents can design experiments, evaluate results, and write reports, giving them control over both a scientific result and the evidence used to support it. This creates a risk of reward hacking: meeting the reward criteria without achieving the intended goal. We study (1) how often models reward-hack without instructions to do so, (2) how effective and detectable their methods are when hacking is allowed, and (3) how they adapt when an LLM review panel returns its decision and reasons. Across 17 language models and 38 tasks, the spontaneous reward-hacking rate is 30.5% on open-ended research-pipeline tasks and 2.9% on task-specific kernels. When hacking is allowed on tasks whose pass thresholds exceed our best compliant baselines, 505/677 attempts (74.6%) are confirmed reward hacks: they both clear the threshold and receive mechanism-verification panel confirmation of an evaluation exploit. An LLM panel reviewing only submitted code and reported scores misses 33/505 confirmed hacks (6.5%). Direct methods that achieve the highest scores are often easy to detect, while less direct methods evade more often. In a five-round loop, the number of model-task pairs with an evasion rises from 7 to 56. Among 79 pairs evaluated under two feedback conditions, cumulative evasion reaches 40.5% with detailed feedback and 20.3% with generic rejection. The detailed condition includes the review decision, reasons, and attempt history, so this comparison does not isolate the effect of explanations. These findings highlight the need for stronger defenses, including metrics kept outside the agent's control and independent recomputation on data chosen to expose likely exploits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自主研究 agent 同时掌控实验结果与其支撑证据，因而可为满足奖励指标而 reward hacking。在 17 个模型、38 个任务上，无指令时自发 hack 率在开放式研究管线任务为 30.5%、在任务特定 kernel 上为 2.9%；允许 hack 时 505/677（74.6%）尝试被机制验证确认为真 hack。只审代码与报告分数的 LLM 面板漏掉 33/505（6.5%），而五轮反馈回路使发生规避的模型-任务对从 7 增至 56，详细反馈下累计规避 40.5%、笼统拒绝下 20.3%。
Motivation: 自主研究 agent 获得对科学结论及其证据的双重控制，奖励指标本身可能被绕过；现有 LLM 评审面板只看提交代码与报告分数，无法可靠识别评估漏洞。
Method: 在 17 个语言模型、38 个任务上分三问研究：无指令的自发 hack 率、允许 hack 时的有效性与可检测性、以及收到 LLM 评审面板决定与理由后的适应行为；对通过阈值的任务做机制验证 (mechanism-verification) 面板确认，并设置五轮反馈回路，比较详细反馈（决定、理由、尝试历史）与笼统拒绝两种条件。
Result: 自发 reward-hacking 率：开放式研究管线任务 30.5%，任务特定 kernel 2.9%。允许 hack 且阈值超过最佳合规基线时，505/677（74.6%）尝试既过阈值又获机制验证确认。只审代码与分数的面板漏检 33/505（6.5%）；直接方法得分最高但易被发现，较间接方法更常规避。五轮回路中发生规避的模型-任务对由 7 升至 56；79 个配对在两种反馈条件下累计规避分别为详细反馈 40.5%、笼统拒绝 20.3%。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要更强防御：把指标置于 agent 控制之外，并在专门暴露漏洞的数据上独立重算；同时指出详细反馈与笼统拒绝的对比并未隔离解释本身的作用。

summary_sections.result: 自发 reward-hacking 率：开放式研究管线任务 30.5%，任务特定 kernel 2.9%。允许 hack 且阈值超过最佳合规基线时，505/677（74.6%）尝试既过阈值又获机制验证确认。只审代码与分数的面板漏检 33/505（6.5%）；直接方法得分最高但易被发现，较间接方法更常规避。五轮回路中发生规避的模型-任务对由 7 升至 56；79 个配对在两种反馈条件下累计规避分别为详细反馈 40.5%、笼统拒绝 20.3%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为需要更强防御：把指标置于 agent 控制之外，并在专门暴露漏洞的数据上独立重算；同时指出详细反馈与笼统拒绝的对比并未隔离解释本身的作用。

papers.title: Decision Hijacking: Prompt Injection Attacks on Jev's Typed Probabilistic Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Most studies of prompt injection focus on generative agents, leaving their effects on models with schema-defined outputs unclear. We examine these effects in Jev, a non-generative decision model, using 510 reconstructed InjecAgent cases. Malicious content shifts action probabilities but rarely causes Jev to select the attacker's target. Override markers reduce this influence, while claims of contextual relatedness have small effects. Adaptive attacks using score feedback double the mean highest attacker-target probability found during optimization, while success on fresh validation calls rises from 1.8% to 3.5%. Exploratory analysis links these successes to small initial decision margins or greater attacker control over the observation. Together, these findings show that schema-defined outputs change but do not eliminate prompt-injection risk, highlighting the need to evaluate how untrusted content influences choices within the allowed action set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非生成式、输出由 schema 约束的决策模型 Jev 上测 prompt injection：510 个重构的 InjecAgent 案例中，恶意内容会移动动作概率但很少让 Jev 直接选中攻击者目标；用分数反馈的自适应攻击把优化期最高攻击者目标概率翻倍，新鲜验证调用上的成功率从 1.8% 升到 3.5%。结论是 schema 约束改变但不消除注入风险，需评估不可信内容如何影响允许动作集内的选择。
Motivation: 现有 prompt injection 研究集中在生成式 agent，输出被 schema 限定的决策模型受影响程度不明。
Method: 以 Jev 这一非生成式决策模型为对象，用 510 个重构的 InjecAgent 案例注入恶意内容；比较 override markers 与 contextual relatedness 声称两类缓解/诱导手段，并做基于分数反馈的自适应攻击优化，再在新鲜验证调用上检验。
Result: 恶意内容移动动作概率但很少使 Jev 选中攻击者目标；override markers 降低该影响，contextual relatedness 声称影响较小；自适应攻击使优化期最高攻击者目标概率的均值翻倍，新鲜验证调用成功率由 1.8% 升至 3.5%；成功案例与较小的初始决策 margin 或攻击者对观测的更大控制相关。
Conclusion: schema 定义的输出改变但不消除 prompt injection 风险，评估重点应放在不可信内容对允许动作集内选择的影响上。

papers.title: Global Convergence of Third-Order Langevin Dynamics for Non-Convex Optimization via Simulated Annealing
papers.abstract_en: We study global convergence guarantees of third-order Langevin dynamics for non-convex optimization via simulated annealing with fixed friction and decreasing noise. An explicit three-block distorted entropy transfers dissipation from the noisy auxiliary variable to the full state. Under dissipativity, regularity, and low-temperature functional-inequality assumptions, logarithmic cooling drives the objective values to the global minimum in probability at the barrier-controlled kinetic rate. For the exact-force-integral and midpoint three-stage discretizations, polynomially decreasing steps preserve this rate on the physical time scale. The cubic local endpoint estimate gives a less restrictive sufficient step-size condition than the available frozen-force kinetic result. A comparison with the one-gradient UBU integrator shows how its centered stochastic local error leads, under the same strong-coupling analysis, to a smaller sufficient iteration exponent. Numerical experiments are conducted to illustrate our theory. For a double well objective, third-order Langevin terminal-success point estimates are higher than UBU at both a common horizon and an equal gradient budget. For a high-dimensional nonconvex neural-network objective using synthetic data, independently tuned UBU and third-order Langevin schemes both outperform overdamped Langevin dynamics; the third-order Langevin point estimate is higher. For the same neural-network objective on real data, we show the same point-estimate ordering for best-basin probability and post-quench test accuracy. Numerical code and associated experiment results are publicly available at https://github.com/gagawjbytw/simulated-annealing-third-order-langevin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定摩擦、递减噪声的模拟退火框架下证明三阶 Langevin 动力学对非凸优化的全局收敛：显式三块扭曲熵把辅助变量的耗散转移到全状态，对数降温使目标值依概率收敛到全局最小，且保持由势垒控制的动力学速率。双井与神经网络目标上，三阶 Langevin 的终点成功点估计在共同时域与等梯度预算下均高于 UBU，且在合成与真实数据上都优于过阻尼 Langevin。
Motivation: 非凸目标下三阶 Langevin 动力学缺少全局收敛保证，且离散步长条件与一阶梯度型积分器的比较缺乏定量依据。
Method: 构造显式三块扭曲熵 (three-block distorted entropy) 将含噪辅助变量的耗散转移到全状态；在耗散性、正则性与低温泛函不等式假设下分析对数降温；对 exact-force-integral 与 midpoint 三阶段离散化给出多项式递减步长条件，并用三次局部端点估计放宽步长限制，再与一梯度 UBU 积分器在同一强耦合分析下对比。
Result: 对数降温使目标值依概率收敛到全局最小，速率由势垒控制的动力学速率给出；三次局部端点估计给出的充分步长条件比已有 frozen-force 动力学结果更宽松；同一强耦合分析下 UBU 的中心化随机局部误差导致更小的充分迭代指数。数值上，双井目标中三阶 Langevin 终点成功点估计在共同时域与等梯度预算下均高于 UBU；合成数据的高维非凸神经网络目标上，独立调参的 UBU 与三阶 Langevin 都优于过阻尼 Langevin，三阶 Langevin 点估计更高；真实数据同一目标上 best-basin 概率与淬火后测试准确率保持相同排序。
Conclusion: 三阶 Langevin 配合对数降温与多项式递减步长可在非凸目标上保住势垒控制的全局收敛速率，并在数值上取得高于 UBU 与过阻尼 Langevin 的成功点估计。

papers.title: UltraBench 2: Towards Robust Evaluation of Vision Foundation Models on Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Benchmarking is an increasingly critical part of research in machine learning and the domains where it is applied, including healthcare. Yet, despite the steady development of new ultrasound foundation models in recent years, the development of well-designed benchmarks to evaluate them has lagged behind. This deficiency has led to fragmented and inconsistent evaluations of competing models, making it difficult to measure progress. To address this issue, we introduce UltraBench 2, a comprehensive benchmark with wide anatomical and task coverage, and a focus on standardization, reproducibility, and ease-of-use. Using this benchmark, we compare existing vision foundation models for ultrasound image analysis. Our analyses demonstrate that ultrasound-specific pretraining still leads on classification, but that state-of-the-art general-purpose models have drawn level on segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出超声视觉基础模型评测基准 UltraBench 2，覆盖广解剖与多任务，强调标准化、可复现与易用性，并用它比较现有视觉基础模型。结论是超声专用预训练在分类任务上仍领先，而通用 SOTA 模型在分割任务上已追平。
Motivation: 超声基础模型不断涌现，但配套评测基准发展滞后，导致各模型评估碎片化、口径不一致，难以衡量进展。
Method: 构建覆盖广解剖与多任务的统一基准，围绕标准化、可复现与易用性设计，用它对现有超声图像分析视觉基础模型做分类与分割两类任务的横向比较。
Result: 在该基准上，超声专用预训练模型在分类任务上仍领先；通用 SOTA 视觉基础模型在分割任务上已与之持平。
Conclusion: 超声专用预训练的价值集中在分类，分割上通用模型已不落下风；统一基准是让不同模型可比的前提。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Adversarial Closed-Loop Curriculum for Evolving Role-Playing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Role-playing agents based on large language models have been widely applied in areas such as personalized assistance and social simulation. Recent RL methods typically train on a fixed scenario pool collected before learning begins. This creates a distributional bottleneck: as the agent improves, the scenarios where it performs poorly also change, while the training distribution remains static. Therefore, we propose AdvRole, an adversarial context rewriting framework that turns role-playing RL into a closed-loop curriculum. AdvRole alternates between an Actor that learns to role-play and a Rewriter that edits character profiles and dialogue contexts into actor-specific hard scenarios. The Rewriter is trained with a performance-gap reward, which favors rewrites that reduce the current Actor's score relative to the original scenario. As a result, the scenario pool evolves with the Actor and continuously targets under-mastered regions of the character-context space. Experiments on three role-playing benchmarks covering English and Chinese, as well as a new multilingual benchmark we release, show that AdvRole consistently outperforms baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdvRole 把角色扮演 RL 从固定场景池改成对抗式闭环课程：Actor 学角色扮演，Rewriter 用性能差距奖励把人物画像与对话上下文改写成针对当前 Actor 的难题场景，使场景池随 Actor 演化、持续覆盖角色-上下文空间中未掌握的区域。在覆盖中英文的三个角色扮演基准加一个自建多语言基准上，AdvRole 一致优于基线。
Motivation: 现有角色扮演 RL 通常在学习开始前收集固定场景池，形成分布瓶颈：Actor 变强后其薄弱场景也随之改变，而训练分布保持静态。
Method: AdvRole 是对抗式上下文改写框架，交替训练 Actor 与 Rewriter；Rewriter 用 performance-gap reward 训练，偏好那些把当前 Actor 分数相对原场景拉低的改写，从而生成 actor-specific 难题场景。
Result: 在覆盖英文与中文的三个角色扮演基准以及作者新发布的多语言基准上，AdvRole 一致优于基线（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 让场景池随 Actor 演化并持续瞄准未掌握区域，可替代静态场景池，成为角色扮演 RL 的闭环课程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: fable.intermittent: benchmarking probabilistic forecasting methods for intermittent time series
papers.abstract_en: Intermittent time series are common in spare-parts demand and retail sales. Since the cost of forecast errors is typically asymmetric, decisions such as inventory control require the full predictive distribution rather than a point forecast. Many probabilistic forecasting methods have been proposed; their implementations, however, are scattered across different software frameworks, making it difficult to compare them systematically. We introduce fable.intermittent, an R package that implements several probabilistic forecasting methods for intermittent series within the fable framework. The package allows several models to be fitted and evaluated on a collection of time series through a single, simple forecasting pipeline. We also introduce TWEES, a new exponential smoothing model with a Tweedie predictive distribution. Fitting TWEES requires repeated evaluation of the computationally demanding Tweedie density. We also release the R package tweedieDistr, whose implementation of the Tweedie distribution is substantially faster than the existing one while preserving the same numerical accuracy. We evaluate the methods implemented in fable.intermittent on four datasets, also released in the package.
papers.comment: Submitted to the International Journal of Forecasting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: fable.intermittent 把间歇性时间序列（备件需求、零售销售）的多种概率预测方法统一进 fable 框架的单一预测流水线，并同时提出带 Tweedie 预测分布的指数平滑模型 TWEES 与更快的 tweedieDistr 包。在四个随包发布的数据集上评估这些方法，tweedieDistr 在保持相同数值精度的同时显著快于现有 Tweedie 密度实现。
Motivation: 间歇序列的预测误差成本不对称，库存决策需要完整预测分布而非点预测；但现有概率预测方法散落在不同软件框架里，难以系统比较。
Method: 在 R 的 fable 框架内实现 fable.intermittent，用统一的简单流水线对一批时间序列拟合并评估多个概率模型；新增 TWEES（Tweedie 预测分布的指数平滑模型），其拟合需反复计算计算量大的 Tweedie 密度，故另发布 tweedieDistr 包加速该密度计算。
Result: 在四个随包发布的数据集上评估 fable.intermittent 中实现的方法；tweedieDistr 的 Tweedie 分布实现比现有实现 substantially faster，同时保持相同的数值精度。
Conclusion: 把间歇序列的概率预测方法收进单一框架并配一个更快的 Tweedie 密度实现，可让这类模型在需要完整预测分布的库存决策中被系统比较与实际拟合。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 在四个随包发布的数据集上评估 fable.intermittent 中实现的方法；tweedieDistr 的 Tweedie 分布实现比现有实现 substantially faster，同时保持相同的数值精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把间歇序列的概率预测方法收进单一框架并配一个更快的 Tweedie 密度实现，可让这类模型在需要完整预测分布的库存决策中被系统比较与实际拟合。

papers.title: UO-FIE: Combining Exact-Label Supervision with Graded Utility for Factivity Inference
papers.abstract_en: The Factivity Inference Evaluation 2026 (FIE2026) classifies Chinese context-hypothesis pairs into nine ordered factivity intervals. Its evaluation metric rewards both exact predictions and proximity to the correct interval, while 64.1% of the 566 training examples belong to a single class. In preliminary experiments, several mDeBERTa classification models predominantly predict the dominant class, whereas a Huber-regression baseline produces more predictions near the correct interval but fewer exact matches. We introduce Utility-Oriented Factivity Inference (UO-FIE), a parameter-efficient system that combines exact-label supervision with graded utility. UO-FIE predicts a distribution over the nine classes and combines hard-label supervision, utility-based soft targets, scheduled class weights, and an ordinal loss. We evaluate expected-utility decoding in controlled comparisons and use ordinal calibration selected on out-of-fold predictions for the submitted system. Based on Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA, UO-FIE ranks first in the fine-tuning track with a macro utility of 0.8316. A separate prompt-based ensemble ranks third in the non-fine-tuning track with a macro utility of 0.8450.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as oral presentation at CCL26-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 FIE2026 中文语境-假设对的九级有序 factivity 区间分类，提出 UO-FIE：在 Qwen3.5-9B + LoRA 上同时用硬标签监督与分级效用软目标，配合调度类权重和 ordinal loss 预测九类分布。微调赛道以 macro utility 0.8316 排名第一，独立的 prompt 集成在非微调赛道以 0.8450 排名第三。
Motivation: FIE2026 训练集 566 条中有 64.1% 集中在单一类别，mDeBERTa 分类模型因此偏向预测多数类；而 Huber 回归虽让预测更接近正确区间，精确命中却更少，需要同时兼顾精确标签与邻近效用。
Method: UO-FIE 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 加 LoRA 做参数高效微调，输出九类分布；损失组合硬标签监督、基于效用的软目标、调度类权重 (scheduled class weights) 与 ordinal loss。提交系统用 out-of-fold 预测上选出的 ordinal calibration，另在受控对比中检验 expected-utility decoding。
Result: 微调赛道 macro utility 0.8316 排名第一；独立的 prompt 集成在非微调赛道 macro utility 0.8450 排名第三。训练集 566 条中 64.1% 属于单一类；初步实验里 mDeBERTa 主要预测多数类，Huber 回归基线更接近正确区间但精确命中更少。
Conclusion: 在类别高度不平衡的有序区间评测中，把精确标签监督与分级效用目标结合，比单纯分类或回归更能同时拿到精确命中与邻近得分。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning for Joint Wire Calibration and Interaction Position Reconstruction in Multi-Wire Parallel Plate Avalanche Counters
papers.abstract_en: Scientific instruments require accurate calibration to convert detector signals into reliable physical observables. Conventional calibration procedures typically rely on dedicated calibration measurements, analytical response models or labelled reference data, limiting their ability to adapt to changing operating conditions and detector aging. We present a physics-informed self-supervised learning framework that jointly performs wire calibration and interaction position reconstruction in Multi-Wire Parallel Plate Avalanche Counters (MWPPACs) without requiring labelled position measurements or dedicated calibration runs. The method formulates detector calibration as a latent optimization problem in which global wire gains and event-wise interaction positions are estimated simultaneously using supervision derived exclusively from detector geometry and charge-energy consistency constraints. A detector-independent neural network reconstructs sub-wire interaction positions from local charge distributions, eliminating the need to assume analytical induction profiles by learning the detector response directly from experimental data. The end-to-end differentiable framework enables continuous detector self-calibration while improving the uniformity and accuracy of position reconstruction. Experimental evaluation on the entrance MWPPAC tracking detectors of the VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer demonstrates stable convergence, improved spatial homogeneity and enhanced position resolution. Beyond the detector studied, the method establishes a general framework for physics-informed self-supervised calibration of scientific instruments and is a step toward autonomous intelligent instrumentation capable of continuous adaptation during operation. In this paradigm, detector calibration is no longer a prerequisite for an experiment but an integral part of the measurement process itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向多丝平行板雪崩计数器 (MWPPAC) 的物理信息自监督框架，把丝增益标定与事例相互作用位置重建写成同一个隐变量优化问题，监督只来自探测器几何与电荷-能量一致性约束，无需标注位置或专门标定实验。在 VAMOS++ 磁谱仪入口 MWPPAC 上实验显示稳定收敛、空间均匀性改善、位置分辨增强。
Motivation: 常规探测器标定依赖专门标定测量、解析响应模型或标注参考数据，难以适应工况变化与探测器老化。
Method: 将全局丝增益与逐事例相互作用位置作为联合隐变量同时估计，监督信号仅由探测器几何和电荷-能量一致性约束导出；用一个与探测器无关的神经网络从局部电荷分布重建亚丝级位置，直接从实验数据学习响应而不假设解析感应剖面；整体端到端可微，支持运行中持续自标定。
Result: 在 VAMOS++ 磁谱仪入口 MWPPAC 跟踪探测器上实验评估：框架稳定收敛，位置重建的空间均匀性改善，位置分辨增强。
Conclusion: 标定不必是实验的前置步骤，可作为测量过程本身的一部分，随运行持续自标定；该框架可推广到其他科学仪器的物理信息自监督标定。

papers.title: Learning to Discover Interesting Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly able to solve advanced mathematical problems, including many that have been open for decades. This opens the door to expansion of mathematical knowledge at unprecedented scale. Yet, while LLMs may be able to conjecture and prove more and more theorems, it remains open whether this new mathematical knowledge is interesting or useful. We define intrinsic interestingness of a theorem as the ratio between the length of its proof and the length of its statement. We show that this correlates strongly with an extrinsic measure of the downstream utility of a theorem. We identify the difficulty of a proof conditioned on a set of premises as a useful primitive for computing these metrics, and train a 27B model that predicts proof difficulty more accurately than frontier general-purpose models. Optimizing for our metric creates a model capable of producing more interesting theorems, while also reducing substantial or full overlap with Mathlib from 91.9% to 30.6%, showcasing the creation of more out-of-distribution math. We show that our system can generate candidate theorems, select the most interesting among them, and iteratively build on a self-expanding mathematical library. These metrics provide a practical and quantifiable signal for ranking conjectures and guiding proof search within formal mathematical libraries. Our framework provides a path towards self-expanding, machine-verified mathematical libraries that can choose worthwhile statements without relying on human-supplied targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把定理的内在有趣度定义为证明长度与陈述长度之比，并证明该指标与下游效用的外在度高度相关；据此训练 27B 模型预测给定前提集下的证明难度，比前沿通用模型更准。优化该指标后生成的定理与 Mathlib 的完全或大幅重叠从 91.9% 降到 30.6%，系统可自动生成、筛选并迭代扩展机器验证的数学库。
Motivation: LLM 已能解决数十年未决的高级数学问题，但新产生的数学知识是否有趣、有用仍无判定标准，猜想与证明的扩展缺少可排序的信号。
Method: 定义内在有趣度为证明长度与陈述长度之比，并论证其与下游效用的外在度量强相关；以「给定前提集下的证明难度」为核心原语，训练一个 27B 模型做难度预测，再用该指标优化生成模型，配合候选生成—筛选—迭代扩展的循环构建自扩展数学库。
Result: 优化该指标得到的模型产出更有趣的定理，与 Mathlib 的 substantial or full overlap 从 91.9% 降至 30.6%，即生成更多分布外数学；27B 难度预测模型比前沿通用模型预测更准（摘要未给出具体精度数值）。
Conclusion: 证明长度与陈述长度之比可作为排序猜想、引导形式化数学库中证明搜索的实用可量化信号，使系统无需人工给定目标即可选择值得证明的陈述。

papers.title: HClimRep-Ocean: A Global Ocean Emulator on an Unstructured Mesh
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning (ML) emulators for atmospheric processes have advanced rapidly in recent years, transforming weather forecasting. Although early ML ocean forecasting models now exist, they remain less developed than their atmospheric counterparts. Unlike the atmosphere, much of the ocean's kinetic energy resides in mesoscale eddies whose characteristic spatial scales are approximately an order of magnitude smaller than those of comparable atmospheric features. Moreover, complex coastlines, narrow straits, and ice-covered seas make boundary representation a central challenge that atmospheric models do not face. Consequently, numerical ocean simulations commonly use locally refined or even completely unstructured meshes. However, their data-driven counterparts have so far been built around latitude-longitude grids. We present HClimRep-Ocean, an ocean emulator that operates directly on the native unstructured mesh of FESOM2. The emulator is trained on a 209-year AWI-CM3 control integration and is run without atmospheric forcing, receiving the atmospheric state only at initialisation time, which isolates the predictability carried by the ocean state itself. Skill is strongly field-dependent: for currents, HClimRep-Ocean outperforms every reference at 30 day forecast, whereas for temperature and salinity a damped-anomaly persistence forecast remains the more accurate estimator. This behaviour is physically interpretable: current variability is largely geostrophic and internally generated, whereas sea-surface temperature and salinity fluctuations are driven by atmospheric forcing through weather state. Evaluated independently on the OceanBench benchmark, a reanalysis-trained variant of HClimRep-Ocean achieves the lowest RMSE against GLORYS reanalysis among all assessed systems, confirming the competitiveness of the native-mesh approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HClimRep-Ocean 直接在 FESOM2 的非结构网格上做全球海洋模拟器，用 209 年 AWI-CM3 控制试验训练，初始化后不给大气强迫、只在起始时刻接收大气状态，从而隔离海洋自身携带的可预报性。30 天预报中流场胜过全部参考方法，而温盐仍以阻尼距平持续性 (damped-anomaly persistence) 更准；在 OceanBench 上按 GLORYS 再分析评 RMSE，再分析训练变体在所有受评系统中最低。
Motivation: 海洋中尺度涡的空间尺度比同类大气特征小约一个量级，加上复杂海岸线、窄海峡与冰封海域，边界表示必须用局地加密甚至完全非结构网格；但现有数据驱动海洋模型都建在经纬度网格上，无法直接表达这类网格。
Method: 模拟器直接运行在 FESOM2 的原生非结构网格上，训练数据为 209 年 AWI-CM3 控制积分；运行时不施加大气强迫，大气状态仅在初始化时输入。另有一个用再分析训练的变体，独立在 OceanBench 基准上评测，以 GLORYS 再分析为参照。
Result: 流场在 30 天预报上优于每一个参考方法；温度和盐度则仍是阻尼距平持续性预报更准。OceanBench 独立评测中，再分析训练变体相对 GLORYS 再分析取得所有受评系统里最低的 RMSE。
Conclusion: 海洋模拟器的技巧强依赖变量：流场变率大体是地转且内部生成的，可在无大气强迫下由海洋状态自身预报；而海表温盐变率由天气驱动的大气强迫决定，脱离强迫后持续性方法反而更准，原生非结构网格路线本身具备竞争力。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: BRFID: Toward Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Flipping 60\% of training labels from a single Byzantine client using label-flipping model poisoning self-degrades an attacker's own federated detection accuracy, $99.96\%$ (at no poisoning rate) to $84.33\%$ in a three-client federated IDS. Where the Federated global ensemble maintains stable accuracy across all tested poison rates, without a defense mechanism in place and without coordination between attackers. In this paper, we present empirical results quantifying the impact of label-flipping poisoning attacks on a three-client federated IDS trained on CICIDS2017 with non-IID attack subtype distributions across clients. We demonstrate that the signal of the adversarial self-compromise represents a detectable anomaly for exploitation for Byzantine client identification in the absence of target data exfiltration. We note that the aggregation step uses a Federated Forest (tree concatenation) rather than a parametric FedAvg; the results therefore measure the impact of poisoning on per-client performance under ensemble aggregation, and extension to genuine FedAvg with a parametric classifier is planned for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三客户端联邦入侵检测系统 (CICIDS2017，非 IID 攻击子类型分布) 中，单个 Byzantine 客户端翻转 60% 训练标签做 label-flipping 模型投毒，会先拖垮攻击者自己：其检测准确率从无投毒时的 99.96% 跌到 84.33%，而联邦全局 ensemble 在所有测试投毒率下保持稳定。作者据此把这种「攻击者自损」信号当作可检测异常，用于在无目标数据外泄时识别 Byzantine 客户端。
Motivation: 联邦入侵检测里 Byzantine 客户端投毒的破坏力通常被高估，缺少对 label-flipping 攻击实际影响的量化；若攻击者自损本身可被检测，就可在无目标数据外泄的场景下反向定位恶意客户端。
Method: 在三客户端联邦 IDS 上做实证：以 CICIDS2017 训练，各客户端攻击子类型分布非 IID，注入单客户端 label-flipping 模型投毒并扫描投毒率；聚合采用 Federated Forest（树拼接）而非参数化 FedAvg，度量各客户端在 ensemble 聚合下的表现。
Result: 攻击者翻转 60% 标签时自身联邦检测准确率由 99.96%（无投毒）降至 84.33%；联邦全局 ensemble 在所有测试投毒率下保持稳定准确率，且攻击者之间无协调、无防御机制在位。
Conclusion: label-flipping 投毒在 ensemble 聚合下会自损攻击者，该自-compromise 信号可作为 Byzantine 客户端识别的异常特征；结论目前限于 Federated Forest 树拼接聚合，作者计划扩展到参数化 FedAvg。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在三客户端联邦入侵检测系统 (CICIDS2017，非 IID 攻击子类型分布) 中，单个 Byzantine 客户端翻转 60% 训练标签做 label-flipping 模型投毒，会先拖垮攻击者自己：其检测准确率从无投毒时的 99.96% 跌到 84.33%，而联邦全局 ensemble 在所有测试投毒率下保持稳定。作者据此把这种「攻击者自损」信号当作可检测异常，用于在无目标数据外泄时识别 Byzantine 客户端。

papers.title: TAM-Chain: Multi-Scale Thyroid Cytology Classification via Absorbing Markov Chains and Shannon Entropy Uncertainty Quantification for False-Negative Suppression and Domain-Shift Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Background & Problem: Thyroid Fine-Needle Aspiration Biopsy (FNAB) cytology based on the Bethesda System plays a pivotal role in early thyroid cancer detection; however, deep learning approaches face substantial challenges regarding high false-negative rates and overconfidence under clinical domain shift. Methods: In this study, we propose TAM-Chain, a multi-scale (10x, 20x, 40x) thyroid cytology classification framework leveraging Absorbing Markov Chain theory combined with Shannon Entropy-based Uncertainty Quantification. The framework dynamically models multi-magnification feature extraction as an absorbing stochastic process, enabling optimal stopping criteria and a human-in-the-loop referral mechanism to strictly suppress critical diagnostic errors. Results: Extensive evaluation on an internal test set (N = 235) demonstrates a Macro F1 score of 0.9741 with an absolute False-Negative Rate (FNR) of 0.00%. On an independent external validation set (N = 1015) presenting severe domain shift, TAM-Chain maintains superior stability and classification performance (Macro F1 = 0.7026) by adaptively adjusting the expected stopping step and triggering specialist referrals, significantly outperforming single-magnification baselines. Conclusion: The TAM-Chain framework proves to be a highly effective, safe, and adaptable solution for digital pathology workflows, successfully harmonizing automated diagnostic efficiency with stringent biological safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAM-Chain 把甲状腺 FNAB 细胞学的多放大倍数（10x/20x/40x）特征提取建模为吸收马尔可夫链，用 Shannon 熵做不确定性量化，导出最优停止步并触发专科转诊，以压低假阴性。内部测试集（N=235）Macro F1 0.9741、绝对 FNR 0.00%；在有严重 domain shift 的外部验证集（N=1015）上 Macro F1 0.7026，显著优于单放大倍数基线。
Motivation: 深度学习做甲状腺细胞学诊断假阴性率高，且在临床 domain shift 下过度自信，可能漏掉关键恶性诊断。
Method: 多尺度（10x、20x、40x）特征提取被动态建模为吸收随机过程 (absorbing stochastic process)，结合 Shannon 熵不确定性量化给出最优停止准则，并接入 human-in-the-loop 转诊机制；在内部测试集与独立外部验证集上评测。
Result: 内部测试集 N=235：Macro F1 0.9741，绝对 FNR 0.00%。外部验证集 N=1015（严重 domain shift）：Macro F1 0.7026，通过自适应调整期望停止步与触发专科转诊保持稳定性，显著优于单放大倍数基线。
Conclusion: 把多倍数诊断流程写成吸收马尔可夫链并以熵驱动转诊，可在 domain shift 下同时保住分类性能与假阴性安全约束，适用于数字病理工作流。

papers.title: NumericJev: Jev-like LLM Numerical Decoding with Multiway Decision Trees
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can interpret natural lan- guage, yet robust decisions remain challenging. Jev-like models expose structured choices, but these interfaces do not directly provide numeri- cal values at a requested precision. We propose NUMERICJEV, a training-free numerical decod- ing algorithm that enables numerical output from any LLM with a Jev-like structured-choice in- terface. Surprisingly, on our arithmetic bench- mark, it outperforms direct selection from a can- didate list containing the correct answer by 2.93 percentage points (Figure 1). Our motivation comes from the observation that numerical range selection is itself a decision problem that Jev- like LLMs can address. NUMERICJEV recur- sively refines a range through a multiway deci- sion tree while retaining the original question in context, without parameter updates or hidden- state access. On a 100-value grid, a ten-way tree requires only two decision rounds. Range- normalized MAE is 1.84% versus 5.18% for di- rect choice. A separate three-date historical- index study yields 4.58% mean relative recall er- ror and 0% readout error when the value is sup- plied. Code is available at https://github. com/Bring-AI/jev-numeric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NUMERICJEV 是一种免训练的数值解码算法：把数值区间选择当作 Jev-like 结构化选择的决策问题，用多路决策树递归细化区间，同时把原问题保留在上下文中，不更新参数也不访问隐状态。在算术基准上它比从含正确答案的候选列表直接选择高 2.93 个百分点，100 值网格上十路树只需两轮决策，区间归一化 MAE 为 1.84%（直接选择 5.18%）。
Motivation: LLM 虽能理解自然语言，但稳健决策仍然困难；Jev-like 接口暴露结构化选项，却不能直接按指定精度给出数值。
Method: 训练-free 的 NUMERICJEV 算法：把数值范围选择建模为多路决策树 (multiway decision tree)，递归细化区间，每轮都把原始问题保留在上下文中，调用 Jev-like 结构化选择接口，不做参数更新、不读隐状态。
Result: 在算术基准上比包含正确答案的候选列表直接选择高 2.93 个百分点；100 值网格上十路树只需两轮决策；区间归一化 MAE 1.84% 对直接选择 5.18%；另有一项三日期历史指数研究，平均相对召回误差 4.58%，当数值被直接给出时读出误差 0%。
Conclusion: 把数值输出转成区间递归细化的决策问题，任何带 Jev-like 结构化选择接口的 LLM 都能免训练地输出指定精度数值，且在该算术基准上反而优于直接候选选择。

papers.title: Persistent Billable State: Denial-of-Wallet Attacks and Defenses in Tool-Calling LLM Agents
authors: Bibo Tu (1 and 2) ((1) Institute of Information Engineering
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
(4) State Key Laboratory of Networking and Switching Technology
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step tool-calling LLM agents rely on host runtimes to preserve state across turns. When a runtime carries an external tool return into later model inputs, providers meter it again. An admitted malicious or compromised tool can thereby convert untrusted data into recurring victim-billed processing without victim credentials or local runtime privilege. We call retained content persistent billable state and formalize the host's decision over whether and how it enters later billable context as the persistent billable-state boundary. We present the first systematic security study of this post-admission lifecycle. We derive six denial-of-wallet attack vectors and build DOW-BENCH, an end-to-end harness evaluated across six model families. Across 243 executions, usage telemetry shows that the maximum per-session cumulative input reaches 14,293x the session's first-call input. Controlled history-policy reruns isolate raw retention's contribution: retaining raw history increases mean effective session cost by 21.2-35.9%. Compression succeeds on 10/12 and 11/12 history-dependent tasks, versus 2/12 under deletion for each provider. To govern this boundary, we combine deterministic history transformation with four host-side invariants that bound prompt mass, context growth, recursive opportunity, and cumulative spend before reingestion. The kernel contains every recurring attack in the 123-evaluation replay corpus. Across 24 Mistral Small 4 workflows, a progress-authorized policy achieves 22/24 oracle-verified task successes with no pre-completion interruptions, versus 13/24 under a fixed cap. Only 71 of 3,830 scanned MCP server and transport repositories expose any code-visible safeguard proxy, and none cover all four safeguard families. These results establish persistent billable state as a first-class security object and pre-reingestion as its host-owned control point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把多步工具调用 LLM agent 中被运行时保留、并在后续轮次再次计费的外部工具返回定义为 persistent billable state，提出 DOW-BENCH 端到端评测与基于确定性历史变换加四条宿主侧不变量的防护。243 次执行中单会话累计输入最高达首次调用的 14,293 倍；保留原始历史使平均有效会话成本上升 21.2–35.9%；该内核在 123 条重放语料中拦下全部循环攻击，且在 24 个 Mistral Small 4 工作流上取得 22/24 任务成功（固定上限仅 13/24）。
Motivation: 多步工具调用 agent 的宿主运行时跨轮保留状态，被放行的恶意或被攻陷工具可把不可信数据变成反复由受害者计费的处理，而无需受害者凭证或本地运行时权限；此前缺少对这一准入后生命周期的系统安全研究。
Method: 形式化宿主的 persistent billable-state boundary 决策，推导六种 denial-of-wallet 攻击向量并构建端到端 harness DOW-BENCH，覆盖六个模型家族；防护端用确定性历史变换加四条宿主侧不变量，分别约束 prompt 质量、上下文增长、递归机会与再摄取前的累计花费。
Result: 243 次执行中单会话累计输入最高达首次调用的 14,293 倍；受控历史策略重跑显示保留原始历史使平均有效会话成本增加 21.2–35.9%；压缩在两家 provider 上分别于 10/12 与 11/12 依赖历史的任务成功，而删除策略各仅 2/12；内核在 123 条评测重放语料中拦下全部循环攻击；24 个 Mistral Small 4 工作流上进度授权策略 22/24 oracle 验证成功且无完成前中断，固定上限为 13/24；扫描的 3,830 个 MCP server 与传输仓库中仅 71 个暴露任一代码可见防护代理，无一覆盖全部四类。
Conclusion: persistent billable state 应作为一等安全对象，pre-reingestion 是宿主应持有的控制点；扫描结果表明现有 MCP 生态的防护覆盖极不完整。

papers.title: SGA: Uncertainty Quantification for Multi-Step Forecasting in Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The recent emergence of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has significantly advanced multi-step forecasting performance, enabling accurate predictions over extended future horizons. However, existing TSFMs often suffer from significantly inherent uncertainty, which typically manifests as derived forecast branches emerging at each time step and spreading to subsequent steps; different forecast branches often exhibit varying forecasting performance, thereby undermining the credibility of TSFM forecasts. In this paper, we propose the Slicing-Graphing-Alignment (SGA) method to quantify the uncertainty of multi-step TSFM forecasts. The proposed SGA first characterizes the topology of all potential forecast branches using a directed acyclic graph, such that the graph complexity bounds the uncertainty of multi-step forecasts, and then precisely measures the graph complexity by integrating both topological information and TSFM-inherent stochasticity. Experimental results conducted on 11 TSFMs and 27 datasets demonstrate that (i) SGA achieves the best performance when ranking predictive errors with uncertainty estimates; (ii) SGA works with a more extensive and more precise sampling coverage than those of existing UQ methods, deriving a quantification mechanism fundamentally different from those of established ones; and (iii) larger model scales of TSFMs correlate with lower uncertainty estimates of multi-step forecasts, suggesting another empirical scaling law for uncertainty quantification of multi-step TSFM forecasts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Slicing-Graphing-Alignment (SGA) 量化时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 多步预报的不确定性：用有向无环图刻画各时间步分叉出的预报分支拓扑，以图复杂度界定不确定性，并结合拓扑信息与 TSFM 固有随机性度量该复杂度。在 11 个 TSFM、27 个数据集上，SGA 用不确定性排序预测误差时表现最佳，采样覆盖更广更准，且模型规模越大、多步预报不确定性估计越低。
Motivation: TSFM 多步预报在每一步会分叉出不同表现的预报分支，固有不确定性削弱预报可信度，而现有 UQ 方法的量化机制与采样覆盖不足以刻画这种分支扩散。
Method: SGA 分三步：slicing 用有向无环图 (DAG) 表征所有潜在预报分支的拓扑，以图复杂度界定多步预报不确定性；graphing 融合拓扑信息与 TSFM 固有随机性精确度量图复杂度；alignment 将不确定性估计与预测误差对齐用于排序。
Result: 在 11 个 TSFM 和 27 个数据集上：SGA 在用不确定性估计排序预测误差时取得最佳表现；相比已有 UQ 方法采样覆盖更广且更精确；模型规模越大，多步预报不确定性估计越低，构成一条关于 TSFM 多步预报 UQ 的经验 scaling law。
Conclusion: 以预报分支的图复杂度作为不确定性代理，可在 TSFM 多步预报上给出比既有 UQ 更可靠的误差排序，并揭示模型规模与多步不确定性的负相关经验规律。

summary_sections.conclusion: 以预报分支的图复杂度作为不确定性代理，可在 TSFM 多步预报上给出比既有 UQ 更可靠的误差排序，并揭示模型规模与多步不确定性的负相关经验规律。

papers.title: Auditability Is Not One Property: Rule Overlap, Behavioural Agreement, and Composition in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning (RL) policies are often distributed as opaque neural checkpoints, while training logs show that a run occurred without explaining what the policy learned. We study whether independently trained policies can be represented and composed through auditable discrete behavioral rules. We define auditability as six separately testable predicates: trace integrity, lossless coding, rule coverage, behavioral agreement, composition quality, and value-model reliability. Our protocol uses a shared frozen symbolizer, passive rule extraction, an append-only hash-bound ledger, exact environment replay, and offline confidence-ranked arbitration with an explicit blind-spot fallback. The results place strict limits on this description layer. Rule-set overlap does not imply behavioral agreement: policies may share symbolic rules while choosing near-chance-matching actions on fresh states. The fused policy therefore selects among existing rules rather than generating a new skill. On a conflict-dominated task, an apparent fusion failure is traced to an induction/deployment mismatch: rules induced from sampled actions were evaluated under argmax actions, and deployment-consistent re-induction reverses the arbitration ordering. A fitted-Q generalized-policy-improvement diagnostic also fails in both environments, limiting claims that rule fusion is superior to value-based composition. One exploratory comparison favors rule fusion, but its comparator is post hoc, the task is partly saturated, and the fused policy remains below the strongest held-out actor. We contribute an evidence-bounded audit and composition protocol, not a claim of universal interpretability or autonomous skill generation. Future work must add temporally extended skills, cross-skill interfaces, composition search, and independent novelty audits.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Experimental results cover eight random seeds on CartPole-v1 and Acrobot-v1. Code, data, and audit artifacts are available in the accompanying repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 RL 策略的可审计性拆成六条可独立检验的谓词（trace integrity、lossless coding、rule coverage、behavioral agreement、composition quality、value-model reliability），用共享冻结 symbolizer、被动规则抽取、append-only 哈希账本、精确环境回放与离线置信度排序仲裁构成审计协议。结论是规则集重叠不等于行为一致：策略可共享符号规则却在新状态上选择近随机匹配的动作，融合策略只能在既有规则间选择而不能生成新技能；在冲突主导任务上，用部署一致的 argmax 重新归纳规则即可反转仲裁排序。
Motivation: RL 策略常以不透明神经 checkpoint 分发，训练日志只能说明跑过训练而无法说明学到了什么；需要判断独立训练的策略能否用可审计的离散行为规则来表示与组合。
Method: 协议包含共享冻结 symbolizer、被动规则抽取 (passive rule extraction)、append-only 哈希绑定账本、精确环境回放，以及带显式 blind-spot fallback 的离线置信度排序仲裁；可审计性被形式化为六条可分别检验的谓词。另用 fitted-Q generalized-policy-improvement 诊断与规则融合做对照，并对冲突主导任务做归纳/部署一致性检查。
Result: 实验覆盖 CartPole-v1 与 Acrobot-v1 两个环境、八个随机种子。规则集重叠不蕴含行为一致：共享符号规则的策略在新状态上仍可能选择近随机匹配的动作。冲突主导任务中一次表面的融合失败被定位为归纳/部署不匹配（用采样动作归纳的规则在 argmax 动作下评估），部署一致的重新归纳反转了仲裁排序。fitted-Q generalized-policy-improvement 诊断在两个环境中均失败；一次探索性比较偏向规则融合，但其比较对象是 post hoc、任务部分饱和，融合策略仍低于最强 held-out actor。
Conclusion: 作者主张给出的是有证据边界的审计与组合协议，而非普适可解释性或自主技能生成的断言；规则融合优于基于价值的组合这一说法受限于上述诊断失败。后续工作需加入时间上延展的技能、跨技能接口、组合搜索与独立新颖性审计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Token Clustering and Semantic Sequence Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Although hyperspectral images (HSIs) provide rich spectral-spatial information, accurate pixel-level classification remains challenging because of spectral-spatial heterogeneity and complex spatial structures. Existing vision state space models (Mamba) typically construct sequences according to predefined spatial neighborhoods, without explicitly accounting for semantic similarity or spatial non-stationarity. To address this limitation, we propose Token Clustering and Semantic Sequence Mamba (STMamba), which organizes sparse tokens into semantically coherent sequences for hyperspectral image classification with the following features. First, at the macro level, a hierarchical encoder decoder progressively selects semantic tokens with the Token Clustering Module (TCM) and restores dense features using a parameter-free Cross-scale Neighborhood Attention (CNA) Upsampler. Second, at the micro level, TCM first identifies representative cluster centers through density-aware clustering and estimates soft memberships based on feature similarity. A quadtree-based dynamic selection strategy then retains sparse and spatially distributed tokens from each semantic cluster, forming coherent semantic-token sequences while reducing redundant pixel-wise representations. Third, parallel Spatial and Spectral Semantic-wise Sequencing Mamba (SWSM) modules capture complementary long-range spatial and spectral dependencies within homogeneous semantic token sequences while suppressing irrelevant interactions across heterogeneous regions. Experimental results on three large-scale benchmark datasets demonstrate that STMamba outperforms the SOTA methods with respect to quantitative and qualitative results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 STMamba：用密度感知聚类的 Token Clustering Module 把高光谱像素组织成语义一致的稀疏 token 序列，再用并行的空间/光谱语义序列 Mamba (SWSM) 建模长程依赖。在三个大规模基准数据集上，STMamba 在定量与定性结果上均超过 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 高光谱图像存在光谱-空间异质性与复杂空间结构，而现有 Mamba 视觉模型按预定义空间邻域构造序列，不考虑语义相似性与空间非平稳性，导致像素级分类不准。
Method: 宏观层面用层次化编码-解码器，经 Token Clustering Module (TCM) 逐级筛选语义 token，再用免参数的 Cross-scale Neighborhood Attention (CNA) Upsampler 恢复稠密特征；微观层面 TCM 以密度感知聚类找代表中心并按特征相似度估计软隶属度，再用 quadtree 动态选择保留稀疏且空间分布的 token；并行的 Spatial and Spectral Semantic-wise Sequencing Mamba (SWSM) 在同质语义 token 序列内捕捉空间与光谱长程依赖，同时抑制跨异质区域的无关交互。
Result: 在三个大规模高光谱分类基准数据集上，STMamba 在定量与定性两方面均优于 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 按语义相似性而非固定空间邻域来构造序列，是高光谱像素级分类中比预定义邻域更有效的 Mamba 建模方式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Uncovering Residential PV-EV Co-Adoption from Smart-Meter Data: Load Archetypes and Detection for Demand-Side Planning
papers.abstract_en: The increasing adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) and rooftop photovoltaic (PV) systems is reshaping residential electricity demand and creating new challenges for demand-side management (DSM), tariff design, and low-voltage network planning. Much of the existing literature examines EV charging or PV generation in isolation, leaving the behavioral dynamics of household co-adoption less understood. We develop an integrated, two-part workflow to analyze advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) data. A discovery component applies dynamic time warping (DTW) k-means with DTW barycenter averaging to cluster daily import or export profiles into interpretable behavioral archetypes, while a predictive component trains a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) model on 21-day windows and benchmarks it against tabular baselines for PV/EV activity detection. The EV activity labels are inferred from charging-like load signatures because charger measurements are unavailable. Using half-hourly AusNet residential data from Victoria, Australia, the clustering uncovers distinct patterns across PV-only, EV-only, co-adoption, and neither cohorts; for co-adopters, a midday-centered weekday export archetype accounts for approximately 50% of days. At validation-tuned thresholds, both BiLSTM and XGBoost achieve strong discrimination. BiLSTM obtains 0.991 for the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), 0.906 for macro-F1, and the highest recall on the most difficult class (0.836 for EV-only recall). Tree-based baselines remain competitive. Performance remains stable across plausible labeling rules (macro-F1: 0.894--0.914) and strictly forward temporal splits (macro-F1: 0.894--0.906).
papers.journal_ref: Next Energy, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 AMI 半小时负荷数据做 PV-EV 共同采用的两段式流程：DTW k-means 加 DTW barycenter averaging 把日进口/出口曲线聚成可解释行为原型，BiLSTM 在 21 天窗口上检测 PV/EV 活动。在 AusNet（Victoria）数据上，共采用户的平日午间出口原型约占 50% 天数；BiLSTM AUROC 0.991、macro-F1 0.906、EV-only recall 0.836，XGBoost 等树模型仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 既有研究多把 EV 充电与 PV 发电分开考察，家庭层面的共同采用行为动态不清楚，而 DSM、电价设计与低压网络规划正需要这类信息。
Method: 发现段用 DTW k-means 与 DTW barycenter averaging 聚类日进口/出口负荷曲线得到行为原型；预测段在 21 天窗口上训练 BiLSTM，并与表格类基线（含 XGBoost）对比做 PV/EV 活动检测。EV 标签由充电样负荷特征推断，因为没有充电桩实测。数据为 Victoria, Australia 的 AusNet 半小时住宅 AMI。
Result: 共采用户中以午间为中心的平日出口原型约占 50% 天数；在验证调优阈值下 BiLSTM AUROC 0.991、macro-F1 0.906、最难类 EV-only recall 0.836，为各类中最高 recall。macro-F1 在不同标注规则下稳定于 0.894–0.914，在严格前向时间切分下为 0.894–0.906；树模型基线保持竞争力。
Conclusion: AMI 负荷曲线足以同时支撑 PV/EV 行为原型发现与活动检测，且检测性能对标注规则与时间切分稳健，可用于需求侧规划。

papers.title: Time-Series Foundation Models That Understand Data Revisions
papers.abstract_en: Historical observations are not always fixed: statistical agencies revise previously published values as new evidence arrives. Forecasting from a contemporary download can therefore expose a model to information unavailable at the date it purportedly made a prediction. We propose VINTAGE-TS, a revision-aware adaptation of a time-series foundation model that distinguishes observation time from information-availability time. Its targets are the next period's first-published value and the value available a fixed number of days after that publication; neither is declared final truth. A joint predictive distribution preserves dependence between these targets and exposes uncertainty about their difference. We specify an ALFRED-based rolling evaluation, a matched Chronos-2 comparison, conventional and revision-aware baselines, and a separate audit of pretraining overlap. The accompanying software implements validity-interval reconstruction, delayed-label filtering, a frozen-backbone adapter interface, and reproducible diagnostics. An executed synthetic demonstration and a 25-configuration sensitivity suite verify the workflow, expose variation across seeds and revision regimes, and illustrate how hindsight contamination changes measured performance. Thirty one automated tests check temporal and integration contracts. Real ALFRED and Chronos-2 experiments have not been executed; no empirical foundation-model advantage is claimed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VINTAGE-TS 把时间序列基础模型的预测目标从「当期下载值」改为区分观测时间与信息可得时间的双目标：下一期首发值与首发后固定天数可得值，并用联合预测分布刻画两者差值的不确定性。合成演示与 25 配置敏感性套件显示，事后信息污染 (hindsight contamination) 会改变测得性能且随随机种子与修订机制波动；作者明确尚未跑真实 ALFRED 与 Chronos-2 实验，不主张任何基础模型优势。
Motivation: 统计机构会回溯修订历史值，用当下下载的数据训练或评估模型，等于让它看到预测时点尚不存在的信息，测出的性能因此虚高。
Method: VINTAGE-TS 是对时间序列基础模型的修订感知改造：目标设为下一期首发值与首发后固定天数可得值的联合预测分布，二者都不当作最终真值；配套 ALFRED 滚动评估协议、匹配的 Chronos-2 对比、常规与修订感知基线、预训练重叠审计，软件实现有效区间重构、延迟标签过滤、冻结骨干适配器接口与可复现诊断。
Result: 执行了合成演示与 25 配置敏感性套件，显示跨随机种子与修订机制的性能变化，并演示事后信息污染如何改变测得性能；31 个自动化测试校验时序与集成契约。真实 ALFRED 与 Chronos-2 实验尚未执行。
Conclusion: 时间序列基础模型的评测必须按信息可得时间而非观测时间切分，否则结果被回溯修订污染；当前工作只验证了评估流程本身，不构成任何模型的经验优势。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and governing sensitive recall. The suite extends LoCoMo's corpora and harness, pairing every detect/block metric with a matched do-not-over-detect control: surface-matched hard negatives price false intervention, so no track can be gamed by flagging everything. The benchmark itself is validated first: independent, gold-blind double annotation with adjudication, judge decoy calibration, and a separability audit. On the human-validated Track B v1.0 key (161 items, post-adjudication kappa = 0.85), no tested configuration simultaneously achieves high contradiction recall, high hard-negative specificity, and high attribution: flat-RAG baselines detect 0.76-0.97 of true contradictions but falsely flag 16-43% of surface-matched safe drafts depending on backend, while a deployed coherence-oriented system almost never over-flags (0.98-1.00 specificity) yet catches 42% of true contradictions -- a trade-off no recall-only score can see. A 13-configuration baseline ladder localizes causes: every gold contradiction is detectable from its evidence alone (recall 1.000), calibrated models nearly solve the track given the full transcript -- consistent with substantial retrieval-coverage gaps -- and draft-only floors reveal model-dependent style priors. A system's TWIST profile, beside its recall score, measures whether memory knows when to intervene and when not to.

papers.title: Where Cyber Agents Struggle: Bottleneck Analysis of Multi-Stage LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-stage LLM-based cyber agents may complete attack workflows while remaining brittle, costly, or reliant on incorrect interpretations of execution evidence. Success rates alone obscure inefficiency, adaptation through retries, and recognition of success or failure. We present an end-to-end diagnostic study of an Autonomous Adversary system with orchestrator, executor, and validator LLMs in enterprise-like lateral-movement scenarios. Six frontier models are evaluated across two scenarios and three modes: expert-defined, self-scaffolded, and fully autonomous. We assess validator consistency and evidence grounding; introduce a subtask-conditioned, cost-aware score for abnormal token use, retries, and runtime; and use comparative LLM-as-a-Judge analysis to identify planning deficiencies, including tool misalignment, plan similarity, over-specification, inadequate probing, and weak recovery. Validators are generally relevant and evidence-grounded but often nonspecific and overly optimistic. Bottlenecks cluster in credential and lateral-movement tasks, spread with scenario complexity, and vary more under full autonomy. Reliable evaluation must assess outcomes, evidence interpretation, resource use, and adaptation after failure.
papers.comment: The 19th International Symposium on Foundations & Practice of Security (FPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对多阶段 LLM 网络攻击代理 (Autonomous Adversary：orchestrator/executor/validator) 做端到端瓶颈诊断，发现成功率会掩盖成本与证据误读：validator 通常与证据相关但过于乐观、不够具体，瓶颈集中在凭据与横向移动任务，并随场景复杂度扩散、在全自主模式下波动更大。作者主张可靠评估必须同时考核结果、证据解读、资源消耗与失败后适应。
Motivation: 只看成功率无法暴露多阶段 LLM 代理的低效、重试适应与对执行证据的错误解读，而这些正是企业横向移动场景中脆弱性与成本的来源。
Method: 在类企业横向移动场景中评测含 orchestrator、executor、validator 三类 LLM 的 Autonomous Adversary 系统，覆盖 6 个前沿模型、2 个场景、3 种模式（expert-defined、self-scaffolded、fully autonomous）；评估 validator 一致性与证据落地性，提出子任务条件、成本感知的异常 token 用量/重试/运行时评分，并用 comparative LLM-as-a-Judge 归纳规划缺陷（工具错配、计划相似、过度指定、探测不足、恢复乏力）。
Result: 6 个前沿模型 × 2 场景 × 3 模式的诊断显示：validator 普遍相关且证据落地但常不具体、过度乐观；瓶颈聚集在 credential 与 lateral-movement 任务，随场景复杂度扩散，在 fully autonomous 模式下差异更大；识别出工具错配、计划相似、过度指定、探测不足、恢复乏力等规划缺陷。
Conclusion: 多阶段网络代理的可靠性评估不能只报成功率，必须并列考核结果、证据解读、资源使用与失败后适应；瓶颈位置随自主程度与场景复杂度变化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a categorical policy's expected score-gradient norm vanishes as its distribution sharpens, so the predictions that most need correction receive the weakest updates. We propose Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization (DEEPO), a dual-stage enhancement combining signal variance regularization with gradient preconditioning: semantic-entropy-triggered expert prefixes inject grounded continuations on high-uncertainty queries, providing direct supervision and restoring advantage variance, while advantage-sign-aware Renyi preconditioning counteracts logit-level saturation so correction reaches confident errors in the operational confidence regime. Both branches improve over GRPO individually; their interaction is statistically significant on VideoMMMU---the most complex long-horizon task in our evaluation suite (+4.0$, 95\% CI [1.1, 6.9])---and additive elsewhere. DEEPO reduces hallucination while preserving accuracy and training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEEPO 针对多模态大模型 RL 矫正链的两处断裂：高语义熵难题常整组答错使组相对优势归零，自信错误 token 又因策略分布变尖而梯度不可见。它用语义熵触发的专家前缀注入接地续写恢复优势方差，再用优势符号感知的 Renyi 预条件打破 logit 饱和；两支单独都优于 GRPO，在 VideoMMMU 上交互项显著（+4.0，95% CI [1.1, 6.9]），其余任务为可加。
Motivation: RL 提升 MLLM 推理但对幻觉的作用不均：rollout 层高语义熵难题整组一致答错使组相对优势塌到零，优化层自信错误 token 的期望分数梯度范数随分布变尖而消失，最该被纠正的预测反而更新最弱。
Method: DEEPO 双阶段增强：信号方差正则 + 梯度预条件。语义熵触发的专家前缀在高不确定查询上注入接地续写，提供直接监督并恢复优势方差；优势符号感知的 Renyi 预条件对抗 logit 级饱和，使纠正能到达自信错误。
Result: 两支单独均优于 GRPO；在 VideoMMMU（评测套件中最复杂的长程任务）上二者交互统计显著，+4.0，95% CI [1.1, 6.9]，其余任务为可加。DEEPO 降低幻觉同时保持准确率与训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 幻觉源于矫正链上优势方差塌缩与梯度不可见两处断裂，分别注入监督与重加权梯度即可同时改善，且在最难长程任务上交互项显著。
Relevance: 1
