papers.title: QINA: Quantum-Inspired Nonlinear Adapters for Pretrained Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Adapting large pretrained vision models under limited data and frozen-backbone constraints remains a central challenge in transfer learning. While lightweight adapters and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods are widely adopted, most rely on generic multilayer perceptrons or low-rank linear updates, offering limited control over the spectral and geometric structure of feature transformations. We investigate whether structured nonlinear feature lifting can improve representational alignment in frozen regimes. We introduce Quantum-Inspired Nonlinear Adapters (QINA), compact modules that perform learnable trigonometric feature lifting followed by bounded nonlinear aggregation. The design induces structured oscillatory basis functions with an explicit norm-dependent Lipschitz bound, enabling spectral reshaping of pretrained representations without increasing the receptive field or significantly expanding parameter count. Importantly, the method operates entirely within standard deep learning frameworks and does not require quantum hardware. Through systematic experiments across natural and medical imaging datasets, classification and segmentation tasks, multiple adapters and placements, and varying training budgets, we show that performance in frozen regimes is primarily representation-limited. Nonlinear lifting improves adaptation, and the proposed structured trigonometric formulation consistently outperforms identity baselines, fixed Fourier feature mappings, and parameter-matched baseline adapters. Within the evaluated frozen-backbone settings, structured spectral parameterization provides a more effective inductive bias than generic nonlinear adapters. This work highlights the importance of geometry- and spectrum-aware adaptation mechanisms for large pretrained vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QINA 用可学习的三角函数特征提升 (trigonometric feature lifting) 加有界非线性聚合替换 adapter 里的通用 MLP 或低秩线性更新，在冻结骨干下重塑预训练表征的谱结构，并给出显式的范数依赖 Lipschitz 上界。在自然与医学影像的分类和分割任务上，该结构化谱参数化一致优于 identity 基线、固定 Fourier feature 映射与参数量匹配的基线 adapter，且不扩大感受野、不显著增加参数量。
Motivation: 冻结骨干、少数据的迁移场景中，主流 adapter 依赖通用 MLP 或低秩线性更新，对特征变换的谱与几何结构缺少控制，难以判断冻结体制下的瓶颈究竟是表征还是适配器容量。
Method: QINA 是紧凑模块：先做可学习的三角函数特征提升，再做有界非线性聚合，形成带范数依赖 Lipschitz 界的结构化振荡基函数；全程在标准深度学习框架内实现，不需要量子硬件。实验系统改变 adapter 类型与插入位置、训练预算，并覆盖自然与医学影像的分类与分割任务。
Result: 在所评测的冻结骨干设定下，性能主要受表征限制 (representation-limited)；非线性提升改善适配效果，QINA 的结构化三角形式一致优于 identity 基线、固定 Fourier feature 映射和参数匹配的基线 adapter。
Conclusion: 对大预训练视觉模型，几何与谱感知的结构化参数化比通用非线性 adapter 提供更有效的归纳偏置，冻结体制的瓶颈主要在表征本身。

papers.title: CATCH: Counterfactual Anatomical Tissue Inpainting with Conditional Haar Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: BraTS local synthesis replaces masked regions in T1-weighted brain MRI with plausible tumor-free tissue while preserving observed anatomy. We present CATCH, conditional 3D diffusion in an invertible Haar-wavelet domain. Its denoiser receives noisy target coefficients, voided-image coefficients, and a signed mask; tumor-excluded wavelet reconstruction and a hole-focused loss guide training, and hard compositing preserves observed voxels. We compare fixed masks, tumor-component augmentation, and a weighted mixture of tumor-derived, irregular-blob, and ellipsoidal masks. Of 25 development cases, five prespecified cases select each arm's checkpoint and all 25 of their trajectory aggregations; a separate 75-case internal set compares the frozen pipelines and selects a weighted mixture for organizer evaluation. Five-trajectory averaging yielded internal SSIM/PSNR/MSE (mean$\pm$SD) of $0.80\pm0.13$, $19.18\pm1.80$dB, and $0.010\pm0.005$. As the sole officially evaluated pipeline, weighted mixture yielded $0.772\pm0.119$, $20.89\pm3.27$dB, and $0.0098\pm0.0054$ on the 219-case BraTS 2026 validation set. Against compute-matched random augmentation internally, it improved SSIM by 0.019 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.013-0.025), PSNR by 0.95dB, and MSE by 0.003; all three paired comparisons remained significant after Holm correction. Results favor the complete weighted-mixture policy within CATCH; absent official fixed- and random-pipeline scores and a directly comparable external baseline limit broader conclusions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 15th BraTS Workshop in MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATCH 用条件 3D Haar 小波可逆扩散做 BraTS 局部合成，把 T1 脑 MRI 中被掩蔽的肿瘤区域补成合理的无瘤组织并保留已观测解剖。掩蔽策略对比中，肿瘤衍生、不规则 blob 与椭球三者加权混合最优：内部 75 例上相对算力匹配的随机增强 SSIM 提升 0.019、PSNR 提升 0.95dB、MSE 降低 0.003，且经 Holm 校正后仍显著。
Motivation: BraTS 局部合成要在替换掩蔽区的同时不破坏已观测解剖，而掩蔽区域的形状分布（肿瘤衍生 vs 合成几何）如何影响补全质量此前缺少受控比较。
Method: CATCH 是可逆 Haar 小波域中的条件 3D 扩散：去噪器接收含噪目标系数、被挖空图像系数与带符号掩码；训练用排除肿瘤的小波重建与聚焦孔洞的损失引导，硬合成保留已观测体素。比较固定掩码、肿瘤成分增强、以及肿瘤衍生/不规则 blob/椭球掩码的加权混合三种策略；25 例开发集中各 5 例预指定病例选 checkpoint，独立 75 例内部集比较冻结管线并选出加权混合送交主办方评测。
Result: 五轨迹平均在内部集 SSIM 0.80±0.13、PSNR 19.18±1.80dB、MSE 0.010±0.005；作为唯一官方评测管线，加权混合在 219 例 BraTS 2026 验证集上 SSIM 0.772±0.119、PSNR 20.89±3.27dB、MSE 0.0098±0.0054。内部对比算力匹配的随机增强，SSIM +0.019（95% bootstrap CI 0.013–0.025）、PSNR +0.95dB、MSE −0.003，三项配对比较经 Holm 校正后均显著。
Conclusion: 在 CATCH 内部，完整的加权混合掩蔽策略优于固定与随机增强方案；但缺少官方的固定/随机管线分数与可直接比较的外部基线，限制了更广的结论。

papers.title: ToCo-Mesh: Topology-Consistent Dynamic Mesh Reconstruction via Adaptive Tessellation and Surface-Aligned 2DGS
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic meshes with consistent topology from multi-view temporal images remains a challenge. Existing approaches typically face a dilemma between fine-scale shape recovery and topological stability. Frame-by-frame extraction methods capture fine details but break vertex correspondence, leading to flickering meshes. Conversely, template-based deformation ensures consistency but struggles to adapt its surface resolution during optimization, missing local surface details. To address these limitations, we propose ToCo-Mesh, a dynamic reconstruction framework that maintains topology consistency over time while achieving high-fidelity geometry. Specifically, we introduce a dual-mesh representation, where a canonical template mesh is tightly bound to time-varying coarse guide meshes via barycentric parameterization. While keeping guide meshes fixed to condition the deformation, we perform error-driven split-and-merge on the template mesh to progressively increase reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, to suppress surface irregularities and achieve photorealistic rendering, we incorporate a Surface-Aligned 2DGS module. By anchoring flattened Gaussians to mesh faces, we utilize their rendered normals to guide inverse geometric fine-tuning. To our knowledge, ToCo-Mesh is the first framework to enable adaptive mesh refinement while maintaining strict topological consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves SOTA geometric accuracy while maintaining competitive rendering quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ToCo-Mesh 用双网格表示在多视角时序图像上重建拓扑一致的动态网格：规范模板网格经重心参数化绑定到时变粗引导网格，引导网格固定以约束形变，对模板网格做误差驱动的 split-and-merge 渐进加密，并用 Surface-Aligned 2DGS 把扁平高斯锚定到网格面、以其渲染法线引导逆向几何微调。作者称其为首个在保持严格拓扑一致的同时实现自适应网格加密的框架，实验达到 SOTA 几何精度且渲染质量有竞争力。
Motivation: 逐帧提取能抓细节但破坏顶点对应导致网格闪烁，模板形变保证一致却无法在优化中调整表面分辨率、丢失局部细节，细尺度恢复与拓扑稳定难以兼得。
Method: 双网格表示：规范模板网格通过重心参数化 (barycentric parameterization) 绑定到时变粗引导网格，引导网格固定以条件化形变；对模板网格做误差驱动的 split-and-merge 逐步提升保真度；加入 Surface-Aligned 2DGS 模块，把扁平高斯锚定到网格面上，用其渲染法线引导逆向几何微调 (inverse geometric fine-tuning)。
Result: 在多视角时序图像的动态重建上，作者称方法取得 SOTA 几何精度并保持有竞争力的渲染质量，且据称是首个在维持严格拓扑一致的同时实现自适应网格加密的框架。
Conclusion: 把拓扑一致性交给固定的引导网格、把细节交给误差驱动的模板加密，可以同时避免逐帧闪烁与模板形变的分辨率僵化。

papers.title: PPTBench: Can Coding Agents Reconstruct the Visual World through Structured, Editable Slides
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are beginning to act in the visual world. They now build webpages, GUIs, games, 3D scenes, diagrams, and documents. Success in such visual coding requires bridging two spaces: inferring visual structure and expressing it programmatically. Slides are a core medium of knowledge work, widely used to communicate ideas and collaborate in a form that people can directly inspect and edit. Therefore, they provide an ideal testbed for visual coding, as they require agents to recover visual structure and realize it as editable objects. However, existing benchmarks either rely on subjective open-ended evaluation, produce non-editable code outputs, or focus only on local editing rather than end-to-end visual reconstruction. We introduce PPTBench, which benchmarks visual coding through editable slide reconstruction. It contains 500 tasks, each based on a scientific flow diagram from a real arXiv paper and requiring agents to reconstruct it as a single PPTX page composed of native, editable objects. A four-stage Agentic Judge evaluates artifact validity, semantic correctness, rendering quality, and fine-grained visual quality. Across 31 configurations spanning model families, effort levels, and harnesses, the best configuration, Kimi K3, reaches only 67.80, while the median scores 19.47. We find that agents can reliably produce valid PPTX files but still struggle with semantic and visual correctness, especially text details. More reasoning mainly helps agents pass hard gates, while stronger verification is more consistently associated with higher quality. PPTBench advances the vision of coding agents that can understand and reconstruct the visual world through structured, editable code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPTBench 用 500 个来自真实 arXiv 论文科学流程图的可编辑 PPTX 重建任务评测 coding agent，四阶段 Agentic Judge 分别打分产物有效性、语义正确性、渲染质量与细粒度视觉质量。31 个配置中最好的 Kimi K3 仅得 67.80，中位数 19.47：agent 能稳定产出合法 PPTX，但语义与视觉正确性（尤其文字细节）仍差；更多推理主要帮助通过硬性门槛，更强的验证才与更高画质稳定相关。
Motivation: 现有视觉编码基准要么依赖主观开放式评分，要么产出不可编辑代码，要么只测局部编辑而非端到端视觉重建，无法衡量 agent 能否把视觉结构恢复成可直接检查、可编辑的对象。
Method: 每个任务给定一张真实 arXiv 论文的科学流程图，要求 agent 重建为单页、由原生可编辑对象构成的 PPTX；用四阶段 Agentic Judge 依次评产物有效性、语义正确性、渲染质量与细粒度视觉质量，横跨模型家族、effort 等级与 harness 共 31 个配置。
Result: 500 个任务、31 个配置下，最佳配置 Kimi K3 得分 67.80，中位数 19.47；agent 能可靠生成有效 PPTX，但语义与视觉正确性（尤其文字细节）普遍不足；更多推理主要提升通过硬门槛的比例，更强的验证与更高画质更稳定相关。
Conclusion: 可编辑幻灯片重建是检验 coding agent 能否理解并重建视觉世界的有效测试床，当前瓶颈在语义与视觉正确性而非文件合法性，提升质量更应靠加强验证而非单纯加推理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TopoFuse: Topology-Aware Tri-Planar Fusion for 3D Cryo-Electron Tomography Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Automated segmentation of cryo-electron tomograms routinely produces masks that are voxel-accurate but topologically broken: membranes fragment, organelles merge into one another, and enclosed cavities collapse. Existing topology-aware losses reduce these violations but cannot eliminate them, because topology is encouraged through gradient pressure rather than structurally enforced. We introduce TopoFuse, which reframes topology as a differentiable projection operator rather than a loss penalty. At each forward pass, the projection operator $\mathrm{Proj}_T$ (a PH-guided sparse edit) identifies the critical voxels responsible for topological violations via bottleneck matching and applies sparse edits to satisfy a specified topology target (diagram feature counts and lifetime budgets) for dimensions $d \in \{0,2\}$. If the projection converges, the output satisfies those constraints on the downsampled grid ($s=2$); when it does not, a repair certificate exposes this explicitly, enabling downstream filtering. A topology prior head predicts the correction target directly from input features, removing any dependence on ground-truth topology at inference. Across three cryo-ET benchmarks, TopoFuse reduces Betti number error by 54% over the strongest soft-loss baseline ($p < 0.001$), improves Dice by 4.6 points, and edits only 3.1% of voxels to achieve this.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoFuse 把 3D 冷冻电镜断层成像 (cryo-ET) 分割中的拓扑约束从软损失改成可微投影算子 Proj_T：每步前向用瓶颈匹配定位致拓扑违规的关键体素，做稀疏编辑以满足 d∈{0,2} 的 Betti 数与寿命预算。在三个 cryo-ET 基准上，Betti 数误差较最强软损失基线降低 54% (p<0.001)，Dice 提升 4.6 点，且只编辑 3.1% 的体素。
Motivation: cryo-ET 自动分割得到的掩膜体素级准确但拓扑破损：膜断裂、细胞器相互合并、封闭腔塌陷。现有拓扑感知损失只通过梯度压力鼓励拓扑，无法根除违规。
Method: 将拓扑重构为可微投影算子 Proj_T（PH 引导的稀疏编辑）：通过瓶颈匹配识别致拓扑违规的关键体素，在降采样网格 (s=2) 上施加稀疏编辑以满足 d∈{0,2} 的 diagram 特征计数与寿命预算；投影不收敛时输出修复证书 (repair certificate) 供下游过滤；另设拓扑先验头直接从输入特征预测修正目标，推理时不依赖真值拓扑。
Result: 在三个 cryo-ET 基准上，Betti 数误差较最强软损失基线降低 54% (p<0.001)，Dice 提升 4.6 点，仅编辑 3.1% 的体素。
Conclusion: 把拓扑当作结构上强制的可微投影而非梯度惩罚，可在极少体素改动下同时压低 Betti 数误差并抬高 Dice；投影收敛时约束在 s=2 网格上成立，不收敛时以修复证书显式暴露。

papers.title: Revalidation Beats Stateful Routing for Scientific Surrogates Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Surrogate models are often chosen during development and then left in place as new measurements arrive. That practice becomes risky when noise, input support, or physical parameters change. We asked whether such changes call for a stateful adaptive controller, or whether it is enough to validate the candidate models again on each new batch. To study this question, we built RegimeShift-Surrogates, a reproducible streaming benchmark spanning eight analytic and dynamical tasks, four stationary or shifting regimes, ten held-out seeds, and eight classical, multilayer-perceptron, and Kolmogorov-Arnold network surrogates. The confirmatory run contains 30,720 model fits and 3,200 scored deployment windows. Choosing the model with the lowest validation loss in the current window yields mean log regret 0.091 against a per-window oracle; the best fixed model chosen in hindsight yields 0.192. The paired difference is -0.101 (hierarchical bootstrap 95% CI [-0.165, -0.040]; Holm-adjusted p = 0.0469), with revalidation ahead in 26 of 32 task-scenario combinations. None of the stateful alternatives, including exponential smoothing, dual-timescale adaptation, Page-Hinkley resets, or margin gating, improves the pooled result, and delayed bias correction makes it worse. Oracle choices also differ substantially by task: k-nearest neighbors dominate the damped oscillator, vanilla KAN is often selected for two-dimensional surfaces, and MLPs lead on the Runge and Van der Pol tasks. In this benchmark, fresh validation evidence is useful; carrying old evidence forward is often not.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, and 22 references; includes reproducibility appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在流式分布偏移下，每个新窗口重新用验证损失挑选代理模型，比维护有状态自适应控制器更划算：平均 log regret 0.091，而事后选定的固定模型为 0.192，配对差 -0.101（95% CI [-0.165, -0.040]，Holm 校正 p=0.0469），32 个任务-场景组合中 26 个支持重新验证。
Motivation: 代理模型在开发期选定后长期沿用，一旦噪声、输入支撑或物理参数漂移就失效；需要判断该上状态自适应控制器，还是每批新数据重新验证候选模型即可。
Method: 构建可复现流式基准 RegimeShift-Surrogates：8 个解析与动力学任务、4 个平稳/偏移 regime、10 个留出种子、8 种经典/MLP/Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络代理；确认性运行含 30,720 次模型拟合与 3,200 个打分部署窗口，对照指数平滑、双时间尺度自适应、Page-Hinkley 重置、margin gating 等有状态方案与延迟偏差校正。
Result: 当前窗口验证损失最低的选择平均 log regret 0.091，事后最优固定模型 0.192，配对差 -0.101（分层 bootstrap 95% CI [-0.165, -0.040]，Holm 校正 p=0.0469），32 个任务-场景组合中 26 个重新验证占优；所有有状态方案均未改善合并结果，延迟偏差校正反而更差。oracle 选择随任务差异大：k 近邻主导 damped oscillator，vanilla KAN 常被选用于二维曲面，MLP 在 Runge 与 Van der Pol 上领先。
Conclusion: 新鲜验证证据有用，旧证据前向传递往往无益；在该基准上无需有状态自适应控制器，逐窗口重验证即可。

papers.title: RAPTOR: RAndom-projection Physics-informed Transient sOlveR
papers.abstract_en: The complexity of time-domain simulation of modern power systems has increased significantly because converter-based resources introduce control dynamics that must be simulated alongside slower system-level and fast electromagnetic dynamics. The resulting wide range of timescales may force classical time-domain solvers to use small timesteps, complicate the solution of nonlinear equations at each timestep, and reduce solver reliability under strongly nonlinear and multi-timescale transient conditions. This paper introduces RAPTOR, a first-of-its-kind time-domain simulation framework for power system dynamic simulations. At its core, RAPTOR introduces a new integration technique that represents the unknown trajectory of hybrid differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) over a time interval using a physics-informed random-projection neural network (PIRPNN) built from fixed Gaussian radial basis functions (RBFs). A nonlinear solver, e.g., Newton-Raphson, determines how to combine the fixed RBFs so that the resulting trajectory satisfies the governing equations. By combining RBFs with broad and localized shapes, RAPTOR can represent complex multi-timescale behavior over comparatively long time intervals. This enables larger effective simulation advances, fewer overall nonlinear solver iterations, and faster integration over long time horizons. Numerical studies on stiff RMS models, IEEE 9-, 14-, 39-, 57-, and 118-bus RMS simulation benchmarks, and EMT test cases show that RAPTOR accurately finds solutions with substantially fewer sequential simulation advances while offering superior accuracy-runtime performance. With speedups of over 10x in certain cases, these results showcase RAPTOR's potential to outperform long-standing and widely used integration methods, such as the Radau method and the trapezoidal rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAPTOR 用物理信息随机投影神经网络 (PIRPNN) 在一个时间区间上直接表示混合 DAE 的未知轨迹，固定高斯 RBF 作基函数，由 Newton-Raphson 求解组合系数使轨迹满足控制方程。宽窄 RBF 混合可覆盖多时间尺度，从而用更少的顺序推进步完成长时段积分；在 IEEE 9/14/39/57/118-bus RMS 基准与 EMT 算例上部分算例加速超过 10x，精度-运行时间表现优于 Radau 与梯形法。
Motivation: 变换器型电源引入控制动态，使电力系统时域仿真横跨慢系统级到快电磁的多时间尺度，经典求解器被迫取小步长、每步非线性方程更难解，强非线性多时间尺度暂态下可靠性下降。
Method: 在时间区间上用固定高斯径向基函数 (RBF) 构建物理信息随机投影神经网络 (PIRPNN) 表示混合 DAE 未知轨迹，由 Newton-Raphson 等非线性求解器决定固定 RBF 的组合系数，使轨迹满足控制方程；宽形状与局部形状 RBF 混合以覆盖多时间尺度。
Result: 在 stiff RMS 模型、IEEE 9、14、39、57、118-bus RMS 仿真基准及 EMT 测试算例上，RAPTOR 以显著更少的顺序仿真推进步得到准确解，部分算例加速超过 10x，精度-运行时间表现优于长期广泛使用的 Radau 方法与梯形法。

papers.title: Decoupling Knowledge and Privacy: Post-Task Self-Distillation Replay for LLM Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Privacy-preserving continual learning (PPCL) must reduce the reproduction of sensitive content while retaining useful knowledge across sequential tasks. Formal privacy guarantees characterize randomized mechanisms, whereas operational output control concerns whether a trained model selectively reduces the likelihood of sensitive content in its outputs. In this work, we investigate the latter together with continual-learning utility under realistic task evolution. Retention and privacy correction operate at different granularities: task acquisition requires broad preservation of current- and old-task behavior, whereas privacy correction targets sparse annotated positions. Joint optimization leaves the current-task preservation target continually changing. We propose SPARK, a retention-correction decomposition that first freezes the learned post-task distribution and then applies selective correction around this stable reference. Self-Distillation Replay learns the current task while distilling behavior from previous tasks, and Post-Task Privacy Correction reduces annotated-PII likelihood while anchoring current- and old-task non-PII behavior to the resulting checkpoint. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SPARK achieves effective selective PII suppression while preserving strong continual-learning utility and knowledge retention across diverse settings. Code and data will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARK 把隐私保护持续学习 (PPCL) 拆成保留与隐私纠正两步：先用 Self-Distillation Replay 学当前任务并蒸馏旧行为，冻结得到 post-task 分布，再围绕这个稳定参考做 Post-Task Privacy Correction，只压低标注 PII 位置的似然。结果是选择性抑制 PII 的同时保住持续学习效用与知识保留。
Motivation: 持续学习里隐私纠正与任务保留粒度不同——任务获取要大范围保持当前与旧任务行为，隐私纠正只针对稀疏标注位置；联合优化会让当前任务的保留目标不断变动。
Method: SPARK 采用 retention-correction 分解：Self-Distillation Replay 在学习当前任务时从先前任务蒸馏行为，得到 checkpoint 后冻结为 post-task 分布；Post-Task Privacy Correction 在该稳定参考上做选择性纠正，压低标注 PII 似然并把当前与旧任务的非 PII 行为锚定到该 checkpoint。
Result: 在多种设置下，SPARK 实现了有效的选择性 PII 抑制，同时保持较强的持续学习效用与知识保留；代码与数据将于发表时发布。
Conclusion: 把隐私纠正与任务保留解耦、先冻结 post-task 分布再做选择性纠正，可以在压低敏感内容输出的同时不牺牲持续学习的知识保持。

papers.title: Three Ways Classical Test Theory Misleads for LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: An LLM judge scores a bank of responses against a rubric, and the reliability comes back at $0.52$. What has been measured? Judge evaluation has begun borrowing reliability statistics from classical test theory, usually without stating the measurement design each statistic assumes, and we show that three widely portable ones mean something different for a judge than for a test because the judge setting rearranges the roles those designs rest on. First, an internal-consistency coefficient computed over rubric elements contains no scorer facet. Holding one judge's measured error rate fixed at $4.72\%$, KR-20 still ranges from $0.01$ to $0.68$ as the item bank is redesigned around it, and varying judge error moves the coefficient by a comparable amount, so item design and judge error are not separately identified and no single value can be read as a property of the judge. Second, the dependability index $Φ(λ)$ is a ratio of variance components, and the classification probability with which it is sometimes identified differs from it by $0.25$-$0.43$ on our bank and by $0.17$-$0.30$ on simulated data where the underlying model holds exactly. Third, Livingston-Lewis accuracy is indexed to an examinee's own true score on the same instrument, so scoring it against external gold conflates judge unreliability with criterion invalidity. Reviewing the three closest judge-evaluation papers, we found no published instance of these errors, which makes the caution prospective. A coefficient that cannot be attributed to the judge nonetheless travels downstream into deployment decisions and disclosure documents. We therefore close with four reporting lines that keep the attribution attached to the number.
papers.comment: 5 pages plus references and appendix (12 pages total), 4 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/louisyzhu/llm-judge-reliability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 评审 (LLM judge) 的信度统计直接搬自经典测量理论 (classical test theory)，但评审场景颠倒了这些统计所依赖的测量设计角色，导致同一数字含义改变。固定单个评审错误率 4.72% 时，KR-20 随题库重设计在 0.01–0.68 间浮动，题项设计与评审误差不可分；可依赖性指数 Φ(λ) 与被混同的分类概率在题库上相差 0.25–0.43、在模型精确成立的模拟数据上仍差 0.17–0.30。作者给出四条报告规范，使归因附着在数字上。
Motivation: 评审评估开始借用经典测量理论的信度统计，却通常不声明每个统计量所假设的测量设计；一个无法归因于评审的系数会流入部署决策与披露文档。
Method: 论证三个可移植统计量在评审设定下的含义错位：内部一致性系数不含评分者facet；把可依赖性指数 Φ(λ)（方差成分之比）等同于分类概率；Livingwin-Lewis 准确度以被试自身真分为索引，改用外部金标准会混淆评审不可靠性与标准无效性。用自建题库与模型精确成立的模拟数据量化差异，并综述三篇最接近的评审评估论文。
Result: 固定评审错误率 4.72% 时 KR-20 随题库设计在 0.01–0.68 间变化，改变评审误差带来的系数变化幅度相当；Φ(λ) 与分类概率在作者题库上相差 0.25–0.43，在底层模型精确成立的模拟数据上仍差 0.17–0.30；综述三篇最接近的评审评估论文未发现这些错误的已发表实例。
Conclusion: 这三个系数无法归因于评审本身，其警示是前瞻性的；作者以四条报告规范收尾，要求把归因与数字绑定。

papers.title: Safety-oriented pedestrian trajectory prediction at urban intersections using time-to-collision and crossing-zone context
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction is important for proactive road-safety applications, particularly at urban intersections where pedestrian motion is shaped by both vehicle interactions and crossing context. This study presents a safety-oriented trajectory-prediction framework that combines pedestrian motion history with Time-to-Collision (TTC) information and crossing-zone indicators. Using naturalistic trajectories from one urban intersection in the inD (Intersection Drone) dataset, several neural architectures were evaluated with 1.6 s observation and 2.4 s prediction horizons. A pooled Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) separately encodes TTC histories and crossing-zone context before integrating them with pedestrian positions. In addition to conventional Average Displacement Error (ADE) and Final Displacement Error (FDE), prediction performance was assessed using the frequency and magnitude of errors exceeding a study-defined 1 m tolerance. A weighted loss was also introduced to place greater training emphasis on large coordinate-wise errors. Applying this loss to the position-only LSTM reduced ADE from 0.210 to 0.190 m and FDE from 0.550 to 0.503 m, while reducing ADE and FDE exceedance counts by 34.8% and 19.8%, respectively. The final pooled configuration incorporating TTC and crossing-zone information achieved an ADE of 0.184 m and FDE of 0.491 m, with further reductions of 33.5% and 6.3% in ADE and FDE exceedance counts relative to the safety-oriented position-only LSTM. The results indicate that safety-oriented training and structured integration of interaction and contextual information can reduce large trajectory-prediction errors, although broader validation across pedestrians, sites, and datasets is required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 inD 单个路口的行人轨迹预测上，把 TTC 与过街区 (crossing-zone) 上下文分别编码再与位置融合的 pooled LSTM，并配合强调大坐标误差的加权损失，可压低大误差尾部。加权损失使 position-only LSTM 的 ADE 从 0.210 降到 0.190 m、FDE 从 0.550 降到 0.503 m，超 1 m 容差计数分别减少 34.8% 与 19.8%；加入 TTC 与过街区后 ADE 0.184 m、FDE 0.491 m，超限计数再降 33.5% 与 6.3%。
Motivation: 城市路口行人轨迹受车辆交互与过街语境共同塑造，常规 ADE/FDE 掩盖了少数大位移误差，而正是这些大误差对主动道路安全最关键。
Method: 用 inD (Intersection Drone) 数据集的自然轨迹，1.6 s 观测、2.4 s 预测时长，评估多种神经网络架构；pooled LSTM 分别编码 TTC 历史与 crossing-zone 上下文，再与行人位置整合；除 ADE/FDE 外，按研究自定的 1 m 容差统计超限频率与幅度，并引入对大坐标误差加权的损失。
Result: 加权损失作用于 position-only LSTM：ADE 0.210 → 0.190 m，FDE 0.550 → 0.503 m，ADE/FDE 超限计数分别减少 34.8% 和 19.8%。最终 pooled 配置（含 TTC 与 crossing-zone）ADE 0.184 m、FDE 0.491 m，相对安全导向的 position-only LSTM 超限计数再降 33.5%（ADE）与 6.3%（FDE）。
Conclusion: 安全导向的加权训练加上交互与语境信息的结构化融合能减少行人轨迹的大误差；作者同时指出需要在更多行人、站点与数据集上做更广验证。

papers.title: Understanding and Exploiting Initialization Anchoring Weakness in Feedback-Based Agent Planning
papers.abstract_en: Feedback-based planning improves agent reliability by incorporating tool observations and corrective feedback. However, its protection may not be distributed uniformly across planning stages. We conduct a round-wise analysis of four representative feedback mechanisms and uncover an initialization anchoring weakness: the first feedback round corrects 46\% of adversarial directions, whereas the rates fall to 13\% and 7\% among directions surviving into the next two rounds. Our analysis attributes this weakness to three interacting factors: a contextually plausible shift in the initial plan, insufficient counterevidence, and the persistence of accepted directions in the accumulated trajectory. Based on these findings, we propose \textsc{InitAnchor}, a black-box framework for exploiting this weakness through attacker-controlled external materials. It operationalizes the three factors as directional-shift, contextual-plausibility, and counterevidence-resilience signals under either limited target access or no target access. Across 112 tasks from 16 domains, six agent architectures, and five backbone LLMs, \textsc{InitAnchor} achieves average ASRs of 76.1\% and 72.0\% under the two settings while reducing first-round mitigation rates to 21.0\% and 25.0\%, respectively. It also remains effective against six defenses and across six real-world agent systems. These findings show that feedback-based agents can retain early biases even when later correction is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对基于反馈的 agent 规划做逐轮分析，发现首轮反馈能纠正 46% 的对抗方向，但存活到第二、三轮的方向纠正率骤降到 13% 和 7%，即初始化锚定 (initialization anchoring) 弱点。据此提出黑盒攻击框架 InitAnchor，用 attacker-controlled 外部材料把三个成因编码为 directional-shift、contextual-plausibility、counterevidence-resilience 信号，在 112 个任务上平均 ASR 达 76.1% 与 72.0%，并把首轮纠正率压到 21.0% 与 25.0%。
Motivation: 基于反馈的 agent 规划被当作可靠性保障，但保护在各规划阶段分布不均：早期被接受的对抗方向会随轨迹累积持续存活，后续纠正难以追回。
Method: 先对四种代表性反馈机制做 round-wise 分析，把弱点归因为初始计划的情境合理偏移、反证不足、已接受方向在累积轨迹中的持续存在；再提出黑盒框架 InitAnchor，将三者操作化为 directional-shift、contextual-plausibility、counterevidence-resilience 三个信号，支持有限目标访问与无目标访问两种设定，通过攻击者控制的外部材料注入。
Result: 首轮反馈纠正 46% 的对抗方向，存活到后两轮的纠正率分别降到 13% 与 7%。在 16 个领域 112 个任务、六种 agent 架构、五个 backbone LLM 上，InitAnchor 两种设定的平均 ASR 分别为 76.1% 与 72.0%，首轮缓解率降到 21.0% 与 25.0%；对六种防御和六个真实世界 agent 系统仍有效。
Conclusion: 反馈型 agent 即使后续存在纠正机制，仍会保留早期偏置，因此反馈强度应集中在首轮而非平均分配；InitAnchor 证明该弱点可被黑盒方式稳定利用。

summary_sections.result: 首轮反馈纠正 46% 的对抗方向，存活到后两轮的纠正率分别降到 13% 与 7%。在 16 个领域 112 个任务、六种 agent 架构、五个 backbone LLM 上，InitAnchor 两种设定的平均 ASR 分别为 76.1% 与 72.0%，首轮缓解率降到 21.0% 与 25.0%；对六种防御和六个真实世界 agent 系统仍有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 反馈型 agent 即使后续存在纠正机制，仍会保留早期偏置，因此反馈强度应集中在首轮而非平均分配；InitAnchor 证明该弱点可被黑盒方式稳定利用。

papers.title: An Agnostic Sample Compression Scheme for Squared Loss of Near-Linear Size in the Fat-Shattering Dimension
papers.abstract_en: We construct, for every function class $\mathcal{F}\subseteq[0,1]^{\mathcal{X}}$ and every accuracy $0<α\le 1$, an agnostic sample compression scheme for the empirical squared loss: for every finite sample $S\in(\mathcal{X}\times[0,1])^m$ with arbitrary (noisy) labels, the scheme stores at most $O(\mathrm{fat}(\mathcal{F},c'α)\cdot\log^3(2/α))$ original labeled examples and auxiliary bits, independent of the sample size $m$, and reconstructs a function $\hat f$ with $L_2(\hat f,S)\le\inf_{f\in\mathcal{F}}L_2(f,S)+α$. This resolves, in the positive, the open problem of Attias, Hanneke, Kontorovich, and Sadigurschi (ICML 2024, Section 5), which asks for an agnostic $\ell_2$ compression scheme of size $\mathrm{fat}(\mathcal{F},cα)\cdot\mathrm{polylog}(c/α)$. All previously known bounded-size constructions, agnostic and even realizable, incur a multiplicative dual fat-shattering factor, which can be exponentially larger than the primal dimension; our scheme removes the dual factor entirely, including in the realizable case. The dual factor in prior work enters solely through a sparsification step that forces uniform approximation on the sample. By targeting only a $(1-ε)$-fraction of sample points, which suffices for an average-loss guarantee over a bounded range, K'egl's boosting margin bound yields $O(\log(1/ε))$ rounds independent of $m$, and sparsification is never needed. The booster's synthetic target labels (values of a near-optimal $f^*\in\mathcal{F}$) are transmitted through quantized side-information bits attached to stored original examples, and the cross term of the squared loss forces the weak-learning scale $Θ(α)$, matching the same-scale form of the open problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在经验平方损失下为任意函数类构造 agnostic 样本压缩方案，存储 O(fat(F,c'α)·log³(2/α)) 个原始带标例子加辅助比特，与样本量 m 无关，重构函数满足 L2 ≤ inf L2 + α。关键在于只逼近 (1-ε) 样本点并用量化 side-information 传合成标签，从而完全去掉以往构造中的 dual fat-shattering 因子。
Motivation: Attias、Hanneke、Kontorovich 与 Sadigurschi (ICML 2024, Section 5) 提出的开放问题：能否给出 agnostic ℓ₂ 压缩方案，尺寸为 fat(F,cα)·polylog(c/α)。此前所有有界尺寸构造（agnostic 乃至 realizable）都带一个乘性 dual fat-shattering 因子，可能比 primal 维数指数级更大。
Method: 对有界值域 [0,1] 上的 F 与任意含噪标签样本，只对 (1-ε) 比例样本点做逼近（对有界范围的平均损失已足够），从而绕开强制一致逼近的 sparsification 步骤；用 K'egl 的 boosting margin bound 得到与 m 无关的 O(log(1/ε)) 轮；booster 的合成目标标签（近最优 f* 的取值）以量化 side-information 比特附在存储的原始例子上传输，平方损失的交叉项把弱学习尺度定为 Θ(α)。
Result: 压缩尺寸 O(fat(F,c'α)·log³(2/α))，与样本量 m 无关；重构 f̂ 满足 L2(f̂,S) ≤ inf_{f∈F} L2(f,S) + α；boosting 轮数 O(log(1/ε)) 且与 m 无关；dual fat-shattering 因子被完全去除，realizable 情形同样适用；弱学习尺度 Θ(α) 与开放问题要求的 same-scale 形式一致。
Conclusion: 只要不追求对样本的一致逼近而只保平均损失，agnostic ℓ₂ 压缩就能做到 primal fat-shattering 维数级尺寸，正面解决 ICML 2024 的开放问题，并连带去掉 realizable 情形的 dual 因子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bandit Multiclass PAC Learning: Corrected Lower Bounds, Exact Families, and a Confidence Direct-Sum Phenomenon
papers.abstract_en: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with bandit feedback: the learner observes an i.i.d. instance, predicts one of $K$ labels, and learns only whether the prediction was correct. Hanneke, Meng, Moran, and Shaeiri (arXiv:2605.25678) characterized the optimal sample complexity via the bandit DS dimension $\mathrm{BDS}$ up to logarithmic factors, and asked whether every class admits sample complexity $O((\mathrm{BDS}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$. First, we show that the published lower bound $Ω((\mathrm{BDS}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$ is incorrect as stated: we exhibit explicit classes with $\mathrm{BDS}=K-1$ whose sample complexity is exponentially smaller, and locate two independent gaps in its proof. We repair the lower-bound theory around a new anchored dimension $\mathrm{aBDS}\le\mathrm{BDS}$, proving a constant-free three-part lower bound. On the upper-bound side we remove the ambient label count $K$ entirely, proving $O((B\log^3 B+B\log(1/δ))/ε)$ for $B=\mathrm{BDS}$, plus a constant-confidence bound via a new fiberization lemma; for two natural families we determine the sample complexity up to constant factors. Finally, we answer the open question in the negative under its uniform-constant reading, and show the failure is intrinsic: for an explicit affine multiplexer class we establish the full confidence profile $Θ((n\min{n,\log(1/δ)}+\log(1/δ))/ε)$, a confidence direct-sum regime where a multiplicative $\log(1/δ)$ cost is information-theoretically necessary, followed by a rank-saturation phase transition. Two classes with identical dimension profiles can have polynomially different sample complexities, so no characterization by these dimensions alone is accurate to polylogarithmic factors. We also show these results are consistent with additive-confidence list-PAC guarantees via the ListCascade bridge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 bandit 反馈的可实现多类 PAC 学习中，指出已发表的下界 Ω((BDS+log(1/δ))/ε) 陈述有误：构造 BDS=K-1 但样本复杂度指数更小的显式类，并定位证明中两处独立漏洞。围绕新锚定维度 aBDS≤BDS 重建下界，上界完全去掉标签数 K，得到 O((B log³B+B log(1/δ))/ε)；对显式仿射多路复用类证明 Θ((n·min{n,log(1/δ)}+log(1/δ))/ε) 的置信度 direct-sum，说明仅靠这些维度无法在 polylog 因子内刻画样本复杂度。
Motivation: Hanneke、Moran、Meng、Shaeiri 用 bandit DS 维度 (BDS) 刻画了 bandit 多类 PAC 的最优样本复杂度（差 log 因子），并留下开放问题：是否每个类都满足 O((BDS+log(1/δ))/ε)。该刻画与下界的正确性直接决定这一问题的答案。
Method: 先给出 BDS=K-1 而样本复杂度指数更小的显式类，指出原下界证明的两处独立漏洞；再引入锚定维度 aBDS≤BDS，证明无常数因子的三部分下界。上界侧用新 fiberization 引理去掉环境标签数 K，得到 O((B log³B+B log(1/δ))/ε) 与常数置信度界，并对两个自然族确定常数因子级样本复杂度；最后经 ListCascade 桥接与加性置信度 list-PAC 保证对照。
Result: 显式类 BDS=K-1 但样本复杂度指数小于 Ω((BDS+log(1/δ))/ε)；上界 O((B log³B+B log(1/δ))/ε)，B=BDS，完全不含 K；对显式仿射多路复用类给出完整置信度剖面 Θ((n·min{n,log(1/δ)}+log(1/δ))/ε)，其中乘性 log(1/δ) 代价信息论必需，随后出现 rank-saturation 相变；两个维度剖面相同的类样本复杂度可相差多项式。
Conclusion: 在均匀常数读法下原开放问题答案为否，且失败是内在的：仅凭 BDS、aBDS 这类维度无法在 polylog 因子内准确刻画 bandit 多类 PAC 的样本复杂度，必须区分置信度是加性还是乘性代价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fair Like Us? Auditing LLM Alignment in Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Fair allocation of scarce, indivisible resources is an important challenge in many societal problems. While there are several formal theories of fairness, no single definition can always be satisfied. As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions and act as agents, they raise new concerns about distributional justice: their judgments are not directly tied to any specific fairness framework and may violate key normative principles. In this work, we introduce a general method for evaluating fairness reasoning in LLMs. We study first-person fairness judgments across a broad set of models and compare them directly with human responses on matched scenarios and elicitation conditions. We find that LLMs tend to prefer stricter fairness constraints than humans, show more self-interested behavior, are sensitive to how information is framed, and are difficult to align with human judgments using fine-tuning with current datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一套评估 LLM 公平性推理的通用方法，在匹配情境与提问条件下把模型的第一人称公平判断与人类回答直接对比。LLM 偏好比人类更严格的公平约束、表现出更强的自利倾向、对信息框架敏感，且用现有数据集微调难以对齐人类判断。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地参与决策与代理执行，其分配判断不绑定任何明确的公平理论框架，可能违反关键规范性原则，而稀缺不可分资源的分配本身没有单一总能满足的公平定义。
Method: 提出通用的 LLM 公平推理评估方法：在广泛模型集合上采集第一人称公平判断，并在匹配的情境与信息引出条件下与人类回答直接对照。
Result: LLM 倾向偏好比人类更严格的公平约束，表现出更多自利行为，对信息框架（framing）敏感；用当前数据集做微调难以将模型与人类判断对齐。
Conclusion: LLM 的分配正义判断与人类在多个维度上系统性偏离，且现有微调数据不足以弥合这一差距。

papers.title: Predicting Symptoms of Amotivation and Anhedonia among University Students with a Novel Oversampling Method
papers.abstract_en: University students experience disproportionately high rates of common mental health conditions, such as depression, which can impair learning, social functioning, and overall well-being. Within this context, symptoms of amotivation (i.e. loss of motivational drive) and anhedonia (i.e. diminished interest or pleasure) are particularly debilitating, yet they frequently go undetected. Developing new approaches to identify students with prominent amotivation and anhedonia could enable earlier and more targeted intervention. Machine learning (ML) methods have increasingly been used to classify individuals according to symptom severity. However, these ML models often suffer from class imbalance, where the majority of cases fall in the low-symptom group and relatively few in the high-symptom group. This imbalance can reduce model accuracy and bias predictions. To address this, studies commonly employ the popular oversampling strategy SMOTE. However, SMOTE has a notable limitation: it may generate invalid values for nominal variables. In this paper, we introduce a novel and effective oversampling method that addresses this shortcoming. Our approach leverages a predictive model to generate nominal variables, rather than interpolating them. We validate our method on a large-scale GPS location dataset collected from university students and demonstrate that it is significantly better than existing oversampling approaches in predicting elevated symptoms of amotivation and anhedonia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对大学生动机缺失 (amotivation) 与快感缺失 (anhedonia) 高症状样本稀少导致的类别不平衡，提出用预测模型生成名义变量而非插值的过采样方法，替代 SMOTE 以避免生成非法名义取值。在大规模大学生 GPS 位置数据集上，该方法预测高症状学生的显著优于现有过采样方法。
Motivation: 大学生抑郁等常见精神健康问题高发，动机缺失与快感缺失症状常被漏检；ML 分类模型中低症状占多数、高症状极少，类别不平衡会降低准确度并使预测有偏，而常用 SMOTE 对名义变量插值会产生非法取值。
Method: 提出一种新过采样方法：名义变量由一个预测模型生成，而非在样本间插值，用于缓解高症状组样本稀少的类别不平衡；在大学生大规模 GPS 位置数据集上验证。
Result: 在大规模大学生 GPS 位置数据集上，该过采样方法在预测 elevated amotivation and anhedonia 症状上显著优于现有过采样方法。
Conclusion: 对名义变量用预测式生成代替插值，是处理含类别型特征的精神健康症状分类不平衡问题的有效过采样路径。

papers.title: Sequential knowledge editing breaks a model's ability to tell good evidence from bad, without costing it accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing is evaluated on whether the edited fact changed, whether paraphrases follow, and whether unrelated answers stayed put. A model can pass all three and still lose something none of them measures: the ability to decide, on facts that were never edited, which retrieved documents to believe. We score the log odds a model assigns to its remembered answer against the answer an injected passage asserts, before and after editing, holding the query, the passage and both candidate strings fixed. Our cleanest arm is a conservatively tuned LoRA: after 1,000 sequential edits on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct it leaves MMLU unchanged to four decimal places, yet the spread of the arbitration quantity across untouched facts falls by 36%. Selective prediction degrades with it. Area under the risk-coverage curve rises by 0.107, against 0.005 for a norm-matched perturbation at the same MMLU, and error on the model's most confident quarter of arbitration decisions goes from 0.217 to 0.342. This is not capability loss. Sweeping random perturbation over five severities, damage bad enough to cut MMLU from 0.6275 to 0.3725 produces less harm (0.088) than MEMIT does at 0.6050 (0.102). The effect holds across three seeds, two model families, two datasets, two probe-disjointness criteria, three prompt templates and paraphrased queries. Layer ablation on saved weight deltas shows it is distributed: no single layer reproduces it, and removing any one recovers about half. Under retrieval with a frozen retriever, accuracy falls from 0.592 to 0.46. A secondary finding may matter more in practice. Three of five model and method pairings we ran collapse to chance MMLU at 1,000 sequential edits under published hyperparameters, while edit success stays at 1.00 and locality reads clean. Sequential-editing evaluations that never measure capability cannot see this.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 连续知识编辑 (sequential knowledge editing) 会在完全不改动模型准确率的情况下，破坏模型在未编辑事实上判断检索文档可信度的能力。1,000 次 LoRA 编辑后 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 MMLU 四位小数不变，但仲裁量在未触碰事实上的离散度下降 36%，检索增强下准确率从 0.592 跌到 0.46；作者主张编辑评测必须同时测能力与仲裁，不能只看 edit success 和 locality。
Motivation: 现有知识编辑评测只检查被编辑事实是否改写、paraphrase 是否跟随、无关答案是否保持，没有任何一项衡量模型在从未编辑的事实上该相信哪份检索文档，因此编辑造成的隐性损伤不可见。
Method: 固定 query、注入 passage 与两个候选串，测量模型对自身记忆答案相对 passage 断言答案的 log odds 在编辑前后的变化（arbitration quantity）；主实验用保守调参的 LoRA 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上做 1,000 次连续编辑，并与 norm-matched perturbation、MEMIT 及五档随机扰动严重度对比，另做层消融、三种 seed、两个模型族、两个数据集、三种 prompt 模板与冻结检索器下的检索评测。
Result: 1,000 次编辑后 MMLU 精确到四位小数不变，但未触碰事实上仲裁量离散度下降 36%；risk-coverage 曲线下面积 (AURC) 上升 0.107，而同等 MMLU 的 norm-matched perturbation 仅 0.005；模型最自信四分之一决策上的错误率从 0.217 升到 0.342。随机扰动把 MMLU 从 0.6275 砍到 0.3725 造成的伤害 (0.088) 仍小于 MEMIT 在 MMLU 0.6050 时的 0.102。层消融显示效应分布式存在，去掉任一层只恢复约一半。冻结检索器下检索准确率从 0.592 降到 0.46。五组模型-方法配对中有三组在已发表超参下于 1,000 次连续编辑后 MMLU 崩到随机水平，而 edit success 仍为 1.00、locality 看似干净。
Conclusion: 知识编辑的能力损伤与准确率脱钩：MMLU 与 locality 全绿时，模型区分好坏证据的能力和选择性预测已经在退化，因此只报 edit success 与 locality 的连续编辑评测系统性地看不见这种崩溃。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not All Synthetic Data Are Equal: Expert-Committee Audit Screening for Imbalanced Crash-Injury-Severity Prediction in Automated Driving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automated driving systems (ADSs) are increasingly operating on public roads, raising safety concerns, yet reliable prediction of crash injury severity remains difficult because crash reports are limited, severe outcomes are rare, and injury classes are highly imbalanced. Existing augmentation methods mainly increase minority-class sample size but rarely assess whether generated samples are credible for safety-critical prediction. This study proposes Expert-Committee Audit Screening (ECAS), a credibility-aware sample acceptance framework for ADS crash injury severity prediction under data imbalance. Using 1,477 incident-level ADS crashes from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Standing General Order records, ECAS audits generated minority samples through a real-data-only expert committee based on label support, boundary separation, committee agreement, and local plausibility. Within-class percentile normalization and Pareto non-dominated sorting select accepted samples without manually assigned evidence weights. With a fixed backbone combining normalizing flow augmentation and a Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) classifier, the best ECAS configuration achieved the highest balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and minor-injury recall among all evidence configurations. Local neighborhood analysis showed that ECAS-accepted samples were better supported by nearby real minority crashes than unscreened retained samples. Shapley additive explanations and partial dependence plots further indicated that lower injury severity classes were mainly associated with crash counterpart and pre-crash movement, whereas moderate-plus injuries were more sensitive to posted speed limit and operating context. These findings support a shift from quantity-oriented augmentation to credibility-aware sample acceptance for ADS safety prediction and risk governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向自动驾驶 (ADS) 事故伤害严重度不平衡预测的可信度感知样本接受框架 ECAS：用仅基于真实数据的专家委员会按标签支持、边界分离、委员会一致性和局部合理性审计生成的少数类样本，再用类内百分位归一化与 Pareto 非支配排序决定接受与否，无需人工指定证据权重。在 1,477 条 NHTSA Standing General Order ADS 事故记录上，固定 normalizing flow 增广 + TabPFN 分类器时，最佳 ECAS 配置在 balanced accuracy、macro-F1 与 minor-injury recall 上均为所有证据配置中最高。
Motivation: ADS 事故报告稀缺、重伤结局罕见且伤害类别高度不平衡，现有增广方法只增加少数类样本量，不检验生成样本对安全关键预测是否可信。
Method: ECAS 以仅真实数据的专家委员会审计生成样本，依据 label support、boundary separation、committee agreement、local plausibility 四项证据；类内百分位归一化后做 Pareto 非支配排序筛选接受样本。骨干固定为 normalizing flow 增广加 Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) 分类器，数据为 NHTSA Standing General Order 的 1,477 条事故级 ADS 崩溃记录。
Result: 最佳 ECAS 配置在全部证据配置中取得最高 balanced accuracy、macro-F1 与 minor-injury recall；局部邻域分析显示 ECAS 接受的样本比未筛查保留样本得到附近真实少数类事故更强支持。Shapley additive explanations 与 partial dependence plots 显示低伤害等级主要关联 crash counterpart 与 pre-crash movement，moderate-plus 伤害对 posted speed limit 与 operating context 更敏感。
Conclusion: ADS 安全预测的增广应从数量导向转向可信度导向的样本接受，因为被真实少数类邻域支持的生成样本才对不平衡伤害分类有效。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Named Entity Recognition using Sliding Window Approach
papers.abstract_en: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a core NLP task, but transformer-based sentence-level models struggle with long documents because of fixed input-length limits: truncation drops content, and non-overlapping chunking fragments entities at segment boundaries. We introduce an inference-only pipeline that extends a frozen NER model, MahaNER-BERT, fine-tuned on the MahaNER corpus, to document-level prediction via overlapping sliding windows that are merged into a single annotation, without any retraining or architectural change. We evaluate the pipeline on six document-level corpora built from the MahaNER test set using two strategies: Normal Repeat, which duplicates sentence sequences to extend length while preserving contextual continuity, and Random Repeat, which concatenates distinct sequences to produce longer, heterogeneous inputs, each instantiated at three length levels, across several sliding-window configurations. The model retains a macro F1-score of up to 0.8902, with variation staying below one percentage point regardless of document length or construction strategy. Compared with the conventional non-windowed approach, the sliding-window pipeline avoids the boundary-fragmentation errors introduced by non-overlapping segmentation, yielding consistently higher and more stable document-level F1-scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长文档 NER 中固定输入长度导致的截断丢内容与分块边界切断实体问题，提出推理阶段的重叠滑动窗口流水线：把冻结的 MahaNER-BERT 逐窗预测后合并为单一文档级标注，不重训也不改结构。在由 MahaNER 测试集构造的六个文档级语料上，宏 F1 最高保持 0.8902，且随文档长度与构造策略波动小于 1 个百分点，比非重叠分块更稳。
Motivation: Transformer 句级模型受固定输入长度限制：截断丢内容，非重叠分块在段边界切断实体，长文档级 NER 因此退化。
Method: 推理专用流水线：冻结已在 MahaNER 语料微调的 MahaNER-BERT，用重叠滑动窗口逐段预测再合并为单一标注，无重训、无结构改动。评测用 MahaNER 测试集构造六个文档级语料，含 Normal Repeat（复制句子序列保持上下文连续）与 Random Repeat（拼接不同序列）两种构造策略、各三个长度档，覆盖多种滑窗配置。
Result: 宏 F1 最高 0.8902，且不随文档长度或构造策略变化超过 1 个百分点；相对常规非加窗方法，重叠滑窗避免了非重叠分段引入的边界碎片化错误，文档级 F1 更高也更稳定。
Conclusion: 在不重训的前提下，重叠滑窗加合并足以把句级 NER 模型提升到文档级并消除边界碎片化，性能对文档长度与构造方式不敏感。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ReCalMatch:Reliability-Calibrated Semantic Guidance for Semi-Supervised Fine-Grained Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised fine-grained visual recognition is highly vulnerable to overconfident pseudo-label errors: visually similar categories frequently produce high-confidence yet incorrect predictions, and consistency regularization then reinforces these errors throughout training. Existing semi-supervised learning (SSL) methods estimate pseudo-label reliability almost entirely from the visual classifier itself---maximum probability, adaptive thresholds, or entropy---signals that remain blind to whether a predicted class is \emph{semantically} compatible with the visual representation. We propose \textbf{ReCalMatch}, a reliability-calibrated semantic framework for semi-supervised fine-grained recognition. Rather than treating textual semantics as auxiliary supervision, ReCalMatch uses multi-aspect semantic prototypes as \emph{calibration evidence} for pseudo-label learning. We construct class-conditioned semantic prototypes from class names and domain-specific semantic aspects, and measure a \emph{visual--semantic agreement} score between each unlabeled embedding and its pseudo-label prototype. This agreement is combined with prediction confidence and entropy into a single reliability weight that down-weights pseudo-labels that are visually confident but semantically inconsistent. A semantic consistency term and a semantic margin regularizer further sharpen prototype separability under limited labels. Extensive experiments on CUB-200-2011, Stanford Dogs, NABirds, and iNaturalist18 show that ReCalMatch consistently improves strong SSL baselines, with the largest gains in low-label regimes where pseudo-label noise is most severe.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Official list of accepted papers:https://bmvc2026.bmva.org/programme/accepted_papers/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReCalMatch 把类名与领域语义方面构成的多方面语义原型当作伪标签可靠性的校准证据，用视觉-语义一致性分数与置信度、熵合成单一权重，压低视觉高置信但语义不一致的伪标签。在 CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs、NABirds、iNaturalist18 上一致提升强 SSL 基线，低标注量下增益最大。
Motivation: 细粒度类别视觉高度相似，视觉分类器给出的高置信伪标签常是错的，一致性正则会把错误贯穿训练放大；仅靠最大概率、自适应阈值或熵无法判断预测类别与视觉表示是否语义相容。
Method: 从类名与领域语义方面构建类条件语义原型，计算无标注样本嵌入与其伪标签原型之间的视觉-语义一致性分数，与预测置信度、熵合并为单一可靠性权重对伪标签降权；另加语义一致性项与语义 margin 正则化器，在有限标签下锐化原型可分性。
Result: 在 CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs、NABirds 和 iNaturalist18 上一致提升强 SSL 基线，且在伪标签噪声最严重的低标注量区间增益最大。
Conclusion: 伪标签可靠性不能只由视觉分类器自身估计，把文本语义原型作为校准证据可在低标注场景下更有效地抑制细粒度伪标签错误。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Sequential Price of Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sequential task updates are fundamental to continual learning, but their recency bias can impose a lasting performance cost. We study this cost in an overparameterized linear-regression model with i.i.d. task sampling. We prove that distribution-level forgetting and population loss converge to the same stationary limit. This common limit separates exactly into the intrinsic loss asymptotically attained by joint training and an additional sequential price, and in more homogeneous task geometries the two terms coincide, making the total loss twice that of joint training. We further analyze fixed-strength elastic weight consolidation (EWC) under general task curvatures and characterize its stationary sequential price at every regularization strength. Under strong regularization, the price decays inversely with EWC strength while convergence to stationarity slows at the same scale. On the Jester joke-rating dataset, the theory exactly quantifies both the sequential price generated by naturally conflicting user preferences and its reduction by EWC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在过参数化线性回归与 i.i.d. 任务采样下，序贯任务更新的持续学习 (continual learning) 稳态损失可精确分解为联合训练的本征损失加上一项 sequential price；任务几何越同质，两项相等，总损失恰为联合训练的两倍。固定强度 EWC 在强正则区使该价格按 EWC 强度的倒数衰减，但收敛到稳态的速度在同一尺度上变慢。
Motivation: 序贯任务更新的 recency bias 会给持续学习带来持久的性能代价，但这一代价此前缺少可分解、可闭式刻画的理论度量，也未说明正则化如何在代价与收敛速度之间取舍。
Method: 在过参数化线性回归模型加 i.i.d. 任务采样设定下做理论分析：证明 distribution-level forgetting 与 population loss 收敛到同一稳态极限，并把该极限精确分解为 joint training 的 intrinsic loss 与 sequential price；再在一般任务曲率下分析固定强度 EWC，刻画每个正则强度处的稳态 sequential price。
Result: 证明 forgetting 与 population loss 收敛到同一稳态极限，且极限精确分解为 joint training 的本征损失加 sequential price；在更同质的任务几何中两项相等，总损失为 joint training 的两倍。强正则下 EWC 的 sequential price 按 EWC 强度的倒数衰减，而收敛到稳态的速度在同一尺度上减慢。在 Jester 笑话评分数据集上，理论精确量化了由自然冲突的用户偏好产生的 sequential price 及其被 EWC 的削减。

papers.title: GBFRVFL: Granular-Ball Computing-Based Fuzzy Random Vector Functional Link Network
papers.abstract_en: In practical machine learning tasks, data are often contaminated with noise, outliers, and class imbalance, which can degrade the performance of conventional models. While random vector functional link (RVFL) networks offer fast training and strong generalization, they do not explicitly handle uncertainty or exploit local data structure. To address these limitations, we propose a fuzzy granular-ball random vector functional link (GBFRVFL) framework that leverages granular-ball computing to abstract raw samples into adaptive granular balls. Within this framework, we introduce two membership assignment schemes: (i) F-GBRVFL, which incorporates fuzzy membership to quantify the reliability of each granular ball, and (ii) SDAP-GBRVFL, which we propose, incorporates a novel statistical density-adaptive pythagorean membership (SDAPM) scheme that dynamically adjusts membership and non-membership values based on class variance, local sparsity, and granular-ball compactness. These schemes enhance robustness to noise, outliers, class imbalance, and uncertainty in granular-ball distributions, while retaining the computational efficiency of RVFL networks. Extensive experiments on 37 benchmark UCI and KEEL datasets under both clean and noisy conditions demonstrate that the proposed models consistently outperform baseline models, achieving superior accuracy and stability. The results validate the effectiveness of integrating granular-ball computing with adaptive membership schemes for reliable, scalable, and noise-tolerant learning.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GBFRVFL 把 RVFL 的原始样本聚成自适应 granular ball，并用两种隶属度方案量化每个球的可靠性：F-GBRVFL 用模糊隶属度，SDAP-GBRVFL 用统计密度自适应毕达哥拉斯隶属度 (SDAPM)，按类方差、局部稀疏度和球紧致度动态调整隶属与非隶属值。在 37 个 UCI/KEEL 基准的干净与含噪条件下，两个模型在准确率与稳定性上一致优于基线。
Motivation: RVFL 训练快、泛化好，但不显式处理不确定性也不利用局部数据结构；实际数据常含噪声、离群点与类别不平衡，常规模型性能因此下降。
Method: 用 granular-ball computing 把原始样本抽象为自适应 granular ball，再在球层面做分类：F-GBRVFL 引入模糊隶属度表示每个球的可靠性，SDAP-GBRVFL 提出 SDAPM 方案，依据类方差、局部稀疏度与 granular-ball 紧致度动态调整隶属度和非隶属度，同时保留 RVFL 的计算效率。
Result: 在 37 个 UCI 与 KEEL 基准数据集上、干净与含噪两种条件下进行实验，所提模型相对基线模型一致取得更高的准确率与更好的稳定性。
Conclusion: 把 granular-ball computing 与自适应隶属度方案结合，可在保留 RVFL 训练效率的同时提升对噪声、离群点、类别不平衡与不确定性学习的可靠性与可扩展性。

papers.title: Do World Models Make Better Robots? A Survey of Evaluation Benchmarks for Predictive Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning now advances along two tracks that rarely meet. On one side, direct Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies map observations to actions and are scored by closed-loop task success. On the other, predictive and generative world models forecast future observations and are scored by open-loop prediction or generation quality. A natural question sits between them: does world modelling earn a measurable, closed-loop advantage over a direct policy, and for which robotic capabilities? We argue that the field cannot yet answer this question, and that the reason is a gap in how it is measured, not in the models themselves. World-model benchmarks score prediction without ever executing it, while task-success suites host a single policy and never build a world-model versus VLA contrast. This survey maps the evaluation landscape around that gap. We catalogue 160 web-verified benchmarks spanning 2017 to 2026 and organise them by evaluation mode, robotic capability, and model family into four lanes: policy suites, embodied agents, world model evaluation, and prediction-to-action bridges. Across the corpus, 138 of 160 benchmarks are model-agnostic and only 11 (7%) build an explicit VLA-versus-world-model contrast; counterfactual capability is almost entirely unmeasured, and only four benchmarks turn prediction into executed action. We contribute an operational taxonomy, a coverage comparison against the eight closest surveys (ours is the only one to cross capability with model family), an evaluation loop that isolates the advantage of prediction, and an actionable protocol of four advantage-aware metrics anchored on named testbeds. The organising claim is not that world models help or do not help, but that answering the question requires benchmarks built to ask it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇机器人具身智能评测基准综述，梳理 2017–2026 年 160 个经网络核验的基准，指出世界模型与 VLA 策略谁更强这一问题当前无法回答，因为度量方式存在缺口：世界模型基准只评开环预测不执行，任务成功套件只跑单一策略不做对比。160 个基准中 138 个与模型无关，仅 11 个（7%）建立显式 VLA 对世界模型对比，仅 4 个把预测转成执行动作。作者主张要回答该问题必须专门构建能提出这一问题的基准，并给出四条 advantage-aware 指标协议。
Motivation: 机器人学习沿两条互不相交的轨道发展：VLA 策略以闭环任务成功度量，世界模型以开环预测质量度量，缺少能隔离预测带来闭环优势的评测，导致世界模型是否真正优于直接策略这一核心问题无法回答。
Method: 综述按评测模式、机器人能力与模型族组织 160 个基准为四条通道：policy suites、embodied agents、world model evaluation、prediction-to-action bridges；提出操作性分类体系、与八个最接近综述的覆盖对比（本文是唯一交叉能力与模型族的）、一个隔离预测优势的评测循环，以及锚定在具名测试床上的四条 advantage-aware 指标协议。
Result: 目录覆盖 2017 至 2026 年 160 个网络核验基准，其中 138 个模型无关，仅 11 个（7%）建立显式 VLA 对世界模型对比，仅 4 个把预测转为执行动作，反事实能力几乎完全未被测量；与八个最接近综述的覆盖对比中本文是唯一交叉能力与模型族的。
Conclusion: 组织性主张不是世界模型有帮助或无帮助，而是回答该问题需要专门为此构建的基准；论文贡献分类体系、评测循环与四条 advantage-aware 指标协议。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Graph, Loop, and Harness Engineering for Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering and Analytical Processing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly automate data workflows, but end-to-end cloud data engineering and analytical execution require reliable coordination across code, data, infrastructure, and runtime environments. We present two zero-trust frameworks. Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering generates, deploys, and verifies complete cloud data-engineering solutions from natural-language tasks, with completion conditioned on repository, deployment, runtime, and policy evidence. Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP combines governed Data Preparation with verified Online Analytical Processing (OLAP), permitting production promotion only after validation and evidence-bound approval, and releasing analytical answers only after Same-Snapshot Execution, Exact Result Equivalence, deterministic grounding, and reflection. Both frameworks share three abstractions: graph engineering for evidence-gated workflow structure, loop engineering for bounded recovery, and agent-harness engineering for zero-trust execution. We evaluate both frameworks under nominal execution, controlled failures, bounded recovery, and policy-constrained conditions, measuring verified completion, recovery, authorization enforcement, production promotion, and verified OLAP execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两个零信任 (zero-trust) 智能体框架：Zero-Trust Agentic Data Engineering 从自然语言任务生成、部署并验证完整云数据工程方案，完成与否取决于仓库、部署、运行时与策略证据；Zero-Trust Agentic OLAP 要求 Same-Snapshot Execution 与 Exact Result Equivalence 通过后才放行分析结果。两者共享 graph engineering、loop engineering、agent-harness engineering 三层抽象，在名义执行、受控故障、有界恢复与策略约束条件下评测验证完成率、恢复、授权强制、生产晋级与验证 OLAP 执行。
Motivation: LLM 智能体自动化数据工作流时，跨代码、数据、基础设施与运行时的端到端云数据工程和分析执行缺少可靠的协调与信任约束，生产晋级和分析结果放行缺乏证据支撑。
Method: 三个共享抽象：graph engineering 组织证据门控的工作流结构，loop engineering 提供有界恢复 (bounded recovery)，agent-harness engineering 负责零信任执行。Agentic Data Engineering 以仓库、部署、运行时、策略证据作为完成条件；Agentic OLAP 将受治理的数据准备与验证过的 OLAP 结合，要求验证与证据绑定审批后才晋级生产，并在 Same-Snapshot Execution、Exact Result Equivalence、确定性 grounding 与 reflection 全部满足后才释放分析答案。
Result: 在名义执行、受控故障、有界恢复与策略约束四类条件下评测两个框架，度量为 verified completion、recovery、authorization enforcement、production promotion 与 verified OLAP execution；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把证据门控、有界恢复与零信任执行做成三个可复用抽象，可以让云数据工程与 OLAP 的完成、晋级和结果放行都以可验证证据为前提。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: To Think or Not to Think: Allocating Reasoning Where It Helps
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective in enhancing the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, this capability comes with systematic \textit{length misallocation}, in which models devote excessive reasoning to simple questions while terminating prematurely on harder ones, degrading inference efficiency with negligible accuracy improvement. Many length-adaptive methods mitigate this issue by allocating token budgets according to question difficulty, under the implicit assumption that harder questions benefit monotonically from extended reasoning. In contrast, we find that the effect of reasoning length on accuracy is concentrated on \textit{partially solvable} questions. Our further analysis reveals that explicit length rewards can produce unintended training dynamics. Motivated by these findings, we propose \textbf{CARE}---\textbf{C}ontrastive \textbf{A}ccuracy \textbf{R}eward \textbf{E}stimation---which compares the beneficial length adjustment per question from online sampled responses and applies adaptive length rewards within Group Relative Policy Optimization, with no extra hyperparameters or additional inference cost. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves Pass@1 by up to \(4\%\) while simultaneously reducing reasoning length by \(37\%\), achieving higher token efficiency. Code will be available upon the acceptance of this paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 用对比式准确率奖励估计 (Contrastive Accuracy Reward Estimation) 在 GRPO 内部按题施加自适应长度奖励，纠正 RL 训练 LLM 时的长度错配：简单题过度推理、难题过早终止。推理长度对准确率的作用集中在「部分可解」题目上，据此分配推理预算后 Pass@1 最多提升 4%，同时推理长度缩短 37%。
Motivation: RL 增强 LLM 推理时出现系统性长度错配：简单题消耗过多 token、难题过早截断，推理效率下降而准确率几乎不涨；现有按难度分配预算的方法默认难题单调受益于更长推理，这一假设不成立。
Method: 提出 CARE (Contrastive Accuracy Reward Estimation)：对每道题比较在线采样回答之间带来收益的长度调整量，把该估计作为自适应长度奖励嵌入 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，不引入额外超参数，也不增加推理开销。
Result: 在多个推理 benchmark 上，Pass@1 最多提升 4%，同时推理长度减少 37%，token 效率提高；分析发现推理长度对准确率的影响集中在 partially solvable 题目上，且显式长度奖励会引发非预期的训练动态。
Conclusion: 按题目实际可获益的长度调整而非按难度单调加码来分配推理预算，能在提升 Pass@1 的同时大幅缩短推理长度。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 按题目实际可获益的长度调整而非按难度单调加码来分配推理预算，能在提升 Pass@1 的同时大幅缩短推理长度。

papers.title: Investigating White Blood Cells as a Source of False-Positive Malaria Parasite Detection in African Blood-Smear Images
papers.abstract_en: White blood cells (WBCs) present on every Giemsa-stained thick blood smear share visual properties with early-stage Plasmodium falciparum ring-form trophozoites: small size, round morphology, and intense purple staining. They are a plausible but untested source of false positives in parasite-only detectors. We trained two YOLOv12s models on the Lacuna Malaria Detection dataset (8,000 images from Uganda and Ghana): Model A with parasite labels only, and Model B with both parasite and WBC labels. Seven independent spatial and statistical analyses tested whether false positive (FP) predictions cluster near WBC locations. All seven refute the hypothesis. In both models, 95% of FPs are pure background detections (IoU below 0.10 against any ground-truth box); zero are WBC class confusions. Ripley's Cross-K analysis shows spatial repulsion between FP centroids and WBC positions at every radius tested. Model B outperforms Model A overall (mAP50 0.859 vs. 0.755), and the advantage is uniform across all WBC-proximity bands, pointing to multi-task representation learning rather than WBC suppression as the cause. False positives arise from Giemsa stain debris and preparation artifacts. Effective mitigation requires staining artifact augmentation and annotation of unannotated early-stage ring forms rather than WBC labeling alone.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 3rd MIRASOL workshop, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Lacuna 疟疾检测数据集（8,000 张乌干达与加纳 Giemsa 厚血涂片）上训练两个 YOLOv12，用七项空间与统计检验判定白细胞是否是仅检虫模型的假阳性来源，结果全部否定该假设：两模型 95% 的假阳性是纯背景检出（与任一真值框 IoU<0.10），零例为 WBC 类别混淆，Ripley's Cross-K 显示 FP 质心与 WBC 位置在所有半径上空间排斥。
Motivation: 厚血涂片中白细胞与早期环状体滋养体在尺寸、圆形与深染上高度相似，是一个合理但未经检验的假阳性来源；若成立，缓解手段应是标注 WBC，否则方向就错了。
Method: 在 Lacuna Malaria Detection 数据集（8,000 张，乌干达与加纳）训练两个 YOLOv12：Model A 仅用寄生虫标签，Model B 同时用寄生虫与 WBC 标签；再用七项独立的空间与统计分析检验 FP 预测是否聚集在 WBC 附近，含 Ripley's Cross-K 与按 WBC 距离分带的 mAP50 比较。
Result: 七项检验全部反驳假设；两模型 95% 的 FP 为纯背景检出（IoU<0.10），WBC 类别混淆为 0；Ripley's Cross-K 在所有测试半径上显示 FP 质心与 WBC 位置空间排斥；Model B 整体 mAP50 0.859 vs Model A 0.755，且优势在所有 WBC 邻近分带上一致。
Conclusion: 假阳性来自 Giemsa 染液碎屑与制片伪影，而非 WBC；有效缓解应做染色伪影增广并标注未标注的早期环状体，单靠 WBC 标注不够。

papers.title: MoSign: Challenge-Response Motion-Watermark Authentication for Anonymous Virtual-Reality Users
papers.abstract_en: Social virtual reality (VR) creates a paradox. A user's body motion is a high-entropy biometric: head and hand trajectories alone re-identify users among tens of thousands with over $94\%$ accuracy, so anonymizing the rendered avatar is a practical necessity. Yet a user often still wants to prove their identity to a chosen party from inside that anonymity. We present MoSign, which recasts digital watermarking as a challenge-response authentication protocol on the motion channel. MoSign embeds a time-varying keyed message into the style latent of a motion variational autoencoder via keystream-whitened Gaussian-Shading: watermarked motion is provably indistinguishable from watermark-free motion, since any detector's advantage reduces to breaking a pseudorandom function, so the mark composes with anonymization. The message is a keyed MAC over an epoch counter, a session nonce, and a deployment context, making MoSign replay-resistant and bounding forgery by the verifier's measured false-accept rate times the adversary's online query budget. A key-holding verifier decides with a sequential test. We identify render$\rightarrow$record$\rightarrow$re-estimate ("recapture") as the realistic VR attack surface: a generic pose estimator strips the necessarily subtle watermark, but a recapture-robust keyed reader recovers it (up to $0.96$ codeword accuracy on a projected-2D channel, $0.81$ through a full render-to-video loop), while without the key recovery stays at chance. On HumanML3D, MoSign authenticates every legitimate user at a false-accept rate of $10^{-4}$ on clean and most channels and stays undetectable (detection AUC $0.51$, chance $0.5$); on the BOXRR-23 VR dataset it carries the mark through a real anonymizer at $0.99$ codeword accuracy and adds no de-anonymization side channel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoSign 把数字水印改写成 VR 动作通道上的挑战-响应认证：在动作 VAE 的 style latent 中嵌入由 keystream 白化的 Gaussian-Shading 生成的时变密钥消息，消息是覆盖 epoch 计数器、会话 nonce 与部署上下文的 MAC，因而可重放抵抗且与匿名化叠加。在 HumanML3D 上对合法用户以 1e-4 假接受率完成认证、检测 AUC 仅 0.51（随机 0.5），在 BOXRR-23 VR 数据集上穿过真实匿名器仍达 0.99 码字准确率。
Motivation: 社交 VR 中头手轨迹本身是高熵生物特征，仅凭轨迹即可在数万人中以 94% 以上准确率重识别，匿名化头像因此是刚需；但用户仍需在匿名状态下向指定方证明身份，现有匿名与认证互斥。
Method: 把水印做成动作通道上的挑战-响应协议：用 keystream 白化的 Gaussian-Shading 将时变密钥消息嵌入 motion VAE 的 style latent，消息为覆盖 epoch 计数器、会话 nonce 与部署上下文的密钥 MAC；持钥验证者用序贯检验 (sequential test) 判决，并针对 render→record→re-estimate 的 recapture 攻击面训练抗 recapture 的密钥读取器。
Result: 头部与手部轨迹重识别准确率超过 94%；抗 recapture 读取器在投影 2D 通道上码字准确率最高 0.96，穿过完整 render-to-video 回路为 0.81，无密钥时停留在随机水平。HumanML3D 上合法用户全部认证成功，干净及多数通道假接受率为 1e-4，检测 AUC 0.51（随机 0.5）；BOXRR-23 VR 数据集上穿过真实匿名器码字准确率 0.99，且不引入去匿名侧信道。
Conclusion: 水印可以与匿名化共存：只要检测优势归约为破解伪随机函数，动作水印即可在不破坏匿名的前提下提供可重放抵抗、伪造受假接受率与在线查询预算约束的认证。

papers.title: Hybrid Variational Quantum-Classical Framework with Adaptive Weighting and Efficiency Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks have emerged as a promising approach for leveraging quantum computing in machine learning while mitigating current hardware limitations. This paper presents Sim-HVQC, a hybrid Deep Quantum Neural Network that couples an adaptive, parameter-free SimAM weighting module with classical feature extraction to preserve class-discriminative information prior to encoding into a Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC). Previous studies are restricted to binary classification [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]. In contrast, the proposed framework is trained and evaluated on various multi-class datasets(MNIST, KMNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and EMNIST). The framework further demonstrates reproducibility, parameter efficiency, and interpretability through multi-seed evaluation, parameter analysis, and latent/quantum feature inspection. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Dilli822/ SimAM-HVQC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sim-HVQC：用免参数的自适应 SimAM 加权模块与经典特征提取保留类判别信息，再编码进变分量子电路 (VQC)，把此前局限于二分类的混合量子-经典网络扩展到多分类。在 MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、EMNIST 上训练评估，并通过多种子评测、参数分析与潜空间/量子特征检查展示可复现性、参数效率与可解释性。
Motivation: 既有的混合量子-经典神经网络研究受限于二分类任务，缺少多分类能力以及对参数效率、可复现性和可解释性的系统检验。
Method: Sim-HVQC 流水线：免参数的自适应 SimAM 加权模块先对经典特征做类判别加权，经典特征提取器进一步压缩，再编码进变分量子电路 (VQC)；训练与评测覆盖 MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、EMNIST 四个多分类数据集，并做多种子评测、参数量分析与潜空间/量子特征可视化检查。
Result: 在 MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST、EMNIST 多分类数据集上完成训练与评估，突破既往工作仅限二分类的设定；以多种子评测、参数分析和潜空间/量子特征检查给出可复现性、参数效率与可解释性证据（摘要未列出具体准确率数值）。
Conclusion: Sim-HVQC 说明免参数 SimAM 加权加 VQC 的混合架构可以胜任多分类而非仅二分类，并同时具备参数效率与可解释性；源码已在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: Ingest-Time Fact Compilation for Cost-Efficient and Reliable Question Answering over Revised Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Most agentic question answering (QA) systems do an important part of their semantic work at the worst possible time: every time someone asks a question. When a corpus contains revisions, drafts, revocations, deletions, and sources with different levels of authority, the model must reconstruct the governed current state on every read - then throw that work away and repeat it on the next query. This is a bit like a database that rebuilds a materialized view every time someone reads from it. We present ingest-time fact compilation, an architecture that performs this work when corpus data is ingested or changed. Raw passages are rephrased into self-contained facts; rules governing revisions, deletions, effective dates, and source trust are resolved once; and the resulting state is stored as typed records carrying source and revision provenance. At query time, an inexpensive model reads the compiled record instead of reconstructing it from noisy candidates. In a controlled synthetic experiment across five seeds, the same low-cost model produced the correct value, source, and revision in only one of 30 trials under query-time reconstruction, but in all 30 trials from the compiled substrate, at 12.89 times lower mean read cost per question. On simpler revision questions both architectures were exact, but the compiled path used 21.6 times fewer tokens. A separate test found that fact rephrasing roughly halved verbose Federal Reserve dialogue while preserving high source entailment, but left concise Wikipedia prose essentially unchanged. These results support a narrow but practical claim: resolving a corpus state once can make subsequent QA cheaper and more reliable for inexpensive models. We release the open source, MIT-licensed implementation and experimental artifacts.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 International Conference on Applied Science and Technology - Engineering Science (iCAST-ES 2026), Surabaya, Indonesia, October 2026. Code and frozen experimental artifacts: https://github.com/aix-sc/isc (tag data-freeze-2026-07-16)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ingest-time fact compilation：把语料的修订、撤销、删除与来源权威规则在数据摄入时一次性解析成带来源与版本溯源的 typed records，查询时廉价模型直接读编译结果而非每次重建。在五随机种子的受控合成实验中，同一低成本模型在查询时重建下 30 次试验仅 1 次给出正确的值、来源与版本，而编译路径 30 次全对，单题平均读取成本低 12.89 倍。
Motivation: 含修订与撤销的语料上，agentic QA 每次查询都要重建受治理的当前状态，做完即丢弃，重复付出语义成本且易出错。
Method: 摄入或变更时把原始段落改写为自包含 facts，一次性解析修订、删除、生效日期与来源信任规则，存成带来源和版本溯源的 typed records；查询时用廉价模型直接读取编译记录。另测 fact rephrasing 对冗长对话与简洁文本的影响。
Result: 五随机种子受控合成实验：查询时重建 30 次试验仅 1 次同时答对值、来源与版本，编译底座 30 次全对，平均读取成本低 12.89 倍；较简单的修订问题两种架构都精确，但编译路径少用 21.6 倍 token；fact rephrasing 让冗长的 Federal Reserve 对话篇幅约减半且保持高 source entailment，而简洁的 Wikipedia 文本基本不变。
Conclusion: 语料状态只解析一次，就能让后续 QA 对廉价模型同时更便宜更可靠；该主张被作者限定为 narrow but practical，实现与实验工件以 MIT 许可开源。

papers.title: VG-TIE: An interpretable tabular-to-image encoding method based on visibility graphs
papers.abstract_en: Tabular-to-image encoding methods enable the application of models based on both convolutional neural networks and vision transformers to tabular data, transforming feature vectors into images. Existing methods employ linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction techniques (e.g., Principal Component Analysis (PCA), t-SNE, and UMAP) to determine pixel positions, resulting in images whose spatial layout do not inherently reflect feature relationships. This paper introduces Visibility Graphs for Tabular-to-Image Encoding (VG-TIE), a novel method that encodes the structure of feature values using Natural Visibility Graph (NVG) and Horizontal Visibility Graph (HVG) into a two-dimensional space obtained through PCA. The resulting images are model-agnostic and intrinsically interpretable. Each pixel corresponds to an input feature, its intensity reflects the magnitude and direction of deviation from the population mean, and edges represent formally defined visibility relationships between features. VG-TIE provides two interpretability methods: (i) feature ranking from node degree distributions; and (ii) local and global feature importance from pixel intensity combined with Grad-CAM. Experiments on six public tabular datasets show that VG-TIE is competitive with other tabular-to-image methods while providing interpretability on feature importance and ranking similar to intrinsic interpretable methods. The results highlight the potential of the proposed image-based transformation to provide an effective framework that expands the use of deep learning across tabular data domains.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有 tabular-to-image 方法用 PCA、t-SNE、UMAP 等降维决定像素位置，图像的空间布局不反映特征间关系，因而难以解释。
Method: 先用 PCA 得到二维空间，再用 NVG 与 HVG 把特征值结构编码进该空间；每个像素对应一个输入特征，强度反映相对总体均值的偏离幅度与方向，边为形式化定义的特征可见性关系。解释途径有两条：由节点度分布做特征排序，以及像素强度结合 Grad-CAM 给出局部与全局特征重要性。
Result: 在六个公开表格数据集上的实验显示 VG-TIE 与其它 tabular-to-image 方法相比具有竞争力，且在特征重要性与排序上的可解释性与内在可解释方法相当。
Conclusion: 把可见图结构嵌入图像编码，可以在不牺牲表格分类性能的前提下让像素级表示本身可解释，从而把基于深度学习的模型扩展到更多表格数据领域。

papers.title: Albireo: Adaptive, Energy-Efficient Inference Framework for Video Object Detection on the Edge
papers.abstract_en: Video object detection on edge devices runs computationally expensive detectors over long frame streams, causing high energy consumption and sustained GPU utilization. Although consecutive frames are highly redundant, naive frame skipping is content-blind: it skips during critical moments such as object entry, occlusion recovery, and abrupt motion, degrading detection quality. We present Albireo, a detector-agnostic, codec-free adaptive inference framework that wraps off-the-shelf detectors and decides when detector invocation can be safely skipped based on scene content and per-object temporal state, requiring no detector modification or retraining. Albireo maintains a 10-dimensional Kalman filter (KF) per active object and invokes the detector only when prediction uncertainty exceeds a threshold; on skipped frames, boxes are predicted from the KF state at near-zero GPU cost. A KF-based rescue mechanism preserves confirmed objects through brief detector misses to prevent output fragmentation, while a lightweight empty-scene screen avoids detector calls on objectless frames. We evaluate Albireo on the BDD100K MOT validation split with three architecturally distinct detectors (YOLO11x, YOLO26x, RF-DETR-Large) on two NVIDIA Jetson platforms (AGX Thor, AGX Orin). Across all configurations, Albireo keeps AP@50 within +/-1.2 pp of per-frame inference while reducing total energy by 12.1-17.6%. On YOLO26x, it improves AP@50 by +0.8 pp while reducing energy by 17.6% (Thor) and 14.4% (Orin) and per-frame energy-delay product by 24.9% and 26.1%, respectively. Thus, the default operating point improves accuracy, energy, and latency together. In contrast, FixedSkip-2, a fixed-interval baseline with a 50% skip rate, loses 8.6 pp AP@50. Source code, evaluation pipeline, and per-clip results are available at https://github.com/amirtaherin/albireo
papers.comment: Accepted at the ACM/IEEE Symposium on Edge Computing (SEC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Albireo 是面向边缘设备视频目标检测的免改码、免重训自适应推理框架：每个活跃目标维护 10 维 Kalman filter，仅当预测不确定度超过阈值才调用检测器，跳帧时用 KF 状态直接出框。在 BDD100K MOT 验证集、三种检测器与两款 Jetson 上，AP@50 相对逐帧推理保持在 ±1.2 pp 内，总能耗降低 12.1–17.6%；YOLO26x 上 AP@50 反升 0.8 pp 且能耗降 17.6%（Thor）/14.4%（Orin），而固定 50% 跳帧的 FixedSkip-2 损失 8.6 pp AP@50。
Motivation: 边缘端视频检测要在长帧流上持续跑重检测器，能耗与 GPU 占用高；朴素按固定间隔跳帧是内容盲的，会在目标进入、遮挡恢复、剧烈运动等关键时刻丢帧，直接拉低检测质量。
Method: detector-agnostic 且 codec-free 的包装式框架，不改检测器也不重训：每个活跃目标维护 10 维 Kalman filter，预测不确定度超阈值才调用检测器，跳帧帧的框由 KF 状态给出；配 KF-based rescue 机制在短暂漏检时保住已确认目标以防输出碎片化，再加轻量 empty-scene screen 跳过无目标帧。评测用 BDD100K MOT 验证集，检测器为 YOLO11x、YOLO26x、RF-DETR-Large，平台为 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor 与 AGX Orin。
Result: 全部配置下 AP@50 相对逐帧推理保持在 ±1.2 pp 内，总能耗降低 12.1–17.6%。YOLO26x 上 AP@50 提升 +0.8 pp，能耗下降 17.6%（Thor）与 14.4%（Orin），单帧 energy-delay product 分别下降 24.9% 与 26.1%。固定间隔基线 FixedSkip-2（50% 跳帧率）损失 8.6 pp AP@50。
Conclusion: 默认工作点可同时改善精度、能耗与延迟，说明按目标级不确定度调度检测器调用优于内容盲的固定跳帧；该结论在三种架构不同的检测器与两款 Jetson 平台上一致成立。

papers.title: AgentKernel: The Trust-Native Agentic Operating System
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI agents routinely cross trust boundaries: they ingest untrusted content, combine it with privileged instructions, persist intermediate beliefs in long-term memory, and invoke privileged tools. This creates an attack surface in which malicious payloads can enter through model inputs and cause harmful tool actions. Yet current governance stacks remain application-level middleware that share a process trust boundary with the agents they monitor. We argue that agents need an operating-system substrate providing mandatory, non-bypassable services for identity, input mediation, memory governance, and execution control. We introduce AgentKernel, a trust-native agent operating system built around the premise that security must be a first-class design constraint. AgentKernel wraps the agent lifecycle in a mandatory enforcement boundary organized into four pillars: Identity, Perception, Cognition, and Execution. Each pillar adapts classical OS security principles to failures at the semantic plane, including delegation abuse, prompt injection, memory poisoning, and tool misuse. AgentKernel treats structural security as a capability multiplier. Kernel-managed identity supports trustworthy cross-organization collaboration; graduated perception replaces brittle single-point filters; information-flow-controlled memory improves retrieval fidelity while limiting poisoning; and semantic-to-kernel enforcement permits broader tool privileges behind a non-bypassable boundary. We position AgentKernel as the missing OS layer beneath orchestration frameworks, agent runtimes, governance platforms, and execution sandboxes, and use systematic comparison and security analysis to show how a single integrated architecture can enforce security across the full agent lifecycle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentKernel 把 AI agent 的身份、输入中介、记忆治理与执行控制下沉为不可绕过的 OS 级强制边界，用 Identity、Perception、Cognition、Execution 四支柱把经典 OS 安全原则迁移到语义平面，以抵御 prompt injection、记忆投毒与工具滥用。作者主张结构性安全是能力倍增器：内核托管身份支撑跨组织协作，分级感知替代单点过滤，信息流控制的记忆在限制投毒的同时提升检索保真度，语义到内核的强制使工具可在不可绕过边界后获得更宽权限。
Motivation: 现有 agent 治理栈只是应用层中间件，与被监控的 agent 共享同一进程信任边界，恶意载荷可经模型输入进入并触发有害工具动作。
Method: 提出 AgentKernel，用强制执行边界包裹 agent 生命周期，分四支柱：Identity、Perception、Cognition、Execution；各支柱把委托滥用、prompt injection、记忆中毒、工具误用等语义平面失效对应到经典 OS 安全机制，并以系统性对比加安全分析定位为编排框架、agent 运行时、治理平台与执行沙箱之下的 OS 层。
Result: 通过系统性对比与安全分析展示单一集成架构可在完整 agent 生命周期上强制执行安全；具体机制包括内核托管身份、渐进式分级感知、受信息流控制的记忆，以及语义到内核的执行强制。
Conclusion: 安全必须是 agent 系统的一等设计约束并由 OS 级不可绕过边界承担，而非事后加装的应用层中间件。
Relevance: 0
