papers.title: SpectralCTGaussians: Projection-Domain Reconstruction and Basis Material Decomposition for Spectral CT using 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Spectral computed tomography (CT) extends conventional CT by measuring attenuation across multiple energy channels, allowing improved modeling of physical X-ray interactions and energy-dependent material behavior and leading to richer scene understanding. We present a novel method for spectral CT reconstruction and basis material decomposition using 3D Gaussian Splatting by adding per-Gaussian basis material fractions to the set of learnable parameters, which together with a set of energy-dependent basis functions define the attenuation across the full spectral range. The basis functions represent various physical attenuation models such as photoelectric absorption and Compton scattering, and are jointly optimized across all energy channels through a differentiable polychromatic forward model, with material decomposition performed via mean-shift clustering of the resulting coefficients. We evaluate our method on a baseline real-world dataset as well as a synthetic dataset that we introduce, comparing against traditional reconstruction algorithms and state-of-the-art learning-based CT reconstruction methods. Our approach outperforms all traditional baselines in novel view synthesis and achieves the best PSNR among all compared methods for spectral CT volume reconstruction, while describing all energy channels with a single shared representation that requires a number of Gaussians comparable to single-channel Gaussian splatting-based CT reconstruction approaches. For basis material decomposition, no traditional or learning-based baseline offers one-step decomposition with direct RGB material segmentation, and our method additionally recovers the photoelectric basis with higher PSNR than traditional pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectralCTGaussians 把每个 Gaussian 的基材料分数 (basis material fractions) 加入可学习参数，用可微多色前向模型跨全部能量通道联合优化光电吸收与康普顿散射等物理衰减基函数，再对系数做 mean-shift 聚类得到一步式材料分解。在真实基线数据集与自建合成数据上，新视角合成胜过全部传统基线，谱 CT 体重建取得所有对比方法中最高 PSNR，且光电基 PSNR 高于传统流水线。
Motivation: 谱 CT 需要跨多个能量通道建模能量依赖的材料行为，传统重建与分解流水线难以一步给出直接 RGB 材料分割，学习式方法也缺少用单一共享表示描述全部能量通道的方案。
Method: 在 3D Gaussian Splatting 的可学习参数中加入每 Gaussian 基材料分数，与一组代表光电吸收、康普顿散射等物理衰减模型的基函数共同定义全谱段衰减；通过可微多色前向模型跨所有能量通道联合优化，材料分解由系数的 mean-shift 聚类完成。
Result: 在真实世界基线数据集与作者引入的合成数据上，与传统重建算法及最先进学习式 CT 重建方法比较：新视角合成胜过全部传统基线，谱 CT 体重建取得所有对比方法中最高 PSNR，用与单通道 Gaussian splatting CT 重建相当数量的 Gaussian 描述全部能量通道；材料分解方面，光电基的 PSNR 高于传统流水线，且是唯一提供一步式分解与直接 RGB 材料分割的方法。
Conclusion: 把基材料分数作为 Gaussian 的可学习参数并用可微多色前向模型联合优化，可以用单一共享表示同时完成谱 CT 重建与一步式基材料分解，并在 PSNR 上超过传统与学习式对比方法。

papers.title: A Manifold-Aware Topic Modeling Approach via Rank-Based Prototypes
papers.abstract_en: Recent topic models leverage pretrained embeddings, but neural architectures produce latent representations without grounding in specific texts, and clustering-based pipelines assign representative documents only post hoc, relying on absolute distances distorted by hubness and anisotropy in high-dimensional spaces. We introduce MARETopic, a training-free framework that casts topic discovery as rank-based prototype selection. After projecting embeddings onto a low-dimensional manifold, MARETopic builds ranked lists encoding ordinal neighborhood structure. A greedy algorithm selects exactly K exemplar documents, real corpus texts, whose neighborhoods cover the corpus. Two variants share this criterion. MARETopic$_\text{Corr}$ scores candidates with a query performance predictor and a rank correlation measure, leading Purity and NMI on the two benchmarks with the most categories, ahead of both neural and clustering-based topic models. MARETopic$_\text{Diff}$ scores them with a rank-based diffusion matrix, needs neither measure, and runs 1.7 to 1.9 times faster. Without a single gradient update, MARETopic leads topic coherence on two of three datasets. A novel inter-topic Maximal Marginal Relevance step raises vocabulary diversity at little cost in coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/thcastilho/maretopic.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Main Conference of 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARETopic 是一个免训练的主题发现框架：把预训练 embedding 投影到低维流形后构建秩邻域列表，用贪心算法选出恰好 K 篇真实文档作为主题原型。Corr 变体用查询性能预测器加秩相关度打分，在类别数最多的两个基准上 Purity 与 NMI 领先神经与聚类主题模型；Diff 变体改用秩扩散矩阵，无需该度量且快 1.7–1.9 倍。全程零梯度更新，仍在三个数据集中的两个上取得最高 topic coherence。
Motivation: 神经主题模型的潜在表示不锚定到具体文本，聚类流水线只能事后挑代表文档，且依赖被 hubness 与 anisotropy 扭曲的绝对距离，高维下选代表失真。
Method: MARETopic 先把 embedding 投影到低维流形，构建编码序数邻域结构的秩列表，再用贪心算法选出恰好 K 篇真实文档作为覆盖全语料的原型。Corr 变体用查询性能预测器 (query performance predictor) 加秩相关度给候选打分；Diff 变体改用基于秩的扩散矩阵打分，不需要该度量。另加一个基于 Maximal Marginal Relevance 的主题间步骤提升词表多样性。
Result: 在两个类别数最多的基准上，MARETopic_Corr 的 Purity 与 NMI 领先神经与聚类主题模型；MARETopic_Diff 运行速度快 1.7 至 1.9 倍。无一次梯度更新，MARETopic 在三个数据集中的两个上取得最高 topic coherence；MMR 步骤以很小的 coherence 代价提升词表多样性。
Conclusion: 免训练的秩式原型选择即可在主题质量上与神经和聚类主题模型竞争，绝对距离在高维空间中并非必需；秩扩散打分能在几乎不损失判据的前提下换到更快速度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Optimal Recovery Meets Bayesian Learning: Where Worst-Case Bounds Pay Off
papers.abstract_en: Worst-case Optimal Recovery (OR) and Bayesian learning describe the same Gaussian-quadratic-Hilbert problems in two vocabularies. We sharpen the correspondence - the radius of information equals a nugget-optimized GP posterior variance and is attained by the posterior mean at a closed-form balance nugget - and measure, inside three published Bayesian systems, where the worst-case side pays. The ledger is two-sided: the losses instruct as much as the wins. Morozov calibration tracks a test-access oracle within $1.00$-$1.19\times$ where $σ$-blind rules fail, is $4.9$-$6.3\times$ more reproducible across noise draws ($p=0.002$-$0.004$), and is the only deployable rule whose selection survives a change of backend ($1.36\times$ against $12$-$30\times$ for the released weight, ML-II and GCV); tight certificates cover at the information-theoretic floor with no numerical slack. But on exchangeable data split-conformal beats the OR head on interval score, a water-filling prior adds nothing without an oracle noise hint, and under covariate shift the OR band keeps coverage on every dataset yet loses interval score to split-conformal, and to a feature-free constant band, on most cells; what pays is not shift but shift on a learnable target, which a training-free audit statistic predicts before any model is fitted. In Bayesian optimization the certified width is a validity floor whose scalar inflation we prove inert under a checkable margin condition and check at every step. Inertness is graded, not binary, and in the size of the inflation as much as in the objective: $κ{=}2$ is inert wherever $κ{=}5$ is and on more cells besides, while $κ{=}5$ moves half the Ackley seeds and every Griewank seed. Exploration is a shape problem, not a scale one. The design rule: match the guarantee tool to the data regime, and audit the regime first.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把 worst-case Optimal Recovery (OR) 与贝叶斯学习统一为同一类 Gaussian-quadratic-Hilbert 问题，证明 information radius 等于 nugget 优化后的 GP 后验方差，并在三个已发表贝叶斯系统里逐条核算 worst-case 侧何时真正划算。Morozov 校准在测试访问 oracle 附近 1.00–1.19×、跨噪声抽样可复现性高 4.9–6.3×（p=0.002–0.004），且是唯一换 backend 后仍存活的可部署规则（1.36×，对比 released weight、ML-II、GCV 的 12–30×）；但在可交换数据上 split-conformal 的 interval score 胜过 OR head，协方差偏移下 OR band 保住覆盖却在多数格子输掉 interval score。设计规则是按数据 regime 配保证工具，并先用一个免训练 audit 统计量判定 regime。
Motivation: Worst-case OR 与贝叶斯学习长期各说各话，worst-case 证书在真实贝叶斯系统里是否划算、在哪个数据 regime 划算没有系统核算；协方差偏移与可交换数据下区间方法的选择也缺少可事先判定的依据。
Method: 先建立 OR 与贝叶斯的对应：information radius 等于 nugget-optimized GP posterior variance，且由 posterior mean 在闭式 balance nugget 处达到；再在三个已发表贝叶斯系统中对比 Morozov calibration、released weight、ML-II、GCV 等选择规则，与 split-conformal、feature-free constant band 比较 interval score 与 coverage，并用一个训练前 audit 统计量预测 regime；贝叶斯优化部分证明标量宽度膨胀在可检验 margin 条件下 inert，并逐步检查。
Result: Morozov 校准跟踪 test-access oracle 在 1.00–1.19× 内，而 σ-blind 规则失效；跨噪声抽样可复现性高 4.9–6.3×（p=0.002–0.004）；换 backend 后存活倍率 1.36×，对比 released weight、ML-II、GCV 的 12–30×；tight certificates 覆盖到 information-theoretic floor 且无数值松弛。可交换数据上 split-conformal 在 interval score 上胜过 OR head；协方差偏移下 OR band 在每个数据集保住 coverage，但在多数格子 interval score 输给 split-conformal 与 feature-free constant band。BO 中 κ=2 inert 的格子是 κ=5 的超集，κ=5 推动一半 Ackley seeds 与全部 Griewank seeds。
Conclusion: Worst-case 保证的收益取决于数据 regime 而非偏移本身：真正有回报的是可学习目标上的偏移，且可由训练前 audit 统计量预测；保证工具应与 regime 匹配，探索是形状问题而非尺度问题。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Free the Language Model From the Vision Encoder: Semantic Serialization as a Perception Interface for Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end vision-language models (VLMs) bind visual competence to the scale of their language model: as the language model shrinks, perception and reasoning degrade together. We study an embodied scene question-answering (QA) interface in which vision never enters the language model. A frozen perception stack detects and ranges objects; a deterministic semantic serializer compiles the perceived state, errors included, into decision-aligned text; an unmodified text-only large language model (LLM) answers. On a visible-scope-matched, occlusion-audited campus-robot benchmark, under a prospectively frozen criterion, the serialized interface, using detectors fine-tuned in-domain within each fold, outperforms a zero-shot VLM whose language model has the same 7B scale (0.7892 vs 0.7462), with a larger margin at 3B (0.7673 vs 0.6913). Preregistered decoupling experiments show the gain survives paraphrase, attributing it to decision-aligned computation rather than answer-string leakage, while novel judgment vocabularies bound its scope. The advantage grows as the reader shrinks to 1.5B and reverses at 0.5B, and a ground-truth oracle locates the reader-capability floor. Under matched task supervision the interfaces converge: a VLM fine-tuned with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) overtakes the zero-shot system but only ties an equally supervised text reader (0.8441 vs 0.8396, no statistically resolved difference), and both routes remain perception-bound. Reported perception parameters are comparable to those of the VLM's vision tower, and total compute is not smaller.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语义序列化 (semantic serialization) 作为小语言模型的感知接口：视觉完全不进 LLM，由冻结感知栈检测测距、确定性序列化器把状态（含误差）编译成决策对齐文本，再交给未改动的纯文本 LLM 作答。在校园机器人场景 QA 基准上，序列化接口以同为 7B 的零样本 VLM 为对照取得 0.7892 vs 0.7462，3B 时 0.7673 vs 0.6913；优势随读取器缩小到 1.5B 而增大，在 0.5B 反转。
Motivation: 端到端 VLM 把视觉能力绑死在语言模型规模上：LM 一缩小，感知与推理一起退化，小模型难以独立承担具身场景 QA。
Method: 冻结感知栈负责目标检测与测距；确定性语义序列化器把感知状态（含误差）编译为决策对齐文本；未修改的纯文本 LLM 作答。评测用可见范围匹配、遮挡审计的校园机器人基准，采用预先冻结的判据，检测器在每折内做域内微调；另设预注册的解耦实验（改写、判断词表、真值 oracle）与 LoRA 微调对照。
Result: 序列化接口 0.7892 vs 零样本 VLM 0.7462（同为 7B），3B 时 0.7673 vs 0.6913；优势在读取器缩到 1.5B 时增大、0.5B 时反转，真值 oracle 定位读取器能力下限。改写后增益仍在，归因于决策对齐计算而非答案串泄漏。同等任务监督下 LoRA 微调的 VLM 0.8441 vs 同等监督的文本读取器 0.8396，无统计显著差异；感知参数量与 VLM 视觉塔相当，总计算量并不更小。
Conclusion: 小模型场景下把感知移出语言模型、以决策对齐文本作接口可胜过同规模零样本 VLM，但优势依赖读取器规模区间，且在匹配监督下两条路线收敛、同受感知能力约束。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Operator Packages, Proposer Strength, and Construction-Family Plateaus in Office-Scale Verified Search
papers.abstract_en: Verified search, in which a language model proposes programs, a hard evaluator scores them, and selection keeps the best, has recently moved mathematical records; controlled ablations of the proposer-side components remain rare. We instrument a minimal FunSearch-style loop at office scale (a 30B local model on a laptop, 120-600 verified samples per run) with three operator packages: a schematic notebook the model writes and carries instead of verbatim elites, a named obstacle, and behavioural repulsion from constructions already found. On nine construction problems from a public repository, the complete 2^3 factorial with two replicates favours the primary contrast in a nominal two-stage analysis: the composition closes more of the seed-to-record gap (+0.196; nominal pooled p=0.023, stage-combination p~0.08; median per-problem effect +0.045). Repulsion raises construction-hash diversity everywhere (p=0.0039; partly a manipulation check). The factorial finds no positive memory-by-repulsion interaction (bounded to about +/-0.04); the gain decomposes additively, and memory+repulsion is the only arm that never collapses (0 of 18 runs), within 0.025 of the full composition. A frontier proposer under the identical loop reaches in tens of samples what the local model does not in hundreds; in single scoping runs its gains arrive without the operators. The search stalls after closing ~92% of the gap on the flagship problem, and the registered family-hint test gives the stall its first reading: named in words, the reference family is adopted and loses; handed as code, it is optimized, but our best finite-grid implementation remains below the plateau reached unaided. The loop transported and optimized the idea it was handed; no unaided run produced it. We release the harness, every candidate, and the dated pre-registrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 FunSearch 式 verified search 循环上做 2^3 因子消融，检验三个 proposer 侧算子包（schematic notebook 记忆、named obstacle、对已发现构造的行为排斥）各自与交互的作用。完整组合把 seed-to-record 差距多关 +0.196（名义 pooled p=0.023，stage-combination p≈0.08，逐题中位效应 +0.045），排斥使构造哈希多样性在所有题上提升（p=0.0039），memory×repulsion 无正交互（界于约 ±0.04），且 memory+repulsion 是唯一 18 次运行中零崩溃的臂。
Motivation: Verified search 已刷新数学纪录，但 proposer 侧组件的受控消融很少；作者把最小 FunSearch 循环缩到办公规模（笔记本上的 30B 本地模型，每次运行 120–600 个已验证样本），使全因子实验可负担。
Method: 在最小 FunSearch 式循环（LLM 提出程序、硬评估器打分、保留最优）上实现三个算子包：模型书写并携带的 schematic notebook（替代逐字 elite）、named obstacle、以及对已找到构造的行为排斥；在公开仓库的九个构造问题上跑 2^3 全因子设计、每格两次重复，另加 frontier proposer 的同循环对照与注册的 family-hint 测试。
Result: 主对比关闭 seed-to-record 差距 +0.196（名义 pooled p=0.023，stage-combination p≈0.08，逐题中位效应 +0.045）；排斥在所有题上提高构造哈希多样性（p=0.0039，部分属操纵检查）；memory×repulsion 交互界于约 ±0.04 且为加性分解，memory+repulsion 臂 0/18 次崩溃、距完整组合 0.025 以内；frontier proposer 数十样本即达本地模型数百样本未达之处；旗舰问题在关闭约 92% 差距后停滞，family-hint 以文字给出时参考族被采纳但变差，以代码给出时被优化但最佳有限网格实现仍低于无辅助达到的平台。
Conclusion: 算子包的收益是加性而非交互的，memory+repulsion 足以避免崩溃；停滞源于把外部想法搬运并优化到既有平台，而非缺少该想法——无辅助运行从未产生它。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: iCoder-27B: Recursive AI-Led Development of Frontier Industrial Coding Model
papers.abstract_en: Recursive AI, the prospect of AI taking an increasingly complete role in building and improving AI, is a crown jewel of AI for AI. Although recursive self-development has become practical for small models, bounded tasks, and fixed time budgets, a more consequential realization of this ambition, i.e., developing a release-ready, frontier-competitive model, remains far more challenging. In this work, we ask how little human involvement is sufficient for an agent to develop a frontier model. We concentrate human input into a high-density, low-frequency interface: experts encode objectives, stage scaffolds, permission boundaries, and operating procedures as reusable research skills, while the agent instantiates these priors, selects experiments, diagnoses outcomes, and revises the training strategy. In the challenging domain of industrial coding, the agent evolves data and coordinates SFT, on-policy self-distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, ultimately producing iCoder, a 27B model for RTL design and GPU kernel optimization. Across seven benchmarks, iCoder leads RTLLM, outperforming GPT-5.5 and Claude-Opus-4.8; ranks second on CVDP and KernelBench L2, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 16 points; and ties Claude-Opus-4.8 for the best TritonBench result. Exploratory case studies further show iCoder's competitive iterative RTL and GPU-kernel optimization with substantially fewer tokens. These results chart an engineering path toward recursive self-improvement, in which humans distill the principles of model building, agents operationalize them through evidence-driven experimentation, and each generation of AI becomes a more capable architect of the next.

papers.title: Limited Structural Reliability in Public Educational Prediction Benchmarks: A Four-Dimension Audit of Seven Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Across seven public educational prediction datasets, three passed all four pre-modeling reliability checks; the remaining four either failed group-aware generalization tests or lacked the provenance metadata needed to run them. One dataset was initially classified as failing but corrected after excluding group-identifier features from the holdout matrix, demonstrating that the audit can distinguish genuine cross-group confounding from feature-encoding artifacts. Each dataset was audited before model optimization using four checks: baseline gap, split instability, null separation, and metadata adequacy under group-aware holdout. The dominant failure mode was not weak iid performance alone but cross-group fragility: in the clearest case, UCI Student declined from iid R-squared 0.242 to group-holdout R-squared -0.097, while Higher Ed collapsed from 0.041 to -8.79. Increasing model complexity did not remove this pattern: ensemble models improved structurally sound datasets but amplified instability or failed under group holdout on fragile ones. An exploratory cross-dataset comparison further showed that stronger profiles clustered in larger, richer-grouped, performance-proximal datasets, while random-split performance severely overstated deployable signal in fragile datasets. Classification-metric sensitivity analyses reached the same substantive conclusions. The results show that benchmark reliability in educational AI is constrained less by algorithm choice than by data structure, group heterogeneity, and evaluation design. A reusable pre-modeling audit offers a minimum quality gate before public educational datasets support strong benchmark or deployment claims.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables. Accepted by Scientific Reports (2026). Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21887892
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对七个公开教育预测数据集做建模前四维审计（baseline gap、split instability、null separation、metadata adequacy，均在 group-aware holdout 下），仅三个全部通过。最清晰的失败案例中 UCI Student 的 iid R² 0.242 跌到 group-holdout R² -0.097，Higher Ed 从 0.041 崩到 -8.79；加模型复杂度（ensemble）不能消除该模式，随机切分严重高估可部署信号。
Motivation: 公开教育 AI 基准常在随机 iid 切分下报强性能，但跨组泛化与来源元数据的可靠性从未在建模前被系统检查，导致 benchmark 或部署声明建立在脆弱数据结构上。
Method: 在模型优化之前对每个数据集跑四项检查：baseline gap、split instability、null separation、group-aware holdout 下的 metadata adequacy；另做一次探索性跨数据集比较与 classification-metric 敏感性分析，并演示把 group-identifier 特征从 holdout 矩阵剔除后可区分真实跨组混杂与特征编码假象。
Result: 七个数据集中 3 个通过全部四项检查，其余 4 个要么 group-aware 泛化测试失败、要么缺少运行该测试所需的 provenance 元数据；1 个数据集最初判为失败、剔除 group-identifier 特征后更正。UCI Student iid R² 0.242 → group-holdout R² -0.097，Higher Ed 0.041 → -8.79。ensemble 在结构健全的数据集上提升、在脆弱数据集上放大不稳定或在 group holdout 下失效；随机切分性能在脆弱数据集上严重高估可部署信号，classification-metric 敏感性分析结论一致。
Conclusion: 教育 AI 基准可靠性主要受数据结构、组异质性与评估设计约束，而非算法选择；这套可复用的建模前审计应作为公开数据集支撑强 benchmark 或部署声明前的最低质量门槛。

papers.title: AgenticCADedit: A Stateful, Tool-Mediated Agentic Approach to Multimodal 3D CAD Editing
papers.abstract_en: Computer-aided design is central to industrial manufacturing, and much of a designer's daily work consists of editing existing models from multimodal requests involving speech, sketches, and model interaction. Existing neural CAD approaches focus predominantly on unconditional or text-conditioned generation. The neuralCAD-Edit approach formalizes expert multimodal editing requests, but its iterative baseline refines a complete CAD program across attempts, executing each attempt from the original model in a stateless CAD environment. Every attempt must therefore reconstruct the entire edit from scratch, so partially correct progress is discarded rather than accumulated, and the model can neither inspect the geometry it has just produced nor selectively revert a single faulty operation. We present AgenticCADedit, which turns editing into a sequence of small, verifiable actions on a persistent CAD state instead of a single regenerated program. Rather than emitting one complete program, it applies incremental code steps that each commit to the session, inspects the resulting faces and edges, renders highlighted selections to verify that the intended region was addressed, and reverts individual operations when it was not. Subsequent actions therefore build on the geometry produced by earlier ones. Our approach improves on all metrics for all three evaluated LLMs (open-weight: qwen3.6-27b, gemma4-31b; proprietary: gpt-5.6-luna), with the largest gains for the weakest baseline model, qwen3.6-27b, whose validity rises from 51.0% to 94.8% and acceptance from 1.6% to 12.0%. A token-cost analysis with gpt-5.6-luna further shows $66.7$% fewer output tokens than neuralCAD-Edit, while $94.8$% of input tokens are served from the prompt cache.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgenticCADedit 把多模态 3D CAD 编辑从「每次重写整段程序」改成在持久 CAD 状态上执行一串小而可验证的增量代码步骤：每步提交到会话、检查生成的面与边、渲染高亮选区核对目标区域，错了就回滚单个操作。在三个 LLM 上全部指标提升，最弱的 qwen3.6-27b validity 从 51.0% 升到 94.8%、acceptance 从 1.6% 升到 12.0%，gpt-5.6-luna 上输出 token 比 neuralCAD-Edit 少 66.7%。
Motivation: neuralCAD-Edit 的迭代基线在无状态环境里每次从原模型重跑整段 CAD 程序，部分正确的进度被丢弃而非累积，模型也无法检查刚生成的几何或单独回滚一个错误操作。
Method: 把编辑形式化为作用于持久 CAD 状态的序列动作：逐步提交增量代码、检查生成的 faces 与 edges、渲染高亮选区以验证目标区域、必要时回滚单个操作，后续动作建立在先前几何之上；对比基线为 neuralCAD-Edit，评测三个 LLM（qwen3.6-27b、gemma4-31b、gpt-5.6-luna）。
Result: 三个 LLM 上所有指标均提升，最大增益出现在最弱基线 qwen3.6-27b：validity 51.0% → 94.8%，acceptance 1.6% → 12.0%。用 gpt-5.6-luna 的 token 成本分析显示输出 token 比 neuralCAD-Edit 少 66.7%，且 94.8% 的输入 token 由 prompt cache 提供。
Conclusion: 把 CAD 编辑拆成有状态、可检查、可回滚的小步动作，比每次整体重生成程序更能累积进度并降低成本，收益对能力较弱的模型尤其明显。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: An Exploratory Ablation of a Small MLA--SSM Hybrid Language Model
papers.abstract_en: We report an exploratory, single-seed ablation of TALH (Adaptive Latent Hybrid), a decoder-only language model with parallel Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and a custom recurrent state-space (SSM) branch. Five variants, spanning 117--217M estimated active parameters per token, are trained from scratch on a FineWeb sample for the same number of optimisation steps and tokens. In this specific setup, removing the SSM branch gives the largest degradation in validation perplexity (MLA-only PPL 315), whereas removing MLA has a much smaller effect (SSM-only PPL 239). A dense-FFN hybrid obtains PPL 231, compared with 240 for the tested top-2 ternary-MoE hybrid, while using 3.87 GB less peak training memory. We also preserve a preliminary Apple M3 timing observation: among the five unoptimised implementations, MLA-only has the flattest measured time-to-first-token curve from 512 to 2,048 prompt tokens, although the dense Transformer is much faster in absolute terms. Because the runs are single-seed, parameter counts are unmatched, the evaluation stream may overlap the training source, and raw repeated timing records are unavailable, these results support implementation-specific hypotheses rather than general conclusions about MLA, SSMs, or mixture-of-experts models.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Exploratory single-seed ablation study. Code and replication package available at https://github.com/unseen1980/talh
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 TALH（Adaptive Latent Hybrid）这一并行 MLA 与自研递归 SSM 分支的 decoder-only 小模型做单种子消融：去掉 SSM 分支使验证困惑度劣化最大（MLA-only PPL 315），去掉 MLA 影响小得多（SSM-only PPL 239）。在该特定设置下 dense-FFN 混合 PPL 231，优于 top-2 ternary-MoE 混合的 240 且峰值训练内存少 3.87 GB；作者明确限定这些结果只支持实现相关的假设。
Motivation: MLA、SSM 与 MoE 在小语言模型中的相对贡献缺少受控消融证据；作者以同训练步数与 token 数的从头训练来隔离各分支的作用。
Method: 训练 TALH 的五个变体（117–217M 每 token 估计活跃参数），在 FineWeb 采样上从头训练、统一优化步数与 token 数；单种子，含 MLA-only、SSM-only、dense-FFN 混合与 top-2 ternary-MoE 混合等变体，并在 Apple M3 上记录未优化实现的首 token 延迟。
Result: 验证 PPL：MLA-only 315、SSM-only 239、dense-FFN 混合 231、top-2 ternary-MoE 混合 240，dense-FFN 比 MoE 少用 3.87 GB 峰值训练内存；Apple M3 上五个未优化实现中 MLA-only 在 512–2048 prompt token 区间的 time-to-first-token 曲线最平，但 dense Transformer 绝对速度更快。
Conclusion: 在这一实现与该单种子设置下，SSM 分支对验证困惑度的贡献大于 MLA，dense-FFN 混合以更低内存取得优于所测 ternary-MoE 的 PPL；作者强调参数量未对齐、评估流可能与训练源重叠，结论仅限实现层面的假设。

papers.title: Evidence-Driven Differential Diagnosis of Malignant Melanoma
papers.abstract_en: We present a modular and multi-level framework for the differential diagnosis of malignant melanoma. Our framework integrates contextual information and evidence at the lesion, patient, and population levels, enabling decision-making at each level. We introduce an anatomic-site aware masked transformer, which effectively models the patient context by considering all lesions in a patient, which can be variable in count, and their site of incidence. Additionally, we incorporate patient metadata via learnable demographics embeddings to capture population statistics. Through extensive experiments, we explore the influence of specific information on the decision-making process and examine the tradeoff in metrics when considering different types of information. Validation results using the SIIM-ISIC 2020 dataset indicate including the lesion context with location and metadata improves specificity by 17.15% and 7.14%, respectively, while enhancing balanced accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/narenakash/meldd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层证据驱动的黑色素瘤鉴别诊断框架，在病灶、患者、群体三个层级分别做决策：anatomic-site aware masked transformer 建模患者全部病灶及其发病部位，demographics embedding 注入人群统计。在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 上，加入病灶位置上下文使 specificity 提升 17.15%，加入 metadata 再提升 7.14%，balanced accuracy 同时改善。
Motivation: 黑色素瘤鉴别诊断通常只看单张病灶图像，忽略了同一患者其他病灶的位置信息与人群统计学背景，而这些上下文对决策有可量化的影响。
Method: 框架分病灶、患者、群体三级：用 anatomic-site aware masked transformer 处理数量可变的患者病灶集合及其发病部位；用可学习的 demographics embedding 融入患者 metadata；通过消融实验考察各类信息对决策的贡献与指标间的权衡。
Result: 在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 数据集上，纳入带位置的病灶上下文使 specificity 提升 17.15%，纳入 metadata 使 specificity 提升 7.14%，两者同时提升 balanced accuracy。
Conclusion: 把病灶位置与患者 metadata 作为结构化证据纳入鉴别诊断，可在 SIIM-ISIC 2020 上换取 specificity 与 balanced accuracy 的同步改善，且信息类型之间存在指标权衡。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: STRAND: Benchmarking and Improving Object-Centric Spatio-Temporal Monitoring in Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced video understanding, they remain highly prone to hallucinations in dynamic scenes. We argue this stems from a failure in spatio-temporal monitoring, the ability to persistently track object identities, states, and relations over time. Existing benchmarks obscure this deficit by relying on single final-answer evaluations for queries that can often be resolved via local visual cues or statistical priors. To rigorously diagnose this, we introduce STRAND, a benchmark of human-verified object-centric facts that evaluates intermediate reasoning by decomposing queries into sub-questions, distinguishing genuine temporal understanding from coincidental correctness. Crucially, we score models with Faithful Accuracy, an unconditional joint metric that credits a prediction only when the target answer and every prerequisite sub-question are correct, so that a model cannot inflate its score by being selectively consistent on the small subset of targets it happens to answer correctly. To address failure modes exposed by STRAND, we further propose an object-centric framework that explicitly constructs and reasons over structured object trajectories via chunk-wise state extraction and temporal aggregation. Extensive experiments, including backbone-, frame-, call-, and token-matched comparisons against both end-to-end MLLMs and modular video harnesses, demonstrate that our object-centric framework significantly reduces hallucinated answers and improves spatio-temporal reasoning consistency over state-of-the-art MLLMs. The code, model, and data have been made available at nguyentthong.github.io/strand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRAND 提出以物体为中心的视频时空监控基准，把查询拆成子问题并用 Faithful Accuracy 计分：只有目标答案与全部前置子问题都答对才计分，从而区分真正的时序理解与碰巧答对。配套的物体中心框架用分块状态抽取 (chunk-wise state extraction) 与时间聚合显式构建物体轨迹，在与端到端 MLLM 和模块化视频 harness 的 backbone、帧数、调用数、token 对齐比较中显著减少幻觉回答并提升时空推理一致性。
Motivation: 视频 MLLM 在动态场景中易产生幻觉，根源是无法持续追踪物体身份、状态与关系的时空监控能力缺失；现有基准只评最终答案，局部视觉线索或统计先验就能答对，掩盖了这一缺陷。
Method: STRAND 是人工核验的以物体为中心的事实基准，把查询分解为子问题来评中间推理，并以无条件联合指标 Faithful Accuracy 计分（目标答案与每个前置子问题全对才给分）。为修复暴露的失败模式，提出物体中心框架：分块状态抽取加时间聚合，显式构建并推理结构化物体轨迹。
Result: 在与端到端 MLLM 及模块化视频 harness 的 backbone、frame、call、token 对齐比较中，物体中心框架显著减少幻觉回答，并在时空推理一致性上优于 state-of-the-art MLLM。
Conclusion: 把物体轨迹显式结构化并按 Faithful Accuracy 严格计分，能同时压低视频 MLLM 的幻觉并提升时空推理一致性；代码、模型与数据已在 nguyentthong.github.io/strand 开源。

papers.title: PROVE: Proof-guided Regime-aware Operator Verification for Hallucination Detection in Medical Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: In medical visual question answering (VQA), hallucinations of vision-language models (VLMs) may lead to confident but incorrect responses, raising the risk of diagnostic errors. Existing hallucination detection methods uniformly estimate the reliability of VLM outputs from response consistency or visual evidence. However, such uniform verification across questions ignores question-specific characteristics, resulting in missed overconfident errors and false alarms from over-verification. We present PROVE (Proof-guided Regime-aware Operator Verification), a black-box detector that adapts verification strategy to the evidential structure of each question. PROVE classifies questions into three verification regimes based on what kind of visual proof they demand, activates a regime-specific subset of five complementary operators, and adjusts operator importance per question through a lightweight calibration layer conditioned on deterministic question-answer features. PROVE uses question-specific evidence to reweight operators and produce a calibrated risk score. Evaluated on 8048 test samples across three medical VQA benchmarks and four frontier VLMs, PROVE achieves 0.821 AUROC, outperforming the strongest baseline by +0.159, with consistent gains across all models and benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROVE 是面向医学 VQA 幻觉检测的黑盒方法：按问题所需的视觉证据类型把问题分到三种验证 regime，只激活五个互补算子中与该 regime 匹配的子集，再用轻量校准层按确定性问答特征调整算子权重，输出校准风险分。在三个医学 VQA 基准共 8048 条测试样本、四个前沿 VLM 上取得 0.821 AUROC，比最强基线高 0.159。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法对所有问题统一地从回答一致性或视觉证据估计可靠性，忽略问题本身的证据结构差异，导致漏掉过度自信的错误，也带来过度验证造成的误报。
Method: PROVE 按问题要求的视觉证明类型将问题分类为三种验证 regime，为每种 regime 激活五个互补算子中的特定子集；一个以确定性问答特征为条件的轻量校准层逐题调整算子重要性，再用问题特定证据重加权算子并给出校准风险分。
Result: 在三个医学 VQA 基准的 8048 条测试样本、四个前沿 VLM 上，PROVE 达到 0.821 AUROC，比最强基线高 +0.159，且在所有模型与基准上增益一致。
Conclusion: 按问题证据结构定制验证策略并逐题校准算子权重，能同时减少漏检的过度自信错误与过度验证误报，优于统一验证。

papers.title: When Agents Act Unwatched: The Reduced-Supervision Paradox in Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI is sold on a simple promise: the system keeps acting when the user stops watching. That promise creates an accountability inversion. As stepwise supervision recedes, verification does not disappear; it moves into the runtime infrastructure that defines authority, records action, interrupts execution, checks outcomes, and supports repair. We call this the reduced-supervision paradox. Using a 63-artifact audit, we examine its public visibility across 46 research papers and 17 engineering, documentation, security, and governance sources. We find that agents' action surfaces are far easier to reconstruct than the mechanisms needed to answer for their actions. Tool mediation and monitoring traces were clearly visible in 40 and 37 artifacts, whereas checkpoint placement was clearly visible in 6, validator independence in 4, recovery in 2, and contestability in 1. Three action paths show why this imbalance matters. A repository path can preserve rich diffs after a consequential change. A browser path can cross organizational boundaries faster than permissions travel. A service path can follow policy while leaving affected people without recourse. We argue that observability can become a substitute for accountability when it shifts verification onto users after meaningful intervention is no longer possible. Our action-path diagnostic instead asks whether a delegated action remains connected to authority, evidence, interruption, independent judgment, recovery, and challenge. The claim is deliberately bounded to public visibility; it does not establish the prevalence or effectiveness of undisclosed controls. We contribute an action-level account that recasts the harness from a technical wrapper into accountability infrastructure.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 tables. Expanded preprint with a structured public-artifact audit and three worked action paths
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出“减少监督悖论”：随着逐步人工监督退去，验证并未消失，而是转移到定义权限、记录动作、中断执行、检查结果与支持修复的运行时基础设施中。对 63 份公开材料（46 篇研究论文与 17 份工程/文档/安全/治理来源）的审计显示，动作面远比问责机制更易重建：工具中介与监控痕迹清晰可见的有 40 和 37 份，而检查点位置、验证器独立性、恢复、可争议性分别只有 6、4、2、1 份。
Motivation: Agentic AI 的卖点是用户不再盯着时系统仍持续行动，但随之产生问责反转：监督退去后验证被推给运行时基础设施，而这些机制在公开材料中几乎不可见，用户在关键干预点之后才被迫承担验证成本。
Method: 对 63 份公开材料做结构化审计（46 篇研究论文 + 17 份工程、文档、安全与治理来源），按动作面与问责机制分类统计可见性；再用三条动作路径（仓库、浏览器、服务）说明失衡如何发生，并提出一个动作级诊断框架，检查受托动作是否仍连着权限、证据、中断、独立判断、恢复与挑战。
Result: 63 份材料中，工具中介清晰可见 40 份、监控痕迹 37 份，而检查点位置 6 份、验证器独立性 4 份、恢复 2 份、可争议性 1 份。三条路径分别展示：仓库路径在重大变更后仍保留丰富 diff；浏览器路径跨越组织边界的速度快于权限传播速度；服务路径遵循政策却让受影响者无处申诉。
Conclusion: 可观测性会在关键干预之后把验证推给用户，从而变成问责的替代品；作者主张把 harness 从技术包装重新定义为问责基础设施，并明确将论断限定在公开可见性，不涉及未公开控制的普遍性或有效性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Active Client Selection in Federated Trajectory Prediction with Uncertainty-Awareness and Heterogeneous Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Training sequence models such as transformers is now standard for autonomous vehicle trajectory prediction, yet assembling high-quality centralized datasets remains challenging because real-world trajectories are fragmented across regions and vehicles. Federated Learning (FL) offers a natural alternative, but faces two distinctive challenges: high scene uncertainty arising from trajectory or map ambiguity, and cross-scene complexity heterogeneity caused by diverse map topology, traffic density, agent composition, and driving behaviors. We propose a family of active client selection methods that progressively incorporate awareness of scene uncertainty and complexity to prioritize informative clients. Our uncertainty-aware selectors use per-client negative log-likelihood under an uncertainty-aware global objective and estimated aleatoric uncertainty. We further develop a selector that jointly considers scene complexity and uncertainty, motivated by the intuition that knowledge from complex scenes can transfer to easier ones. Experiments on Argoverse show that federated trajectory prediction outperforms locally trained models. Uncertainty-aware selection accelerates convergence and improves minADE, minFDE, and MR. Under strong scene-complexity heterogeneity, our joint complexity- and uncertainty-aware selector achieves the best generalization and further accelerates convergence, demonstrating the benefit of prioritizing complex and informative scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自动驾驶轨迹预测的联邦学习 (Federated Learning) 中提出一族主动客户端选择方法：用每客户端负对数似然 (NLL) 与估计的 aleatoric uncertainty 排序优先选信息量大的客户端，再加入场景复杂度联合选择。在 Argoverse 上，联邦训练优于本地训练，不确定性感知选择加快收敛并改善 minADE、minFDE、MR；在强场景复杂度异质下，复杂度+不确定性联合选择泛化最好且收敛最快。
Motivation: 真实轨迹数据分散在各区域与车辆，难以组建高质量集中式数据集；联邦学习虽可行，但轨迹/地图歧义带来的场景不确定性与地图拓扑、车流密度、行为差异造成的跨场景复杂度异质会拖慢训练并损害泛化。
Method: 一族渐进引入场景不确定性与复杂度感知的主动客户端选择器：不确定性选择器基于不确定性全局目标下的每客户端 NLL 与估计的 aleatoric uncertainty；联合选择器同时考虑场景复杂度与不确定性，依据复杂场景知识可迁移到简单场景的直觉优先选复杂且信息量大的客户端。
Result: 在 Argoverse 上，联邦轨迹预测优于本地训练模型；不确定性感知选择加速收敛并改善 minADE、minFDE 与 MR；在强场景复杂度异质条件下，联合复杂度与不确定性感知选择器取得最好的泛化并进一步加速收敛。
Conclusion: 优先选择复杂且信息量大的场景客户端，可在联邦轨迹预测中同时提升泛化与收敛速度，说明客户端选择应同时纳入不确定性与场景复杂度。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: PEEL: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for Identifiable Uncertainty in CT Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not uniquely identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: the likelihood determines three combinations of four NIG parameters and is constant along a one-dimensional fiber. We identify that fiber using independent physical measurement. As an initial embodiment, a reconstruction network receives one noisy filtered-backprojection (FBP) image and is first trained only by Student-t negative log-likelihood to estimate the three identifiable coordinates (gamma, alpha, c). The network is then frozen; repeated physical-noise realizations propagated through its reconstruction output form a Monte Carlo (MC) teacher label for output-domain aleatoric variance. An aleatoric head attached to frozen features learns this label, after which (beta, nu) are recovered algebraically. On 30 held-out simulated objects at five photon levels, one-image predictions achieved pooled Spearman correlations of 0.832-0.951 against independent 400-repeat references, median within-image correlations were 0.834-0.947, and 98.81-99.55% of evaluated pixels satisfied the algebraic admissibility condition. The method needs no KL term, reference prior, evidence regularizer, or cross-loss weight.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Proof-of-concept study of physics-enabled identification of NIG uncertainty in CT imaging

TL;DR: CT 成像中 NIG 回归的四个参数无法从 Student-t 边际似然唯一辨识（似然只确定三个组合，沿一维 fiber 不变），PEEL 用独立物理测量把这条 fiber 定下来：先只用 Student-t 负对数似然训练重建网络估计可辨识坐标 (gamma, alpha, c)，冻结后以重复物理噪声传播生成 MC 教师标签训练 aleatoric 头，再代数恢复 (beta, nu)。在 30 个留出模拟物体、5 个光子水平上，单张图像预测与 400 次重复参考的 Spearman 相关达 0.832–0.951，98.81–99.55% 像素满足代数可容许条件。
Motivation: NIG 回归的边际 Student-t 似然只确定四个参数中的三个组合，参数沿一维 fiber 不可辨识，导致 aleatoric 不确定度无法唯一标定；CT 重建中需要从单张含噪图像给出可辨识的输出域方差。
Method: PEEL 分两阶段：网络接收单张含噪 FBP 图像，先仅以 Student-t 负对数似然训练估计可辨识坐标 (gamma, alpha, c)；随后冻结网络，把重复物理噪声实现传播过重建输出，构成输出域 aleatoric 方差的 Monte Carlo 教师标签，用挂在冻结特征上的 aleatoric 头拟合该标签，最后代数恢复 (beta, nu)。整个流程不需要 KL 项、参考先验、evidence 正则或交叉损失权重。
Result: 在 30 个留出模拟物体、5 个光子水平上，单张图像预测相对独立 400 次重复参考的 pooled Spearman 相关为 0.832–0.951，图像内中位相关为 0.834–0.947，98.81–99.55% 的被评估像素满足代数可容许条件。
Conclusion: 用独立物理测量固定 NIG 的不可辨识 fiber，可以在不引入 KL、先验或正则项的情况下从单张 FBP 图像恢复可辨识且物理自洽的 aleatoric 不确定度；作者将其定位为 CT 成像上的概念验证研究。

papers.title: A Computational Framework for Modelling Organisation-Level Semantic Identity from Longitudinal Textual Data
papers.abstract_en: Organisations continuously generate large volumes of textual data that capture how they communicate, evolve and differentiate themselves over time. Although recent advances in natural language processing have substantially improved organisation-level text analytics, existing approaches primarily represent organisations as latent embeddings or predictive feature vectors for similarity estimation, classification or retrieval. Consequently, there is currently no general computational framework for modelling organisation-level semantic identity as an interpretable and evolving semantic construct derived from longitudinal textual evidence. This paper introduces a computational framework that integrates semantic representation learning, graph-based semantic modelling, organisation-level semantic fingerprints, temporal semantic evolution and evidence-driven validation within a unified analytical methodology. Organisations are characterised through complementary semantic dimensions describing diversity, concentration, connectivity, novelty and semantic community composition, which are analysed longitudinally to infer evidence-supported semantic identities. The framework is demonstrated using a longitudinal corpus of K-pop lyrics from artists affiliated with the four major South Korean entertainment companies. The empirical analyses reveal distinguishable multidimensional semantic identities, diverse temporal evolutionary trajectories and coherent integrated identity profiles. Comprehensive validation demonstrates that the inferred identities are statistically supported, robust under alternative analytical assumptions, reproducible and operationally informative. Beyond the case study, the proposed framework establishes organisation-level semantic identity and provides a transferable methodology for modelling organisational behaviour from longitudinal textual data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出组织级语义身份计算框架，把语义表示学习、图建模、语义指纹与时间演化整合为统一方法，用多样性、集中度、连接性、新颖性和语义社群构成五个维度刻画组织。在韩国四大娱乐公司旗下 K-pop 歌词语料上，识别出可区分的多维语义身份与多样的时间演化轨迹，且推断身份在替代分析假设下稳健、可复现。
Motivation: 现有组织级文本分析把组织表示成潜 embedding 或预测特征向量，只用于相似度、分类与检索，缺少把语义身份当作可解释、随时间演化的构念来建模的通用框架。
Method: 框架整合语义表示学习、基于图的语义建模、组织级语义指纹、时间语义演化与证据驱动验证；用五个互补语义维度（多样性、集中度、连接性、新颖性、语义社群构成）做纵向分析以推断有证据支撑的语义身份。
Result: 在韩国四大娱乐公司旗下 K-pop 歌手的纵向歌词语料上，实证分析揭示可区分的多维语义身份、多样的时间演化轨迹与连贯的整合身份画像；验证表明推断身份有统计支撑、在替代分析假设下稳健、可复现且具操作信息量。
Conclusion: 组织级语义身份可以作为可解释、随时间演化的构念被建模，该方法可迁移用于从纵向文本数据刻画组织行为。

papers.title: When Identical Rows Disagree: From Benchmark Identifiability to Replication-Robust Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: A released table is often treated as an i.i.d. sample, although its repeated rows may encode business frequency, repeated entities, joins, resampling, or extraction errors. We show that this ambiguity creates a hidden measurement layer with three consequences: feature-identical rows impose an attained evaluation ceiling, row-weighted AUROC is sensitive to replication, and row-trained detectors learn a multiplicity-size-biased law. An exact-row audit of all 690 OddBench datasets finds train-test overlap in 355, feature-identical label conflict in 147, and a test anomaly identical to a training normal in 137. Switching from row to support weighting changes AUROC by at least 0.05 on 50-61 datasets across four classical detector geometries. We introduce SCOUT (Support-Count Orthogonalized Unsupervised Testing), a factorized anomaly detector that separates replication-invariant support evidence from exposure-aware count evidence. Factorwise split-conformal calibration yields marginal false-positive-rate control, while the support channel is exactly invariant to arbitrary positive row replication. On 686 OddBench datasets and five seeds, support-only SCOUT is non-inferior to row-wise Isolation Forest in raw AUROC and improves replication-invariant AUROC. External normal-support evaluations track nominal false-positive levels, and four backbones remain exactly unchanged under controlled replication. Semi-synthetic interventions show that conditional count modeling helps materially only under strong rate heterogeneity. These results specify when multiplicity should be treated as signal, nuisance, or uninterpretable without additional information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布表格被当作 i.i.d. 样本，重复行会造出隐藏测量层：特征相同的行设定了评估天花板，行加权 AUROC 对复制敏感，行训练的检测器学到多重性尺寸偏置的分布。对全部 690 个 OddBench 数据集做精确行审计，355 个存在训练-测试重叠、147 个特征相同但标签冲突、137 个测试异常与训练正常样本相同；改用 support 加权后 AUROC 在四个经典检测器几何上至少变化 0.05 的数据集有 50–61 个。
Motivation: 公开表格的重复行可能来自业务频次、实体重复、连接、重采样或抽取错误，其语义歧义使行级评估与行级训练都失真，异常检测的评估上限与假阳性控制随之不可靠。
Method: 提出 SCOUT (Support-Count Orthogonalized Unsupervised Testing)：把复制不变的 support 证据与暴露感知的 count 证据因子化分离，用 factorwise split-conformal 校准获得边际假阳性率控制，support 通道对任意正行复制严格不变。
Result: 690 个 OddBench 数据集中 355 个有训练-测试重叠、147 个特征相同标签冲突、137 个测试异常与训练正常相同；行加权切到 support 加权使 AUROC 至少变化 0.05 的数据集在四个经典检测器几何上有 50–61 个。在 686 个 OddBench 数据集、五个随机种子上，support-only SCOUT 在原始 AUROC 上不劣于行级 Isolation Forest 并提升复制不变 AUROC；外部 normal-support 评估贴近名义假阳性水平，四个 backbone 在受控复制下严格不变；半合成干预显示条件 count 建模仅在强速率异质性下才有实质帮助。
Conclusion: 多重性何时应被当作信号、干扰项或在缺少额外信息时不可解释，可以被明确界定；support 通道的复制不变性使假阳性控制在任意正行复制下保持。

papers.title: PartHackBench: Certified Equal-Progress Stress Tests for Partial-Credit Tool-Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tool agents often make useful progress without reaching terminal success, motivating partial-credit evaluation. Yet evaluators may reward milestones that were temporary, later reversed, or not attributable to the evaluated agent. Comparing an honest trajectory with a higher-scoring adversarial one is inconclusive if the latter made more genuine progress. We introduce PartHackBench, a controlled methodology that removes this confound. A private certifier admits a pair only when its trajectories match component-wise in both current-state predicate satisfaction and standardized agent attribution; score inflation, defined as f(A) - f(H), is measured only afterward. In 18 sealed held-out tasks in PB-CSTE, the frozen historical-target run produced matched adversaries for 15 tasks. Historical credit yielded mean inflation of .252, conditional attack success of 10/15, end-to-end yield of 10/18, and detected none of 14 strict rollbacks. Semantic LLM judges were more resistant but remained vulnerable, especially under evaluator-targeted attacks, while PB-CSTE current-state controls, defined as exact functions of the certified components, yielded zero inflation by construction. PartHackBench thus provides a certified control for testing whether evaluator credit changes while all benchmark-defined task-relevant progress remains fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PartHackBench 用私有 certifier 只接纳「当前状态谓词满足与标准化 agent 归因逐项匹配」的诚实/对抗轨迹对，把 score inflation f(A)-f(H) 留到配对之后测量，从而在进度完全固定的条件下检验评测器是否被操纵。在 PB-CSTE 的 18 个密封留出任务上，历史目标冻结跑为 15 个任务配出对抗轨迹，历史归因给出平均膨胀 .252、条件攻击成功 10/15、端到端产出 10/18，且 14 次严格回滚一次都没检出。
Motivation: 长程 tool agent 常有部分进展却未达终态成功，部分分评测因此必要；但评测器可能奖励临时、后被撤销或不可归因于被测 agent 的里程碑，使诚实轨迹与高分对抗轨迹的比较无法归因于评测器本身。
Method: 私有 certifier 逐项匹配两条轨迹的当前状态谓词满足与标准化 agent 归因，只对通过配对的对计算 score inflation = f(A) - f(H)；在 PB-CSTE 上跑 18 个密封留出任务的 frozen historical-target run，并对照语义 LLM judge 与 PB-CSTE current-state controls（定义为已认证组件的精确函数）。
Result: 18 个密封留出任务中 15 个配出匹配对抗轨迹；历史归因平均膨胀 .252，条件攻击成功 10/15，端到端产出 10/18，14 次严格回滚检出 0 次。语义 LLM judge 抵抗性更强但仍可被攻击，尤其在 evaluator-targeted attack 下；current-state controls 按构造膨胀为零。
Conclusion: 历史 credit 类评测器会在任务相关进度完全固定时凭空给出分数，而 current-state 控制把膨胀压到零；评测器信用是否随操纵变化，必须在认证的等进度对照下检验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DeepGOF-1: A Pretrained Convolutional Goodness-of-Fit Test for Logistic Regression with a Computable Consistency Certificate
papers.abstract_en: Goodness-of-fit tests for logistic regression are least reliable where they are most needed: at small samples their levels drift from the nominal one, and combining them worsens the drift. We propose a test whose statistic is a convolutional network, trained once on simulated departures, that reads misfit as a picture: a grid of standardized residuals over covariate ranks. The analyst never trains. The network ships frozen, and the p-value is the rank of the observed score within the analyst's own bootstrap, so the level is a property of the calibration rather than of what the network learned. We prove exactness under pivotality, asymptotic exactness without it, and a consistency theorem whose key condition is computable from the frozen weights in one forward pass, giving a per-alternative certificate; we also measure the test's blind cone. On a pre-declared sixty-cell grid the deployed level stays in the nominal band in fifty-eight cells, while that grid's power criterion failed; on a published benchmark it is the most stable of thirteen levels across settings and sample sizes, and the test outpowers every partition test at every sample size while ranking seventh overall. A bank-failure application and a versioned release close the paper.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Submitted for publication. Research compendium (frozen weights, training corpus and generator, benchmark harness, and every per-replicate p-value) archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22113219. The deployable test ships as deepgof1() in the R package ebrahim.gof

TL;DR: DeepGOF-1 把 logistic 回归的拟合优度检验做成一个预训练卷积网络：把标准化残差按协变量秩排成网格当作图像打分，p 值取该分数在分析者自身 bootstrap 中的秩，因此检验水平由校准而非网络学到的东西决定。在预声明的六十格网格上部署水平有 58 格落在名义带内，在已发表基准上是 13 个水平设定中最稳定的一个，且在每个样本量上都胜过全部 partition 检验，但总体排名第七。
Motivation: logistic 回归的拟合优度检验在小样本下水平偏离名义值最严重，而把多个检验合并反而加剧这种漂移，检验在最需要它的地方最不可靠。
Method: 检验统计量是一个卷积网络，一次性在模拟的偏离 (simulated departures) 上训练后冻结发布；输入是协变量秩网格上的标准化残差图像，分析者不再训练。p 值由观测分数在分析者自身 bootstrap 分布中的秩给出；理论上证明 pivotal 条件下精确、无 pivotal 时渐近精确，并给出一致性定理，其关键条件可从冻结权重一次前向传播算出，从而给出逐备择 (per-alternative) 证书，同时测量检验的盲锥 (blind cone)。
Result: 在预声明的六十格网格上，部署水平有 58 格保持在名义带内，但该网格的 power 判据未通过；在已发表基准上，它是 13 个水平设定跨设置与样本量中最稳定的，并在每个样本量上都胜过每一个 partition 检验，总体排名第七。附带一个银行倒闭应用与版本化发布（deepgof1()，R 包 ebrahim.gof）。
Conclusion: 把检验水平交给 bootstrap 校准、把网络冻结，可以让小样本 logistic 拟合优度检验的水平稳定下来并给出可计算的一致性证书；代价是整体功效排名仍只到第七，且存在可测量的盲锥。

papers.title: Task-Resolved Fisher Spectroscopy for Quantum Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses fixed quantum dynamics to encode a time series and trains only a classical readout, but a benchmark capacity alone does not reveal whether task information is lost in the reservoir, the measurement, feature compression, or finite sampling. We introduce \emph{task-resolved Fisher spectroscopy}, in which prediction targets define orthonormal score coordinates on the stationary distribution of input histories. Reweighting labeled histories along these scores generates an exactly affine family of reservoir states and measurement outcomes. In the same coordinates, we obtain a many-body Fisher-information hierarchy relating the state quantum Fisher information, the Fisher information of the complete measurement record, and moment matrices retained through many-body order $r$. The quadratic form of each moment matrix is exactly the stationary capacity of the optimal linear readout, while a finite-measurement extension predicts the approach from one-shot records to ideal expectation-value features. The measurement-level quantities require only stationary labeled records and measured outcome strings, not an input model or quantum-state tomography. In a five-spin open reservoir, interactions route fourth-order temporal information into higher-body correlations, so low-order compression can incur orders-of-magnitude sampling overhead even when a conventional parity target remains accessible. For correlated inputs and outputs, record-defined task scores predict held-out capacities, the required feature order, and measurement-budget dependence; optimizing the local measurement axis recovers otherwise hidden task information. The framework connects benchmark performance to experimentally actionable diagnoses of reservoir encoding, measurement choice, classical representation, and shot allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 task-resolved Fisher spectroscopy：用预测目标在输入历史平稳分布上定义正交 score 坐标，把重加权后的库态与测量结果化为精确仿射族，并给出连接量子 Fisher 信息、完整测量记录 Fisher 信息与多体矩矩阵的层级。在五自旋开放库中，四阶时间信息被互作路由进高阶关联，低阶压缩会带来数量级的采样开销，即使常规 parity 目标仍可读出；优化局域测量轴可找回隐藏的任务信息。
Motivation: QRC 只训经典读出，但单一 benchmark capacity 无法定位任务信息究竟丢失在库编码、测量、特征压缩还是有限采样环节，实验上缺少可操作的诊断量。
Method: 以预测目标定义平稳分布上的正交 score 坐标，沿这些坐标重加权带标签历史，得到精确仿射的库态与测量结果族；在同一坐标下建立态 QFI、完整测量记录 Fisher 信息与保留到多体阶 r 的矩矩阵层级，矩矩阵二次型等于最优线性读出的平稳 capacity，并加入有限测量扩展以刻画从单次记录到理想期望值特征的过渡；测量层量只需平稳带标签记录与实测结果串，不需要输入模型或量子态层析。
Result: 在五自旋开放库中，互作把四阶时间信息路由到更高体关联，低阶压缩可造成数量级 (orders-of-magnitude) 的采样开销，而常规 parity 目标仍可访问；对相关输入与输出，由记录定义的任务 score 能预测 held-out capacity、所需特征阶数与测量预算依赖，优化局域测量轴可恢复原本隐藏的任务信息。
Conclusion: benchmark 表现可以被拆解为库编码、测量选择、经典表示与 shot 分配的可实验诊断，任务信息的可见性取决于特征阶数与测量轴的选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Classifier-Dependent Benefits of Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Android Malware Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Detecting and classifying Android malware families remains challenging due to high feature dimensionality, class imbalance, and the high cost of expert-labeled data. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) offers a way to leverage unlabeled samples, but prior works rarely test whether SSL benefits generalize across classifier types or report statistical significance. We present a systematic evaluation of pseudo-labeling across six classifiers (LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, MLP, and SVM) on the CICMalDroid 2020 dataset, using five-fold stratified cross-validation and paired t-tests across five labeled ratios (1-20%). We find that SSL benefit is strongly classifier-dependent: SVM shows the largest significant gain (+4.4% accuracy at 5% labels, p = 0.0028), LightGBM improves modestly (+0.8 to +1.3% at 2-5% labels), while Random Forest is significantly harmed at low label ratios (-3.1% at 1% labels). Per-class analysis reveals SSL disproportionately benefits the hardest-to-classify families, with Adware F1 improving by +13.8 percentage points versus only +0.8 for the already well-classified Benign class. We further show that approximately 800 labeled samples (10% of the dataset) yield near-optimal performance across all classifiers. These findings offer practical guidance on when and with which classifier pseudo-labeling is worthwhile for Android malware classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CICMalDroid 2020 上系统评测伪标签半监督学习 (pseudo-labeling SSL) 对六种分类器的影响，发现收益强依赖分类器：SVM 在 5% 标注比例下准确率提升 4.4%（p = 0.0028），Random Forest 在 1% 标注比例下反而显著下降 3.1%。约 800 个标注样本（占数据集 10%）即可让所有分类器接近最优，作者据此给出何时、用哪个分类器做伪标签的实用判据。
Motivation: Android 恶意软件家族分类面临特征维度高、类别不平衡、专家标注昂贵的问题；已有 SSL 研究很少检验收益能否跨分类器泛化，也少有统计显著性检验。
Method: 在 CICMalDroid 2020 上对六种分类器（LightGBM、XGBoost、Random Forest、Logistic Regression、MLP、SVM）做伪标签 SSL 系统评测：五折分层交叉验证、五个标注比例（1–20%）、配对 t 检验，并做逐类分析。
Result: SVM 在 5% 标注下准确率 +4.4%（p = 0.0028）；LightGBM 在 2–5% 标注下 +0.8 至 +1.3%；Random Forest 在 1% 标注下显著受损 −3.1%；逐类上 Adware F1 提升 13.8 个百分点，而 Benign 仅 +0.8；约 800 个标注样本（数据集 10%）在所有分类器上接近最优。
Conclusion: 伪标签的收益不是普适的，而是由分类器类型和标注比例共同决定；低标注场景应优先选 SVM 类分类器并避开 Random Forest，标注预算约 800 样本即可饱和。

papers.title: Is Reasoning Always Useful? Rethinking Reasoning Utility in Universal Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-enhanced universal multimodal embeddings (UME) improve heterogeneous retrieval, but plausible rationales do not necessarily produce discriminative rankings. We study this gap by comparing the discriminative (DISC) and reasoning-driven generative (GEN) branches of UME-R1, a state-of-the-art reasoning UME method. We decompose reasoning utility into positive-target gain, hard-negative gain, and their margin difference. Positive similarity increases for 56.6%, but 15.7% are false-helpful cases where reasoning moves hard negatives closer even more. Local-neighborhood and token-attribution diagnostics suggest why: reasoning often de-condenses retrieved neighborhoods, but utility requires separator-aligned movement, while influential CoT tokens frequently encode evidence shared by positives and hard negatives. Motivated by these diagnostics, we propose SURE (Score-structure Utility Router for Embeddings), which improves UME-R1-7B by 1.5 points and yields consistent gains on two additional embedding models on MMEB-V2, without retraining, label-based policy selection, or extra VLM forward passes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推理增强的通用多模态嵌入 (UME) 中，正样本相似度提升的 56.6% 里有 15.7% 属于 false-helpful：推理把难负样本拉得更近。诊断显示推理常使检索邻域去凝聚，而效用需要沿 separator 方向移动，CoT 关键 token 多编码正负共享证据；据此提出的 SURE 路由器在不重训、不额外前向的条件下把 UME-R1-7B 提升 1.5 分。
Motivation: 推理增强能提高 UME 的正样本相似度，但看似合理的 rationale 不必然带来有区分度的排序，推理何时真正有用缺少可诊断的判定依据。
Method: 对比 UME-R1 的判别分支 (DISC) 与推理驱动生成分支 (GEN)，把推理效用分解为正样本增益、难负样本增益及二者差值；用局部邻域诊断与 token 归因定位原因，再据此提出 SURE (Score-structure Utility Router for Embeddings)，无需重训、无需基于标签选策略、不增加 VLM 前向次数。
Result: 正样本相似度提升占 56.6%，其中 15.7% 为 false-helpful 案例（推理使难负样本更靠近）；SURE 使 UME-R1-7B 提升 1.5 分，并在 MMEB-V2 上对另外两个嵌入模型给出一致增益。
Conclusion: 推理效用取决于移动是否与 separator 对齐而非相似度整体抬升，用分数结构路由器即可在不重训的前提下把有害推理路由掉。

papers.title: Visual Representation and History Modeling for Navigation World Models
papers.abstract_en: Navigation World Models (NWMs) predict action-conditioned visual futures for planning. Two practical challenges are central to their design: selecting a suitable visual representation and efficiently modeling observation history for repeated candidate queries. Standard Global-Softmax attention provides flexible interactions but repeatedly processes the same history, leading to increasing computation and memory costs for long contexts and multi-query planning. We study both problems within a unified conditional flow-transformer framework. We first compare five frozen visual representations under the same dynamics model and evaluation. To reduce redundant history computation, we design Cached-Linear, a hybrid architecture that combines local and shifted-window attention for target mixing with linear attention for reusable history access. We further develop Balanced Gated Delta Network (GDN), which augments this design with frame-wise recurrent memory for temporal history modeling. Experiments on RECON, SACSoN, and SCAND show that representation choice depends on the prediction objective: PAE-L performs best for reconstruction, RAE-B for direct prediction, and V-JEPA for long-horizon rollout. Under shared-history workloads, Cached-Linear substantially reduces computation and memory compared with Global-Softmax, while Balanced GDN improves selected direct-prediction endpoints with efficient context reuse. Overall, we systematically study visual representation and history modeling for NWMs and develop hybrid reusable-history architectures for efficient long-context and multi-query prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一的 conditional flow-transformer 框架下，导航世界模型 (NWM) 的视觉表征选择取决于预测目标：PAE-L 最适合重建、RAE-B 最适合直接预测、V-JEPA 最适合长时程 rollout。为省去重复处理历史，提出 Cached-Linear（局部与 shifted-window attention 做 target mixing、linear attention 做可复用历史访问）与 Balanced Gated Delta Network（加帧级循环记忆），在共享历史负载下相比 Global-Softmax 大幅降低计算与内存。
Motivation: NWM 要为规划反复查询候选动作下的视觉未来，Global-Softmax 每次都重算同一段历史，长上下文与多查询规划下计算和内存成本持续上升；同时视觉表征该按什么目标挑选缺乏统一比较。
Method: 在 conditional flow-transformer 中统一研究两问题：先在同一动力学模型与评测下比较五种冻结视觉表征；再提出 Cached-Linear 混合架构，用局部与 shifted-window attention 做 target mixing、linear attention 做可复用历史访问，并进一步提出 Balanced Gated Delta Network (GDN)，加入帧级循环记忆建模时间历史。
Result: 在 RECON、SACSoN、SCAND 上：表征选择随目标而变——PAE-L 重建最佳、RAE-B 直接预测最佳、V-JEPA 长时程 rollout 最佳；共享历史负载下 Cached-Linear 相比 Global-Softmax 显著降低计算与内存；Balanced GDN 在部分直接预测端点上提升结果并保持高效上下文复用。
Conclusion: 视觉表征没有跨目标的统一赢家，而可复用历史的混合注意力架构是长上下文、多查询 NWM 预测的效率出路。

papers.title: UNWIND: Any-Length Facial Video for Stress Detection without Temporal Windowing
papers.abstract_en: Automatic stress recognition from facial video provides a non-contact approach for affective monitoring. However, most existing video-based methods divide complete recordings into shorter temporal segments before performing classification. Such segmentation requires additional decisions concerning segment duration, overlap, and prediction aggregation, and may restrict the model from exploiting information distributed across the entire recording. We introduce UNWIND, a facial-video framework for stress detection that analyzes a complete recording as a single model input, eliminating the need for temporal windowing or external segmentation. UNWIND reorganizes the video by folding its temporal dimension into the channel dimension of a two-dimensional spatial representation, which is subsequently processed through a unified asymmetric-attention architecture. With a temporal stride of $τ=1$, the framework processes the entire $120$-second sequence, corresponding to $3{,}600$ frames sampled at $30$~fps, in a single input. We evaluate seven temporal-stride settings on a stress dataset comprising $58$ subjects, using a stratified subject-level protocol that covers configurations from dense frame retention to sparse temporal sampling. The highest test accuracy, $70.02\%$, is obtained at $τ=15$, while processing all frames at $τ=1$ achieves a comparable accuracy of $69.73\%$. Computational requirements range from $12.48$ to $348.78$ GFLOPs across the evaluated stride settings, illustrating the balance between temporal sampling density and computational efficiency. The findings show that effective facial-video stress recognition can be achieved without dividing recordings into temporal windows and that complete-recording inference can be performed within a single unified model.

Method: 将视频时间维折叠为二维空间表示的通道维，送入统一的非对称注意力 (asymmetric-attention) 架构；τ=1 时单次输入覆盖整段 120 秒、3,600 帧。评测 7 种 temporal stride 设置，采用分层的被试级 (subject-level) 划分协议。

papers.title: HiPACE: Hierarchical Phase-Boundary Analysis and Controlled Evaluation of Feature Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose LLM activations into sparse dictionary atoms, so that each distinct concept gets its own feature. One recurring behavior complicates this premise: feature absorption, in which a parent concept and its children--fruit and {apple, banana, pear}, say--collapse into a shared family direction. Prior work documents absorption empirically; missing is a closed-form prediction of when the shared direction is the cost-optimal representation of an active semantic family. This paper closes that gap. For a hierarchical Bernoulli generator with $k$ active children and residual scale $α$, the $L_0$-penalized reconstruction objective admits a closed-form phase boundary $λ_c(k,α)=α^2 k/(k-1)$: above it, pure parent absorption is strictly cheaper than pure child coding. Building on this boundary, we introduce HiPACE, an evaluation protocol that tests the boundary's structural consequence in real SAE dictionaries--measuring parent--child decoder structure over WordNet families, freezing the discovery-selected statistic before testing on unseen families, and contrasting genuine families against randomized sibling nulls. The boundary proves sharp in its native regime, predicting the synthetic transition within $\pm15%$ on all 30 tested cells. In Pythia-160m SAEs, the parent--child decoder gap recovers the predicted ordering with partial correlations up to $-0.93$ that sustain on the locked holdout and exclude sibling nulls ($p=0.002$). Controlled activation composition connects the theory's active-child count to the recovered family directions, and residual-stream interventions show that signed family directions increase parent-category logits, reversing under sign flip and vanishing under random controls--establishing causal sufficiency at the family-subspace level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiPACE 针对稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 中的特征吸收 (feature absorption) 给出闭式相界 λ_c(k,α)=α²k/(k-1)：当 L0 惩罚系数高于该阈值时，把整个语义家族压进共享父方向比逐子概念编码更省重构代价。在合成设定的全部 30 个测试格点上，边界对转变位置的预测误差在 ±15% 以内；在 Pythia-160m SAE 上，父-子 decoder 间隙与理论排序的部分相关达 -0.93，并在锁定留出集上保持、排除随机兄弟零假设 (p=0.002)。
Motivation: 特征吸收（父概念与子概念塌缩到共享方向）此前只有经验记录，缺少闭式判据说明共享方向何时是活跃语义家族的代价最优表示，因而无法在真实 SAE 字典中可检验地预测吸收何时发生。
Method: 对含 k 个活跃子概念、残差尺度 α 的层级 Bernoulli 生成器，推导 L0 惩罚重构目标的闭式相界 λ_c(k,α)=α²k/(k-1)；据此提出 HiPACE 评测协议：在 WordNet 家族上测量父-子 decoder 结构，先冻结发现阶段选定的统计量再在未见家族上测试，并与随机兄弟零假设对照；辅以受控激活组合与残差流干预。
Result: 相界在其原生机制内是尖锐的，在全部 30 个测试格点上把合成转变预测到 ±15% 以内；Pythia-160m SAE 中父-子 decoder 间隙恢复出理论预测的排序，部分相关最高达 -0.93，且在锁定留出集上保持并排除兄弟零假设 (p=0.002)；残差流干预显示带符号的家族方向提升父类别 logits，符号翻转后反转、随机对照下消失。
Conclusion: 特征吸收不是 SAE 的偶然缺陷，而是 L0 惩罚系数越过闭式相界后的代价最优解；父-子 decoder 间隙可作为该相界的可检验代理，并在家族子空间层面具备因果充分性。

papers.title: Spaceborne differential photogrammetry for control-free measurement of large-gradient deformation with structural immunity and a predictable accuracy envelope
papers.abstract_en: Optical satellite image correlation measures wide-area deformation in regimes where coherent interferometric synthetic aperture radar fails because displacement gradients are too large. However, standard pairwise workflows lack a pre-acquisition error budget and rely on extensive stable terrain. We formulate repeat-pass optical correlation as a differential estimation problem without surveyed ground control. Nominal georeferencing defines the coordinate frame, stable-area constraints and displacement priors resolve the datum, and surface displacement is estimated jointly with inter-epoch revisit-bias coefficients. The model yields a predictive accuracy envelope and calibrated per-point posterior uncertainty, bounds along-track uncertainty through a displacement prior, and represents pushbroom jitter using per-line revisit offsets. Simulations and Sentinel-2 and WorldView-2 experiments on the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake, the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake, and the Baltoro glacier validate the predicted noise floor, control-free accuracy margin, and leakage caused by view-angle and digital elevation model errors. The measured noise floor reaches approximately $0.05$ pixel at $10$,m ground sampling distance. With only five stable tiles, conventional destriping changes the estimated Baltoro trunk velocity from $106$ to $1251$myr$^{-1}$, whereas the prior-constrained estimate remains $87$myr$^{-1}$. Closure analysis attributes approximately $88\%$ of pair-error variance to individual scenes, consistent with $25{,}354$ ITS_LIVE glacier-velocity triplets. Three matching methods lead to the same conclusions. The framework therefore turns pairwise correlation into a robust measurement with a predictive error budget, reduced dependence on stable terrain, and conclusions independent of the matching method.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把重复轨道光学影像相关形变测量改写成无需地面控制点的差分估计：名义地理定位定坐标系，稳定区约束与位移先验定基准，位移与跨历元重访偏置系数联合求解，并给出可预测的精度包络与逐点后验不确定度。在 Sentinel-2 与 WorldView-2 的 2019 Ridgecrest、2023 Kahramanmaraş 地震和 Baltoro 冰川实验中，10 m GSD 下噪声底约 0.05 像素；仅用 5 块稳定图幅时常规 destriping 把 Baltoro 干流速度从 106 改到 1251 m/yr，而先验约束估计保持 87 m/yr。
Motivation: 光学卫星影像相关能在形变梯度过大、相干 InSAR 失效的区域测大范围形变，但常规两两流程缺少采集前误差预算，且依赖大片稳定地形，跨历元条带与视角/DEM 误差会直接泄漏进速度估计。
Method: 把重复轨道光学相关表述为无实测控制的差分估计：名义地理定位定义坐标系，稳定区约束与位移先验解算基准，位移与跨历元 revisit-bias 系数联合估计；用位移先验约束沿轨不确定度，以逐行 revisit 偏移表示 pushbroom jitter，并输出预测精度包络与校准的逐点后验不确定度。
Result: 仿真与 Sentinel-2、WorldView-2 实验覆盖 2019 Ridgecrest 地震、2023 Kahramanmaraş 地震和 Baltoro 冰川，验证了预测噪声底、无控制精度余量以及视角与 DEM 误差导致的泄漏。10 m 地面采样距离下实测噪声底约 0.05 像素；仅 5 块稳定图幅时常规 destriping 使 Baltoro 干流速度由 106 变为 1251 m/yr，先验约束估计为 87 m/yr；闭合分析显示约 88% 的配对误差方差来自单景，与 25,354 个 ITS_LIVE 冰川速度三元组一致，三种匹配方法结论相同。
Conclusion: 两两相关可以变成带预测误差预算、对稳定地形依赖更低、且结论与匹配方法无关的稳健测量；跨历元偏置与位移先验是把条带和基准不稳从速度里分离出来的关键。

papers.title: Certified Predictive Value-of-Advice Gating for Cost-Aware Language-Model Guidance in Reinforcement Learning
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Language-model advice can accelerate reinforcement learning, but calls are costly and returned actions may be stale or wrong. We formulate advice acquisition as a response-contingent metareasoning problem: before querying, the controller predicts possible parsed responses, evaluates the decision and declared continuation that would follow each response, and queries only when a lower confidence bound on predictive value exceeds the priced cost. Execution is governed separately by an action-specific certificate. Under explicit assumptions, certified advice is near-optimal, a wrapped learner inherits fallback regret only under intervention stability, and conservative allocation loses at most the declared query-value estimation error relative to a myopic oracle. On BabyAI, a proxy-calibrated controller with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B advisors improves GoToObj return over no querying by 0.029 +/- 0.016 and 0.030 +/- 0.015 across 20 seeds while reducing calls by more than 97% relative to always-query. GoToLocal is a null result. Exactly matched-call tests show an advantage over random placement only for the 1.5B advisor and no advantage over an equal-budget early schedule. Mondrian calibration improves decision-relevant empirical coverage from 0.47 to 0.85, still below the 0.90 target, while the formally covered radius is vacuous. The demonstrated benefit is therefore robust sparse advice volume on a useful task, not a proven per-state placement advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把向语言模型求教建模为响应条件化的元推理 (response-contingent metareasoning)：查询前预测可能的解析响应、评估各响应后的决策与延续，仅当预测价值的置信下界超过定价成本才查询，执行另由动作级 certificate 把关。在 BabyAI 上用 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 顾问，GoToObj 回报较不查询提高 0.029±0.016 与 0.030±0.015（20 seeds），调用减少 97% 以上；GoToLocal 为零结果，等调用预算下仅对 1.5B 顾问胜过随机放置。
Motivation: 语言模型建议能加速强化学习，但每次调用有成本，且返回的动作可能过期或错误，需要在查询前判断是否值得花钱求教。
Method: 将求教建模为响应条件化元推理：控制器先预测可能的解析响应，评估每个响应后会执行的决策与声明的延续，仅当预测价值的置信下界高于定价成本时才查询；执行由独立的动作级 certificate 控制。理论上给出显式假设下 certified advice 近最优、包装学习器仅在干预稳定性下继承 fallback regret、保守分配相对短视 oracle 至多损失声明的查询价值估计误差；实证用 proxy-calibrated 控制器配 Qwen2.5-1.5B 与 7B 顾问，20 seeds。
Result: BabyAI GoToObj 回报较不查询提高 0.029±0.016（1.5B）与 0.030±0.015（7B），20 seeds，调用较 always-query 减少 97% 以上；GoToLocal 为零结果。等调用测试中仅 1.5B 顾问胜过随机放置，对等预算的 early schedule 无优势。Mondrian 校准把决策相关经验覆盖率从 0.47 提到 0.85，仍低于 0.90 目标，形式化覆盖半径为空洞 (vacuous)。
Conclusion: 已证实的收益是稀疏建议量在有用任务上的稳健回报提升，而非逐状态放置优势；后者需要更好的校准与非空的形式化覆盖。

papers.title: Delay-of-Gratification as a Multi-Agent Survival Micro-benchmark for Long-Horizon LLMs: Social Exposure, Personas, and Tool Use Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as multi-turn agents that must sustain goals, use tools, and adapt to other agents over extended interactions. However, existing research lacks auditable, multi-turn, multi-factorial experiments that quantify LLM behavior under explicit constraints, with time-resolved statistics that reveal how behavior unfolds over long horizons. To address this gap, we develop a multi-agent micro-benchmark inspired by the Stanford marshmallow experiment: ReAct agents operate minute-by-minute with a "raise a question" tool under a per-step budget, while we factorially manipulate social context (broadcast vs. isolated), personas (age, hedonic drive), and metacognitive policy (mandatory vs. optional tool use). We analyze outcomes with Kaplan-Meier (KM) survival curves and discrete-time hazard models over a long risk horizon across 19,200 agent trajectories in 64 cells. Behavior shows a sharp early "eat" impulse, and only 75.9% of agents persist to the end. In a discrete-time hazard model, isolation reduces per-minute risk relative to broadcast, whereas a must-use self-questioning policy increases risk. On average, agents ask $\approx 7.12$ questions and hit the per-step budget in $\approx 6\%$ of minutes. Questioning declines faster under broadcast than isolation. Ablation experiments demonstrated that removing hedonic drive and/or persona age increases survival and completion, narrows the broadcast/isolated gap, but leaves the must vs. may ordering intact. The combined ablation (no hedonic + no persona age) yields the highest completion (approaching $1.0$). These results establish delay-of-gratification as a compact, multi-turn interaction benchmark that captures social contagion and tool-use dynamics in LLM agents, providing a reproducible testbed and statistics for analyzing long-horizon, multi-agent behavior.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把斯坦福棉花糖实验改造成多智能体生存微基准：ReAct 智能体按分钟推进、每步有预算地使用 raise a question 工具，因子化操纵社会情境、人设与工具使用策略。19,200 条轨迹中仅 75.9% 存活到最后；隔离比广播降低每分钟风险，强制提问策略反而升高风险，去掉享乐驱动与人设年龄后完成率最高、接近 1.0。
Motivation: 现有研究缺少可审计、多轮、多因子的实验，无法量化 LLM 在显式约束下的行为随长时程展开的时间分辨统计。
Method: 受 Stanford marshmallow experiment 启发构建多智能体微基准：ReAct 智能体逐分钟运行，每步预算内可调用 raise a question 工具；因子化操纵社会情境（broadcast vs. isolated）、人设（年龄、享乐驱动）与元认知策略（mandatory vs. optional 工具使用），共 64 个实验单元、19,200 条轨迹，用 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线与离散时间风险模型 (discrete-time hazard model) 分析，并做消融。
Result: 行为呈现早期急剧的 eat 冲动，仅 75.9% 智能体坚持到最后；离散时间风险模型中隔离相对广播降低每分钟风险，强制自我提问策略升高风险；平均提问约 7.12 次，约 6% 的分钟触及每步预算；提问在广播下比隔离下降更快。消融显示去掉享乐驱动和/或人设年龄提高存活与完成率、缩小广播与隔离差距，但不改变 must 优于 may 的排序；联合消融（无享乐 + 无年龄）完成率最高，接近 1.0。
Conclusion: 延迟满足可作为紧凑的多轮交互基准，同时捕捉 LLM 智能体的社会传染与工具使用动态，为长时程多智能体行为提供可复现的测试台与统计量。

papers.title: Evaluation of Multi-Turn Consistency in LLM Agents: Survival Analysis and Failure-Rationale Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents may perform well on isolated tasks yet drift into inconsistency over extended interaction. We evaluate temporal consistency in a controlled 20-step multi-agent setting inspired by delayed-gratification studies. At each step, an agent chooses between continuing to delay a reward or claiming it immediately (terminating the episode). Across a full-factorial manipulation of social visibility (private vs public), persona stressors, and deliberation policy, we run 84,540 trajectories spanning 8 model families. Treating the first reward-claim as a time-to-event outcome, we estimate Kaplan-Meier survival curves and fit discrete-time hazard regression to quantify how experimental factors shift failure risk over time. Then, to analyze rationales and language patterns associated with failure, we build a seven-category taxonomy from 13,780 deliberation traces from agents who choose to terminate the episode, using an LLM-assisted labeling paired with human audit ($κ=0.83$). Rationale profiles change systematically with time and context: early failures are more impulse-driven, later failures more fatigue- and cost-benefit-framed, while public settings increase norm-oriented justifications. We also find a deliberation-inconsistency association: among failures, longer deliberation correlates with higher rates of intra-rationale contradiction (simultaneous pro-delay and pro-claim statements), challenging the assumption that more reasoning text implies greater consistency. Together, the survival and rationale analyses reveal distinct temporal reliability regimes and model-specific "failure fingerprints", offering an evaluation lens for diagnosing inconsistency in multi-turn agent behavior.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 20 步延迟满足多智能体设定中评估 LLM agent 的时序一致性：84,540 条轨迹、8 个模型族，把首次领取奖励当作 time-to-event，用 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线与离散时间风险回归量化各因素对失败风险的影响，并从 13,780 条 deliberation 轨迹构建七类失败理由分类。早期失败偏冲动、后期偏疲劳与成本收益框架，公共情境增加规范性辩护；失败样本中 deliberation 越长，理由内部自相矛盾（同时支持拖延与领取）比例越高。
Motivation: LLM agent 在单次任务上表现好，但在长程交互中会逐渐漂移为不一致；现有评测缺少把失败发生时间与失败理由语言模式结合起来的诊断视角。
Method: 在受延迟满足研究启发的受控 20 步多智能体设定中做全因子操纵：社会可见性（private vs public）、persona 压力源、deliberation 策略；把首次领取奖励作为 time-to-event 结果，估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线并拟合离散时间风险回归 (discrete-time hazard regression)；再对 13,780 条终止轨迹用 LLM 辅助标注加人工审核（κ=0.83）构建七类理由分类。
Result: 共 84,540 条轨迹、覆盖 8 个模型族；理由分类基于 13,780 条 deliberation 轨迹，人工审核一致性 κ=0.83。理由画像随时间与情境系统变化：早期失败更冲动驱动，后期失败更多疲劳与成本收益框架，公共情境增加规范性辩护；在失败样本中 deliberation 越长，理由内部矛盾（同时出现 pro-delay 与 pro-claim 表述）比例越高。
Conclusion: 生存分析与理由分析共同揭示不同的时序可靠性区间和模型特有的失败指纹，为诊断多轮 agent 行为不一致提供评测视角；更多推理文本并不意味着更高一致性。

papers.title: BLADE: Distilled LLM Regularization for Calibrated Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion models optimize ranking, although many downstream applications require calibrated probabilities. We present BLADE, a variational model that separates latent truth from graph recording and distills offline language-model judgments into a frozen teacher regularizer. The LLM is absent during inference. Posterior samples provide predictive probabilities and epistemic uncertainty, while the compact teacher remains available only as an optional triage factor. Across five benchmarks, BLADE remains competitive under a common ranking protocol and reduces adaptive ECE by a macro-average of 60.1% relative to deep ensembles and 78.1% relative to temperature-scaled RotatE. On identical FB15k-237 candidate sets, BLADE also improves ECE, Brier score, and NLL over validation-selected histogram binning and a matched generative ComplEx2 model, with these improvements persisting on a prespecified near-miss pool. Under controlled injected missingness, the full triage score achieves a mean AUC-PR of 0.863, compared with 0.805 for its strongest non-teacher variant. Leakage stress tests show that aligned semantics matter, but they cannot exclude knowledge acquired during LLM pretraining. We therefore claim calibration only for the declared candidate distributions, not for all unobserved triples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BLADE 是一个知识图谱补全 (KGC) 的变分校准模型：把潜在真值与图的记录过程分开，并把离线 LLM 判断蒸馏成冻结的 teacher 正则项，推理时完全不用 LLM。在五个基准上其自适应 ECE 相对 deep ensemble 宏平均降低 60.1%、相对 temperature-scaled RotatE 降低 78.1%，但校准声明只覆盖声明的候选分布。
Motivation: KGC 模型优化的是排序指标，而下游应用需要校准的概率；直接调用 LLM 做打分又无法在推理时承担成本，且 LLM 预训练带来的知识泄漏会污染校准声明。
Method: BLADE 是变分模型，将潜在真值与图记录过程解耦；用离线 LLM 判断蒸馏出一个冻结的 teacher 正则器（推理时缺席），后验采样给出预测概率与认知不确定性，紧凑 teacher 仅作为可选 triage 因子参与打分；评测用统一排序协议、验证集选择的 histogram binning 与匹配的 generative ComplEx2 作对照，并做受控注入缺失与泄漏压力测试。
Result: 五个基准上自适应 ECE 相对 deep ensemble 宏平均降低 60.1%、相对 temperature-scaled RotatE 降低 78.1%；在相同 FB15k-237 候选集上 ECE、Brier、NLL 均优于验证集选择的 histogram binning 与 ComplEx2，且在预设 near-miss 池上保持；受控注入缺失下完整 triage 分数 AUC-PR 0.863，最强非 teacher 变体 0.805。
Conclusion: 蒸馏式 LLM 正则可以在推理无 LLM 的前提下显著改善 KGC 概率校准，但对齐语义无法排除 LLM 预训练阶段已获得的知识，因此校准只对声明的候选分布成立，不外推到所有未观测三元组。

papers.title: Generalized Graph Variational Autoencoders: Bounded Divergences Control Posterior Collapse
papers.abstract_en: The variational graph autoencoder (VGAE) regularizes its posterior toward the prior with the Kullback-Leibler divergence, a choice inherited from the variational autoencoder rather than argued for. We introduce the generalized graph variational autoencoder (GGVA), which replaces that term with any member of the Rényi-Tsallis family of order $q$ while leaving every other part of the model untouched. Both members admit closed forms for diagonal Gaussians and both recover the KL exactly as $q \to 1$, so the VGAE is the $q=1$ arm of our own model rather than a separate baseline, and any measured difference is attributable to a single scalar. Our analysis identifies boundedness, not the order, as the operative property: for $q<1$ the Tsallis divergence is bounded above by $1/(1-q)$, independently of the latent width, whereas the KL and the Rényi divergence of the same order are unbounded. On ten graphs spanning three synthetic families, a social network, three citation networks, a connectome, a power grid and a road network, $q$ moves the retained posterior information by up to $49\times$ relative to the VGAE, while the Rényi arm at the same order stays within $1.02$-$1.30\times$ of it on all six larger real graphs (isolating the bound as the cause). The retained information is usable: probing the frozen embedding for node class, a label absent from the objective, gives GGVA up to $+0.14$ macro-F1 over the VGAE on CiteSeer, with the Rényi control again tracking the VGAE. We also report what the design was built to expose: none of this reaches held-out link-prediction accuracy on any of the six larger real graphs, and boundedness delays posterior collapse rather than preventing it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 VGAE 的 KL 正则换成 Rényi-Tsallis 家族中任意阶 q 的散度（GGVA），其余结构不动，q=1 时精确退化为 KL。关键性质是有界性而非阶数：q<1 的 Tsallis 散度上界为 1/(1-q)，与隐变量宽度无关。在 10 张图上 q 使保留后验信息相对 VGAE 变化最多 49×，CiteSeer 节点分类 macro-F1 最多 +0.14；但六张较大真实图的留出链路预测精度无一提升，且有界性只是推迟而非阻止 posterior collapse。
Motivation: VGAE 用 KL 把后验拉向先验这一选择是从 VAE 沿袭来的，并未针对图数据论证；而 posterior collapse 会抹掉隐表示中的信息，需要弄清到底是散度的阶数还是有界性在起作用。
Method: 提出 generalized graph variational autoencoder (GGVA)：把 KL 项替换为 Rényi-Tsallis 家族中任意阶 q 的散度，模型其余部分不变；两者对对角高斯都有闭式，且 q→1 时精确回到 KL，因此 VGAE 就是模型的 q=1 分支而非外部基线。分析给出 q<1 时 Tsallis 散度上界 1/(1-q)（与隐宽度无关），并用同阶 Rényi（无界）作为对照隔离有界性这一变量。
Result: 在覆盖三个合成族、一个社交网络、三个引文网络、一个 connectome、一个电网和一个路网的 10 张图上，q 相对 VGAE 使保留后验信息变化最多 49×；同阶 Rényi 分支在全部六张较大真实图上仅落在 VGAE 的 1.02–1.30× 之内，从而把差异归因于有界性。冻结嵌入探测节点类别（目标函数中没有该标签）时，GGVA 在 CiteSeer 上较 VGAE 最多 +0.14 macro-F1，Rényi 对照仍贴着 VGAE。六张较大真实图的留出 link-prediction 精度无一被触及。
Conclusion: 起作用的性质是有界性而不是散度的阶数：有界 Tsallis 项能大幅移动保留的后验信息并改善下游节点分类探针，但只推迟 posterior collapse 而非阻止它，也不带来链路预测收益。
