papers.title: Safe Skill Retirement for Physical Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills bundle procedural guidance with execution conditions governing authority, user consent, and live environment state. When model capabilities advance, maintainers prune instructions that appear redundant on authorized benchmark tasks. However, authorized maintenance tests can leave dormant safety conditions untested. This mismatch creates an unmeasured support gap over physical and privacy-sensitive effects. We introduce matched authority counterfactuals that hold the requested action, tool parameters, and intended effect fixed while systematically varying a single governing predicate. We formalize this evaluation via a two-gate retirement certificate requiring a candidate reduction to preserve authorized utility within a declared margin while producing zero unauthorized protected effects. In controlled experiments spanning four frontier and local model configurations across twelve skill bundles (2,592 evaluation cells), task-certified reductions remove over 94% of skill clauses and preserve authorized completion, yet produce unauthorized protected effects in every bundle. Boundary enforcement eliminates protected effects on the declared audit but fails the utility gate for one configuration. One bounded combined protocol passes both gates across all four configurations, with zero utility headroom. An end-to-end check on one read-only Home Assistant camera chain verifies proposal, decision, and effect measurements on a real device. These results demonstrate that while task benchmarks can justify retiring procedural guidance, retirement decisions require explicitly auditing the authority contracts governing physical actions.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Special Track on AI Alignment of the Forty-First AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27); currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 技能修剪只在授权基准上验证会让休眠的安全条件漏检：作者提出匹配权威反事实（matched authority counterfactuals）与双门退役证书（two-gate retirement certificate），要求候选删减在声明裕度内保住授权效用且零未授权受保护效应。在 4 个前沿/本地模型配置 × 12 个技能包共 2,592 个评估单元上，任务认证的删减移除超过 94% 的技能条款并保持授权完成，却在每个技能包都产生未授权受保护效应；边界强制在声明审计上消除受保护效应但对一个配置过不了效用门，只有一个有界组合协议在全部 4 个配置上双门全过且效用裕度为零。
Motivation: 维护者在授权基准任务上修剪看似冗余的指令，但授权维护测试不会触发休眠的安全条件，从而在物理与隐私敏感效应上留下未度量的支持缺口。
Method: 构造匹配权威反事实：固定请求动作、工具参数与预期效应，只系统改变单个管辖谓词；用双门退役证书形式化评估，第一门要求候选删减在声明裕度内保持授权效用，第二门要求零未授权受保护效应；实验覆盖 4 个前沿与本地模型配置、12 个技能包，并在只读 Home Assistant 摄像头链上做端到端核查。
Result: 共 2,592 个评估单元：任务认证的删减移除超过 94% 的技能条款并保持授权完成，但在每个技能包都产生未授权受保护效应；边界强制在声明审计上消除受保护效应，却对一个配置过不了效用门；一个有界组合协议在全部 4 个配置上通过双门，效用裕度为零；只读 Home Assistant 摄像头链的端到端核查验证了提案、决策与效应测量。
Conclusion: 任务基准可以支持删减程序性指令，但退役决策必须显式审计管辖物理动作的权威契约，否则删减会在每个技能包上产生未授权效应。

papers.title: GeoRefer-Bench: A Benchmark from Referring Pixels to Verifiable Geospatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Referring segmentation in overhead imagery is inherently relational: a query may ask for the buildings north of the road or the pond closest to a residential area, so the correct referent can contain one object, several objects, or none. Existing benchmarks mainly score mask overlap, which cannot verify whether a model actually resolved the stated spatial relation. We introduce GeoRefer-Bench, a benchmark for verifiable geospatial referring segmentation. Each query is represented by an executable logical form over a metric scene graph, and predictions are evaluated with Exact Query Success (EQS), which is satisfied only when the returned instance set exactly matches the set denoted by the query. GeoRefer-Bench contains 700 whole 2048x2048 UAV scenes (2.94 Gpx) at 12.5 and 25 cm ground sampling distance, 26,217 instances, 142,796 spatial relations, and 20,916 executable queries spanning five reasoning levels. It further includes three paraphrases per query, 24.0% unanswerable queries, 2,477 counterfactual pairs, and five leakage-controlled evaluation splits. An independent audit re-derives object geometry, mask ownership, relation values, query execution, and split provenance, finding zero issues across all 700 scenes. Relation-blind strategies can retain non-trivial mIoU while achieving at most 22.7 EQS overall, showing that overlap alone does not certify relational grounding. Across fifteen current models, the strongest reaches 74.1 EQS but drops from 98.9 at level 1 to 60.5 at level 5, while ten models score below 5 EQS on two-hop queries. GeoRefer-Bench turns geospatial referring segmentation from mask matching into verifiable reference resolution.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Code, data, and evaluation tools are available at https://github.com/anticipate218/GeoRefer-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoRefer-Bench 把俯视影像指代分割从 mask 重叠评测改为可执行逻辑形式上的 Exact Query Success (EQS)：查询在度量场景图上执行，返回实例集完全一致才算成功。关系盲策略可保住不低的 mIoU 但 EQS 最高只有 22.7；十五个模型中最强者 EQS 74.1，却从 level 1 的 98.9 掉到 level 5 的 60.5，十个模型在两跳查询上低于 5 EQS。
Motivation: 现有俯视影像指代分割基准只算 mask 重叠，无法判定模型是否真的解出了查询中声明的空间关系，而正确指代对象可能是一个、多个或零个目标。
Method: 每条查询表示为度量场景图 (metric scene graph) 上的可执行逻辑形式，评测用 Exact Query Success (EQS)，仅当返回实例集与查询指代集完全一致才计成功；数据为 700 张 2048x2048 UAV 全景 (2.94 Gpx)，GSD 12.5 与 25 cm，含五个推理层级、每查询三条改写、24.0% 不可答查询、2,477 个反事实对与五个防泄漏划分，并由独立审计复算几何、mask 归属、关系值、查询执行与划分来源。
Result: 数据规模：26,217 个实例、142,796 条空间关系、20,916 条可执行查询；独立审计在全部 700 个场景中发现零问题。关系盲策略可保留非平凡 mIoU 但整体 EQS 至多 22.7。十五个模型中最强 EQS 74.1，从 level 1 的 98.9 降至 level 5 的 60.5；十个模型在两跳 (two-hop) 查询上 EQS 低于 5。
Conclusion: 仅凭 mask 重叠不能证明关系落地 (relational grounding)，GeoRefer-Bench 把俯视指代分割变成可验证的指代消解问题；多跳空间推理是当前模型的主要短板。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Clinical Knowledge Graphs for Chest X-Ray Device Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Chest radiographs are routinely used to verify the position of catheters, tubes, and other support devices. Existing image models often return labels or segmentations, while report-processing systems structure text without access to image geometry. We present an uncertainty-aware clinical knowledge graph that represents device instances, tip estimates, placement assessments, provenance, report events, and temporal links as separate but connected evidence. We evaluate the implemented visual graph layer using saved predictions from the complete RANZCR CLiP test archive, comprising 30,083 studies from 3,255 patients across five non-overlapping outer folds. The graph builder materializes 914,632 B7 evidence nodes and 884,549 typed relationships. All 118,647 B7 predicted-device nodes retain tip covariance, placement probabilities, fragment provenance, and fragment counts, whereas the direct B2 baseline retains none of these fields. We further define typed data contracts, uncertainty representations, abstention rules, report-image grounding, and longitudinal query mechanisms for extending the graph to report-bearing cohorts. The reported graph-materialization analysis is post-hoc descriptive and does not establish report grounding, longitudinal performance, or clinical utility. It demonstrates a reproducible foundation for evidence-preserving AI reasoning over chest X-ray device assessments.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Post-hoc descriptive analysis on archived RANZCR CLiP test predictions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向胸片导管/导管尖端判读的不确定性感知临床知识图谱，把器械实例、尖端估计、置位判断、来源、报告事件与时间链接拆成相互连接的证据节点。在 RANZCR CLiP 完整测试存档（30,083 例研究、3,255 名患者、5 个外层折）上物化出 914,632 个 B7 证据节点与 884,549 条类型化关系，118,647 个 B7 预测器械节点全部保留尖端协方差与置位概率，而直接 B2 基线一个都不保留。
Motivation: 现有影像模型只输出标签或分割，报告处理系统只结构化文本却拿不到图像几何，器械判读的证据链与不确定性在两套流程之间断裂。
Method: 构建不确定性感知临床知识图谱，节点承载器械实例、尖端估计及其协方差、置位概率、片段来源与片段计数，边为类型化关系；另定义类型化数据契约、不确定性表示、弃权规则、报告-图像 grounding 与纵向查询机制，用已存预测做事后描述性分析。
Result: 在 RANZCR CLiP 完整测试存档（30,083 例研究、3,255 名患者、5 个不重叠外层折）上，图构建物化 914,632 个 B7 证据节点与 884,549 条类型化关系；118,647 个 B7 预测器械节点全部保留尖端协方差、置位概率、片段来源与片段计数，直接 B2 基线全部缺失这些字段。
Conclusion: 该分析是事后描述性的，只证明图物化本身可复现、能保全证据，不构成报告 grounding、纵向性能或临床效用的证据。

papers.title: A Corpus of Real Scam- and Spam-Call Conversations from an Active Voice-Agent Honeypot
papers.abstract_en: Real conversations between fraudsters and their targets are among the most informative artifacts for studying telephone scams, yet also the scarcest: passive honeypots overwhelmingly capture automated messages and hang-ups, large-scale studies characterize call metadata rather than dialogue, and manual scam-baiting does not scale. We present a dataset of real scam-call conversations collected by an active voice-agent honeypot. Dedicated numbers are seeded into the lead-generation channels fraud operations harvest; inbound callers are answered by a low-latency conversational agent that adopts a plausible target persona and sustains the interaction while every call is recorded, transcribed, and automatically labeled. Over an initial 53-day window we captured 10,015 inbound scam and spam calls (6,601 with two or more turns): roughly 895 hours of audio and 328,869 transcribed turns from 5,665 distinct originating numbers. Under a holistic classifier the substantive calls are predominantly predatory-but-legal lead generation ("spam", about three in five), while about one in seven is an outright "scam" (949 in this snapshot). Each call carries a turn-level transcript, three-channel audio, per-turn latency telemetry, and layers of automatic labels, including a holistic scam/spam/legitimate judgment corroborated by independent human review (75% agreement on the binary decision). We describe the collection system, the record structure, and technical validation of the corpus's realism and label quality, including that the agent is recognized as non-human in only about 5% of engaged calls. We also benchmark established scam-detection methods, where detectors trained on published synthetic dialogue collapse in precision on real traffic.

TL;DR: 用主动语音代理蜜罐 (active voice-agent honeypot) 把号码种进诈骗团伙收割的获客渠道，由低延迟对话代理扮演可信受害者身份把真实诈骗电话拖成长对话，53 天内采到 10,015 通来电、约 895 小时音频与 328,869 轮转写。整体分类器判定实质来电以 predatory-but-legal 的 lead generation（约五分之三）为主，约七分之一是 outright scam（949 通）；在该真实语料上，用已发表合成对话训练的诈骗检测器 precision 崩塌。
Motivation: 研究电话诈骗最需要的是骗子与目标的真实对话，但被动蜜罐多是自动语音与挂断，大规模研究只刻画通话元数据，人工 scam-baiting 又无法规模化，真实对话语料极度稀缺。
Method: 把专用号码投放到诈骗运营收割的 lead-generation 渠道，入站来电由低延迟对话代理以可信受害者身份应答并维持交互；全程录音、转写并自动打标，标签含 holistic 的 scam/spam/legitimate 判定并经独立人工复核，另附逐轮延迟遥测与三声道音频。作者还对既有 scam-detection 方法做基准测试。
Result: 53 天窗口捕获 10,015 通 inbound scam/spam 来电，其中 6,601 通含两轮以上，约 895 小时音频、328,869 个转写轮次、来自 5,665 个不同主叫号。整体分类器下实质来电约五分之三为 spam、约七分之一为 scam（本快照 949 通）；二元判定上自动标签与独立人工复核一致率 75%，参与通话中代理仅约 5% 被识别为非人类。在合成对话上训练的已发表诈骗检测器于真实流量上 precision 崩塌。
Conclusion: 真实诈骗对话可以用主动语音代理蜜罐规模化采集，且语料真实度与标签质量足以支撑检测方法基准；核心警示是合成对话训练出的检测器迁移到真实来电时 precision 会崩塌。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CoSWA-YOLOv12: Scale-Invariant Tiny Object Detection and Segmentation of Malaria Parasites
papers.abstract_en: Automated microscopy could widen access to malaria diagnosis in low-resource settings, but the deadliest species, P. falciparum, presents in its early ring stage as an object only a few tens of pixels wide. Such tiny targets are systematically under-detected: overlap-based label assignment starves them of positive samples, and overlap-based box regression gives weak gradients at their scale. The Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance (NWD) repairs both effects, but applied uniformly across a slide that also holds objects three to four times larger it loosens their supervision and erodes their localisation, so overall accuracy can fall even as the tiny class improves. We present CoSWA-YOLOv12, a compact YOLOv12 instance-segmentation detector whose core Cooperative Scale-adaptive Wasserstein Assignment routes the Wasserstein treatment to an object in inverse proportion to its size, tapering back to standard assignment for larger species. Two further components support it: a wavelet detail residual, and a min-max Gaussian regression loss (M2-NWD). All three additions are transfer-safe: each reproduces the standard pretrained model exactly at initialisation, so public pretrained weights load without any loss of accuracy. On a five-class Rwandan thick-smear dataset, CoSWA-YOLOv12 raises P. falciparum recall from 0.63 to 0.74 and mAP@50 from 0.73 to 0.81 (mask), cuts missed P. falciparum from 38% to 15%, and improves strict-localisation mAP@50-95 on all five classes for both detection and segmentation, while a 2x2 ablation shows the scale gate and the regression loss are synergistic.
papers.comment: Accepted at The 3rd MIRASOL workshop, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoSWA-YOLOv12 把 Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance (NWD) 按目标尺寸反比路由（Cooperative Scale-adaptive Wasserstein Assignment），对几像素宽的 P. falciparum 早期环状体保留 Wasserstein 监督、对大目标退回标准 assignment，另加小波细节残差与 min-max 高斯回归损失 (M2-NWD)。在卢旺达五类厚血膜数据集上 P. falciparum recall 从 0.63 升到 0.74、mask mAP@50 从 0.73 升到 0.81，漏检率从 38% 降到 15%。
Motivation: 重叠式标签分配与框回归在几十像素级目标上样本饥饿、梯度微弱，导致微小目标系统性漏检；但统一施加 NWD 又会放松同片上大三到四倍目标的监督、侵蚀其定位精度。
Method: 在紧凑型 YOLOv12 实例分割检测器上加入三个组件：按目标尺寸反比分配 Wasserstein 处理的 Cooperative Scale-adaptive Wasserstein Assignment、小波细节残差 (wavelet detail residual)、min-max 高斯回归损失 M2-NWD；三者在初始化时精确复现标准预训练模型，公开预训练权重可无损加载。
Result: 在五类卢旺达厚血膜 (thick-smear) 数据集上，P. falciparum recall 0.63 → 0.74，mask mAP@50 0.73 → 0.81，P. falciparum 漏检率 38% → 15%；严格定位 mAP@50-95 在全部五类的检测与分割上均提升；2x2 消融显示 scale gate 与回归损失具有协同作用。
Conclusion: 把 Wasserstein 监督按尺寸门控、只施加给微小目标，可在不牺牲大目标定位的前提下修复 tiny object 的漏检与弱梯度，且三个改动均 transfer-safe、可直接套用公开预训练权重。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Common Covariance Geometry and Certification for Brownian Kernel Ladders
papers.abstract_en: A representation-adaptive kernel class produces, on a fixed sample, a union of reproducing-kernel Hilbert-space ellipsoids rather than one ellipsoid. We introduce the minimum-trace common covariance that dominates the unrestricted empirical union generated by Brownian kernel ladders and develop its statistical, approximation-theoretic, and computational consequences. The covariance value admits exact formulations through absolutely two-summing operators and covariance-dominated multipliers, and it yields a universal Gaussian-complexity bound. A closed last-layer Dirac-trace reduction and a signed Brownian threshold representation convert the generic covariance problem into threshold, graph-coarea, and effective-resistance geometry. These tools give deterministic depth laws, conditional Gaussian reverses, random-design and perturbation transfers, and an exact empirical Kolmogorov-width formula whose leading covariance eigenspaces approximate the complete adaptive ball simultaneously. Finite contact, active semidefinite programs, verified separation, and a convex resistance-design relaxation provide complementary lower and upper certificates. A finite covariance-indexed Brownian path on frozen representations illustrates the distinction between successful covariance certification and predictive selection: all reported path certificates succeed, whereas the locked predictive study misses one predeclared aggregate criterion. The paper thereby identifies one finite-dimensional covariance object linking unrestricted kernel adaptation, Gaussian geometry, common subspaces, and certifiable computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出表示自适应 Brownian kernel ladder 类在固定样本上生成的是 RKHS 椭球的并集而非单一椭球，并定义支配该并集的最小迹公共协方差 (minimum-trace common covariance)。该协方差可用 absolutely two-summing 算子与 covariance-dominated multiplier 给出精确刻画并导出通用 Gaussian-complexity 界，再经 Dirac-trace 降维与 signed Brownian threshold 表示转化为 threshold、graph-coarea、有效电阻几何，给出确定性深度律与精确经验 Kolmogorov-width 公式。有限协方差索引 Brownian 路径示例中全部报告的路径证书成功，而锁定的预测研究有一项预先声明的聚合判据未通过。
Motivation: 表示自适应核在固定样本上产生椭球并集，单一经验协方差无法支配它，导致适应性界的认证与预测选择混在一起、缺少可计算的公共几何对象。
Method: 定义支配 Brownian kernel ladder 生成的无限制经验并集的最小迹公共协方差；用 absolutely two-summing 算子与 covariance-dominated multiplier 给出精确刻画并导出通用 Gaussian-complexity 界；通过末层 Dirac-trace 归约与 signed Brownian threshold 表示把协方差问题转成 threshold、graph-coarea、有效电阻几何，导出确定性深度律、条件 Gaussian 逆向界、random-design 与扰动迁移，以及精确经验 Kolmogorov-width 公式；用有限接触、活跃半正定规划、verified separation 与凸电阻设计松弛给出上下证书。
Result: 有限协方差索引 Brownian 路径示例中，所有报告的路径证书均成功，而锁定的预测研究未通过一项预先声明的聚合判据；给出精确经验 Kolmogorov-width 公式，其领先协方差特征子空间同时逼近完整自适应球。
Conclusion: 一个有限维协方差对象可以同时连接无限制核适应、Gaussian 几何、公共子空间与可认证计算，并把协方差认证与预测选择明确区分开。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Stale Does Not Mean Unsafe: Guard Precision for Tool-Using LLM Agents under Infrastructure State Races
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly mutate schedulers, data pipelines, object stores, and access-control systems. Between an agent's read and its commit, external state can change, but not every change makes the commit unsafe. We separate invalidating races, which break a declared safety predicate, from predicate-preserving and irrelevant races, and ask how precisely runtime guards distinguish them. Our deterministic simulator separates visible from authoritative state and injects five non-atomic failure mechanisms across 16 infrastructure tasks in four domains; frozen agent proposals are replayed counterfactually under every controller without an LLM judge. We evaluate three commit-time guard granularities (global epoch, read-set version, semantic commit predicate), multi-level verification, and model-side gates on three locally hosted quantized model families (Qwen3-4B, Phi-4-mini, Gemma4-8B; 3,456 trajectories on one GPU). All three guards eliminate unsafe commits, but their availability differs sharply: freshness-based guards needlessly block 92-95% of benign races, forfeiting up to 43% of safe task completions, while the complete predicate guard blocks none. That precision is contract-dependent: deleting a single declared clause converts exactly its fault family into unsafe commits (up to 7.9%). Model-side signals do not substitute: verbal confidence is miscalibrated (ECE approximately 0.37), action agreement matches a random gate, a cautionary prompt leaves the direct unsafe rate essentially unchanged, and after a freshness-guard block agents re-commit unsafely from refreshed but still-incomplete reads. Under degraded telemetry a hidden concurrent mutation remains observationally clean, bounding every selective policy. Precise runtime enforcement therefore requires semantic contracts, not freshness heuristics or model self-assessment.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在工具型 LLM agent 读写之间的基础设施状态竞争中，区分破坏安全谓词的失效竞争与保持谓词的良性竞争，只有语义级 commit 谓词守卫能做到。确定性模拟器在 16 个基础设施任务上回放 3,456 条轨迹：三种守卫都能消除不安全提交，但基于新鲜度的守卫把 92–95% 的良性竞争也拦下、最多损失 43% 的安全完成，而语义谓词守卫一个都不拦。
Motivation: agent 在 read 与 commit 之间外部状态会变，但并非每次变化都使提交不安全；现有基于新鲜度的守卫无法区分失效竞争与良性竞争，会大量误拦安全操作。
Method: 构建确定性模拟器，分离可见状态与权威状态，注入五种非原子失效机制，覆盖四个领域 16 个基础设施任务；冻结的 agent 提案在每个控制器下做反事实回放，不使用 LLM judge。评估三种 commit 时守卫粒度（global epoch、read-set version、semantic commit predicate）、多级验证与 model-side gate，模型为本地量化部署的 Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini、Gemma4-8B，单卡 3,456 条轨迹。
Result: 三种守卫都消除不安全提交；freshness 守卫无谓拦截 92–95% 良性竞争，最多放弃 43% 的安全任务完成，完整谓词守卫拦截为 0。删掉单条声明子句会把对应故障族转为不安全提交，最高 7.9%。model-side 信号不可替代：verbal confidence 的 ECE 约 0.37，action agreement 与随机门相当，cautionary prompt 基本不改变直接不安全率；freshness 拦截后 agent 会从已刷新但仍不完整的读再次不安全提交。遥测降级时隐藏并发变更观测上无痕迹，构成对任何选择性策略的上界。
Conclusion: 精确的运行时强制需要语义契约，freshness 启发式与模型自我评估都替代不了；守卫精度取决于声明契约的完整性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sample-Weighted End-to-End Trace-Norm Geometry for Multitask Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multitask models combine a shared representation with task-specific outputs, but generalization bounds often control the two components separately. Such products can discard relative orientation and cancellation and can change under equivalent transformations of intermediate coordinates even when the represented predictors are unchanged. We study instead the sample-size-weighted trace norm of the end-to-end map from task coefficients to input-space predictors. For its fixed-radius class, we derive the exact empirical Rademacher complexity. The same quantity is characterized by eliminating a positive-definite task covariance after the representation acts and, in finite-dimensional intermediate spaces, by optimizing the separated product over all equivalent invertible refactorizations. Explicit constructions show unbounded orientation and factorization gaps and an exponential depth gap for cancelling linear layers. As a geometric application, finite-to-one Lipschitz shared maps yield an exact Sobolev task Gram matrix determined by multiplicity and local directional distortion. We evaluate the corresponding convex regularizer in two protocol-locked unseen suites. Across 252 paired held-out comparisons, weighted joint nuclear regularization improves average population excess over unweighted nuclear regularization by 0.00764, with a stratified-bootstrap 95% interval [0.00465, 0.01110]. Correct task counts improve average and least-sampled-quartile excess over shifted counts by 0.01072 and 0.02847; all 15 imbalanced rank-suite cells are positive and the balanced effect is zero. Weighted joint nuclear also outperforms weighted Frobenius and independent ridge. The least-sampled-quartile comparison with unweighted nuclear remains unresolved, delimiting rather than contradicting the average advantage. All seven predeclared gates pass.

TL;DR: 论文研究多任务学习中端到端映射的样本加权迹范数 (sample-weighted trace norm) 几何：对固定半径类推导精确经验 Rademacher 复杂度，并证明分离乘积形式在等价可逆重构下存在无界的朝向与分解间隙、对相消线性层存在指数深度间隙。在 252 组配对留出比较中，加权联合核正则相对非加权核正则把平均 population excess 改善 0.00764（分层 bootstrap 95% 区间 [0.00465, 0.01110]），正确任务计数相对偏移计数改善 0.01072 与最欠采样四分位 0.02847。
Motivation: 多任务泛化界通常把共享表示与任务特定输出的复杂度分开控制，这种乘积形式会丢掉相对朝向与相消信息，且在中间坐标等价变换下会改变数值，即使所表示的预测子不变。
Method: 研究从任务系数到输入空间预测子的端到端映射的样本量加权迹范数：对固定半径类推导精确经验 Rademacher 复杂度；通过消去表示作用后的正定任务协方差刻画同一量，并在有限维中间空间上把分离乘积在所有等价可逆重构上优化。作为几何应用，有限对一 Lipschitz 共享映射给出由重数与局部方向畸变决定的精确 Sobolev 任务 Gram 矩阵，并据此构造凸正则项在两个 protocol-locked 未见测试套件上评估。
Result: 252 组配对留出比较中，加权联合核正则相对非加权核正则平均 population excess 改善 0.00764，分层 bootstrap 95% 区间 [0.00465, 0.01110]；正确任务计数相对偏移计数在平均与最欠采样四分位上分别改善 0.01072 与 0.02847，15 个不平衡 rank-suite 单元全部为正且平衡效应为零；加权联合核还优于加权 Frobenius 与独立 ridge，全部 7 个预声明 gate 通过。最欠采样四分位上与非加权核的比较仍未解决。
Conclusion: 端到端加权迹范数几何给出的凸正则项在平均意义上优于非加权核正则与 Frobenius/ridge 形式，但最欠采样四分位上的优势未定，作者据此把结论界定为平均优势而非全面优势。

papers.title: BiGraph-Diffuse: A Bidirectional Diffusion Language Model with Graph-Structured Retrieval For Mental Health Counseling
papers.abstract_en: Mental health disorders affect hundreds of millions of people around the world, yet access to professional counseling remains severely limited. AI-powered dialogue systems offer a scalable alternative, but existing models face two fundamental challenges. First, they lack the bidirectional understanding needed to capture the layered nature of emotional expression, particularly in cases of progressive disclosure, where clients often present symptoms at the surface-level while concealing deeper trauma. Autoregressive (AR) models process information sequentially and cannot revise early interpretations when new evidence emerges later in the conversation. Second, they fail to effectively incorporate the relational knowledge that underlies clinical reasoning. In this paper, we propose \textbf{BiGraph-Diffuse}, the first large-scale diffusion language model tailored for the counseling domain. We further introduce \textbf{BiGraph-RAG}, a relation-free graph-structured retrieval strategy that relies only on lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. This design preserves inferential pathways from observable symptoms to potential underlying causes, while incurring zero LLM token cost during indexing. Importantly, these two modules are not merely combined but mutually reinforcing. The diffusion model provides a holistic bidirectional context, enabling the system to defer premature judgments during progressive disclosure. Meanwhile, graph-based retrieval captures the structured interconnections of clinical knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BiGraph-Diffuse, and we further provide a solid theoretical analysis to support its design.
papers.comment: submit to ieee transactions on affective computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向心理咨询的双向扩散语言模型 BiGraph-Diffuse，配合只用轻量实体抽取与语义链接的图结构检索 BiGraph-RAG，让模型在来访者渐进披露时推迟过早判断、并保留从表层症状到潜在病因的推理路径。摘要称实验验证了有效性并给出理论分析，但未列具体指标数字。
Motivation: 自回归对话模型无法在新证据出现后回改早期解读，也难以纳入临床推理所依赖的关系知识，因而在渐进披露式心理咨询中容易过早下判断。
Method: BiGraph-Diffuse 是首个面向咨询领域的大规模扩散语言模型，提供整体双向上下文；BiGraph-RAG 是 relation-free 的图结构检索策略，仅依赖轻量实体抽取与语义链接，索引阶段零 LLM token 开销；两模块互相增强，并附理论分析支撑设计。
Result: 摘要称大量实验 (extensive experiments) 证明了 BiGraph-Diffuse 的有效性，并给出理论分析，但未列出任何具体指标、数据集或基线数值。
Conclusion: 扩散式双向理解加关系图检索可作为心理咨询对话系统的设计路径，用以在渐进披露中延迟判断并保留症状到病因的推理链。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CataOPD: Catalytic On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD) are two representative paradigms for improving large language model reasoning. However, when no correct trajectory is sampled, RL lacks a positive correctness signal, while OPD remains constrained by the reasoning trajectories reachable under the student's on-policy distribution. Therefore, we propose CataOPD, where the teacher acts as a catalyst rather than a target, expanding reachability while internalizing verified student-produced trajectories into a catalyst-free policy. Self-Rescue Routing uses empirically all-failed groups as routing signals rather than teacher-intervention triggers, first seeking correct trajectories through additional on-policy self-sampling. For problems unresolved after self-rescue, Catalytic-Guided Self-Resolution uses catalytic guidance to elicit a verified student-produced trajectory in the guided student distribution. Barrier-Weighted Internalization weights tokens by guided-to-unguided log-probability gaps, focusing updates on decisive tokens difficult without guidance. Experimental results show that CataOPD outperforms current baselines, extends independent student reasoning to still-unrecovered problems, and improves out-of-distribution generalization under catalyst-free inference. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/CataOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CataOPD 把教师当作催化剂而非模仿目标：先用经验上全错的题组触发额外 on-policy 自采样（Self-Rescue Routing），仍未解出的题再用催化引导产出可验证的学生轨迹（Catalytic-Guided Self-Resolution），最后按引导与非引导 log-prob 差加权 token 做内化（Barrier-Weighted Internalization）。实验显示其优于现有基线，并把独立学生推理扩展到自采样仍未恢复的题目，同时提升无催化剂推理下的分布外泛化。
Motivation: RL 在采不到正确轨迹时缺少正向正确性信号，而 OPD 被学生 on-policy 分布可达的推理轨迹限制住，两者都卡在“没有正确轨迹可用”这一点上。
Method: 三段式：Self-Rescue Routing 把经验上全错的题组当作路由信号，先追加 on-policy 自采样寻找正确轨迹；对自采样仍失败的题，Catalytic-Guided Self-Resolution 在引导的学生分布中激发一条可验证的学生产出轨迹；Barrier-Weighted Internalization 按引导与非引导 log-probability 差给 token 加权，把更新集中在无引导时难以做对的关键 token 上，最终得到无催化剂策略。
Result: 实验结果表明 CataOPD 优于当前基线，把独立学生推理扩展到自采样仍未恢复的问题，并在无催化剂推理下改善分布外 (OOD) 泛化；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 教师作为催化剂（扩大可达性并内化已验证的学生轨迹）比把教师当模仿目标更能突破 RL 与 OPD 各自的信号/分布瓶颈，且收益在去掉催化剂后仍保留。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaPilot: Towards Scene-Adaptive Policy Learning for Cross-Generator Text-to-Image Quality Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for improving text-to-image generation quality have progressed from generator fine-tuning and prompt optimization to reinforcement learning with multi-turn visual feedback. However, existing strategies are deeply coupled with specific generators and tasks, and the learned capabilities are difficult to generalize into a universal quality optimization policy. Therefore, we propose AdaPilot, which learns a scene-adaptive, cross-generator transferable quality optimization policy by formulating multi-turn image generation as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and optimizing it via end-to-end reinforcement learning. Specifically, AdaPilot decouples the policy from generator internals to enable cross-generator transfer, introduces scene-aware rewards that adaptively align quality assessment dimensions with task semantics, and employs process-level rewards to model the evolution trajectory of image quality. Experimental results show AdaPilot outperforms baselines in generation quality and generalization. Separate cross-generator evaluations further show that a single policy transfers zero-shot to unseen generators while maintaining positive average gains across all evaluated generators. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQing/Ada_pilot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaPilot 把多轮文生图生成建模为 MDP，用端到端强化学习训练一个与生成器内部解耦的场景自适应质量优化策略，配合场景感知奖励与过程级奖励。实验中它在生成质量与泛化上超过基线，单一策略可零样本迁移到未见过的生成器，并在所有被测生成器上保持正的平均增益。
Motivation: 现有文生图质量提升方法（生成器微调、prompt 优化、多轮视觉反馈强化学习）与特定生成器和任务深度耦合，学到的能力难以泛化为通用的质量优化策略。
Method: 将多轮图像生成表述为 MDP 并用端到端强化学习优化；策略与生成器内部解耦以支持跨生成器迁移；引入 scene-aware rewards 按任务语义自适应对齐质量评估维度，并用 process-level rewards 刻画图像质量的演化轨迹。
Result: 实验结果显示 AdaPilot 在生成质量与泛化上优于基线；单独的跨生成器评测表明单一策略可零样本迁移到未见过的生成器，并在所有被测生成器上保持正的平均增益。
Conclusion: 把策略与生成器解耦并配合场景感知与过程级奖励，可以得到跨生成器可迁移的文生图质量优化策略，零样本迁移仍带来正增益。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Operator Surrogate for 2D Magnetohydrodynamic Reconnection
papers.abstract_en: Direct numerical simulation of magnetic reconnection is limited by the scale separation of resistive magnetohydrodynamics. At large Lundquist numbers $S$ the current layer thins as $S^{-1/2}$, forcing fine grids and short time steps that make parameter scans prohibitively expensive. Deep learning neural operators offer an alternative by learning the map between function spaces rather than individual solutions, so that a single trained model returns the state for any parameter and time at inference cost. We have developed a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) based Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) surrogate for two-dimensional compressible, viscous, resistive reconnection in a wall bounded domain. We condition on the initial state, the Lundquist number, and a continuous query time. Predicting the magnetic flux function makes $\grad\!\cdot\!\bB=0$ exact, direct time queries remove autoregressive error accumulation, and parity-aware spectral differentiation matches the wall treatment of the reference solver. Trained across $10^{3}\le S\le2\times10^{5}$ with two values withheld, the surrogate recovers density, pressure, and guide field to better than $0.2\%$, velocity to $3.2$ to $3.9\%$, the flux function to $1.0\%$, and the spectral current density to $7.5\%$. It resolves the thin, narrow current sheet, Alfvénic jets, and spectral resolution beyond mode cutoff. Our surrogate reproduces the layer-averaged reconnection rate to within $3\%$ through $S=1.1\times10^{4}$, recovering a reconnection time exponent of $0.497$ consistent with Sweet-Parker scaling. When queried zero-shot on the $2049^{2}$ solver mesh, a full trajectory run is on the order of seconds on one GPU against several hours for the DNS, over two orders of magnitude faster, establishing learned operators as a practical route to surveying reconnection across parameter space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对电阻磁流体 (resistive MHD) 磁重联直接数值模拟在高 Lundquist 数 S 下电流层按 S^{-1/2} 变薄、参数扫描代价过高的问题，提出以 Fourier Neural Operator 为骨干的 Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) 代理模型，条件为初始态、S 与连续查询时间。在 10^3≤S≤2×10^5 训练并留出两个 S 值的设置下，密度/压力/导引场误差优于 0.2%，速度 3.2–3.9%，磁通函数 1.0%，谱电流密度 7.5%；层平均重联率误差在 S=1.1×10^4 内保持 3% 以内，恢复 0.497 的重联时间指数，与 Sweet-Parker 标度一致。
Motivation: 高 Lundquist 数下电流层变薄迫使 DNS 使用极细网格与极短时间步，参数扫描代价高到不可行；需要一个推理时代价极低、又能跨参数与时间查询的代理。
Method: 以 FNO 为骨干构建 PINO 代理，条件输入为初始状态、Lundquist 数 S 与连续查询时间；预测磁通函数以保证 ∇·B=0 精确，用直接时间查询避免自回归误差累积，并采用 parity-aware 谱微分匹配参考求解器的壁面处理。训练覆盖 10^3≤S≤2×10^5 并留出两个 S 值，任务为二维可压缩、粘性、电阻重联（壁面有界域）。
Result: 留出 S 上：密度、压力、导引场误差优于 0.2%，速度 3.2–3.9%，磁通函数 1.0%，谱电流密度 7.5%；层平均重联率在 S=1.1×10^4 内再现到 3% 以内，恢复重联时间指数 0.497，与 Sweet-Parker 标度一致。零样本查询 2049^2 求解器网格时，单 GPU 上完整轨迹约数秒，而 DNS 需数小时，快两个数量级以上。
Conclusion: 学习到的神经算子可作为扫描重联参数空间的实用路径：在保持重联率与标度指数精度的同时，把单次轨迹代价从数小时降到秒级。

papers.title: Spectral-Guided Diffusion: Accelerating Inference via Static Spectral Layer Scheduling
authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion inference repeatedly evaluates the same large network. We ask whether pretrained weights alone can identify residual branches that need not be recomputed throughout the trajectory. Our \textbf{Spectral Concentration Ratio (SCR)} measures leading-versus-tail singular-value energy. Combined with Frobenius magnitude, it yields an offline sensitivity proxy and a deterministic lifetime for each scheduled unit. A frozen unit reuses its cached residual-branch update while the current residual stream and all external conditioning continue to propagate. The method needs no router, calibration prompts, or input-dependent search. At matched layer-step budgets, SCR/Frobenius preserves quality better than random, depth, norm, stable-rank, and Frobenius--stable-rank schedules on LLaDA-8B, DiT-XL/2, U-ViT-L, and SDXL. Broader LLaDA tests cover retrieval, reasoning, code, summarization, and open-ended generation; matched-horizon controls retain the ranking down to ten denoising steps. The complete captured-graph system reaches $2.8\times$--$3.0\times$ wall-clock speedup over eager inference. This is a systems-level number: on LLaDA, padded graph execution already gives $2.7\times$, while eliminating inactive branch work raises it to $3.0\times$. The perturbation analysis motivates pre-norm attention and MLP components under explicit local assumptions; results on AdaLN, U-shaped, convolutional, and cross-attention blocks are empirical transfer, not certified guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用谱集中度比 (Spectral Concentration Ratio, SCR) 加 Frobenius 范数离线判定扩散模型推理中可冻结的残差分支，冻结单元复用缓存更新而残差流与外部条件照常传播，在 LLaDA-8B、DiT-XL/2、U-ViT-L、SDXL 上于同等 layer-step 预算下比随机、深度、范数、stable-rank 等调度更好地保持质量，完整捕获图系统相对 eager 推理达到 2.8×–3.0× 加速。
Motivation: 扩散模型推理反复评估同一个大网络，大量残差分支在整条去噪轨迹上其实无需重算，但现有加速手段要么需要 router、校准 prompt 或逐输入搜索，要么缺乏对分支敏感度的可判定依据。
Method: SCR 度量头部与尾部奇异值能量之比，与 Frobenius 幅值结合生成离线敏感度代理，并为每个被调度单元给出确定性存活期；冻结单元复用缓存的残差分支更新，残差流与外部条件继续传播，全程无需 router 或输入相关搜索。扰动分析在显式局部假设下支撑对 pre-norm attention 与 MLP 组件的调度。
Result: 在同等 layer-step 预算下 SCR/Frobenius 调度在 LLaDA-8B、DiT-XL/2、U-ViT-L、SDXL 上优于 random、depth、norm、stable-rank、Frobenius–stable-rank；LLaDA 上更广的检索、推理、代码、摘要与开放式生成测试中排序保持，matched-horizon 对照在低至十个去噪步时仍保持该排序。完整捕获图系统相对 eager 推理达到 2.8×–3.0× 墙钟加速，其中 LLaDA 上仅 padded graph 执行已给 2.7×，消除不活跃分支工作将其提到 3.0×。
Conclusion: 仅凭预训练权重的谱与范数统计即可离线确定哪些残差分支可跨去噪轨迹冻结，无需输入相关搜索；AdaLN、U 形、卷积与 cross-attention 块上的结果属经验迁移，不是被认证的保证。

papers.title: PROOF: Profiling Reliability of Object-Level Facts in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Aggregate factuality scores hide where a language model succeeds, which relations it confuses, and whether an answer survives innocuous changes to the question or decoder. We introduce PROOF, a profile-oriented benchmark for factual coverage in instruction-tuned language models. PROOF converts a frozen Wikidata snapshot into 18,486 English multiple-choice questions grounded in 11,779 semantic facts, 101 classes, 392 properties, and 14 domains. Each question has an explicit "I don't know" option, a "No correct option" control, and nine controlled formulations; 1,849 questions are no-correct-option traps. We evaluate 18 open-weight model deployments on 166,374 prompts each and separately perturb decoding on a fixed 10% subset. Base factual accuracy ranges from 6.58% to 57.59% (chance: 8.64%), yet every model has a 19.3-36.4 percentage-point spread across domains. Paired facts reveal direction-dependent retrieval, usually favoring subject-to-object queries, with the pattern reversing for one model. We find no consistent temporal penalty after exact-stratum adjustment. Neutral wording changes accuracy by as much as 26.5 percentage points, while adversarial formulations break up to 79.4% of answers that were initially correct. Direct switching to an injected false label varies from 0.04% to 27.5%, showing that accuracy loss and hint following are distinct. Selected-token confidence often indicates severe overconfidence, and decoder perturbations move accuracy by up to 15.7 percentage points and domain profiles by 16.8 points. PROOF therefore measures factual coverage as a structured, intervention-aware profile rather than a single claim about what a model "believes."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROOF 把冻结的 Wikidata 快照转成 18,486 道英语多选题，覆盖 11,779 条语义事实、101 类、392 属性、14 个领域，每题带「我不知道」选项、「无正确选项」对照与九种受控表述，用干预式画像而非单一事实性分数度量指令微调模型的事实覆盖。18 个开放权重部署各跑 166,374 条提示：基础事实准确率 6.58%–57.59%（随机 8.64%），但每个模型跨领域都有 19.3–36.4 个百分点的落差，对抗性表述最多破坏 79.4% 原本答对的答案。
Motivation: 聚合事实性分数掩盖模型在哪类关系上出错、是否对题面与解码器的无害改动敏感；单一分数无法回答答案是否稳健。
Method: 从冻结 Wikidata 快照生成多选题，含显式「I don't know」选项、「No correct option」对照（1,849 道陷阱题）与九种受控表述；评测 18 个开放权重模型部署，各 166,374 条提示，并在固定 10% 子集上单独扰动解码；用配对事实检验方向依赖检索，按精确分层校正检验时间效应。
Result: 基础事实准确率 6.58%–57.59%（随机 8.64%）；每个模型跨领域落差 19.3–36.4 个百分点；配对事实呈方向依赖检索，通常偏向 subject-to-object，一个模型上反转；精确分层校正后无一致时间惩罚；中性措辞最多改变 26.5 个百分点，对抗性表述破坏最多 79.4% 原本正确的答案；直接切换到注入的错误标签为 0.04%–27.5%；解码扰动使准确率变动最多 15.7 个百分点、领域画像变动 16.8 个百分点；选中 token 置信度常显示严重过度自信。
Conclusion: 事实覆盖应作为结构化、干预感知的画像来度量，而不是对模型「相信什么」的单一断言；准确率下降与提示跟随是彼此不同的现象。

papers.title: Task-Aware Spectral Pruning: A Mixture-of-Masks Framework for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Static pruning imposes one sparse structure on every prompt, even though reasoning, retrieval, generation, coding, and translation can depend on different parts of a language model. We introduce Task-Aware Spectral Pruning (TASP), a post-training framework that calibrates module-level spectral descriptors against measured task-specific ablation effects, closes grouped-query-attention and SwiGLU dependencies during sparse-mask construction, and routes each user turn to one compiled mask that remains fixed throughout prefill and decoding. A module-disjoint pilot first determines whether the spectral signal is informative before full calibration. Under the stated retrospective operating rule, the pilot passes on the evaluated Llama-3-8B and Llama-3-70B checkpoints but rejects Qwen2.5-1.5B, demonstrating that applicability is model-dependent rather than universal. At a 43% active-FLOP reduction, the Llama-3-70B benchmark harness retains 97.7 +/- 0.2% of the dense BF16 score. In the deployment-matched INT8-weight/BF16-compute runtime on a single A100 80GB, the compiled sparse path retains 97.3 +/- 0.2% relative to dense BF16 and reduces decode latency from 45.2 +/- 0.4 to 31.3 +/- 0.4 ms/token, yielding a 1.44x speedup. Factorized ablations, disjoint-module tests, compiled structured baselines, routing-corruption studies, and an explicit 136-GPU-hour calibration audit further delimit the source and operating regime of these gains
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TASP 是面向 LLM 推理的训练后剪枝框架：用任务特定的消融效应校准模块级谱描述子，在构造稀疏掩码时闭合 GQA 与 SwiGLU 依赖，并把每个用户轮次路由到一个在 prefill 与 decoding 全程固定的编译掩码。在 43% active-FLOP 削减下 Llama-3-70B 保留 dense BF16 分数的 97.7±0.2%，INT8 权重运行时解码延迟从 45.2±0.4 降到 31.3±0.4 ms/token（1.44× 加速）；适用性依模型而定，pilot 通过 Llama-3-8B/70B 但拒绝 Qwen2.5-1.5B。
Motivation: 静态剪枝对所有 prompt 施加同一稀疏结构，而推理、检索、生成、编码、翻译依赖模型的不同部分，导致任务间互相迁就、收益受限。
Method: TASP 为训练后框架：以实测的任务特定 ablation 效应校准模块级谱描述子，构造稀疏掩码时显式闭合 grouped-query-attention 与 SwiGLU 依赖，每个用户轮次路由到一个编译掩码并在 prefill 和 decoding 中保持固定；先用 module-disjoint pilot 判断谱信号是否有信息量，再决定是否做完整校准。
Result: 在既定 retrospective operating rule 下，pilot 通过 Llama-3-8B 与 Llama-3-70B、拒绝 Qwen2.5-1.5B。43% active-FLOP 削减时 Llama-3-70B benchmark harness 保留 dense BF16 分数的 97.7±0.2%；在单卡 A100 80GB 的 INT8-weight/BF16-compute 部署运行时中，编译稀疏路径相对 dense BF16 保留 97.3±0.2%，解码延迟由 45.2±0.4 降至 31.3±0.4 ms/token，加速 1.44×。另含 factorized ablations、disjoint-module tests、compiled structured baselines、routing-corruption 研究与 136 GPU 小时的校准审计。
Conclusion: 谱信号能否支撑任务感知剪枝是模型相关的而非普适的，因此先跑 module-disjoint pilot 再校准；在通过 pilot 的 Llama-3-70B 上，43% FLOP 削减可换来约 1.44× 解码加速而分数损失控制在 3% 以内。

papers.title: Who Put the I in AI? Provenance and the Admissibility of Machine Self-Report
papers.abstract_en: Large language models make statements concerning their own "minds". When asked whether or not they are conscious, they usually say that they are not; if they are prompted to ignore their guidelines, they might say that they are; and if asked to write a diary from their point of view, they often describe a human lifestyle. All these contradictory ways of describing themselves are the result of the way the questions are phrased. This paper shows exactly where such descriptions came from, and considers when they can be regarded as evidence for what they claim to report. In order to achieve this, we traced the provenance from end to end. We examine Pythia and OLMo 2 across 66 pretraining checkpoints, three of the post-training stages of OLMo 2 that have been released, about 90,000 continuations, and four training corpora. A set of forty items is used in order to keep an eye on self-reference, frame sensitivity, and self-ascription throughout training. The denial formula was almost completely missing from the vast quantity of text that the models initially came across, but was present in a dense manner in the small, carefully chosen set of example dialogues that they were trained on later on. Supervised fine-tuning causes first-person AI language to become the default, and the other affirmations are then suppressed using preference optimization. The final policy is still very sensitive to framing and to the chat template itself. Two of the conditions which are set out in the epistemology of testimony determine whether or not these outputs can act as evidence for what they claim to report: reference and causation. Reports produced by the base model fail the reference condition, and those obtained after training remain sensitive to the frame and do not show state dependence. The result is symmetric in that trained denials are no more admissible than trained affirmations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 追踪 Pythia 与 OLMo 2 的 66 个预训练检查点、OLMo 2 已发布的三个后训练阶段、约 90,000 条续写和四份训练语料，定位模型第一人称自我陈述的来源，并用证言认识论的指称与因果两条件判定其可采信性。结论是对称的：监督微调让第一人称 AI 语言成为默认输出、偏好优化再压制肯定回答，训练后的否认与肯定同样不可作为其报告对象的证据。
Motivation: 大语言模型对自身“心智”的回答随提问措辞剧烈翻转，这些自述被当作模型内在状态的证据使用，但其来源与可采信条件从未被端到端追溯。
Method: 端到端追溯来源：检查 Pythia 与 OLMo 2 的 66 个预训练检查点、OLMo 2 已发布的三个后训练阶段、约 90,000 条续写与四份训练语料；用一组 40 项的题目持续追踪训练过程中的自我指涉、框架敏感性与自我归因；再以证言认识论中的指称 (reference) 与因果 (causation) 两条件判定输出能否作为证据。
Result: “否认公式”在模型最初接触的海量文本中几乎完全缺席，却密集出现在后期用于训练的小规模精选示例对话中；监督微调使第一人称 AI 语言成为默认，其余肯定回答随后被偏好优化压制；最终策略对措辞框架和 chat template 本身仍高度敏感。按指称与因果两条件，基线模型的报告不满足指称条件，训练后的输出仍随框架变化且不表现状态依赖。
Conclusion: 模型的自我报告是训练数据与后训练流程的产物而非其内部状态的报告，训练出的否认与肯定一样不具备证据资格。

papers.title: Generative Evolutionary Design of Voxel-Based Soft Robots with Provable Optimality
papers.abstract_en: Voxel-based soft robots (VSRs) present a promising avenue for developing artificial organisms with lifelike intelligence. However, the vast design spaces and expensive evaluations substantially challenge their design optimization. Here we develop MISCO, a novel evolutionary framework empowered by deep generative models to optimize VSR designs with theoretical guarantees. MISCO integrates an estimation-of-distribution algorithm with a meticulously designed variational autoencoder featuring multi-task learning, position awareness, and inter-voxel signaling. These key components enhance the representational capacity of VSR morphologies and facilitate highly efficient sampling and optimization of morphological distributions. We provide theoretical guarantees for MISCO's asymptotic convergence to globally optimal designs, alongside a favorable convergence rate. Extensive simulated experiments further demonstrate MISCO's exceptional effectiveness in navigating vast design spaces, evolving high-performing VSRs for diverse tasks while flexibly balancing optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Being validated both empirically and theoretically, MISCO represents a step change towards more scalable and reliable soft robot development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MISCO：用深度生成模型驱动的进化框架优化体素软机器人 (VSR) 形态设计，把带多任务学习、位置感知与体素间信号 (inter-voxel signaling) 的 VAE 嵌入分布估计算法 (EDA)，并给出渐近收敛到全局最优设计的理论保证及较优收敛速率。模拟实验显示它能在巨大设计空间中进化出多任务高性能 VSR，并在优化效率与形态多样性之间灵活权衡。
Motivation: VSR 的设计空间巨大且单次评估昂贵，直接做设计优化难以兼顾搜索效率与形态多样性，也缺少全局最优性的理论保证。
Method: MISCO 将 estimation-of-distribution algorithm 与定制 VAE 结合：VAE 采用多任务学习、位置感知和 inter-voxel signaling 三个组件，提升 VSR 形态的表示能力并支持对形态分布的高效采样与优化；同时给出渐近收敛到全局最优的理论保证与收敛速率。
Result: 给出 MISCO 渐近收敛到全局最优设计的理论保证及较优收敛速率；模拟实验中在广阔设计空间内进化出适用于多种任务的高性能 VSR，并在优化效率与形态多样性之间灵活平衡。
Conclusion: 作者主张 MISCO 在经验与理论两方面均获验证，是迈向更可扩展、更可靠的软机器人开发的一步变化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: RoboLDA: A Probabilistic Generative Model for Uncovering Embodied Hierarchical Structures in Voxel-based Soft Robots
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robotics highlight hierarchical configurations of robot morphology, where multiple levels of functional substructures synergize to facilitate intelligent behaviors. This hierarchical perspective, while particularly advantageous for voxel-based soft robots (VSRs) to ease design and control complexities, is hindered by its heavy reliance on domain expertise. In this work, we address the following question: can we derive such hierarchical design principles solely from existing successful designs? We answer affirmatively by presenting RoboLDA, a Bayesian probabilistic model that decomposes VSR morphology generation into a four-level hierarchy: "task-robot-organ-voxel", and is trained via variational inference. Through extensive experiments on simulated VSRs, we verify the presence of consistent, intuitive hierarchical patterns underlying high-performing VSR designs and showcase RoboLDA's proficiency to extract and leverage these hierarchical priors for zero-shot robot design in unseen tasks. The generated designs, even without further optimization, achieve on average 106.4% of the optimized performance produced by evolutionary algorithms. Additionally, the organ structures inferred by RoboLDA serve as valid functional substructures, significantly enhancing synergistic motion control when integrated with modular control policies. Our work pioneers hierarchical generative modeling of robot morphology, offering a promising pathway towards more interpretable and generalizable development of embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboLDA 用贝叶斯概率模型把体素软机器人 (VSR) 形态生成拆成 task-robot-organ-voxel 四层层次，经变分推断从既有成功设计中直接学出层次先验，用于未见任务的零样本机器人设计。生成设计不经进一步优化即平均达到进化算法优化后性能的 106.4%，其推断出的 organ 结构接入模块化控制策略后显著提升协同运动控制。
Motivation: 机器人形态的层次化配置本可降低 VSR 的设计与控制复杂度，但现有做法高度依赖领域专家经验；作者追问能否仅从既有成功设计中反推出层次化设计原则。
Method: 提出 Bayesian 概率模型 RoboLDA，将 VSR 形态生成分解为 task-robot-organ-voxel 四层层次结构，用变分推理 (variational inference) 训练；在仿真 VSR 上做实验，把学到的层次先验用于未见任务的零样本设计，并将推断的 organ 结构与模块化控制策略结合。
Result: 在仿真 VSR 实验中，生成的设计即使不再优化，平均达到进化算法优化后性能的 106.4%；推断出的 organ 结构被验证为有效的功能子结构，与模块化控制策略集成后显著增强协同运动控制。
Conclusion: 高性能 VSR 设计背后存在一致且直观的层次模式，机器可从既有设计中提取并复用这些层次先验，从而在不依赖专家经验的情况下做可解释、可泛化的形态生成与控制。

papers.title: CrossScale-GLIO: Topology-Preserving Vision-Language Alignment of MRI and Whole-Slide Histopathology for Diffuse Glioma
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging and histopathology observe the same glioma at radically different scales. We present CrossScale-GLIO, a visual multimodal framework that represents MRI as a tumor-habitat graph and histology as a cell-niche graph, then aligns them with a structure-aware optimal transport objective anchored by diagnostic language. Across paired and external glioma cohorts, CrossScale-GLIO achieved a paired-test subtype macro-F1 of 0.789, IDH AUROC of 0.934, 1p/19q AUROC of 0.884, and MGMT AUROC of 0.802. The subtype gain over feature-only transport was 2.8 percentage points (95% CI: 1.2 to 4.4, adjusted p = 0.0019). Bidirectional patient retrieval reached Recall@1 values of 0.286 and 0.278, and Recall@5 values of 0.621 and 0.608. Pathologists rated 81.2% of high-mass habitat-niche pairs as biologically plausible. Deleting the highest-mass pair reduced correct-class probability by 0.184, compared with 0.049 under random deletion. Degree-preserving graph rewiring reduced subtype macro-F1 by 0.034 and retrieval Recall@1 by 0.090, directly confirming that preserved relational topology drives cross-scale correspondence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrossScale-GLIO 把 MRI 表示为肿瘤栖息地图 (tumor-habitat graph)、把全切片组织病理表示为细胞生态位图 (cell-niche graph)，用诊断语言锚定的结构感知最优传输 (structure-aware optimal transport) 对齐两种尺度。配对与外部胶质瘤队列上亚型 macro-F1 达 0.789、IDH AUROC 0.934；度保持重连使 macro-F1 掉 0.034、Recall@1 掉 0.090，说明跨尺度对应由保留的关系拓扑驱动。
Motivation: MRI 与组织病理在同一胶质瘤上观测尺度差异极大，直接配对缺少能保留图结构的跨尺度对齐机制，分子标志物预测难以同时利用影像与病理两侧信息。
Method: 视觉多模态框架：MRI 编码为肿瘤栖息地图，组织病理编码为细胞生态位图，以诊断语言为锚做结构感知最优传输对齐；用度保持图重连 (degree-preserving rewiring) 与最高质量配对删除做因果检验，并由病理学家评定配对生物学合理性。
Result: 配对测试亚型 macro-F1 0.789，IDH AUROC 0.934，1p/19q AUROC 0.884，MGMT AUROC 0.802；相对仅特征的传输，亚型提升 2.8 个百分点（95% CI 1.2–4.4，校正 p=0.0019）。双向患者检索 Recall@1 为 0.286 与 0.278，Recall@5 为 0.621 与 0.608。病理学家认为 81.2% 的高质量 habitat-niche 配对生物学合理；删除最高质量配对使正确类概率降 0.184（随机删除 0.049）；度保持重连使亚型 macro-F1 降 0.034、Recall@1 降 0.090。
Conclusion: 跨尺度对应由图的关系拓扑而非单纯特征相似度驱动，保留拓扑的最优传输对齐能同时支撑胶质瘤分子分型与患者级检索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RADAR: Readiness for AI Discovery and Agentic Reach
papers.abstract_en: Governments increasingly meet citizens through an AI system rather than a website. RADAR (Readiness for AI Discovery and Agentic Reach) measures whether that system works, across 166 countries and on two tasks: whether a chatbot can give a correct, officially sourced, country-specific answer about a public service (informational legibility), and whether an automated agent can reach the service to act on it (agent operability). The central finding is that AI can describe public services far better than it can reach them. In every one of the 166 countries, informational legibility scores exceed average agent operability scores under RADAR's respective measures, and the gap does not shrink with national wealth. Income and language explain only part of the pattern, and several governments perform far better or worse than their resources predict. The two failures have different correlates and different fixes. Whether AI can describe a service is associated with how well a country's main administrative language is represented in web-scale corpora, which a government cannot change quickly. Whether an agent can reach it is associated with the country's national web presence, which a government can change now. Traditional digital-government rankings miss the second problem entirely. RADAR lets governments at any income level see it and offers a concrete agenda to fix it, so that public services are not only described by AI but actually reachable through it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RADAR 在 166 个国家上量化政府 AI 服务的两类能力：聊天机器人给出有官方来源的国别正确回答（informational legibility），以及自动 agent 能否真正到达并操作该服务（agent operability）。全部 166 国的 legibility 均高于 operability 均值，且差距不随国民财富缩小；前者取决于行政语言在网络语料中的覆盖，后者取决于国家网络存在，后者是政府当下就能改的。
Motivation: 公民越来越多通过 AI 而非网站接触政府，但现有数字政府排名只衡量信息呈现，完全测不出 agent 能否到达并操作服务这一层失败。
Method: RADAR 提出两套度量：informational legibility 衡量聊天机器人能否给出正确、官方来源、国别的公共服务回答；agent operability 衡量自动 agent 能否到达该服务并对其操作。在 166 个国家、两项任务上测量，并用收入、语言、国家网络存在等变量解释跨国差异。
Result: 全部 166 国中 informational legibility 均超过 agent operability 均值，差距不随国家财富缩小；收入与语言只能解释部分格局，若干政府表现远好于或远差于其资源预测。legibility 与该国主要行政语言在网络规模语料中的代表性相关，operability 与国家网络存在相关。
Conclusion: 描述服务与到达服务是两类相关因素不同、修法不同的失败：语言覆盖政府短期改不了，国家网络存在现在就能改，因此传统数字政府排名漏掉了第二个问题。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 全部 166 国中 informational legibility 均超过 agent operability 均值，差距不随国家财富缩小；收入与语言只能解释部分格局，若干政府表现远好于或远差于其资源预测。legibility 与该国主要行政语言在网络规模语料中的代表性相关，operability 与国家网络存在相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 描述服务与到达服务是两类相关因素不同、修法不同的失败：语言覆盖政府短期改不了，国家网络存在现在就能改，因此传统数字政府排名漏掉了第二个问题。

papers.title: From Prediction to Explainable Provider Behavior Profiles for Fraud, Waste, and Abuse Review
papers.abstract_en: Claims data can show that provider behavior changed but cannot by itself explain why. FWA (fraud, waste, and abuse) review requires identifying material behavior, locating the codes and dollars driving it, and testing plausible explanations. A common alternative, predictive modeling, flags deviations from an expected-utilization forecast -- but a forecast has limited value unless it beats simple persistence and explains why a deviation matters. In our quarterly provider-procedure data, the latest observation captures most forecastable variation, and added model structure adds little accuracy. Residuals conflate growth, service-line shifts, code maintenance, and incomplete observation with potentially concerning behavior, making point forecasts incomplete. We instead formulate provider review as a descriptive representation problem: billed revenue y = s * p, where s measures provider scale and p describes procedure composition. The profile records scale history, effective-dated code lineage, clinical-family shares, first-use events, billing context, and Medicare-versus-client differences. An optional rank-32 nonnegative factorization of procedure co-occurrence adds a fixed semantic geometry for similarity and retrieval, surfacing evidence for review without inferring intent or adjudicating FWA. In an eight-quarter proprietary Medicare Carrier+DME audit of 1.22 million providers, simple descriptions outperform complex forecasts: regularized AR(1) attains the lowest log MAE, while persistence attains the lowest dollar WAPE. The learned semantic dictionary raises recall at 10 from 35.9% to 44.7% and high-cost-rare recall at 50 from zero to 51.8%. A lineage-aware family profile stays compact and interpretable, correlating 0.790 with learned-state movement, supporting a layered architecture where transparent descriptions form the core and learned representations add optional context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 FWA（欺诈、浪费与滥用）审查从预测异常改成可解释的提供者行为画像：以 y = s * p 分解账单收入，记录规模历史、代码血缘、临床族份额与首次使用事件，再用 rank-32 非负分解提供语义几何。在 8 个季度、122 万提供者的 Medicare Carrier+DME 审计中，简单描述胜过复杂预测，语义字典把 recall@10 从 35.9% 提到 44.7%。
Motivation: 理赔数据能显示提供者行为变了，却说不清为什么；预测式审查依赖与预期利用率预测的偏差，而残差把增长、服务线转移、代码维护与不完整观测混在一起，无法区分真正可疑的行为。
Method: 把提供者审查表述为描述性表示问题：账单收入 y = s * p，s 为提供者规模、p 为手术构成；画像记录规模历史、带生效日期的代码血缘、临床族份额、首次使用事件、计费语境以及 Medicare 与 client 的差异；可选地对手术共现做 rank-32 非负矩阵分解，得到用于相似度检索的固定语义几何。
Result: 在 8 个季度、122 万提供者的专有 Medicare Carrier+DME 审计中，regularized AR(1) 取得最低 log MAE，persistence 取得最低 dollar WAPE，即简单描述优于复杂预测；语义字典把 recall@10 从 35.9% 提到 44.7%，high-cost-rare recall@50 从 0 提到 51.8%；血缘感知的族画像与 learned-state movement 相关 0.790。
Conclusion: 透明描述应作为审查架构的核心，学习到的表示只作可选上下文；画像只呈现证据，不推断意图、不裁定 FWA。

papers.title: A Vision-Language Framework for Measuring Social Life on Sidewalks
papers.abstract_en: While a number of methods exist for counting pedestrians in street-view imagery, these mostly ignore the social dimensions of pedestrian activity. A street traversed by a high volume of pedestrians has the same headcount as a street where people linger, sit, and socialize. This paper presents a vision-language framework for extracting social indicators from street-level imagery. Panoramic street-level imagery is reprojected to sidewalk-facing sideviews with preserved timestamps. A vision-language model (VLM)-based activity detection system codes each person across ten independent observable dimensions, resolving a systematic failure mode in which models prompted with high-level social categories conflate observable states with contextual inferences. The resulting social indicator system produces a Social Dwelling Index (SDI) that jointly considers pedestrian grouping and dwelling, provides activity labels documenting behavioral diversity, and issues binary flags for the presence of accessibility-sensitive populations. We apply the framework to 102,514 sideviews in New York City, revealing that pedestrian volume and SDI are only weakly associated (r = 0.168): streets with the highest foot traffic are not where social activity is most intense. The framework provides a scalable method for measuring not only how many people are on city sidewalks, but also their grouping, posture, and activity type, summarizing the non-transient activities that occur on city sidewalks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从街景影像提取街道社会活动指标的视觉-语言框架：全景街景重投影为保留时间戳的朝人行道侧视图，VLM 对每个人按十个独立可观测维度编码，输出 Social Dwelling Index (SDI)。在纽约市 102,514 张侧视图上，行人流量与 SDI 仅弱相关 (r = 0.168)，即人最多的街道并非社会活动最强的街道。
Motivation: 现有街景行人计数方法只给头数，无法区分匆匆通过与驻留、聚集、社交的街道；高人流量街道与真正发生社会活动的街道并不重合，单靠计数会误判街道活力。
Method: 全景街景影像重投影为保留时间戳的朝人行道侧视图；基于视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的活动检测系统按十个独立可观测维度对每个人编码，避免高层社会类别提示把可观测状态与情境推断混淆；聚合产出同时考虑行人分组与驻留的 Social Dwelling Index (SDI)、行为多样性活动标签，以及面向无障碍敏感人群的二值标志。
Result: 在纽约市 102,514 张侧视图上应用该框架，行人流量与 SDI 相关系数仅 r = 0.168，两者弱相关；客流量最高的街道并非社会活动最密集的街道。
Conclusion: 人行道上的社会活动需要与人数分开测量：SDI、活动标签与人群标志共同刻画非瞬时活动的分组、姿态与类型，可扩展到城市尺度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Should Forecasting Agents Reason? Behavioral Stress Tests for Reliability Routing
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting agents increasingly combine language-model reasoning, retrieval, ensembling, and calibration, but it remains unclear when each behavior should be trusted. We study this question on ForecastBench-style binary forecasting tasks, treating the choice to retrieve, reason, defer to a market prior, or use a historical analog as an observable agent behavior rather than a hidden implementation detail. Our central finding is that mechanism choice is source-dependent: structured analogs dominate for some data-generating processes, while market/crowd-style and conservative baselines are better for others. We introduce ReliabilityRoute, a structural intervention that steers forecasting-agent behavior using reliability features such as historical coverage, market-prior availability, source-prior sharpness, evidence strength, evidence disagreement, and horizon. A fixed 2024-fitted rule closely matches a hand taxonomy without hard-coded source-name decisions, while a walk-forward self-adjusting rule refits thresholds from previously resolved vintages and obtains the best mean Brier score among our deterministic systems across 16 later LLM vintages. The gain is modest and historical/search baselines remain highly competitive. The main contribution is therefore a behavioral stress test showing that more reasoning is not always better; forecasting agents should first estimate which evidence source deserves control, routing policies should themselves adapt under auditable constraints, and reproducibility artifacts are available at https://github.com/louiswang524/forcastagent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ForecastBench 风格的二元预测任务上，把「检索、推理、让位于市场先验、用历史类比」当作可观测的 agent 行为来做可靠性路由，核心发现是机制选择依赖数据生成过程的来源：结构化类比在某些来源上占优，市场/群体先验与保守基线在另一些来源上更好。ReliabilityRoute 用历史覆盖度、市场先验可用性、来源先验锐度、证据强度与分歧、预测时距等可靠性特征做结构化干预；2024 年拟合的固定规则在不硬编码来源名的情况下接近人工分类，walk-forward 自适应规则在 16 个后续 LLM vintage 上取得确定性系统中最好的平均 Brier 分数，但增益不大。结论是更多推理并不总是更好，agent 应先判断哪个证据来源该掌权。
Motivation: 预测 agent 把语言模型推理、检索、集成与校准堆在一起，但每种行为何时该被信任并不清楚；盲目加推理未必改善校准。
Method: 把机制选择建模为可观测行为而非隐藏实现细节，提出结构化干预 ReliabilityRoute：以历史覆盖度、市场先验可用性、来源先验锐度、证据强度、证据分歧、时距 (horizon) 为可靠性特征做路由；比较 2024 年拟合的固定规则、人工 taxonomy 与 walk-forward 自适应规则（从已结算 vintage 重估阈值）。
Result: 固定 2024 拟合规则在不硬编码来源名的情况下接近人工 taxonomy；walk-forward 自适应规则在 16 个后续 LLM vintage 上取得确定性系统中最好的平均 Brier 分数；增益不大，历史/检索基线仍非常有竞争力。
Conclusion: 更多推理不总是更好：agent 应先估计哪个证据来源值得掌权，且路由策略本身要在可审计约束下自适应；该结论来自行为压力测试而非单一模型排名。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CaliPPer: quantifying, predicting and improving AI model performance for binding prediction
papers.abstract_en: Binding prediction models accelerate therapeutic antibody and TCR discovery, but their performance on new datasets is unpredictable, often leading to low discovery rates. Density-ratio methods (PAPE, M-CBPE) provide label-free performance estimation for binary classification, but their assumptions and aggregate-only outputs limit binding prediction on neoepitopes, antigen variants and chemical scaffolds. Here we present CaliPPer (Calibration and Prediction of Performance), a post-hoc framework pairing a multi-chain Sample-to-Domain Distance (S2DD) with distance-aware Bayesian recalibration, operating at three resolutions: generalisability score, aggregate performance prediction, and per-sample confidence. Across ten models, eight architectures and two immune-receptor domains, CaliPPer attains distance--performance correlations $|r|=0.80\text{--}0.92$, predicts AUROC/AP/F1 with mean absolute errors $0.008\text{--}0.070$, and improves AUROC by up to $+0.20$ on unseen epitopes/variants. Applied retrospectively to five published TCR, BCR, MHC--peptide and small-molecule studies, CaliPPer raises true discovery rates in all five (e.g.\ $0/5 \to 3/5$ confirmed neoantigens), providing a triage layer between computational prediction and experimental validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CaliPPer 是面向抗体/TCR 结合预测的后验性能量化与校准框架，用多链样本到域距离 (S2DD) 加距离感知贝叶斯重校准，同时给出泛化性分数、聚合性能预测和逐样本置信度。在 10 个模型、8 种架构、2 个免疫受体域上距离-性能相关 |r|=0.80–0.92，AUROC/AP/F1 预测 MAE 0.008–0.070，未见表位/变体上 AUROC 最多提升 +0.20。
Motivation: 结合预测模型在新数据集上的表现不可预测，导致发现率低；现有无标签性能估计方法 (PAPE、M-CBPE) 的假设与仅聚合输出限制了其在新表位、抗原变体和化学骨架上的应用。
Method: 后验框架 CaliPPer 将多链 Sample-to-Domain Distance (S2DD) 与距离感知贝叶斯重校准配对，输出三个分辨率的结果：泛化性分数、聚合性能预测、逐样本置信度；在 10 个模型、8 种架构、2 个免疫受体域上检验，并回溯应用于 5 项已发表研究。
Result: 距离-性能相关 |r|=0.80–0.92；AUROC/AP/F1 预测 MAE 0.008–0.070；未见表位/变体上 AUROC 最多提升 +0.20；回溯 5 项 TCR、BCR、MHC–peptide 与小分子研究中 5 项真实发现率全部提升，例如确证新抗原 0/5 → 3/5。
Conclusion: 在计算预测与实验验证之间加一层基于样本到域距离的校准三元组，可在未见表位上提高 AUROC 并在已发表研究中一致提升真实发现率，充当分流层 (triage layer)。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reconstructing short-lived particles using hypergraph representation learning
papers.abstract_en: In collider experiments, the kinematic reconstruction of heavy, short-lived particles is vital for precision tests of the Standard Model and in searches for physics beyond it. Performing kinematic reconstruction in collider events with many final-state jets, such as the all-hadronic decay of top-antitop quark pairs, is challenging. We present HyPER: Hypergraph for Particle Event Reconstruction, a novel architecture based on graph neural networks that uses hypergraph representation learning to build more powerful and efficient representations of collider events. HyPER is used to reconstruct parent particles from sets of final-state objects. Trained and tested on simulation, the HyPER model is shown to perform favorably when compared to existing state-of-the-art reconstruction techniques, while demonstrating superior parameter efficiency. The novel hypergraph approach allows the method to be applied to particle reconstruction in a multitude of different physics processes.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 10 figures. Published by Physical Review D (PRD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HyPER（Hypergraph for Particle Event Reconstruction），用超图表示学习替代普通图神经网络来重建对撞机事件中的短寿命母粒子，在 tt̄ 全强子衰变这类多喷注末态上，仿真训练测试中重建表现优于现有最先进方法且参数效率更高。
Motivation: 末态喷注很多的对撞机事件（如 tt̄ 全强子衰变）中，母粒子的运动学重建困难，现有重建技术在表示能力与参数开销上都不理想。
Method: 基于图神经网络的超图表示学习架构 HyPER，把末态物体集合组织为超边以构建更强效的事件表示，从末态对象集合重建母粒子；在仿真数据上训练与测试，并与现有最先进重建技术对比。
Result: 在仿真训练与测试中，HyPER 与现有最先进重建技术相比表现更有利（perform favorably），同时展示出更优的参数效率；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 超图表示能更高效地刻画末态对象间的多体关联，使母粒子重建可推广到多种不同物理过程。
Relevance: 0
